translation:
A, as its first of letters, every speech maintains; The "Primal Deity" is first through all the world's domains

Meaning: As the letter A is the first of all letters, so the eternal God is first in the world
pope_couplet: A, as its first of letters, every speech maintains; The "Primal Deity" is first through all the world's domains
explanation_en: As the letter A is the first of all letters, so the eternal God is first in the world
explanation_ta: எழுத்துக்கள் எல்லாம் அகரத்தை அடிப்படையாக கொண்டிருக்கின்றன. அதுபோல உலகம் கடவுளை அடிப்படையாக கொண்டிருக்கிறது.

translation:
No fruit have men of all their studied lore, Save they the 'Purely Wise One's' feet adore

Meaning: What Profit have those derived from learning, who worship not the good feet of Him who is possessed of pure knowledge ?
pope_couplet: No fruit have men of all their studied lore, Save they the 'Purely Wise One's' feet adore
explanation_en: What Profit have those derived from learning, who worship not the good feet of Him who is possessed of pure knowledge ?
explanation_ta: தூய அறிவு வடிவாக விளங்கும் இறைவனுடைய நல்ல திருவடிகளை தொழாமல் இருப்பாரானால், அவர் கற்ற கல்வியினால் ஆகிய பயன் என்ன?

translation:
His feet, 'Who o'er the full-blown flower hath past,' who gainIn bliss long time shall dwell above this earthly plain

Meaning: They who are united to the glorious feet of Him who passes swiftly over the flower of the mind, shall flourish long above all worlds
pope_couplet: His feet, 'Who o'er the full-blown flower hath past,' who gainIn bliss long time shall dwell above this earthly plain
explanation_en: They who are united to the glorious feet of Him who passes swiftly over the flower of the mind, shall flourish long above all worlds
explanation_ta: அன்பரின் அகமாகிய மலரில் வீற்றிருக்கும் கடவுளின் சிறந்த திருவடிகளை பொருந்தி நினைக்கின்றவர், இன்ப உலகில் நிலைத்து வாழ்வார்

translation:
His foot, 'Whom want affects not, irks not grief,' who gainShall not, through every time, of any woes complain

Meaning: To those who meditate the feet of Him who is void of desire or aversion, evil shall never come
pope_couplet: His foot, 'Whom want affects not, irks not grief,' who gainShall not, through every time, of any woes complain
explanation_en: To those who meditate the feet of Him who is void of desire or aversion, evil shall never come
explanation_ta: விருப்பு வெறுப்பு இல்லாத கடவுளின் திருவடிகளை பொருந்தி நினைக்கின்றவர்க்கு எப்போதும் எவ்விடத்திலும் துன்பம் இல்லை

translation:
The men, who on the 'King's' true praised delight to dwell, Affects not them the fruit of deeds done ill or well

Meaning: The two-fold deeds that spring from darkness shall not adhere to those who delight in the true praise of God
pope_couplet: The men, who on the 'King's' true praised delight to dwell, Affects not them the fruit of deeds done ill or well
explanation_en: The two-fold deeds that spring from darkness shall not adhere to those who delight in the true praise of God
explanation_ta: கடவுளின் உண்மைப் புகழை விரும்பி அன்பு செலுத்துகின்றவரிடம் அறியாமையால் விளையும் இருவகை வினையும் சேர்வதில்லை

translation:
Long live they blest, who 've stood in path from falsehood freed; His, 'Who quenched lusts that from the sense-gates five proceed'

Meaning: Those shall long proposer who abide in the faultless way of Him who has destroyed the five desires of the senses
pope_couplet: Long live they blest, who 've stood in path from falsehood freed; His, 'Who quenched lusts that from the sense-gates five proceed'
explanation_en: Those shall long proposer who abide in the faultless way of Him who has destroyed the five desires of the senses
explanation_ta: ஐம்பொறி வாயிலாக பிறக்கும் வேட்கைகளை அவித்த இறைவனுடைய பொய்யற்ற ஒழுக்க நெறியில் நின்றவர், நிலை பெற்ற நல்வாழ்க்கை வாழ்வர்

translation:
Unless His foot, 'to Whom none can compare,' men gain,'Tis hard for mind to find relief from anxious pain

Meaning: Anxiety of mind cannot be removed, except from those who are united to the feet of Him who is incomparable
pope_couplet: Unless His foot, 'to Whom none can compare,' men gain,'Tis hard for mind to find relief from anxious pain
explanation_en: Anxiety of mind cannot be removed, except from those who are united to the feet of Him who is incomparable
explanation_ta: தனக்கு ஒப்புமை இல்லாத தலைவனுடைய திருவடிகளைப் பொருந்தி நினைக்கின்றவர் அல்லாமல், மற்றவர்க்கு மனக்கவலையை மாற்ற முடியாது

translation:
Unless His feet 'the Sea of Good, the Fair and Bountiful,' men gain,'Tis hard the further bank of being's changeful sea to attain

Meaning: None can swim the sea of vice, but those who are united to the feet of that gracious Being who is a sea of virtue
pope_couplet: Unless His feet 'the Sea of Good, the Fair and Bountiful,' men gain,'Tis hard the further bank of being's changeful sea to attain
explanation_en: None can swim the sea of vice, but those who are united to the feet of that gracious Being who is a sea of virtue
explanation_ta: அறக்கடலாக விளங்கும் கடவுளின் திருவடிகளைப் பொருந்தி நினைக்கின்றவர் அல்லாமல், மற்றவர் பொருளும் இன்பமுமாகிய மற்ற கடல்களைக் கடக்க முடியாது

translation:
Before His foot, 'the Eight-fold Excellence,' with unbent head, Who stands, like palsied sense, is to all living functions dead

Meaning: The head that worships not the feet of Him who is possessed of eight attributes, is as useless as a sense without the power of sensation
pope_couplet: Before His foot, 'the Eight-fold Excellence,' with unbent head, Who stands, like palsied sense, is to all living functions dead
explanation_en: The head that worships not the feet of Him who is possessed of eight attributes, is as useless as a sense without the power of sensation
explanation_ta: கேட்காதசெவி, பார்க்காத கண் போன்ற எண் குணங்களை உடைய கடவுளின் திருவடிகளை வணங்காதவரின் தலைகள் பயனற்றவைகளாம்

translation:
They swim the sea of births, the 'Monarch's' foot who gain; None others reach the shore of being's mighty main

Meaning: None can swim the great sea of births but those who are united to the feet of God
pope_couplet: They swim the sea of births, the 'Monarch's' foot who gain; None others reach the shore of being's mighty main
explanation_en: None can swim the great sea of births but those who are united to the feet of God
explanation_ta: இறைவனுடைய திருவடிகளை பொருந்தி நினைக்கின்றவர் பிறவியாகிய பெரிய கடலைக் கடக்க முடியும். மற்றவர் கடக்க முடியாது

translation:
The world its course maintains through life that rain unfailing gives; Thus rain is known the true ambrosial food of all that lives

Meaning: By the continuance of rain the world is preserved in existence; it is therefore worthy to be called ambrosia
pope_couplet: The world its course maintains through life that rain unfailing gives; Thus rain is known the true ambrosial food of all that lives
explanation_en: By the continuance of rain the world is preserved in existence; it is therefore worthy to be called ambrosia
explanation_ta: மழை பெய்ய உலகம் வாழ்ந்து வருவதால், மழையானது உலகத்து வாழும் உயிர்களுக்கு அமிழ்தம் என்று உணரத்தக்கதாகும்

translation:
The rain makes pleasant food for eaters rise; As food itself, thirst-quenching draught supplies

Meaning: Rain produces good food, and is itself food
pope_couplet: The rain makes pleasant food for eaters rise; As food itself, thirst-quenching draught supplies
explanation_en: Rain produces good food, and is itself food
explanation_ta: உண்பவர்க்குத் தக்க உணவுப் பொருள்களை விளைவித்துத் தருவதோடு, பருகுவோர்க்குத் தானும் ஓர் உணவாக இருப்பது மழையாகும்

translation:
If clouds, that promised rain, deceive, and in the sky remain, Famine, sore torment, stalks o'er earth's vast ocean-girdled plain

Meaning: If the cloud, withholding rain, deceive (our hopes) hunger will long distress the sea-girt spacious world
pope_couplet: If clouds, that promised rain, deceive, and in the sky remain, Famine, sore torment, stalks o'er earth's vast ocean-girdled plain
explanation_en: If the cloud, withholding rain, deceive (our hopes) hunger will long distress the sea-girt spacious world
explanation_ta: மழை பெய்யாமல் பொய்படுமானால், கடல் சூழ்ந்த அகன்ற உலகமாக இருந்தும் பசி உள்ளே நிலைத்து நின்று உயிர்களை வருத்தும்

translation:
If clouds their wealth of waters fail on earth to pour, The ploughers plough with oxen's sturdy team no more

Meaning: If the abundance of wealth imparting rain diminish, the labour of the plough must cease
pope_couplet: If clouds their wealth of waters fail on earth to pour, The ploughers plough with oxen's sturdy team no more
explanation_en: If the abundance of wealth imparting rain diminish, the labour of the plough must cease
explanation_ta: மழை என்னும் வருவாய் வளம் குன்றி விட்டால், ( உணவுப் பொருள்களை உண்டாக்கும்) உழவரும் ஏர் கொண்டு உழமாட்டார்

translation:
'Tis rain works all: it ruin spreads, then timely aid supplies; As, in the happy days before, it bids the ruined rise

Meaning: Rain by its absence ruins men; and by its existence restores them to fortune
pope_couplet: 'Tis rain works all: it ruin spreads, then timely aid supplies; As, in the happy days before, it bids the ruined rise
explanation_en: Rain by its absence ruins men; and by its existence restores them to fortune
explanation_ta: பெய்யாமல் வாழ்வைக் கெடுக்க வல்லதும் மழை; மழையில்லாமல் வளம் கெட்டு நொந்தவர்க்கும் துணையாய் அவ்வாறே காக்க வல்லதும் மழையாகும்

translation:
If from the clouds no drops of rain are shed'Tis rare to see green herb lift up its head

Meaning: If no drop falls from the clouds, not even the green blade of grass will be seen
pope_couplet: If from the clouds no drops of rain are shed'Tis rare to see green herb lift up its head
explanation_en: If no drop falls from the clouds, not even the green blade of grass will be seen
explanation_ta: வானத்திலிருந்து மழைத்துளி வீழ்ந்தால் அல்லாமல், உலகத்தில் ஓரறிவுயிராகிய பசும்புல்லின் தலையையும் காண முடியாது

translation:
If clouds restrain their gifts and grant no rain, The treasures fail in ocean's wide domain

Meaning: Even the wealth of the wide sea will be diminished, if the cloud that has drawn (its waters) up gives them not back again (in rain)
pope_couplet: If clouds restrain their gifts and grant no rain, The treasures fail in ocean's wide domain
explanation_en: Even the wealth of the wide sea will be diminished, if the cloud that has drawn (its waters) up gives them not back again (in rain)
explanation_ta: மேகம் கடலிலிருந்து நீரைக் கொண்டு அதனிடத்திலேயே பெய்யாமல் விடுமானால், பெரிய கடலும் தன் வளம் குன்றிப் போகும்

translation:
If heaven grow dry, with feast and offering never more, Will men on earth the heavenly ones adore

Meaning: If the heaven dry up, neither yearly festivals, nor daily worship will be offered in this world, to the celestials
pope_couplet: If heaven grow dry, with feast and offering never more, Will men on earth the heavenly ones adore
explanation_en: If the heaven dry up, neither yearly festivals, nor daily worship will be offered in this world, to the celestials
explanation_ta: மழை பெய்யாமல் போகுமானால் இவ்வுலகத்தில் வானோர்க்காக நடைபெறும் திருவிழாவும் நடைபெறாது; நாள் வழிபாடும் நடைபெறாது

translation:
If heaven its watery treasures ceases to dispense, Through the wide world cease gifts, and deeds of 'penitence'

Meaning: If rain fall not, penance and alms-deeds will not dwell within this spacious world
pope_couplet: If heaven its watery treasures ceases to dispense, Through the wide world cease gifts, and deeds of 'penitence'
explanation_en: If rain fall not, penance and alms-deeds will not dwell within this spacious world
explanation_ta: மழை பெய்யவில்லையானால், இந்த பெரிய உலகத்தில் பிறர் பொருட்டு செய்யும் தானமும், தம் பொருட்டு செய்யும் தவமும் இல்லையாகும்.

translation:
When water fails, functions of nature cease, you say; Thus when rain fails, no men can walk in 'duty's ordered way'

Meaning: If it be said that the duties of life cannot be discharged by any person without water, so without rain there cannot be the flowing of water
pope_couplet: When water fails, functions of nature cease, you say; Thus when rain fails, no men can walk in 'duty's ordered way'
explanation_en: If it be said that the duties of life cannot be discharged by any person without water, so without rain there cannot be the flowing of water
explanation_ta: எப்படிப்பட்டவர்க்கும் நீர் இல்லாமல் உலக வாழ்க்கை நடைபெறாது என்றால், மழை இல்லையானால் ஒழுக்கமும் நிலைபெறாமல் போகும்

translation:
The settled rule of every code requires, as highest good, Their greatness who, renouncing all, true to their rule have stood

Meaning: The end and aim of all treatise is to extol beyond all other excellence, the greatness of those who, while abiding in the rule of conduct peculiar to their state, have abandoned all desire
pope_couplet: The settled rule of every code requires, as highest good, Their greatness who, renouncing all, true to their rule have stood
explanation_en: The end and aim of all treatise is to extol beyond all other excellence, the greatness of those who, while abiding in the rule of conduct peculiar to their state, have abandoned all desire
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கத்தில் நிலைத்து நின்று பற்று விட்டவர்களின் பெருமையைச் சிறந்ததாக போற்றி கூறுவதே நூல்களின் துணிவாகும்.

translation:
As counting those that from the earth have passed away,'Tis vain attempt the might of holy men to say

Meaning: To describe the measure of the greatness of those who have forsaken the two-fold desires, is like counting the dead
pope_couplet: As counting those that from the earth have passed away,'Tis vain attempt the might of holy men to say
explanation_en: To describe the measure of the greatness of those who have forsaken the two-fold desires, is like counting the dead
explanation_ta: பற்றுக்களைத் துறந்தவர்களின் பெருமையை அளந்து கூறுதல், உலகத்தில் இதுவரை பிறந்து இறந்தவர்களை கணக்கிடுவதைப்போன்றது.

translation:
Their greatness earth transcends, who, way of both worlds weighed, In this world take their stand, in virtue's robe arrayed

Meaning: The greatness of those who have discovered the properties of both states of being, and renounced the world, shines forth on earth (beyond all others)
pope_couplet: Their greatness earth transcends, who, way of both worlds weighed, In this world take their stand, in virtue's robe arrayed
explanation_en: The greatness of those who have discovered the properties of both states of being, and renounced the world, shines forth on earth (beyond all others)
explanation_ta: பிறப்பு வீடு என்பன போல் இரண்டிரண்டாக உள்ளவைகளின் கூறுபாடுகளை ஆராய்ந்தறிந்து அறத்தை மேற்கொண்டவரின் பெருமையே உலகத்தில் உயர்ந்தது

translation:
He, who with firmness, curb the five restrains, Is seed for soil of yonder happy plains

Meaning: He who guides his five senses by the hook of wisdom will be a seed in the world of heaven
pope_couplet: He, who with firmness, curb the five restrains, Is seed for soil of yonder happy plains
explanation_en: He who guides his five senses by the hook of wisdom will be a seed in the world of heaven
explanation_ta: அறிவு என்னும் கருவியினால் ஐம்பொறிகளாகிய யானைகளை அடக்கி காக்க வல்லவன், மேலான வீட்டிற்கு விதை போன்றவன்

translation:
Their might who have destroyed 'the five', shall soothly tellIndra, the lord of those in heaven's wide realms that dwell

Meaning: Indra, the king of the inhabitants of the spacious heaven, is himself, a sufficient proof of the strength of him who has subdued his five senses
pope_couplet: Their might who have destroyed 'the five', shall soothly tellIndra, the lord of those in heaven's wide realms that dwell
explanation_en: Indra, the king of the inhabitants of the spacious heaven, is himself, a sufficient proof of the strength of him who has subdued his five senses
explanation_ta: ஐந்து புலன்களாலாகும் ஆசைகளை ஒழித்தவனுடைய வல்லமைக்கு, வானுலகத்தாரின் தலைவனாகிய இந்திரனே போதுமான சான்று ஆவான்

translation:
Things hard in the doing will great men do; Things hard in the doing the mean eschew

Meaning: The great will do those things which is difficult to be done; but the mean cannot do them
pope_couplet: Things hard in the doing will great men do; Things hard in the doing the mean eschew
explanation_en: The great will do those things which is difficult to be done; but the mean cannot do them
explanation_ta: செய்வதற்கு அருமையான செயல்களை செய்ய வல்லவரே பெரியோர். செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல்களைச் செய்யமாட்டாதவர் சிறியோர்.

translation:
Taste, light, touch, sound, and smell: who knows the wayOf all the five,- the world submissive owns his sway

Meaning: The world is within the knowledge of him who knows the properties of taste, sight, touch, hearing and smell
pope_couplet: Taste, light, touch, sound, and smell: who knows the wayOf all the five,- the world submissive owns his sway
explanation_en: The world is within the knowledge of him who knows the properties of taste, sight, touch, hearing and smell
explanation_ta: சுவை, ஒளி, ஊறு, ஓசை, நாற்றம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஐந்தின் வகைகளையும் ஆராய்ந்து அறிய வல்லவனுடைய அறிவில் உள்ளது உலகம்.

translation:
The might of men whose word is never vain, The 'secret word' shall to the earth proclaim

Meaning: The hidden words of the men whose words are full of effect, will shew their greatness to the world
pope_couplet: The might of men whose word is never vain, The 'secret word' shall to the earth proclaim
explanation_en: The hidden words of the men whose words are full of effect, will shew their greatness to the world
explanation_ta: பயன் நிறைந்த மொழிகளில் வல்ல சான்றோரின் பெருமையை, உலகத்தில் அழியாமல் விளங்கும் அவர்களுடைய மறைமொழிகளே காட்டிவிடும்.

translation:
The wrath 'tis hard e'en for an instant to endure, Of those who virtue's hill have scaled, and stand secure

Meaning: The anger of those who have ascended the mountain of goodness, though it continue but for a moment, cannot be resisted
pope_couplet: The wrath 'tis hard e'en for an instant to endure, Of those who virtue's hill have scaled, and stand secure
explanation_en: The anger of those who have ascended the mountain of goodness, though it continue but for a moment, cannot be resisted
explanation_ta: நல்ல பண்புகளாகிய மலையின்மேல் ஏறி நின்ற பெரியோர், ஒரு கணப்பொழுதே சினம் கொள்வார் ஆயினும் அதிலிருந்து ஒருவரைக் காத்தல் அரிதாகும்.

translation:
Towards all that breathe, with seemly graciousness adorned they live; And thus to virtue's sons the name of 'Anthanar' men give

Meaning: The virtuous are truly called Anthanar; because in their conduct towards all creatures they are clothed in kindness
pope_couplet: Towards all that breathe, with seemly graciousness adorned they live; And thus to virtue's sons the name of 'Anthanar' men give
explanation_en: The virtuous are truly called Anthanar; because in their conduct towards all creatures they are clothed in kindness
explanation_ta: எல்லா உயிர்களிடத்திலும் செம்மையான அருளை மேற்கொண்டு ஒழுகுவதால், அறவோரே அந்தணர் எனப்படுவோர் ஆவர்.

translation:
It yields distinction, yields prosperity; what gainGreater than virtue can a living man obtain

Meaning: Virtue will confer heaven and wealth; what greater source of happiness can man possess ?
pope_couplet: It yields distinction, yields prosperity; what gainGreater than virtue can a living man obtain
explanation_en: Virtue will confer heaven and wealth; what greater source of happiness can man possess ?
explanation_ta: அறம் சிறப்பையும் அளிக்கும்: செல்வத்தையும் அளிக்கும்: ஆகையால் உயிர்க்கு அத்தகைய அறத்தை விட நன்மையானது வேறு யாது?
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
No greater gain than virtue aught can cause; No greater loss than life oblivious of her laws

Meaning: There can be no greater source of good than (the practice of) virtue; there can be no greater source of evil than the forgetfulness of it
pope_couplet: No greater gain than virtue aught can cause; No greater loss than life oblivious of her laws
explanation_en: There can be no greater source of good than (the practice of) virtue; there can be no greater source of evil than the forgetfulness of it
explanation_ta: ஒரு வருடைய வாழ்கைக்கு அறத்தை விட நன்மையானதும் இல்லை: அறத்தை போற்றாமல் மறப்பதை விடக்கொடியதும் இல்லை.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
To finish virtue's work with ceaseless effort strive, What way thou may'st, where'er thou see'st the work may thrive

Meaning: As much as possible, in every way, incessantly practise virtue
pope_couplet: To finish virtue's work with ceaseless effort strive, What way thou may'st, where'er thou see'st the work may thrive
explanation_en: As much as possible, in every way, incessantly practise virtue
explanation_ta: செய்யக்கூடிய வகையால், எக்காரணத்தாலும் விடாமல் செல்லுமிடமெல்லாம் அறச்செயலைப் போற்றிச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
Spotless be thou in mind! This only merits virtue's name; All else, mere pomp of idle sound, no real worth can claim

Meaning: Let him who does virtuous deeds be of spotless mind; to that extent is virtue; all else is vain show
pope_couplet: Spotless be thou in mind! This only merits virtue's name; All else, mere pomp of idle sound, no real worth can claim
explanation_en: Let him who does virtuous deeds be of spotless mind; to that extent is virtue; all else is vain show
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன்மனதில் குற்றம் இல்லாதவானாக இருக்க வேண்டும். அறம் அவ்வளவே: மனத்தூய்மை இல்லாத மற்றவை ஆரவாரத் தன்மை உடையவை.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
'Tis virtue when, his footsteps sliding not through envy, wrath, Lust, evil speech-these four, man onwards moves in ordered path

Meaning: That conduct is virtue which is free from these four things, viz, malice, desire, anger and bitter speech
pope_couplet: 'Tis virtue when, his footsteps sliding not through envy, wrath, Lust, evil speech-these four, man onwards moves in ordered path
explanation_en: That conduct is virtue which is free from these four things, viz, malice, desire, anger and bitter speech
explanation_ta: பொறாமை, ஆசை, சினம், கடுஞ்சொல் ஆகிய இந்த நான்கு குற்றங்களுக்கும் இடங்கொடுக்காமல் அவற்றைக் கடித்து ஒழுகுவதே அறமாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
Do deeds of virtue now Say not, 'To-morrow we'll be wise'; Thus, when thou diest, shalt thou find a help that never dies

Meaning: Defer not virtue to another day; receive her now; and at the dying hour she will be your undying friend
pope_couplet: Do deeds of virtue now Say not, 'To-morrow we'll be wise'; Thus, when thou diest, shalt thou find a help that never dies
explanation_en: Defer not virtue to another day; receive her now; and at the dying hour she will be your undying friend
explanation_ta: இளைஞராக உள்ளவர், பிற்காலத்தில் பார்த்து கொள்ளலாம் என்று எண்ணாமல் அறம் செய்ய வேண்டும். அதுவே உடல் அழியும் காலத்தில் அழியா துணையாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
Needs not in words to dwell on virtue's fruits: compareThe man in litter borne with them that toiling bear

Meaning: The fruit of virtue need not be described in books; it may be inferred from seeing the bearer of a palanquin and the rider therein
pope_couplet: Needs not in words to dwell on virtue's fruits: compareThe man in litter borne with them that toiling bear
explanation_en: The fruit of virtue need not be described in books; it may be inferred from seeing the bearer of a palanquin and the rider therein
explanation_ta: பல்லக்கை சுமப்பவனும் அதன்மேலிருந்து ஊர்ந்து செல்லுவோனுமாகிய அவர்களிடையே அறத்தின் பயன் இஃது என்று கூறவேண்டா.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
If no day passing idly, good to do each day you toil, A stone it will be to block the way of future days of moil

Meaning: If one allows no day to pass without some good being done, his conduct will be a stone to block up the passage to other births
pope_couplet: If no day passing idly, good to do each day you toil, A stone it will be to block the way of future days of moil
explanation_en: If one allows no day to pass without some good being done, his conduct will be a stone to block up the passage to other births
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அறம் செய்ய தவறிய நாள் ஏற்படாதவாறு அறத்தை செய்வானானால் அதுவே அவன் உடலோடு வாழும் நாள் வரும் பிறவி வழியை அடைக்கும் கல்லாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
What from virtue floweth, yieldeth dear delight; All else extern, is void of glory's light

Meaning: Only that pleasure which flows from domestic virtue is pleasure; all else is not pleasure, and it is without praise
pope_couplet: What from virtue floweth, yieldeth dear delight; All else extern, is void of glory's light
explanation_en: Only that pleasure which flows from domestic virtue is pleasure; all else is not pleasure, and it is without praise
explanation_ta: அறநெறியில் வாழ்வதன் பயனாக வருவதே இன்பமாகும். அறத்தோடு பொருந்தாமல் வருவன எல்லாம் இன்பம் இல்லாதவை: புகழும் இல்லாதவை.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
'Virtue' sums the things that should be done;'Vice' sums the things that man should shun

Meaning: That is virtue which each ought to do, and that is vice which each should shun
pope_couplet: 'Virtue' sums the things that should be done;'Vice' sums the things that man should shun
explanation_en: That is virtue which each ought to do, and that is vice which each should shun
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் வாழ்நாளில் முயற்சி மேற்கொண்டு செய்யத்தக்கது அறமே. செய்யாமல் காத்து கொள்ளத்தக்கது பழியே.
adhigaram_name_en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

translation:
The men of household virtue, firm in way of good, sustainThe other orders three that rule professed maintain

Meaning: He will be called a (true) householder, who is a firm support to the virtuous of the three orders in
pope_couplet: The men of household virtue, firm in way of good, sustainThe other orders three that rule professed maintain
explanation_en: He will be called a (true) householder, who is a firm support to the virtuous of the three orders in
explanation_ta: இல்லறத்தில் வாழ்பவனாகச் சொல்லப்படுகிறவன் அறத்தின் இயல்பை உடைய மூவருக்கும் நல்வழியில் நிலை பெற்ற துணையாவான்.

translation:
To anchorites, to indigent, to those who've passed away, The man for household virtue famed is needful held and stay

Meaning: He will be said to flourish in domestic virtue who aids the forsaken, the poor, and the dead
pope_couplet: To anchorites, to indigent, to those who've passed away, The man for household virtue famed is needful held and stay
explanation_en: He will be said to flourish in domestic virtue who aids the forsaken, the poor, and the dead
explanation_ta: துறந்தவர்கும் வறியவர்க்கும் தன்னிடத்தே இறந்தவர்க்கும் இல்லறம் மேற்கொண்டு வாழ்கிறவன் துணையாவான்.

translation:
The manes, God, guests kindred, self, in due degree, These five to cherish well is chiefest charity

Meaning: The chief (duty of the householder) is to preserve the five-fold rule (of conduct) towards the manes, the Gods, his guests, his relations and himself
pope_couplet: The manes, God, guests kindred, self, in due degree, These five to cherish well is chiefest charity
explanation_en: The chief (duty of the householder) is to preserve the five-fold rule (of conduct) towards the manes, the Gods, his guests, his relations and himself
explanation_ta: தென்புலத்தார், தெய்வம் விருந்தினர், சுற்றத்தார், தான் என்ற ஐவகையிடத்தும் அறநெறி தவறாமல் போற்றுதல் சிறந்த கடமையாகும்.

translation:
Who shares his meal with other, while all guilt he shuns, His virtuous line unbroken though the ages runs

Meaning: His descendants shall never fail who, living in the domestic state, fears vice (in the acquisition of property) and shares his food (with others)
pope_couplet: Who shares his meal with other, while all guilt he shuns, His virtuous line unbroken though the ages runs
explanation_en: His descendants shall never fail who, living in the domestic state, fears vice (in the acquisition of property) and shares his food (with others)
explanation_ta: பொருள் சேர்க்கும் பொது பழிக்கு அஞ்சிச் சேர்த்து, செலவு செய்யும் போது பகுந்து உண்பதை மேற்க்கொண்டால், அவ்வாழ்கையின் ஒழுங்கு எப்போதும் குறைவதில்லை.

translation:
If love and virtue in the household reign, This is of life the perfect grace and gain

Meaning: If the married life possess love and virtue, these will be both its duty and reward
pope_couplet: If love and virtue in the household reign, This is of life the perfect grace and gain
explanation_en: If the married life possess love and virtue, these will be both its duty and reward
explanation_ta: இல்வாழ்க்கையின் அன்பும் அறமும் உடையதாக விளங்குமானால், அந்த வாழக்கையின் பண்பும் பயனும் அதுவே ஆகும்.

translation:
If man in active household life a virtuous soul retain, What fruit from other modes of virtue can he gain

Meaning: What will he who lives virtuously in the domestic state gain by going into the other, (ascetic) state ?
pope_couplet: If man in active household life a virtuous soul retain, What fruit from other modes of virtue can he gain
explanation_en: What will he who lives virtuously in the domestic state gain by going into the other, (ascetic) state ?
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அறநெறியில் இல்வாழ்க்கையைச் செலுத்தி வாழ்வானானால், அத்தகையவன் வேறு நெறியில் சென்று பெறத்தக்கது என்ன?

translation:
In nature's way who spends his calm domestic days,'Mid all that strive for virtue's crown hath foremost place

Meaning: Among all those who labour (for future happiness) he is greatest who lives well in the household state
pope_couplet: In nature's way who spends his calm domestic days,'Mid all that strive for virtue's crown hath foremost place
explanation_en: Among all those who labour (for future happiness) he is greatest who lives well in the household state
explanation_ta: அறத்தின் இயல்பொடு இல்வாழ்கை வாழ்கிறவன்- வாழ முயல்கிறவன் பல திறத்தாரிலும் மேம்பட்டு விளங்குகிறவன் ஆவான்.

translation:
Others it sets upon their way, itself from virtue ne'er declines; Than stern ascetics' pains such life domestic brighter shines

Meaning: The householder who, not swerving from virtue, helps the ascetic in his way, endures more than those who endure penance
pope_couplet: Others it sets upon their way, itself from virtue ne'er declines; Than stern ascetics' pains such life domestic brighter shines
explanation_en: The householder who, not swerving from virtue, helps the ascetic in his way, endures more than those who endure penance
explanation_ta: மற்றவரை அறநெறியில் ஒழுகச்செய்து தானும்அறம் தவறாத இல்வாழ்க்கை , தவம் செய்வாரைவிட மிகச்சிறந்த வல்லமை உடைய வாழ்க்கையாகும்.

translation:
The life domestic rightly bears true virtue's name; That other too, if blameless found, due praise may claim

Meaning: The marriage state is truly called virtue The other state is also good, if others do not reproach it
pope_couplet: The life domestic rightly bears true virtue's name; That other too, if blameless found, due praise may claim
explanation_en: The marriage state is truly called virtue The other state is also good, if others do not reproach it
explanation_ta: அறம் என்று சிறப்பித்து சொல்லப்பட்டது இல்வாழ்க்கையே ஆகும். அதுவும் மற்றவன் பழிக்கும் குற்றம் இல்லாமல் விளங்கினால் மேலும் நன்மையாகும்.

translation:
Who shares domestic life, by household virtues graced, Shall, mid the Gods, in heaven who dwell, be placed

Meaning: He who on earth has lived in the conjugal state as he should live, will be placed among the Gods who dwell in heaven
pope_couplet: Who shares domestic life, by household virtues graced, Shall, mid the Gods, in heaven who dwell, be placed
explanation_en: He who on earth has lived in the conjugal state as he should live, will be placed among the Gods who dwell in heaven
explanation_ta: உலகத்தில் வாழவேண்டிய அறநெறியில் நின்று வாழ்கிறவன், வானுலகத்தில் உள்ள தெய்வ முறையில் வைத்து மதிக்கப்படுவான்.

translation:
As doth the house beseem, she shows her wifely dignity; As doth her husband's wealth befit, she spends: help - meet is she

Meaning: She who has the excellence of home virtues, and can expend within the means of her husband, is a help in the domestic state
pope_couplet: As doth the house beseem, she shows her wifely dignity; As doth her husband's wealth befit, she spends: help - meet is she
explanation_en: She who has the excellence of home virtues, and can expend within the means of her husband, is a help in the domestic state
explanation_ta: இல்வாழ்க்கைக்கு ஏற்ற நற்பண்பு உடையவளாகித் தன்கணவனுடைய பொருள் வளத்துக்குத் தக்க வாழ்க்கை நடத்துகிறவளே வாழ்க்கைத்துணை ஆவாள்.

translation:
If household excellence be wanting in the wife, Howe'er with splendour lived, all worthless is the life

Meaning: If the wife be devoid of domestic excellence, whatever (other) greatness be possessed, the conjugal state, is nothing
pope_couplet: If household excellence be wanting in the wife, Howe'er with splendour lived, all worthless is the life
explanation_en: If the wife be devoid of domestic excellence, whatever (other) greatness be possessed, the conjugal state, is nothing
explanation_ta: இல்வாழ்க்கைக்கு தக்க நற்பண்பு மனைவியிடம் இல்லையானால், ஒருவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை வேறு எவ்வளவு சிறப்புடையதானாலும் பயன் இல்லை.

translation:
There is no lack within the house, where wife in worth excels, There is no luck within the house, where wife dishonoured dwells

Meaning: If his wife be eminent (in virtue), what does (that man) not possess ? If she be without excellence, what does (he) possess ?
pope_couplet: There is no lack within the house, where wife in worth excels, There is no luck within the house, where wife dishonoured dwells
explanation_en: If his wife be eminent (in virtue), what does (that man) not possess ? If she be without excellence, what does (he) possess ?
explanation_ta: மனைவி நற்பண்பு உடையவளானால் வாழ்க்கையில் இல்லாதது என்ன? அவள் நற்பண்பு இல்லாதவளானால் வாழ்க்கையில் இருப்பது என்ன?

translation:
If woman might of chastity retain, What choicer treasure doth the world contain

Meaning: What is more excellent than a wife, if she possess the stability of chastity ?
pope_couplet: If woman might of chastity retain, What choicer treasure doth the world contain
explanation_en: What is more excellent than a wife, if she possess the stability of chastity ?
explanation_ta: இல்வாழ்க்கையில் கற்பு என்னும் உறுதிநிலை இருக்கப் பெற்றால், பெண்ணைவிட பெருமையுடையவை வேறு என்ன இருக்கின்றன?

translation:
No God adoring, low she bends before her lord; Then rising, serves: the rain falls instant at her word

Meaning: If she, who does not worship God, but who rising worships her husband, say, "let it rain," it will rain
pope_couplet: No God adoring, low she bends before her lord; Then rising, serves: the rain falls instant at her word
explanation_en: If she, who does not worship God, but who rising worships her husband, say, "let it rain," it will rain
explanation_ta: வேறு தெய்வம் தொழாதவளாய்த் தன் கணவனையே தெய்வமாகக் கொண்டு தொழுது துயிலெழுகின்றவள் பெய் என்றால் மழை பெய்யும்.

translation:
Who guards herself, for husband's comfort cares, her household's fame, In perfect wise with sleepless soul preserves, -give her a woman's name

Meaning: She is a wife who unweariedly guards herself, takes care of her husband, and preserves an unsullied fame
pope_couplet: Who guards herself, for husband's comfort cares, her household's fame, In perfect wise with sleepless soul preserves, -give her a woman's name
explanation_en: She is a wife who unweariedly guards herself, takes care of her husband, and preserves an unsullied fame
explanation_ta: கற்பு நெறியில் தன்னையும் காத்துக்கொண்டு, தன்கணவனையும் காப்பாற்றி, தகுதியமைந்த புகழையும் காத்து உறுதி தளராமல் வாழ்கின்றவளே பெண்.

translation:
Of what avail is watch and ward?Honour's woman's safest guard

Meaning: What avails the guard of a prison ? The chief guard of a woman is her chastity
pope_couplet: Of what avail is watch and ward?Honour's woman's safest guard
explanation_en: What avails the guard of a prison ? The chief guard of a woman is her chastity
explanation_ta: மகளிரைக் காவல் வைத்துக் காக்கும் காப்பு முறை என்ன பயனை உண்டாக்கும்? அவர்கள் நிறை என்னும் பண்பால் தம்மைத் தான் காக்கும் கற்பே சிறிந்தது.

translation:
If wife be wholly true to him who gained her as his bride, Great glory gains she in the world where gods bliss abide

Meaning: If women shew reverence to their husbands, they will obtain great excellence in the world where the gods flourish
pope_couplet: If wife be wholly true to him who gained her as his bride, Great glory gains she in the world where gods bliss abide
explanation_en: If women shew reverence to their husbands, they will obtain great excellence in the world where the gods flourish
explanation_ta: கணவனைப் போற்றிக் கடமையைச் செய்யப்பெற்றால் மகளிர் பெரிய சிறப்பை உடைய மேலுலகவாழ்வைப் பெறுவர்.

translation:
Who have not spouses that in virtue's praise delight, They lion-like can never walk in scorner's sight

Meaning: The man whose wife seeks not the praise (of chastity) cannot walk with lion-like stately step, before those who revile them
pope_couplet: Who have not spouses that in virtue's praise delight, They lion-like can never walk in scorner's sight
explanation_en: The man whose wife seeks not the praise (of chastity) cannot walk with lion-like stately step, before those who revile them
explanation_ta: புகழைக் காக்க விரும்பும் மனைவி இல்லாதவர்க்கு, இகழ்ந்து பேசும் பகைவர் முன் காளை போல் நடக்கும் பெருமித நடை இல்லை.

translation:
The house's 'blessing', men pronounce the house-wife excellent; The gain of blessed children is its goodly ornament

Meaning: The excellence of a wife is the good of her husband; and good children are the jewels of that goodness
pope_couplet: The house's 'blessing', men pronounce the house-wife excellent; The gain of blessed children is its goodly ornament
explanation_en: The excellence of a wife is the good of her husband; and good children are the jewels of that goodness
explanation_ta: மனைவியின் நற்பண்பே இல்வாழ்க்கைக்கு மங்கலம் என்று கூறுவர்: நல்ல மக்களைப் பெறுதலே அதற்கு நல்லணிகலம் என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Of all that men acquire, we know not any greater gain, Than that which by the birth of learned children men obtain

Meaning: Among all the benefits that may be acquired, we know no greater benefit than the acquisition of intelligent children
pope_couplet: Of all that men acquire, we know not any greater gain, Than that which by the birth of learned children men obtain
explanation_en: Among all the benefits that may be acquired, we know no greater benefit than the acquisition of intelligent children
explanation_ta: பெறத்தகுந்த பேறுகளில் அறிய வேண்டியவைகளை அறியும் நன்மக்களைப் பெறுவதைத் தவிர, மற்றப்பேறுகளை யாம் மதிப்பதில்லை.

translation:
Who children gain, that none reproach, of virtuous worth, No evils touch them, through the sev'n-fold maze of birth

Meaning: The evils of the seven births shall not touch those who abtain children of a good disposition, free from vice
pope_couplet: Who children gain, that none reproach, of virtuous worth, No evils touch them, through the sev'n-fold maze of birth
explanation_en: The evils of the seven births shall not touch those who abtain children of a good disposition, free from vice
explanation_ta: பழி இல்லாத நல்ல பண்பு உடைய மக்களைப்பெற்றால் ஒருவனுக்கு ஏழு பிறவியிலும் தீவினைப் பயனாகிய துன்பங்கள் சென்று சேரா.

translation:
'Man's children are his fortune,' say the wise; From each one's deeds his varied fortunes rise

Meaning: Men will call their sons their wealth, because it flows to them through the deeds which they (sons) perform on their behalf
pope_couplet: 'Man's children are his fortune,' say the wise; From each one's deeds his varied fortunes rise
explanation_en: Men will call their sons their wealth, because it flows to them through the deeds which they (sons) perform on their behalf
explanation_ta: தம்மக்களே தம்முடைய பொருள்கள் என்று அறிஞர் கூறுவர். மக்களாகிய அவர்தம் பொருள்கள் அவரவருடைய வினையின் பயனால் வந்து சேரும்.

translation:
Than God's ambrosia sweeter far the food before men laid, In which the little hands of children of their own have play'd

Meaning: The rice in which the little hand of their children has dabbled will be far sweeter (to the parent) than ambrosia
pope_couplet: Than God's ambrosia sweeter far the food before men laid, In which the little hands of children of their own have play'd
explanation_en: The rice in which the little hand of their children has dabbled will be far sweeter (to the parent) than ambrosia
explanation_ta: தம்முடைய மக்களின் சிறு கைகளால் அளாவப்பெற்ற உணவு, பெற்றோர்க்கு அமிழ்தத்தை விட மிக்க இனிமை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
To patent sweet the touch of children dear; Their voice is sweetest music to his ear

Meaning: The touch of children gives pleasure to the body, and the hearing of their words, pleasure to the ear
pope_couplet: To patent sweet the touch of children dear; Their voice is sweetest music to his ear
explanation_en: The touch of children gives pleasure to the body, and the hearing of their words, pleasure to the ear
explanation_ta: மக்களின் உடம்பைத் தொடுதல் உடம்பிற்கு இன்பம் தருவதாகும்: அம் மக்களின் மழலைச் சொற்களைக் கேட்டால் செவிக்கு இன்பம் தருவதாகும்.

translation:
'The pipe is sweet,' 'the lute is sweet,' by them't will be averred, Who music of their infants' lisping lips have never heard

Meaning: "The pipe is sweet, the lute is sweet," say those who have not heard the prattle of their own children
pope_couplet: 'The pipe is sweet,' 'the lute is sweet,' by them't will be averred, Who music of their infants' lisping lips have never heard
explanation_en: "The pipe is sweet, the lute is sweet," say those who have not heard the prattle of their own children
explanation_ta: தம் மக்களின் மழலைச் சொல்லைக் கேட்டு அதன் இனிமையை நுகராதவரே குழலின் இசை இனியது யாழின் இசை இனியது என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Sire greatest boon on son confers, who makes him meet, In councils of the wise to fill the highest seat

Meaning: The benefit which a father should confer on his son is to give him precedence in the assembly of the learned
pope_couplet: Sire greatest boon on son confers, who makes him meet, In councils of the wise to fill the highest seat
explanation_en: The benefit which a father should confer on his son is to give him precedence in the assembly of the learned
explanation_ta: தந்தை தன் மகனுக்குச் செய்யத்தக்க நல்லுதவி, கற்றவர் கூட்டத்தில் தன் மகன் முந்தியிருக்கும்படியாக அவனைக் கல்வியில் மேம்படச் செய்தலாகும்.

translation:
Their children's wisdom greater than their own confessed, Through the wide world is sweet to every human breast

Meaning: That their children should possess knowledge is more pleasing to all men of this great earth than to themselves
pope_couplet: Their children's wisdom greater than their own confessed, Through the wide world is sweet to every human breast
explanation_en: That their children should possess knowledge is more pleasing to all men of this great earth than to themselves
explanation_ta: தம் மக்களின் அறிவுடைமை தமக்கு இன்பம் பயப்பதை விட உலகத்து உயிர்களுக்கேல்லாம் மிகுந்த இன்பம் பயப்பதாகும்.

translation:
When mother hears him named 'fulfill'd of wisdom's lore,'Far greater joy she feels, than when her son she bore

Meaning: The mother who hears her son called "a wise man" will rejoice more than she did at his birth
pope_couplet: When mother hears him named 'fulfill'd of wisdom's lore,'Far greater joy she feels, than when her son she bore
explanation_en: The mother who hears her son called "a wise man" will rejoice more than she did at his birth
explanation_ta: தன் மகனை நற்பண்பு நிறைந்தவன் என பிறர் சொல்லக் கேள்வியுற்ற தாய், தான் அவனை பெற்றக் காலத்தில் உற்ற மகிழ்ச்சியை விடப் பெரிதும் மகிழ்வாள்.

translation:
To sire, what best requital can by grateful child be done?To make men say, 'What merit gained the father such a son?'

Meaning: (So to act) that it may be said "by what great penance did his father beget him," is the benefit which a son should render to his father
pope_couplet: To sire, what best requital can by grateful child be done?To make men say, 'What merit gained the father such a son?'
explanation_en: (So to act) that it may be said "by what great penance did his father beget him," is the benefit which a son should render to his father
explanation_ta: மகன் தன் தந்தைக்குச் செய்யத் தக்க கைம்மாறு, இவன் தந்தை இவனை மகனாகப் பெற என்ன தவம் செய்தானோ என்று பிறர் புகழ்ந்து சொல்லும் சொல்லாகும்.

translation:
And is there bar that can even love restrain?The tiny tear shall make the lover's secret plain

Meaning: Is there any fastening that can shut in love ? Tears of the affectionate will publish the love that is within
pope_couplet: And is there bar that can even love restrain?The tiny tear shall make the lover's secret plain
explanation_en: Is there any fastening that can shut in love ? Tears of the affectionate will publish the love that is within
explanation_ta: அன்புக்கும் அடைத்து வைக்கும் தாழ் உண்டோ? அன்புடையவரின் சிறு கண்ணீரே ( உள்ளே இருக்கும் அன்பைப் ) பலரும் அறிய வெளிப்படுத்திவிடும்

translation:
The loveless to themselves belong alone; The loving men are others' to the very bone

Meaning: Those who are destitute of love appropriate all they have to themselves; but those who possess love consider even their bones to belong to others
pope_couplet: The loveless to themselves belong alone; The loving men are others' to the very bone
explanation_en: Those who are destitute of love appropriate all they have to themselves; but those who possess love consider even their bones to belong to others
explanation_ta: அன்பு இல்லாதவர் எல்லாப்பொருள்களையும் தமக்கே உரிமையாகக் கொண்டு வாழ்வார்: அன்பு உடையவர் தம் உடமையும் பிறர்க்கு உரிமையாக்கி வாழ்வர்

translation:
Of precious soul with body's flesh and bone, The union yields one fruit, the life of love alone

Meaning: They say that the union of soul and body in man is the fruit of the union of love and virtue (in a former birth)
pope_couplet: Of precious soul with body's flesh and bone, The union yields one fruit, the life of love alone
explanation_en: They say that the union of soul and body in man is the fruit of the union of love and virtue (in a former birth)
explanation_ta: அருமையான உயிர்க்கு உடம்போடு பொருந்தி இருக்கின்ற உறவு, அன்போடு பொருந்தி வாழும் வாழ்க்கையின் பயன்என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
From love fond yearning springs for union sweet of minds; And that the bond of rare excelling friendship binds

Meaning: Love begets desire: and that (desire) begets the immeasureable excellence of friendship
pope_couplet: From love fond yearning springs for union sweet of minds; And that the bond of rare excelling friendship binds
explanation_en: Love begets desire: and that (desire) begets the immeasureable excellence of friendship
explanation_ta: அன்பு பிறரிடம் விருப்பம் உடையவராக வாழும் தன்மையைத் தரும்: அஃது எல்லாரிடத்தும் நட்பு என்றுசொல்லப்படும் அளவற்ற சிறப்பைத் தரும்

translation:
Sweetness on earth and rarest bliss above, These are the fruits of tranquil life of love

Meaning: These are the fruits of tranquil life of love
pope_couplet: Sweetness on earth and rarest bliss above, These are the fruits of tranquil life of love
explanation_en: These are the fruits of tranquil life of love
explanation_ta: உலகத்தில் இன்பம் உற்று வாழ்கின்றவர் அடையும் சிறப்பு, அன்பு உடையவராகிப் பொருந்தி வாழும் வாழ்கையின் பயன் என்று கூறுவர்

translation:
The unwise deem love virtue only can sustain, It also helps the man who evil would restrain

Meaning: The ignorant say that love is an ally to virtue only, but it is also a help to get out of vice
pope_couplet: The unwise deem love virtue only can sustain, It also helps the man who evil would restrain
explanation_en: The ignorant say that love is an ally to virtue only, but it is also a help to get out of vice
explanation_ta: அறியாதவர், அறத்திற்கு மட்டுமே அன்பு துணையாகும் என்று கூறுவர்:ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால் வீரத்திற்க்கும் அதுவே துணையாக நிற்கின்றது

translation:
As sun's fierce ray dries up the boneless things, So loveless beings virtue's power to nothing brings

Meaning: Virtue will burn up the soul which is without love, even as the sun burns up the creature which is without bone, ie worms
pope_couplet: As sun's fierce ray dries up the boneless things, So loveless beings virtue's power to nothing brings
explanation_en: Virtue will burn up the soul which is without love, even as the sun burns up the creature which is without bone, ie worms
explanation_ta: எலும்பு இல்லாத உடம்போடு வாழும் புழுவை வெயில் காய்ந்து வருத்துவது போல் அன்பு இல்லாத உயிரை அறம் வருத்தும்.

translation:
The loveless soul, the very joys of life may know, When flowers, in barren soil, on sapless trees, shall blow

Meaning: The domestic state of that man whose mind is without love is like the flourishing of a withered tree upon the parched desert
pope_couplet: The loveless soul, the very joys of life may know, When flowers, in barren soil, on sapless trees, shall blow
explanation_en: The domestic state of that man whose mind is without love is like the flourishing of a withered tree upon the parched desert
explanation_ta: அகத்தில் அன்பு இல்லாமல் வாழும் உயிர் வாழக்கை வளமற்ற பாலைநிலத்தில் பட்டமரம் தளிர்த்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Though every outward part complete, the body's fitly framed; What good, when soul within, of love devoid, lies halt and maimed

Meaning: Of what avail are all the external members (of the body) to those who are destitute of love, the internal member
pope_couplet: Though every outward part complete, the body's fitly framed; What good, when soul within, of love devoid, lies halt and maimed
explanation_en: Of what avail are all the external members (of the body) to those who are destitute of love, the internal member
explanation_ta: உடம்பின் அகத்து உறுப்பாகிய அன்பு இல்லாதவர்க்கு உடம்பின் புறத்து உறுப்புக்கள் எல்லாம் என்ன பயன் செய்யும்.

translation:
Bodies of loveless men are bony framework clad with skin; Then is the body seat of life, when love resides within

Meaning: That body alone which is inspired with love contains a living soul: if void of it, (the body) is bone overlaid with skin
pope_couplet: Bodies of loveless men are bony framework clad with skin; Then is the body seat of life, when love resides within
explanation_en: That body alone which is inspired with love contains a living soul: if void of it, (the body) is bone overlaid with skin
explanation_ta: அன்பின் வழியில் இயங்கும் உடம்பே உயிர்நின்ற உடம்பாகும்: அன்பு இல்லாதவர்க்கு உள்ள உடம்பு எலும்பைத் தோல்போர்த்த வெற்றுடம்பே ஆகும்

translation:
All household cares and course of daily life have this in viewGuests to receive with courtesy, and kindly acts to do

Meaning: The whole design of living in the domestic state and laying up (property) is (to be able) to exercise the benevolence of hospitality
pope_couplet: All household cares and course of daily life have this in viewGuests to receive with courtesy, and kindly acts to do
explanation_en: The whole design of living in the domestic state and laying up (property) is (to be able) to exercise the benevolence of hospitality
explanation_ta: வீட்டில் இருந்து பொருள்களைக் காத்து இல்வாழ்க்கை நடத்துவதெல்லாம் விருந்தினரைப் போற்றி உதவி செய்யும் பொருட்டே ஆகும்

translation:
Though food of immortality should crown the board, Feasting alone, the guests without unfed, is thing abhorred

Meaning: It is not fit that one should wish his guests to be outside (his house) even though he were eating the food of immortality
pope_couplet: Though food of immortality should crown the board, Feasting alone, the guests without unfed, is thing abhorred
explanation_en: It is not fit that one should wish his guests to be outside (his house) even though he were eating the food of immortality
explanation_ta: விருந்தினராக வந்தவர் வீட்டின் புறத்தே இருக்கத் தான் மட்டும் உண்பது சாவாமருந்தாகிய அமிழ்தமே ஆனாலும் அது விரும்பத்தக்கது அன்று

translation:
Each day he tends the coming guest with kindly care; Painless, unfailing plenty shall his household share

Meaning: The domestic life of the man that daily entertains the guests who come to him shall not be laid waste by poverty
pope_couplet: Each day he tends the coming guest with kindly care; Painless, unfailing plenty shall his household share
explanation_en: The domestic life of the man that daily entertains the guests who come to him shall not be laid waste by poverty
explanation_ta: தன்னை நோக்கி வரும் விருந்தினரை நாள் தோறும் போற்றுகின்றவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை, துன்பத்தால் வருந்திக் கெட்டுப் போவதில்லை.

translation:
With smiling face he entertains each virtuous guest,'Fortune' with gladsome mind shall in his dwelling rest

Meaning: Lakshmi with joyous mind shall dwell in the house of that man who, with cheerful countenance, entertains the good as guests
pope_couplet: With smiling face he entertains each virtuous guest,'Fortune' with gladsome mind shall in his dwelling rest
explanation_en: Lakshmi with joyous mind shall dwell in the house of that man who, with cheerful countenance, entertains the good as guests
explanation_ta: நல்ல விருந்தினராய் வந்தவரை முகமலர்ச்சி கொண்டு போற்றுகின்றவனுடைய வீட்டில் மனமகிழ்ந்து திருமகள் வாழ்வாள்.

translation:
Who first regales his guest, and then himself supplies, O'er all his fields, unsown, shall plenteous harvests rise

Meaning: Is it necessary to sow the field of the man who, having feasted his guests, eats what may remain ?
pope_couplet: Who first regales his guest, and then himself supplies, O'er all his fields, unsown, shall plenteous harvests rise
explanation_en: Is it necessary to sow the field of the man who, having feasted his guests, eats what may remain ?
explanation_ta: விருந்தினரை முன்னே போற்றி உணவளித்து மிஞ்சிய உணவை உண்டு வாழ்கின்றவனுடைய நிலத்தில் விதையும் விதைக்க வேண்டுமோ?

translation:
The guest arrived he tends, the coming guest expects to see; To those in heavenly homes that dwell a welcome guest is he

Meaning: He who, having entertained the guests that have come, looks out for others who may yet come, will be a welcome guest to the inhabitants of heaven
pope_couplet: The guest arrived he tends, the coming guest expects to see; To those in heavenly homes that dwell a welcome guest is he
explanation_en: He who, having entertained the guests that have come, looks out for others who may yet come, will be a welcome guest to the inhabitants of heaven
explanation_ta: வந்த விருந்தினரைப் போற்றி, இனிவரும் விருந்தினரை எதிர் பார்த்திருப்பவன், வானுலகத்தில் உள்ள தேவர்க்கும் நல்ல விருந்தினனாவான்

translation:
To reckon up the fruit of kindly deeds were all in vain; Their worth is as the worth of guests you entertain

Meaning: The advantages of benevolence cannot be measured; the measure (of the virtue) of the guests (entertained) is the only measure
pope_couplet: To reckon up the fruit of kindly deeds were all in vain; Their worth is as the worth of guests you entertain
explanation_en: The advantages of benevolence cannot be measured; the measure (of the virtue) of the guests (entertained) is the only measure
explanation_ta: விருந்தோம்புதலாகிய வேள்வியின் பயன் இவ்வளவு என்று அளவு படுத்தி கூறத்தக்கது அன்று, விருந்தினரின் தகுதிக்கு ஏற்ற அளவினதாகும்

translation:
With pain they guard their stores, yet 'All forlorn are we,' they'll cry, Who cherish not their guests, nor kindly help supply

Meaning: Those who have taken no part in the benevolence of hospitality shall (at length lament) saying, "we have laboured and laid up wealth and are now without support."
pope_couplet: With pain they guard their stores, yet 'All forlorn are we,' they'll cry, Who cherish not their guests, nor kindly help supply
explanation_en: Those who have taken no part in the benevolence of hospitality shall (at length lament) saying, "we have laboured and laid up wealth and are now without support."
explanation_ta: விருந்தினரை ஓம்பி அந்த வேள்வியில் ஈடுபடாதவர் பொருள்களை வருந்திக்காத்துப் (பின்பு இழந்து) பற்றுக்கொடு இழந்தோமே என்று இரங்குவர்

translation:
To turn from guests is penury, though worldly goods abound;'Tis senseless folly, only with the senseless found

Meaning: That stupidity which excercises no hospitality is poverty in the midst of wealth It is the property of the stupid
pope_couplet: To turn from guests is penury, though worldly goods abound;'Tis senseless folly, only with the senseless found
explanation_en: That stupidity which excercises no hospitality is poverty in the midst of wealth It is the property of the stupid
explanation_ta: செல்வநிலையில் உள்ள வறுமை என்பது விருந்தோம்புதலைப் போற்றாத அறியாமையாகும்: அஃது அறிவிலிகளிடம் உள்ளதாகும்.

translation:
The flower of 'Anicha' withers away, If you do but its fragrance inhale; If the face of the host cold welcome convey, The guest's heart within him will fail

Meaning: As the Anicham flower fades in smelling, so fades the guest when the face is turned away
pope_couplet: The flower of 'Anicha' withers away, If you do but its fragrance inhale; If the face of the host cold welcome convey, The guest's heart within him will fail
explanation_en: As the Anicham flower fades in smelling, so fades the guest when the face is turned away
explanation_ta: அனிச்சப்பூ மோந்தவுடன் வாடிவிடும்: அதுபோல் முகம் மலராமல் வேறு பட்டு நோக்கியவுடன் விருந்தினர் வாடி நிற்பார்.

translation:
Pleasant words are words with all pervading love that burn; Words from his guileless mouth who can the very truth discern

Meaning: Sweet words are those which imbued with love and free from deceit flow from the mouth of the virtuous
pope_couplet: Pleasant words are words with all pervading love that burn; Words from his guileless mouth who can the very truth discern
explanation_en: Sweet words are those which imbued with love and free from deceit flow from the mouth of the virtuous
explanation_ta: அன்பு கலந்து வஞ்சம் அற்றவைகளாகிய சொற்கள், மெய்ப்பொருள் கண்டவர்களின் வாய்ச்சொற்கள் இன்சொற்களாகும்.

translation:
A pleasant word with beaming smile's preferred, Even to gifts with liberal heart conferred

Meaning: Sweet speech, with a cheerful countenance is better than a gift made with a joyous mind
pope_couplet: A pleasant word with beaming smile's preferred, Even to gifts with liberal heart conferred
explanation_en: Sweet speech, with a cheerful countenance is better than a gift made with a joyous mind
explanation_ta: முகம் மலர்ந்து இன்சொல் உடையவனாக இருக்கப்பெற்றால், மனம் மகிழ்ந்து பொருள் கொடுக்கும் ஈகையைவிட நல்லதாகும்.

translation:
With brightly beaming smile, and kindly light of loving eye, And heart sincere, to utter pleasant words is charity

Meaning: Sweet speech, flowing from the heart (uttered) with a cheerful countenance and a sweet look, is true virtue
pope_couplet: With brightly beaming smile, and kindly light of loving eye, And heart sincere, to utter pleasant words is charity
explanation_en: Sweet speech, flowing from the heart (uttered) with a cheerful countenance and a sweet look, is true virtue
explanation_ta: முகத்தால் விரும்பி- இனிமையுடன் நோக்கி- உள்ளம் கலந்து இன்சொற்களைக் கூறும் தன்மையில் உள்ளதே அறமாகும்.

translation:
The men of pleasant speech that gladness breathe around, Through indigence shall never sorrow's prey be found

Meaning: Sorrow-increasing poverty shall not come upon those who use towards all, pleasure-increasing sweetness of speech
pope_couplet: The men of pleasant speech that gladness breathe around, Through indigence shall never sorrow's prey be found
explanation_en: Sorrow-increasing poverty shall not come upon those who use towards all, pleasure-increasing sweetness of speech
explanation_ta: யாரிடத்திலும் இன்புறத்தக்க இன்சொல் வழங்குவோர்க்குத் துன்பத்தை மிகுதிபடுத்தும் வறுமை என்பது இல்லையாகும்.

translation:
Humility with pleasant speech to man on earth, Is choice adornment; all besides is nothing worth

Meaning: Humility and sweetness of speech are the ornaments of man; all others are not (ornaments)
pope_couplet: Humility with pleasant speech to man on earth, Is choice adornment; all besides is nothing worth
explanation_en: Humility and sweetness of speech are the ornaments of man; all others are not (ornaments)
explanation_ta: வணக்கம் உடையவனாகவும் இன்சொல் வழங்குவோனாகவும் ஆதலே ஒருவனுக்கு அணிகலனாகும் மற்றவை அணிகள் அல்ல.

translation:
Who seeks out good, words from his lips of sweetness flow; In him the power of vice declines, and virtues grow

Meaning: If a man, while seeking to speak usefully, speaks also sweetly, his sins will diminish and his virtue increase
pope_couplet: Who seeks out good, words from his lips of sweetness flow; In him the power of vice declines, and virtues grow
explanation_en: If a man, while seeking to speak usefully, speaks also sweetly, his sins will diminish and his virtue increase
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு நன்மையானவற்றை நாடி இனிமை உடையச் சொற்களைச் சொல்லின், பாவங்கள் தேய்ந்து குறைய அறம் வளர்ந்து பெருகும்.

translation:
The words of sterling sense, to rule of right that strict adhere, To virtuous action prompting, blessings yield in every sphere

Meaning: That speech which, while imparting benefits ceases not to please, will yield righteousness (for this world) and merit (for the next world)
pope_couplet: The words of sterling sense, to rule of right that strict adhere, To virtuous action prompting, blessings yield in every sphere
explanation_en: That speech which, while imparting benefits ceases not to please, will yield righteousness (for this world) and merit (for the next world)
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு நன்மையான பயனைத் தந்து நல்ல பண்பிலிருந்து நீங்காத சொற்கள்,வழங்குவோனுக்கும் இன்பம் தந்து நன்மை பயக்கும்.

translation:
Sweet kindly words, from meanness free, delight of heart, In world to come and in this world impart

Meaning: Sweet speech, free from harm to others, will give pleasure both in this world and in the next
pope_couplet: Sweet kindly words, from meanness free, delight of heart, In world to come and in this world impart
explanation_en: Sweet speech, free from harm to others, will give pleasure both in this world and in the next
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்குத் துன்பம் விளைக்கும் சிறுமையிலிருந்து நீங்கிய இனிய சொற்கள் மறுமைக்கும் இம்மைக்கும் வழங்குவோனுக்கு இன்பம் தரும் .

translation:
Who sees the pleasure kindly speech affords, Why makes he use of harsh, repellant words

Meaning: Why does he use harsh words, who sees the pleasure which sweet speech yields ?
pope_couplet: Who sees the pleasure kindly speech affords, Why makes he use of harsh, repellant words
explanation_en: Why does he use harsh words, who sees the pleasure which sweet speech yields ?
explanation_ta: இனிய சொற்கள் இன்பம் பயத்தலைக் காண்கின்றவன், அவற்றிற்கு மாறான வன்சொற்களை வழங்குவது என்ன பயன் கருதியோ?

translation:
When pleasant words are easy, bitter words to use, Is, leaving sweet ripe fruit, the sour unripe to choose

Meaning: To say disagreeable things when agreeable are at hand is like eating unripe fruit when there is ripe
pope_couplet: When pleasant words are easy, bitter words to use, Is, leaving sweet ripe fruit, the sour unripe to choose
explanation_en: To say disagreeable things when agreeable are at hand is like eating unripe fruit when there is ripe
explanation_ta: இனிய சொற்கள் இருக்கும் போது அவற்றை விட்டுக் கடுமையான சொற்களைக் கூறுதல் கனிகள் இருக்கும் போது அவற்றை விட்டு காய்களைப் பறித்துத் தின்பதைப் போன்றது .

translation:
Assistance given by those who ne'er received our aid, Is debt by gift of heaven and earth but poorly paid

Meaning: (The gift of) heaven and earth is not an equivalent for a benefit which is conferred where none had been received
pope_couplet: Assistance given by those who ne'er received our aid, Is debt by gift of heaven and earth but poorly paid
explanation_en: (The gift of) heaven and earth is not an equivalent for a benefit which is conferred where none had been received
explanation_ta: தான் ஓர் உதவியும் முன் செய்யாதிருக்கப் பிறன் தனக்கு செய்த உதவிக்கு மண்ணுலகத்தையும் விண்ணுலகத்தையும் கைமாறாகக் கொடுத்தாலும் ஈடு ஆக முடியாது.

translation:
A timely benefit, -though thing of little worth, The gift itself, -in excellence transcends the earth

Meaning: A favour conferred in the time of need, though it be small (in itself), is (in value) much larger than the world
pope_couplet: A timely benefit, -though thing of little worth, The gift itself, -in excellence transcends the earth
explanation_en: A favour conferred in the time of need, though it be small (in itself), is (in value) much larger than the world
explanation_ta: உற்ற காலத்தில் ஒருவன் செய்த உதவி சிறிதளவாக இருந்தாலும், அதன் தன்மையை அறிந்தால் உலகைவிட மிகப் பெரிதாகும்.

translation:
Kindness shown by those who weigh not what the return may be:When you ponder right its merit, 'Tis vaster than the sea

Meaning: If we weigh the excellence of a benefit which is conferred without weighing the return, it is larger than the sea
pope_couplet: Kindness shown by those who weigh not what the return may be:When you ponder right its merit, 'Tis vaster than the sea
explanation_en: If we weigh the excellence of a benefit which is conferred without weighing the return, it is larger than the sea
explanation_ta: இன்ன பயன் கிடைக்கும் என்றுஆராயாமல் ஒருவன் செய்த உதவியின் அன்புடைமையை ஆராய்ந்தால் அதன் நன்மை கடலைவிட பெரியதாகும் .

translation:
Each benefit to those of actions' fruit who rightly deem, Though small as millet-seed, as palm-tree vast will seem

Meaning: Though the benefit conferred be as small as a millet seed, those who know its advantage will consider it as large as a palmyra fruit
pope_couplet: Each benefit to those of actions' fruit who rightly deem, Though small as millet-seed, as palm-tree vast will seem
explanation_en: Though the benefit conferred be as small as a millet seed, those who know its advantage will consider it as large as a palmyra fruit
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தினையளவாகிய உதவியைச் செய்த போதிலும் அதன் பயனை ஆராய்கின்றவர், அதனையே பனையளவாகக் கொண்டு போற்றுவர்.

translation:
The kindly aid's extent is of its worth no measure true; Its worth is as the worth of him to whom the act you do

Meaning: The benefit itself is not the measure of the benefit; the worth of those who have received it is its measure
pope_couplet: The kindly aid's extent is of its worth no measure true; Its worth is as the worth of him to whom the act you do
explanation_en: The benefit itself is not the measure of the benefit; the worth of those who have received it is its measure
explanation_ta: கைமாறாகச் செய்யும் உதவி முன் செய்த உதவியின் அளவை உடையது அன்று, உதவி செய்யப்பட்டவற்றின் பண்புக்கு ஏற்ற அளவை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
Kindness of men of stainless soul remember evermoreForsake thou never friends who were thy stay in sorrow sore

Meaning: Forsake not the friendship of those who have been your staff in adversity Forget not be benevolence of the blameless
pope_couplet: Kindness of men of stainless soul remember evermoreForsake thou never friends who were thy stay in sorrow sore
explanation_en: Forsake not the friendship of those who have been your staff in adversity Forget not be benevolence of the blameless
explanation_ta: குற்றமற்றவரின் உறவை எப்போதும் மறக்கலாகாது: துன்பம் வந்த காலத்தில் உறுதுணையாய் உதவியவர்களின் நட்பை எப்போதும் விடாலாகாது .

translation:
Through all seven worlds, in seven-fold birth, Remains in mem'ry of the wiseFriendship of those who wiped on earth, The tears of sorrow from their eyes

Meaning: (The wise) will remember throughout their seven-fold births the love of those who have wiped away their affliction
pope_couplet: Through all seven worlds, in seven-fold birth, Remains in mem'ry of the wiseFriendship of those who wiped on earth, The tears of sorrow from their eyes
explanation_en: (The wise) will remember throughout their seven-fold births the love of those who have wiped away their affliction
explanation_ta: தம்முடைய துன்பத்தைப் போக்கி உதவியவரின் நட்பைப் பல்வேறு வகையான பிறவியிலும் மறவாமல் போற்றுவர் பெரியோர்.

translation:
'Tis never good to let the thought of good things done thee pass away; Of things not good, 'tis good to rid thy memory that very day

Meaning: It is not good to forget a benefit; it is good to forget an injury even in the very moment (in which it is inflicted)
pope_couplet: 'Tis never good to let the thought of good things done thee pass away; Of things not good, 'tis good to rid thy memory that very day
explanation_en: It is not good to forget a benefit; it is good to forget an injury even in the very moment (in which it is inflicted)
explanation_ta: ஒருவரர்முன்செய்த நன்மையை மறப்பது அறம் அன்று; அவர் செய்த தீமையைச் செய்த அப்‌பொழுதே மறந்து விடுவது அறம்.

translation:
Effaced straightway is deadliest injury, By thought of one kind act in days gone by

Meaning: Though one inflict an injury great as murder, it will perish before the thought of one benefit (formerly) conferred
pope_couplet: Effaced straightway is deadliest injury, By thought of one kind act in days gone by
explanation_en: Though one inflict an injury great as murder, it will perish before the thought of one benefit (formerly) conferred
explanation_ta: முன் உதவி செய்தவர் பின்பு ‌கொன்றார் போன்ற துன்பத்தைச் செய்தாரானாலும், அவர் முன் செய்த ஒரு நன்மையை நினைத்தாலும் அந்தத் துன்பம் கெடும்.

translation:
Who every good have killed, may yet destruction flee; Who 'benefit' has killed, that man shall ne'er 'scape free

Meaning: He who has killed every virtue may yet escape; there is no escape for him who has killed a benefit
pope_couplet: Who every good have killed, may yet destruction flee; Who 'benefit' has killed, that man shall ne'er 'scape free
explanation_en: He who has killed every virtue may yet escape; there is no escape for him who has killed a benefit
explanation_ta: எந்த அறத்தை அழித்தவர்க்கும் தப்பிப் பிழைக்க வழி உண்டாகும்; ஒருவர் செய்த உதவியை மறந்து அழித்தவனுக்கு உய்வு இல்லை.

translation:
If justice, failing not, its quality maintain, Giving to each his due, -'tis man's one highest gain

Meaning: That equity which consists in acting with equal regard to each of (the three) divisions of men [enemies, strangers and friends] is a pre-eminent virtue
pope_couplet: If justice, failing not, its quality maintain, Giving to each his due, -'tis man's one highest gain
explanation_en: That equity which consists in acting with equal regard to each of (the three) divisions of men [enemies, strangers and friends] is a pre-eminent virtue
explanation_ta: அந்தந்தப் பகுதிதோறும் முறையோடு பொருந்தி ஒழுகப்பெற்றால், நடுவுநிலைமை என்று கூறப்படும் அறம் நன்மையாகும்.

translation:
The just man's wealth unwasting shall endure, And to his race a lasting joy ensure

Meaning: The wealth of the man of rectitude will not perish, but will bring happiness also to his posterity
pope_couplet: The just man's wealth unwasting shall endure, And to his race a lasting joy ensure
explanation_en: The wealth of the man of rectitude will not perish, but will bring happiness also to his posterity
explanation_ta: நடுவுநிலைமை உடையவனின் செல்வவளம் அழிவில்லாமல் அவனுடைய வழியில் உள்ளார்க்கும் உறுதியான நன்மை தருவதாகும்.

translation:
Though only good it seem to give, yet gainBy wrong acquired, not e'en one day retain

Meaning: Forsake in the very moment (of acquisition) that gain which, though it should bring advantage, is without equity
pope_couplet: Though only good it seem to give, yet gainBy wrong acquired, not e'en one day retain
explanation_en: Forsake in the very moment (of acquisition) that gain which, though it should bring advantage, is without equity
explanation_ta: தீமை பயக்காமல் நன்மையே தருவதானாலும் நடுவு நி‌லைமை தவறி உண்டாகும் ஆக்கத்தை அப்போதே கைவிட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who just or unjust lived shall soon appear:By each one's offspring shall the truth be clear

Meaning: The worthy and unworthy may be known by the existence or otherwise of good offsprings
pope_couplet: Who just or unjust lived shall soon appear:By each one's offspring shall the truth be clear
explanation_en: The worthy and unworthy may be known by the existence or otherwise of good offsprings
explanation_ta: நடுவுநிலைமை உடையவர் நடுவுநிலை‌மை இல்லாதவர் என்பது அவரவர்க்குப் பின் எஞ்சி நிற்கும் புகழாலும் பழியாலும் காணப்படும்.

translation:
The gain and loss in life are not mere accident; Just mind inflexible is sages' ornament

Meaning: Loss and gain come not without cause; it is the ornament of the wise to preserve evenness of mind (under both)
pope_couplet: The gain and loss in life are not mere accident; Just mind inflexible is sages' ornament
explanation_en: Loss and gain come not without cause; it is the ornament of the wise to preserve evenness of mind (under both)
explanation_ta: கேடும் ஆக்கமும் வாழ்வில் இல்லாதவை அல்ல; ஆகையால் நெஞ்சில் நடுவுநிலைமை தவறாமல் இருத்தலே சான்றோர்க்கு அழகாகும்.

translation:
If, right deserting, heart to evil turn, Let man impending ruin's sign discern

Meaning: Let him whose mind departing from equity commits sin well consider thus within himself, "I shall perish."
pope_couplet: If, right deserting, heart to evil turn, Let man impending ruin's sign discern
explanation_en: Let him whose mind departing from equity commits sin well consider thus within himself, "I shall perish."
explanation_ta: தன் நெஞ்சம் நடுவுநிலை நீங்கித் தவறு செய்ய நினைக்குமாயின், நான் கெடப்போகின்றேன் என்று ஒருவன் அறிய வேண்டும்.

translation:
The man who justly lives, tenacious of the right, In low estate is never low to wise man's sight

Meaning: The great will not regard as poverty the low estate of that man who dwells in the virtue of equity
pope_couplet: The man who justly lives, tenacious of the right, In low estate is never low to wise man's sight
explanation_en: The great will not regard as poverty the low estate of that man who dwells in the virtue of equity
explanation_ta: நடுவுநிலைமை நின்று அறநெறியில் நிலைத்து வாழகின்றவன் அடைந்த வறுமை நிலையைக் கேடு என கொள்ளாது உலகு.

translation:
To stand, like balance-rod that level hangs and rightly weighs, With calm unbiassed equity of soul, is sages' praise

Meaning: To incline to neither side, but to rest impartial as the even-fixed scale is the ornament of the wise
pope_couplet: To stand, like balance-rod that level hangs and rightly weighs, With calm unbiassed equity of soul, is sages' praise
explanation_en: To incline to neither side, but to rest impartial as the even-fixed scale is the ornament of the wise
explanation_ta: முன்னே தான் சமமாக இருந்து, பின்பு பொருளைச் சீர்தூக்கும் துலாக்கோல் போல் அமைந்து, ஒரு பக்கமாக சாயாமல் நடுவுநி‌லைமை போற்றுவது சான்றோர்க்கு அழகாகும்.

translation:
Inflexibility in word is righteousness, If men inflexibility of soul possess

Meaning: Freedom from obliquity of speech is rectitude, if there be (corresponding) freedom from bias of mind
pope_couplet: Inflexibility in word is righteousness, If men inflexibility of soul possess
explanation_en: Freedom from obliquity of speech is rectitude, if there be (corresponding) freedom from bias of mind
explanation_ta: உள்ளத்தில் கோணுதல் இல்லாத தன்மையை உறுதியாகப் பெற்றால், சொல்லிலும் கோணுதல் இல்லாதிருத்தல் நடுவுநிலைமையாம்.

translation:
As thriving trader is the trader known, Who guards another's interests as his own

Meaning: The true merchandize of merchants is to guard and do by the things of others as they do by their own
pope_couplet: As thriving trader is the trader known, Who guards another's interests as his own
explanation_en: The true merchandize of merchants is to guard and do by the things of others as they do by their own
explanation_ta: பிறர் பொருளையும் தம் பொருள் போல் போற்றிச் செய்தால், அதுவே வாணிகம் செய்வோர்க்கு உரி‌ய நல்ல வாணிக முறையாகும்.

translation:
Control of self does man conduct to bliss th' immortals share; Indulgence leads to deepest night, and leaves him there

Meaning: Self-control will place (a man) among the Gods; the want of it will drive (him) into the thickest darkness (of hell)
pope_couplet: Control of self does man conduct to bliss th' immortals share; Indulgence leads to deepest night, and leaves him there
explanation_en: Self-control will place (a man) among the Gods; the want of it will drive (him) into the thickest darkness (of hell)
explanation_ta: அடக்கம் ஒருவனை உயர்த்தித் தேவருள் சேர்க்கும்; அடக்கம் இல்லாதிருத்தல், பொல்லாத இருள் போன்ற தீய வாழ்க்கையில் செலுத்தி விடும்.

translation:
Guard thou as wealth the power of self-control; Than this no greater gain to living soul

Meaning: Let self-control be guarded as a treasure; there is no greater source of good for man than that
pope_couplet: Guard thou as wealth the power of self-control; Than this no greater gain to living soul
explanation_en: Let self-control be guarded as a treasure; there is no greater source of good for man than that
explanation_ta: அடக்கத்தை உறுதிப் பொருளாகக் கொண்டு போற்றிக் ‌காக்க வேண்டும். அந்த அடக்கத்தைவிட மேம்பட்ட ஆக்கம் உயிர்க்கு இல்லை.

translation:
If versed in wisdom's lore by virtue's law you self restrainYour self-repression known will yield you glory's gain

Meaning: Knowing that self-control is knowledge, if a man should control himself, in the prescribed course, such self-control will bring him distinction among the wise
pope_couplet: If versed in wisdom's lore by virtue's law you self restrainYour self-repression known will yield you glory's gain
explanation_en: Knowing that self-control is knowledge, if a man should control himself, in the prescribed course, such self-control will bring him distinction among the wise
explanation_ta: அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறிந்து, நல்வழியில் அடங்கி ஒழுகப்பெற்றால், அந்த அடக்கம் நல்லோரால் அறியப்பட்டு மேன்மை பயக்கும்.

translation:
In his station, all unswerving, if man self subdue, Greater he than mountain proudly rising to the view

Meaning: More lofty than a mountain will be the greatness of that man who without swerving from his domestic state, controls himself
pope_couplet: In his station, all unswerving, if man self subdue, Greater he than mountain proudly rising to the view
explanation_en: More lofty than a mountain will be the greatness of that man who without swerving from his domestic state, controls himself
explanation_ta: தன் நிலையிலிருந்து மாறுபடாமல் அடங்கி ஒழுகுவோனுடைய உயர்வு, மலையின் உயர்வை விட மிகவும் பெரிதாகும்.

translation:
To all humility is goodly grace; but chief to themWith fortune blessed, -'tis fortune's diadem

Meaning: Humility is good in all; but especially in the rich it is (the excellence of) higher riches
pope_couplet: To all humility is goodly grace; but chief to themWith fortune blessed, -'tis fortune's diadem
explanation_en: Humility is good in all; but especially in the rich it is (the excellence of) higher riches
explanation_ta: பணிவுடையவராக ஒழுகுதல்பொதுவாக எல்லோர்க்கும் நல்லதாகும்; அவர்களுள் சிறப்பாகச் செல்வர்க்கே மற்றொரு செல்வம் போன்றதாகும்.

translation:
Like tortoise, who the five restrainsIn one, through seven world bliss obtains

Meaning: Should one throughout a single birth, like a tortoise keep in his five senses, the fruit of it will prove a safe-guard to him throughout the seven-fold births.
pope_couplet: Like tortoise, who the five restrainsIn one, through seven world bliss obtains
explanation_en: Should one throughout a single birth, like a tortoise keep in his five senses, the fruit of it will prove a safe-guard to him throughout the seven-fold births.
explanation_ta: ஒரு பிறப்பில், ஆமைபோல் ஐம்பொறிகளையும் அடக்கியாள வல்லவனானால், அஃது அவனுக்குப் பல பிறப்பிலும் காப்பாகும் சிறப்பு உடையது.

translation:
Whate'er they fail to guard, o'er lips men guard should keep; If not, through fault of tongue, they bitter tears shall weep

Meaning: Whatever besides you leave unguarded, guard your tongue; otherwise errors of speech and the consequent misery will ensue
pope_couplet: Whate'er they fail to guard, o'er lips men guard should keep; If not, through fault of tongue, they bitter tears shall weep
explanation_en: Whatever besides you leave unguarded, guard your tongue; otherwise errors of speech and the consequent misery will ensue
explanation_ta: காக்க வேண்டியவற்றுள் எவற்றைக் காக்கா விட்டாலும் நாவையாவது காக்க வேண்டு்ம்; காக்கத் தவறினால் சொற்குற்றத்தில் அகப்பட்டுத் துன்புறுவர்.

translation:
Though some small gain of good it seem to bring, The evil word is parent still of evil thing

Meaning: If a man's speech be productive of a single evil, all the good by him will be turned into evil
pope_couplet: Though some small gain of good it seem to bring, The evil word is parent still of evil thing
explanation_en: If a man's speech be productive of a single evil, all the good by him will be turned into evil
explanation_ta: தீய ‌சொற்களின் பொருளால் விளையும் தீமை ஒன்றாயினும் ஒருவனிடம் உண்டானால், அதனால் மற்ற அறங்களாலும் நன்மை விளையாமல் போகும்.
