translation:
In flesh by fire inflamed, nature may thoroughly heal the sore; In soul by tongue inflamed, the ulcer healeth never more

Meaning: The wound which has been burnt in by fire may heal, but a wound burnt in by the tongue will never heal
pope_couplet: In flesh by fire inflamed, nature may thoroughly heal the sore; In soul by tongue inflamed, the ulcer healeth never more
explanation_en: The wound which has been burnt in by fire may heal, but a wound burnt in by the tongue will never heal
explanation_ta: தீயினால் சுட்ட புண் புறத்தே வடு இருந்தாலும் உள்ளே ஆறிவிடும்; ஆனால் நாவினால் தீய சொல் கூறிச் சுடும் வடு என்றும் ஆறாது.

translation:
Who learns restraint, and guards his soul from wrath, Virtue, a timely aid, attends his path

Meaning: Virtue, seeking for an opportunity, will come into the path of that man who, possessed of learning and self-control, guards himself against anger
pope_couplet: Who learns restraint, and guards his soul from wrath, Virtue, a timely aid, attends his path
explanation_en: Virtue, seeking for an opportunity, will come into the path of that man who, possessed of learning and self-control, guards himself against anger
explanation_ta: சினம் தோன்றாமல் காத்து, கல்வி கற்று, அடக்கமுடையவனாக இருக்க வல்லவனுடைய செவ்வியை, அவனுடைய வழியில் சென்று அறம் பார்த்திருக்கும்.

translation:
'Decorum' gives especial excellence; with greater care'Decorum' should men guard than life, which all men share

Meaning: Propriety of conduct leads to eminence, it should therefore be preserved more carefully than life
pope_couplet: 'Decorum' gives especial excellence; with greater care'Decorum' should men guard than life, which all men share
explanation_en: Propriety of conduct leads to eminence, it should therefore be preserved more carefully than life
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கமே எல்லார்க்கும் மேன்மையைத் தருவதாக இருப்பதால், அந்த ஒழுக்கமே உயிரை விடச் சிறந்ததாகப் போற்றப்படும்.

translation:
Searching, duly watching, learning, 'decorum' still we find; Man's only aid; toiling, guard thou this with watchful mind

Meaning: Let propriety of conduct be laboriously preserved and guarded; though one know and practise and excel in many virtues, that will be an eminent aid
pope_couplet: Searching, duly watching, learning, 'decorum' still we find; Man's only aid; toiling, guard thou this with watchful mind
explanation_en: Let propriety of conduct be laboriously preserved and guarded; though one know and practise and excel in many virtues, that will be an eminent aid
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கத்தை வருந்தியும் போற்றிக் காக்க வேண்டும்; பலவற்றையும் ஆராய்ந்து போற்றித் தெளிந்தாலும், அந்த ஒழுக்கமே வாழ்க்கையில் துணையாக விளங்கும்.

translation:
'Decorum's' true nobility on earth;'Indecorum's' issue is ignoble birth

Meaning: Propriety of conduct is true greatness of birth, and impropriety will sink into a mean birth
pope_couplet: 'Decorum's' true nobility on earth;'Indecorum's' issue is ignoble birth
explanation_en: Propriety of conduct is true greatness of birth, and impropriety will sink into a mean birth
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கம் உடையவராக வாழ்வதே உயர்ந்த குடிப்பிறப்பின் தன்மையாகும்; ஒழுக்கம் தவறுதல் இழிந்த குடிப்பிறப்பின் தன்மையாகி விடும்.

translation:
Though he forget, the Brahman may regain his Vedic lore; Failing in 'decorum due,' birthright's gone for evermore

Meaning: A Brahman though he should forget the Vedas may recover it by reading; but, if he fail in propriety of conduct even his high birth will be destroyed
pope_couplet: Though he forget, the Brahman may regain his Vedic lore; Failing in 'decorum due,' birthright's gone for evermore
explanation_en: A Brahman though he should forget the Vedas may recover it by reading; but, if he fail in propriety of conduct even his high birth will be destroyed
explanation_ta: கற்ற மறைப் பொருளை மறந்தாலும் மீண்டும் அதனை ஓதிக் கற்றுக் கொள்ள முடியும்; ஆனால் மறை ஓதுவனுடைய குடிப்பிறப்பு, ஒழுக்கம் குன்றினால் கெடு்ம்.

translation:
The envious soul in life no rich increase of blessing gains, So man of 'due decorum' void no dignity obtains

Meaning: Just as the envious man will be without wealth, so will the man of destitute of propriety of conduct be without greatness
pope_couplet: The envious soul in life no rich increase of blessing gains, So man of 'due decorum' void no dignity obtains
explanation_en: Just as the envious man will be without wealth, so will the man of destitute of propriety of conduct be without greatness
explanation_ta: பொறாமை உடையவனிடத்தில் ஆக்கம் இல்லாதவாறு போல, ஒழுக்கம் இல்லாதவனுடைய வாழ்க்கையில் உயர்வு இல்லையாகும்.

translation:
The strong of soul no jot abate of 'strict decorum's' laws, Knowing that 'due decorum's' breach foulest disgrace will cause

Meaning: Those firm in mind will not slacken in their observance of the proprieties of life, knowing, as they do, the misery that flows from the transgression from them
pope_couplet: The strong of soul no jot abate of 'strict decorum's' laws, Knowing that 'due decorum's' breach foulest disgrace will cause
explanation_en: Those firm in mind will not slacken in their observance of the proprieties of life, knowing, as they do, the misery that flows from the transgression from them
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கம் தவறுதலால் குற்றம் உண்டாவதை அறிந்து, மனவலிமை உடைய சான்றோர் ஒழுக்கத்தில் தவறாமல் காத்துக் கொள்வர்.

translation:
'Tis source of dignity when 'true decorum' is preserved; Who break 'decorum's' rules endure e'en censures undeserved

Meaning: From propriety of conduct men obtain greatness; from impropriety comes insufferable disgrace
pope_couplet: 'Tis source of dignity when 'true decorum' is preserved; Who break 'decorum's' rules endure e'en censures undeserved
explanation_en: From propriety of conduct men obtain greatness; from impropriety comes insufferable disgrace
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கத்தால் எவரும் மேம்பாட்டை அடைவர்; ஒழுக்கத்திலிருந்து தவறுதலால் அடையத் தகாத பெரும் பழியை அடைவர்.

translation:
'Decorum true' observed a seed of good will be;'Decorum's breach' will sorrow yield eternally

Meaning: Propriety of conduct is the seed of virtue; impropriety will ever cause sorrow
pope_couplet: 'Decorum true' observed a seed of good will be;'Decorum's breach' will sorrow yield eternally
explanation_en: Propriety of conduct is the seed of virtue; impropriety will ever cause sorrow
explanation_ta: நல்லொழுக்கம் இன்பமான நல்வாழ்க்கைக்குக் காரணமாக இருக்கும்; தீயொழுக்கம் எப்போதும் துன்பத்தைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
It cannot be that they who 'strict decorum's' law fulfil, E'en in forgetful mood, should utter words of ill

Meaning: Those who study propriety of conduct will not speak evil, even forgetfully
pope_couplet: It cannot be that they who 'strict decorum's' law fulfil, E'en in forgetful mood, should utter words of ill
explanation_en: Those who study propriety of conduct will not speak evil, even forgetfully
explanation_ta: தீய சொற்களைத் தவறியும் தம்முடைய வாயால் சொல்லும் குற்றம், ஒழுக்கம் உடையவர்க்குப் பொருந்தாததாகும்.

translation:
Who know not with the world in harmony to dwell, May many things have learned, but nothing well

Meaning: Those who know not how to act agreeably to the world, though they have learnt many things, are still ignorant
pope_couplet: Who know not with the world in harmony to dwell, May many things have learned, but nothing well
explanation_en: Those who know not how to act agreeably to the world, though they have learnt many things, are still ignorant
explanation_ta: உலகத்து உயர்ந்தவரோடு பொருந்த ஒழுகும் முறையைக் கற்காதவர், பல நூல்களைக் கற்றிருந்த போதிலும் அறிவில்லாதவரே ஆவர்.

translation:
Who laws of virtue and possession's rights have known, Indulge no foolish love of her by right another's own

Meaning: The folly of desiring her who is the property of another will not be found in those who know (the attributes of) virtue and (the rights of) property
pope_couplet: Who laws of virtue and possession's rights have known, Indulge no foolish love of her by right another's own
explanation_en: The folly of desiring her who is the property of another will not be found in those who know (the attributes of) virtue and (the rights of) property
explanation_ta: பிறனுடைய உரிமையாகிய மனைவியை விரும்பி நடக்கும் அறியாமை, உலகத்தில் அறமும் பொருளும் ஆராய்ந்து கண்டவரிடம் இல்லை.

translation:
No fools, of all that stand from virtue's pale shut out, Like those who longing lurk their neighbour's gate without

Meaning: Among all those who stand on the outside of virtue, there are no greater fools than those who stand outside their neighbour's door
pope_couplet: No fools, of all that stand from virtue's pale shut out, Like those who longing lurk their neighbour's gate without
explanation_en: Among all those who stand on the outside of virtue, there are no greater fools than those who stand outside their neighbour's door
explanation_ta: அறத்தை விட்டுத் தீநெறியில் நின்றவர் எல்லாரிலும் பிறன் மனைவியை விரும்பி அவனுடைய வாயிலில் சென்று நின்றவரைப் போல் அறிவிலிகள் இல்லை.

translation:
They're numbered with the dead, e'en while they live, -how otherwise?With wife of sure confiding friend who evil things devise

Meaning: Certainly they are no better than dead men who desire evil towards the wife of those who
pope_couplet: They're numbered with the dead, e'en while they live, -how otherwise?With wife of sure confiding friend who evil things devise
explanation_en: Certainly they are no better than dead men who desire evil towards the wife of those who
explanation_ta: ஐயமில்லாமல் தெளிந்து நம்பியவருடைய மனைவியிடத்தே விருப்பம் கொண்டு தீமையைச் செய்து நடப்பவர், செத்தவரை விட வேறுபட்டவர் அல்லர்.

translation:
How great soe'er they be, what gain have they of life, Who, not a whit reflecting, seek a neighbour's wife

Meaning: However great one may be, what does it avail if, without at all considering his guilt, he goes unto the wife of another ?
pope_couplet: How great soe'er they be, what gain have they of life, Who, not a whit reflecting, seek a neighbour's wife
explanation_en: However great one may be, what does it avail if, without at all considering his guilt, he goes unto the wife of another ?
explanation_ta: தினையளவும் ஆராய்ந்து பார்க்காமல் பிறனுடைய மனைவியிடம் செல்லுதல், எவ்வளவு பெருமையை உடையவராயினும் என்னவாக முடியும்?

translation:
'Mere triflel' saying thus, invades the home, so he ensuresA gain of guilt that deathless aye endures

Meaning: He who thinks lightly of going into the wife of another acquires guilt that will abide with him imperishably and for ever
pope_couplet: 'Mere triflel' saying thus, invades the home, so he ensuresA gain of guilt that deathless aye endures
explanation_en: He who thinks lightly of going into the wife of another acquires guilt that will abide with him imperishably and for ever
explanation_ta: இச்செயல் எளியது என எண்ணிப் பிறனுடைய மனைவியிடம் நெறி தவறிச் செல்கின்றவன், ‌எப்போதும் அழியாமல் நிலைநிற்கும் பழியை அடைவான்

translation:
Who home ivades, from him pass nevermore, Hatred and sin, fear, foul disgrace; these four

Meaning: Hatred, sin, fear, disgrace; these four will never leave him who goes in to his neighbour's wife
pope_couplet: Who home ivades, from him pass nevermore, Hatred and sin, fear, foul disgrace; these four
explanation_en: Hatred, sin, fear, disgrace; these four will never leave him who goes in to his neighbour's wife
explanation_ta: பகை பாவம் அச்சம் பழி என்னும் இந்நான்கு குற்றங்களும் பிறன் மனைவியிடத்து நெறி தவறி நடப்பவனிடத்திலிருந்து நீங்காவாம்.

translation:
Who sees the wife, another's own, with no desiring eyeIn sure domestic bliss he dwelleth ever virtuously

Meaning: He who desires not the womanhood of her who should walk according to the will of another will be praised as a virtuous house-holder
pope_couplet: Who sees the wife, another's own, with no desiring eyeIn sure domestic bliss he dwelleth ever virtuously
explanation_en: He who desires not the womanhood of her who should walk according to the will of another will be praised as a virtuous house-holder
explanation_ta: அறத்தின் இயல்போடு பொருந்தி இல்வாழ்க்கை வாழ்பவன், பிறனுக்கு உரிமையானவளின் பெண் தன்மையை விரும்பாதவனே

translation:
Manly excellence, that looks not on another's wife, Is not virtue merely, 'tis full 'propriety' of life

Meaning: That noble manliness which looks not at the wife of another is the virtue and dignity of the great
pope_couplet: Manly excellence, that looks not on another's wife, Is not virtue merely, 'tis full 'propriety' of life
explanation_en: That noble manliness which looks not at the wife of another is the virtue and dignity of the great
explanation_ta: பிறனுடைய மனைவியை விரும்பி நோக்காத ‌பெரிய ஆண்மை, சான்றோர்க்கு அறம் மட்டும் அன்று; நிறைந்த ஒழுக்கமுமாகும்.

translation:
Who 're good indeed, on earth begirt by ocean's gruesome tide?The men who touch not her that is another's bride

Meaning: Is it asked, "who are those who shall obtain good in this world surrounded by the terror-producing sea ?" Those who touch not the shoulder of her who belongs to another
pope_couplet: Who 're good indeed, on earth begirt by ocean's gruesome tide?The men who touch not her that is another's bride
explanation_en: Is it asked, "who are those who shall obtain good in this world surrounded by the terror-producing sea ?" Those who touch not the shoulder of her who belongs to another
explanation_ta: கடல் சூழ்ந்த உலகத்தில் நன்மைக்கு உரியவர் யார் என்றொல் பிறனுக்கு உரிமையானவளின் தோளைப் பொருந்தாதவரே ஆவர்

translation:
Though virtue's bounds he pass, and evil deeds hath wrought; At least, 'tis good if neighbour's wife he covet not

Meaning: Though a man perform no virtuous deeds and commit (every) vice, it will be well if he desire not the womanhood of her who is within the limit (of the house) of another
pope_couplet: Though virtue's bounds he pass, and evil deeds hath wrought; At least, 'tis good if neighbour's wife he covet not
explanation_en: Though a man perform no virtuous deeds and commit (every) vice, it will be well if he desire not the womanhood of her who is within the limit (of the house) of another
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அறநெறியில் நிற்காமல் அறமில்லாதவைகளைச் செய்தாலும், பிறனுக்கு உரியவளின் பெண்மையை விரும்பாமல் வாழ்தல் நல்லது

translation:
As earth bears up the men who delve into her breast, To bear with scornful men of virtues is the best

Meaning: To bear with those who revile us, just as the earth bears up those who dig it, is the first of virtues
pope_couplet: As earth bears up the men who delve into her breast, To bear with scornful men of virtues is the best
explanation_en: To bear with those who revile us, just as the earth bears up those who dig it, is the first of virtues
explanation_ta: தன்னை வெட்டுவோரையும் விழாமல் தாங்குகின்ற நிலம் போல், தம்மை இகழ்வாரையும் பொறுப்பதே தலையான பண்பாகும்

translation:
Forgiving trespasses is good always; Forgetting them hath even higher praise;

Meaning: Bear with reproach even when you can retaliate; but to forget it will be still better than that
pope_couplet: Forgiving trespasses is good always; Forgetting them hath even higher praise;
explanation_en: Bear with reproach even when you can retaliate; but to forget it will be still better than that
explanation_ta: வரம்பு கடந்து பிறர் செய்யும் தீங்கை எப்போதும் பொறுக்க வேண்டும்; அத் தீங்கை நினைவிலும் கொள்ளாமல் மறந்து விடுதல் பொறுத்தலை விட நல்லது.

translation:
The sorest poverty is bidding guest unfed depart; The mightiest might to bear with men of foolish heart

Meaning: To neglect hospitality is poverty of poverty To bear with the ignorant is might of might
pope_couplet: The sorest poverty is bidding guest unfed depart; The mightiest might to bear with men of foolish heart
explanation_en: To neglect hospitality is poverty of poverty To bear with the ignorant is might of might
explanation_ta: வறுமையுள் வறுமை, விருந்தினரைப் போற்றாமல் நீக்குதல்; வல்லமையுள் வல்லமை என்பது அறிவிலார் தீங்கு செய்தலைப் பொறுத்தலாகும்.

translation:
Seek'st thou honour never tarnished to retain; So must thou patience, guarding evermore, maintain

Meaning: If you desire that greatness should never leave, you preserve in your conduct the exercise of patience
pope_couplet: Seek'st thou honour never tarnished to retain; So must thou patience, guarding evermore, maintain
explanation_en: If you desire that greatness should never leave, you preserve in your conduct the exercise of patience
explanation_ta: நிறை உடையவனாக இருக்கும் தன்மை தன்னை விட்டு நீங்காமல் இருக்க வேண்டினால், பொறுமையைப் போற்றி ஒழுக வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who wreak their wrath as worthless are despised; Who patiently forbear as gold are prized

Meaning: (The wise) will not at all esteem the resentful They will esteem the patient just as the gold which they lay up with care
pope_couplet: Who wreak their wrath as worthless are despised; Who patiently forbear as gold are prized
explanation_en: (The wise) will not at all esteem the resentful They will esteem the patient just as the gold which they lay up with care
explanation_ta: ( தீங்கு செய்தவரைப்) பொறுக்காமல் வருத்தினவரை உலகத்தார் ஒரு பொருளாக மதியார்; ஆனால், பொறுத்தவரைப் பொன்போல் மனத்துள் வைத்து மதிப்பர்.

translation:
Who wreak their wrath have pleasure for a day; Who bear have praise till earth shall pass away

Meaning: The pleasure of the resentful continues for a day The praise of the patient will continue until (the final destruction of) the world
pope_couplet: Who wreak their wrath have pleasure for a day; Who bear have praise till earth shall pass away
explanation_en: The pleasure of the resentful continues for a day The praise of the patient will continue until (the final destruction of) the world
explanation_ta: தீங்கு செய்தவரைப் பொறுக்காமல் வருத்தினவர்க்கு ஒருநாள் இன்பமே; பொறுத்தவர்க்கு உலகம் அழியும் வரைக்கும் புகழ் உண்டு.

translation:
Though others work thee ill, thus shalt thou blessing reap; Grieve for their sin, thyself from vicious action keep

Meaning: Though others inflict injuries on you, yet compassionating the evil (that will come upon them) it will be well not to do them anything contrary to virtue
pope_couplet: Though others work thee ill, thus shalt thou blessing reap; Grieve for their sin, thyself from vicious action keep
explanation_en: Though others inflict injuries on you, yet compassionating the evil (that will come upon them) it will be well not to do them anything contrary to virtue
explanation_ta: தகுதி அல்லாதவைகளைத் தனக்குப் பிறர் செய்த போதிலும், அதனால், அவர்க்கு வரும் துன்பத்திற்காக நொந்து, அறம் அல்லாதவைகளைச் செய்யாதிருத்தல் நல்லது.

translation:
With overweening pride when men with injuries assail, By thine own righteous dealing shalt thou mightily prevail

Meaning: Let a man by patience overcome those who through pride commit excesses
pope_couplet: With overweening pride when men with injuries assail, By thine own righteous dealing shalt thou mightily prevail
explanation_en: Let a man by patience overcome those who through pride commit excesses
explanation_ta: செருக்கினால் தீங்கானவற்றைச் செய்தவரைத் தாம் தம்முடைய பொறுமைப் பண்பினால் பொறுத்து வென்று விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
They who transgressors' evil words endureWith patience, are as stern ascetics pure

Meaning: Those who bear with the uncourteous speech of the insolent are as pure as the ascetics
pope_couplet: They who transgressors' evil words endureWith patience, are as stern ascetics pure
explanation_en: Those who bear with the uncourteous speech of the insolent are as pure as the ascetics
explanation_ta: வரம்பு கடந்து நடப்பவரின் வாயில் பிறக்கும் கொடுஞ்சொற்களைப் பொறுத்துக் கொள்பவர், துறந்தவரைப் போலத் தூய்மையானவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
Though 'great' we deem the men that fast and suffer pain, Who others' bitter words endure, the foremost place obtain

Meaning: Those who endure abstinence from food are great, next to those who endure the uncourteous speech of others
pope_couplet: Though 'great' we deem the men that fast and suffer pain, Who others' bitter words endure, the foremost place obtain
explanation_en: Those who endure abstinence from food are great, next to those who endure the uncourteous speech of others
explanation_ta: உணவு உண்ணாமல் நோன்பு கிடப்பவர், பிறர் ‌சொல்லும் கொடுஞ் சொற்களைப் பொறுப்பவர்க்கு அடுத்த நிலையில்தான் பெரியவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
As 'strict decorum's' laws, that all men bind, Let each regard unenvying grace of mind

Meaning: Let a man esteem that disposition which is free from envy in the same manner as propriety of conduct
pope_couplet: As 'strict decorum's' laws, that all men bind, Let each regard unenvying grace of mind
explanation_en: Let a man esteem that disposition which is free from envy in the same manner as propriety of conduct
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன் நெஞ்சில் பொறாமை இல்லாமல் வாழும் இயல்பைத் தனக்கு உரிய ஒழுக்க நெறியாகக் கொண்டு போற்ற வேண்டும்.

translation:
If man can learn to envy none on earth,'Tis richest gift, -beyond compare its worth

Meaning: Amongst all attainable excellences there is none equal to that of being free from envy towords others
pope_couplet: If man can learn to envy none on earth,'Tis richest gift, -beyond compare its worth
explanation_en: Amongst all attainable excellences there is none equal to that of being free from envy towords others
explanation_ta: யாரிடத்திலும் பொறாமை இல்லாதிருக்கப் பெற்றால், ஒருவன் பெறத்தக்க மேம்பாடான பேறுகளில் அதற்கு ஒப்பானது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
Nor wealth nor virtue does that man desire 'tis plain, Whom others' wealth delights not, feeling envious pain

Meaning: Of him who instead of rejoicing in the wealth of others, envies it, it will be said "he neither desires virtue not wealth."
pope_couplet: Nor wealth nor virtue does that man desire 'tis plain, Whom others' wealth delights not, feeling envious pain
explanation_en: Of him who instead of rejoicing in the wealth of others, envies it, it will be said "he neither desires virtue not wealth."
explanation_ta: தனக்கு அறமும் ஆக்கமும் விரும்பாதவன் என்று கருதத் தக்கவனே, பிறனுடைய ஆக்கத்தைக் கண்டு மகிழாமல் அதற்காகப் பொறாமைப்படுவான்.

translation:
The wise through envy break not virtue's laws, Knowing ill-deeds of foul disgrace the cause

Meaning: (The wise) knowing the misery that comes from transgression will not through envy commit unrighteous deeds
pope_couplet: The wise through envy break not virtue's laws, Knowing ill-deeds of foul disgrace the cause
explanation_en: (The wise) knowing the misery that comes from transgression will not through envy commit unrighteous deeds
explanation_ta: பொறாமைப்படுதலாகிய தவறான நெறியில் துன்பம் ஏற்படுத‌ை அறிந்து, பொறாமை காரணமாக அறமல்லாதவைகளைச் செய்யார் அறிவுடையோர்.

translation:
Envy they have within! Enough to seat their fate!Though foemen fail, envy can ruin consummate

Meaning: To those who cherish envy that is enough Though free from enemies that (envy) will bring destruction
pope_couplet: Envy they have within! Enough to seat their fate!Though foemen fail, envy can ruin consummate
explanation_en: To those who cherish envy that is enough Though free from enemies that (envy) will bring destruction
explanation_ta: பொறாமை உடை‌யவர்க்கு வேறு பகை வேண்டா. அஃது ஒன்றே போதும், பகைவர் தீங்கு செய்யத் தவறினாலும் தவறாது கேட்டைத் தருவது அது.

translation:
Who scans good gifts to others given with envious eye, His kin, with none to clothe or feed them, surely die

Meaning: He who is envious at a gift (made to another) will with his relations utterly perish destitute of food and rainment
pope_couplet: Who scans good gifts to others given with envious eye, His kin, with none to clothe or feed them, surely die
explanation_en: He who is envious at a gift (made to another) will with his relations utterly perish destitute of food and rainment
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு உதவியாகக் கொடுக்கப்படும் பொருளைக் கண்டு பொறாமைப்படுகின்றவனுடைய சுற்றம், உடையும் உணவும் இல்லாமல் கெடும்.

translation:
From envious man good fortune's goddess turns away, Grudging him good, and points him out misfortune's prey

Meaning: Lakshmi envying (the prosperity) of the envious man will depart and introduce him to her sister
pope_couplet: From envious man good fortune's goddess turns away, Grudging him good, and points him out misfortune's prey
explanation_en: Lakshmi envying (the prosperity) of the envious man will depart and introduce him to her sister
explanation_ta: பொறாமை உடையவனைத் திருமகள் கண்டு பொறாமைப்பட்டுத் தன் தமக்கைக்கு அவனைக் காட்டி நீங்கி விடுவாள்.

translation:
Envy, embodied ill, incomparable bane, Good fortune slays, and soul consigns to fiery pain

Meaning: Envy will destroy (a man's) wealth (in his world) and drive him into the pit of fire (in the world to come.)
pope_couplet: Envy, embodied ill, incomparable bane, Good fortune slays, and soul consigns to fiery pain
explanation_en: Envy will destroy (a man's) wealth (in his world) and drive him into the pit of fire (in the world to come.)
explanation_ta: பொறாமை என்று கூறப்படும் ஒப்பற்ற பாவி, ஒருவனுடைய செல்வத்தைக் கெடுத்துத் தீய வழியில் அவனைச் செலுத்தி விடும்.

translation:
To men of envious heart, when comes increase of joy, Or loss to blameless men, the 'why' will thoughtful hearts employ

Meaning: The wealth of a man of envious mind and the poverty of the righteous will be pondered
pope_couplet: To men of envious heart, when comes increase of joy, Or loss to blameless men, the 'why' will thoughtful hearts employ
explanation_en: The wealth of a man of envious mind and the poverty of the righteous will be pondered
explanation_ta: பொறாமை பொருந்திய நெஞ்சத்தானுடைய ஆக்கமும், பொறாமை இல்லாத நல்லவனுடைய கேடும் ஆராயத் தக்கவை

translation:
No envious men to large and full felicity attain; No men from envy free have failed a sure increase to gain

Meaning: Never have the envious become great; never have those who are free from envy been without greatness
pope_couplet: No envious men to large and full felicity attain; No men from envy free have failed a sure increase to gain
explanation_en: Never have the envious become great; never have those who are free from envy been without greatness
explanation_ta: பொறாமைப்பட்டுப் பெருமையுற்றவரும் உலகத்தில் இல்லை; பொறாமை இல்லாதவராய் மேம்பாட்டிலிருந்து நீங்கியவரும் இல்லை.

translation:
With soul unjust to covet others' well-earned store, Brings ruin to the home, to evil opes the door

Meaning: If a man departing from equity covet the property (of others), at that very time will his family be destroyed and guilt be incurred
pope_couplet: With soul unjust to covet others' well-earned store, Brings ruin to the home, to evil opes the door
explanation_en: If a man departing from equity covet the property (of others), at that very time will his family be destroyed and guilt be incurred
explanation_ta: நடுவுநிலைமை இல்லாமல் பிறர்க்குரிய நல்ல பொருளை ஒருவன் கவர விரும்பினால் அவனுடைய குடியும் கெட்டுக் குற்றமும் அப்போழுதே வந்து சேரும்.

translation:
Through lust of gain, no deeds that retribution bring, Do they, who shrink with shame from every unjust thing

Meaning: Those who blush at the want of equity will not commit disgraceful acts through desire of the profit that may be gained
pope_couplet: Through lust of gain, no deeds that retribution bring, Do they, who shrink with shame from every unjust thing
explanation_en: Those who blush at the want of equity will not commit disgraceful acts through desire of the profit that may be gained
explanation_ta: நடுவுநிலைமை அல்லாதவற்றைக் கண்டு நாணி ஒதுங்குகின்றவர், பிறர் பொருளைக் கவர்வதால் வரும் பயனை விரும்பிப் பழியான செயல்களைச் செய்யார்.

translation:
No deeds of ill, misled by base desire, Do they, whose souls to other joys aspire

Meaning: Those who desire the higher pleasures (of heaven) will not act unjustly through desire of the trifling joy. (in this life.)
pope_couplet: No deeds of ill, misled by base desire, Do they, whose souls to other joys aspire
explanation_en: Those who desire the higher pleasures (of heaven) will not act unjustly through desire of the trifling joy. (in this life.)
explanation_ta: அறநெறியால் பெறும் இன்பத்தை விரும்புகின்றவர், நிலையில்லாத சிறிய இன்பத்தை விரும்பி அறம் அல்லாதவற்றைச் செய்யார்.

translation:
Men who have conquered sense, with sight from sordid vision freed, Desire not other's goods, e'en in the hour of sorest need

Meaning: The wise who have conquered their senses and are free from crime, will not covet (the things of others), with the thought "we are destitute."
pope_couplet: Men who have conquered sense, with sight from sordid vision freed, Desire not other's goods, e'en in the hour of sorest need
explanation_en: The wise who have conquered their senses and are free from crime, will not covet (the things of others), with the thought "we are destitute."
explanation_ta: ஐம்புலன்களையும் வென்ற குற்றமில்லாத அறிவை உடையவர், யாம் வறுமை அடைந்தோம் என்று எண்ணியும் பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பார்‌.

translation:
What gain, though lore refined of amplest reach he learn, His acts towards all mankind if covetous desire to folly turn

Meaning: What is the advantage of extensive and accurate knowledge if a man through covetousness act senselessly towards all ?
pope_couplet: What gain, though lore refined of amplest reach he learn, His acts towards all mankind if covetous desire to folly turn
explanation_en: What is the advantage of extensive and accurate knowledge if a man through covetousness act senselessly towards all ?
explanation_ta: யாரிடத்திலும் பொருளைக் கவர விரும்பிப் பொருந்தாதவற்றைச் செய்தால், நுட்பமானதாய் விரிவுடையதாய் வளர்ந்த அறிவால் பயன் என்ன?

translation:
Though, grace desiring, he in virtue's way stand strong, He's lost who wealth desires, and ponders deeds of wrong

Meaning: If he, who through desire of the virtue of kindness abides in the domestic state ie, the path in which it may be obtained, covet (the property of others) and think of evil methods (to obtain it), he will perish
pope_couplet: Though, grace desiring, he in virtue's way stand strong, He's lost who wealth desires, and ponders deeds of wrong
explanation_en: If he, who through desire of the virtue of kindness abides in the domestic state ie, the path in which it may be obtained, covet (the property of others) and think of evil methods (to obtain it), he will perish
explanation_ta: அருளை விரும்பி அறநெறியில் நின்றவன், பிறனுடைய பொருளை விரும்பிப் பொல்லாத குற்றங்களை எண்ணினால் கெடுவான்.

translation:
Seek not increase by greed of gain acquired; That fruit matured yields never good desired

Meaning: Desire not the gain of covetousness In the enjoyment of its fruits there is no glory
pope_couplet: Seek not increase by greed of gain acquired; That fruit matured yields never good desired
explanation_en: Desire not the gain of covetousness In the enjoyment of its fruits there is no glory
explanation_ta: பிறர் பொருளைக் கவர விரும்புவதால் ஆகும் ஆக்கத்தை விரும்பாதிருக்க வேண்டும்; அது பயன் விளைவிக்கும்போது அப்பயன் நன்மையாவது அரிதாகும்.

translation:
What saves prosperity from swift decline?Absence of lust to make another's cherished riches thine

Meaning: If it is weighed, "what is the indestructibility of wealth," it is freedom from covetousness
pope_couplet: What saves prosperity from swift decline?Absence of lust to make another's cherished riches thine
explanation_en: If it is weighed, "what is the indestructibility of wealth," it is freedom from covetousness
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய செல்வத்திற்குக் குறைவு நேராதிருக்க வழி எது என்றால், அவன் பிறனுடைய கைப்பொருளை விரும்பாதிருத்தலாகும்.

translation:
Good fortune draws anigh in helpful time of need, To him who, schooled in virtue, guards his soul from greed

Meaning: Lakshmi, knowing the manner (in which she may approach) will immediately come to those wise men who, knowing that it is virtue, covet not the property of others
pope_couplet: Good fortune draws anigh in helpful time of need, To him who, schooled in virtue, guards his soul from greed
explanation_en: Lakshmi, knowing the manner (in which she may approach) will immediately come to those wise men who, knowing that it is virtue, covet not the property of others
explanation_ta: அறம் இஃது என்று அறிந்து பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பாத அறிவுடையாரைத் திருமகள் தான் சேரும் திறன் அறிந்து அதற்கு ஏற்றவாறு சேர்வாள்.

translation:
From thoughtless lust of other's goods springs fatal ill, Greatness of soul that covets not shall triumph still

Meaning: To covet (the wealth of another) regardless of consequences will bring destruction That greatness (of mind) which covets not will give victory
pope_couplet: From thoughtless lust of other's goods springs fatal ill, Greatness of soul that covets not shall triumph still
explanation_en: To covet (the wealth of another) regardless of consequences will bring destruction That greatness (of mind) which covets not will give victory
explanation_ta: வி‌ளைவை எண்ணாமல் பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பினால் அஃது அழிவைத் தரும்; அப்பொருளை விரும்பாமல் வாழும் பெருமை வெற்றியைத் தரும்.

translation:
Though virtuous words his lips speak not, and all his deeds are illIf neighbour he defame not, there's good within him still

Meaning: Though one do not even speak of virtue and live in sin, it will be well if it be said of him "he does not backbite."
pope_couplet: Though virtuous words his lips speak not, and all his deeds are illIf neighbour he defame not, there's good within him still
explanation_en: Though one do not even speak of virtue and live in sin, it will be well if it be said of him "he does not backbite."
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அறத்தைப் போற்றிக் கூறாதவனாய் அறமல்லாதவற்றைச் செய்தாலும், மற்றவனைப் பற்றிப் புறங்கூறாமல் இருக்கிறான் என்று சொல்லப்படுதல் நல்லது.

translation:
Than he who virtue scorns, and evil deeds performs, more vile, Is he that slanders friend, then meets him with false smile

Meaning: To smile deceitfully (in another's presence) after having reviled him to his destruction (behind his back) is a greater evil than the commission of (every other) sin and the destruction of (every) virtue
pope_couplet: Than he who virtue scorns, and evil deeds performs, more vile, Is he that slanders friend, then meets him with false smile
explanation_en: To smile deceitfully (in another's presence) after having reviled him to his destruction (behind his back) is a greater evil than the commission of (every other) sin and the destruction of (every) virtue
explanation_ta: அறத்தை அழித்துப் பேசி அறமல்லாதவைகளைச் செய்வதை விட, ஒருவன் இல்லாதவிடத்தில் அவனைப் பழித்துப் பேசி நேரில் பொய்யாக முகமலர்ந்து பேசுதல் தீமையாகும்.

translation:
'Tis greater gain of virtuous good for man to die, Than live to slander absent friend, and falsely praise when nigh

Meaning: Death rather than life will confer upon the deceitful backbiter the profit which (the treatises on) virtue point out
pope_couplet: 'Tis greater gain of virtuous good for man to die, Than live to slander absent friend, and falsely praise when nigh
explanation_en: Death rather than life will confer upon the deceitful backbiter the profit which (the treatises on) virtue point out
explanation_ta: புறங்கூறிப் பொய்யாக நடந்து உயிர் வாழ்தலை விட, அவ்வாறு செய்யாமல் வறுமையுற்று இறந்து விடுதல், அறநூல்கள் சொல்லும் ஆக்கத்தைத் தரும்‌‌.

translation:
In presence though unkindly words you speak, say notIn absence words whose ill result exceeds your thought

Meaning: Though you speak without kindness before another's face speak not in his absence words which regard not the evil subsequently resulting from it
pope_couplet: In presence though unkindly words you speak, say notIn absence words whose ill result exceeds your thought
explanation_en: Though you speak without kindness before another's face speak not in his absence words which regard not the evil subsequently resulting from it
explanation_ta: எதிரே நின்று கண்ணோ‌ட்டம் இல்லாமல் கடுமையாகச் சொன்னாலும் சொல்லலாம்; நேரில் இல்லாதபோது பின் விளைவை ஆராயாத சொல்லைச் சொல்லக்கூடாது.

translation:
The slanderous meanness that an absent friend defames,'This man in words owns virtue, not in heart,' proclaims

Meaning: The emptiness of that man's mind who (merely) praises virtue will be seen from the meanness of reviling another behind his back
pope_couplet: The slanderous meanness that an absent friend defames,'This man in words owns virtue, not in heart,' proclaims
explanation_en: The emptiness of that man's mind who (merely) praises virtue will be seen from the meanness of reviling another behind his back
explanation_ta: அறத்தை நல்லதென்று போற்றும் நெஞ்சம் இல்லாததன்மை, ஒருவன் மற்றவனைப் பற்றிப் புறங்கூறுகின்ற சிறுமையால் காணப்படும்.

translation:
Who on his neighbours' sins delights to dwell, The story of his sins, culled out with care, the world will tell

Meaning: The character of the faults of that man who publishes abroad the faults of others will be sought out and published
pope_couplet: Who on his neighbours' sins delights to dwell, The story of his sins, culled out with care, the world will tell
explanation_en: The character of the faults of that man who publishes abroad the faults of others will be sought out and published
explanation_ta: மற்றவனைப் பற்றிப் புறங்கூறுகின்றவன், அவனுடைய பழிகள் பலவற்றிலும் நோகத்தக்கவை ஆராய்ந்து கூறிப் பிறரால் பழிக்கப்படுவான்.

translation:
With friendly art who know not pleasant words to say, Speak words that sever hearts, and drive choice friends away

Meaning: Those who know not to live in friendship with amusing conversation will by back-biting estrange even their relatives
pope_couplet: With friendly art who know not pleasant words to say, Speak words that sever hearts, and drive choice friends away
explanation_en: Those who know not to live in friendship with amusing conversation will by back-biting estrange even their relatives
explanation_ta: மகிழும்படியாகப் பேசி நட்புக் கொள்ளுதல் நன்மை என்று தெளியாதவர் தம்மை விட்டு நீங்கும்படியாகப் புறம் கூறி நண்பரையும் பிரித்து விடுவர்.

translation:
Whose nature bids them faults of closest friends proclaimWhat mercy will they show to other men's good name

Meaning: What will those not do to strangers whose nature leads them to publish abroad the faults of their intimate friends ?
pope_couplet: Whose nature bids them faults of closest friends proclaimWhat mercy will they show to other men's good name
explanation_en: What will those not do to strangers whose nature leads them to publish abroad the faults of their intimate friends ?
explanation_ta: நெருங்கிப் பழகியவரின் குற்றத்தையும் புறங்கூறித் தூற்றும் இயல்புடையவர், பழகாத அயலாரிடத்து என்ன செய்வாரோ?

translation:
'Tis charity, I ween, that makes the earth sustain their loadWho, neighbours' absence watching, tales or slander tell abroad

Meaning: The world through charity supports the weight of those who reproach others observing their absence
pope_couplet: 'Tis charity, I ween, that makes the earth sustain their loadWho, neighbours' absence watching, tales or slander tell abroad
explanation_en: The world through charity supports the weight of those who reproach others observing their absence
explanation_ta: ஒருவர் நேரில் இல்லாதது கண்டு பழிச்‌சொல் கூறுவோனுடைய உடல் பாரத்தை, இவனையும் சுமப்பதே எனக்கு அறம் என்று கருதி நிலம் சுமக்கின்றதோ?

translation:
If each his own, as neighbours' faults would scan, Could any evil hap to living man

Meaning: If they observed their own faults as they observe the faults of others, would any evil happen to men ?
pope_couplet: If each his own, as neighbours' faults would scan, Could any evil hap to living man
explanation_en: If they observed their own faults as they observe the faults of others, would any evil happen to men ?
explanation_ta: அயலாருடைய குற்றத்தைக் காண்பது போல் தம் குற்றத்தையும் காண வல்லவரானால், நிலைபெற்ற உயிர் வாழ்க்கைக்குத் துன்பம் உண்ட‌ோ?

translation:
Words without sense, while chafe the wise, Who babbles, him will all despise

Meaning: He who to the disgust of many speaks useless things will be despised by all
pope_couplet: Words without sense, while chafe the wise, Who babbles, him will all despise
explanation_en: He who to the disgust of many speaks useless things will be despised by all
explanation_ta: கேட்டவர் பலரும் வெறுக்கும் படியாகப் பயனில்லாத சொற்களைச் சொல்லுகின்றவன், எல்லாராலும் இகழப்படுவான்

translation:
Words without sense, where many wise men hear, to pourThan deeds to friends ungracious done offendeth more

Meaning: To speak useless things in the presence of many is a greater evil than to do unkind things towards friends
pope_couplet: Words without sense, where many wise men hear, to pourThan deeds to friends ungracious done offendeth more
explanation_en: To speak useless things in the presence of many is a greater evil than to do unkind things towards friends
explanation_ta: பலர் முன்னே பயனில்லாத சொற்களைச் சொல்லுதல், நண்பரிடத்தில் அறம் இல்லா செயல்களைச் செய்தலை விடத் தீமையானதாகும்.

translation:
Diffusive speech of useless words proclaimsA man who never righteous wisdom gains

Meaning: That conversation in which a man utters forth useless things will say of him "he is without virtue."
pope_couplet: Diffusive speech of useless words proclaimsA man who never righteous wisdom gains
explanation_en: That conversation in which a man utters forth useless things will say of him "he is without virtue."
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் பயனில்லா பொருள்களைப் பற்றி விரிவாகச் சொல்லும் சொற்கள், அவன் அறம் இல்லாதவன் என்பதை அறிவிக்கும்.

translation:
Unmeaning, worthless words, said to the multitude, To none delight afford, and sever men from good

Meaning: The words devoid of profit or pleasure which a man speaks will, being inconsistent with virtue,
pope_couplet: Unmeaning, worthless words, said to the multitude, To none delight afford, and sever men from good
explanation_en: The words devoid of profit or pleasure which a man speaks will, being inconsistent with virtue,
explanation_ta: பயனோடு பொருந்தாத பண்பு இல்லாத சொற்களைப் பலரிடத்தும் சொல்லுதல், அறத்தோடு பொருந்தாமல் நன்மையிலிருந்து நீங்கச் செய்யும்.

translation:
Gone are both fame and boasted excellence, When men of worth speak of words devoid of sense

Meaning: If the good speak vain words their eminence and excellence will leave them
pope_couplet: Gone are both fame and boasted excellence, When men of worth speak of words devoid of sense
explanation_en: If the good speak vain words their eminence and excellence will leave them
explanation_ta: பயனில்லாத சொற்களை நல்ல பண்பு உடையவர் சொல்லுவாரானால், அவனுடைய மேம்பாடு அவர்க்குரிய மதிப்போடு நீங்கிவிடும்.

translation:
Who makes display of idle words' inanity, Call him not man, -chaff of humanity

Meaning: Call not him a man who parades forth his empty words Call him the chaff of men
pope_couplet: Who makes display of idle words' inanity, Call him not man, -chaff of humanity
explanation_en: Call not him a man who parades forth his empty words Call him the chaff of men
explanation_ta: பயனில்லாத சொற்களைப் பலமுறையும் சொல்லுகின்ற ஒருவனை மனிதன் என்று சொல்லக்கூடாது, மக்களுள் பதர் என்று சொல்லவேண்டும்.

translation:
Let those who list speak things that no delight afford,'Tis good for men of worth to speak no idle word

Meaning: Let the wise if they will, speak things without excellence; it will be well for them not to speak useless things
pope_couplet: Let those who list speak things that no delight afford,'Tis good for men of worth to speak no idle word
explanation_en: Let the wise if they will, speak things without excellence; it will be well for them not to speak useless things
explanation_ta: அறம் இல்லாதவற்றைச் சொன்னாலும் சொல்லலாம், சான்றோர் பயன் இல்லாத சொற்களைச் சொல்லாமல் இருத்தல் நன்மையாகும்.

translation:
The wise who weigh the worth of every utterance, Speak none but words of deep significance

Meaning: The wise who seek after rare pleasures will not speak words that have not much weight in them
pope_couplet: The wise who weigh the worth of every utterance, Speak none but words of deep significance
explanation_en: The wise who seek after rare pleasures will not speak words that have not much weight in them
explanation_ta: அருமையான பயன்களை ஆராயவல்ல அறிவை உடைய அறிஞர், மிக்க பயன் இல்லாத சொற்களை ஒருபோதும் சொல்லமாட்டார்

translation:
The men of vision pure, from wildering folly free, Not e'en in thoughtless hour, speak words of vanity

Meaning: Those wise men who are without faults and are freed from ignorance will not even forgetfully speak things that profit not
pope_couplet: The men of vision pure, from wildering folly free, Not e'en in thoughtless hour, speak words of vanity
explanation_en: Those wise men who are without faults and are freed from ignorance will not even forgetfully speak things that profit not
explanation_ta: மயக்கத்திலிருந்து தெளிந்த மாசற்ற அறிவை உடையவர், பயன் நீங்கிய சொற்களை ஒருகால் மறந்தும் சொல்லமாட்டார்.

translation:
If speak you will, speak words that fruit afford, If speak you will, speak never fruitless word

Meaning: Speak what is useful, and speak not useless words
pope_couplet: If speak you will, speak words that fruit afford, If speak you will, speak never fruitless word
explanation_en: Speak what is useful, and speak not useless words
explanation_ta: சொற்களில் பயன் உடைய சொற்களை மட்டுமே சொல்லவேண்டும், பயன் இல்லாதவைகளாகிய சொற்களை சொல்லவே கூடாது.

translation:
With sinful act men cease to feel the dread of ill within, The excellent will dread the wanton pride of cherished sin

Meaning: Those who have experience of evil deeds will not fear, but the excellent will fear the pride of sin
pope_couplet: With sinful act men cease to feel the dread of ill within, The excellent will dread the wanton pride of cherished sin
explanation_en: Those who have experience of evil deeds will not fear, but the excellent will fear the pride of sin
explanation_ta: தீயவை செய்தலாகிய செருக்கைத் தீவினை உடைய பாவிகள் அஞ்சார், தீவினை இல்லாத மேலோர் மட்டுமே அஞ்சுவர்.

translation:
Since evils new from evils ever grow, Evil than fire works out more dreaded woe

Meaning: Because evil produces evil, therefore should evil be feared more than fire
pope_couplet: Since evils new from evils ever grow, Evil than fire works out more dreaded woe
explanation_en: Because evil produces evil, therefore should evil be feared more than fire
explanation_ta: தீயசெயல்கள் தீமையை விளைவிக்கும் தன்மை உடையனவாக இருத்தலால், அத் தீயச் செயல்கள் தீயைவிடக் கொடியனவாகக் கருதி அஞ்சப்படும்.

translation:
Even to those that hate make no return of ill; So shalt thou wisdom's highest law, 'tis said, fulfil

Meaning: So shalt thou wisdom's highest law, 'tis said, fulfil
pope_couplet: Even to those that hate make no return of ill; So shalt thou wisdom's highest law, 'tis said, fulfil
explanation_en: So shalt thou wisdom's highest law, 'tis said, fulfil
explanation_ta: தம்மை வருத்துவோர்க்கும் தீய செயல்களைச் செய்யாமலிருத்தலை, அறிவு எல்லாவற்றிலும் தலையான அறிவு என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Though good thy soul forget, plot not thy neighbour's fall, Thy plans shall 'virtue's Power' by ruin to thyself forestall

Meaning: Even though forgetfulness meditate not the ruin of another Virtue will meditate the ruin of him who thus meditates
pope_couplet: Though good thy soul forget, plot not thy neighbour's fall, Thy plans shall 'virtue's Power' by ruin to thyself forestall
explanation_en: Even though forgetfulness meditate not the ruin of another Virtue will meditate the ruin of him who thus meditates
explanation_ta: பிறனுக்கு கேட்டைத் தரும் தீய செயல்களை ஒருவன் மறந்தும் கூட எண்ணக்கூடாது, எண்ணினால் எண்ணியவனுக்கு கேடு விளையுமாறு அறம் எண்ணும்.

translation:
Make not thy poverty a plea for ill; Thy evil deeds will make thee poorer still

Meaning: Commit not evil, saying, "I am poor": if you do, you will become poorer still
pope_couplet: Make not thy poverty a plea for ill; Thy evil deeds will make thee poorer still
explanation_en: Commit not evil, saying, "I am poor": if you do, you will become poorer still
explanation_ta: யான் வறியவன் என்று நினைத்துத் தீய செயல்களைச் செய்யக்கூடாது, செய்தால் மீண்டும் வறியவன் ஆகி வருந்துவான்.

translation:
What ranks as evil spare to do, if thou would'st shunAffliction sore through ill to thee by others done

Meaning: Let him not do evil to others who desires not that sorrows should pursue him
pope_couplet: What ranks as evil spare to do, if thou would'st shunAffliction sore through ill to thee by others done
explanation_en: Let him not do evil to others who desires not that sorrows should pursue him
explanation_ta: துன்பம் செய்யும் தீவினைகள் தன்னை வருத்துதலை விரும்பாதவன், தீயசெயல்களைத் தான் பிறருக்குச் செய்யாமலிருக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
From every enmity incurred there is to 'scape, a way; The wrath of evil deeds will dog men's steps, and slay

Meaning: However great be the enmity men have incurred they may still live The enmity of sin will incessantly pursue and kill
pope_couplet: From every enmity incurred there is to 'scape, a way; The wrath of evil deeds will dog men's steps, and slay
explanation_en: However great be the enmity men have incurred they may still live The enmity of sin will incessantly pursue and kill
explanation_ta: எவ்வளவு கொடிய பகை உடையவரும் தப்பி வாழ முடியும், ஆனால் தீயவை செய்தால் வரும் தீவினையாகிய பகை நீங்காமல் பின் சென்று வருத்தும்.

translation:
Man's shadow dogs his steps where'er he wends; Destruction thus on sinful deeds attends

Meaning: Destruction will dwell at the heels of those who commit evil even as their shadow that leaves them not
pope_couplet: Man's shadow dogs his steps where'er he wends; Destruction thus on sinful deeds attends
explanation_en: Destruction will dwell at the heels of those who commit evil even as their shadow that leaves them not
explanation_ta: தீய செயல்களைச் செய்தவர் கேட்டை அடைதல், ஒருவனுடைய நிழல் அவனை விடாமல் வந்து அடியில் தங்கியிருத்தலைப் போன்றது.

translation:
Beware, if to thyself thyself is dear, Lest thou to aught that ranks as ill draw near

Meaning: If a man love himself, let him not commit any sin however small
pope_couplet: Beware, if to thyself thyself is dear, Lest thou to aught that ranks as ill draw near
explanation_en: If a man love himself, let him not commit any sin however small
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன்னைத் தான் விரும்பி வாழ்பவனாயின், தீய செயலாகிய பகுதியை எவ்வளவு சிறியதாயினும் பொருந்தாமல் நீங்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
The man, to devious way of sin that never turned aside, From ruin rests secure, whatever ills betide

Meaning: Know ye that he is freed from destruction who commits no evil, going to neither side of the right path
pope_couplet: The man, to devious way of sin that never turned aside, From ruin rests secure, whatever ills betide
explanation_en: Know ye that he is freed from destruction who commits no evil, going to neither side of the right path
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தவறான நெறியில் சென்று தீயசெயல் செய்யாதிருப்பானானால் அவன் கேடு இல்லாதவன் என்று அறியலாம்.

translation:
Duty demands no recompense; to clouds of heaven, By men on earth, what answering gift is given

Meaning: Benevolence seeks not a return. What does the world give back to the clouds ?
pope_couplet: Duty demands no recompense; to clouds of heaven, By men on earth, what answering gift is given
explanation_en: Benevolence seeks not a return. What does the world give back to the clouds ?
explanation_ta: இந்த உலகத்தார் மழைக்கு என்ன கைமாறு செய்கின்றனர்;, மழை போன்றவர் செய்யும் உதவிகளும் கைமாறு வேண்டாதவை.

translation:
The worthy say, when wealth rewards their toil-spent hours, For uses of beneficence alone 'tis ours

Meaning: All the wealth acquired with perseverance by the worthy is for the exercise of benevolence
pope_couplet: The worthy say, when wealth rewards their toil-spent hours, For uses of beneficence alone 'tis ours
explanation_en: All the wealth acquired with perseverance by the worthy is for the exercise of benevolence
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவாளன் தன்னால் இயன்ற முயற்சி செய்து சேர்த்த பொருள் எல்லாம் தக்கவர்க்கு உதவி செய்வதற்கே ஆகும்.

translation:
To 'due beneficence' no equal good we know, Amid the happy gods, or in this world below

Meaning: It is difficult to obtain another good equal to benevolence either in this world or in that of the gods
pope_couplet: To 'due beneficence' no equal good we know, Amid the happy gods, or in this world below
explanation_en: It is difficult to obtain another good equal to benevolence either in this world or in that of the gods
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு உதவி செய்து வாழும் ஒப்புரவைப் போல நல்லனவாகிய வேறு அறப்பகுதிகளைத் தேவருலகத்திலும் இவ்வுலகத்திலும் பெறுதல் இயலாது.

translation:
Who knows what's human life's befitting grace, He lives; the rest 'mongst dead men have their place

Meaning: He truly lives who knows (and discharges) the proper duties (of benevolence) He who knows them not will be reckoned among the dead
pope_couplet: Who knows what's human life's befitting grace, He lives; the rest 'mongst dead men have their place
explanation_en: He truly lives who knows (and discharges) the proper duties (of benevolence) He who knows them not will be reckoned among the dead
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவை அறிந்து போற்றிப் பிறர்க்கு உதவியாக வாழ்கின்றவன் உயிர்வாழ்கின்றவன் ஆவான், மற்றவன் செத்தவருள் சேர்த்துக் கருதப்படுவான்.

translation:
The wealth of men who love the 'fitting way,' the truly wise, Is as when water fills the lake that village needs supplies

Meaning: The wealth of that man of eminent knowledge who desires to exercise the benevolence approved of by the world, is like the full waters of a city-tank
pope_couplet: The wealth of men who love the 'fitting way,' the truly wise, Is as when water fills the lake that village needs supplies
explanation_en: The wealth of that man of eminent knowledge who desires to exercise the benevolence approved of by the world, is like the full waters of a city-tank
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவினால் உலகம் வாழுமாறு விரும்பும் பேரறிவாளியின் செல்வம், ஊரார் நீருண்ணும் குளம் நீரால் நிறைந்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
A tree that fruits in th' hamlet's central mart, Is wealth that falls to men of liberal heart

Meaning: The wealth of a man (possessed of the virtue) of benevolence is like the ripening of a fruitful tree in the midst of a town
pope_couplet: A tree that fruits in th' hamlet's central mart, Is wealth that falls to men of liberal heart
explanation_en: The wealth of a man (possessed of the virtue) of benevolence is like the ripening of a fruitful tree in the midst of a town
explanation_ta: ஒப்புராவாகிய நற்பண்பு உடையவனிடம் செல்வம் சேர்ந்தால் அஃது ஊரின் நடுவே உள்ள பயன் மிகுந்த மரம் பழங்கள் பழுத்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Unfailing tree that healing balm distils from every part, Is ample wealth that falls to him of large and noble heart

Meaning: If wealth be in the possession of a man who has the great excellence (of benevolence), it is like a tree which as a medicine is an infallible cure for disease
pope_couplet: Unfailing tree that healing balm distils from every part, Is ample wealth that falls to him of large and noble heart
explanation_en: If wealth be in the possession of a man who has the great excellence (of benevolence), it is like a tree which as a medicine is an infallible cure for disease
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவாகிய பெருந்தகைமை உடையவனிடத்து செல்வம் சேர்ந்தால் அஃது எல்லா உறுப்புகளுக்கும் மருந்தாகிப் பயன்படத் தவறாத மரம் போன்றது.

translation:
E'en when resources fall, they weary not of 'kindness due,'-They to whom Duty's self appears in vision true

Meaning: The wise who know what is duty will not scant their benevolence even when they are without wealth
pope_couplet: E'en when resources fall, they weary not of 'kindness due,'-They to whom Duty's self appears in vision true
explanation_en: The wise who know what is duty will not scant their benevolence even when they are without wealth
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவு அறிந்து ஒழுதலாகியத் தன் கடமை அறிந்த அறிவை உடையவர், செல்வ வளம் இல்லாத காலத்திலும் ஒப்புரவுக்குத் தளர மாட்டார்.

translation:
The kindly-hearted man is poor in this alone, When power of doing deeds of goodness he finds none

Meaning: The poverty of a benevolent man, is nothing but his inability to exercise the same
pope_couplet: The kindly-hearted man is poor in this alone, When power of doing deeds of goodness he finds none
explanation_en: The poverty of a benevolent man, is nothing but his inability to exercise the same
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவாகிய நற்பண்பு உடையவன் வறுமை உடையவனாதல், செய்யத்தக்க உதவிகளைச் செய்யாமல் வருந்துகின்ற தன்மையாகும்.

translation:
Though by 'beneficence,' the loss of all should come,'Twere meet man sold himself, and bought it with the sum

Meaning: If it be said that loss will result from benevolence, such loss is worth being procured even by the sale of one's self
pope_couplet: Though by 'beneficence,' the loss of all should come,'Twere meet man sold himself, and bought it with the sum
explanation_en: If it be said that loss will result from benevolence, such loss is worth being procured even by the sale of one's self
explanation_ta: ஒப்புரவால் கேடு வரும் என்றால் அக் கேடு ஒருவன் தன்னை விற்றாவது வாங்கிக்கொள்ளும் தகுதி உடையதாகும்.

translation:
Call that a gift to needy men thou dost dispense, All else is void of good, seeking for recompense

Meaning: To give to the destitute is true charity All other gifts have the nature of (what is done for) a measured return
pope_couplet: Call that a gift to needy men thou dost dispense, All else is void of good, seeking for recompense
explanation_en: To give to the destitute is true charity All other gifts have the nature of (what is done for) a measured return
explanation_ta: வறியவர்க்கு ஒரு பொருளைக் கொடுப்பதே ஈகை எனப்படுவது, மற்றவர்க்குக் கொடுப்பதெல்லாம் பயன் எதிர்பார்த்து கொடுக்கும் தன்மை உடையது.

translation:
Though men declare it heavenward path, yet to receive is ill; Though upper heaven were not, to give is virtue still

Meaning: To beg is evil, even though it were said that it is a good path (to heaven) To give is good, even though it were said that those who do so cannot obtain heaven
pope_couplet: Though men declare it heavenward path, yet to receive is ill; Though upper heaven were not, to give is virtue still
explanation_en: To beg is evil, even though it were said that it is a good path (to heaven) To give is good, even though it were said that those who do so cannot obtain heaven
explanation_ta: பிறரிடம் பொருள் பெற்றுக் கொள்ளுதல் நல்ல நெறி என்றாலும் கொள்ளல் தீமையானது, மேலுலகம் இல்லை என்றாலும் பிறக்குக் கொடுப்பதே சிறந்தது.

translation:
'I've nought' is ne'er the high-born man's reply; He gives to those who raise themselves that cry

Meaning: (Even in a low state) not to adopt the mean expedient of saying "I have nothing," but to give, is the characteristic of the mad of noble birth
pope_couplet: 'I've nought' is ne'er the high-born man's reply; He gives to those who raise themselves that cry
explanation_en: (Even in a low state) not to adopt the mean expedient of saying "I have nothing," but to give, is the characteristic of the mad of noble birth
explanation_ta: யான் வறியவன் என்னும் துன்பச் சொல்லை ஒருவன் உரைப்பதற்கு முன் அவனுக்கு கொடுக்கும் தன்மை, நல்ல குடி பிறப்பு உடையவனிடம் உண்டு.

translation:
The suppliants' cry for aid yields scant delight, Until you see his face with grateful gladness bright

Meaning: To see men begging from us in disagreeable, until we see their pleasant countenance
pope_couplet: The suppliants' cry for aid yields scant delight, Until you see his face with grateful gladness bright
explanation_en: To see men begging from us in disagreeable, until we see their pleasant countenance
explanation_ta: பொருள் வேண்டும் என்ற இரந்தவரின் மகிழ்ந்த முகத்தைக் காணும் வரைக்கும் (இரத்தலைப் போலவே ) இரந்து கேட்கப்படுவதும் துன்பமானது.

translation:
'Mid devotees they're great who hunger's pangs sustain, Who hunger's pangs relieve a higher merit gain

Meaning: The power of those who perform penance is the power of enduring hunger It is inferior to the power of those who remove the hunger (of others)
pope_couplet: 'Mid devotees they're great who hunger's pangs sustain, Who hunger's pangs relieve a higher merit gain
explanation_en: The power of those who perform penance is the power of enduring hunger It is inferior to the power of those who remove the hunger (of others)
explanation_ta: தவ வலிமை உடையவரின் வலிமை பசியை பொறுத்துக் கொள்ளலாகும், அதுவும் அப் பசியை உணவு கொடுத்து மாற்றுகின்றவரின் ஆற்றலுக்குப் பிற்பட்டதாகும்.

translation:
Let man relieve the wasting hunger men endure; For treasure gained thus finds he treasure-house secure

Meaning: The removal of the killing hunger of the poor is the place for one to lay up his wealth
pope_couplet: Let man relieve the wasting hunger men endure; For treasure gained thus finds he treasure-house secure
explanation_en: The removal of the killing hunger of the poor is the place for one to lay up his wealth
explanation_ta: வறியவரின் கடும்பசியைத் தீர்க்க வேண்டும் அதுவே பொருள் பெற்ற ஒருவன் அப் பொருளைத் தனக்குப் பிற்காலத்தில் உதவுமாறு சேர்த்து வைக்கும் இடமாகும்.

translation:
Whose soul delights with hungry men to share his meal, The hand of hunger's sickness sore shall never feel

Meaning: The fiery disease of hunger shall never touch him who habitually distributes his food to others
pope_couplet: Whose soul delights with hungry men to share his meal, The hand of hunger's sickness sore shall never feel
explanation_en: The fiery disease of hunger shall never touch him who habitually distributes his food to others
explanation_ta: தான் பெற்ற உணவை பலரோடும் பகிர்ந்து உண்ணும் பழக்கம் உடையவனை பசி என்று கூறப்படும் தீயநோய் அணுகுதல் இல்லை.

translation:
Delight of glad'ning human hearts with gifts do they not know.Men of unpitying eye, who hoard their wealth and lose it so

Meaning: Do the hard-eyed who lay up and lose their possessions not know the happiness which springs from the pleasure of giving ?
pope_couplet: Delight of glad'ning human hearts with gifts do they not know.Men of unpitying eye, who hoard their wealth and lose it so
explanation_en: Do the hard-eyed who lay up and lose their possessions not know the happiness which springs from the pleasure of giving ?
explanation_ta: தாம் சேர்த்து வைத்துள்ள பொருளைப் பிறருக்குக் கொடுக்காமல் வைத்திருந்து பின் இழந்து விடும் வன் கண்மை உடையவர், பிறர்க்கு கொடுத்து மகிழும் மகிழ்ச்சியை அறியாரோ.

translation:
They keep their garners full, for self alone the board they spread;-'Tis greater pain, be sure, than begging daily bread

Meaning: Solitary and unshared eating for the sake of filling up one's own riches is certainly much more
pope_couplet: They keep their garners full, for self alone the board they spread;-'Tis greater pain, be sure, than begging daily bread
explanation_en: Solitary and unshared eating for the sake of filling up one's own riches is certainly much more
explanation_ta: பொருளின் குறைபாட்டை நிரப்புவதற்க்காக உள்ளதைப் பிறர்க்கு ஈயாமல் தாமே தமியராய் உண்பது வறுமையால் இறப்பதை விடத் துன்பமானது.

translation:
'Tis bitter pain to die, 'Tis worse to live.For him who nothing finds to give

Meaning: Nothing is more unpleasant than death: yet even that is pleasant where charity cannot be exercised
pope_couplet: 'Tis bitter pain to die, 'Tis worse to live.For him who nothing finds to give
explanation_en: Nothing is more unpleasant than death: yet even that is pleasant where charity cannot be exercised
explanation_ta: சாவதை விடத் துன்பமானது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை, ஆனால் வறியவர்க்கு ஒரு பொருள் கொடுக்க முடியாதநிலை வந்தபோது அச் சாதலும் இனியதே ஆகும்.

translation:
See that thy life the praise of generous gifts obtain; Save this for living man exists no real gain

Meaning: Give to the poor and live with praise There is no greater profit to man than that
pope_couplet: See that thy life the praise of generous gifts obtain; Save this for living man exists no real gain
explanation_en: Give to the poor and live with praise There is no greater profit to man than that
explanation_ta: வறியவர்க்கு ஈதல் வேண்டும் அதனால் புகழ் உண்டாக வாழ வேண்டும், அப் புகழ் அல்லாமல் உயிர்க்கு ஊதியமானது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
The speech of all that speak agrees to crownThe men that give to those that ask, with fair renown

Meaning: Whatsoever is spoken in the world will abide as praise upon that man who gives alms to the poor
pope_couplet: The speech of all that speak agrees to crownThe men that give to those that ask, with fair renown
explanation_en: Whatsoever is spoken in the world will abide as praise upon that man who gives alms to the poor
explanation_ta: புகழ்ந்து சொல்கின்றவர் சொல்பவை எல்லாம் வறுமையால் இரப்பவர்க்கு ஒரு பொருள் கொடுத்து உதவுகின்றவரின் மேல் நிற்கின்ற புகழேயாகும்.

translation:
Save praise alone that soars on high, Nought lives on earth that shall not die

Meaning: There is nothing that stands forth in the world imperishable, except fame, exalted in solitary greatness
pope_couplet: Save praise alone that soars on high, Nought lives on earth that shall not die
explanation_en: There is nothing that stands forth in the world imperishable, except fame, exalted in solitary greatness
explanation_ta: உயர்ந்த புகழ் அல்லாமல் உலகத்தில் ஒப்பற்ற ஒரு பொருளாக அழியாமல் நிலைநிற்க வல்லது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
If men do virtuous deeds by world-wide ample glory crowned, The heavens will cease to laud the sage for other gifts renowned

Meaning: If one has acquired extensive fame within the limits of this earth, the world of the Gods will no longer praise those sages who have attained that world
pope_couplet: If men do virtuous deeds by world-wide ample glory crowned, The heavens will cease to laud the sage for other gifts renowned
explanation_en: If one has acquired extensive fame within the limits of this earth, the world of the Gods will no longer praise those sages who have attained that world
explanation_ta: நிலவுலகின் எல்லையில் நெடுங்காலம் நிற்கவல்ல புகழைச் செய்தால், வானுலகம் (அவ்வாறு புகழ் செய்தாரைப் போற்றுமே அல்லாமல்) தேவரைப் போற்றாது..

translation:
Loss that is gain, and death of life's true bliss fulfilled, Are fruits which only wisdom rare can yield

Meaning: Prosperity to the body of fame, resulting in poverty to the body of flesh and the stability to the former arising from the death of the latter, are achievable only by the wise
pope_couplet: Loss that is gain, and death of life's true bliss fulfilled, Are fruits which only wisdom rare can yield
explanation_en: Prosperity to the body of fame, resulting in poverty to the body of flesh and the stability to the former arising from the death of the latter, are achievable only by the wise
explanation_ta: புகழுடம்பு மேம்படுதலாகும் வாழ்வில் கேடும், புகழ் நிலை நிற்பதாகும் சாவும் அறிவில் சிறந்தவர்க்கு அல்லாமல் மற்றவர்க்கு இல்லை.

translation:
If man you walk the stage, appear adorned with glory's grace; Save glorious you can shine, 'twere better hide your face

Meaning: If you are born (in this world), be born with qualities conductive to fame From those who are destitute of them it will be better not to be born
pope_couplet: If man you walk the stage, appear adorned with glory's grace; Save glorious you can shine, 'twere better hide your face
explanation_en: If you are born (in this world), be born with qualities conductive to fame From those who are destitute of them it will be better not to be born
explanation_ta: ஒரு துறையில் முற்பட்டுத் தோன்றுவதானால் புகழோடு தோன்ற வேண்டும், அத்தகைய சிறப்பு இல்லாதவர் அங்குத் தோன்றுவதைவிடத் தோன்றாமலிருப்பதே நல்லது.

translation:
If you your days will spend devoid of goodly fame, When men despise, why blame them? You've yourself to blame

Meaning: Why do those who cannot live with praise, grieve those who despise them, instead of grieving themselves for their own inability
pope_couplet: If you your days will spend devoid of goodly fame, When men despise, why blame them? You've yourself to blame
explanation_en: Why do those who cannot live with praise, grieve those who despise them, instead of grieving themselves for their own inability
explanation_ta: தமக்குப் புகழ் உண்டாகுமாறு வாழமுடியாதவர் தம்மைத் தாம் நொந்து கொள்ளாமல் தம்மை இகழ்கின்றவரை நொந்து கொள்ளக் காரணம் என்ன?

translation:
Fame is virtue's child, they say; if, then, You childless live, you live the scorn of men

Meaning: Not to beget fame will be esteemed a disgrace by the wise in this world
pope_couplet: Fame is virtue's child, they say; if, then, You childless live, you live the scorn of men
explanation_en: Not to beget fame will be esteemed a disgrace by the wise in this world
explanation_ta: தமக்குப் பின் எஞ்சி நிற்பதாகியப் புகழைப் பெறாவிட்டால் உலகத்தார் எல்லார்க்கும் அத்தகைய வாழ்க்கை பழி என்று சொல்லுவர்.

translation:
The blameless fruits of fields' increase will dwindle down, If earth the burthen bear of men without renown

Meaning: The ground which supports a body without fame will diminish in its rich produce
pope_couplet: The blameless fruits of fields' increase will dwindle down, If earth the burthen bear of men without renown
explanation_en: The ground which supports a body without fame will diminish in its rich produce
explanation_ta: புகழ் பெறாமல் வாழ்வைக் கழித்தவருடைய உடம்பைச் சுமந்த நிலம், வசையற்ற வளமான பயனாகிய விளைவு இல்லாமல் குன்றிவிடும்.

translation:
Who live without reproach, them living men we deem; Who live without renown, live not, though living men they seem

Meaning: Those live who live without disgrace Those who live without fame live not
pope_couplet: Who live without reproach, them living men we deem; Who live without renown, live not, though living men they seem
explanation_en: Those live who live without disgrace Those who live without fame live not
explanation_ta: தாம் வாழும் வாழ்க்கையில் பழி உண்டாகாமல் வாழ்கின்றவரே உயிர் வாழ்கின்றவர், புகழ் உண்டாகாமல் வாழ்கின்றவரே உயிர் வாழாதவர்.

translation:
Wealth 'mid wealth is wealth 'kindliness'; Wealth of goods the vilest too possess

Meaning: The wealth of kindness is wealth of wealth, in as much as the wealth of property is possessed by the basest of men
pope_couplet: Wealth 'mid wealth is wealth 'kindliness'; Wealth of goods the vilest too possess
explanation_en: The wealth of kindness is wealth of wealth, in as much as the wealth of property is possessed by the basest of men
explanation_ta: பொருள்களாகிய செல்வங்கள் இழிந்தவரிடத்திலும் உள்ளன; (உயர்ந்தவரிடத்தில் மட்டுமே உள்ள) அருளாகிய செல்வமே செல்வங்களில் சிறந்த செல்வமாகும்.

translation:
The law of 'grace' fulfil, by methods good due trial made, Though many systems you explore, this is your only aid

Meaning: (Stand) in the good path, consider, and be kind. Even considering according to the conflicting tenets of the different sects, kindness will be your best aid, (in the acquisition of heavenly bliss.)
pope_couplet: The law of 'grace' fulfil, by methods good due trial made, Though many systems you explore, this is your only aid
explanation_en: (Stand) in the good path, consider, and be kind. Even considering according to the conflicting tenets of the different sects, kindness will be your best aid, (in the acquisition of heavenly bliss.)
explanation_ta: நல்ல வழியால் ஆராய்ந்து அருளுடையவர்களாக விளங்க வேண்டும்; பலவழிகளால் ஆராய்ந்து கண்டாலும் அருளே வாழ்க்கைக்குத் துணையாக இருக்கும்.

translation:
They in whose breast a 'gracious kindliness' resides, See not the gruesome world, where darkness drear abides

Meaning: They will never enter the world of darkness and wretchedness whose minds are the abode of kindness
pope_couplet: They in whose breast a 'gracious kindliness' resides, See not the gruesome world, where darkness drear abides
explanation_en: They will never enter the world of darkness and wretchedness whose minds are the abode of kindness
explanation_ta: அறியாமையாகிய இருள் பொருந்திய துன்ப உலகில் இருந்து வாழும் வாழ்க்கை, அருள் பொருந்திய நெஞ்சம் உடையவர்களுக்கு இல்லை.

translation:
Who for undying souls of men provides with gracious zeal, In his own soul the dreaded guilt of sin shall never feel

Meaning: (The wise) say that the evils, which his soul would dread, will never come upon the man who exercises kindness and protects the life (of other creatures)
pope_couplet: Who for undying souls of men provides with gracious zeal, In his own soul the dreaded guilt of sin shall never feel
explanation_en: (The wise) say that the evils, which his soul would dread, will never come upon the man who exercises kindness and protects the life (of other creatures)
explanation_ta: தன் உயிரின் பொருட்டு அஞ்சி வாழ்கின்ற தீவினை, உலகில் நிலைபெற்றுள்ள மற்ற உயிர்களைப் போற்றி அருளுடையவனாக இருப்பவனுக்கு இல்லை.

translation:
The teeming earth's vast realm, round which the wild winds blow, Is witness, men of 'grace' no woeful want shall know

Meaning: This great rich earth over which the wind blows, is a witness that sorrow never comes upon the kindhearted
pope_couplet: The teeming earth's vast realm, round which the wild winds blow, Is witness, men of 'grace' no woeful want shall know
explanation_en: This great rich earth over which the wind blows, is a witness that sorrow never comes upon the kindhearted
explanation_ta: அருளுடையவராக வாழ்கின்றவர்களுக்குத் துன்பம் இல்லை, காற்று இயங்குகின்ற வளம் பெரிய உலகத்தில் வாழ்வோரே இதற்குச் சான்று ஆவர்.

translation:
Gain of true wealth oblivious they eschew, Who 'grace' forsake, and graceless actions do

Meaning: (The wise) say that those who neglect kindness and practise cruelties, neglected virtue (in their former birth), and forgot (the sorrows which they must suffer.)
pope_couplet: Gain of true wealth oblivious they eschew, Who 'grace' forsake, and graceless actions do
explanation_en: (The wise) say that those who neglect kindness and practise cruelties, neglected virtue (in their former birth), and forgot (the sorrows which they must suffer.)
explanation_ta: அருள் இல்லாதவராய் அறமல்லாதவைகளைச் செய்து நடப்பவர்களை, உறுதிப்பொருளாகிய அறத்திலிருந்து நீங்கித் தம் வாழ்க்கையின் குறிக்கோளை மறந்தவர் என்பார்.

translation:
As to impoverished men this present world is not; The 'graceless' in you world have neither part nor lot

Meaning: As this world is not for those who are without wealth, so that world is not for those who are without kindness
pope_couplet: As to impoverished men this present world is not; The 'graceless' in you world have neither part nor lot
explanation_en: As this world is not for those who are without wealth, so that world is not for those who are without kindness
explanation_ta: பொருள் இல்லாதவர்க்கு இவ்வுலகத்து வாழ்க்கை இல்லாதவாறு போல உயிர்களிடத்தில் அருள் இல்லாதவர்க்கு அவ்வுலகத்து வாழ்க்கை இல்லையாம்.

translation:
Who lose the flower of wealth, when seasons change, again may bloom; Who lose 'benevolence', lose all; nothing can change their doom

Meaning: Those who are without wealth may, at some future time, become prosperous; those who are destitute of kindness are utterly destitute; for them there is no change
pope_couplet: Who lose the flower of wealth, when seasons change, again may bloom; Who lose 'benevolence', lose all; nothing can change their doom
explanation_en: Those who are without wealth may, at some future time, become prosperous; those who are destitute of kindness are utterly destitute; for them there is no change
explanation_ta: பொருள் இல்லாதவர் ஒரு காலத்தில் வளம் பெற்று விளங்குவர், அருள் இல்லாதவர் வாழ்க்கையின் பயம் அற்றவரே அவர் ஒரு காலத்திலும் சிறந்து விளங்குதல் இல்லை.

translation:
When souls unwise true wisdom's mystic vision see, The 'graceless' man may work true works of charity

Meaning: If you consider, the virtue of him who is without kindness is like the perception of the true being by him who is without wisdom
pope_couplet: When souls unwise true wisdom's mystic vision see, The 'graceless' man may work true works of charity
explanation_en: If you consider, the virtue of him who is without kindness is like the perception of the true being by him who is without wisdom
explanation_ta: அருள் மேற்கொள்ளாதவன் செய்கின்ற அறச்செயலை ஆராய்ந்தால், அஃது அறிவு தெளியாதவன் ஒரு நூலின் உண்மைப் பொருளைக் கண்டாற் போன்றது.

translation:
When weaker men you front with threat'ning brow, Think how you felt in presence of some stronger foe

Meaning: When a man is about to rush upon those who are weaker than himself, let him remember how he has stood (trembling) before those who are stronger than himself
pope_couplet: When weaker men you front with threat'ning brow, Think how you felt in presence of some stronger foe
explanation_en: When a man is about to rush upon those who are weaker than himself, let him remember how he has stood (trembling) before those who are stronger than himself
explanation_ta: (அருள் இல்லாதவன் ) தன்னை விட மெலிந்தவர் மேல் துன்புறுத்த செல்லும் போது, தன்னை விட வலியவரின் முன் தான் அஞ்சி நிற்கும் நிலைமையை நினைக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
How can the wont of 'kindly grace' to him be known, Who other creatures' flesh consumes to feed his own

Meaning: How can he be possessed of kindness, who to increase his own flesh, eats the flesh of other creatures
pope_couplet: How can the wont of 'kindly grace' to him be known, Who other creatures' flesh consumes to feed his own
explanation_en: How can he be possessed of kindness, who to increase his own flesh, eats the flesh of other creatures
explanation_ta: தன் உடம்பைப் பெருக்கச் செய்வதற்காகத் தான் மற்றோர் உயிரின் உடம்பைத் தின்கின்றவன் எவ்வாறு அருளுடையவனாக இருக்க முடியும்.

translation:
No use of wealth have they who guard not their estate; No use of grace have they with flesh who hunger sate

Meaning: As those possess no property who do not take care of it, so those possess no kindness who feed on flesh
pope_couplet: No use of wealth have they who guard not their estate; No use of grace have they with flesh who hunger sate
explanation_en: As those possess no property who do not take care of it, so those possess no kindness who feed on flesh
explanation_ta: பொருளுடையவராக இருக்கும் சிறப்பு அப்பொருளை வைத்துக் காப்பாற்றாதவர்க்கு இல்லை, அருளுடையவராக இருக்கும் சிறப்பு புலால் தின்பவர்க்கு இல்லை.

translation:
Like heart of them that murderous weapons bear, his mind, Who eats of savoury meat, no joy in good can find

Meaning: Like the (murderous) mind of him who carries a weapon (in his hand), the mind of him who feasts with pleasure on the body of another (creature), has no regard for goodness
pope_couplet: Like heart of them that murderous weapons bear, his mind, Who eats of savoury meat, no joy in good can find
explanation_en: Like the (murderous) mind of him who carries a weapon (in his hand), the mind of him who feasts with pleasure on the body of another (creature), has no regard for goodness
explanation_ta: ஓர் உயிரின் உடம்பைச் சுவையாக உண்டவரின் மனம் கொலைக்கருவியைக் கையில் கொண்டவரின் நெஞ்சம் போல் நன்மையாகி அருளைப் போற்றாது.

translation:
'What's grace, or lack of grace'? 'To kill' is this, that 'not to kill'; To eat dead flesh can never worthy end fulfil

Meaning: If it be asked what is kindness and what its opposite, the answer would be preservation and destruction of life; and therefore it is not right to feed on the flesh (obtained by taking away life)
pope_couplet: 'What's grace, or lack of grace'? 'To kill' is this, that 'not to kill'; To eat dead flesh can never worthy end fulfil
explanation_en: If it be asked what is kindness and what its opposite, the answer would be preservation and destruction of life; and therefore it is not right to feed on the flesh (obtained by taking away life)
explanation_ta: அருள் எது என்றால் ஓர் உயிரையும் கொல்லாமலிருத்தல் அருளல்லாது எது என்றால் உயிர்களைக்கொள்ளுதல் அதன் உடம்பைத் தின்னுதல் அறம் அல்லாதது.

translation:
If flesh you eat not, life's abodes unharmed remain; Who eats, hell swallows him, and renders not again

Meaning: Not to eat flesh contributes to the continuance of life; therefore if a man eat flesh, hell will not open its mouth (to let him escape out, after he has once fallen in)
pope_couplet: If flesh you eat not, life's abodes unharmed remain; Who eats, hell swallows him, and renders not again
explanation_en: Not to eat flesh contributes to the continuance of life; therefore if a man eat flesh, hell will not open its mouth (to let him escape out, after he has once fallen in)
explanation_ta: உயிர்கள் உடம்பு பெற்று வாழும் நிலைமை, ஊன் உண்ணாதிருத்தலை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டது ஊன் உண்டால் நரகம் அவனை வெளிவிடாது.

translation:
'We eat the slain,' you say, by us no living creatures die; Who'd kill and sell, I pray, if none came there the flesh to buy

Meaning: If the world does not destroy life for the purpose of eating, then no one would sell flesh for the sake of money
pope_couplet: 'We eat the slain,' you say, by us no living creatures die; Who'd kill and sell, I pray, if none came there the flesh to buy
