explanation_en: If the world does not destroy life for the purpose of eating, then no one would sell flesh for the sake of money
explanation_ta: புலால் தின்னும் பொருட்டு உலகத்தார் உயிர்களைக் கொல்லா திருப்பாரானால், விலையின் பொருட்டு ஊன் விற்பவர் இல்லாமல் போவார்.

translation:
With other beings' ulcerous wounds their hunger they appease; If this they felt, desire to eat must surely cease

Meaning: If men should come to know that flesh is nothing but the unclean ulcer of a body, let them abstain from eating it
pope_couplet: With other beings' ulcerous wounds their hunger they appease; If this they felt, desire to eat must surely cease
explanation_en: If men should come to know that flesh is nothing but the unclean ulcer of a body, let them abstain from eating it
explanation_ta: புலால் உண்ணாமலிருக்க வேண்டும், ஆராய்ந்து அறிவாரைப் பெற்றால், அப் புலால் வேறோர் உயிரின் புண் என்பதை உணரலாம்.

translation:
Whose souls the vision pure and passionless perceive, Eat not the bodies men of life bereave

Meaning: The wise, who have freed themselves from mental delusion, will not eat the flesh which has been severed from an animal
pope_couplet: Whose souls the vision pure and passionless perceive, Eat not the bodies men of life bereave
explanation_en: The wise, who have freed themselves from mental delusion, will not eat the flesh which has been severed from an animal
explanation_ta: குற்றத்திலிருந்து நீங்கிய அறிவை உடையவர், ஒர் உயிரினிடத்திலிருந்து பிரிந்து வந்த ஊனை உண்ணமாட்டார்.

translation:
Than thousand rich oblations, with libations rare, Better the flesh of slaughtered beings not to share

Meaning: Not to kill and eat (the flesh of) an animal, is better than the pouring forth of ghee etc, in a thousand sacrifices
pope_couplet: Than thousand rich oblations, with libations rare, Better the flesh of slaughtered beings not to share
explanation_en: Not to kill and eat (the flesh of) an animal, is better than the pouring forth of ghee etc, in a thousand sacrifices
explanation_ta: நெய் முதலியப் பொருள்களைத் தீயில் சொரிந்து ஆயிரம் வேள்விகள் செய்தலை விட ஒன்றன் உயிரைக்கொன்று உடம்பைத் தின்னாதிருத்தல் நல்லது.

translation:
Who slays nought,- flesh rejects- his feet beforeAll living things with clasped hands adore

Meaning: All creatures will join their hands together, and worship him who has never taken away life, nor eaten flesh
pope_couplet: Who slays nought,- flesh rejects- his feet beforeAll living things with clasped hands adore
explanation_en: All creatures will join their hands together, and worship him who has never taken away life, nor eaten flesh
explanation_ta: ஓருயிரையும் கொல்லாமல் புலால் உண்ணாமல் வாழ்கின்றவனை உலகத்தில் உள்ள எல்லா உயிர்களும் கைகூப்பி வணங்கும்.

translation:
To bear due penitential pains, while no offenceHe causes others, is the type of 'penitence'

Meaning: The nature of religious discipline consists, in the endurance (by the ascetic) of the sufferings which it brings on himself, and in abstaining from giving pain to others
pope_couplet: To bear due penitential pains, while no offenceHe causes others, is the type of 'penitence'
explanation_en: The nature of religious discipline consists, in the endurance (by the ascetic) of the sufferings which it brings on himself, and in abstaining from giving pain to others
explanation_ta: தனக்கு உற்ற துன்பத்தை பொறுத்தலும் மற்ற உயிர்க்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாதிருத்தலும் ஆகிய அவ்வளவே தவத்திற்கு வடிவமாகும்

translation:
To 'penitents' sincere avails their 'penitence'; Where that is not, 'tis but a vain pretence

Meaning: Austerities can only be borne, and their benefits enjoyed, by those who have practised them (in a former birth); it will be useless for those who have not done so, to attempt to practise them (now)
pope_couplet: To 'penitents' sincere avails their 'penitence'; Where that is not, 'tis but a vain pretence
explanation_en: Austerities can only be borne, and their benefits enjoyed, by those who have practised them (in a former birth); it will be useless for those who have not done so, to attempt to practise them (now)
explanation_ta: தவக்கோலமும் தவஒழுக்கமும் உடையவர்க்கே பொருந்துவதாகும்; அக் கோலத்தை தவஒழுக்கம் இல்லாதவர் மேற்கொள்வது வீண்முயற்சியாகும்.

translation:
Have other men forgotten 'penitence' who striveTo earn for penitents the things by which they live

Meaning: It is to provide food etc, for the ascetics who have abandoned (the desire of earthly possessions) that other persons have forgotten (to practise) austerity ?
pope_couplet: Have other men forgotten 'penitence' who striveTo earn for penitents the things by which they live
explanation_en: It is to provide food etc, for the ascetics who have abandoned (the desire of earthly possessions) that other persons have forgotten (to practise) austerity ?
explanation_ta: துறந்தவர்க்கு உணவு முதலியனக் கொடுத்து உதவவேண்டும் என விரும்பி மற்றவர்கள் (இல்லறத்தினர்) தவம் செய்தலை மறந்தார்களோ

translation:
Destruction to his foes, to friends increase of joyThe 'penitent' can cause, if this his thoughts employ

Meaning: If (the ascetic) desire the destruction of his enemies, or the aggrandizement of his friends, it will be effected by (the power of) his austerities
pope_couplet: Destruction to his foes, to friends increase of joyThe 'penitent' can cause, if this his thoughts employ
explanation_en: If (the ascetic) desire the destruction of his enemies, or the aggrandizement of his friends, it will be effected by (the power of) his austerities
explanation_ta: தீமை செய்யும் பகைவரை அடக்குதலும் நன்மை செய்யும் நண்பரை உயர்த்துதலும் நினைத்த அளவில் தவத்தின் வலிமையால் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
That what they wish may, as they wish, be won, By men on earth are works of painful 'penance' done

Meaning: Religious dislipline is practised in this world, because it secures the attainment of whatever one may wish to enjoy (in the world to come)
pope_couplet: That what they wish may, as they wish, be won, By men on earth are works of painful 'penance' done
explanation_en: Religious dislipline is practised in this world, because it secures the attainment of whatever one may wish to enjoy (in the world to come)
explanation_ta: விரும்பிய பயன்களை விரும்பியவாறே அடைய முடியுமாகையால் செய்யத்தக்க தவம் இந்நிலையிலும் (இல்லற வாழ்க்கையிலும்) முயன்று செய்யப்படும்.

translation:
Who works of 'penance' do, their end attain, Others in passion's net enshared, toil but in vain

Meaning: Those discharge their duty who perform austerities; all others accomplish their own destruction, through the entanglement of the desire (of riches and sensual pleasure)
pope_couplet: Who works of 'penance' do, their end attain, Others in passion's net enshared, toil but in vain
explanation_en: Those discharge their duty who perform austerities; all others accomplish their own destruction, through the entanglement of the desire (of riches and sensual pleasure)
explanation_ta: தவம் செய்கின்றவரே தமக்குரிய கடமையைச் செய்கின்றவர் ஆவர், அவர் அல்லாத மற்றவர் ஆசை வலையில் அகப்பட்டு வீண் முயற்சி செய்கின்றவரே.

translation:
The hotter glows the fining fire, the gold the brighter shines; The pain of penitence, like fire, the soul of man refines

Meaning: Just as gold is purified as heated in the fire, will those shine, who have endured the burning of pain (in frequent austerities)
pope_couplet: The hotter glows the fining fire, the gold the brighter shines; The pain of penitence, like fire, the soul of man refines
explanation_en: Just as gold is purified as heated in the fire, will those shine, who have endured the burning of pain (in frequent austerities)
explanation_ta: புடமிட்டு சுடச்சுட ஒளிவிடுகின்ற பொன்னைப் போல் தவம் செய்கின்றவரை துன்பம் வருத்த வருத்த மெய்யுணர்வு மிகும்

translation:
Who gains himself in utter self-control, Him worships every other living soul

Meaning: All other creatures will worship him who has attained the control of his own soul
pope_couplet: Who gains himself in utter self-control, Him worships every other living soul
explanation_en: All other creatures will worship him who has attained the control of his own soul
explanation_ta: தவ வலிமையால் தன்னுடைய உயிர், தான் என்னும் பற்று நீங்கப் பெற்றவனை மற்ற உயிர்கள் எல்லாம் (அவனுடைய பெருமையை உணர்ந்து) தொழும்.

translation:
E'en over death the victory he may gain, If power by penance won his soul obtain

Meaning: Those who have attained the power which religious discipline confers, will be able also to pass the limit of Yama, (the God of death)
pope_couplet: E'en over death the victory he may gain, If power by penance won his soul obtain
explanation_en: Those who have attained the power which religious discipline confers, will be able also to pass the limit of Yama, (the God of death)
explanation_ta: தவம் செய்வதால் பெறத்தக்க ஆற்றலைப் பெற்றவர்க்கு (ஓர் இடையூறும் இல்லையாகையால் ) எமனை வெல்லுதலும் கைகூடும்

translation:
The many all things lack! The cause is plain, The 'penitents' are few The many shun such pain

Meaning: Because there are few who practise austerity and many who do not, there are many destitute and few rich in this world
pope_couplet: The many all things lack! The cause is plain, The 'penitents' are few The many shun such pain
explanation_en: Because there are few who practise austerity and many who do not, there are many destitute and few rich in this world
explanation_ta: ஆற்றல் இல்லாதவர் பலராக உலகில் இருப்பதற்குக் காரணம் தவம் செய்கின்றவர் சிலராகவும், செய்யாதவர் பலராகவும் இருப்பதே ஆகும்.

translation:
Who with deceitful mind in false way walks of covert sin, The five-fold elements his frame compose, decide within

Meaning: The five elements (of his body) will laugh within him at the feigned conduct of the deceitful minded man
pope_couplet: Who with deceitful mind in false way walks of covert sin, The five-fold elements his frame compose, decide within
explanation_en: The five elements (of his body) will laugh within him at the feigned conduct of the deceitful minded man
explanation_ta: வஞ்சமனம் உடையவனது பொய்யொழுக்கத்தை அவனுடைய உடம்பில் கலந்து நிற்க்கும் ஐந்து பூதங்களும் கண்டு தம்முள் சிரிக்கும்.

translation:
What gain, though virtue's semblance high as heaven his fame exalt, If heart dies down through sense of self-detected fault

Meaning: What avails an appearance (of sanctity) high as heaven, if his mind suffers (the indulgence) of conscious sin
pope_couplet: What gain, though virtue's semblance high as heaven his fame exalt, If heart dies down through sense of self-detected fault
explanation_en: What avails an appearance (of sanctity) high as heaven, if his mind suffers (the indulgence) of conscious sin
explanation_ta: தன் மனம் தான் அறிந்த குற்றத்தில் தங்குமானால் வானத்தைப் போல் உயர்ந்துள்ள தவக்கோலம் ஒருவனுக்கு என்ன பயன் செய்யும்.

translation:
As if a steer should graze wrapped round with tiger's skin, Is show of virtuous might when weakness lurks within

Meaning: The assumed appearance of power, by a man who has no power (to restrain his senses and perform austerity), is like a cow feeding on grass covered with a tiger's skin
pope_couplet: As if a steer should graze wrapped round with tiger's skin, Is show of virtuous might when weakness lurks within
explanation_en: The assumed appearance of power, by a man who has no power (to restrain his senses and perform austerity), is like a cow feeding on grass covered with a tiger's skin
explanation_ta: மனத்தை அடக்கும் வல்லமை இல்லாதவன் மேற்கொண்ட வலிய தவக்கோலம், புலியின் தோலைப் போர்த்திக் கொண்டு பயிரை பசு மேய்ந்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
'Tis as a fowler, silly birds to snare, in thicket lurksWhen, clad in stern ascetic garb, one secret evil works

Meaning: He who hides himself under the mask of an ascetic and commits sins, like a sportsman who conceals himself in the thicket to catch birds
pope_couplet: 'Tis as a fowler, silly birds to snare, in thicket lurksWhen, clad in stern ascetic garb, one secret evil works
explanation_en: He who hides himself under the mask of an ascetic and commits sins, like a sportsman who conceals himself in the thicket to catch birds
explanation_ta: தவக்கோலத்தில் மறைந்து கொண்டு தவம் அல்லாத தீயச்செயல்களைச் செய்தல், புதரில் மறைந்து கொண்டு வேடன் பறவைகளை வலைவீசிப் பிடித்தலைப் போன்றது.

translation:
'Our souls are free,' who say, yet practise evil secretly,'What folly have we wrought!' by many shames o'er-whelmed, shall cry

Meaning: The false conduct of those who say they have renounced all desire will one day bring them sorrows that will make them cry out, "Oh! what have we done, what have we done."
pope_couplet: 'Our souls are free,' who say, yet practise evil secretly,'What folly have we wrought!' by many shames o'er-whelmed, shall cry
explanation_en: The false conduct of those who say they have renounced all desire will one day bring them sorrows that will make them cry out, "Oh! what have we done, what have we done."
explanation_ta: பற்றுக்களைத் துறந்தோம் என்று சொல்கின்றவரின் பொய்யொழுக்கம் என்ன செய்தோம் என்ன செய்தோம் என்று வருந்தும் படியான துன்பம் பலவும் தரும்.

translation:
In mind renouncing nought, in speech renouncing every tie, Who guileful live,- no men are found than these of 'harder eye'

Meaning: Amongst living men there are none so hard-hearted as those who without to saking (desire) in their heart, falsely take the appearance of those who have forsaken (it)
pope_couplet: In mind renouncing nought, in speech renouncing every tie, Who guileful live,- no men are found than these of 'harder eye'
explanation_en: Amongst living men there are none so hard-hearted as those who without to saking (desire) in their heart, falsely take the appearance of those who have forsaken (it)
explanation_ta: மனத்தில் பற்றுக்களைத் துறக்காமல் துறந்தவரைப் போல் வஞ்சனைச் செய்து வாழ்கின்றவரைப் போல் இரக்கமற்றவர் எவரும் இல்லை.

translation:
Outward, they shine as 'kunri' berry's scarlet bright; Inward, like tip of 'kunri' bead, as black as night

Meaning: (The world) contains persons whose outside appears (as fair) as the (red) berry of the Abrus, but whose inside is as black as the nose of that berry
pope_couplet: Outward, they shine as 'kunri' berry's scarlet bright; Inward, like tip of 'kunri' bead, as black as night
explanation_en: (The world) contains persons whose outside appears (as fair) as the (red) berry of the Abrus, but whose inside is as black as the nose of that berry
explanation_ta: புறத்தில் குன்றிமணிப்போல் செம்மையானவராய் காணப்பட்டாராயினும் அகத்தில் குன்றிமணியின் மூக்குப்போல் கருத்திருப்பவர் உலகில் உணடு.

translation:
Many wash in hollowed waters, living lives of hidden shame; Foul in heart, yet high upraised of men in virtuous fame

Meaning: There are many men of masked conduct, who perform their ablutions, and (make a show) of
pope_couplet: Many wash in hollowed waters, living lives of hidden shame; Foul in heart, yet high upraised of men in virtuous fame
explanation_en: There are many men of masked conduct, who perform their ablutions, and (make a show) of
explanation_ta: மனத்தில் மாசு இருக்க, தவத்தால் மாண்பு பெற்றவரைப்போல், நீரில் மறைந்து நடக்கும் வஞ்சனை உடைய மாந்தர் உலகில் பலர் உள்ளனர்.

translation:
Cruel is the arrow straight, the crooked lute is sweet, Judge by their deeds the many forms of men you meet

Meaning: As, in its use, the arrow is crooked, and the curved lute is straight, so by their deeds, (and not by their appearance) let (the uprightness or crookedness of) men be estimated
pope_couplet: Cruel is the arrow straight, the crooked lute is sweet, Judge by their deeds the many forms of men you meet
explanation_en: As, in its use, the arrow is crooked, and the curved lute is straight, so by their deeds, (and not by their appearance) let (the uprightness or crookedness of) men be estimated
explanation_ta: நேராகத் தோன்றினும் அம்பு கொடியது; வளைவுடன் தோன்றினாலும் யாழின் கொம்பு நன்மையானது. மக்களின் பண்புகளையும் செயல்வகையால் உணர்ந்துகொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
What's the worth of shaven head or tresses long, If you shun what all the world condemns as wrong

Meaning: There is no need of a shaven crown, nor of tangled hair, if a man abstain from those deeds which the wise have condemned
pope_couplet: What's the worth of shaven head or tresses long, If you shun what all the world condemns as wrong
explanation_en: There is no need of a shaven crown, nor of tangled hair, if a man abstain from those deeds which the wise have condemned
explanation_ta: உலகம் பழிக்கும் தீயொழுக்கத்தை விட்டு விட்டால் மொட்டை அடித்தலும் சடை வளர்த்தலுமாகிய புறக்கோலங்கள் வேண்டா.

translation:
Who seeks heaven's joys, from impious levity secure, Let him from every fraud preserve his spirit pure

Meaning: Let him, who desires not to be despised, keep his mind from (the desire of) defrauding another of the smallest thing
pope_couplet: Who seeks heaven's joys, from impious levity secure, Let him from every fraud preserve his spirit pure
explanation_en: Let him, who desires not to be despised, keep his mind from (the desire of) defrauding another of the smallest thing
explanation_ta: பிறரால் இகழப்படால் வாழ விரும்புகிறவன், எத்தன்மையானப் பொருளையும் பிறரிடமிருந்து வஞ்சித்துக்கொள்ள எண்ணாதபடி தன் நெஞ்சைக் காக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
'Tis sin if in the mind man but thought conceive;'By fraud I will my neighbour of his wealth bereave.'

Meaning: Even the thought (of sin) is sin; think not then of crafiily stealing the property of another
pope_couplet: 'Tis sin if in the mind man but thought conceive;'By fraud I will my neighbour of his wealth bereave.'
explanation_en: Even the thought (of sin) is sin; think not then of crafiily stealing the property of another
explanation_ta: குற்றமானதை உள்ளத்தால் எண்ணுவதும் குற்றமே, அதானால் பிறன் பொருளை அவன் அறியாதப் வகையால் வஞ்சித்துக்கொள்வோம் என்று எண்ணாதிருக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
The gain that comes by fraud, although it seems to growWith limitless increase, to ruin swift shall go

Meaning: The property, which is acquired by fraud, will entirely perish, even while it seems to increase
pope_couplet: The gain that comes by fraud, although it seems to growWith limitless increase, to ruin swift shall go
explanation_en: The property, which is acquired by fraud, will entirely perish, even while it seems to increase
explanation_ta: களவு செய்து பொருள் கொள்வதால் உண்டாகிய ஆக்கம் பெருகுவது போல் தோன்றி இயல்பாக இருக்க வேண்டிய அளவையும் கடந்து கெட்டு விடும்.

translation:
The lust inveterate of fraudful gain, Yields as its fruit undying pain

Meaning: The eager desire of defrauding others will, when it brings forth its fruit, produce undying sorrow
pope_couplet: The lust inveterate of fraudful gain, Yields as its fruit undying pain
explanation_en: The eager desire of defrauding others will, when it brings forth its fruit, produce undying sorrow
explanation_ta: களவு செய்து பிறர் பொருள் கொள்ளுதலில் ஒருவனுக்கு உள்ள மிகுந்த விருப்பம், பயன் விளையும் போது தொலையாதத் துன்பத்தைத் தரும்.

translation:
'Grace' is not in their thoughts, nor know they kind affection's power, Who neighbour's goods desire, and watch for his unguarded hour

Meaning: The study of kindness and the exercise of benevolence is not with those who watch for another's forgetfulness, though desire of his property
pope_couplet: 'Grace' is not in their thoughts, nor know they kind affection's power, Who neighbour's goods desire, and watch for his unguarded hour
explanation_en: The study of kindness and the exercise of benevolence is not with those who watch for another's forgetfulness, though desire of his property
explanation_ta: அருளைப் பெரிதாகக்கருதி அன்பு உடையவராய் நடத்தல், பிறருடைய பொருளைக்கவர எண்ணி அவர் சோர்ந்திருக்கும் நிலையைப் பார்ப்பவரிடத்தில் இல்லை.

translation:
They cannot walk restrained in wisdom's measured bound, In whom inveterate lust of fraudful gain is found

Meaning: They cannot walk steadfastly, according to rule, who eagerly desire to defraud others
pope_couplet: They cannot walk restrained in wisdom's measured bound, In whom inveterate lust of fraudful gain is found
explanation_en: They cannot walk steadfastly, according to rule, who eagerly desire to defraud others
explanation_ta: களவு செய்து பிறர் பொருள் கொள்ளுதலில் மிக்க விருப்பம் உடையவர், அளவு (சிக்கனம்) போற்றி வாழும் நெறியில் நின்று ஒழுக மாட்டார்.

translation:
Practice of fraud's dark cunning arts they shun, Who long for power by 'measured wisdom' won

Meaning: That black-knowledge which is called fraud, is not in those who desire that greatness which is called rectitude
pope_couplet: Practice of fraud's dark cunning arts they shun, Who long for power by 'measured wisdom' won
explanation_en: That black-knowledge which is called fraud, is not in those who desire that greatness which is called rectitude
explanation_ta: களவு என்பதற்கு காரணமான மயங்கிய அறிவு உடையவராயிருத்தல், அளவு அறிந்து வாழ்தலாகிய ஆற்றலை விரும்பினவரிடத்தில் இல்லை.

translation:
As virtue dwells in heart that 'measured wisdom' gains; Deceit in hearts of fraudful men established reigns

Meaning: Deceit dwells in the mind of those who are conversant with fraud, even as virtue in the minds of those who are conversant with rectitude
pope_couplet: As virtue dwells in heart that 'measured wisdom' gains; Deceit in hearts of fraudful men established reigns
explanation_en: Deceit dwells in the mind of those who are conversant with fraud, even as virtue in the minds of those who are conversant with rectitude
explanation_ta: அளவறிந்து வாழ்கின்றவரின் நெஞ்சில் நிற்கும் அறம் போல் களவு செய்து பழகி அறிந்தவரின் நெஞ்சில் வஞ்சம் நிற்கும்.

translation:
Who have no lore save that which fraudful arts supply, Acts of unmeasured vice committing straightway die

Meaning: Those, who are acquainted with nothing but fraud, will perish in the very commission of transgression
pope_couplet: Who have no lore save that which fraudful arts supply, Acts of unmeasured vice committing straightway die
explanation_en: Those, who are acquainted with nothing but fraud, will perish in the very commission of transgression
explanation_ta: களவு செய்தலைத் தவிர மற்ற நல்லவழிகளைத் நம்பித் தெளியாதவர் அளவு அல்லாத செயல்களைச் செய்து அப்போதே கெட்டழிவர்.

translation:
The fraudful forfeit life and being here below; Who fraud eschew the bliss of heavenly beings know

Meaning: Even their body will fail the fraudulent; but even the world of the gods will not fail those who are free from fraud
pope_couplet: The fraudful forfeit life and being here below; Who fraud eschew the bliss of heavenly beings know
explanation_en: Even their body will fail the fraudulent; but even the world of the gods will not fail those who are free from fraud
explanation_ta: களவு செய்வார்க்கு உடலில் உயிர் வாழும் வாழ்வும் தவறிப் போகும், களவு செய்யாமல் வாழ்வோர்க்கு தேவருலகும் வாய்க்கத் தவறாது.

translation:
You ask, in lips of men what 'truth' may be;'Tis speech from every taint of evil free

Meaning: Truth is the speaking of such words as are free from the least degree of evil (to others)
pope_couplet: You ask, in lips of men what 'truth' may be;'Tis speech from every taint of evil free
explanation_en: Truth is the speaking of such words as are free from the least degree of evil (to others)
explanation_ta: வாய்மை என்று கூறப்படுவது எது என்றால், அது மற்றவர்க்கு ஒரு சிறிதும் தீங்கு இல்லாத சொற்களைக் சொல்லுதல் ஆகும்.

translation:
Falsehood may take the place of truthful word, If blessing, free from fault, it can afford

Meaning: Even falsehood has the nature of truth, if it confer a benefit that is free from fault
pope_couplet: Falsehood may take the place of truthful word, If blessing, free from fault, it can afford
explanation_en: Even falsehood has the nature of truth, if it confer a benefit that is free from fault
explanation_ta: குற்றம் தீர்த்த நன்மையை விளைக்குமானால் பொய்யாச் சொற்களும் வாய்மை என்று கருதத் தக்க இடத்தைப் பெறும்.

translation:
Speak not a word which false thy own heart knowsSelf-kindled fire within the false one's spirit glows

Meaning: Let not a man knowingly tell a lie; for after he has told the lie, his mind will burn him (with the memory of his guilt)
pope_couplet: Speak not a word which false thy own heart knowsSelf-kindled fire within the false one's spirit glows
explanation_en: Let not a man knowingly tell a lie; for after he has told the lie, his mind will burn him (with the memory of his guilt)
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன் நெஞ்சம் அறிவதாகிய ஒன்றைக்குறித்துப் பொய்ச் சொல்லக்கூடாது, பொய் சொன்னால் அதைக்குறித்துத் தன் நெஞ்சமே தன்னை வருத்தும்.

translation:
True to his inmost soul who lives,- enshrinedHe lives in souls of all mankind

Meaning: He who, in his conduct, preserves a mind free from deceit, will dwell in the minds of all men
pope_couplet: True to his inmost soul who lives,- enshrinedHe lives in souls of all mankind
explanation_en: He who, in his conduct, preserves a mind free from deceit, will dwell in the minds of all men
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன் உள்ளம் அறியப் பொய் இல்லாமல் நடப்பானானால் அத்தகையவன் உலகத்தாரின் உள்ளங்களில் எல்லாம் இருப்பவனாவான்.

translation:
Greater is he who speaks the truth with full consenting mindThan men whose lives have penitence and charity combined

Meaning: He, who speaks truth with all his heart, is superior to those who make gifts and practise austerities
pope_couplet: Greater is he who speaks the truth with full consenting mindThan men whose lives have penitence and charity combined
explanation_en: He, who speaks truth with all his heart, is superior to those who make gifts and practise austerities
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன் மனதோடு பொருந்த உண்மை பேசுவானானால் அவன் தவத்தேடு தானமும் ஒருங்கே செய்வாரை விடச் சிறந்தவன்.

translation:
No praise like that of words from falsehood free; This every virtue yields spontaneously

Meaning: There is no praise like the praise of never uttering a falsehood: without causing any suffering, it will lead to every virtue
pope_couplet: No praise like that of words from falsehood free; This every virtue yields spontaneously
explanation_en: There is no praise like the praise of never uttering a falsehood: without causing any suffering, it will lead to every virtue
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு பொய் இல்லாமல் வாழ்தலை விடப் புகழ் நிலை வேறொன்றும் இல்லை, அஃது அவன் அறியாமலேயெ அவனுக்கு எல்லா அறமும் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
If all your life be utter truth, the truth alone,'Tis well, though other virtuous acts be left undone

Meaning: If a man has the power to abstain from falsehood, it will be well with him, even though he practise no other virtue
pope_couplet: If all your life be utter truth, the truth alone,'Tis well, though other virtuous acts be left undone
explanation_en: If a man has the power to abstain from falsehood, it will be well with him, even though he practise no other virtue
explanation_ta: பொய்யாமை ஆகிய அறத்தை உண்மையாகவே போற்றி வாழ முடிந்தால் மற்ற அறங்களைச் செய்தலும் நல்லது ஆகும்.

translation:
Outward purity the water will bestow; Inward purity from truth alone will flow

Meaning: Purity of body is produced by water and purity of mind by truthfulness
pope_couplet: Outward purity the water will bestow; Inward purity from truth alone will flow
explanation_en: Purity of body is produced by water and purity of mind by truthfulness
explanation_ta: புறத்தே தூய்மையாக விளங்குதல் நீரினால் ஏற்ப்படும், அதுபோல அகத்தே தூய்மையாக விளங்குதல் வாய்மையால் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
Every lamp is not a lamp in wise men's sight; That's the lamp with truth's pure radiance bright

Meaning: All lamps of nature are not lamps; the lamp of truth is the lamp of the wise
pope_couplet: Every lamp is not a lamp in wise men's sight; That's the lamp with truth's pure radiance bright
explanation_en: All lamps of nature are not lamps; the lamp of truth is the lamp of the wise
explanation_ta: (புறத்தில் உள்ள இருளை நீக்கும்) விளக்குகள் எல்லாம் விளக்குகள் அல்ல, சான்றோர்க்கு (அகத்து இருள் நீக்கும்) பொய்யாமையாகிய விளக்கே விளக்கு ஆகும்.

translation:
Of all good things we've scanned with studious care, There's nought that can with truthfulness compare

Meaning: Amidst all that we have seen (described) as real (excellence), there is nothing so good as truthfulness
pope_couplet: Of all good things we've scanned with studious care, There's nought that can with truthfulness compare
explanation_en: Amidst all that we have seen (described) as real (excellence), there is nothing so good as truthfulness
explanation_ta: யாம் உண்மையாக கண்ட பொருள்களுள் வாய்மைவிடத் எத்தன்மையாலும் சிறந்தவைகளாகச் சொல்லத்தக்கவை வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Where thou hast power thy angry will to work, thy wrath restrain; Where power is none, what matter if thou check or give it rein

Meaning: He restrains his anger who restrains it when it can injure; when it cannot injure, what does it matter whether he restrain it, or not ?
pope_couplet: Where thou hast power thy angry will to work, thy wrath restrain; Where power is none, what matter if thou check or give it rein
explanation_en: He restrains his anger who restrains it when it can injure; when it cannot injure, what does it matter whether he restrain it, or not ?
explanation_ta: பலிக்கும் இடத்தில் சினம் வராமல் காப்பவனே சினம் காப்பவன், பலிக்காத இடத்தில் காத்தால் என்ன, காக்கா விட்டால் என்ன?

translation:
Where power is none to wreak thy wrath, wrath importent is ill; Where thou hast power thy will to work, 'tis greater, evil still

Meaning: Anger is bad, even when it cannot injure; when it can injure; there is no greater evil
pope_couplet: Where power is none to wreak thy wrath, wrath importent is ill; Where thou hast power thy will to work, 'tis greater, evil still
explanation_en: Anger is bad, even when it cannot injure; when it can injure; there is no greater evil
explanation_ta: பலிக்காத இடத்தில் (தன்னை விட வலியவரிடத்தில்) சினம் கொள்வது தீங்கு. பலிக்கும் இடத்திலும் (மெலியவரித்திலும்) சினத்தைவிடத் தீயவை வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
If any rouse thy wrath, the trespass straight forget; For wrath an endless train of evils will beget

Meaning: Forget anger towards every one, as fountains of evil spring from it
pope_couplet: If any rouse thy wrath, the trespass straight forget; For wrath an endless train of evils will beget
explanation_en: Forget anger towards every one, as fountains of evil spring from it
explanation_ta: யாரிடத்திலும் சினம் கொள்ளாமல் அதை மறந்து விட வேண்டும், தீமையான விளைவுகள் அச் சினத்தாலேயே ஏற்படும்.

translation:
Wrath robs the face of smiles, the heart of joy, What other foe to man works such annoy

Meaning: What other foe to man works such annoy?
pope_couplet: Wrath robs the face of smiles, the heart of joy, What other foe to man works such annoy
explanation_en: What other foe to man works such annoy?
explanation_ta: முகமலர்ச்சியும் அகமலர்ச்சியும் கொல்லுகின்ற சினத்தை விட ஒருவனுக்கு பகையானவை வேறு உள்ளனவோ?

translation:
If thou would'st guard thyself, guard against wrath alway;'Gainst wrath who guards not, him his wrath shall slay

Meaning: If a man would guard himself, let him guard against anger; if he do not guard it, anger will kill him
pope_couplet: If thou would'st guard thyself, guard against wrath alway;'Gainst wrath who guards not, him his wrath shall slay
explanation_en: If a man would guard himself, let him guard against anger; if he do not guard it, anger will kill him
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன்னைத்தான் காத்துக் கொள்வதானால் சினம் வராமல் காத்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும், காக்கா விட்டால் சினம் தன்னையே அழித்து விடும்.

translation:
Wrath, the fire that slayeth whose draweth near, Will burn the helpful 'raft' of kindred dear

Meaning: The fire of anger will burn up even the pleasant raft of friendship
pope_couplet: Wrath, the fire that slayeth whose draweth near, Will burn the helpful 'raft' of kindred dear
explanation_en: The fire of anger will burn up even the pleasant raft of friendship
explanation_ta: சினம் என்னும் சேர்ந்தவரை அழிக்கும் நெருப்பு ஒருவனுக்கு இனம் இன்பத் தெப்பத்தையும் சுட்டழிக்கும்.

translation:
The hand that smites the earth unfailing feels the sting; So perish they who nurse their wrath as noble thing

Meaning: Destruction will come upon him who ragards anger as a good thing, as surely as the hand of him who strikes the ground will not fail
pope_couplet: The hand that smites the earth unfailing feels the sting; So perish they who nurse their wrath as noble thing
explanation_en: Destruction will come upon him who ragards anger as a good thing, as surely as the hand of him who strikes the ground will not fail
explanation_ta: (தன் வல்லமை புலப்படுத்தச்) சினத்தை பொருளென்று கொண்டவன் அழிதல், நிலத்தை அறைந்தவனுடைய கை தப்பாதது போல் ஆகும்.

translation:
Though men should work thee woe, like touch of tongues of fire'Tis well if thou canst save thy soul from burning ire

Meaning: Though one commit things against you as painful (to bear) as if a bundle of fire had been thrust upon you, it will be well, to refrain, if possible, from anger
pope_couplet: Though men should work thee woe, like touch of tongues of fire'Tis well if thou canst save thy soul from burning ire
explanation_en: Though one commit things against you as painful (to bear) as if a bundle of fire had been thrust upon you, it will be well, to refrain, if possible, from anger
explanation_ta: பலச் சுடர்களை உடைய பெரு நெருப்பில் தோய்வது போன்ற துன்பத்தை ஒருவன் செய்த போதிலும் கூடுமானால் அவன் மேல் சினங் கொள்ளாதிருத்தல் நல்லது.

translation:
If man his soul preserve from wrathful fires, He gains with that whate'er his soul desires

Meaning: If a man never indulges anger in his heart, he will at once obtain whatever he has thought of
pope_couplet: If man his soul preserve from wrathful fires, He gains with that whate'er his soul desires
explanation_en: If a man never indulges anger in his heart, he will at once obtain whatever he has thought of
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன் மனதால் சினத்தை எண்ணாதிருப்பானானால் நினைத்த நன்மைகளை எல்லாம் அவன் ஒருங்கே பெறுவான்.

translation:
Men of surpassing wrath are like the men who've passed away; Who wrath renounce, equals of all-renouncing sages they

Meaning: Those, who give way to excessive anger, are no better than dead men; but those, who are freed from it, are equal to those who are freed (from death)
pope_couplet: Men of surpassing wrath are like the men who've passed away; Who wrath renounce, equals of all-renouncing sages they
explanation_en: Those, who give way to excessive anger, are no better than dead men; but those, who are freed from it, are equal to those who are freed (from death)
explanation_ta: சினத்தில் அளவு கடந்து சென்றவர் இறந்தவரைப் போன்றவர், சினத்தை அடியோடு துறந்தவர் துறந்தவர்க்கு ஒப்பாவர்.

translation:
Though ill to neighbour wrought should glorious pride of wealth secure, No ill to do is fixed decree of men in spirit pure

Meaning: It is the determination of the spotless not to cause sorrow to others, although they could (by so causing) obtain the wealth which confers greatness
pope_couplet: Though ill to neighbour wrought should glorious pride of wealth secure, No ill to do is fixed decree of men in spirit pure
explanation_en: It is the determination of the spotless not to cause sorrow to others, although they could (by so causing) obtain the wealth which confers greatness
explanation_ta: சிறப்பைத்தருகின்ற பெருஞ் செல்வத்தைப் பெறுவதாக இருந்தாலும், பிறர்க்குத் துன்பம் செய்யாதிருத்தலே மாசற்றவரின் கொள்கையாம்.

translation:
Though malice work its worst, planning no ill return, to endure, And work no ill, is fixed decree of men in spirit pure

Meaning: It is the determination of the spotless not to do evil, even in return, to those who have cherished enmity and done them evil
pope_couplet: Though malice work its worst, planning no ill return, to endure, And work no ill, is fixed decree of men in spirit pure
explanation_en: It is the determination of the spotless not to do evil, even in return, to those who have cherished enmity and done them evil
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் கறுவுகொண்டு துன்பம் செய்த போதிலும் அவனுக்கு திரும்ப துன்பம் செய்யாதிருத்தலே மாசற்றவரின் கொள்கையாகும்.

translation:
Though unprovoked thy soul malicious foes should sting, Retaliation wrought inevitable woes will bring

Meaning: In an ascetic inflict suffering even on those who hate him, when he has not done them any evil, it will afterwards give him irretrievable sorrow
pope_couplet: Though unprovoked thy soul malicious foes should sting, Retaliation wrought inevitable woes will bring
explanation_en: In an ascetic inflict suffering even on those who hate him, when he has not done them any evil, it will afterwards give him irretrievable sorrow
explanation_ta: தான் ஒன்றும் செய்யாதிருக்கத் தனக்குத் தீங்கு செய்தவர்க்கும் துன்பமானாவற்றைச் செய்தால் செய்தபிறகு தப்பமுடியாத துன்பத்தையே கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
To punish wrong, with kindly benefits the doers ply; Thus shame their souls; but pass the ill unheeded by

Meaning: The (proper) punishment to those who have done evil (to you), is to put them to shame by showing them kindness, in return and to forget both the evil and the good done on both sides
pope_couplet: To punish wrong, with kindly benefits the doers ply; Thus shame their souls; but pass the ill unheeded by
explanation_en: The (proper) punishment to those who have done evil (to you), is to put them to shame by showing them kindness, in return and to forget both the evil and the good done on both sides
explanation_ta: இன்னா செய்தவரைத் தண்டித்தல் அவரே நாணும் படியாக அவருக்கு நல்லுதவி செய்து அவருடைய தீமையையும் நன்மையையும் மறந்து விடுதலாகும்.

translation:
From wisdom's vaunted lore what doth the learner gain, If as his own he guard not others' souls from pain

Meaning: What benefit has he derived from his knowledge, who does not endeavour to keep off pain from another as much as from himself ?
pope_couplet: From wisdom's vaunted lore what doth the learner gain, If as his own he guard not others' souls from pain
explanation_en: What benefit has he derived from his knowledge, who does not endeavour to keep off pain from another as much as from himself ?
explanation_ta: மற்ற உயிரின் துன்பத்தை தன் துன்பம் போல் கருதிக் காப்பாற்றா விட்டால் பெற்றுள்ள அறிவினால் ஆகும் பயன் உண்டோ.

translation:
What his own soul has felt as bitter pain, From making others feel should man abstain

Meaning: Let not a man consent to do those things to another which, he knows, will cause sorrow
pope_couplet: What his own soul has felt as bitter pain, From making others feel should man abstain
explanation_en: Let not a man consent to do those things to another which, he knows, will cause sorrow
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் துன்பமானவை என்று தன் வாழ்க்கையில் கண்டு உணர்ந்தவைகளை மற்றவனிடத்தில் செய்யாமல் தவிர்க்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
To work no wilful woe, in any wise, through all the days, To any living soul, is virtue's highest praise

Meaning: It is the chief of all virtues not knowingly to do any person evil, even in the lowest degree, and at any time
pope_couplet: To work no wilful woe, in any wise, through all the days, To any living soul, is virtue's highest praise
explanation_en: It is the chief of all virtues not knowingly to do any person evil, even in the lowest degree, and at any time
explanation_ta: எவ்வளவு சிறியதாயினும் எக்காலத்திலும் எவரிடத்திலும் மனதால் எண்ணி உண்டாகின்ற துன்பச்செயலைச் செய்யாதிருத்தலே நல்லது.

translation:
Whose soul has felt the bitter smart of wrong, how canHe wrongs inflict on ever-living soul of man

Meaning: Why does a man inflict upon other creatures those sufferings, which he has found by experience are sufferings to himself ?
pope_couplet: Whose soul has felt the bitter smart of wrong, how canHe wrongs inflict on ever-living soul of man
explanation_en: Why does a man inflict upon other creatures those sufferings, which he has found by experience are sufferings to himself ?
explanation_ta: தன் உயிருக்குத் துன்பமானவை இவை என்று உணர்ந்தவன், அத் துன்பத்தை மற்ற உயிருக்குச் செய்தல் என்ன காரணத்தாலோ.

translation:
If, ere the noontide, you to others evil do, Before the eventide will evil visit you

Meaning: If a man inflict sorrow upon others in the morning, it will come upon him unsought in the very evening
pope_couplet: If, ere the noontide, you to others evil do, Before the eventide will evil visit you
explanation_en: If a man inflict sorrow upon others in the morning, it will come upon him unsought in the very evening
explanation_ta: முற்பகலில் மற்றவருக்கு துன்பமானவற்றைச் செய்தால் அவ்வாறு செய்தவர்க்கே பிற்பகலில் துன்பங்கள் தாமாக வந்து சேரும்.

translation:
O'er every evil-doer evil broodeth still; He evil shuns who freedom seeks from ill

Meaning: Sorrow will come upon those who cause pain to others; therfore those, who desire to be free from sorrow, give no pain to others
pope_couplet: O'er every evil-doer evil broodeth still; He evil shuns who freedom seeks from ill
explanation_en: Sorrow will come upon those who cause pain to others; therfore those, who desire to be free from sorrow, give no pain to others
explanation_ta: துன்பம் எல்லாம் துன்பம் செய்தவரையேச் சார்வன, ஆகையால் துன்பம் இல்லாமல் வாழ்தலை விரும்புகின்றவர் பிறர்க்கு துன்பம் செய்யார்.

translation:
What is the work of virtue? 'Not to kill'; For 'killing' leads to every work of ill

Meaning: Never to destroy life is the sum of all virtuous conduct The destruction of life leads to every evil
pope_couplet: What is the work of virtue? 'Not to kill'; For 'killing' leads to every work of ill
explanation_en: Never to destroy life is the sum of all virtuous conduct The destruction of life leads to every evil
explanation_ta: அறமாகிய செயல் எது என்றால் ஒரு உயிரையும் கொல்லாமையாகும், கொல்லுதல் அறமல்லாத செயல்கள் எல்லாவற்றையும் விளைக்கும்.

translation:
Let those that need partake your meal; guard every-thing that lives; This the chief and sum of lore that hoarded wisdom gives

Meaning: The chief of all (the virtues) which authors have summed up, is the partaking of food that has been shared with others, and the preservation of the mainfold life of other creatures
pope_couplet: Let those that need partake your meal; guard every-thing that lives; This the chief and sum of lore that hoarded wisdom gives
explanation_en: The chief of all (the virtues) which authors have summed up, is the partaking of food that has been shared with others, and the preservation of the mainfold life of other creatures
explanation_ta: கிடைத்ததைப் பகுந்து கொடுத்துத் தானும் உண்டு பல உயிர்களையும் காப்பாற்றுதல் அறநூலார் தொகுத்த அறங்கள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் தலையான அறமாகும்.

translation:
Alone, first of goods things, is 'not to slay'; The second is, no untrue word to say

Meaning: Not to destroy life is an incomparably (great) good next to it in goodness ranks freedom from falsehood
pope_couplet: Alone, first of goods things, is 'not to slay'; The second is, no untrue word to say
explanation_en: Not to destroy life is an incomparably (great) good next to it in goodness ranks freedom from falsehood
explanation_ta: இணையில்லாத ஓர் அறமாகக் கொல்லாமை நல்லது, அதற்கு அடுத்த நிலையில் கூறத்தக்கதாகப் பொய்யாமை நல்லது.

translation:
You ask, What is the good and perfect way?'Tis path of him who studies nought to slay

Meaning: Good path is that which considers how it may avoid killing any creature
pope_couplet: You ask, What is the good and perfect way?'Tis path of him who studies nought to slay
explanation_en: Good path is that which considers how it may avoid killing any creature
explanation_ta: நல்ல வழி என்று அறநூல்களால் சொல்லப்படுவது எது என்றால், எந்த உயிரையும் கொல்லாத அறத்தைப் போற்றும் நெறியாகும்.

translation:
Of those who 'being' dread, and all renounce, the chief are they, Who dreading crime of slaughter, study nought to slay

Meaning: Of all those who, fearing the permanence of earthly births, have abandoned desire, he is the chief who, fearing (the guilt of) murder, considers how he may avoid the destruction of life
pope_couplet: Of those who 'being' dread, and all renounce, the chief are they, Who dreading crime of slaughter, study nought to slay
explanation_en: Of all those who, fearing the permanence of earthly births, have abandoned desire, he is the chief who, fearing (the guilt of) murder, considers how he may avoid the destruction of life
explanation_ta: வாழ்க்கையின் தன்மையைக்கண்டு அஞ்சித் துறந்தவர்கள் எல்லாரிலும், கொலைசெய்வதற்க்கு அஞ்சிக் கொல்லாத அறத்தைப் போற்றுகின்றவன் உயர்ந்தவன்.

translation:
Ev'n death that life devours, their happy days shall spare, Who law, 'Thou shall not kill', uphold with reverent care

Meaning: Yama, the destroyer of life, will not attack the life of him, who acts under the determination of never destroying life
pope_couplet: Ev'n death that life devours, their happy days shall spare, Who law, 'Thou shall not kill', uphold with reverent care
explanation_en: Yama, the destroyer of life, will not attack the life of him, who acts under the determination of never destroying life
explanation_ta: கொல்லாத அறத்தை மேற்கொண்டு நடக்கின்றவனுடைய வாழ்நாளின் மேல், உயிரைக்கொண்டு செல்லும் கூற்றுவனும் செல்லமாட்டான்.

translation:
Though thine own life for that spared life the price must pay, Take not from aught that lives gift of sweet life away

Meaning: Let no one do that which would destroy the life of another, although he should by so doing, lose his own life
pope_couplet: Though thine own life for that spared life the price must pay, Take not from aught that lives gift of sweet life away
explanation_en: Let no one do that which would destroy the life of another, although he should by so doing, lose his own life
explanation_ta: தன் உயிர் உடம்பிலிருந்து நீங்கிச் செல்வதாக இருந்தாலும், அதைத் தடுப்பதற்காகத் தான் வேறோர் உயிரை நீக்கும் செயலைச் செய்யக்கூடாது.

translation:
Though great the gain of good should seem, the wiseWill any gain by staughter won despise

Meaning: The advantage which might flow from destroying life in sacrifice, is dishonourable to the wise (who renounced the world), even although it should be said to be productive of great good
pope_couplet: Though great the gain of good should seem, the wiseWill any gain by staughter won despise
explanation_en: The advantage which might flow from destroying life in sacrifice, is dishonourable to the wise (who renounced the world), even although it should be said to be productive of great good
explanation_ta: கொலையால் நன்மையாக விளையும் ஆக்கம் பெரிதாக இருந்தாலும், சான்றோர்க்குக் கொலையால் வரும் ஆக்கம் மிக இழிவானதாகும்.

translation:
Whose trade is 'killing', always vile they show, To minds of them who what is vileness know

Meaning: To minds of them who what is vileness know
pope_couplet: Whose trade is 'killing', always vile they show, To minds of them who what is vileness know
explanation_en: To minds of them who what is vileness know
explanation_ta: கொலைத்தொழிலினராகிய மக்கள் அதன் இழிவை ஆராய்ந்தவரிடத்தில் புலைத்தொழிலுடையவராய்த் தாழ்ந்து தோன்றுவர்.

translation:
Who lead a loathed life in bodies sorely pained, Are men, the wise declare, by guilt of slaughter stained

Meaning: (The wise) will say that men of diseased bodies, who live in degradation and in poverty, are those who separated the life from the body of animals (in a former birth)
pope_couplet: Who lead a loathed life in bodies sorely pained, Are men, the wise declare, by guilt of slaughter stained
explanation_en: (The wise) will say that men of diseased bodies, who live in degradation and in poverty, are those who separated the life from the body of animals (in a former birth)
explanation_ta: நோய் மிகுந்த உடம்புடன் வறுமையான தீய வாழ்க்கை உடையவர், முன்பு கொலை பல செய்து உயிர்களை உடம்புகளில் இருந்து நீக்கினவர் என்று அறிஞர் கூறுவர்.

translation:
Lowest and meanest lore, that bids men trust secure, In things that pass away, as things that shall endure

Meaning: That ignorance which considers those things to be stable which are not so, is dishonourable (to the wise)
pope_couplet: Lowest and meanest lore, that bids men trust secure, In things that pass away, as things that shall endure
explanation_en: That ignorance which considers those things to be stable which are not so, is dishonourable (to the wise)
explanation_ta: நிலையில்லாதவைகளை நிலையானவை என்று மயங்கி உணரும் புல்லறிவு உடையவராக இருத்தல் வாழ்க்கையில் இழிந்த நிலையாகும்.

translation:
As crowds round dancers fill the hall, is wealth's increase; Its loss, as throngs dispersing, when the dances cease

Meaning: The acquisition of wealth is like the gathering together of an assembly for a theatre; its expenditure is like the breaking up of that assembly
pope_couplet: As crowds round dancers fill the hall, is wealth's increase; Its loss, as throngs dispersing, when the dances cease
explanation_en: The acquisition of wealth is like the gathering together of an assembly for a theatre; its expenditure is like the breaking up of that assembly
explanation_ta: பெரிய செல்வம் வந்து சேர்தல், கூத்தாடும் இடத்தில் கூட்டம் சேர்வதைப் போன்றது, அது நீங்கிப் போதலும் கூத்து முடிந்ததும் கூட்டம் கலைவதைப் போன்றது.

translation:
Unenduring is all wealth; if you wealth enjoy, Enduring works in working wealth straightway employ

Meaning: Wealth is perishable; let those who obtain it immediately practise those (virtues) which are imperishable
pope_couplet: Unenduring is all wealth; if you wealth enjoy, Enduring works in working wealth straightway employ
explanation_en: Wealth is perishable; let those who obtain it immediately practise those (virtues) which are imperishable
explanation_ta: செல்வம் நிலைக்காத இயல்பை உடையது, அத்தகைய செல்வத்தைப்பெற்றால், பெற்ற அப்போதே நிலையான அறங்களைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
As 'day' it vaunts itself; well understood, 'tis knife', That daily cuts away a portion from thy life

Meaning: Time, which shows itself (to the ignorant) as if it were something (real) is in the estimation of the wise (only) a saw which cuts down life
pope_couplet: As 'day' it vaunts itself; well understood, 'tis knife', That daily cuts away a portion from thy life
explanation_en: Time, which shows itself (to the ignorant) as if it were something (real) is in the estimation of the wise (only) a saw which cuts down life
explanation_ta: வாழ்க்கையை ஆராய்ந்து உணர்வாரைப் பெற்றால் நாள் என்பது ஒரு கால அளவுகோல்காட்டி, உயிரை உடம்பிலிருந்து பிரித்து அறுக்கும் வாளாக உள்ளது.

translation:
Before the tongue lie powerless, 'mid the gasp of gurgling breath, Arouse thyself, and do good deeds beyond the power of death

Meaning: Let virtuous deeds be done quickly, before the hiccup comes making the tongue silent
pope_couplet: Before the tongue lie powerless, 'mid the gasp of gurgling breath, Arouse thyself, and do good deeds beyond the power of death
explanation_en: Let virtuous deeds be done quickly, before the hiccup comes making the tongue silent
explanation_ta: நாவை அடக்கி விக்கல் மேலெழுவதற்கு முன்னே (இறப்பு நெருங்குவதற்கு முன்) நல்ல அறச்செயலை விரைந்து செய்யத்தக்கதாகும்.

translation:
Existing yesterday, today to nothing hurled!-Such greatness owns this transitory world

Meaning: This world possesses the greatness that one who yesterday was is not today
pope_couplet: Existing yesterday, today to nothing hurled!-Such greatness owns this transitory world
explanation_en: This world possesses the greatness that one who yesterday was is not today
explanation_ta: நேற்று இருந்தவன் ஒருவன் இன்று இல்லாமல் இறந்து போனான் என்று சொல்லப்படும் நிலையாமைஆகிய பெருமை உடையது இவ்வுலகம்.

translation:
Who know not if their happy lives shall last the day, In fancies infinite beguile the hours away

Meaning: Innumerable are the thoughts which occupy the mind of (the unwise), who know not that they shall live another moment
pope_couplet: Who know not if their happy lives shall last the day, In fancies infinite beguile the hours away
explanation_en: Innumerable are the thoughts which occupy the mind of (the unwise), who know not that they shall live another moment
explanation_ta: அறிவில்லாதவர் ஒரு வேளையாவது வாழ்க்கையின் தன்மையை ஆராய்ந்து அறிவதில்லை.ஆனால் வீணீல் எண்ணுவனவோ ஒரு கோடியும் அல்ல, மிகப்பல எண்ணங்கள்.

translation:
Birds fly away, and leave the nest deserted bare; Such is the short-lived friendship soul and body share

Meaning: The love of the soul to the body is like (the love of) a bird to its egg which it flies away from and leaves empty
pope_couplet: Birds fly away, and leave the nest deserted bare; Such is the short-lived friendship soul and body share
explanation_en: The love of the soul to the body is like (the love of) a bird to its egg which it flies away from and leaves empty
explanation_ta: உடம்போடு உயிர்க்கு உள்ள உறவு, தான் இருந்த கூடு தனியே இருக்க அதை விட்டு வேறிடத்திற்குப் பறவை பறந்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Death is sinking into slumbers deep; Birth again is waking out of sleep

Meaning: Death is like sleep; birth is like awaking from it
pope_couplet: Death is sinking into slumbers deep; Birth again is waking out of sleep
explanation_en: Death is like sleep; birth is like awaking from it
explanation_ta: இறப்பு எனப்படுவது ஒருவனுக்குஉறக்கம் வருதலைப் போன்றது, பிறப்பு எனப்படுவது உறக்கம் நீங்கி விழித்துக் கொள்வதைப் போன்றது.

translation:
The soul in fragile shed as lodger courts repose:-Is it because no home's conclusive rest it knows

Meaning: It seems as if the soul, which takes a temporary shelter in a body, had not attained a home
pope_couplet: The soul in fragile shed as lodger courts repose:-Is it because no home's conclusive rest it knows
explanation_en: It seems as if the soul, which takes a temporary shelter in a body, had not attained a home
explanation_ta: (நோய்களுக்கு இடமாகிய) உடம்பில் ஒரு மூலையில் குடியிருந்த உயிர்க்கு, நிலையாகப் புகுந்திருக்கும் வீடு இதுவரையில் அமையவில்லையோ.

translation:
From whatever, aye, whatever, man gets free, From what, aye, from that, no more of pain hath he

Meaning: Whatever thing, a man has renounced, by that thing; he cannot suffer pain
pope_couplet: From whatever, aye, whatever, man gets free, From what, aye, from that, no more of pain hath he
explanation_en: Whatever thing, a man has renounced, by that thing; he cannot suffer pain
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் எந்தப் பொருளிலிருந்து, எந்தப் பொருளிலிருந்து பற்று நீங்கியவனாக இருக்கின்றானோ, அந்தந்தப் பொருளால் அவன் துன்பம் அடைவதில்லை.

translation:
'Renunciation' made- ev'n here true pleasures men acquire;'Renounce' while time is yet, if to those pleasures you aspire

Meaning: After a man has renounced (all things), there will still be many things in this world (which he may enjoy); if he should desire them, let him, while it is time abandon (the world)
pope_couplet: 'Renunciation' made- ev'n here true pleasures men acquire;'Renounce' while time is yet, if to those pleasures you aspire
explanation_en: After a man has renounced (all things), there will still be many things in this world (which he may enjoy); if he should desire them, let him, while it is time abandon (the world)
explanation_ta: துன்பமில்லாத நிலைமை வேண்டுமானால் எல்லாப் பொருள்களும் உள்ள காலத்திலேயெ துறக்க வேண்டும்,துறந்த பின் இங்குப் பெறக்கூடும் இன்பங்கள் பல.

translation:
'Perceptions of the five' must all expire;-Relinquished in its order each desire

Meaning: Let the five senses be destroyed; and at the same time, let everything be abandoned that (the ascetic) has (formerly) desired
pope_couplet: 'Perceptions of the five' must all expire;-Relinquished in its order each desire
explanation_en: Let the five senses be destroyed; and at the same time, let everything be abandoned that (the ascetic) has (formerly) desired
explanation_ta: ஐம்பொறிகளுக்கும் உரிய ஐந்து புலன்களின் ஆசையையும் வெல்லுதல் வேண்டும், அவற்றிற்கு வேண்டிய பொருள்களை எல்லாம் ஒரு சேர விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
'Privation absolute' is penance true;'Possession' brings bewilderment anew

Meaning: To be altogether destitute is the proper condition of those who perform austerities; if they possess anything, it will change (their resolution) and bring them back to their confused state
pope_couplet: 'Privation absolute' is penance true;'Possession' brings bewilderment anew
explanation_en: To be altogether destitute is the proper condition of those who perform austerities; if they possess anything, it will change (their resolution) and bring them back to their confused state
explanation_ta: தவம் செய்தவற்கு ஒரு பற்றும் இல்லாதிருத்தல் இயல்பாகும், பற்று உடையவராக இருத்தல் மீண்டும் மயங்குவதற்கு வழியாகும்.

translation:
To those who sev'rance seek from being's varied strife, Flesh is burthen sore; what then other bonds of life

Meaning: What means the addition of other things those who are attempting to cut off (future) births, when even their body is too much (for them)
pope_couplet: To those who sev'rance seek from being's varied strife, Flesh is burthen sore; what then other bonds of life
explanation_en: What means the addition of other things those who are attempting to cut off (future) births, when even their body is too much (for them)
explanation_ta: பிறவித் துன்பத்தைப் போக்க முயல்கின்றவர்க்கு உடம்பும் மிகையான பொருள் ஆகையால் அதற்கு மேல் வேறு தொடர்பு கொள்வது ஏனோ.

translation:
Who kills conceit that utters 'I' and 'mine', Shall enter realms above the powers divine

Meaning: Shall enter realms above the powers divine
pope_couplet: Who kills conceit that utters 'I' and 'mine', Shall enter realms above the powers divine
explanation_en: Shall enter realms above the powers divine
explanation_ta: உடம்பை யான் எனக் கருதலும் தொடர்பு இல்லாத பொருளை எனது எனக்கருதலுமாகிய மயக்கத்தை போக்குகின்றவன், தேவர்க்கும் எட்டாத உயர்ந்த நிலை அடைவான்.

translation:
Who cling to things that cling and eager clasp, Griefs cling to them with unrelaxing grasp

Meaning: Sorrows will never let go their hold of those who give not up their hold of desire
pope_couplet: Who cling to things that cling and eager clasp, Griefs cling to them with unrelaxing grasp
explanation_en: Sorrows will never let go their hold of those who give not up their hold of desire
explanation_ta: யான் எனது என்னும் இருவகைப் பற்றுக்களையும் பற்றிக் கொண்டுவிடாத வரை, துன்பங்களும் விடாமல் பற்றிக்கொள்கின்றன.

translation:
Who thoroughly 'renounce' on highest height are set; The rest bewildered, lie entangled in the net

Meaning: Those who have entirely renounced (all things and all desire) have obtained (absorption into God); all others wander in confusion, entangled in the net of (many) births
pope_couplet: Who thoroughly 'renounce' on highest height are set; The rest bewildered, lie entangled in the net
explanation_en: Those who have entirely renounced (all things and all desire) have obtained (absorption into God); all others wander in confusion, entangled in the net of (many) births
explanation_ta: முற்றத் துறந்தவறே உயர்ந்த நிலையினர் ஆவர், அவ்வாறு துறக்காத மற்றவர் அறியாமையாகிய வலையில் அகப்பட்டவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
When that which clings falls off, severed is being's tie; All else will then be seen as instability

Meaning: At the moment in which desire has been abandoned, (other) births will be cut off; when that has not been done, instability will be seen
pope_couplet: When that which clings falls off, severed is being's tie; All else will then be seen as instability
explanation_en: At the moment in which desire has been abandoned, (other) births will be cut off; when that has not been done, instability will be seen
explanation_ta: இருவகைப் பற்றும் அற்றபொழுதே அந்நிலை பிறவித் துன்பத்தை ஒழிக்கும், இல்லையானால் (பிறவித்துன்பம் மாறி மாறி வந்து) நிலையாமைக் காணப்படும்.

translation:
Cling thou to that which He, to Whom nought clings, hath bid thee cling, Cling to that bond, to get thee free from every clinging thing

Meaning: Desire the desire of Him who is without desire; in order to renounce desire, desire that desire
pope_couplet: Cling thou to that which He, to Whom nought clings, hath bid thee cling, Cling to that bond, to get thee free from every clinging thing
explanation_en: Desire the desire of Him who is without desire; in order to renounce desire, desire that desire
explanation_ta: பற்றில்லாதவனாகிய கடவுளுடைய பற்றை மட்டும் பற்றிக் கொள்ள வேண்டும், உள்ள பற்றுக்களை விட்டொழிப்பதற்கே அப் பற்றைப் பற்ற வேண்டும்.

translation:
Of things devoid of truth as real things men deem;-Cause of degraded birth the fond delusive dream

Meaning: Inglorious births are produced by the confusion (of mind) which considers those things to be real which are not real
pope_couplet: Of things devoid of truth as real things men deem;-Cause of degraded birth the fond delusive dream
explanation_en: Inglorious births are produced by the confusion (of mind) which considers those things to be real which are not real
explanation_ta: மெய்ப்பொருள் அல்லாதவைகளை மெய்ப்பொருள் என்று தவறாக உணர்கின்ற மயக்க உணர்வால் சிறப்பில்லாத துன்பப் பிறவி உண்டாகும்.

translation:
Darkness departs, and rapture springs to men who see, The mystic vision pure, from all delusion free

Meaning: A clear, undimmed vision of things will deliver its possessors from the darkness of future births, and confer the felicity (of heaven)
pope_couplet: Darkness departs, and rapture springs to men who see, The mystic vision pure, from all delusion free
explanation_en: A clear, undimmed vision of things will deliver its possessors from the darkness of future births, and confer the felicity (of heaven)
explanation_ta: மயக்கம் நீங்கிக் குற்றம் அற்ற மெய்யுணர்வை உடையவர்க்கு, அம் மெய்யுணர்வு அறியாமையை நீக்கி இன்ப நிலையைக்கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
When doubts disperse, and mists of error rollAway, nearer is heav'n than earth to sage's soul

Meaning: Heaven is nearer than earth to those men of purified minds who are freed from from doubt
pope_couplet: When doubts disperse, and mists of error rollAway, nearer is heav'n than earth to sage's soul
explanation_en: Heaven is nearer than earth to those men of purified minds who are freed from from doubt
explanation_ta: ஐயத்திலிருந்து நீங்கி மெய்யுணர்வு பெற்றவர்க்கு அடைந்துள்ள இவ்வுலகை விட அடைய வேண்டிய மேலுலகம் அண்மையில் உள்ளதாகும்.

translation:
Five-fold perception gained, what benefits accrueTo them whose spirits lack perception of the true

Meaning: Even those who have all the knowledge which can be attained by the five senses, will derive no benefit from it, if they are without a knowledge of the true nature of things
pope_couplet: Five-fold perception gained, what benefits accrueTo them whose spirits lack perception of the true
explanation_en: Even those who have all the knowledge which can be attained by the five senses, will derive no benefit from it, if they are without a knowledge of the true nature of things
explanation_ta: மெய்யுணர்வு இல்லாதவர்க்கு ஐந்து புலன்களின் வேறுபாட்டால் வளர்ந்த ஐந்து வகை உணர்வும் முற்றப்பெற்ற போதிலும் பயன் இல்லை.

translation:
Whatever thing, of whatsoever kind it be,'Tis wisdom's part in each the very thing to see

Meaning: (True) knowledge is the perception concerning every thing of whatever kind, that that thing is the true thing
pope_couplet: Whatever thing, of whatsoever kind it be,'Tis wisdom's part in each the very thing to see
explanation_en: (True) knowledge is the perception concerning every thing of whatever kind, that that thing is the true thing
explanation_ta: எப்பொருள் எத்தன்மையதாய்த் தோன்றினாலும் (அத்தோற்றத்தை மட்டும் கண்டுமங்காமல்) அப் பொருளின் உண்மையான இயல்பை அறிவதே மெய்யுணர்வு.

translation:
Who learn, and here the knowledge of the true obtain, Shall find the path that hither cometh not again

Meaning: They, who in this birth have learned to know the True Being, enter the road which returns not into this world
pope_couplet: Who learn, and here the knowledge of the true obtain, Shall find the path that hither cometh not again
explanation_en: They, who in this birth have learned to know the True Being, enter the road which returns not into this world
explanation_ta: கற்க வேண்டிய வற்றைக் கற்று இங்கு மெய்ப் பொருளை உணர்ந்தவர் , மீண்டும் இப்பிறப்பிற்கு வராத வழியை அடைவர்.

translation:
The mind that knows with certitude what is, and ponders well, Its thoughts on birth again to other life need not to dwell

Meaning: Let it not be thought that there is another birth for him whose mind having thoroughly considered (all it has been taught) has known the True Being
pope_couplet: The mind that knows with certitude what is, and ponders well, Its thoughts on birth again to other life need not to dwell
explanation_en: Let it not be thought that there is another birth for him whose mind having thoroughly considered (all it has been taught) has known the True Being
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய உள்ளம் உண்மைப் பொருளை ஆராய்ந்து உறுதியாக உணர்ந்தால், அவனுக்கு மீண்டும் பிறப்பு உள்ள தென எண்ண வேண்டா.

translation:
When folly, cause of births, departs; and soul can viewThe truth of things, man's dignity- 'tis wisdom true

Meaning: True knowledge consists in the removal of ignorance; which is (the cause of) births, and the perception of the True Being who is (the bestower of) heaven
pope_couplet: When folly, cause of births, departs; and soul can viewThe truth of things, man's dignity- 'tis wisdom true
explanation_en: True knowledge consists in the removal of ignorance; which is (the cause of) births, and the perception of the True Being who is (the bestower of) heaven
explanation_ta: பிறவித்துன்பத்திற்கு காரணமான அறியாமை நீங்குமாறு முக்தி எனும் சிறந்த நிலைக்குக் காரணமான செம் பொருளைக் காண்பதே மெய்யுணர்வு.

translation:
The true 'support' who knows- rejects 'supports' he sought before-Sorrow that clings all destroys, shall cling to him no more

Meaning: He who so lives as to know Him who is the support of all things and abandon all desire, will be freed from the evils which would otherwise cleave to him and destroy (his efforts after absorption)
pope_couplet: The true 'support' who knows- rejects 'supports' he sought before-Sorrow that clings all destroys, shall cling to him no more
explanation_en: He who so lives as to know Him who is the support of all things and abandon all desire, will be freed from the evils which would otherwise cleave to him and destroy (his efforts after absorption)
explanation_ta: எல்லாப் பொருளுக்கும் சார்பான செம்பொருளை உணர்ந்து பற்றுக் கெடுமாறு ஒழுகினால், சார்வதற்க்கு உரிய துன்பங்கள் திரும்ப வந்து அடையா.

translation:
When lust and wrath and error's triple tyranny is o'er, Their very names for aye extinct, then pain shall be no more

Meaning: If the very names of these three things, desire, anger, and confusion of mind, be destroyed, then will also perish evils (which flow from them)
pope_couplet: When lust and wrath and error's triple tyranny is o'er, Their very names for aye extinct, then pain shall be no more
explanation_en: If the very names of these three things, desire, anger, and confusion of mind, be destroyed, then will also perish evils (which flow from them)
explanation_ta: விருப்பு, வெறுப்பு, அறியாமை ஆகிய இக் குற்றங்கள் மூன்றனுடைய பெயரும் கெடுமாறு ஒழுகினால் துன்பங்கள் வராமற் கெடும்.

translation:
The wise declare, through all the days, to every living thingThat ceaseless round of birth from seed of strong desire doth spring

Meaning: (The wise) say that the seed, which produces unceasing births, at all times, to all creatures, is desire
pope_couplet: The wise declare, through all the days, to every living thingThat ceaseless round of birth from seed of strong desire doth spring
explanation_en: (The wise) say that the seed, which produces unceasing births, at all times, to all creatures, is desire
explanation_ta: எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் எக்காலத்திலும் ஒழியாமல் வருகின்ற பிறவித்துன்பத்தை உண்டாக்கும் வித்து அவா என்றுக் கூறுவர்.

translation:
If desire you feel, freedom from changing birth require!'I' will come, if you desire to 'scape, set free from all desire

Meaning: If anything be desired, freedom from births should be desired; that (freedom from births) will be attained by desiring to be without desire
pope_couplet: If desire you feel, freedom from changing birth require!'I' will come, if you desire to 'scape, set free from all desire
explanation_en: If anything be desired, freedom from births should be desired; that (freedom from births) will be attained by desiring to be without desire
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் ஒன்றை விரும்புவதனால் பிறவா நிலைமையை விரும்ப வேண்டும், அது அவா அற்ற நிலையை விரும்பினால் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
No glorious wealth is here like freedom from desire; To bliss like this not even there can soul aspire

Meaning: There is in this world no excellence equal to freedom from desire; and even in that world, there is nothing like it
pope_couplet: No glorious wealth is here like freedom from desire; To bliss like this not even there can soul aspire
explanation_en: There is in this world no excellence equal to freedom from desire; and even in that world, there is nothing like it
explanation_ta: அவா அற்ற நிலைமை போன்ற சிறந்த செல்வம் இவ்வுலகில் இல்லை, வேறு எங்கும் அதற்க்கு நிகரான ஒன்று இல்லை.

translation:
Desire's decease as purity men know; That, too, from yearning search for truth will grow

Meaning: Purity (of mind) consists in freedom from desire; and that (freedom from desire) is the fruit of the love of truth
pope_couplet: Desire's decease as purity men know; That, too, from yearning search for truth will grow
explanation_en: Purity (of mind) consists in freedom from desire; and that (freedom from desire) is the fruit of the love of truth
explanation_ta: தூயநிலை என்றுக் கூறப்படுவது அவா இல்லா திருத்தலே யாகும், அவா அற்ற அத்தன்மை மெய்ப்பொருளை விரும்புவதால் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
Men freed from bonds of strong desire are free; None other share such perfect liberty

Meaning: They are said to be free (from future birth) who are freed from desire; all others (who, whatever else they may be free from, are not freed from desire) are not thus free
pope_couplet: Men freed from bonds of strong desire are free; None other share such perfect liberty
explanation_en: They are said to be free (from future birth) who are freed from desire; all others (who, whatever else they may be free from, are not freed from desire) are not thus free
explanation_ta: பற்றற்றவர் என்றுக் கூறப்படுவோர் அவா அற்றவரே, அவா அறாத மற்றவர் அவ்வளவாகப் பற்று அற்றவர் அல்லர்.

translation:
Desire each soul beguiles; True virtue dreads its wiles

Meaning: It is the chief duty of (an ascetic) to watch against desire with (jealous) fear; for it has power to deceive (and destroy) him
pope_couplet: Desire each soul beguiles; True virtue dreads its wiles
explanation_en: It is the chief duty of (an ascetic) to watch against desire with (jealous) fear; for it has power to deceive (and destroy) him
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அவாவிற்கு அஞ்சி வாழ்வதே அறம், ஏன் எனில் ஒருவனைச் சோர்வு கண்டுகொடுத்து வஞ்சிப்பது அவாவே.

translation:
Who thoroughly rids his life of passion-prompted deed, Deeds of unfailing worth shall do, which, as he plans, succeed

Meaning: If a man thoroughly cut off all desire, the deeds, which confer immortality, will come to him, in the path in which he seeks them
pope_couplet: Who thoroughly rids his life of passion-prompted deed, Deeds of unfailing worth shall do, which, as he plans, succeed
explanation_en: If a man thoroughly cut off all desire, the deeds, which confer immortality, will come to him, in the path in which he seeks them
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் ஆசையை முழுதும் ஒழித்தால், அவன் கெடாமல் வாழ்வதற்கு உரிய நல்ல செயல் அவன் விரும்புமாறு வாய்க்கும்.

translation:
Affliction is not known where no desires abide; Where these are, endless rises sorrow's tide

Meaning: There is no sorrow to those who are without desire; but where that is, (sorrow) will incessantly come, more and more
pope_couplet: Affliction is not known where no desires abide; Where these are, endless rises sorrow's tide
explanation_en: There is no sorrow to those who are without desire; but where that is, (sorrow) will incessantly come, more and more
explanation_ta: அவா இல்லாதவர்க்குத் துன்பம் இல்லையாகும், அவா இருந்தால் எல்லாத் துன்பங்களும் மேலும் மேலும் ஒழியாமல் வரும்.

translation:
When dies away desire, that woe of woesEv'n here the soul unceasing rapture knows

Meaning: Even while in this body, joy will never depart (from the mind, in which) desire, that sorrow of sorrows, has been destroyed
pope_couplet: When dies away desire, that woe of woesEv'n here the soul unceasing rapture knows
explanation_en: Even while in this body, joy will never depart (from the mind, in which) desire, that sorrow of sorrows, has been destroyed
explanation_ta: அவா என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற துன்பங்களுள் பொல்லாதத் துன்பம் கெடுமானால் இவ் வுலகில் இன்பம் இடையறாமல் வாய்க்கும்.

translation:
Drive from thy soul desire insatiate; Straight'way is gained the moveless blissful state

Meaning: The removal of desire, whose nature it is never to be satisfied, will immediately confer a nature that can never be changed
pope_couplet: Drive from thy soul desire insatiate; Straight'way is gained the moveless blissful state
explanation_en: The removal of desire, whose nature it is never to be satisfied, will immediately confer a nature that can never be changed
explanation_ta: ஒருபோதும் நிரம்பாத தன்மை உடைய அவாவை ஒழித்தால் ஒழித்த அந்நிலையே எப்போதும் மாறாதிருக்கும் இன்ப வாழ்வைத் தரும்.

translation:
Wealth-giving fate power of unflinching effort brings; From fate that takes away idle remissness springs

Meaning: Perseverance comes from a prosperous fate, and idleness from an adverse fate
pope_couplet: Wealth-giving fate power of unflinching effort brings; From fate that takes away idle remissness springs
explanation_en: Perseverance comes from a prosperous fate, and idleness from an adverse fate
explanation_ta: கைப்பொருள் ஆவதற்க்கு காரணமான ஊழால் சோர்வில்லாத முயற்சி உண்டாகும், கைப்பொருள் போவதற்க்கு காரணமான ஊழால் சோம்பல் ஏற்படும்.

translation:
The fate that loss ordains makes wise men's wisdom foolishness; The fate that gain bestows with ampler powers will wisdom bless

Meaning: An adverse fate produces folly, and a prosperous fate produces enlarged knowledge
pope_couplet: The fate that loss ordains makes wise men's wisdom foolishness; The fate that gain bestows with ampler powers will wisdom bless
explanation_en: An adverse fate produces folly, and a prosperous fate produces enlarged knowledge
explanation_ta: பொருள் இழந்தற்கு காரணமான ஊழ், பேதை யாக்கும் பொருள் ஆவதற்க்கு காரணமான ஊழ் அறிவைப் பெருக்கும்.

translation:
In subtle learning manifold though versed man be,'The wisdom, truly his, will gain supremacy

Meaning: Although (a man) may study the most polished treatises, the knowledge which fate has decreed to him will still prevail
pope_couplet: In subtle learning manifold though versed man be,'The wisdom, truly his, will gain supremacy
explanation_en: Although (a man) may study the most polished treatises, the knowledge which fate has decreed to him will still prevail
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் நுட்பமான நூல் பலவற்றைக் கற்றாலும் ஊழுக்கு ஏற்றவாறு அவனுக்கு உள்ள தாகும் அறிவே மேம்பட்டுத் தோன்றும்.

translation:
Two fold the fashion of the world: some live in fortune's light; While other some have souls in wisdom's radiance bright

Meaning: There are (through fate) two different natures in the world, hence the difference (observable in men) in (their acquisition of) wealth, and in their attainment of knowledge
pope_couplet: Two fold the fashion of the world: some live in fortune's light; While other some have souls in wisdom's radiance bright
explanation_en: There are (through fate) two different natures in the world, hence the difference (observable in men) in (their acquisition of) wealth, and in their attainment of knowledge
explanation_ta: உலகத்தின் இயற்க்கை ஊழின் காரணமாக இரு வேறு வகைப்படும், செல்வம் உடையவராதலும் வேறு அறிவு உடையவராதலும் வேறு.

translation:
All things that good appear will oft have ill success; All evil things prove good for gain of happiness

Meaning: In the acquisition of property, every thing favourable becomes unfavourable, and (on the other hand) everything unfavourable becomes favourable, (through the power of fate)
pope_couplet: All things that good appear will oft have ill success; All evil things prove good for gain of happiness
explanation_en: In the acquisition of property, every thing favourable becomes unfavourable, and (on the other hand) everything unfavourable becomes favourable, (through the power of fate)
explanation_ta: செல்வத்தை ஈட்டும் முயற்சிக்கு ஊழ்வகையால் நல்லவை எல்லாம் தீயவை ஆதலும் உண்டு, தீயவை நல்லவை ஆதலும் உண்டு.

translation:
Things not your own will yield no good, howe'er you guard with pain; Your own, howe'er you scatter them abroad, will yours remain

Meaning: Whatever is not conferred by fate cannot be preserved although it be guarded with most painful care; and that, which fate has made his, cannot be lost, although one should even take it and throw it away
pope_couplet: Things not your own will yield no good, howe'er you guard with pain; Your own, howe'er you scatter them abroad, will yours remain
explanation_en: Whatever is not conferred by fate cannot be preserved although it be guarded with most painful care; and that, which fate has made his, cannot be lost, although one should even take it and throw it away
explanation_ta: ஊழால் தமக்கு உரியவை அல்லாதப் பொருள்கள் வருந்திக்காப்பாற்றினாலும் நில்லாமல் போகும் தமக்கு உரியவை கொண்டு போய்ச் சொரிந்தாலும் போகா.

translation:
Save as the 'sharer' shares to each in due degree, To those who millions store enjoyment scarce can be

Meaning: Even those who gather together millions will only enjoy them, as it has been determined by the disposer (of all things)
pope_couplet: Save as the 'sharer' shares to each in due degree, To those who millions store enjoyment scarce can be
explanation_en: Even those who gather together millions will only enjoy them, as it has been determined by the disposer (of all things)
explanation_ta: ஊழ் ஏற்ப்படுத்திய வகையால் அல்லாமல் முயன்று கோடிக்கணக்கானப் பொருளைச் சேர்த்தவருக்கும் அவற்றை நுகர முடியாது.

translation:
The destitute with ascetics merit share, If fate to visit with predestined ills would spare

Meaning: The destitute will renounce desire (and become ascetics), if (fate) do not make them suffer the hindrances to which they are liable, and they pass away
pope_couplet: The destitute with ascetics merit share, If fate to visit with predestined ills would spare
explanation_en: The destitute will renounce desire (and become ascetics), if (fate) do not make them suffer the hindrances to which they are liable, and they pass away
explanation_ta: வரவேண்டிய துன்பங்கள் வந்து வருத்தாமல் நீங்குமானால் நுகரும் பொருள் இல்லாத வறியவர் துறவறம் மேற்க்கொள்வர்.

translation:
When good things come, men view them all as gain; When evils come, why then should they complain

Meaning: How is it that those, who are pleased with good fortune, trouble themselves when evil comes, (since both are equally the decree of fate) ?
pope_couplet: When good things come, men view them all as gain; When evils come, why then should they complain
explanation_en: How is it that those, who are pleased with good fortune, trouble themselves when evil comes, (since both are equally the decree of fate) ?
explanation_ta: நல்வினை விளையும் போது நல்லவை எனக் கருதி மகிழ்கின்றனர், தீவினை விளையும் போது துன்பப்பட்டுக் கலங்குவது ஏனோ.

translation:
What powers so great as those of Destiny? Man's skillSome other thing contrives; but fate's beforehand still

Meaning: What is stronger than fate ? If we think of an expedient (to avert it), it will itself be with us before (the thought)
pope_couplet: What powers so great as those of Destiny? Man's skillSome other thing contrives; but fate's beforehand still
explanation_en: What is stronger than fate ? If we think of an expedient (to avert it), it will itself be with us before (the thought)
explanation_ta: ஊழை விட மிக்க வலிமையுள்ளவை வேறு எவை உள்ளன, ஊழை விலக்கும் பொருட்டு மற்றோரு வழியைஆராய்ந்தாலும் அங்கும் தானே முன் வந்து நிற்கும்.

translation:
An army, people, wealth, a minister, friends, fort: six things-Who owns them all, a lion lives amid the kings

Meaning: He who possesses these six things, an army, a people, wealth, ministers, friends and a fortress, is a lion among kings
pope_couplet: An army, people, wealth, a minister, friends, fort: six things-Who owns them all, a lion lives amid the kings
explanation_en: He who possesses these six things, an army, a people, wealth, ministers, friends and a fortress, is a lion among kings
explanation_ta: படை குடி கூழ் அமைச்சு நட்பு அரண் என்று கூறப்படும் ஆறு அங்கங்களையும் உடையவனே அரசருள் ஆண் சிங்கம் போனறவன்.

translation:
Courage, a liberal hand, wisdom, and energy: these fourAre qualities a king adorn for evermore

Meaning: Never to fail in these four things, fearlessness, liberality, wisdom, and energy, is the kingly character
