pope_couplet: Courage, a liberal hand, wisdom, and energy: these fourAre qualities a king adorn for evermore
explanation_en: Never to fail in these four things, fearlessness, liberality, wisdom, and energy, is the kingly character
explanation_ta: அஞ்சாமை, ஈகை , அறிவுடைமை, ஊக்கமுடைமை இந்த நான்கு பண்புகளும் குறைவு படாமல் இருத்தலே அரசனுக்கு இயல்பாகும்.

translation:
A sleepless promptitude, knowledge, decision strong:These three for aye to rulers of the land belong

Meaning: These three things, viz, vigilance, learning, and bravery, should never be wanting in the ruler of a country
pope_couplet: A sleepless promptitude, knowledge, decision strong:These three for aye to rulers of the land belong
explanation_en: These three things, viz, vigilance, learning, and bravery, should never be wanting in the ruler of a country
explanation_ta: காலம் தாழ்த்தாத தன்மை, கல்வியுடைமை, துணிவுடைமை இந்த மூன்று பண்புகளும் நிலத்தை ஆளும் அரசனுக்கு நீங்காமல் இருக்க வேண்டியவை.

translation:
Kingship, in virtue failing not, all vice restrains, In courage failing not, it honour's grace maintains

Meaning: He is a king who, with manly modesty, swerves not from virtue, and refrains from vice
pope_couplet: Kingship, in virtue failing not, all vice restrains, In courage failing not, it honour's grace maintains
explanation_en: He is a king who, with manly modesty, swerves not from virtue, and refrains from vice
explanation_ta: ஆட்சி முறைக்கு உரிய அறத்தில் தவறாமல் அறமல்லாதவற்றை நீக்கி வீரத்தில் குறைபடாத மானத்தை உடையவனே சிறந்த அரசன் ஆவான்.

translation:
A king is he who treasure gains, stores up, defends, And duly for his kingdom's weal expends

Meaning: He is a king who is able to acquire (wealth), to lay it up, to guard, and to distribute it
pope_couplet: A king is he who treasure gains, stores up, defends, And duly for his kingdom's weal expends
explanation_en: He is a king who is able to acquire (wealth), to lay it up, to guard, and to distribute it
explanation_ta: பொருள் வரும் வழிகளை மேன்மேலும் இயற்றலும் வந்த பொருள்களைச் சேர்த்தலும், காத்தலும் காத்தவற்றை வகுத்துச் செலவு செய்தலும் வல்லவன் அரசன்.

translation:
Where king is easy of access, where no harsh word repels, That land's high praises every subject swells

Meaning: The whole world will exalt the country of the king who is easy of access, and who is free from harsh language
pope_couplet: Where king is easy of access, where no harsh word repels, That land's high praises every subject swells
explanation_en: The whole world will exalt the country of the king who is easy of access, and who is free from harsh language
explanation_ta: காண்பதற்கு எளியவனாய்க் கடுஞ்சொல் கூறாதவாய் இருந்தால் அந்த மன்னனுடைய ஆட்சிக்கு உட்பட்ட நாட்டை உலகம் புகழும்.

translation:
With pleasant speech, who gives and guards with powerful liberal hand, He sees the world obedient all to his command

Meaning: The world will praise and submit itself to the mind of the king who is able to give with affability, and to protect all who come to him
pope_couplet: With pleasant speech, who gives and guards with powerful liberal hand, He sees the world obedient all to his command
explanation_en: The world will praise and submit itself to the mind of the king who is able to give with affability, and to protect all who come to him
explanation_ta: இனியச் சொற்களுடன் தக்கவர்க்குப் பொருளை உதவிக் காக்க வல்ல அரசனுக்கு இவ்வுலகம் தன் புகழோடு தான் கருதியபடி அமைவதாகும்.

translation:
Who guards the realm and justice strict maintains, That king as god o'er subject people reigns

Meaning: That king, will be esteemed a God among men, who performs his own duties, and protects (his subjects).
pope_couplet: Who guards the realm and justice strict maintains, That king as god o'er subject people reigns
explanation_en: That king, will be esteemed a God among men, who performs his own duties, and protects (his subjects).
explanation_ta: நீதி முறை செய்து குடிமக்களைக் காப்பாற்றும் மன்னவன், மக்களுக்கு தலைவன் என்றுக் கருதித் தனியே மதிக்கப்படுவான்.

translation:
The king of worth, who can words bitter to his ear endure, Beneath the shadow of his power the world abides secure

Meaning: The whole world will dwell under the umbrella of the king, who can bear words that embitter the ear
pope_couplet: The king of worth, who can words bitter to his ear endure, Beneath the shadow of his power the world abides secure
explanation_en: The whole world will dwell under the umbrella of the king, who can bear words that embitter the ear
explanation_ta: குறைகூறுவோறின் சொற்களைக் செவிகைக்கும் நிலையிலும் பொறுக்கின்ற பண்பும் உடைய அரசனது குடைநிழலில் உலகம் தங்கும்.

translation:
Gifts, grace, right sceptre, care of people's weal; These four a light of dreaded kings reveal

Meaning: He is the light of kings who has there four things, beneficence, benevolence, rectitude, and care for his people
pope_couplet: Gifts, grace, right sceptre, care of people's weal; These four a light of dreaded kings reveal
explanation_en: He is the light of kings who has there four things, beneficence, benevolence, rectitude, and care for his people
explanation_ta: கொடை, அருள், செங்கோல்முறை, தளர்ந்த குடிமக்களைக்காத்தல் ஆகிய நான்கும் உடைய அரசன், அரசர்க்கெல்லாம் விளக்குப் போன்றவன்.

translation:
So learn that you may full and faultless learning gain, Then in obedience meet to lessons learnt remain

Meaning: Let a man learn thoroughly whatever he may learn, and let his conduct be worthy of his learning
pope_couplet: So learn that you may full and faultless learning gain, Then in obedience meet to lessons learnt remain
explanation_en: Let a man learn thoroughly whatever he may learn, and let his conduct be worthy of his learning
explanation_ta: கல்வி கற்க நல்ல நூல்களைக் குற்றமறக் கற்க வேண்டும், அவ்வாறு கற்ற பிறகு, கற்ற கல்விக்கு தக்கவாறு நெறியில் நிற்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
The twain that lore of numbers and of letters giveAre eyes, the wise declare, to all on earth that live

Meaning: Letters and numbers are the two eyes of man
pope_couplet: The twain that lore of numbers and of letters giveAre eyes, the wise declare, to all on earth that live
explanation_en: Letters and numbers are the two eyes of man
explanation_ta: எண் என்று சொல்லப்படுவன எழுத்து என்று சொல்லப்படுவன ஆகிய இரு வகைக் கலைகளையும் வாழும் மக்களுக்குக் கண்கள் என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Men who learning gain have eyes, men say; Blockheads' faces pairs of sores display

Meaning: The learned are said to have eyes, but the unlearned have (merely) two sores in their face
pope_couplet: Men who learning gain have eyes, men say; Blockheads' faces pairs of sores display
explanation_en: The learned are said to have eyes, but the unlearned have (merely) two sores in their face
explanation_ta: கண்ணுடையவர் என்றுக் கூறப்படுபவர் கற்றவரே, கல்லாதவர் முகத்தில் இரண்டுப் புண் உடையவர் ஆவார்.

translation:
You meet with joy, with pleasant thought you part; Such is the learned scholar's wonderous art

Meaning: It is the part of the learned to give joy to those whom they meet, and on leaving, to make them think (Oh! when shall we meet them again.)
pope_couplet: You meet with joy, with pleasant thought you part; Such is the learned scholar's wonderous art
explanation_en: It is the part of the learned to give joy to those whom they meet, and on leaving, to make them think (Oh! when shall we meet them again.)
explanation_ta: மகிழும் படியாகக் கூடிபழகி (இனி இவரை எப்போது காண்போம் என்று ) வருந்தி நினைக்கும் படியாகப் பிரிதல் புலவரின் தொழிலாகும்.

translation:
With soul submiss they stand, as paupers front a rich man's face; Yet learned men are first; th'unlearned stand in lowest place

Meaning: The unlearned are inferior to the learned, before whom they stand begging, as the destitute before the wealthy
pope_couplet: With soul submiss they stand, as paupers front a rich man's face; Yet learned men are first; th'unlearned stand in lowest place
explanation_en: The unlearned are inferior to the learned, before whom they stand begging, as the destitute before the wealthy
explanation_ta: செல்வர் முன் வறியவர் நிற்பது போல் (கற்றவர்முன்) ஏங்கித் தாழ்ந்து நின்றும் கல்விக் கற்றவரே உயர்ந்தவர், கல்லாதவர் இழிந்தவர்.

translation:
In sandy soil, when deep you delve, you reach the springs below; The more you learn, the freer streams of wisdom flow

Meaning: Water will flow from a well in the sand in proportion to the depth to which it is dug, and knowledge will flow from a man in proportion to his learning
pope_couplet: In sandy soil, when deep you delve, you reach the springs below; The more you learn, the freer streams of wisdom flow
explanation_en: Water will flow from a well in the sand in proportion to the depth to which it is dug, and knowledge will flow from a man in proportion to his learning
explanation_ta: மணலில் உள்ள கேணியில் தோண்டிய அளவிற்க்கு நீர் ஊறும், அதுபோல் மக்களின் கற்றக் கல்வியின் அளவிற்கு அறிவு ஊறும்.

translation:
The learned make each land their own, in every city find a home; Who, till they die; learn nought, along what weary ways they roam

Meaning: How is it that any one can remain without learning, even to his death, when (to the learned man) every country is his own (country), and every town his own (town) ?
pope_couplet: The learned make each land their own, in every city find a home; Who, till they die; learn nought, along what weary ways they roam
explanation_en: How is it that any one can remain without learning, even to his death, when (to the learned man) every country is his own (country), and every town his own (town) ?
explanation_ta: கற்றவனுக்கு தன் நாடும் ஊரும் போல வேறு எதுவாயினும் நாடாகும், ஊராகும் ஆகையால் ஒருவன் சாகும் வரையில் கல்லாமல் காலங்கழிப்பது ஏன்.

translation:
The man who store of learning gains, In one, through seven worlds, bliss attains

Meaning: The learning, which a man has acquired in one birth, will yield him pleasure during seven births
pope_couplet: The man who store of learning gains, In one, through seven worlds, bliss attains
explanation_en: The learning, which a man has acquired in one birth, will yield him pleasure during seven births
explanation_ta: ஒரு பிறப்பில் தான் கற்றக் கல்வியானது அப்பிறப்பிற்கு மட்டும் அல்லாமல் அவனுக்கு ஏழுபிறப்பிறப்பிலும் உதவும் தன்மை உடையது.

translation:
Their joy is joy of all the world, they see; thus moreThe learners learn to love their cherished lore

Meaning: The learned will long (for more learning), when they see that while it gives pleasure to themselves, the world also derives pleasure from it
pope_couplet: Their joy is joy of all the world, they see; thus moreThe learners learn to love their cherished lore
explanation_en: The learned will long (for more learning), when they see that while it gives pleasure to themselves, the world also derives pleasure from it
explanation_ta: தாம் இன்புறுவதற்குக் காரணமான கல்வியால் உலகமும் இன்புறுவதைக் கண்டு, கற்றறிந்த அறிஞர் மேன்மேலும் (அக் கல்வியையே) விரும்புவர்.

translation:
Learning is excellence of wealth that none destroy; To man nought else affords reality of joy

Meaning: Learning is the true imperishable riches; all other things are not riches
pope_couplet: Learning is excellence of wealth that none destroy; To man nought else affords reality of joy
explanation_en: Learning is the true imperishable riches; all other things are not riches
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு அழிவு இல்லாத சிறந்த செல்வம் கல்வியே ஆகும், கல்வியைத் தவிர மற்றப் பொருள்கள் (அத்தகைய சிறப்புடைய) செல்வம் அல்ல.

translation:
Like those at draughts would play without the chequered square, Men void of ample lore would counsels of the learned share

Meaning: To speak in an assembly (of the learned) without fullness of knowledge, is like playing at chess (on a board) without squares
pope_couplet: Like those at draughts would play without the chequered square, Men void of ample lore would counsels of the learned share
explanation_en: To speak in an assembly (of the learned) without fullness of knowledge, is like playing at chess (on a board) without squares
explanation_ta: அறிவு நிரம்புவதற்குக் காரணமானக் நூல்களைக் கற்காமல் கற்றவரிடம் சென்று பேசதல், சூதாடும் அரங்கு இழைக்காமல் வட்டுக்காயை உருட்டிஆடினார் போன்றது.

translation:
Like those who doat on hoyden's undeveloped charms are they, Of learning void, who eagerly their power of words display

Meaning: The desire of the unlearned to speak (in an assembly), is like a woman without breasts desiring (the enjoyment of ) woman-hood
pope_couplet: Like those who doat on hoyden's undeveloped charms are they, Of learning void, who eagerly their power of words display
explanation_en: The desire of the unlearned to speak (in an assembly), is like a woman without breasts desiring (the enjoyment of ) woman-hood
explanation_ta: (கற்றவரின் அவையில்) கல்லாதவன் ஒன்றைச் சொல்ல விரும்புதல், முலை இரண்டும் இல்லாதவள் பெண் தன்மையை விரும்பினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
The blockheads, too, may men of worth appear, If they can keep from speaking where the learned hear

Meaning: The unlearned also are very excellent men, if they know how to keep silence before the learned
pope_couplet: The blockheads, too, may men of worth appear, If they can keep from speaking where the learned hear
explanation_en: The unlearned also are very excellent men, if they know how to keep silence before the learned
explanation_ta: கற்றவரின் முன்னிலையில் ஒன்றையும் சொல்லாமல் அமைதியாக இருக்கப் பெற்றால் கல்லாதவர்களும் மிகவும் நல்லவரே ஆவார்.

translation:
From blockheads' lips, when words of wisdom glibly flow, The wise receive them not, though good they seem to show

Meaning: Although the natural knowledge of an unlearned man may be very good, the wise will not accept for true knowledge
pope_couplet: From blockheads' lips, when words of wisdom glibly flow, The wise receive them not, though good they seem to show
explanation_en: Although the natural knowledge of an unlearned man may be very good, the wise will not accept for true knowledge
explanation_ta: கல்லாதவனுடைய அறிவுடைய ஒருக்கால் மிக நன்றாக இருந்தாலும் அறிவுடையோர் அதனை அறிவின் பகுதியாக ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள மாட்டார்.

translation:
As worthless shows the worth of man unlearned, When council meets, by words he speaks discerned

Meaning: The self-conceit of an unlearned man will fade away, as soon as he speaks in an assembly (of
pope_couplet: As worthless shows the worth of man unlearned, When council meets, by words he speaks discerned
explanation_en: The self-conceit of an unlearned man will fade away, as soon as he speaks in an assembly (of
explanation_ta: கல்லாதவன் ஒருவன் தன்னைத்தான் மகிழ்ந்து பேசும் மதிப்பு ( கற்றவரிடம்) கூடிபேசும் போது அப்பேசினால் கெடும்.

translation:
'They are': so much is true of men untaught; But, like a barren field, they yield us nought

Meaning: The unlearned are like worthless barren land: all that can be said of them is, that they exist
pope_couplet: 'They are': so much is true of men untaught; But, like a barren field, they yield us nought
explanation_en: The unlearned are like worthless barren land: all that can be said of them is, that they exist
explanation_ta: கல்லாதவர் உயிரோடிருக்கின்றனர் என்று சொல்லப்படும் அளவினரே அல்லாமல் ஒன்றும் விளையாத களர் நிலத்திற்கு ஒப்பாவர்.

translation:
Who lack the power of subtle, large, and penetrating sense, Like puppet, decked with ornaments of clay, their beauty's vain pretence

Meaning: The beauty and goodness of one who is destitute of knowledge by the study of great and exquisite works, is like (the beauty and goodness) of a painted earthen doll
pope_couplet: Who lack the power of subtle, large, and penetrating sense, Like puppet, decked with ornaments of clay, their beauty's vain pretence
explanation_en: The beauty and goodness of one who is destitute of knowledge by the study of great and exquisite works, is like (the beauty and goodness) of a painted earthen doll
explanation_ta: நுட்பமானதாய் மாட்சியுடையதாய் ஆராய வல்லவான அறிவு இல்லாதவனுடைய எழுச்சியான அழகு மண்ணால் சிறப்பாகப் புனையப்பட்ட பாவை போன்றது.

translation:
To men unlearned, from fortune's favour greater-evil springsThan poverty to men of goodly wisdom brings

Meaning: Wealth, gained by the unlearned, will give more sorrow than the poverty which may come upon the learned
pope_couplet: To men unlearned, from fortune's favour greater-evil springsThan poverty to men of goodly wisdom brings
explanation_en: Wealth, gained by the unlearned, will give more sorrow than the poverty which may come upon the learned
explanation_ta: கல்லாதவனிடம் சேர்ந்துள்ள செல்வமானது, கற்றறிந்த நல்லவரிடம் உள்ள வறுமையைவிட மிகத்துன்பம் செய்வதாகும்.

translation:
Lower are men unlearned, though noble be their race, Than low-born men adorned with learning's grace

Meaning: The unlearned, though born in a high caste, are not equal in dignity to the learned; though they may have been born in a low caste
pope_couplet: Lower are men unlearned, though noble be their race, Than low-born men adorned with learning's grace
explanation_en: The unlearned, though born in a high caste, are not equal in dignity to the learned; though they may have been born in a low caste
explanation_ta: கல்லாதவர் உயர்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்தவராக இருப்பினும் தாழ்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்திருந்தும் கல்விக் கற்றவரைப் போன்ற பெருமை இல்லாதவரே.

translation:
Learning's irradiating grace who gain, Others excel, as men the bestial train

Meaning: As beasts by the side of men, so are other men by the side of those who are learned in celebrated works
pope_couplet: Learning's irradiating grace who gain, Others excel, as men the bestial train
explanation_en: As beasts by the side of men, so are other men by the side of those who are learned in celebrated works
explanation_ta: அறிவு விளங்குதற்குக் காரணமான நூல்களைக் கற்றவரோடுக் கல்லாதவர், மக்களோடு விலங்குகளுக்கு உள்ள அவ்வளவு வேற்றுமை உடையவர்.

translation:
Wealth of wealth is wealth acquired be ear attent; Wealth mid all wealth supremely excellent

Meaning: Wealth (gained) by the ear is wealth of wealth; that wealth is the chief of all wealth
pope_couplet: Wealth of wealth is wealth acquired be ear attent; Wealth mid all wealth supremely excellent
explanation_en: Wealth (gained) by the ear is wealth of wealth; that wealth is the chief of all wealth
explanation_ta: செவியால் கேட்டறியும் செல்வம், செல்வங்களுள் ஒன்றாகப் போற்றப்படும் செல்வமாகும், அச் செல்வம் செல்வங்கள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் தலையானதாகும்.

translation:
When 'tis no longer time the listening ear to feedWith trifling dole of food supply the body's need

Meaning: When there is no food for the ear, give a little also to the stomach
pope_couplet: When 'tis no longer time the listening ear to feedWith trifling dole of food supply the body's need
explanation_en: When there is no food for the ear, give a little also to the stomach
explanation_ta: செவிக்கு கேள்வியாகிய உணவு இல்லாத போது (அதற்க்கு துணையாக உடலை ஒப்புமாறு) வயிற்றுக்கும் சிறிது உணவு தரப்படும்.

translation:
Who feed their ear with learned teachings rare, Are like the happy gods oblations rich who share

Meaning: Those who in this world enjoy instruction which is the food of the ear, are equal to the Gods, who enjoy the food of the sacrifices
pope_couplet: Who feed their ear with learned teachings rare, Are like the happy gods oblations rich who share
explanation_en: Those who in this world enjoy instruction which is the food of the ear, are equal to the Gods, who enjoy the food of the sacrifices
explanation_ta: செவியுணவாகிய கேள்வி உடையவர் நிலத்தில் வாழ்கின்றவரே ஆயினும் அவி உணவைக் கொள்ளும் தேவரோடு ஒப்பாவார்.

translation:
Though learning none hath he, yet let him hear alway:In weakness this shall prove a staff and stay

Meaning: Although a man be without learning, let him listen (to the teaching of the learned); that will be to him a staff in adversity
pope_couplet: Though learning none hath he, yet let him hear alway:In weakness this shall prove a staff and stay
explanation_en: Although a man be without learning, let him listen (to the teaching of the learned); that will be to him a staff in adversity
explanation_ta: நூல்களைக் கற்றவில்லையாயினும், கற்றறிந்தவர்களிடம் கேட்டறிய வேண்டும், அது ஒருவனுக்கு வாழ்க்கையில் தளர்ச்சி வந்த போது ஊன்றுகோல் போல் துணையாகும்.

translation:
Like staff in hand of him in slippery ground who straysAre words from mouth of those who walk in righteous ways

Meaning: The words of the good are like a staff in a slippery place
pope_couplet: Like staff in hand of him in slippery ground who straysAre words from mouth of those who walk in righteous ways
explanation_en: The words of the good are like a staff in a slippery place
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்கமுடைய சான்றோரின் வாய்ச் சொற்கள், வழுக்கல் உடைய சேற்று நிலத்தில் ஊன்றுகோல் போல் வாழ்க்கையில் உதவும்.

translation:
Let each man good things learn, for e'en as heShall learn, he gains increase of perfect dignity

Meaning: Let a man listen, never so little, to good (instruction), even that will bring him great dignity
pope_couplet: Let each man good things learn, for e'en as heShall learn, he gains increase of perfect dignity
explanation_en: Let a man listen, never so little, to good (instruction), even that will bring him great dignity
explanation_ta: எவ்வளவு சிறிதே ஆயினும் நல்லவற்றைக் கேட்டறிய வேண்டும், கேட்ட அந்த அளவிற்கு அவை நிறைந்த பெருமையைத் தரும்.

translation:
Not e'en through inadvertence speak they foolish word, With clear discerning mind who've learning's ample lessons heard

Meaning: Not even when they have imperfectly understood (a matter), will those men speak foolishly, who have profoundly studied and diligently listened (to instruction)
pope_couplet: Not e'en through inadvertence speak they foolish word, With clear discerning mind who've learning's ample lessons heard
explanation_en: Not even when they have imperfectly understood (a matter), will those men speak foolishly, who have profoundly studied and diligently listened (to instruction)
explanation_ta: நுட்பமாக உணர்ந்து நிறைந்த கேள்வியறிவை உடையவர், ( ஒரு கால் பொருள்களைத்) தவறாக உணர்ந்திருந்தாலும் பேதைமையானவற்றைச் சொல்லார்.

translation:
Where teaching hath not oped the learner's ear, The man may listen, but he scarce can hear

Meaning: The ear which has not been bored by instruction, although it hears, is deaf
pope_couplet: Where teaching hath not oped the learner's ear, The man may listen, but he scarce can hear
explanation_en: The ear which has not been bored by instruction, although it hears, is deaf
explanation_ta: கேள்வியறிவால் துளைக்கப் படாத செவிகள், ( இயற்கையான துளைகள் கொண்டு ஓசையைக்) கேட்டறிந்தாலும் கேளாத செவிட்டுத் தன்மை உடையனவே.

translation:
'Tis hard for mouth to utter gentle, modest word, When ears discourse of lore refined have never heard

Meaning: It is a rare thing to find modesty, a reverend mouth- with those who have not received choice instruction
pope_couplet: 'Tis hard for mouth to utter gentle, modest word, When ears discourse of lore refined have never heard
explanation_en: It is a rare thing to find modesty, a reverend mouth- with those who have not received choice instruction
explanation_ta: நுட்பமான பொருள்களைக் கேட்டறிந்தவர் அல்லாத மற்றவர், வணக்கமானச் சொற்களைப் பேசும் வாயினை உடையவராக முடியாது.

translation:
His mouth can taste, but ear no taste of joy can give!What matter if he die, or prosperous live

Meaning: What does it matter whether those men live or die, who can judge of tastes by the mouth, and not by the ear ?
pope_couplet: His mouth can taste, but ear no taste of joy can give!What matter if he die, or prosperous live
explanation_en: What does it matter whether those men live or die, who can judge of tastes by the mouth, and not by the ear ?
explanation_ta: செவியால் கேள்விச் சுவை உணராமல் வாயின் சுவையுணர்வு மட்டும் உடைய மக்கள், இறந்தாலும் என்ன, உயிரோடு வாழ்ந்தாலும் என்ன.

translation:
True wisdom wards off woes, A circling fortress high; Its inner strength man's eager foes Unshaken will defy

Meaning: Wisdom is a weapon to ward off destruction; it is an inner fortress which enemies cannot destroy
pope_couplet: True wisdom wards off woes, A circling fortress high; Its inner strength man's eager foes Unshaken will defy
explanation_en: Wisdom is a weapon to ward off destruction; it is an inner fortress which enemies cannot destroy
explanation_ta: அறிவு அழிவு வராமல் காக்கும் கருவியாகும், அன்றியும் பகைகொண்டு எதிர்ப்பவர்க்கும் அழிக்க முடியாத உள்ளரணும் ஆகும்.

translation:
Wisdom restrains, nor suffers mind to wander where it would; From every evil calls it back, and guides in way of good

Meaning: Not to permit the mind to go where it lists, to keep it from evil, and to employ it in good, this is wisdom
pope_couplet: Wisdom restrains, nor suffers mind to wander where it would; From every evil calls it back, and guides in way of good
explanation_en: Not to permit the mind to go where it lists, to keep it from evil, and to employ it in good, this is wisdom
explanation_ta: மனத்தை சென்ற இடத்தில் செல்லவிடாமல், தீமையானதிலிருந்து நீக்கிக் காத்து நன்மையானதில் செல்லவிடுவதே அறிவாகும்.

translation:
Though things diverse from divers sages' lips we learn,'Tis wisdom's part in each the true thing to discern

Meaning: To discern the truth in every thing, by whomsoever spoken, is wisdom
pope_couplet: Though things diverse from divers sages' lips we learn,'Tis wisdom's part in each the true thing to discern
explanation_en: To discern the truth in every thing, by whomsoever spoken, is wisdom
explanation_ta: எப்பொருளை யார் யார் இடம் கேட்டாலும் (கேட்டவாறே கொள்ளாமல்) அப் பொருளின் மெய்யானப் பொருளைக் காண்பதே அறிவாகும்.

translation:
Wisdom hath use of lucid speech, words that acceptance win, And subtle sense of other men's discourse takes in

Meaning: To speak so as that the meaning may easily enter the mind of the hearer, and to discern the subtlest thought which may lie hidden in the words of others, this is wisdom
pope_couplet: Wisdom hath use of lucid speech, words that acceptance win, And subtle sense of other men's discourse takes in
explanation_en: To speak so as that the meaning may easily enter the mind of the hearer, and to discern the subtlest thought which may lie hidden in the words of others, this is wisdom
explanation_ta: தான் சொல்லுவன எளிய பொருளையுடையனவாகப் பதியுமாறு சொல்லி, தான் பிறரிடம் கேட்பவற்றின் நுட்பமானப் பொருளையும் ஆராய்ந்து காண்பது அறிவாகும்.

translation:
Wisdom embraces frank the world, to no caprice exposed; Unlike the lotus flower, now opened wide, now petals strictly closed

Meaning: To secure the friendship of the great is true wisdom; it is (also) wisdom to keep (that friendship unchanged, and) not opening and closing (like the lotus flower)
pope_couplet: Wisdom embraces frank the world, to no caprice exposed; Unlike the lotus flower, now opened wide, now petals strictly closed
explanation_en: To secure the friendship of the great is true wisdom; it is (also) wisdom to keep (that friendship unchanged, and) not opening and closing (like the lotus flower)
explanation_ta: உலகத்து உயர்ந்தவரை நட்பாக்கி கொள்வது சிறந்த அறிவு, முன்னே மகிழ்ந்து விரிதலும் பின்னே வருந்திக் குவிதலும் இல்லாத அறிவு.

translation:
As dwells the world, so with the world to dwellIn harmony- this is to wisely live and well

Meaning: To live as the world lives, is wisdom
pope_couplet: As dwells the world, so with the world to dwellIn harmony- this is to wisely live and well
explanation_en: To live as the world lives, is wisdom
explanation_ta: உலகம் எவ்வாறு நடைபெறுகின்றதோ, உலகத்தோடு பொருந்திய வகையில் தானும் அவ்வாறு நடப்பதே அறிவாகும்.

translation:
The wise discern, the foolish fail to see, And minds prepare for things about to be

Meaning: The wise are those who know beforehand what will happen; those who do not know this are the unwise
pope_couplet: The wise discern, the foolish fail to see, And minds prepare for things about to be
explanation_en: The wise are those who know beforehand what will happen; those who do not know this are the unwise
explanation_ta: அறிவுடையோர் எதிர்காலத்தில் நிகழப்போவதை முன்னே எண்ணி அறியவல்லார், அறிவில்லாதவர் அதனை அறிய முடியாதவர்.

translation:
Folly meets fearful ills with fearless heart; To fear where cause of fear exists is wisdom's part

Meaning: Not to fear what ought to be feared, is folly; it is the work of the wise to fear what should be feared
pope_couplet: Folly meets fearful ills with fearless heart; To fear where cause of fear exists is wisdom's part
explanation_en: Not to fear what ought to be feared, is folly; it is the work of the wise to fear what should be feared
explanation_ta: அஞ்சத்தக்கதைக் கண்டு அஞ்சாதிருப்பது அறியாமையாகும், அஞ்சத் தக்கதைக் கண்டு அஞ்சுவதே அறிவுடையவரின் தொழிலாகும்.

translation:
The wise with watchful soul who coming ills foresee; From coming evil's dreaded shock are free

Meaning: No terrifying calamity will happen to the wise, who (foresee) and guard against coming evils
pope_couplet: The wise with watchful soul who coming ills foresee; From coming evil's dreaded shock are free
explanation_en: No terrifying calamity will happen to the wise, who (foresee) and guard against coming evils
explanation_ta: வரப்போவதை முன்னே அறிந்து காத்துக் கொள்ளவல்ல அறிவுடையவர்க்கு, அவர் நடுங்கும் படியாக வரக்கூடிய துன்பம் ஒன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
The wise is rich, with ev'ry blessing blest; The fool is poor, of everything possessed

Meaning: Those who possess wisdom, possess every thing; those who have not wisdom, whatever they may possess, have nothing
pope_couplet: The wise is rich, with ev'ry blessing blest; The fool is poor, of everything possessed
explanation_en: Those who possess wisdom, possess every thing; those who have not wisdom, whatever they may possess, have nothing
explanation_ta: அறிவுடையவர் (வேறொன்றும் இல்லாதிருப்பினும்) எல்லாம் உடையவரே ஆவர், அறிவில்லாதவர் வேறு என்ன உடையவராக இருப்பினும் ஒன்றும் இல்லாதவரே ஆவர்.

translation:
Who arrogance, and wrath, and littleness of low desire restrain, To sure increase of lofty dignity attain

Meaning: Truly great is the excellence of those (kings) who are free from pride, anger, and lust
pope_couplet: Who arrogance, and wrath, and littleness of low desire restrain, To sure increase of lofty dignity attain
explanation_en: Truly great is the excellence of those (kings) who are free from pride, anger, and lust
explanation_ta: செருக்கும் சினமும் காமமும் ஆகிய இந்தக் குற்றங்கள் இல்லாதவனுடைய வாழ்வில் காணும் பெருக்கம் மேம்பாடு உடையதாகும்.

translation:
A niggard hand, o'erweening self-regard, and mirthUnseemly, bring disgrace to men of kingly brith

Meaning: Avarice, undignified pride, and low pleasures are faults in a king
pope_couplet: A niggard hand, o'erweening self-regard, and mirthUnseemly, bring disgrace to men of kingly brith
explanation_en: Avarice, undignified pride, and low pleasures are faults in a king
explanation_ta: பொருள் கொடாத தன்மையும் மாட்சியில்லாத மானமும், தகுதியற்ற மகிழ்ச்சியும் தலைவனாக இருப்பனுக்கு குற்றங்களாகும்.

translation:
Though small as millet-seed the fault men deem; As palm tree vast to those who fear disgrace 'twill seem

Meaning: Those who fear guilt, if they commit a fault small as a millet seed, will consider it to be as large as a palmyra tree
pope_couplet: Though small as millet-seed the fault men deem; As palm tree vast to those who fear disgrace 'twill seem
explanation_en: Those who fear guilt, if they commit a fault small as a millet seed, will consider it to be as large as a palmyra tree
explanation_ta: பழி நாணுகின்ற பெருமக்கள் தினையளவாகிய சிறு குற்றம் நேர்ந்தாலும் அதை பனையளவாகக் கருதிக் (குற்றம் செய்யாமல்) காத்துக் கொள்வர்.

translation:
Freedom from faults is wealth; watch heedfully'Gainst these, for fault is fatal enmity

Meaning: Guard against faults as a matter (of great consequence; for) faults are a deadly enemy
pope_couplet: Freedom from faults is wealth; watch heedfully'Gainst these, for fault is fatal enmity
explanation_en: Guard against faults as a matter (of great consequence; for) faults are a deadly enemy
explanation_ta: குற்றமே ஒருவனுக்கு அழிவை உண்டாக்கும் பகையாகும், ஆகையால் குற்றம் செய்யாமல் இருப்பதே நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டு காத்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
His joy who guards not 'gainst the coming evil day, Like straw before the fire shall swift consume away

Meaning: The prosperity of him who does not timely guard against faults, will perish like straw before fire
pope_couplet: His joy who guards not 'gainst the coming evil day, Like straw before the fire shall swift consume away
explanation_en: The prosperity of him who does not timely guard against faults, will perish like straw before fire
explanation_ta: குற்றம் நேர்வதற்கு முன்னமே வராமல் காத்துக் கொள்ளாதவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை, நெருப்பின் முன் நின்ற வைக்கோல் போர் போல் அழிந்துவிடும்.

translation:
Faultless the king who first his own faults cures, and thenPermits himself to scan faults of other men

Meaning: What fault will remain in the king who has put away his own evils, and looks after the evils of others
pope_couplet: Faultless the king who first his own faults cures, and thenPermits himself to scan faults of other men
explanation_en: What fault will remain in the king who has put away his own evils, and looks after the evils of others
explanation_ta: முன்னே தன் குற்றத்தைக் கண்டு நீக்கி பிறகு பிறருடையக் குற்றத்தை ஆராயவல்லவனானால், தலைவனுக்கு என்ன குற்றமாகும்.

translation:
Who leaves undone what should be done, with niggard mind, His wealth shall perish, leaving not a wrack behind

Meaning: The wealth of the avaricious man, who does not expend it for the purposes for which he ought to expend it will waste away and not continue
pope_couplet: Who leaves undone what should be done, with niggard mind, His wealth shall perish, leaving not a wrack behind
explanation_en: The wealth of the avaricious man, who does not expend it for the purposes for which he ought to expend it will waste away and not continue
explanation_ta: செய்யத்தக்க நன்மைகளைச் செய்யாமல் பொருளைச் சேர்த்து வைத்திருப்பவனுடைய செல்வம், உய்யுந் தன்மை இல்லாமல் அழியும்.

translation:
The greed of soul that avarice men call, When faults are summed, is worst of all

Meaning: Griping avarice is not to be reckoned as one among other faults; (it stands alone - greater than all)
pope_couplet: The greed of soul that avarice men call, When faults are summed, is worst of all
explanation_en: Griping avarice is not to be reckoned as one among other faults; (it stands alone - greater than all)
explanation_ta: பொருளினிடத்தில் பற்றுக் கொள்ளும் உள்ளமாகிய ஈயாத்தன்மை, குற்றம் எதனோடும் சேர்ந்து எண்ணத்தகாத ஒரு தனிக் குற்றமாகும்.

translation:
Never indulge in self-complaisant mood, Nor deed desire that yields no gain of good

Meaning: Let no (one) praise himself, at any time; let him not desire to do useless things
pope_couplet: Never indulge in self-complaisant mood, Nor deed desire that yields no gain of good
explanation_en: Let no (one) praise himself, at any time; let him not desire to do useless things
explanation_ta: எக்காலத்திலும் தன்னை மிக உயர்வாக எண்ணி வியந்து மதிக்கக் கூடாது, நன்மை தராத செயலைத்தான் விரும்பவும் கூடாது.

translation:
If, to your foes unknown, you cherish what you love, Counsels of men who wish you harm will harmless prove

Meaning: If (a king) enjoys, privately the things which he desires, the designs of his enemies will be useless
pope_couplet: If, to your foes unknown, you cherish what you love, Counsels of men who wish you harm will harmless prove
explanation_en: If (a king) enjoys, privately the things which he desires, the designs of his enemies will be useless
explanation_ta: தன் விருப்பம் பிறர்க்கு தெரியாதபடி விருப்பமான வற்றை நுகர வல்லவனானால், பகைவர் தன்னை வஞ்சிப்பதற்காகச் செய்யும் சூழ்ச்சிகள் பலிக்காமல் போகும்.

translation:
As friends the men who virtue know, and riper wisdom share, Their worth weighed well, the king should choose with care

Meaning: Let (a king) ponder well its value, and secure the friendship of men of virtue and of mature knowledge
pope_couplet: As friends the men who virtue know, and riper wisdom share, Their worth weighed well, the king should choose with care
explanation_en: Let (a king) ponder well its value, and secure the friendship of men of virtue and of mature knowledge
explanation_ta: அறம் உணர்ந்தவராய்த் தன்னை விட மூத்தவராய் உள்ள அறிவுடையவரின் நட்பை, கொள்ளும் வகை அறிந்து ஆராய்ந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
Cherish the all-accomplished men as friends, Whose skill the present ill removes, from coming ill defends

Meaning: Let (a king) procure and kindly care for men who can overcome difficulties when they occur, and guard against them before they happen
pope_couplet: Cherish the all-accomplished men as friends, Whose skill the present ill removes, from coming ill defends
explanation_en: Let (a king) procure and kindly care for men who can overcome difficulties when they occur, and guard against them before they happen
explanation_ta: வந்துள்ள துன்பத்தை நீக்கி, இனித் துன்பம் வராதபடி முன்னதாகவே காக்கவல்ல தன்மையுடையவரைப் போற்றி நட்புக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
To cherish men of mighty soul, and make them all their own, Of kingly treasures rare, as rarest gift is known

Meaning: To cherish great men and make them his own, is the most difficult of all difficult things
pope_couplet: To cherish men of mighty soul, and make them all their own, Of kingly treasures rare, as rarest gift is known
explanation_en: To cherish great men and make them his own, is the most difficult of all difficult things
explanation_ta: பெரியாரைப் போற்றி தமக்குச் சுற்றத்தாராக்கிக் கொள்ளுதல், பெறத்தக்க அரிய பேறுகள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் அருமையானதாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
To live with men of greatness that their own excels, As cherished friends, is greatest power that with a monarch dwells

Meaning: So to act as to make those men, his own, who are greater than himself is of all powers the highest
pope_couplet: To live with men of greatness that their own excels, As cherished friends, is greatest power that with a monarch dwells
explanation_en: So to act as to make those men, his own, who are greater than himself is of all powers the highest
explanation_ta: தம்மைவிட (அறிவு முதலியவற்றால் ) பெரியவர் தமக்குச் சுற்றத்தராகுமாறு நடத்தல், வல்லமை எல்லாவற்றிலும் சிறந்ததாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
The king, since counsellors are monarch's eyes, Should counsellors select with counsel wise

Meaning: As a king must use his ministers as eyes (in managing his kingdom), let him well examine their character and qualifications before he engages them
pope_couplet: The king, since counsellors are monarch's eyes, Should counsellors select with counsel wise
explanation_en: As a king must use his ministers as eyes (in managing his kingdom), let him well examine their character and qualifications before he engages them
explanation_ta: தக்க வழிகளை ஆராய்ந்து கூறும் அறிஞரையே உலகம் கண்ணாகக் கொண்டு நடத்தலால், மன்னவனும் அத்தகையாரைக் ஆராய்ந்து நட்புக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
The king, who knows to live with worthy men allied, Has nought to fear from any foeman's pride

Meaning: There will be nothing left for enemies to do, against him who has the power of acting (so as to secure) the fellowship of worthy men
pope_couplet: The king, who knows to live with worthy men allied, Has nought to fear from any foeman's pride
explanation_en: There will be nothing left for enemies to do, against him who has the power of acting (so as to secure) the fellowship of worthy men
explanation_ta: தக்க பெரியாரின் கூட்டத்தில் உள்ளனவாய் நடக்கவல்ல ஒருவனுக்கு,அவனுடைய பகைவர் செய்யக்கூடியத் தீங்கு ஒன்றும் இல்லை.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
What power can work his fall, who faithful ministersEmploys, that thunder out reproaches when he errs

Meaning: Who are great enough to destroy him who has servants that have power to rebuke him ?
pope_couplet: What power can work his fall, who faithful ministersEmploys, that thunder out reproaches when he errs
explanation_en: Who are great enough to destroy him who has servants that have power to rebuke him ?
explanation_ta: கடிந்து அறிவுரைக் கூறவல்ல பெரியாரின் துணை கொண்டு நடப்பவரை கெடுக்கும் ஆற்றல் உள்ளவர் எவர் இருக்கின்றனர்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
The king with none to censure him, bereft of safeguards all, Though none his ruin work, shall surely ruined fall

Meaning: The king, who is without the guard of men who can rebuke him, will perish, even though there be no one to destroy him
pope_couplet: The king with none to censure him, bereft of safeguards all, Though none his ruin work, shall surely ruined fall
explanation_en: The king, who is without the guard of men who can rebuke him, will perish, even though there be no one to destroy him
explanation_ta: கடிந்து அறிவுரைக் கூறும் பெரியாரின் துணை இல்லாதக் காவலற்ற அரசன், தன்னைக் கெடுக்ககும் பகைவர் எவரும் இல்லாவிட்டாலும் கெடுவான்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
Who owns no principal, can have no gain of usury; Who lacks support of friends, knows no stability

Meaning: There can be no gain to those who have no capital; and in like manner there can be no permanence to
pope_couplet: Who owns no principal, can have no gain of usury; Who lacks support of friends, knows no stability
explanation_en: There can be no gain to those who have no capital; and in like manner there can be no permanence to
explanation_ta: முதல் இல்லாத வணிகர்க்கு அதனால் வரும் ஊதியம் இல்லை, அதுபோல் தம்மைத் தாங்கிக் காப்பாற்றும் துணை இல்லாதவர்க்கு நிலைபேறு இல்லை.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
Than hate of many foes incurred, works greater woeTen-fold, of worthy men the friendship to forego

Meaning: It is tenfold more injurious to abandon the friendship of the good, than to incur the hatred of the many
pope_couplet: Than hate of many foes incurred, works greater woeTen-fold, of worthy men the friendship to forego
explanation_en: It is tenfold more injurious to abandon the friendship of the good, than to incur the hatred of the many
explanation_ta: நல்லவராகிய பெரியாரின் தொடர்பைக் கைவிடுதல் பலருடைய பகையைத் தேடிக்கொள்வதைவிடப் பத்து மடங்கு தீமை உடையதாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Seeking the Aid of Great Men

translation:
The great of soul will mean association fear; The mean of soul regard mean men as kinsmen dear

Meaning: (True) greatness fears the society of the base; it is only the low - minded who will regard them as friends
pope_couplet: The great of soul will mean association fear; The mean of soul regard mean men as kinsmen dear
explanation_en: (True) greatness fears the society of the base; it is only the low - minded who will regard them as friends
explanation_ta: பெரியோரின் இயல்பு சிற்றினத்தை அஞ்சி ஒதுக்கும், சிறியோரின் இயல்பு அதையே சுற்றமாக எண்ணித் தழுவிக் கொள்ளும்.

translation:
The waters' virtues change with soil through which they flow; As man's companionship so will his wisdom show

Meaning: As water changes (its nature), from the nature of the soil (in which it flows), so will the character of men resemble that of their associates
pope_couplet: The waters' virtues change with soil through which they flow; As man's companionship so will his wisdom show
explanation_en: As water changes (its nature), from the nature of the soil (in which it flows), so will the character of men resemble that of their associates
explanation_ta: சேர்ந்த நிலத்தின் இயல்பால் அந்த நீர் வேறுபட்டு அந் நிலத்தின் தன்மையுடையதாகும், அதுபோல் மக்களுடைய அறிவு இனத்தின் இயல்பினை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
Perceptions manifold in men are of the mind alone; The value of the man by his companionship is known

Meaning: The power of knowing is from the mind; (but) his character is from that of his associates
pope_couplet: Perceptions manifold in men are of the mind alone; The value of the man by his companionship is known
explanation_en: The power of knowing is from the mind; (but) his character is from that of his associates
explanation_ta: மக்களுக்கு இயற்கையறிவு மனத்தால் ஏற்படும், இப்படிப் பட்டவன் என்று உலகத்தாரால் மதிக்கப்படும் சொல், சேர்ந்த இனத்தால் ஏற்படும்.

translation:
Man's wisdom seems the offspring of his mind;'Tis outcome of companionship we find

Meaning: Wisdom appears to rest in the mind, but it really exists to a man in his companions
pope_couplet: Man's wisdom seems the offspring of his mind;'Tis outcome of companionship we find
explanation_en: Wisdom appears to rest in the mind, but it really exists to a man in his companions
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு சிறப்பறிவு மனத்தில் உள்ளது போலக் காட்டி (உண்மையாக நோக்கும் போது) அவன் சேர்ந்த இனத்தில் உள்ளதாகும்.

translation:
Both purity of mind, and purity of action clear, Leaning no staff of pure companionship, to man draw near

Meaning: Chaste company is the staff on which come, these two things, viz, purity of mind and purity of conduct
pope_couplet: Both purity of mind, and purity of action clear, Leaning no staff of pure companionship, to man draw near
explanation_en: Chaste company is the staff on which come, these two things, viz, purity of mind and purity of conduct
explanation_ta: மனத்தின் தூய்மை செய்யும் செயலின் தூய்மை ஆகிய இவ்விரண்டும் சேர்ந்த இனத்தின் தூய்மையைப் பொறுத்தே ஏற்ப்படும்.

translation:
From true pure-minded men a virtuous race proceeds; To men of pure companionship belong no evil deeds

Meaning: To the pure-minded there will be a good posterity By those whose associates are pure, no deeds will be done that are not good
pope_couplet: From true pure-minded men a virtuous race proceeds; To men of pure companionship belong no evil deeds
explanation_en: To the pure-minded there will be a good posterity By those whose associates are pure, no deeds will be done that are not good
explanation_ta: மனம் தூய்மையாகப் பெற்றவர்க்கு , அவர்க்குப் பின் எஞ்சி நிற்கும் புகழ் முதலியவை நன்மையாகும், இனம் தூய்மையாக உள்ளவர்க்கு நன்மையாகாத செயல் இல்லை.

translation:
Goodness of mind to lives of men increaseth gain; And good companionship doth all of praise obtain

Meaning: Goodness of mind will give wealth, and good society will bring with it all praise, to men
pope_couplet: Goodness of mind to lives of men increaseth gain; And good companionship doth all of praise obtain
explanation_en: Goodness of mind will give wealth, and good society will bring with it all praise, to men
explanation_ta: மனதின் நன்மை உயிர்க்கு ஆக்கமாகும், இனத்தின் தன்மை (அவ்வளவோடு நிற்காமல்) எல்லாப் புகழையும் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
To perfect men, though minds right good belong, Yet good companionship is confirmation strong

Meaning: Yet good companionship is confirmation strong
pope_couplet: To perfect men, though minds right good belong, Yet good companionship is confirmation strong
explanation_en: Yet good companionship is confirmation strong
explanation_ta: மனதின் நன்மையை உறுதியாக உடையவராயினும் சான்றோர்க்கு இனத்தின் நன்மை மேலும் நல்ல காவலாக அமையும்.

translation:
Although to mental goodness joys of other life belong, Yet good companionship is confirmation strong

Meaning: Future bliss is (the result) of goodness of mind; and even this acquires strength from the society of the good
pope_couplet: Although to mental goodness joys of other life belong, Yet good companionship is confirmation strong
explanation_en: Future bliss is (the result) of goodness of mind; and even this acquires strength from the society of the good
explanation_ta: மனத்தின் நன்மையால் மறுமை இன்பம் உண்டாகும், அதுவும் இனத்தின் நன்மையால் மேலும் சிறப்புடையதாகும்.

translation:
Than good companionship no surer help we know; Than bad companionship nought causes direr woe

Meaning: There is no greater help than the company of the good; there is no greater source of sorrow than the company of the wicked
pope_couplet: Than good companionship no surer help we know; Than bad companionship nought causes direr woe
explanation_en: There is no greater help than the company of the good; there is no greater source of sorrow than the company of the wicked
explanation_ta: நல்ல இனத்தைவிடச் சிறந்ததாகிய துணையும் உலகத்தில் இல்லை, தீய இனத்தைவிடத் துன்பப்படுத்தும் பகையும் இல்லை.

translation:
Expenditure, return, and profit of the deedIn time to come; weigh these- than to the act proceed

Meaning: Let a man reflect on what will be lost, what will be acquired and (from these) what will be his ultimate gain, and (then, let him) act
pope_couplet: Expenditure, return, and profit of the deedIn time to come; weigh these- than to the act proceed
explanation_en: Let a man reflect on what will be lost, what will be acquired and (from these) what will be his ultimate gain, and (then, let him) act
explanation_ta: (ஒரு செயலைத் தொடங்குமுன்) அதனால் அழிவதையும் அழிந்த பின் ஆவதையும், பின்பு உண்டாகும் ஊதியத்தையும் ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
With chosen friends deliberate; next use the private thought; Then act By those who thus proceed all works with ease are wrought

Meaning: There is nothing too difficult to (be attained by) those who, before they act, reflect well themselves, and thoroughly consider (the matter) with chosen friends
pope_couplet: With chosen friends deliberate; next use the private thought; Then act By those who thus proceed all works with ease are wrought
explanation_en: There is nothing too difficult to (be attained by) those who, before they act, reflect well themselves, and thoroughly consider (the matter) with chosen friends
explanation_ta: ஆராய்ந்து சேர்ந்த இனத்துடன் (செயலைப்பற்றி) நன்றாகத் தேர்ந்து, தாமும் எண்ணிப்பார்த்துச் செய்கின்றவர்க்கு அறிய பொருள் ஒன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
To risk one's all and lose, aiming at added gain, Is rash affair, from which the wise abstain

Meaning: Wise men will not, in the hopes of profit, undertake works that will consume their principal
pope_couplet: To risk one's all and lose, aiming at added gain, Is rash affair, from which the wise abstain
explanation_en: Wise men will not, in the hopes of profit, undertake works that will consume their principal
explanation_ta: பின் விளையும் ஊதியத்தைக் கருதி இப்போது கையில் உள்ள முதலை இழந்து விடக் காரணமாச் செயலை அறிவுடையோர் மேற்க்கொள்ள மாட்டார்.

translation:
A work of which the issue is not clear, Begin not they reproachful scorn who fear

Meaning: Those who fear reproach will not commence anything which has not been (thoroughly considered) and made clear to them
pope_couplet: A work of which the issue is not clear, Begin not they reproachful scorn who fear
explanation_en: Those who fear reproach will not commence anything which has not been (thoroughly considered) and made clear to them
explanation_ta: இழிவு தருவதாகியக் குற்றத்திற்கு அஞ்சுகின்றவர் (இன்ன ஊதியம் பயிக்கும் என்னும்) தெளிவு இல்லாத செயலைத் தொடங்கமாட்டார்.

translation:
With plans not well matured to rise against your foe, Is way to plant him out where he is sure to grow

Meaning: One way to promote the prosperity of an enemy, is (for a king) to set out (to war) without having thoroughly weighed his ability (to cope with its chances)
pope_couplet: With plans not well matured to rise against your foe, Is way to plant him out where he is sure to grow
explanation_en: One way to promote the prosperity of an enemy, is (for a king) to set out (to war) without having thoroughly weighed his ability (to cope with its chances)
explanation_ta: செயலின் வகைகளை எல்லாம் முற்ற எண்ணாமல் செய்யத்தொடங்குதல், பகைவரை வளரும் பாத்தியில் நிலைபெறச் செய்வதொரு வழியாகும்.

translation:
'Tis ruin if man do an unbefitting thing; Fit things to leave undone will equal ruin bring

Meaning: He will perish who does not what is not fit to do; and he also will perish who does not do what it is fit to
pope_couplet: 'Tis ruin if man do an unbefitting thing; Fit things to leave undone will equal ruin bring
explanation_en: He will perish who does not what is not fit to do; and he also will perish who does not do what it is fit to
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் செய்யத்தகாத செயல்களைச் செய்வதனால் கெடுவான், செய்யத்தக்க செயல்களை செய்யாமல் விடுவதனாலும் கெடுவான்.

translation:
Think, and then dare the deed! Who cry,'Deed dared, we'll think,' disgraced shall be

Meaning: Consider, and then undertake a matter; after having undertaken it, to say "We will consider," is folly
pope_couplet: Think, and then dare the deed! Who cry,'Deed dared, we'll think,' disgraced shall be
explanation_en: Consider, and then undertake a matter; after having undertaken it, to say "We will consider," is folly
explanation_ta: (செய்யத் தகுந்த) செயலையும் வழிகளை எண்ணிய பிறகே துணிந்து தொடங்க வேண்டும், துணிந்த பின் எண்ணிப் பார்க்கலாம் என்பது குற்றமாகும்.

translation:
On no right system if man toil and strive, Though many men assist, no work can thrive

Meaning: The work, which is not done by suitable methods, will fail though many stand to uphold it
pope_couplet: On no right system if man toil and strive, Though many men assist, no work can thrive
explanation_en: The work, which is not done by suitable methods, will fail though many stand to uphold it
explanation_ta: தக்கவழியில் செய்யப்படாத முயற்சி பலர் துணையாக நின்று(அதை முடிக்குமாறு) காத்த போதிலும் குறையாகிவிடும்.

translation:
Though well the work be done, yet one mistake is made, To habitudes of various men when no regard is paid

Meaning: There are failures even in acting well, when it is done without knowing the various dispositions of men
pope_couplet: Though well the work be done, yet one mistake is made, To habitudes of various men when no regard is paid
explanation_en: There are failures even in acting well, when it is done without knowing the various dispositions of men
explanation_ta: அவரவருடைய இயல்புகளை அறிந்து அவரவருக்குப் பொருந்துமாறு செய்யாவிட்டால், நன்மை செய்வதிலும் தவறு உண்டாகும்.

translation:
Plan and perform no work that others may despise; What misbeseems a king the world will not approve as wise

Meaning: Let a man reflect, and do things which bring no reproach; the world will not approve, with him, of things which do not become of his position to adopt
pope_couplet: Plan and perform no work that others may despise; What misbeseems a king the world will not approve as wise
explanation_en: Let a man reflect, and do things which bring no reproach; the world will not approve, with him, of things which do not become of his position to adopt
explanation_ta: தம் நிலையோடு பொருந்தாதவற்றை உலகம் ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளாது, ஆகையால் உலகம் இகழ்ந்து தள்ளாத செயல்களை ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
The force the strife demands, the force he owns, the force of foes, The force of friends; these should he weigh ere to the war he goes

Meaning: Let (one) weigh well the strength of the deed (he purposes to do), his own strength, the strength of his enemy, and the strength of the allies (of both), and then let him act
pope_couplet: The force the strife demands, the force he owns, the force of foes, The force of friends; these should he weigh ere to the war he goes
explanation_en: Let (one) weigh well the strength of the deed (he purposes to do), his own strength, the strength of his enemy, and the strength of the allies (of both), and then let him act
explanation_ta: செயலின் வலிமையும் தன் வலிமையும் பகைவனுடைய வலிமையும் ,இருவருக்கும் துணையானவரின் வலிமையும் ஆராய்ந்து செயல்பட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who know what can be wrought, with knowledge of the means, on this, Their mind firm set, go forth, nought goes with them amiss

Meaning: There is nothing which may not be accomplished by those who, before they attack (an enemy), make themselves acquainted with their own ability, and with whatever else is (needful) to be known, and
pope_couplet: Who know what can be wrought, with knowledge of the means, on this, Their mind firm set, go forth, nought goes with them amiss
explanation_en: There is nothing which may not be accomplished by those who, before they attack (an enemy), make themselves acquainted with their own ability, and with whatever else is (needful) to be known, and
explanation_ta: தனக்குப் பொருந்தும் செயலையும் அதற்காக அறிய வேண்டியதையும் அறிந்து அதனிடம் நிலைத்து முயல்கின்றவர்க்கு முடியாதது ஒன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
Ill-deeming of their proper powers, have many monarchs striven, And midmost of unequal conflict fallen asunder riven

Meaning: There are many who, ignorant of their (want of) power (to meet it), have haughtily set out to war, and broken down in the midst of it
pope_couplet: Ill-deeming of their proper powers, have many monarchs striven, And midmost of unequal conflict fallen asunder riven
explanation_en: There are many who, ignorant of their (want of) power (to meet it), have haughtily set out to war, and broken down in the midst of it
explanation_ta: தன்னுடைய வலிமை இவ்வளவு என அறியாமல் ஊக்கத்தால் முனைந்து தொடங்கி இடையில் அதை முடிக்க வகையில்லாமல் அழிந்தவர் பலர்.

translation:
Who not agrees with those around, no moderation knows, In self-applause indulging, swift to ruin goes

Meaning: He will quickly perish who, ignorant of his own resources flatters himself of his greatness, and does
pope_couplet: Who not agrees with those around, no moderation knows, In self-applause indulging, swift to ruin goes
explanation_en: He will quickly perish who, ignorant of his own resources flatters himself of his greatness, and does
explanation_ta: மற்றவர்களோடு ஒத்து நடக்காமல், தன் வலிமையின் அளவையும் அறியாமல், தன்னை வியந்து மதித்துக் கொண்டிருப்பவன் விரைவில் கெடுவான்.

translation:
With peacock feathers light, you load the wain; Yet, heaped too high, the axle snaps in twain

Meaning: The axle tree of a bandy, loaded only with peacocks' feathers will break, if it be greatly overloaded
pope_couplet: With peacock feathers light, you load the wain; Yet, heaped too high, the axle snaps in twain
explanation_en: The axle tree of a bandy, loaded only with peacocks' feathers will break, if it be greatly overloaded
explanation_ta: மயிலிறகு ஏற்றிய வண்டியே ஆனாலும் , அந்த பண்டமும் (அளவோடு ஏற்றாமல்) அளவு கடந்து மிகுதியாக ஏற்றினால் அச்சு முறியும்.

translation:
Who daring climbs, and would himself upraiseBeyond the branch's tip, with life the forfeit pays

Meaning: There will be an end to the life of him who, having climbed out to the end of a branch, ventures to go further
pope_couplet: Who daring climbs, and would himself upraiseBeyond the branch's tip, with life the forfeit pays
explanation_en: There will be an end to the life of him who, having climbed out to the end of a branch, ventures to go further
explanation_ta: ஒரு மரத்தின் நுனிக்கொம்பில் ஏறியவர், அதையும் கடந்து மேலே ஏற முனைந்தால், அவருடைய உயிர்க்கு முடிவாக நேர்ந்துவிடும்.

translation:
With knowledge of the measure due, as virtue bids you give!That is the way to guard your wealth, and seemly live

Meaning: Let a man know the measure of his ability (to give), and let him give accordingly; such giving is the way to preserve his property
pope_couplet: With knowledge of the measure due, as virtue bids you give!That is the way to guard your wealth, and seemly live
explanation_en: Let a man know the measure of his ability (to give), and let him give accordingly; such giving is the way to preserve his property
explanation_ta: தக்க வழியில் பிறர்க்கு கொடுக்கும் அளவு அறிந்து வாழாதவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை (பல வளமும்) இருப்பது போல் தோன்றி இல்லாமல் மறைந்து விடும்.

translation:
Incomings may be scant; but yet, no failure there, If in expenditure you rightly learn to spare

Meaning: Even though the income (of a king) be small, it will not cause his (ruin), if his outgoings be not larger than his income
pope_couplet: Incomings may be scant; but yet, no failure there, If in expenditure you rightly learn to spare
explanation_en: Even though the income (of a king) be small, it will not cause his (ruin), if his outgoings be not larger than his income
explanation_ta: பொருள் வரும் வழி (வருவாய்) சிறிதாக இருந்தாலும், போகும் வழி (செலவு) விரிவுபடாவிட்டால் அதனால் தீங்கு இல்லை.

translation:
Who prosperous lives and of enjoyment knows no bound, His seeming wealth, departing, nowhere shall be found

Meaning: The prosperity of him who lives without knowing the measure (of his property), will perish, even while it seems to continue
pope_couplet: Who prosperous lives and of enjoyment knows no bound, His seeming wealth, departing, nowhere shall be found
explanation_en: The prosperity of him who lives without knowing the measure (of his property), will perish, even while it seems to continue
explanation_ta: பொருளின் அளவு அறிந்து வாழாதவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை (பல வளமும்) இருப்பது போல் தோன்றி இல்லாமல் மறைந்து கெட்டு விடும்.

translation:
Beneficence that measures not its bound of means, Will swiftly bring to nought the wealth on which it leans

Meaning: The measure of his wealth will quickly perish, whose liberality weighs not the measure of his property
pope_couplet: Beneficence that measures not its bound of means, Will swiftly bring to nought the wealth on which it leans
explanation_en: The measure of his wealth will quickly perish, whose liberality weighs not the measure of his property
explanation_ta: தனக்கு பொருள் உள்ள அளவை ஆராயாமல் மேற்கொள்ளும் ஒப்புரவினால், ஒருவனுடைய செல்வத்தின் அளவு விரைவில் கெடும்.

translation:
A crow will conquer owl in broad daylight; The king that foes would crush, needs fitting time to fight

Meaning: A crow will overcome an owl in the day time; so the king who would conquer his enemy must have (a suitable) time
pope_couplet: A crow will conquer owl in broad daylight; The king that foes would crush, needs fitting time to fight
explanation_en: A crow will overcome an owl in the day time; so the king who would conquer his enemy must have (a suitable) time
explanation_ta: காக்கை தன்னைவிட வலிய கோட்டானைப் பகலில் வென்றுவிடும், அதுபோல் பகையை வெல்லக்கருதும் அரசர்க்கும் அதற்கு ஏற்ற காலம் வேண்டும்.

translation:
The bond binds fortune fast is ordered effort made, Strictly observant still of favouring season's aid

Meaning: Acting at the right season, is a cord that will immoveably bind success (to a king)
pope_couplet: The bond binds fortune fast is ordered effort made, Strictly observant still of favouring season's aid
explanation_en: Acting at the right season, is a cord that will immoveably bind success (to a king)
explanation_ta: காலத்தோடுப் பொருந்துமாறு ஆராய்ந்து நடத்தல் ( நில்லாத இயல்பு உடைய) செல்வத்தை நீங்காமல் நிற்குமாறு கட்டும் கயிறாகும்.

translation:
Can any work be hard in very fact, If men use fitting means in timely act

Meaning: Is there anything difficult for him to do, who acts, with (the right) instruments at the right time ?
pope_couplet: Can any work be hard in very fact, If men use fitting means in timely act
explanation_en: Is there anything difficult for him to do, who acts, with (the right) instruments at the right time ?
explanation_ta: (செய்யும் செயலை முடிப்பதற்கு வேண்டிய) கருவிகளுடன் ஏற்றக் காலத்தையும் அறிந்து செய்தால் அரிய செயல்கள் என்பது உண்டோ.

translation:
The pendant world's dominion may be won, In fitting time and place by action done

Meaning: Though (a man) should meditate (the conquest of) the world, he may accomplish it if he acts in the right time, and at the right place
pope_couplet: The pendant world's dominion may be won, In fitting time and place by action done
explanation_en: Though (a man) should meditate (the conquest of) the world, he may accomplish it if he acts in the right time, and at the right place
explanation_ta: (செயலை முடிப்பதற்கு ஏற்ற) காலத்தை அறிந்து இடத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு செய்தால், உலகமே வேண்டும் எனக் கருதினாலும் கைகூடும்.

translation:
Who think the pendant world itself to subjugate, With mind unruffled for the fitting time must wait

Meaning: They who thoughtfully consider and wait for the (right) time (for action), may successfully meditate (the conquest of) the world
pope_couplet: Who think the pendant world itself to subjugate, With mind unruffled for the fitting time must wait
explanation_en: They who thoughtfully consider and wait for the (right) time (for action), may successfully meditate (the conquest of) the world
explanation_ta: உலகத்தைக் கொள்ளக் கருதிகின்றவர் அதைப்பற்றி எண்ணிக் கலங்காமல் அதற்கு ஏற்ற காலத்தைக் கருதிக்கொண்டு பொறுத்திருப்பர்.

translation:
The men of mighty power their hidden energies repress, As fighting ram recoils to rush on foe with heavier stress

Meaning: The self-restraint of the energetic (while waiting for a suitable opportunity), is like the drawing back of a fighting-ram in order to butt
pope_couplet: The men of mighty power their hidden energies repress, As fighting ram recoils to rush on foe with heavier stress
explanation_en: The self-restraint of the energetic (while waiting for a suitable opportunity), is like the drawing back of a fighting-ram in order to butt
explanation_ta: ஊக்கம் மிகுந்தவன் (காலத்தை எதிர்பார்த்து) அடங்கியிருத்தல் போர் செய்யும் ஆட்டுக்கடா தன் பகையைத் தாக்குவதற்க்காகப் பின்னே கால் வாங்குதலைப் போன்றது.

translation:
The glorious once of wrath enkindled make no outward show, At once; they bide their time, while hidden fires within them glow

Meaning: The wise will not immediately and hastily shew out their anger; they will watch their time, and restrain it within
pope_couplet: The glorious once of wrath enkindled make no outward show, At once; they bide their time, while hidden fires within them glow
explanation_en: The wise will not immediately and hastily shew out their anger; they will watch their time, and restrain it within
explanation_ta: அறிவுடையவர் ( பகைவர் தீங்கு செய்த) அப்பொழுதே உடனே புறத்தில் சினம் கொள்ளமாட்டார், (வெல்வதற்கு ஏற்ற) காலம் பார்த்து அகத்தில் சினம் கொள்வார்.

translation:
If foes' detested form they see, with patience let them bear; When fateful hour at last they spy,- the head lies there

Meaning: If one meets his enemy, let him show him all respect, until the time for his destruction is come; when that is come, his head will be easily brought low
pope_couplet: If foes' detested form they see, with patience let them bear; When fateful hour at last they spy,- the head lies there
explanation_en: If one meets his enemy, let him show him all respect, until the time for his destruction is come; when that is come, his head will be easily brought low
explanation_ta: பகைவரைக் கண்டால் பொறுத்துச் செல்லவேண்டும், அப் பகைவர்க்கு முடிவுகாலம் வந்த போது அவருடைய தலை கீழே விழும்.

translation:
When hardest gain of opportunity at last is won, With promptitude let hardest deed be done

Meaning: If a rare opportunity occurs, while it lasts, let a man do that which is rarely to be accomplished (but for such an opportunity)
pope_couplet: When hardest gain of opportunity at last is won, With promptitude let hardest deed be done
explanation_en: If a rare opportunity occurs, while it lasts, let a man do that which is rarely to be accomplished (but for such an opportunity)
explanation_ta: கிடைத்தற்கறிய காலம் வந்து வாய்க்குமானால், அந்த வாய்ப்பைப் பயன்படுத்திக் கொண்டு அப்போதே செய்தற்கரியச் செயல்களைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
As heron stands with folded wing, so wait in waiting hour; As heron snaps its prey, when fortune smiles, put forth your power

Meaning: At the time when one should use self-control, let him restrain himself like a heron; and, let him like it, strike, when there is a favourable opportunity
pope_couplet: As heron stands with folded wing, so wait in waiting hour; As heron snaps its prey, when fortune smiles, put forth your power
explanation_en: At the time when one should use self-control, let him restrain himself like a heron; and, let him like it, strike, when there is a favourable opportunity
explanation_ta: பொறுத்திருக்கும் காலத்தில் கொக்குப் போல் அமைதியாக இருக்க வேண்டும், காலம் வாய்த்த போது அதன் குத்து போல் தவறாமல் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
Begin no work of war, depise no foe, Till place where you can wholly circumvent you know

Meaning: Let not (a king) despise (an enemy), nor undertake any thing (against him), until he has obtained (a suitable) place for besieging him
pope_couplet: Begin no work of war, depise no foe, Till place where you can wholly circumvent you know
explanation_en: Let not (a king) despise (an enemy), nor undertake any thing (against him), until he has obtained (a suitable) place for besieging him
explanation_ta: முற்றுகை செய்வதற்கு ஏற்ற இடத்தைக் கண்டபின் அல்லாமல் எச் செயலையும் தொடங்கக்கூடாது, பகைவரை இகழவும் கூடாது.

translation:
Though skill in war combine with courage tried on battle-field, The added gain of fort doth great advantage yield

Meaning: Even to those who are men of power and expedients, an attack in connection with a fortification will yield many advantages
pope_couplet: Though skill in war combine with courage tried on battle-field, The added gain of fort doth great advantage yield
explanation_en: Even to those who are men of power and expedients, an attack in connection with a fortification will yield many advantages
explanation_ta: மாறுபாடு பொருந்திய வலிமை உடையவர்க்கும் அரணோடு பொருந்தி ஏற்படுகின்ற வெற்றியானது பல வகைப் பயன்களையும் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
E'en weak ones mightily prevail, if place of strong defence, They find, protect themselves, and work their foes offence

Meaning: Even the powerless will become powerful and conquer, if they select a proper field (of action), and guard themselves, while they make war on their enemies
pope_couplet: E'en weak ones mightily prevail, if place of strong defence, They find, protect themselves, and work their foes offence
explanation_en: Even the powerless will become powerful and conquer, if they select a proper field (of action), and guard themselves, while they make war on their enemies
explanation_ta: தக்க இடத்தை அறிந்து தம்மைக் காத்துக் கொண்டு பகைவரிடத்திற் சென்று தம் செயலைச் செய்தால், வலிமை இல்லாதவறும் வலிமை உடையவராக வெல்வர்,

translation:
The foes who thought to triumph, find their thoughts were vain, If hosts advance, seize vantage ground, and thence the fight maintain

Meaning: If they who draw near (to fight) choose a suitable place to approach (their enemy), the latter, will have to relinquish the thought which they once entertained, of conquering them
pope_couplet: The foes who thought to triumph, find their thoughts were vain, If hosts advance, seize vantage ground, and thence the fight maintain
explanation_en: If they who draw near (to fight) choose a suitable place to approach (their enemy), the latter, will have to relinquish the thought which they once entertained, of conquering them
explanation_ta: தக்க இடத்தை அறிந்து பொருந்தியவராய்ச் செயலைச் செய்வாராயின், அவரை வெல்ல எண்ணியிருந்த பகைவர் தம் எண்ணத்தை இழந்துவிடுவார்.

translation:
The crocodile prevails in its own flow of water wide, If this it leaves, 'tis slain by anything beside

Meaning: In deep water, a crocodile will conquer (all other animals); but if it leave the water, other animals will conquer it
pope_couplet: The crocodile prevails in its own flow of water wide, If this it leaves, 'tis slain by anything beside
explanation_en: In deep water, a crocodile will conquer (all other animals); but if it leave the water, other animals will conquer it
explanation_ta: ஆழமுள்ள நீரில் முதலை மற்ற உயிர்களை வெல்லும், ஆனால் நீரிலிருந்து விலகிவந்தால் அந்த முதலையையும் மற்ற உயிர்கள் வென்றுவிடும்.

translation:
The lofty car, with mighty wheel, sails not o'er watery main, The boat that skims the sea, runs not on earth's hard plain

Meaning: Wide chariots, with mighty wheels, will not run on the ocean; neither will ships that the traverse ocean, move on the earth
pope_couplet: The lofty car, with mighty wheel, sails not o'er watery main, The boat that skims the sea, runs not on earth's hard plain
explanation_en: Wide chariots, with mighty wheels, will not run on the ocean; neither will ships that the traverse ocean, move on the earth
explanation_ta: வலிய சக்கரங்களையுடைய பெரியத் தேர்கள் கடலில் ஓடமுடியாது, கடலில் ஓடுகின்ற கப்பல்களும் நிலத்தில் ஓடமுடியாது.

translation:
Save their own fearless might they need no other aid, If in right place they fight, all due provision made

Meaning: You will need no other aid than fearlessness, if you thoroughly reflect (on what you are to do), and select (a suitable) place for your operations
pope_couplet: Save their own fearless might they need no other aid, If in right place they fight, all due provision made
explanation_en: You will need no other aid than fearlessness, if you thoroughly reflect (on what you are to do), and select (a suitable) place for your operations
explanation_ta: (செய்யும் வழிவகைகமைக்) குறைவில்லாமல் எண்ணித் தக்க இடத்தில் பொருந்திச் செய்தால், அஞ்சாமை அல்லாமல் வேறு துணை வேண்டியதில்லை.

translation:
If lord of army vast the safe retreat assailOf him whose host is small, his mightiest efforts fail

Meaning: The power of one who has a large army will perish, if he goes into ground where only a small army can act
pope_couplet: If lord of army vast the safe retreat assailOf him whose host is small, his mightiest efforts fail
explanation_en: The power of one who has a large army will perish, if he goes into ground where only a small army can act
explanation_ta: சிறிய படை உடையவனுக்குத் தக்கதாக உள்ள இடத்தில் பொருந்தி நின்றால், பெரிய படை உடையவன் தன் ஊக்கம் அழிவான்.

translation:
Though fort be none, and store of wealth they lack,'Tis hard a people's homesteads to attack

Meaning: It is a hazardous thing to attack men in their own country, although they may neither have power nor a good fortress
pope_couplet: Though fort be none, and store of wealth they lack,'Tis hard a people's homesteads to attack
explanation_en: It is a hazardous thing to attack men in their own country, although they may neither have power nor a good fortress
explanation_ta: அரணாகிய நன்மையும் மற்றச் சிறப்பும் இல்லாதவராயினும் பகைவர் வாழ்கின்ற இடத்திற்குச் சென்று அவரைத் தாக்குதல் அரிது.

translation:
The jackal slays, in miry paths of foot-betraying fen, The elephant of fearless eye and tusks transfixing armed men

Meaning: A fox can kill a fearless, warrior-faced elephant, if it go into mud in which its legs sink down
pope_couplet: The jackal slays, in miry paths of foot-betraying fen, The elephant of fearless eye and tusks transfixing armed men
explanation_en: A fox can kill a fearless, warrior-faced elephant, if it go into mud in which its legs sink down
explanation_ta: வேல் ஏந்திய வீரரைக் கோர்த்தெடுத்த கொம்பு உடைய யானையையும், கால் ஆழும் சேற்று நில்த்தில் அகப்பட்ட போது நரிகள் கொன்றுவிடும்.

translation:
How treats he virtue, wealth and pleasure? How, when life's at stake, Comports himself? This four-fold test of man will full assurance make

Meaning: Let (a minister) be chosen, after he has been tried by means of these four things, viz,-his virtue, (love of) money, (love of) sexual pleasure, and tear of (losing) life
pope_couplet: How treats he virtue, wealth and pleasure? How, when life's at stake, Comports himself? This four-fold test of man will full assurance make
explanation_en: Let (a minister) be chosen, after he has been tried by means of these four things, viz,-his virtue, (love of) money, (love of) sexual pleasure, and tear of (losing) life
explanation_ta: அறம், பொருள், இன்பம், உயிர்காக அஞ்சும் அச்சம் ஆகிய நான்கு வகையாலும் ஆராயப்பட்ட பிறகே ஒருவன் (ஒரு தொழிலுக்கு உரியவனாகத்) தெளியப்படுவான்.

translation:
Of noble race, of faultless worth, of generous prideThat shrinks from shame or stain; in him may king confide

Meaning: (The king's) choice should (fall) on him, who is of good family, who is free from faults, and who has the modesty which fears the wounds (of sin)
pope_couplet: Of noble race, of faultless worth, of generous prideThat shrinks from shame or stain; in him may king confide
explanation_en: (The king's) choice should (fall) on him, who is of good family, who is free from faults, and who has the modesty which fears the wounds (of sin)
explanation_ta: நல்லகுடியில் பிறந்து குற்றங்களிலிருந்து நீங்கிப் பழியாச் செயல்களைச் செய்ய அஞ்சுகின்ற நாணம் உடையவனையே நம்பித் தெளிய வேண்டும்.

translation:
Though deeply learned, unflecked by fault, 'tis rare to see, When closely scanned, a man from all unwisdom free

Meaning: When even men, who have studied the most difficult works, and who are free from faults, are (carefully) examined, it is a rare thing to find them without ignorance
pope_couplet: Though deeply learned, unflecked by fault, 'tis rare to see, When closely scanned, a man from all unwisdom free
explanation_en: When even men, who have studied the most difficult works, and who are free from faults, are (carefully) examined, it is a rare thing to find them without ignorance
explanation_ta: அரிய நூல்களைத் கற்றுத் தேர்ந்து குற்றம் அற்றவரிடத்திலும் ஆராய்ந்துப் பார்க்குமிடத்தில் அறியாமை இல்லாதிருப்பது அருமையாகும்.

translation:
Weigh well the good of each, his failings closely scan, As these or those prevail, so estimate the man

Meaning: Let (a king) consider (a man's) good qualities, as well as his faults, and then judge (of his character) by that which prevails
pope_couplet: Weigh well the good of each, his failings closely scan, As these or those prevail, so estimate the man
explanation_en: Let (a king) consider (a man's) good qualities, as well as his faults, and then judge (of his character) by that which prevails
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய குணங்களை ஆராய்ந்து, பிறகு குற்றங்களையும் ஆராய்ந்து, மிகுதியானவை எவையென ஆராய்ந்து, மிகுந்திப்பவற்றால் தெளிந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
Of greatness and of meanness too, The deeds of each are touchstone true

Meaning: A man's deeds are the touchstone of his greatness and littleness
pope_couplet: Of greatness and of meanness too, The deeds of each are touchstone true
explanation_en: A man's deeds are the touchstone of his greatness and littleness
explanation_ta: (மக்களுடைய குணங்களாலாகிய) பெருமைக்கும் (குற்றங்களாலாகிய) சிறுமைக்கும் தேர்ந்தறியும் உரைக் கல்லாக இருப்பவை அவரவருடைய செயல்களே ஆகும்.

translation:
Beware of trusting men who have no kith of kin; No bonds restrain such men, no shame deters from sin

Meaning: Let (a king) avoid choosing men who have no relations; such men have no attachment, and thereforehave no fear of crime
pope_couplet: Beware of trusting men who have no kith of kin; No bonds restrain such men, no shame deters from sin
explanation_en: Let (a king) avoid choosing men who have no relations; such men have no attachment, and thereforehave no fear of crime
explanation_ta: சுற்றத்தாறின் தெடர்பு அற்றவரை நம்பித் தெளியக்கூடாது, அவர் உலகத்தில் பற்று இல்லாதவராகையால் பழிக்கு நாண மாட்டார்.

translation:
By fond affection led who trusts in men of unwise soul, Yields all his being up to folly's blind control

Meaning: Yields all his being up to folly's blind control
pope_couplet: By fond affection led who trusts in men of unwise soul, Yields all his being up to folly's blind control
explanation_en: Yields all his being up to folly's blind control
explanation_ta: அறியவேண்டியவற்றை அறியாதிருப்பவரை அன்புடைமை காரணமாக நம்பித்தெளிதல், (தெளிந்தவர்க்கு) எல்லா அறியாமையும் கெடும்.

translation:
Who trusts an untried stranger, brings disgrace, Remediless, on all his race

Meaning: Sorrow that will not leave even his posterity will come upon him chooses a stranger whose character he has not known
pope_couplet: Who trusts an untried stranger, brings disgrace, Remediless, on all his race
explanation_en: Sorrow that will not leave even his posterity will come upon him chooses a stranger whose character he has not known
explanation_ta: மற்றவனை ஒன்றும் ஆராயாமல் தெளிந்தால் அஃது (அவனுக்கு மட்டும் அல்லாமல்) அவனுடைய வழிமுறையில் தோன்றினவருக்கும் துன்பத்தைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Trust no man whom you have not fully tried, When tested, in his prudence proved confide

Meaning: Let (a king) choose no one without previous consideration; after he has made his choice, let him unhesitatingly select for each such duties as are appropriate
pope_couplet: Trust no man whom you have not fully tried, When tested, in his prudence proved confide
explanation_en: Let (a king) choose no one without previous consideration; after he has made his choice, let him unhesitatingly select for each such duties as are appropriate
explanation_ta: யாரையும் ஆராயாமல் தெளியக்கூடாது, நன்றாக ஆராய்ந்த பின்னர் அவரிடம் தெளிவாகக் கொள்ளத்தக்க பொருள்களைத் தெளிந்து நம்ப வேண்டும்.

translation:
Trust where you have not tried, doubt of a friend to feel, Once trusted, wounds inflict that nought can heal

Meaning: To make choice of one who has not been examined, and to entertain doubts respecting one who has been chosen, will produce irremediable sorrow
