pope_couplet: Trust where you have not tried, doubt of a friend to feel, Once trusted, wounds inflict that nought can heal
explanation_en: To make choice of one who has not been examined, and to entertain doubts respecting one who has been chosen, will produce irremediable sorrow
explanation_ta: ஒருவனை ஆராயாமல் தெளிவடைதலும், ஆராய்ந்து தெளிவடைந்த ஒருவனிடம் ஐயப்படுதலும் ஆகிய இவை நீங்காதத் துன்பத்தைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Who good and evil scanning, ever makes the good his joy; Such man of virtuous mood should king employ

Meaning: He should be employed (by a king), whose nature leads him to choose the good, after having weighed both the evil and the good in any undertaking
pope_couplet: Who good and evil scanning, ever makes the good his joy; Such man of virtuous mood should king employ
explanation_en: He should be employed (by a king), whose nature leads him to choose the good, after having weighed both the evil and the good in any undertaking
explanation_ta: நன்மையும் தீமையுமாகிய இரண்டையும் ஆராய்ந்து நன்மை தருகின்றவற்றையே விரும்புகின்ற இயல்புடையவன் (செயலுக்கு உரியவனாக) ஆளப்படுவான்.

translation:
Who swells the revenues, spreads plenty o'er the land, Seeks out what hinders progress, his the workman's hand

Meaning: Let him do (the king's) work who can enlarge the sources (of revenue), increase wealth and considerately prevent the accidents (which would destroy it)
pope_couplet: Who swells the revenues, spreads plenty o'er the land, Seeks out what hinders progress, his the workman's hand
explanation_en: Let him do (the king's) work who can enlarge the sources (of revenue), increase wealth and considerately prevent the accidents (which would destroy it)
explanation_ta: பொருள் வரும் வழிகளைப் பெருக்கச் செய்து, அவற்றால் வளத்தை உண்டாக்கி, வரும் இடையூறுகளைஆராய்ந்து நீக்க வல்லவனே செயல் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
A loyal love with wisdom, clearness, mind from avarice free; Who hath these four good gifts should ever trusted be

Meaning: Let the choice (of a king) fall upon him who largely possesses these four things, love, knowledge, a clear mind and freedom from covetousness
pope_couplet: A loyal love with wisdom, clearness, mind from avarice free; Who hath these four good gifts should ever trusted be
explanation_en: Let the choice (of a king) fall upon him who largely possesses these four things, love, knowledge, a clear mind and freedom from covetousness
explanation_ta: அன்பு, அறிவு, ஐயமில்லாமல் தெளியும் ஆற்றல், அவா இல்லாமை ஆகிய இந் நான்கு பண்புகளையும் நிலையாக உடையவனைத் தெளியலாம்.

translation:
Even when tests of every kind are multiplied, Full many a man proves otherwise, by action tried

Meaning: Even when (a king) has tried them in every possible way, there are many men who change, from the nature of the works (in which they may be employed)
pope_couplet: Even when tests of every kind are multiplied, Full many a man proves otherwise, by action tried
explanation_en: Even when (a king) has tried them in every possible way, there are many men who change, from the nature of the works (in which they may be employed)
explanation_ta: எவ்வகையால் ஆராய்ந்து தெளிந்த பிறகும்(செயலை மேற்க்கொண்டு செய்யும் போது) அச் செயல்வகையால் வேறுபடும் மக்கள் உலகத்தில் பலர் உண்டு.

translation:
No specious fav'rite should the king's commission bear, But he that knows, and work performs with patient care

Meaning: (A king's) work can only be accomplished by a man of wisdom and patient endurance; it is not of a nature to be given to one from mere personal attachment
pope_couplet: No specious fav'rite should the king's commission bear, But he that knows, and work performs with patient care
explanation_en: (A king's) work can only be accomplished by a man of wisdom and patient endurance; it is not of a nature to be given to one from mere personal attachment
explanation_ta: (செய்யும் வழிகளை) அறிந்து இடையூறுகளைத்தாங்கிச் செய்து முடிக்க வல்லவனை அல்லாமல், மற்றவனைச் சிறந்தவன் என்றுக் கருதி ஒருச் செயலைச் செய்யுமாறு ஏவக்கூடாது.

translation:
Let king first ask, 'Who shall the deed perform?' and 'What the deed?'Of hour befitting both assured, let every work proceed

Meaning: Let (a king) act, after having considered the agent (whom he is to employ), the deed (he desires to do), and the time which is suitable to it
pope_couplet: Let king first ask, 'Who shall the deed perform?' and 'What the deed?'Of hour befitting both assured, let every work proceed
explanation_en: Let (a king) act, after having considered the agent (whom he is to employ), the deed (he desires to do), and the time which is suitable to it
explanation_ta: செய்கின்றவனுடைய தன்மையை ஆராய்ந்து, செயலின் தன்மையையும் ஆராய்ந்து, தக்கக் காலத்தோடு பொறுந்துமாறு உணர்ந்து செய்விக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
'This man, this work shall thus work out,' let thoughtful king command; Then leave the matter wholly in his servant's hand

Meaning: After having considered, "this man can accomplish this, by these means", let (the king) leave with him the discharge of that duty
pope_couplet: 'This man, this work shall thus work out,' let thoughtful king command; Then leave the matter wholly in his servant's hand
explanation_en: After having considered, "this man can accomplish this, by these means", let (the king) leave with him the discharge of that duty
explanation_ta: இந்தச் செயலை இக்கருவியால் இன்னவன் செய்துமுடிப்பான் என்று ஆராய்ந்த பிறகே அத் தொழிலை அவனிடம் ஒப்படைக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
As each man's special aptitude is known, Bid each man make that special work his own

Meaning: Having considered what work a man is fit for, let (the king) employ him in that work
pope_couplet: As each man's special aptitude is known, Bid each man make that special work his own
explanation_en: Having considered what work a man is fit for, let (the king) employ him in that work
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் ஒரு தொழிலைச் செய்வதற்கு உரியவனாக இருப்பதை ஆராய்ந்த பிறகு அவனைத் அத் தொழிலுக்கு உரியவனாகும்படிச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
Fortune deserts the king who ill can bear, Informal friendly ways of men his tolls who share

Meaning: Prosperity will leave (the king) who doubts the friendship of the man who steadily labours in the discharge of his duties
pope_couplet: Fortune deserts the king who ill can bear, Informal friendly ways of men his tolls who share
explanation_en: Prosperity will leave (the king) who doubts the friendship of the man who steadily labours in the discharge of his duties
explanation_ta: மேற்க்கொண்ட தொழிலில் எப்போதும் முயற்சி உடையவனின் உறவைத் தவறாக நினைக்கும் தலைவனை விட்டுச் செல்வம் நீங்கும்.

translation:
Let king search out his servants' deeds each day; When these do right, the world goes rightly on its way

Meaning: Let a king daily examine the conduct of his servants; if they do not act crookedly, the world will not act crookedly
pope_couplet: Let king search out his servants' deeds each day; When these do right, the world goes rightly on its way
explanation_en: Let a king daily examine the conduct of his servants; if they do not act crookedly, the world will not act crookedly
explanation_ta: தொழில் செய்கின்றவன் கோணாதிருக்கும் வரையில் உலகம் கெடாது, ஆகையால் மன்னன் நாள்தோறும் அவனுடைய நிலைமையை ஆராய வேண்டும்.

translation:
When wealth is fled, old kindness still to show, Is kindly grace that only kinsmen know

Meaning: Even when (a man's) property is all gone, relatives will act towards him with their accustomed (kindness)
pope_couplet: When wealth is fled, old kindness still to show, Is kindly grace that only kinsmen know
explanation_en: Even when (a man's) property is all gone, relatives will act towards him with their accustomed (kindness)
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் வறியவனான காலத்திலும் அவனுக்கும் தமக்கும் இருந்த உறவைப் பாராட்டிப் பேசும் பண்புகள் சுற்றத்தாரிடம் உண்டு.

translation:
The gift of kin's unfailing love bestowsMuch gain of good, like flower that fadeless blows

Meaning: If (a man's) relatives remain attached to him with unchanging love, it will be a source of everincreasing wealth
pope_couplet: The gift of kin's unfailing love bestowsMuch gain of good, like flower that fadeless blows
explanation_en: If (a man's) relatives remain attached to him with unchanging love, it will be a source of everincreasing wealth
explanation_ta: அன்பு நீங்காத சுற்றம் ஒருவனுக்குக் கிடைத்தால், அது மேன்மேலும் வளர்ச்சி குறையாத ஆக்கம் பலவற்றையும் அவனுக்குக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
His joy of life who mingles not with kinsmen gathered round, Is lake where streams pour in, with no encircling bound

Meaning: The wealth of one who does not mingle freely with his relatives, will be like the filling of water in a
pope_couplet: His joy of life who mingles not with kinsmen gathered round, Is lake where streams pour in, with no encircling bound
explanation_en: The wealth of one who does not mingle freely with his relatives, will be like the filling of water in a
explanation_ta: சுற்றத்தாரோடு மனம் கலந்து பழகும் தன்மை இல்லாதவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை, குளப்பரப்பானது கரையில்லாமல் நீர் நிறைந்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
The profit gained by wealth's increase, Is living compassed round by relatives in peace

Meaning: To live surrounded by relatives, is the advantage to be derived from the acquisition of wealth
pope_couplet: The profit gained by wealth's increase, Is living compassed round by relatives in peace
explanation_en: To live surrounded by relatives, is the advantage to be derived from the acquisition of wealth
explanation_ta: தக்கவழியில் செய்யப்படாத முயற்சி பலர் துணையாக நின்று(அதை முடிக்குமாறு) காத்த போதிலும் குறையாகிவிடும்.

translation:
Who knows the use of pleasant words, and liberal gifts can give, Connections, heaps of them, surrounding him shall live

Meaning: He will be surrounded by numerous relatives who manifests generosity and affability
pope_couplet: Who knows the use of pleasant words, and liberal gifts can give, Connections, heaps of them, surrounding him shall live
explanation_en: He will be surrounded by numerous relatives who manifests generosity and affability
explanation_ta: பொருள் கொடுத்தலும் இன்சொல் கூறுதலுமாகிய இரண்டும் செய்யவல்லவனானால் ஒருவன் தொடர்ந்த பலச் சுற்றத்தால் சூழப்படுவான்.

translation:
Than one who gifts bestows and wrath restrains, Through the wide world none larger following gains

Meaning: No one, in all the world, will have so many relatives (about him), as he who makes large gift, and does not give way to anger
pope_couplet: Than one who gifts bestows and wrath restrains, Through the wide world none larger following gains
explanation_en: No one, in all the world, will have so many relatives (about him), as he who makes large gift, and does not give way to anger
explanation_ta: பெரிய கொடையாளியாகவும் சினமற்றவனாகவும் ஒருவன் இருந்தால் அவனைப் போல் சுற்றத்தாரை உடையவர் உலகத்தில் யாரும் இல்லை.

translation:
The crows conceal not, call their friends to come, then eat; Increase of good such worthy ones shall meet

Meaning: The crows do not conceal (their prey), but will call out for others (to share with them) while they eat it; wealth will be with those who show a similar disposition (towards their relatives)
pope_couplet: The crows conceal not, call their friends to come, then eat; Increase of good such worthy ones shall meet
explanation_en: The crows do not conceal (their prey), but will call out for others (to share with them) while they eat it; wealth will be with those who show a similar disposition (towards their relatives)
explanation_ta: காக்கை (தனக்கு கிடைத்ததை) மறைத்து வைக்காமல் சுற்றத்தைக் கூவி அழைத்து உண்ணும். ஆக்கமும் அத்தகைய இயல்பு உடையவர்க்கே உண்டு.

translation:
Where king regards not all alike, but each in his degree,'Neath such discerning rule many dwell happily

Meaning: Many relatives will live near a king, when they observe that he does not look on all alike, but that he looks on each man according to his merit
pope_couplet: Where king regards not all alike, but each in his degree,'Neath such discerning rule many dwell happily
explanation_en: Many relatives will live near a king, when they observe that he does not look on all alike, but that he looks on each man according to his merit
explanation_ta: அரசன் எல்லாரையும் பொதுவகையாக நோக்காமல், அவரவர் சிறப்புக்கு ஏற்றவாறு நோக்கினால், அதை விரும்பி சுற்றமாக வாழ்கின்றவர் பலர் ஆவர்.

translation:
Who once were his, and then forsook him, as beforeWill come around, when cause of disagreement is no more

Meaning: Those who have been friends and have afterwards forsaken him, will return and join themselves (to him), when the cause of disagreement is not to be found in him
pope_couplet: Who once were his, and then forsook him, as beforeWill come around, when cause of disagreement is no more
explanation_en: Those who have been friends and have afterwards forsaken him, will return and join themselves (to him), when the cause of disagreement is not to be found in him
explanation_ta: முன் சுற்றத்தாறாக இருந்து பின் ஒருக் காரணத்தால் பிரிந்தவரின் உறவு, அவ்வாறு அவர் பொருந்தாமலிருந்த காரணம் நீங்கியபின் தானே வந்து சேரும்.

translation:
Who causeless went away, then to return, for any cause, ask leave; The king should sift their motives well, consider, and receive

Meaning: When one may have left him, and for some cause has returned to him, let the king fulfil the object (for which he has come back) and thoughtfully receive him again
pope_couplet: Who causeless went away, then to return, for any cause, ask leave; The king should sift their motives well, consider, and receive
explanation_en: When one may have left him, and for some cause has returned to him, let the king fulfil the object (for which he has come back) and thoughtfully receive him again
explanation_ta: தன்னிடமிருந்து பிரிந்து சென்று பின் ஒருக் காரணம்பற்றித் திரும்பிவந்தவனை, அரசன் அவன் நாடிய உதவியைச் செய்து ஆராய்ந்து உறவு கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
'Tis greater ill, it rapture of o'erweening gladness to the soulBring self-forgetfulness than if transcendent wrath control

Meaning: More evil than excessive anger, is forgetfulness which springs from the intoxication of great joy
pope_couplet: 'Tis greater ill, it rapture of o'erweening gladness to the soulBring self-forgetfulness than if transcendent wrath control
explanation_en: More evil than excessive anger, is forgetfulness which springs from the intoxication of great joy
explanation_ta: பெரிய உவகையால் மகிழ்ந்திருக்கும் போது மறதியால் வரும் சோர்வு, ஒருவனுக்கு வரம்பு கடந்த சினம் வருவதைவிடத் தீமையானதாகும்.

translation:
Perpetual, poverty is death to wisdom of the wise; When man forgets himself his glory dies

Meaning: Forgetfulness will destroy fame, even as constant poverty destroys knowledge
pope_couplet: Perpetual, poverty is death to wisdom of the wise; When man forgets himself his glory dies
explanation_en: Forgetfulness will destroy fame, even as constant poverty destroys knowledge
explanation_ta: நாள் தோறும் விடாமல் வரும் வறுமை அறிவைக் கொல்வது போல, ஒருவனுடைய புகழை அவனுடைய மறதிக் கொன்று விடும்.

translation:
'To self-oblivious men no praise'; this ruleDecisive wisdom sums of every school

Meaning: Thoughtlessness will never acquire fame; and this tenet is upheld by all treatises in the world
pope_couplet: 'To self-oblivious men no praise'; this ruleDecisive wisdom sums of every school
explanation_en: Thoughtlessness will never acquire fame; and this tenet is upheld by all treatises in the world
explanation_ta: மறதியால் சோர்ந்து நடப்பவர்க்குப் புகழுடன் வாழும் தன்மையில்லை, அஃது உலகத்தில் எப்படிப்பட்டநூலோர்க்கும் ஒப்ப முடிந்த முடிப்பாகும்.

translation:
'To cowards is no fort's defence'; e'en soThe self-oblivious men no blessing know

Meaning: Just as the coward has no defence (by whatever fortifications ha may be surrounded), so the thoughtless has no good (whatever advantages he may possess)
pope_couplet: 'To cowards is no fort's defence'; e'en soThe self-oblivious men no blessing know
explanation_en: Just as the coward has no defence (by whatever fortifications ha may be surrounded), so the thoughtless has no good (whatever advantages he may possess)
explanation_ta: உள்ளத்தில் அச்சம் உடையவர்க்குப் புறத்திலே அரண் இருந்து பயன் இல்லை, அதுபோல் மறதி உடையவர்க்கு நல்ல நிலை வாய்த்தும் பயன் இல்லை.

translation:
To him who nought foresees, recks not of anything, The after woe shall sure repentance bring

Meaning: The thoughtless man, who provides not against the calamities that may happen, will afterwards repent for his fault
pope_couplet: To him who nought foresees, recks not of anything, The after woe shall sure repentance bring
explanation_en: The thoughtless man, who provides not against the calamities that may happen, will afterwards repent for his fault
explanation_ta: வரும் இடையூறுகளை முன்னே அறிந்துக் காக்காமல் மறந்து சோர்ந்தவன், பின்பு அவை வந்துற்றபோது தன் பிழையை நினைத்து இரங்குவான்.

translation:
Towards all unswerving, ever watchfulness of soul retain, Where this is found there is no greater gain

Meaning: There is nothing comparable with the possession of unfailing thoughtfulness at all times; and towards all persons
pope_couplet: Towards all unswerving, ever watchfulness of soul retain, Where this is found there is no greater gain
explanation_en: There is nothing comparable with the possession of unfailing thoughtfulness at all times; and towards all persons
explanation_ta: யாரிடத்திலும் எக்காலத்திலும் மறந்தும் சோர்ந்திருக்காதத் தன்மை தவறாமல் பொருந்தியிருக்குமானால், அதற்கு ஒப்பான நன்மை வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
Though things are arduous deemed, there's nought may not be won, When work with mind's unslumbering energy and thought is done

Meaning: There is nothing too difficult to be accomplished, if a man set about it carefully, with unflinching endeavour
pope_couplet: Though things are arduous deemed, there's nought may not be won, When work with mind's unslumbering energy and thought is done
explanation_en: There is nothing too difficult to be accomplished, if a man set about it carefully, with unflinching endeavour
explanation_ta: மறவாமை என்னும் கருவிகொண்டு (கடமைகளைப்) போற்றிச் செய்தால், செய்வதற்கு அரியவை என்று ஒருவனால் முடியாத செயல்கள் இல்லை.

translation:
Let things that merit praise thy watchful soul employ; Who these despise attain through sevenfold births no joy

Meaning: Let (a man) observe and do these things which have been praised (by the wise); if he neglects and fails to perform them, for him there will be no (happiness) throughout the seven births
pope_couplet: Let things that merit praise thy watchful soul employ; Who these despise attain through sevenfold births no joy
explanation_en: Let (a man) observe and do these things which have been praised (by the wise); if he neglects and fails to perform them, for him there will be no (happiness) throughout the seven births
explanation_ta: சான்றோர் புகழ்ந்து சொல்லியச் செயல்களைப் போற்றிச் செய்யவேண்டும், அவ்வாறு செய்யாமல் மறந்து சோர்ந்தவர்க்கு ஏழுப் பிறப்பிலும் நன்மை இல்லை.

translation:
Think on the men whom scornful mind hath brought to nought, When exultation overwhelms thy wildered thought

Meaning: Let (a king) think of those who have been ruined by neglect, when his mind is elated with joy
pope_couplet: Think on the men whom scornful mind hath brought to nought, When exultation overwhelms thy wildered thought
explanation_en: Let (a king) think of those who have been ruined by neglect, when his mind is elated with joy
explanation_ta: தாம் தம் மகிழ்ச்சியால் செருக்குக் கொண்டு கடமையை மறந்திருக்கும் போது, அவ்வாறு சோர்ந்திருந்த காரணத்தால் முற்காலத்தில் அழிந்தவரை நினைக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
'Tis easy what thou hast in mind to gain, If what thou hast in mind thy mind retain

Meaning: It is easy for (one) to obtain whatever he may think of, if he can again think of it
pope_couplet: 'Tis easy what thou hast in mind to gain, If what thou hast in mind thy mind retain
explanation_en: It is easy for (one) to obtain whatever he may think of, if he can again think of it
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் எண்ணியதை விடாமல் எண்ணி (சோர்வில்லாமல்) இருக்கப் பெற்றால், அவன் கருதியதை அடைதல் எளிதாகும்.

translation:
Search out, to no one favour show; with heart that justice lovesConsult, then act; this is the rule that right approves

Meaning: To examine into (the crimes which may be committed), to show no favour (to any one), to desire to act with impartiality towards all, and to inflict (such punishments) as may be wisely resolved on,
pope_couplet: Search out, to no one favour show; with heart that justice lovesConsult, then act; this is the rule that right approves
explanation_en: To examine into (the crimes which may be committed), to show no favour (to any one), to desire to act with impartiality towards all, and to inflict (such punishments) as may be wisely resolved on,
explanation_ta: யாரிடத்திலும் (குற்றம் இன்னதென்று) ஆராய்ந்து, கண்ணோட்டம் செய்யாமல் நடுவுநிலைமைப் பொருந்தி (செய்யத்தக்கதை) ஆராய்ந்து செய்வதே நீதிமுறையாகும்.

translation:
All earth looks up to heav'n whence raindrops fall; All subjects look to king that ruleth all

Meaning: When there is rain, the living creation thrives; and so when the king rules justly, his subjects thrive
pope_couplet: All earth looks up to heav'n whence raindrops fall; All subjects look to king that ruleth all
explanation_en: When there is rain, the living creation thrives; and so when the king rules justly, his subjects thrive
explanation_ta: உலகத்தில் உள்ள உயிர்கள் எல்லாம் மழையை நம்பி வாழ்கின்றன, அதுபோல் குடிமக்கள் எல்லாம் அரசனுடைய செங்கோலை நோக்கி வாழ்கின்றனர்.

translation:
Learning and virtue of the sages spring, From all-controlling sceptre of the king

Meaning: The sceptre of the king is the firm support of the Vedas of the Brahmin, and of all virtues therein described
pope_couplet: Learning and virtue of the sages spring, From all-controlling sceptre of the king
explanation_en: The sceptre of the king is the firm support of the Vedas of the Brahmin, and of all virtues therein described
explanation_ta: அந்தணர் போற்றும் மறைநூலுக்கும் அறத்திற்கும் அடிப்படையாய் நின்று உலகத்தைக் காப்பது அரசனுடைய செங்கோலாகும்.

translation:
Whose heart embraces subjects all, lord over mighty landWho rules, the world his feet embracing stands

Meaning: The world will constantly embrace the feet of the great king who rules over his subjects with love
pope_couplet: Whose heart embraces subjects all, lord over mighty landWho rules, the world his feet embracing stands
explanation_en: The world will constantly embrace the feet of the great king who rules over his subjects with love
explanation_ta: குடிகளை அன்போடு அணைத்துக் கொண்டு செங்கோல் செலுத்துகின்ற அரசனுடைய அடியைப்பொருந்தி உலகம் நிலை பெறும்.

translation:
Where king, who righteous laws regards, the sceptre wields, There fall the showers, there rich abundance crowns the fields

Meaning: Rain and plentiful crops will ever dwell together in the country of the king who sways his sceptre with justice
pope_couplet: Where king, who righteous laws regards, the sceptre wields, There fall the showers, there rich abundance crowns the fields
explanation_en: Rain and plentiful crops will ever dwell together in the country of the king who sways his sceptre with justice
explanation_ta: நீதி முறைப்படி செங்கோல் செலுத்தும் அரசனுடைய நாட்டில் பருவ மழையும் நிறைந்த விளைவும் ஒருசேர ஏற்படுவனவாகும்.

translation:
Not lance gives kings the victory, But sceptre swayed with equity

Meaning: It is not the javelin that gives victory, but the king's sceptre, if it do no injustice
pope_couplet: Not lance gives kings the victory, But sceptre swayed with equity
explanation_en: It is not the javelin that gives victory, but the king's sceptre, if it do no injustice
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு வெற்றி பெற்றுத் தருவது வேல் அன்று, அரசனுடைய செங்கோலே ஆகும், அச் செங்கோலும் கோணாதிருக்குமாயின்.

translation:
The king all the whole realm of earth protects; And justice guards the king who right respects

Meaning: The king defends the whole world; and justice, when administered without defect, defends the king
pope_couplet: The king all the whole realm of earth protects; And justice guards the king who right respects
explanation_en: The king defends the whole world; and justice, when administered without defect, defends the king
explanation_ta: உலகத்தை எல்லாம் அரசன் காப்பாற்றுவான், நீதிமுறை கெடாதவாறு ஆட்சி செய்வானாயின் அரசனை அந்த முறையே காப்பாற்றும்.

translation:
Hard of access, nought searching out, with partial handThe king who rules, shall sink and perish from the land

Meaning: The king who gives not facile audience (to those who approach him), and who does not examine and pass judgment (on their complaints), will perish in disgrace
pope_couplet: Hard of access, nought searching out, with partial handThe king who rules, shall sink and perish from the land
explanation_en: The king who gives not facile audience (to those who approach him), and who does not examine and pass judgment (on their complaints), will perish in disgrace
explanation_ta: எளிய செவ்வி உடையவனாய் ஆராய்ந்து நீதி முறை செய்யாத அரசன், தாழ்ந்த நிலையில் நின்று (பகைவரில்லாமலும் ) தானே கெடுவான்.

translation:
Abroad to guard, at home to punish, bringsNo just reproach; 'tis work assigned to kings

Meaning: In guarding his subjects (against injury from others), and in preserving them himself; to punish crime
pope_couplet: Abroad to guard, at home to punish, bringsNo just reproach; 'tis work assigned to kings
explanation_en: In guarding his subjects (against injury from others), and in preserving them himself; to punish crime
explanation_ta: குடிகளைப் பிறர் வருந்தாமல் காத்து, தானும் வருந்தாமல் காப்பாற்றி, அவற்களுடைய குற்றங்களைத் தக்க தண்டனையால் ஒழித்தல், அரசனுடைய தொழில் பழி அன்று.

translation:
By punishment of death the cruel to restrain, Is as when farmer frees from weeds the tender grain

Meaning: For a king to punish criminals with death, is like pulling up the weeds in the green corn
pope_couplet: By punishment of death the cruel to restrain, Is as when farmer frees from weeds the tender grain
explanation_en: For a king to punish criminals with death, is like pulling up the weeds in the green corn
explanation_ta: கொடியவர் சிலரைக் கொலைத்தண்டனையால் அரசன் ஒறுத்தல் பயிரைக் காப்பாற்றக் களையைச் களைவதற்க்கு நிகரான செயலாகும்.

translation:
Than one who plies the murderer's trade, more cruel is the kingWho all injustice works, his subjects harassing

Meaning: The king who gives himself up to oppression and acts unjustly (towards his subjects) is more cruel than the man who leads the life of a murderer
pope_couplet: Than one who plies the murderer's trade, more cruel is the kingWho all injustice works, his subjects harassing
explanation_en: The king who gives himself up to oppression and acts unjustly (towards his subjects) is more cruel than the man who leads the life of a murderer
explanation_ta: குடிகளை வருத்தும் தொழிலை மேற்கொண்டு, முறையல்லாத செயல்களைச் செய்து நடக்கும் அரசன் கொலைத் தொழிலைக் கொண்டவரை விடக் கொடியவன்.

translation:
As 'Give' the robber cries with lance uplift, So kings with sceptred hand implore a gift

Meaning: The request (for money) of him who holds the sceptre is like the word of a highway robber who stands with a weapon in hand and says "give up your wealth"
pope_couplet: As 'Give' the robber cries with lance uplift, So kings with sceptred hand implore a gift
explanation_en: The request (for money) of him who holds the sceptre is like the word of a highway robber who stands with a weapon in hand and says "give up your wealth"
explanation_ta: ஆட்சிக்குறிய கோலை ஏந்தி நின்ற அரசன் குடிகளைப் பொருள் கேட்டல் , போகும் வழியில் கள்வன் கொடு என்று கேட்பதைப் போன்றது.

translation:
Who makes no daily search for wrongs, nor justly rules, that kingDoth day by day his realm to ruin bring

Meaning: The country of the king who does not daily examine into the wrongs done and distribute justice, will daily fall to ruin
pope_couplet: Who makes no daily search for wrongs, nor justly rules, that kingDoth day by day his realm to ruin bring
explanation_en: The country of the king who does not daily examine into the wrongs done and distribute justice, will daily fall to ruin
explanation_ta: நாள் தோறும் தன் ஆட்சியில் நன்மை தீமைகளை ஆராய்ந்து முறைசெய்யாத அரசன், நாள் தோறும் (மெல்ல மெல்லத்) தன் நாட்டை இழந்து வருவான்.

translation:
Whose rod from right deflects, who counsel doth refuse, At once his wealth and people utterly shall lose

Meaning: The king, who, without reflecting (on its evil consequences), perverts justice, will lose at once both his wealth and his subjects
pope_couplet: Whose rod from right deflects, who counsel doth refuse, At once his wealth and people utterly shall lose
explanation_en: The king, who, without reflecting (on its evil consequences), perverts justice, will lose at once both his wealth and his subjects
explanation_ta: (ஆட்சிமுறை கெட்டுக்) கொடுங்கோலனாகி ஆராயாமல் எதையும் செய்யும் அரசன், பொருளையும் குடிகளையும் ஒரு சேர இழந்து விடுவான்.

translation:
His people's tears of sorrow past endurance, are not theySharp instruments to wear the monarch's wealth away

Meaning: Will not the tears, shed by a people who cannot endure the oppression which they suffer (from their king), become a saw to waste away his wealth ?
pope_couplet: His people's tears of sorrow past endurance, are not theySharp instruments to wear the monarch's wealth away
explanation_en: Will not the tears, shed by a people who cannot endure the oppression which they suffer (from their king), become a saw to waste away his wealth ?
explanation_ta: (முறை செய்யாதவனுடைய) செல்வத்தைத் தேய்த்து அழிக்க வல்ல படை அவனால் பலர் துன்பப்பட்டுத் துன்பம் பொறுக்க முடியாமல் அழுத கண்ணீர் அன்றோ.

translation:
To rulers' rule stability is sceptre right; When this is not, quenched is the rulers' light

Meaning: Righteous government gives permanence to (the fame of) kings; without that their fame will have no endurance
pope_couplet: To rulers' rule stability is sceptre right; When this is not, quenched is the rulers' light
explanation_en: Righteous government gives permanence to (the fame of) kings; without that their fame will have no endurance
explanation_ta: அரசர்க்கு புகழ் நிலைபெறக் காரணம் செங்கோல் முறையாகும், அஃது இல்லையானால் அரசர்க்கு புகழ் நிலைபெறாமல் போகும்.

translation:
As lack of rain to thirsty lands beneath, Is lack of grace in kings to all that breathe

Meaning: As is the world without rain, so live a people whose king is without kindness
pope_couplet: As lack of rain to thirsty lands beneath, Is lack of grace in kings to all that breathe
explanation_en: As is the world without rain, so live a people whose king is without kindness
explanation_ta: மழைத்துளி இல்லாதிருத்தல் உலகத்திற்கு எத்தன்மையானதோ, அத்தன்மையானது நாட்டில் வாழும் குடிமக்களுக்கு அரசனுடைய அருள் இல்லாத ஆட்சி.

translation:
To poverty it adds a sharper sting, To live beneath the sway of unjust king

Meaning: Property gives more sorrow than poverty, to those who live under the sceptre of a king without justice
pope_couplet: To poverty it adds a sharper sting, To live beneath the sway of unjust king
explanation_en: Property gives more sorrow than poverty, to those who live under the sceptre of a king without justice
explanation_ta: முறை செய்யாத அரசனுடைய கொடுங்கோல் ஆட்சியின் கீழ் இருக்கப் பெற்றால், பொருள் இல்லாத வறுமை நிலையைவிடச் செல்வநிலை துன்பமானதாகும்.

translation:
Where king from right deflecting, makes unrighteous gain, The seasons change, the clouds pour down no rain

Meaning: If the king acts contrary to justice, rain will become unseasonable, and the heavens will withhold their showers
pope_couplet: Where king from right deflecting, makes unrighteous gain, The seasons change, the clouds pour down no rain
explanation_en: If the king acts contrary to justice, rain will become unseasonable, and the heavens will withhold their showers
explanation_ta: அரசன் முறை தவறி நாட்டை ஆட்சி செய்வானானால், அந்த நாட்டில் பருவமழை தவறி மேகம் மழை பெய்யாமல் போகும்.

translation:
Where guardian guardeth not, udder of kine grows dry, And Brahmans' sacred lore will all forgotten lie

Meaning: If the guardian (of the country) neglects to guard it, the produce of the cows will fail, and the men of six duties viz, the Brahmins will forget the vedas
pope_couplet: Where guardian guardeth not, udder of kine grows dry, And Brahmans' sacred lore will all forgotten lie
explanation_en: If the guardian (of the country) neglects to guard it, the produce of the cows will fail, and the men of six duties viz, the Brahmins will forget the vedas
explanation_ta: நாட்டைக் காக்கும் தலைவன் முறைப்படி காக்காவிட்டால், அந் நாட்டில் பசுக்கள் பால் தருதலாகிய பயன் குன்றும், அந்தணரும் அறநூல்களை மறப்பர்.

translation:
Who punishes, investigation made in due degree, So as to stay advance of crime, a king is he

Meaning: He is a king who having equitably examined (any injustice which has been brought to his notice), suitably punishes it, so that it may not be again committed
pope_couplet: Who punishes, investigation made in due degree, So as to stay advance of crime, a king is he
explanation_en: He is a king who having equitably examined (any injustice which has been brought to his notice), suitably punishes it, so that it may not be again committed
explanation_ta: செய்த குற்றத்தை தக்கவாறு ஆராய்ந்து மீண்டும் அக் குற்றம் செய்யாத படி குற்றத்திற்குப் பொருந்துமாறு தண்டிப்பவனே அரசன் ஆவான்.

translation:
For length of days with still increasing joys on Heav'n who call, Should raise the rod with brow severe, but let it gently fall

Meaning: Let the king, who desires that his prosperity may long remain, commence his preliminary enquires with strictness, and then punish with mildness
pope_couplet: For length of days with still increasing joys on Heav'n who call, Should raise the rod with brow severe, but let it gently fall
explanation_en: Let the king, who desires that his prosperity may long remain, commence his preliminary enquires with strictness, and then punish with mildness
explanation_ta: ஆக்கம் நெடுங்காலம் நீங்காமலிருக்க விரும்புகின்றவர் (தண்டிக்கத் தொடங்கும் போது) அளவு கடந்து செய்வது போல் காட்டி அளவு மீறாமல் முறை செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
Where subjects dread of cruel wrongs endure, Ruin to unjust king is swift and sure

Meaning: The cruel-sceptred king, who acts so as to put his subjects in fear, will certainly and quickly come to ruin
pope_couplet: Where subjects dread of cruel wrongs endure, Ruin to unjust king is swift and sure
explanation_en: The cruel-sceptred king, who acts so as to put his subjects in fear, will certainly and quickly come to ruin
explanation_ta: குடிகள் அஞ்சும் படியான கொடுமைகளைச் செய்து ஆளும் கொடுங்கோல் அரசனானால், அவன் திண்ணமாக விரைவில் கெடுவான்.

translation:
'Ah! cruel is our king', where subjects sadly say, His age shall dwindle, swift his joy of life decay

Meaning: The king who is spoken of as cruel will quickly perish; his life becoming shortened
pope_couplet: 'Ah! cruel is our king', where subjects sadly say, His age shall dwindle, swift his joy of life decay
explanation_en: The king who is spoken of as cruel will quickly perish; his life becoming shortened
explanation_ta: நம் அரசன் கடுமையானவன் என்று குடிகளால் கூறப்படும் கொடுஞ்சொல்லை உடைய அரசன், தன் ஆயுள் குறைந்து விரைவில் கெடுவான்.

translation:
Whom subjects scarce may see, of harsh forbidding countenance; His ample wealth shall waste, blasted by demon's glance

Meaning: The great wealth of him who is difficult of access and possesses a sternness of countenance, is like that which has been obtained by a devil
pope_couplet: Whom subjects scarce may see, of harsh forbidding countenance; His ample wealth shall waste, blasted by demon's glance
explanation_en: The great wealth of him who is difficult of access and possesses a sternness of countenance, is like that which has been obtained by a devil
explanation_ta: எளிதில் காணமுடியாத அருமையும், இனிமையற்ற முகமும் உடையவனது பெரிய செல்வம், பேய் கண்டு காத்திருப்பதைப் போன்ற தன்மையுடையது.

translation:
The tyrant, harsh in speach and hard of eye, His ample joy, swift fading, soon shall die

Meaning: The abundant wealth of the king whose words are harsh and whose looks are void of kindness, will instantly perish instead of abiding long, with him
pope_couplet: The tyrant, harsh in speach and hard of eye, His ample joy, swift fading, soon shall die
explanation_en: The abundant wealth of the king whose words are harsh and whose looks are void of kindness, will instantly perish instead of abiding long, with him
explanation_ta: கடுஞ்சொல் உடையவனாய்க் கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாதவனாய் உள்ளவனுடைய பெரிய செல்வம் நீடித்தல் இல்லாமல் அப்பொழுதே கெடும்.

translation:
Harsh words and punishments severe beyond the right, Are file that wears away the monarch's conquering might

Meaning: Severe words and excessive punishments will be a file to waste away a king's power for destroying (his enemies)
pope_couplet: Harsh words and punishments severe beyond the right, Are file that wears away the monarch's conquering might
explanation_en: Severe words and excessive punishments will be a file to waste away a king's power for destroying (his enemies)
explanation_ta: கடுமையான சொல்லும் முறைகடந்த தண்டனையும் அரசனுடைய வெற்றிக்கு காரணமான வலிமையைத் தேய்க்கும் அரம் ஆகும்.

translation:
Who leaves the work to those around, and thinks of it no more; If he in wrathful mood reprove, his prosperous days are o'er

Meaning: The prosperity of that king will waste away, who without reflecting (on his affairs himself), commits them to his ministers, and (when a failure occurs) gives way to anger, and rages against them
pope_couplet: Who leaves the work to those around, and thinks of it no more; If he in wrathful mood reprove, his prosperous days are o'er
explanation_en: The prosperity of that king will waste away, who without reflecting (on his affairs himself), commits them to his ministers, and (when a failure occurs) gives way to anger, and rages against them
explanation_ta: அமைச்சர் முதலான தன் இனத்தாரிடம் கலந்து எண்ணாத அரசன், சினத்தின் வழியில் சென்று சீறி நிற்பானானால், அவனுடைய செல்வம் சுருங்கும்.

translation:
Who builds no fort whence he may foe defy, In time of war shall fear and swiftly die

Meaning: The king who has not provided himself with a place of defence, will in times of war be seized with fear and quickly perish
pope_couplet: Who builds no fort whence he may foe defy, In time of war shall fear and swiftly die
explanation_en: The king who has not provided himself with a place of defence, will in times of war be seized with fear and quickly perish
explanation_ta: முன்னமே தக்கவாறு அரண் செய்து கொள்ளாத அரசன் போர் வந்த காலத்தில் (தற்காப்பு இல்லாமல்) அஞ்சி விரைவில் அழிவான்.

translation:
Tyrants with fools their counsels share:Earth can no heavier burthen bear

Meaning: The earth bears up no greater burden than ignorant men whom a cruel sceptre attaches to itself (as the ministers of its evil deeds)
pope_couplet: Tyrants with fools their counsels share:Earth can no heavier burthen bear
explanation_en: The earth bears up no greater burden than ignorant men whom a cruel sceptre attaches to itself (as the ministers of its evil deeds)
explanation_ta: கடுங்கோலாகிய ஆட்சிமுறை கல்லாதவரைத் தனக்கு அரணாகச் சேர்த்துக் கொள்ளும், அது தவிர நிலத்திற்கு சுமை வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Since true benignity, that grace exceeding great, residesIn kingly souls, world in happy state abides

Meaning: The world exists through that greatest ornament (of princes), a gracious demeanour
pope_couplet: Since true benignity, that grace exceeding great, residesIn kingly souls, world in happy state abides
explanation_en: The world exists through that greatest ornament (of princes), a gracious demeanour
explanation_ta: கண்ணோட்டம் என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற மிகச் சிறந்த அழகு இருக்கும் காரணத்தால் தான், இந்த உலகம் அழியாமல் இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
The world goes on its wonted way, since grace benign is there; All other men are burthen for the earth to bear

Meaning: The prosperity of the world springs from the kindliness, the existence of those who have no (kindliness) is a burden to the earth
pope_couplet: The world goes on its wonted way, since grace benign is there; All other men are burthen for the earth to bear
explanation_en: The prosperity of the world springs from the kindliness, the existence of those who have no (kindliness) is a burden to the earth
explanation_ta: கண்ணோட்டத்தினால் உலகியல் நடைபெறுகின்றது, கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாதவர் உயிரோடு இருத்தல் நிலத்திற்குச் சுமையே தவிர வேறு பயனில்லை.

translation:
Where not accordant with the song, what use of sounding chordsWhat gain of eye that no benignant light affords

Meaning: Of what avail is a song if it be inconsistent with harmony ? what is the use of eyes which possess no kindliness
pope_couplet: Where not accordant with the song, what use of sounding chordsWhat gain of eye that no benignant light affords
explanation_en: Of what avail is a song if it be inconsistent with harmony ? what is the use of eyes which possess no kindliness
explanation_ta: பாடலோடு பொருந்துதல் இல்லையானால் இசை என்ன பயனுடையதாகும், அதுபோல் கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாவிட்டால் கண் என்ன பயனுடையதாகும்.

translation:
The seeming eye of face gives no expressive light, When not with duly meted kindness bright

Meaning: Beyond appearing to be in the face, what good do they do, those eyes in which is no well-regulated kindness ?
pope_couplet: The seeming eye of face gives no expressive light, When not with duly meted kindness bright
explanation_en: Beyond appearing to be in the face, what good do they do, those eyes in which is no well-regulated kindness ?
explanation_ta: தக்க அளவிற்குக் கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாத கண்கள் முகத்தில் உள்ளவை போல் தோன்றுதல் அல்லாமல் வேறு என்ன பயன் செய்யும்.

translation:
Benignity is eyes' adorning grace; Without it eyes are wounds disfiguring face

Meaning: Kind looks are the ornaments of the eyes; without these they will be considered (by the wise) to be merely two sores
pope_couplet: Benignity is eyes' adorning grace; Without it eyes are wounds disfiguring face
explanation_en: Kind looks are the ornaments of the eyes; without these they will be considered (by the wise) to be merely two sores
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய கண்ணுக்கு அணிகலமாவது கண்ணோட்டம் என்னும் பண்பே, அஃது இல்லையானால் புண் என்று உணரப்படும்.

translation:
Whose eyes 'neath brow infixed diffuse no rayOf grace; like tree in earth infixed are they

Meaning: They resemble the trees of the earth, who although they have eyes, never look kindly (on others)
pope_couplet: Whose eyes 'neath brow infixed diffuse no rayOf grace; like tree in earth infixed are they
explanation_en: They resemble the trees of the earth, who although they have eyes, never look kindly (on others)
explanation_ta: கண்ணோட்டதிற்க்கு உரிய கண்ணோடுப் பொருந்தி இருந்தும் கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாதவர் (கண் இருந்தும் காணாத ) மரத்தினைப் போன்றவர்.

translation:
Eyeless are they whose eyes with no benignant lustre shine; Who've eyes can never lack the light of grace benign

Meaning: Men without kind looks are men without eyes; those who (really) have eyes are also not devoid of kind looks
pope_couplet: Eyeless are they whose eyes with no benignant lustre shine; Who've eyes can never lack the light of grace benign
explanation_en: Men without kind looks are men without eyes; those who (really) have eyes are also not devoid of kind looks
explanation_ta: கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாத மக்கள் கண் இல்லாதவரே ஆவர், கண் உடைய மக்கள் கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லா திருத்தலும் இல்லை.

translation:
Who can benignant smile, yet leave no work undone; By them as very own may all the earth be won

Meaning: The world is theirs (kings) who are able to show kindness, without injury to their affairs, (administration of justice)
pope_couplet: Who can benignant smile, yet leave no work undone; By them as very own may all the earth be won
explanation_en: The world is theirs (kings) who are able to show kindness, without injury to their affairs, (administration of justice)
explanation_ta: தம் தம் கடமையாகிய தொழில் கெடாமல் கண்ணோட்டம் உடையவராக இருக்க வல்லவர்க்கு இவ்வுலகம் உரிமை உடையது.

translation:
To smile on those that vex, with kindly face, Enduring long, is most excelling grace

Meaning: Patiently to bear with, and show kindness to those who grieve us, is the most excellent of all dispositions
pope_couplet: To smile on those that vex, with kindly face, Enduring long, is most excelling grace
explanation_en: Patiently to bear with, and show kindness to those who grieve us, is the most excellent of all dispositions
explanation_ta: தண்டித்தற்குரிய தன்மை உடையவரிடத்திலும் கண்ணோட்டம் செய்து ( அவர் செய்த குற்றத்தைப்) பொருத்துக் காக்கும் பண்பே சிறந்தது.

translation:
They drink with smiling grace, though poison interfused they see, Who seek the praise of all-esteemed courtesy

Meaning: Those who desire (to cultivate that degree of) urbanity which all shall love, even after swallowing the poison served to them by their friends, will be friendly with them
pope_couplet: They drink with smiling grace, though poison interfused they see, Who seek the praise of all-esteemed courtesy
explanation_en: Those who desire (to cultivate that degree of) urbanity which all shall love, even after swallowing the poison served to them by their friends, will be friendly with them
explanation_ta: எவராலும் விரும்பத்தக்க நாகரிகமான கண்ணோட்டத்தை விரும்புகின்றவர், பழகியவர் தமக்கு நஞ்சு இடக்கண்டும் அதை உண்டு அமைவர்.

translation:
These two: the code renowned and spies, In these let king confide as eyes

Meaning: Let a king consider as his eyes these two things, a spy and a book (of laws) universally esteemed
pope_couplet: These two: the code renowned and spies, In these let king confide as eyes
explanation_en: Let a king consider as his eyes these two things, a spy and a book (of laws) universally esteemed
explanation_ta: ஒற்றரும் புகழ் அமைந்த நீதிநூலும் ஆகிய இவ்விருவகைக் கருவிகளையும் அரசன் தன்னுடைய கண்களாகத் தெளியவேணடும்.

translation:
Each day, of every subject every deed,'Tis duty of the king to learn with speed

Meaning: 'Tis duty of the king to learn with speed
pope_couplet: Each day, of every subject every deed,'Tis duty of the king to learn with speed
explanation_en: 'Tis duty of the king to learn with speed
explanation_ta: எல்லாரிடத்திலும் நிகழ்கின்றவை எல்லாவற்றையும் எக்காலத்திலும் (ஒற்றரைக் கொண்டு) விரைந்து அறிதல் அரசனுக்குரிய தொழிலாகும்.

translation:
By spies who spies, not weighing things they bring, Nothing can victory give to that unwary king

Meaning: There is no way for a king to obtain conquests, who knows not the advantage of discoveries made by a spy
pope_couplet: By spies who spies, not weighing things they bring, Nothing can victory give to that unwary king
explanation_en: There is no way for a king to obtain conquests, who knows not the advantage of discoveries made by a spy
explanation_ta: ஒற்றரால் (நாட்டு நிகழ்ச்சிகளை) அறிந்து அவற்றின் பயனை ஆராய்ந்துணராத அரசன் வெற்றிபெறத்தக்க வழி வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
His officers, his friends, his enemies, All these who watch are trusty spies

Meaning: He is a spy who watches all men, to wit, those who are in the king's employment, his relatives, and his enemies
pope_couplet: His officers, his friends, his enemies, All these who watch are trusty spies
explanation_en: He is a spy who watches all men, to wit, those who are in the king's employment, his relatives, and his enemies
explanation_ta: தம்முடைய தொழிலைச் செய்கின்றவர், தம் சுற்றத்தார், தம் பகைவர் என்றுக்கூறப்படும் எல்லாரையும் ஆராய்வதே ஒற்றரின் தொழிலாகும்.

translation:
Of unsuspected mien and all-unfearing eyes, Who let no secret out, are trusty spies

Meaning: A spy is one who is able to assume an appearance which may create no suspicion (in the minds of others), who fears no man's face, and who never reveals (his purpose)
pope_couplet: Of unsuspected mien and all-unfearing eyes, Who let no secret out, are trusty spies
explanation_en: A spy is one who is able to assume an appearance which may create no suspicion (in the minds of others), who fears no man's face, and who never reveals (his purpose)
explanation_ta: ஐயுற முடியாத உருவத்தோடு, பார்த்தவருடைய கண் பார்வைக்கு அஞ்சாமல் எவ்விடத்திலும் மனதிலுள்ளதை வெளிப்படுத்தாமல் இருக்க வல்லவனே ஒற்றன் ஆவன்.

translation:
As monk or devotee, through every hindrance making way, A spy, whate'er men do, must watchful mind display

Meaning: He is a spy who, assuming the appearance of an ascetic, goes into (whatever place he wishes), examines into (all, that is needful), and never discovers himself, whatever may be done to him
pope_couplet: As monk or devotee, through every hindrance making way, A spy, whate'er men do, must watchful mind display
explanation_en: He is a spy who, assuming the appearance of an ascetic, goes into (whatever place he wishes), examines into (all, that is needful), and never discovers himself, whatever may be done to him
explanation_ta: துறந்தவரின் வடிவத்தை உடையவராய், அறிய இடங்களிலெல்லாம் சென்று ஆராய்ந்து (ஐயுற்றவர்) என்ன செய்தாலும் சோர்ந்து விடாதவரே ஒற்றர் ஆவர்.

translation:
A spy must search each hidden matter out, And full report must render, free from doubt

Meaning: A spy is one who is able to discover what is hidden and who retains no doubt concerning what he has known
pope_couplet: A spy must search each hidden matter out, And full report must render, free from doubt
explanation_en: A spy is one who is able to discover what is hidden and who retains no doubt concerning what he has known
explanation_ta: மறைந்த செய்திகளையும் கேட்டறிய வல்லவனாய் அறிந்த செய்திகளை ஐயப்படாமல் துணிய வல்லவனாய் உள்ளவனே ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.

translation:
Spying by spies, the things they tellTo test by other spies is well

Meaning: Let not a king receive the information which a spy has discovered and made known to him, until he has examined it by another spy
pope_couplet: Spying by spies, the things they tellTo test by other spies is well
explanation_en: Let not a king receive the information which a spy has discovered and made known to him, until he has examined it by another spy
explanation_ta: ஓர் ஒற்றன் மறைந்து கேட்டுத் தெரிவித்தச் செய்தியையும் மற்றோர் ஒற்றனால் கேட்டு வரச் செய்து ஒப்புமை கண்டபின் உண்மை என்றுக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
One spy must not another see: contrive it so; And things by three confirmed as truth you know

Meaning: Let a king employ spies so that one may have no knowledge of the other; and when the information of three agrees together, let him receive it
pope_couplet: One spy must not another see: contrive it so; And things by three confirmed as truth you know
explanation_en: Let a king employ spies so that one may have no knowledge of the other; and when the information of three agrees together, let him receive it
explanation_ta: ஓர் ஒற்றனை மற்றோர் ஒற்றன் அறியாதபடி ஆள வேண்டும், அவ்வாறு ஆளப்பட்ட ஒற்றர் மூவரின் சொல் ஒத்திருந்தால் அவை உண்மை எனத் தெளியப்படும்.

translation:
Reward not trusty spy in others' sight, Or all the mystery will come to light

Meaning: Let not a king publicly confer on a spy any marks of his favour; if he does, he will divulge his own secret
pope_couplet: Reward not trusty spy in others' sight, Or all the mystery will come to light
explanation_en: Let not a king publicly confer on a spy any marks of his favour; if he does, he will divulge his own secret
explanation_ta: ஒற்றனிடத்தில் செய்யும் சிறப்பைப் பிறர் அறியுமாறு செய்யக்கூடாது, செய்தால் மறைபொருளைத்தானே வெளிப்படுத்தியவன் ஆவான்.

translation:
'Tis energy gives men o'er that they own a true control; They nothing own who own not energy of soul

Meaning: Energy makes out the man of property; as for those who are destitute of it, do they (really) possess what they possess ?
pope_couplet: 'Tis energy gives men o'er that they own a true control; They nothing own who own not energy of soul
explanation_en: Energy makes out the man of property; as for those who are destitute of it, do they (really) possess what they possess ?
explanation_ta: ஒருவர் பெற்றிருக்கின்றார் என்று சொல்லத்தக்க சிறப்புடையது ஊக்கமாகும், ஊக்கம் இல்லாதவர் வேறு எதைப் பெற்றிருந்தாலும் அதை உடையவர் ஆவரோ.

translation:
The wealth of mind man owns a real worth imparts, Material wealth man owns endures not, utterly departs

Meaning: The possession of (energy of) mind is true property; the possession of wealth passes away and abides not
pope_couplet: The wealth of mind man owns a real worth imparts, Material wealth man owns endures not, utterly departs
explanation_en: The possession of (energy of) mind is true property; the possession of wealth passes away and abides not
explanation_ta: ஒருவர்க்கு ஊக்கமுடைமையே நிலையான உடைமையாகும், மற்றப் பொருளுடைமையானது நிலைபேறு இல்லாமல் நீங்கிவிடுவதாகும்.

translation:
'Lost is our wealth,' they utter not this cry distressed, The men of firm concentred energy of soul possessed

Meaning: They who are possessed of enduring energy will not trouble themselves, saying, "we have lost our property."
pope_couplet: 'Lost is our wealth,' they utter not this cry distressed, The men of firm concentred energy of soul possessed
explanation_en: They who are possessed of enduring energy will not trouble themselves, saying, "we have lost our property."
explanation_ta: ஊக்கத்தை உறுதியாகத் தம்கைப் பொருளாக உடையவர், ஆக்கம்( இழந்து விட்டக்காலத்திலும்) இழந்து விட்டோம் என்று கலங்க மாட்டார்.

translation:
The man of energy of soul inflexible, Good fortune seeks him out and comes a friend to dwell

Meaning: Wealth will find its own way to the man of unfailing energy
pope_couplet: The man of energy of soul inflexible, Good fortune seeks him out and comes a friend to dwell
explanation_en: Wealth will find its own way to the man of unfailing energy
explanation_ta: சோர்வு இல்லாத ஊக்கம் உடையவனிடத்தில் ஆக்கமானது தானே அவன் உள்ள இடத்திற்கு வழிக் கேட்டுக்கொண்டு போய்ச் சேரும்.

translation:
With rising flood the rising lotus flower its stem unwinds; The dignity of men is measured by their minds

Meaning: The stalks of water-flowers are proportionate to the depth of water; so is men's greatness proportionate to their minds
pope_couplet: With rising flood the rising lotus flower its stem unwinds; The dignity of men is measured by their minds
explanation_en: The stalks of water-flowers are proportionate to the depth of water; so is men's greatness proportionate to their minds
explanation_ta: நீர்ப்பூக்களின் தாளின் நீளம் அவை நின்ற நீரின் அளவினவாகும், மக்களின் ஊக்கத்தை அளவினதாகும் வாழ்க்கையின் உயர்வு.

translation:
Whate'er you ponder, let your aim be loftly still, Fate cannot hinder always, thwart you as it will

Meaning: In all that a king thinks of, let him think of his greatness; and if it should be thrust from him (by fate), it will have the nature of not being thrust from him
pope_couplet: Whate'er you ponder, let your aim be loftly still, Fate cannot hinder always, thwart you as it will
explanation_en: In all that a king thinks of, let him think of his greatness; and if it should be thrust from him (by fate), it will have the nature of not being thrust from him
explanation_ta: எண்ணுவதெல்லாம் உயர்வைப்பற்றியே எண்ண வேண்டும், அவ் வுயர்வுக் கைகூடாவிட்டாலும் அவ்வாறு எண்ணுவதை விடக்கூடாது.

translation:
The men of lofty mind quail not in ruin's fateful hour, The elephant retains his dignity mind arrows' deadly shower

Meaning: The strong minded will not faint, even when all is lost; the elephant stands firm, even when wounded by a shower of arrows
pope_couplet: The men of lofty mind quail not in ruin's fateful hour, The elephant retains his dignity mind arrows' deadly shower
explanation_en: The strong minded will not faint, even when all is lost; the elephant stands firm, even when wounded by a shower of arrows
explanation_ta: உடம்பை மறைக்குமளவு அம்புகளால் புண்பட்டும் யானைத் தன் பெருமையை நிலைநிறுத்தும், அதுபோல் ஊக்கம் உடையவர் அழிவு வந்தவிடத்திலும் தளர மாட்டார்.

translation:
The soulless man can never gainTh' ennobling sense of power with men

Meaning: Those who have no (greatness of) mind, will not acquire the joy of saying in the world, "we have excercised liaberality"
pope_couplet: The soulless man can never gainTh' ennobling sense of power with men
explanation_en: Those who have no (greatness of) mind, will not acquire the joy of saying in the world, "we have excercised liaberality"
explanation_ta: ஊக்கம் இல்லாதவர் இவ்வுலகில் யாம் வண்மை உடையேம் என்றுத் தம்மைத் தான் எண்ணி மகிழும் மகிழ்ச்சியை அடையமாடடார்.

translation:
Huge bulk of elephant with pointed tusk all armed, When tiger threatens shrinks away alarmed

Meaning: Although the elephant has a large body, and a sharp tusk, yet it fears the attack of the tiger
pope_couplet: Huge bulk of elephant with pointed tusk all armed, When tiger threatens shrinks away alarmed
explanation_en: Although the elephant has a large body, and a sharp tusk, yet it fears the attack of the tiger
explanation_ta: யானை பருத்த உடம்பை உடையது, கூர்மையானக் கொம்புகளை உடையது, ஆயினும் ஊக்கமுள்ளதாகியப் புலி தாக்கினால் அதற்கு அஞ்சும்.

translation:
Firmness of soul in man is real excellance; Others are trees, their human form a mere pretence

Meaning: Energy is mental wealth; those men who are destitute of it are only trees in the form of men
pope_couplet: Firmness of soul in man is real excellance; Others are trees, their human form a mere pretence
explanation_en: Energy is mental wealth; those men who are destitute of it are only trees in the form of men
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு வலிமையானது ஊக்க மிகுதியே, அவ்வூக்கம் இல்லாதவர் மரங்களே, (வடிவால்) மக்களைப் போல் இருத்தலே வேறுபாடு.

translation:
Of household dignity the lustre beaming bright, Flickers and dies when sluggish foulness dims its light

Meaning: By the darkness, of idleness, the indestructible lamp of family (rank) will be extinguished
pope_couplet: Of household dignity the lustre beaming bright, Flickers and dies when sluggish foulness dims its light
explanation_en: By the darkness, of idleness, the indestructible lamp of family (rank) will be extinguished
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு தன் குடியாகிய மங்காத விளக்கு, அவனுடைய சோம்பலாகிய மாசு படிய படிய ஒளி மங்கிக் கெட்டுவிடும்.

translation:
Let indolence, the death of effort, die, If you'd uphold your household's dignity

Meaning: Let those, who desire that their family may be illustrious, put away all idleness from their conduct
pope_couplet: Let indolence, the death of effort, die, If you'd uphold your household's dignity
explanation_en: Let those, who desire that their family may be illustrious, put away all idleness from their conduct
explanation_ta: தம் குடியைச் சிறப்புடைய குடியாக விளங்குமாறு செய்ய விரும்புகின்றவர் சோம்பலைச் சோம்பலாகக் கொண்டு முயற்சியுடையவராய் நடக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who fosters indolence within his breast, the silly elf!The house from which he springs shall perish ere himself

Meaning: The (lustre of the) family of the ignorant man, who acts under the influence of destructive laziness will perish, even before he is dead
pope_couplet: Who fosters indolence within his breast, the silly elf!The house from which he springs shall perish ere himself
explanation_en: The (lustre of the) family of the ignorant man, who acts under the influence of destructive laziness will perish, even before he is dead
explanation_ta: அழிக்கும் இயல்புடைய சோம்பலைத் தன்னிடம் கொண்டு நடக்கும் அறிவவில்லாதவன் பிறந்த குடி அவனுக்கு முன் அழிந்துவிடும்.

translation:
His family decays, and faults unheeded thrive, Who, sunk in sloth, for noble objects doth not strive

Meaning: Family (greatness) will be destroyed, and faults will increase, in those men who give way to laziness, and put forth no dignified exertions
pope_couplet: His family decays, and faults unheeded thrive, Who, sunk in sloth, for noble objects doth not strive
explanation_en: Family (greatness) will be destroyed, and faults will increase, in those men who give way to laziness, and put forth no dignified exertions
explanation_ta: சோம்பலில் அகப்பட்டு சிறந்த முயற்சி இல்லாதவராய் வாழ்கின்றவர்க்கு குடியின் பெருமை அழிந்து குற்றம் பெருகும்.

translation:
Delay, oblivion, sloth, and sleep: these fourAre pleasure-boat to bear the doomed to ruin's shore

Meaning: Procrastination, forgetfulness, idleness, and sleep, these four things, form the vessel which is desired by those destined to destruction
pope_couplet: Delay, oblivion, sloth, and sleep: these fourAre pleasure-boat to bear the doomed to ruin's shore
explanation_en: Procrastination, forgetfulness, idleness, and sleep, these four things, form the vessel which is desired by those destined to destruction
explanation_ta: காலம் நீட்டித்தல், சோம்பல், மறதி, அளவு மீறியத் தூக்கம் ஆகிய இந் நான்கும் கெடுகின்ற இயல்புடையவர் விரும்பி ஏறும் மரக்கலமாம்.

translation:
Though lords of earth unearned possessions gain, The slothful ones no yield of good obtain

Meaning: It is a rare thing for the idle, even when possessed of the riches of kings who ruled over the whole earth, to derive any great benefit from it
pope_couplet: Though lords of earth unearned possessions gain, The slothful ones no yield of good obtain
explanation_en: It is a rare thing for the idle, even when possessed of the riches of kings who ruled over the whole earth, to derive any great benefit from it
explanation_ta: நாட்டை ஆளும் தலைவருடைய உறவுத் தானே வந்து சேர்ந்தாலும், சோம்பல் உடையவர் சிறந்த பயனை அடைய முடியாது.

translation:
Who hug their sloth, nor noble works attempt, Shall bear reproofs and words of just contempt

Meaning: Those who through idleness, and do not engage themselves in dignified exertion, will subject
pope_couplet: Who hug their sloth, nor noble works attempt, Shall bear reproofs and words of just contempt
explanation_en: Those who through idleness, and do not engage themselves in dignified exertion, will subject
explanation_ta: சோம்பலை விரும்பி மேற்க் கொண்டு சிறந்த முயற்சி இல்லாதவராய் வாழ்கின்றவர் பிறர் இடித்துக் கூறி இகழ்கின்ற சொல்லைக் கேட்கும் நிலைமை அடைவர்.

translation:
If sloth a dwelling find mid noble family, Bondsmen to them that hate them shall they be

Meaning: If idleness take up its abode in a king of high birth, it will make him a slave of his enemies
pope_couplet: If sloth a dwelling find mid noble family, Bondsmen to them that hate them shall they be
explanation_en: If idleness take up its abode in a king of high birth, it will make him a slave of his enemies
explanation_ta: சோம்பல் நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்தவனிடம் வந்து பொருந்தினால், அஃது அவனை அவனுடைய பகைவர்க்கு அடிமையாகுமாறு செய்துவிடும்.

translation:
Who changes slothful habits savesHimself from all that household rule depraves

Meaning: When a man puts away idleness, the reproach which has come upon himself and his family will disappear
pope_couplet: Who changes slothful habits savesHimself from all that household rule depraves
explanation_en: When a man puts away idleness, the reproach which has come upon himself and his family will disappear
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் சோம்பலை ஆளுந் தன்மையை மாற்றிவிட்டால் அவனுடைய குடியிலும் ஆண்மையிலும் வந்தக் குற்றம் தீர்ந்து விடும்.

translation:
The king whose life from sluggishness is rid, Shall rule o'er all by foot of mighty god bestrid

Meaning: The king who never gives way to idleness will obtain entire possession of (the whole earth) passed over by him who measured (the worlds) with His foot
pope_couplet: The king whose life from sluggishness is rid, Shall rule o'er all by foot of mighty god bestrid
explanation_en: The king who never gives way to idleness will obtain entire possession of (the whole earth) passed over by him who measured (the worlds) with His foot
explanation_ta: அடியால் உலகத்தை அளந்த கடவுள் தாவியப் பரப்பு எல்லாவற்றையும் சோம்பல் இல்லாத அரசன் ஒரு சேர அடைவான்.

translation:
Say not, 'Tis hard', in weak, desponding hour, For strenuous effort gives prevailing power

Meaning: Yield not to the feebleness which says, "this is too difficult to be done"; labour will give the greatness (of mind) which is necessary (to do it)
pope_couplet: Say not, 'Tis hard', in weak, desponding hour, For strenuous effort gives prevailing power
explanation_en: Yield not to the feebleness which says, "this is too difficult to be done"; labour will give the greatness (of mind) which is necessary (to do it)
explanation_ta: இது செய்வதற்கு அருமையாகாது என்று சோர்வுறாமல் இருக்க வேண்டும், அதைச் செய்வதற்க்குத் தக்க பெருமையை முயற்சி உண்டாக்கும்,

translation:
In action be thou, 'ware of act's defeat; The world leaves those who work leave incomplete

Meaning: Take care not to give up exertion in the midst of a work; the world will abandon those who abandon their unfinished work
pope_couplet: In action be thou, 'ware of act's defeat; The world leaves those who work leave incomplete
explanation_en: Take care not to give up exertion in the midst of a work; the world will abandon those who abandon their unfinished work
explanation_ta: தொழிலாகிய குறையைச் செய்யாமல் கைவிட்டவரை உலகம் கைவிடும், ஆகையால் தொழில் முயற்சி இல்லாதிருத்தலை ஒழிக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
In strenuous effort doth resideThe power of helping others: noble pride

Meaning: The lustre of munificence will dwell only with the dignity of laboriousness or efforts
pope_couplet: In strenuous effort doth resideThe power of helping others: noble pride
explanation_en: The lustre of munificence will dwell only with the dignity of laboriousness or efforts
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு உதவிசெய்தல் என்னும் மேம்பட்ட நிலைமை முயற்சி என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற உயர்ந்த பண்பில் நிலைத்திருக்கின்றது.

translation:
Beneficent intent in men by whom no strenuous work is wrought, Like battle-axe in sexless being's hand availeth nought

Meaning: The liberality of him, who does not labour, will fail, like the manliness of a hermaphrodite, who has a sword in its hand
pope_couplet: Beneficent intent in men by whom no strenuous work is wrought, Like battle-axe in sexless being's hand availeth nought
explanation_en: The liberality of him, who does not labour, will fail, like the manliness of a hermaphrodite, who has a sword in its hand
explanation_ta: முயற்சி இல்லாதவன் உதவிசெய்பவனாக இருத்தல், பேடி தன் கையில் வாளை எடுத்தும் ஆளும் தன்மைபோல் நிறைவேறாமல் போகும்.

translation:
Whose heart delighteth not in pleasure, but in action finds delight, He wipes away his kinsmen's grief and stands the pillar of their might

Meaning: He who desires not pleasure, but desires labour, will be a pillar to sustain his relations, wiping away their sorrows
pope_couplet: Whose heart delighteth not in pleasure, but in action finds delight, He wipes away his kinsmen's grief and stands the pillar of their might
explanation_en: He who desires not pleasure, but desires labour, will be a pillar to sustain his relations, wiping away their sorrows
explanation_ta: தன் இன்பத்தை விரும்பாதவனாய் மேற்க்கொண்டச் செயலை முடிக்க விரும்புகிறவன், தன் சுற்றத்தாரின் துன்பத்தைப் போக்கித் தாங்குகின்ற தூண் ஆவான்.

translation:
Effort brings fortune's sure increase, Its absence brings to nothingness

Meaning: Labour will produce wealth; idleness will bring poverty
pope_couplet: Effort brings fortune's sure increase, Its absence brings to nothingness
explanation_en: Labour will produce wealth; idleness will bring poverty
explanation_ta: முயற்சி ஒருவனுக்குச் செல்வத்தைப் பெருகச் செய்யும், முயற்சி இல்லாதிருத்தல் அவனுக்கு வறுமையைச் சேர்த்துவிடும்.

translation:
In sluggishness is seen misfortune's lurid form, the wise declare; Where man unslothful toils, she of the lotus flower is there

Meaning: They say that the black Mudevi (the goddess of adversity) dwells with laziness, and the Latchmi (the goddess of prosperity) dwells with the labour of the industrious
pope_couplet: In sluggishness is seen misfortune's lurid form, the wise declare; Where man unslothful toils, she of the lotus flower is there
explanation_en: They say that the black Mudevi (the goddess of adversity) dwells with laziness, and the Latchmi (the goddess of prosperity) dwells with the labour of the industrious
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய சோம்பலில் கரிய மூதேவி வாழ்கின்றாள், சோம்பல் இல்லாதவனுடைய முயற்சியிலே திருமகள் வாழ்கின்றாள்.

translation:
'Tis no reproach unpropitious fate should ban; But not to do man's work is foul disgrace to man

Meaning: Adverse fate is no disgrace to any one; to be without exertion and without knowing what should be known, is disgrace
pope_couplet: 'Tis no reproach unpropitious fate should ban; But not to do man's work is foul disgrace to man
explanation_en: Adverse fate is no disgrace to any one; to be without exertion and without knowing what should be known, is disgrace
explanation_ta: நன்மை விளைவிக்கும் ஊழ் இல்லாதிருத்தல் யார்க்கும் பழி அன்று, அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறிந்து முயற்சி செய்யாதிருத்தலே பழி.

translation:
Though fate-divine should make your labour vain; Effort its labour's sure reward will gain

Meaning: Although it be said that, through fate, it cannot be attained, yet labour, with bodily exertion, will yield its reward
pope_couplet: Though fate-divine should make your labour vain; Effort its labour's sure reward will gain
explanation_en: Although it be said that, through fate, it cannot be attained, yet labour, with bodily exertion, will yield its reward
explanation_ta: ஊழியின் காரணத்தால் ஒரு செயல் செய்ய முடியாமல் போகுமாயினும், முயற்சி தன் உடம்பு வருந்திய வருத்தத்தின் கூலியையாவது கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Who strive with undismayed, unfaltering mind, At length shall leave opposing fate behind

Meaning: They who labour on, without fear and without fainting will see even fate (put) behind their back
pope_couplet: Who strive with undismayed, unfaltering mind, At length shall leave opposing fate behind
explanation_en: They who labour on, without fear and without fainting will see even fate (put) behind their back
explanation_ta: சோர்வு இல்லாமல் முயற்சியில் குறைவு இல்லாமல் முயல்கின்றவர்,(செயலுக்கு இடையூறாக வரும்)ஊழையும் ஒரு காலத்தில் தோல்வியுறச் செய்யும்.

translation:
Smile, with patient, hopeful heart, in troublous hour; Meet and so vanquish grief; nothing hath equal power

Meaning: If troubles come, laugh; there is nothing like that, to press upon and drive away sorrow
pope_couplet: Smile, with patient, hopeful heart, in troublous hour; Meet and so vanquish grief; nothing hath equal power
explanation_en: If troubles come, laugh; there is nothing like that, to press upon and drive away sorrow
explanation_ta: துன்பம் வரும்போது (அதற்காக கலங்காமல்) நகுதல் வேண்டும், அத் துன்பத்தை எதிர்த்து வெல்லவல்லது அதைப் போன்றது வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Though sorrow, like a flood, comes rolling on, When wise men's mind regards it,- it is gone

Meaning: A flood of troubles will be overcome by the (courageous) thought which the minds of the wise will entertain, even in sorrow
pope_couplet: Though sorrow, like a flood, comes rolling on, When wise men's mind regards it,- it is gone
explanation_en: A flood of troubles will be overcome by the (courageous) thought which the minds of the wise will entertain, even in sorrow
explanation_ta: வெள்ளம் போல் அளவற்றதாய் வரும் துன்பமும், அறிவுடையவன் தன் உள்ளத்தினால் அத் துன்பத்தின் இயல்பை நினைத்த அளவில் கெடும்.

translation:
Who griefs confront with meek, ungrieving heart, From them griefs, put to grief, depart

Meaning: They give sorrow to sorrow, who in sorrow do not suffer sorrow
pope_couplet: Who griefs confront with meek, ungrieving heart, From them griefs, put to grief, depart
explanation_en: They give sorrow to sorrow, who in sorrow do not suffer sorrow
explanation_ta: துன்பம் வந்த போது அதற்க்காக வருந்திக் கலங்காதவர் அந்தத் துன்பத்திற்கே துன்பம் உண்டாக்கி அதை வென்று விடுவார்.

translation:
Like bullock struggle on through each obstructed way; From such an one will troubles, troubled, roll away

Meaning: Troubles will vanish (i.e., will be troubled) before the man who (struggles against difficulties) as a
pope_couplet: Like bullock struggle on through each obstructed way; From such an one will troubles, troubled, roll away
explanation_en: Troubles will vanish (i.e., will be troubled) before the man who (struggles against difficulties) as a
explanation_ta: தடைபட்ட இடங்களில் எல்லாம் (வண்டியை இழுத்துச் செல்லும்) எருதுபோல் விடாமுயற்சி உடையவன் உற்றத் துன்பமே துன்பப்படுவதாகும்.

translation:
When griefs press on, but fail to crush the patient heart, Then griefs defeated, put to grief, depart

Meaning: The troubles of that man will be troubled (and disappear) who, however thickly they may come upon him, does not abandon (his purpose)
pope_couplet: When griefs press on, but fail to crush the patient heart, Then griefs defeated, put to grief, depart
explanation_en: The troubles of that man will be troubled (and disappear) who, however thickly they may come upon him, does not abandon (his purpose)
explanation_ta: விடாமல் மேன் மேலும் துன்பம் வந்தபோதிலும் கலங்காமலிருக்கும் ஆற்றலுடையவன் அடைந்த துன்பமே துன்பப்பட்டு போகும்.

translation:
Who boasted not of wealth, nor gave it all their heart, Will not bemoan the loss, when prosperous days depart

Meaning: Will those men ever cry out in sorrow, "we are destitute" who, (in their prosperity), give not way to (undue desire) to keep their wealth
pope_couplet: Who boasted not of wealth, nor gave it all their heart, Will not bemoan the loss, when prosperous days depart
explanation_en: Will those men ever cry out in sorrow, "we are destitute" who, (in their prosperity), give not way to (undue desire) to keep their wealth
explanation_ta: செல்வம் வந்த போது இதைப்பெற்றோமே என்று பற்றுக்கொண்டு காத்தறியாதவர் வறுமை வந்த போது இழந்தோமே என்று அல்லல்படுவரோ.

translation:
'Man's frame is sorrow's target', the noble mind reflects, Nor meets with troubled mind the sorrows it expects

Meaning: The great will not regard trouble as trouble, knowing that the body is the butt of trouble
pope_couplet: 'Man's frame is sorrow's target', the noble mind reflects, Nor meets with troubled mind the sorrows it expects
explanation_en: The great will not regard trouble as trouble, knowing that the body is the butt of trouble
explanation_ta: மேலோர், உடம்பு துன்பத்திற்கு இலக்கமானது என்று உணர்ந்து, (துன்பம் வந்த போது) கலங்குவதை ஒழுக்க நெறியாகக் கொள்ளமாட்டர்.

translation:
He seeks not joy, to sorrow man is born, he knows; Such man will walk unharmed by touch of human woes

Meaning: That man never experiences sorrow, who does not seek for pleasure, and who considers distress to be natural (to man)
pope_couplet: He seeks not joy, to sorrow man is born, he knows; Such man will walk unharmed by touch of human woes
explanation_en: That man never experiences sorrow, who does not seek for pleasure, and who considers distress to be natural (to man)
explanation_ta: இன்பமானதை விரும்பாதவனாய்த் துன்பம் இயற்கையானது என்று தெளிந்திருப்பவன், துன்பம் வந்த போது துன்ப முறுவது இல்லை.

translation:
Mid joys he yields not heart to joys' controlMid sorrows, sorrow cannot touch his soul

Meaning: He does not suffer sorrow, in sorrow who does not look for pleasure in pleasure
pope_couplet: Mid joys he yields not heart to joys' controlMid sorrows, sorrow cannot touch his soul
explanation_en: He does not suffer sorrow, in sorrow who does not look for pleasure in pleasure
explanation_ta: இன்பம் வந்திக் காலத்தில் அந்த இன்பத்தை விரும்பிப் போற்றாதவன் துன்பம் வந்த காலத்தில் அந்தத் துன்பத்தை அடைவது இல்லை.

translation:
Who pain as pleasure takes, he shall acquireThe bliss to which his foes in vain aspire

Meaning: The elevation, which even his enemies will esteem, will be gained by him, who regards pain as pleasure
pope_couplet: Who pain as pleasure takes, he shall acquireThe bliss to which his foes in vain aspire
explanation_en: The elevation, which even his enemies will esteem, will be gained by him, who regards pain as pleasure
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் துன்பத்தையே தனக்கு இன்பமாகக் கருதிக்கொள்வானானால் அவனுடைய பகைவரும் விரும்பத்தக்க சிறப்பு உண்டாகும்.

translation:
A minister is he who grasps, with wisdom large, Means, time, work's mode, and functions rare he must discharge

Meaning: The minister is one who can make an excellent choice of means, time, manner of execution, and the difficult undertaking (itself)
pope_couplet: A minister is he who grasps, with wisdom large, Means, time, work's mode, and functions rare he must discharge
explanation_en: The minister is one who can make an excellent choice of means, time, manner of execution, and the difficult undertaking (itself)
explanation_ta: செயலுக்கு உரிய கருவியும், ஏற்றக் காலமும், செய்யும் வகையும் செய்யப்படும் அறியச் செயலும் சிறப்படையச் செய்ய வல்லவன் அமைச்சன்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
A minister must greatness own of guardian power, determined mind, Learn'd wisdom, manly effort with the former five combined

Meaning: The minister is one who in addition to the aforesaid five things excels in the possession of firmness,
pope_couplet: A minister must greatness own of guardian power, determined mind, Learn'd wisdom, manly effort with the former five combined
explanation_en: The minister is one who in addition to the aforesaid five things excels in the possession of firmness,
explanation_ta: அஞ்சாமையும், குடிபிறப்பும், காக்கும் திறனும், கற்றறிந்த அறிவும் முயற்சியும் ஆகிய இவ்வைந்தும் திருந்தப்பெற்றவன் அமைச்சன்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
A minister is he whose power can foes divide, Attach more firmly friends, of severed ones can heal the breaches wide

Meaning: The minister is one who can effect discord (among foes), maintain the good-will of his friends and restore to friendship those who have seceded (from him)
pope_couplet: A minister is he whose power can foes divide, Attach more firmly friends, of severed ones can heal the breaches wide
explanation_en: The minister is one who can effect discord (among foes), maintain the good-will of his friends and restore to friendship those who have seceded (from him)
explanation_ta: பகைவர்ககு துணையானவரைப் பிரித்தலும், தம்மிடம் உள்ளவரைக் காத்தலும், பிரிந்து கொண்டவரை மீண்டும் சேர்த்துக்கொள்ளலும் வல்லவன் அமைச்சன்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
A minister has power to see the methods help afford, To ponder long, then utter calm conclusive word

Meaning: The minister is one who is able to comprehend (the whole nature of an undertaking), execute it in the best manner possible, and offer assuring advice (in time of necessity)
pope_couplet: A minister has power to see the methods help afford, To ponder long, then utter calm conclusive word
explanation_en: The minister is one who is able to comprehend (the whole nature of an undertaking), execute it in the best manner possible, and offer assuring advice (in time of necessity)
explanation_ta: (செய்யத்தக்க செயலை) ஆராய்தலும், அதற்குரிய வழிகளை ஆராய்ந்து செய்தலும், துணிவாகக் கருத்தைச் சொல்லுதலும் வல்லவன் அமைச்சன்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
The man who virtue knows, has use of wise and pleasant wordsWith plans for every season apt, in counsel aid affords

Meaning: He is the best helper (of the king) who understanding the duties, of the latter, is by his special learning, able to tender the fullest advice, and at all times conversant with the best method (of
pope_couplet: The man who virtue knows, has use of wise and pleasant wordsWith plans for every season apt, in counsel aid affords
explanation_en: He is the best helper (of the king) who understanding the duties, of the latter, is by his special learning, able to tender the fullest advice, and at all times conversant with the best method (of
explanation_ta: அறத்தை அறிந்தவனாய், அறிவு நிறைந்து அமைந்த சொல்லை உடையவனாய், எக்காலத்திலும் செயல்செய்யும் திறன் அறிந்தவனாய் உள்ளவன் ஆராய்ந்து கூறும் துணையாவான்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
When native subtilty combines with sound scholastic lore,'Tis subtilty surpassing all, which nothing stands before

Meaning: What (contrivances) are there so acute as to resist those who possess natural acuteness in addition to learning ?
pope_couplet: When native subtilty combines with sound scholastic lore,'Tis subtilty surpassing all, which nothing stands before
explanation_en: What (contrivances) are there so acute as to resist those who possess natural acuteness in addition to learning ?
explanation_ta: இயற்கையான நுட்ப அறிவை நூலறிவோடு ஒருங்கே உடையவர்க்கு மிக்க நுட்பமான சூழ்ச்சிகளாய் முன் நிற்பவை எவை உள்ளன.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
Though knowing all that books can teach, 'tis truest tactTo follow common sense of men in act
