Meaning: Though you are acquainted with the (theoretical) methods (of performing an act), understand the ways of the world and act accordingly
pope_couplet: Though knowing all that books can teach, 'tis truest tactTo follow common sense of men in act
explanation_en: Though you are acquainted with the (theoretical) methods (of performing an act), understand the ways of the world and act accordingly
explanation_ta: நூலறிவால் செயலைச் செய்யும் வகைகளைச் அறிந்த போதிலும் உலகத்தின் இயற்கையை அறிந்து அதனோடு பொருந்துமாறு செய்யவேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
'Tis duty of the man in place aloud to sayThe very truth, though unwise king may cast his words away

Meaning: Although the king be utterly ignorant, it is the duty of the minister to give (him) sound advice
pope_couplet: 'Tis duty of the man in place aloud to sayThe very truth, though unwise king may cast his words away
explanation_en: Although the king be utterly ignorant, it is the duty of the minister to give (him) sound advice
explanation_ta: அறிவுறுத்துவாரின் அறிவையையும் அழித்துத் தானும் அறியாதவனாக அரசன் இருந்தாலும், அமைச்சன் அவனுக்கு உறுதியானவற்றை எடுத்துக்கூறல் க‌டமையாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
A minister who by king's side plots evil thingsWorse woes than countless foemen brings

Meaning: Far better are seventy crores of enemies (for a king) than a minister at his side who intends (his) ruin
pope_couplet: A minister who by king's side plots evil thingsWorse woes than countless foemen brings
explanation_en: Far better are seventy crores of enemies (for a king) than a minister at his side who intends (his) ruin
explanation_ta: தவறான வழிகளை எண்ணி கூறுகின்ற அமைச்சனை விட எழுபது கோடி பகைவர் பக்கத்தில் இருந்தாலும் நன்மையாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
For gain of end desired just counsel nought availsTo minister, when tact in execution fails

Meaning: Those ministers who are destitute of (executive) ability will fail to carry out their projects, although they may have contrived aright
pope_couplet: For gain of end desired just counsel nought availsTo minister, when tact in execution fails
explanation_en: Those ministers who are destitute of (executive) ability will fail to carry out their projects, although they may have contrived aright
explanation_ta: (செயல்களைச் முடிக்கும்) திறன் இல்லாதவர், முன்னே எண்ணி வைத்திருந்தும் (செய்யும் போது) குறையானவைகளையேச் செய்வர்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Office of Minister of state

translation:
A tongue that rightly speaks the right is greatest gain, It stands alone midst goodly things that men obtain

Meaning: The possession of that goodness which is called the goodness of speech is (even to others) better than any other goodness
pope_couplet: A tongue that rightly speaks the right is greatest gain, It stands alone midst goodly things that men obtain
explanation_en: The possession of that goodness which is called the goodness of speech is (even to others) better than any other goodness
explanation_ta: நாவன்மையாகிய நலம் ஒருவகைச் செல்வம் ஆகும், அந்த நாநலம் தனிச்சிறப்புடையது, ஆகையால் மற்ற எந்த நலங்களிலும் அடங்குவது அன்று.

translation:
Since gain and loss in life on speech depend, From careless slip in speech thyself defend

Meaning: Since (both) wealth and evil result from (their) speech, ministers should most carefully guard themselves against faultiness therein
pope_couplet: Since gain and loss in life on speech depend, From careless slip in speech thyself defend
explanation_en: Since (both) wealth and evil result from (their) speech, ministers should most carefully guard themselves against faultiness therein
explanation_ta: ஆக்கமும் கேடும் சொல்லுகின்ற சொல்லால் வருவதால் ஒருவன் தன்னுடைய சொல்லிற்க்கு தவறு நேராமல் காத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்

translation:
'Tis speech that spell-bound holds the listening ear, While those who have not heard desire to hear

Meaning: The (minister's) speech is that which seeks (to express) elements as bind his friends (to himself) and is so delivered as to make even his enemies desire (his friendship)
pope_couplet: 'Tis speech that spell-bound holds the listening ear, While those who have not heard desire to hear
explanation_en: The (minister's) speech is that which seeks (to express) elements as bind his friends (to himself) and is so delivered as to make even his enemies desire (his friendship)
explanation_ta: சொல்லும் போது கேட்டவரைத் தன் வயப்படுத்தும் பண்புகளுடன், கேட்காதவரும் கேட்க விரும்புமாறு கூறப்படுவது சொல்வன்மையாகும்.

translation:
Speak words adapted well to various hearers' state; No higher virtue lives, no gain more surely great

Meaning: Understand the qualities (of your hearers) and (then) make your speech; for superior to it, there is neither virtue nor wealth
pope_couplet: Speak words adapted well to various hearers' state; No higher virtue lives, no gain more surely great
explanation_en: Understand the qualities (of your hearers) and (then) make your speech; for superior to it, there is neither virtue nor wealth
explanation_ta: சொல்லின் திறத்தை அறிந்து சொல்லை வழங்க வேண்டும், அத் தகைய சொல்வன்மையை விடச் சிறந்த அறமும் பொருளும் இல்லை.

translation:
Speak out your speech, when once 'tis past disputeThat none can utter speech that shall your speech refute

Meaning: Deliver your speech, after assuring yourself that no counter speech can defeat your own
pope_couplet: Speak out your speech, when once 'tis past disputeThat none can utter speech that shall your speech refute
explanation_en: Deliver your speech, after assuring yourself that no counter speech can defeat your own
explanation_ta: வேறோரு சொல் அந்தச் சொல்லை வெல்லும் சொல்லாக இல்லாதிருந்தால் அறிந்த பிறகே சொல்லக்கருதியதைச் சொல்லவேண்டும்.

translation:
Charming each hearer's ear, of others' words to seize the sense, Is method wise of men of spotless excellence

Meaning: It is the opinion of those who are free from defects in diplomacy that the minister should speak so as to make his hearers desire (to hear more) and grasp the meaning of what he hears himself
pope_couplet: Charming each hearer's ear, of others' words to seize the sense, Is method wise of men of spotless excellence
explanation_en: It is the opinion of those who are free from defects in diplomacy that the minister should speak so as to make his hearers desire (to hear more) and grasp the meaning of what he hears himself
explanation_ta: பிறர் விரும்பும் படியாகத் தாம் சொல்லின் பிறர் சொல்லும் போது அச் சொல்லின் பயனை ஆராய்ந்து கொள்ளுதல் மாசற்ற சிறப்புடையவரின் கொள்கையாகும்.

translation:
Mighty in word, of unforgetful mind, of fearless speech,'Tis hard for hostile power such man to overreach

Meaning: It is impossible for any one to conquer him by intrique who possesses power of speech, and is neither faulty nor timid
pope_couplet: Mighty in word, of unforgetful mind, of fearless speech,'Tis hard for hostile power such man to overreach
explanation_en: It is impossible for any one to conquer him by intrique who possesses power of speech, and is neither faulty nor timid
explanation_ta: தான் கருதியவற்றை நன்கு சொல்ல வல்லவனாய் சொல்லும் போது சோர்வு இல்லாதவனாய், அஞ்சாதவனாய் உள்ளவனை மாறுபாட்டால் வெல்வது யார்க்கும் முடியாது.

translation:
Swiftly the listening world will gather round, When men of mighty speech the weighty theme propound

Meaning: If there be those who can speak on various subjects in their proper order and in a pleasing manner, the world would readily accept them
pope_couplet: Swiftly the listening world will gather round, When men of mighty speech the weighty theme propound
explanation_en: If there be those who can speak on various subjects in their proper order and in a pleasing manner, the world would readily accept them
explanation_ta: கருத்துக்களை ஒழுங்காகக் கோர்த்து இனியாக சொல்ல வல்லவரைப் பெற்றால், உலகம் விரைந்து அவருடைய ஏவலைக் கேட்டு நடக்கும்.

translation:
Who have not skill ten faultless words to utter plain, Their tongues will itch with thousand words man's ears to pain

Meaning: They will desire to utter many words, who do not know how to speak a few faultless ones
pope_couplet: Who have not skill ten faultless words to utter plain, Their tongues will itch with thousand words man's ears to pain
explanation_en: They will desire to utter many words, who do not know how to speak a few faultless ones
explanation_ta: குற்றமற்றவையாகியச் சில சொற்களைச் சொல்லத் தெரியாதவர், உண்மையாகவே பலச் சொற்களைச் சொல்லிக்கொண்டிருக்க விரும்புவர்.

translation:
Like scentless flower in blooming garland boundAre men who can't their lore acquired to other's ears expound

Meaning: Those who are unable to set forth their acquirements (before others) are like flowers blossoming in a cluster and yet without fragrance
pope_couplet: Like scentless flower in blooming garland boundAre men who can't their lore acquired to other's ears expound
explanation_en: Those who are unable to set forth their acquirements (before others) are like flowers blossoming in a cluster and yet without fragrance
explanation_ta: தாம் கற்ற நூற்ப் பொருளைப் பிறர் உணருமாறு விரிந்துரைக்க முடியாதவர், கொத்தாக மலர்ந்திருந்த போதிலும் மணம் கமழாத மலரைப் போன்றவர்.

translation:
The good external help confers is worldly gain; By action good men every needed gift obtain

Meaning: The efficacy of support will yield (only) wealth; (but) the efficacy of action will yield all that is desired
pope_couplet: The good external help confers is worldly gain; By action good men every needed gift obtain
explanation_en: The efficacy of support will yield (only) wealth; (but) the efficacy of action will yield all that is desired
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு வாய்த்த துணையின் நன்மை ஆக்கத்தைக் கொடுக்கும், செய்யும் வினையின் நன்மை அவன் விரும்பிய எல்லாவற்றையும் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
From action evermore thyself restrainOf glory and of good that yields no gain

Meaning: Ministers should at all times avoid acts which, in addition to fame, yield no benefit (for the future)
pope_couplet: From action evermore thyself restrainOf glory and of good that yields no gain
explanation_en: Ministers should at all times avoid acts which, in addition to fame, yield no benefit (for the future)
explanation_ta: புகழையும் அறத்தையும் தாராத (தூய்மை அற்ற) செயல்களை எக்காலத்திலும் ஒருவன் செய்யாமல் விட்டொழிக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who tell themselves that nobler things shall yet be wonAll deeds that dim the light of glory must they shun

Meaning: Those who say, "we will become (better)" should avoid the performance of acts that would destroy (their fame)
pope_couplet: Who tell themselves that nobler things shall yet be wonAll deeds that dim the light of glory must they shun
explanation_en: Those who say, "we will become (better)" should avoid the performance of acts that would destroy (their fame)
explanation_ta: மேன்மேலும் உயர்வோம் என்று விரும்பி முயல்கின்றவர் தம்முடைய புகழ் கெடுவதற்குக் காரணமான செயலைச் செய்யாமல் விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Though troubles press, no shameful deed they do, Whose eyes the ever-during vision view

Meaning: Those who have infallible judgement though threatened with peril will not do acts which have brought disgrace (on former ministers)
pope_couplet: Though troubles press, no shameful deed they do, Whose eyes the ever-during vision view
explanation_en: Those who have infallible judgement though threatened with peril will not do acts which have brought disgrace (on former ministers)
explanation_ta: அசைவற்ற ‌தெளிந்த அறிவினையுடையவர், துன்பத்தில் சிக்குண்டாலும் (அத் துன்பத்தைத் தீர்ப்பதற்க்காகவும்) இழிவானச் செயல்களைச் செய்யமாட்டார்.

translation:
Do nought that soul repenting must deplore, If thou hast sinned, 'tis well if thou dost sin no more

Meaning: Let a minister never do acts of which he would have to grieve saying, "what is this I have done"; (but) should he do (them), it were good that he grieved not
pope_couplet: Do nought that soul repenting must deplore, If thou hast sinned, 'tis well if thou dost sin no more
explanation_en: Let a minister never do acts of which he would have to grieve saying, "what is this I have done"; (but) should he do (them), it were good that he grieved not
explanation_ta: பிறகு நினைத்து வருந்துவதற்குக் காரணமானச் செயல்களைச் செய்யக் கூடாது, ஒரு கால் தவறிச் செய்தாலும் மீண்டும் அத் தன்மையானவற்றைச் செய்யாதிருத்தல் நல்லது.

translation:
Though her that bore thee hung'ring thou behold, no deedDo thou, that men of perfect soul have crime decreed

Meaning: Though a minister may see his mother starve; let him do not act which the wise would (treat with contempt)
pope_couplet: Though her that bore thee hung'ring thou behold, no deedDo thou, that men of perfect soul have crime decreed
explanation_en: Though a minister may see his mother starve; let him do not act which the wise would (treat with contempt)
explanation_ta: பெற்ற தாயின் பசியைக் கண்டு வருந்த நேர்ந்தாலும், சான்றோர் பழிப்பதற்குக் காரணமான இழிவுற்றச் செயல்களைச் செய்யக்கூடாது.

translation:
Than store of wealth guilt-laden souls obtain, The sorest poverty of perfect soul is richer gain

Meaning: Far more excellent is the extreme poverty of the wise than wealth obtained by heaping up of sinful
pope_couplet: Than store of wealth guilt-laden souls obtain, The sorest poverty of perfect soul is richer gain
explanation_en: Far more excellent is the extreme poverty of the wise than wealth obtained by heaping up of sinful
explanation_ta: பழியை மேற்கொண்டு இழிதொழில் செய்து பெறும் செல்வத்தை விடச் சான்றோர் வினைத்தூய்மையோடிருந்து பெறும் பொல்லாத வறுமையே சிறந்தது.

translation:
To those who hate reproof and do forbidden thingWhat prospers now, in after days shall anguish bring

Meaning: The actions of those, who have not desisted from doing deeds forbidden (by the great), will, even if they succeed, cause them sorrow
pope_couplet: To those who hate reproof and do forbidden thingWhat prospers now, in after days shall anguish bring
explanation_en: The actions of those, who have not desisted from doing deeds forbidden (by the great), will, even if they succeed, cause them sorrow
explanation_ta: ஆகாதவை என விலக்கப்பட்ட செயல்களை விலக்கிவிடாமல் மேற்கொண்டு செய்தவர்க்கும், அச் செயல் நிறைவேறினாலும் துன்பமே கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
What's gained through tears with tears shall go; From loss good deeds entail harvests of blessings grow

Meaning: All that has been obtained with tears (to the victim) will depart with tears (to himself); but what has been by fair means; though with loss at first, will afterwards yield fruit
pope_couplet: What's gained through tears with tears shall go; From loss good deeds entail harvests of blessings grow
explanation_en: All that has been obtained with tears (to the victim) will depart with tears (to himself); but what has been by fair means; though with loss at first, will afterwards yield fruit
explanation_ta: பிறர் வருந்துமாறு செய்து பெற்ற பொருள் எல்லாம் பெற்றவன் வருந்துமாறு செய்து போய்விடும், நல்வழியில் வந்தவை இழக்கப்பட்டாலும் பிறகு பயன் தரும்

translation:
In pot of clay unburnt he water pours and would retain, Who seeks by wrong the realm in wealth and safety to maintain

Meaning: (For a minister) to protect (his king) with wealth obtained by foul means is like preserving a vessel of wet clay by filling it with water
pope_couplet: In pot of clay unburnt he water pours and would retain, Who seeks by wrong the realm in wealth and safety to maintain
explanation_en: (For a minister) to protect (his king) with wealth obtained by foul means is like preserving a vessel of wet clay by filling it with water
explanation_ta: வஞ்சனையான வழியால் பொருளைச்சேர்த்துக் காப்பாற்றுதல், பச்சை மண்கலத்தில் நீரை விட்டு அதைக் காப்பாற்றி வைத்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
What men call 'power in action' know for 'power of mind'Externe to man all other aids you find

Meaning: Firmness in action is (simply) one's firmness of mind; all other (abilities) are not of this nature
pope_couplet: What men call 'power in action' know for 'power of mind'Externe to man all other aids you find
explanation_en: Firmness in action is (simply) one's firmness of mind; all other (abilities) are not of this nature
explanation_ta: ஒரு தொழிலின் திட்பம் என்று சொல்லப்படுவது ஒருவனுடைய மனதின் திட்பமே (உறுதியே) ஆகும், மற்றவை எல்லாம் வேறானவை.

translation:
'Each hindrance shun', 'unyielding onward press, If obstacle be there,'These two define your way, so those that search out truth declare

Meaning: Not to perform a ruinous act, and not to be discouraged by the ruinous termination of an act, are the two maxims which, the wise say, from the principles of those who have investigated the subject
pope_couplet: 'Each hindrance shun', 'unyielding onward press, If obstacle be there,'These two define your way, so those that search out truth declare
explanation_en: Not to perform a ruinous act, and not to be discouraged by the ruinous termination of an act, are the two maxims which, the wise say, from the principles of those who have investigated the subject
explanation_ta: இடையூறு வருவதற்கு முன்பே நீக்குதல், வந்த பின் தளராமை ஆகிய இந்த இரண்டினது வழியே வினைத்திட்பம் பற்றி ஆராய்ந்தவரின் கொள்கையாம்.

translation:
Man's fitting work is known but by success achieved; In midst the plan revealed brings ruin ne'er to be retrieved

Meaning: So to perform an act as to publish it (only) at its termination is (true) manliness; for to announce it beforehand, will cause irremediable sorrow
pope_couplet: Man's fitting work is known but by success achieved; In midst the plan revealed brings ruin ne'er to be retrieved
explanation_en: So to perform an act as to publish it (only) at its termination is (true) manliness; for to announce it beforehand, will cause irremediable sorrow
explanation_ta: செய்யும் செயலை முடிவில் வெளிப்படும் படியாக செய்யும் தகுதியே ஆண்மையாகும், இடையில் வெளிபட்டால் நீங்காத துன்பத்தைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Easy to every man the speech that shows the way; Hard thing to shape one's life by words they say

Meaning: To say (how an act is to be performed) is (indeed) easy for any one; but far difficult it is to do according to what has been said
pope_couplet: Easy to every man the speech that shows the way; Hard thing to shape one's life by words they say
explanation_en: To say (how an act is to be performed) is (indeed) easy for any one; but far difficult it is to do according to what has been said
explanation_ta: இச் செயலை இவ்வாறு செய்து முடிக்கலாம் என்று சொல்லுதல் எவர்க்கும் எளியனவாம், சொல்லிய படி செய்து முடித்தல் அரியனவாம்.

translation:
The power in act of men renowned and great, With king acceptance finds and fame through all the state

Meaning: The firmness in action of those who have become great by the excellence (of their counsel) will, by attaining its fulfilment in the person of the king, be esteemed (by all).
pope_couplet: The power in act of men renowned and great, With king acceptance finds and fame through all the state
explanation_en: The firmness in action of those who have become great by the excellence (of their counsel) will, by attaining its fulfilment in the person of the king, be esteemed (by all).
explanation_ta: செயல் திறனால் பெருமைபெற்று உயர்ந்தவரின் வினைத் திட்பமானது நாட்டை ஆளும் அரசனிடத்திலும் எட்டி மதிக்கப்பட்டு விளங்கும்.

translation:
Whate'er men think, ev'n as they think, may men obtain, If those who think can steadfastness of will retain

Meaning: If those who have planned (an undertaking) possess firmness (in executing it) they will obtain what they have desired even as they have desired it
pope_couplet: Whate'er men think, ev'n as they think, may men obtain, If those who think can steadfastness of will retain
explanation_en: If those who have planned (an undertaking) possess firmness (in executing it) they will obtain what they have desired even as they have desired it
explanation_ta: எண்ணியவர் (எண்ணியபடியே செயல் ஆற்றுவதில்) உறுதியுடையவராக இருக்கப்பெற்றால் அவர் எண்ணியவற்றை எண்ணியவாறே அடைவர்.

translation:
Despise not men of modest bearing; Look not at form, but what men are:For some there live, high functions sharing, Like linch-pin of the mighty car

Meaning: Let none be despised for (their) size; (for) the world has those who resemble the linch-pin of the big rolling car
pope_couplet: Despise not men of modest bearing; Look not at form, but what men are:For some there live, high functions sharing, Like linch-pin of the mighty car
explanation_en: Let none be despised for (their) size; (for) the world has those who resemble the linch-pin of the big rolling car
explanation_ta: உருளும் பெரிய தேர்க்கு அச்சில் இருந்து தாங்கும் சிறிய ஆணிப் போன்றவர்கள் உலகத்தில் உள்ளனர், அவர்களுடைய உருவின் சிறுமையைக்கண்டு இகழக் கூடாது.

translation:
What clearly eye discerns as right, with steadfast will, And mind unslumbering, that should man fulfil

Meaning: An act that has been firmly resolved on must be as firmly carried out without delay
pope_couplet: What clearly eye discerns as right, with steadfast will, And mind unslumbering, that should man fulfil
explanation_en: An act that has been firmly resolved on must be as firmly carried out without delay
explanation_ta: மனம் தளராமல் ஆராய்ந்து துணிந்து ஏற்றத் தொழிலைச் சோர்வு கொள்ளாமல் காலந் தாழ்த்தாமல் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
Though toil and trouble face thee, firm resolve hold fast, And do the deeds that pleasure yield at last

Meaning: Though it should cause increasing sorrow (at the outset), do with firmness the act that yield bliss (in the end)
pope_couplet: Though toil and trouble face thee, firm resolve hold fast, And do the deeds that pleasure yield at last
explanation_en: Though it should cause increasing sorrow (at the outset), do with firmness the act that yield bliss (in the end)
explanation_ta: (முடிவில்) இன்பம் கொடுக்கும் தொழிலைச் செய்யும் போது துன்பம் மிக வந்த போதிலும் துணிவு மேற்கொண்டு செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
The world desires not men of every power possessed, Who power in act desire not,- crown of all the rest

Meaning: The great will not esteem those who esteem not firmness of action, whatever other abilities the latter may possess
pope_couplet: The world desires not men of every power possessed, Who power in act desire not,- crown of all the rest
explanation_en: The great will not esteem those who esteem not firmness of action, whatever other abilities the latter may possess
explanation_ta: வேறு எத்தகைய உறுதி உடையவராக இருந்தாலும், செய்யும் தொழிலில் உறுதி இல்லாதவரை உலகம் விரும்பிப் போற்றாது.

translation:
The Resolve is counsel's end, If resolutions halt In weak delays, still unfulfilled, 'tis grievous fault

Meaning: Consultation ends in forming a resolution (to act); (but) delay in the execution of that resolve is an evil
pope_couplet: The Resolve is counsel's end, If resolutions halt In weak delays, still unfulfilled, 'tis grievous fault
explanation_en: Consultation ends in forming a resolution (to act); (but) delay in the execution of that resolve is an evil
explanation_ta: ஆராய்ந்து எண்ணுவதற்கு எல்லை துணிவு கொள்வதே ஆகும், அவ்வாறு கொண்ட துணிவு காலந் தாழ்த்து நிற்பது குற்றமாகும்.

translation:
Slumber when sleepy work's in hand beware Thou slumber not when action calls for sleepless care

Meaning: Sleep over such (actions) as may be slept over; (but) never over such as may not be slept over
pope_couplet: Slumber when sleepy work's in hand beware Thou slumber not when action calls for sleepless care
explanation_en: Sleep over such (actions) as may be slept over; (but) never over such as may not be slept over
explanation_ta: காலந்தாழ்த்தி செய்யத் தக்கவற்றைக் காலந்தாழ்ந்தே செய்ய வேண்டும், காலந்தாழ்த்தாமல் விரைந்து செய்யவேண்டிய செயல்களைச் செய்ய காலந்தாழ்த்தக் கூடாது.

translation:
When way is clear, prompt let your action be; When not, watch till some open path you see

Meaning: Whenever it is possible (to overcome your enemy) the act (of fighting) is certainly good; if not, endeavour to employ some more successful method
pope_couplet: When way is clear, prompt let your action be; When not, watch till some open path you see
explanation_en: Whenever it is possible (to overcome your enemy) the act (of fighting) is certainly good; if not, endeavour to employ some more successful method
explanation_ta: இயலுமிடத்தில் எல்லாம் செயலைச் செய்து முடித்தல் நல்லது, இயலாவில்லையானால் பயன்படும் இடம் நோக்கியாவது செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
With work or foe, when you neglect some little thing, If you reflect, like smouldering fire, 'twill ruin bring

Meaning: When duly considered, the incomplete execution of an undertaking and hostility will grow and destroy one like the (unextinguished) remnant of a fire
pope_couplet: With work or foe, when you neglect some little thing, If you reflect, like smouldering fire, 'twill ruin bring
explanation_en: When duly considered, the incomplete execution of an undertaking and hostility will grow and destroy one like the (unextinguished) remnant of a fire
explanation_ta: செய்யத்தொடங்கியச் செயல், கொண்ட பகை என்று இவ்விரண்டின் குறை ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால், தீயின் குறைபோல் தெரியாமல் வளர்ந்து கெடுக்கும்.

translation:
Treasure and instrument and time and deed and place of act These five, till every doubt remove, think o'er with care exact

Meaning: Do an act after a due consideration of the (following) five, viz money, means, time, execution and place
pope_couplet: Treasure and instrument and time and deed and place of act These five, till every doubt remove, think o'er with care exact
explanation_en: Do an act after a due consideration of the (following) five, viz money, means, time, execution and place
explanation_ta: வேண்டிய பொருள், ஏற்றக்கருவி, தக்க காலம், மேற்கொண்ட தொழில், உரிய இடம் ஆகிய ஐந்தினையும் மயக்கம் தீர எண்ணிச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
Accomplishment, the hindrances, large profits won By effort these compare,- then let the work be done

Meaning: An act is to be performed after considering the exertion required, the obstacles to be encountered, and the great profit to be gained (on its completion)
pope_couplet: Accomplishment, the hindrances, large profits won By effort these compare,- then let the work be done
explanation_en: An act is to be performed after considering the exertion required, the obstacles to be encountered, and the great profit to be gained (on its completion)
explanation_ta: செயலை முடிக்கும் வகையும், வரக்கூடிய இடையூறும், முடிந்த போது கிடைக்கும் பெரும்பயனும் ஆகியவற்றை ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who would succeed must thus begin first let him ask The thoughts of them who thoroughly know the task

Meaning: The method of performance for one who has begun an act is to ascertain the mind of him who knows the secret thereof
pope_couplet: Who would succeed must thus begin first let him ask The thoughts of them who thoroughly know the task
explanation_en: The method of performance for one who has begun an act is to ascertain the mind of him who knows the secret thereof
explanation_ta: செயலைச் செய்கின்றவன் செய்ய வேண்டிய முறை, அச் செயலின் உண்மையான இயல்பை அறிந்தவனுடையக் கருத்தைத் தான் ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளவதாகும்

translation:
By one thing done you reach a second work's accomplishment; So furious elephant to snare its fellow brute is sent

Meaning: To make one undertaking the means of accomplishing another (similar to it) is like making one rutting elephant the means of capturing another
pope_couplet: By one thing done you reach a second work's accomplishment; So furious elephant to snare its fellow brute is sent
explanation_en: To make one undertaking the means of accomplishing another (similar to it) is like making one rutting elephant the means of capturing another
explanation_ta: ஒரு செயலைச் செய்யும் போது அச் செயலால் மற்றொரு செயலையும் செய்து முடித்துக் கொள்ளல், ஒரு யானையால் மற்றொரு யானையைப் பிடித்தலைப் போன்றது.

translation:
Than kindly acts to friends more urgent thing to do, Is making foes to cling as friends attached to you

Meaning: One should rather hasten to secure the alliance of the foes (of one's foes) than perform good offices to one's friends
pope_couplet: Than kindly acts to friends more urgent thing to do, Is making foes to cling as friends attached to you
explanation_en: One should rather hasten to secure the alliance of the foes (of one's foes) than perform good offices to one's friends
explanation_ta: பகைவராக உள்ளவரைப் பொருந்துமாறு சேர்த்துக் கொள்ளல், நண்பர்க்கு உதவியானவற்றை செய்தலைவிட விரைந்து செய்யத்தக்கதாகும்.

translation:
The men of lesser realm, fearing the people's inward dread, Accepting granted terms, to mightier ruler bow the head

Meaning: Ministers of small states, afraid of their people being frightened, will yield to and acknowledge their superior foes, if the latter offer them a chance of reconciliation
pope_couplet: The men of lesser realm, fearing the people's inward dread, Accepting granted terms, to mightier ruler bow the head
explanation_en: Ministers of small states, afraid of their people being frightened, will yield to and acknowledge their superior foes, if the latter offer them a chance of reconciliation
explanation_ta: வலிமை குறைந்தவர், தம்மை சார்ந்துள்ளவர் நடுங்குவதற்காக தாம் அஞ்சி, வேண்டியது கிடைக்ககுமானால் வலிமைமிக்கவரைப் பணிந்தும் ஏற்றுக் கொள்வர்.

translation:
Benevolence high birth, the courtesy kings love:-These qualities the envoy of a king approve

Meaning: The qualification of an ambassador are affection (for his relations) a fitting birth, and the possession of attributes pleasing to royalty
pope_couplet: Benevolence high birth, the courtesy kings love:-These qualities the envoy of a king approve
explanation_en: The qualification of an ambassador are affection (for his relations) a fitting birth, and the possession of attributes pleasing to royalty
explanation_ta: அன்புடையவனாதல், தகுதியானக் குடிப்பிறப்பு உடையவனாதல் அரசர் விரும்பும் சிறந்த பண்பு உடையவனாதல், ஆகிய இவை தூது உரைப்பவனுடையத் தகுதிகள்.

translation:
Love, knowledge, power of chosen words, three things, Should he possess who speaks the words of kings

Meaning: Love (to his sovereign), knowledge (of his affairs), and a discriminating power of speech (before other sovereigns) are the three sine qua non qualifications of an ambassador
pope_couplet: Love, knowledge, power of chosen words, three things, Should he possess who speaks the words of kings
explanation_en: Love (to his sovereign), knowledge (of his affairs), and a discriminating power of speech (before other sovereigns) are the three sine qua non qualifications of an ambassador
explanation_ta: அன்பு, அறிவு, ஆராய்ந்து சொல்கின்ற சொல் வன்மை ஆகிய இவை மூன்றும் தூது உரைப்பவர்க்கு இன்றியமையாத மூன்று பண்புகளாகும்.

translation:
Mighty in lore amongst the learned must he be, Midst jav'lin-bearing kings who speaks the words of victory

Meaning: To be powerful in politics among those who are learned (in ethics) is the character of him who speaks
pope_couplet: Mighty in lore amongst the learned must he be, Midst jav'lin-bearing kings who speaks the words of victory
explanation_en: To be powerful in politics among those who are learned (in ethics) is the character of him who speaks
explanation_ta: அரசனிடம் சென்று தன் அரசனுடைய வெற்றிக்கு காரணமானச் செயலைப் பற்றித் தூது உரைப்பவன் திறம் நூலறிந்தவருள் நூல் வல்லவனாக விளங்குதல் ஆகும்.

translation:
Sense, goodly grace, and knowledge exquisiteWho hath these three for envoy's task is fit

Meaning: He may go on a mission (to foreign rulers) who has combined in him all these three viz, (natural) sense, an attractive bearing and well-tried learning
pope_couplet: Sense, goodly grace, and knowledge exquisiteWho hath these three for envoy's task is fit
explanation_en: He may go on a mission (to foreign rulers) who has combined in him all these three viz, (natural) sense, an attractive bearing and well-tried learning
explanation_ta: இயற்கை அறிவு, விரும்பத்தக்கத் தோற்றம், ஆராய்ச்சி உடையக் கல்வி ஆகிய இம் மூன்றின் பொருத்தம் உடையவன் தூது உரைக்கும் தொழிலுக்குச் செல்லலாம்.

translation:
In terms concise, avoiding wrathful speech, who utters pleasant word, An envoy he who gains advantage for his lord

Meaning: He is an ambassador who (in the presence of foreign rulers) speaks briefly, avoids harshness, talks so as to make them smile, and thus brings good (to his own sovereign)
pope_couplet: In terms concise, avoiding wrathful speech, who utters pleasant word, An envoy he who gains advantage for his lord
explanation_en: He is an ambassador who (in the presence of foreign rulers) speaks briefly, avoids harshness, talks so as to make them smile, and thus brings good (to his own sovereign)
explanation_ta: பலவற்றைத் தொகுத்து சொல்லியும், அவற்றுள் பயனற்றவைகளை நீக்கியும், மகிழுமாறு சொல்லியும் தன் தலைவனுக்கு நன்மை உண்டாக்குகின்றவன் தூதன்.

translation:
An envoy meet is he, well-learned, of fearless eyeWho speaks right home, prepared for each emergency

Meaning: He is an ambassador who having studied (politics) talks impressively, is not afraid of angry looks, and knows (to employ) the art suited to the time
pope_couplet: An envoy meet is he, well-learned, of fearless eyeWho speaks right home, prepared for each emergency
explanation_en: He is an ambassador who having studied (politics) talks impressively, is not afraid of angry looks, and knows (to employ) the art suited to the time
explanation_ta: கற்பன கற்று, பிறருடைய பகையான பார்வைக்கு அஞ்சாமல் கேட்பவர் உள்ளத்தில் பதியுமாறு சொல்லி, காலத்திற்க்குப் பொருத்தமானதை அறிகின்றவனே தூதன்.

translation:
He is the best who knows what's due, the time considered well, The place selects, then ponders long ere he his errand tell

Meaning: He is chief (among ambassadors) who understands the proper decorum (before foreign princes), seeks the (proper) occasion, knows the (most suitable) place, and delivers his message after (due)
pope_couplet: He is the best who knows what's due, the time considered well, The place selects, then ponders long ere he his errand tell
explanation_en: He is chief (among ambassadors) who understands the proper decorum (before foreign princes), seeks the (proper) occasion, knows the (most suitable) place, and delivers his message after (due)
explanation_ta: தன் கடமை இன்னதென்று தெளிவாக அறிந்து , அதை செய்வதற்கு ஏற்றக்காலத்தை எதிர்நோக்கி தக்க இடத்தையும் ஆராய்ந்து சொல்கின்றவனே தூதன்.

translation:
Integrity, resources, soul determined, truthfulnessWho rightly speaks his message must these marks possess

Meaning: The qualifications of him who faithfully delivers his (sovereign's) message are purity, the support (of foreign ministers), and boldness, with truthfulness in addition to the (aforesaid) three
pope_couplet: Integrity, resources, soul determined, truthfulnessWho rightly speaks his message must these marks possess
explanation_en: The qualifications of him who faithfully delivers his (sovereign's) message are purity, the support (of foreign ministers), and boldness, with truthfulness in addition to the (aforesaid) three
explanation_ta: தூய ஒழுக்கம் உடையவனாதல், துணை உடையவனாதல், துணிவு உடையவனாதல் இந்த மூன்றும் வாய்த்திருத்தலே தூது உரைப்பவனுடைய தகுதியாகும்.

translation:
His faltering lips must utter no unworthy thing, Who stands, with steady eye, to speak the mandates of his king

Meaning: He alone is fit to communicate (his sovereign's) reply, who possesses the firmness not to utter even inadvertently what may reflect discredit (on the latter)
pope_couplet: His faltering lips must utter no unworthy thing, Who stands, with steady eye, to speak the mandates of his king
explanation_en: He alone is fit to communicate (his sovereign's) reply, who possesses the firmness not to utter even inadvertently what may reflect discredit (on the latter)
explanation_ta: குற்றமானச் சொற்களை வாய் சோர்ந்தும் சொல்லாத உறுதி உடையவனே அரசன் சொல்லியனுப்பிய சொற்களை மற்ற வேந்தர்க்கு உரைக்கும் தகுதியுடையவன்.

translation:
Death to the faithful one his embassy may bring; To envoy gains assured advantage for his king

Meaning: He is the ambassador who fearlessly seeks his sovereign's good though it should cost him his life (to deliver his message)
pope_couplet: Death to the faithful one his embassy may bring; To envoy gains assured advantage for his king
explanation_en: He is the ambassador who fearlessly seeks his sovereign's good though it should cost him his life (to deliver his message)
explanation_ta: தனக்கு அழிவே தருவதாக இருந்தாலும் அதற்காக அஞ்சி விட்டுவிடாமல், தன் அரசனுக்கு நன்மை உண்டாகுமாறு செய்கின்றவனே தூதன்.

translation:
Who warm them at the fire draw not too near, nor keep too much aloof; Thus let them act who dwell beneath of warlike kings the palace-roof

Meaning: Thus let them act who dwell beneath of warlike kings the palace-roof
pope_couplet: Who warm them at the fire draw not too near, nor keep too much aloof; Thus let them act who dwell beneath of warlike kings the palace-roof
explanation_en: Thus let them act who dwell beneath of warlike kings the palace-roof
explanation_ta: அரசரைச் சார்ந்து வாழ்கின்றவர், அவரை மிக நீங்காமலும், மிக அணுகாமலும் நெருப்பில் குளிர் காய்கின்றவர் போல இருக்க வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
To those who prize not state that kings are wont to prize, The king himself abundant wealth supplies

Meaning: For ministers not to cover the things desired by their kings will through the kings themselves yield them everlasting wealth
pope_couplet: To those who prize not state that kings are wont to prize, The king himself abundant wealth supplies
explanation_en: For ministers not to cover the things desired by their kings will through the kings themselves yield them everlasting wealth
explanation_ta: அரசர் விரும்புகின்றவர்களைத் தாம் விரும்பாமலிருத்தல் (அரசரைச் சார்ந்திருப்பவர்க்கு) அரசரால் நிலையான ஆக்கத்தைப் பெற்றுத் தரும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Who would walk warily, let him of greater faults beware; To clear suspicions once aroused is an achievement rare

Meaning: Ministers who would save themselves should avoid (the commission of) serious errors for if the king's suspicion is once roused, no one can remove it
pope_couplet: Who would walk warily, let him of greater faults beware; To clear suspicions once aroused is an achievement rare
explanation_en: Ministers who would save themselves should avoid (the commission of) serious errors for if the king's suspicion is once roused, no one can remove it
explanation_ta: .( அரசரைச் சார்ந்தவர்) தம்மைக் காத்துக் கொள்ள விரும்பினால் அரியத் தவறுகள் நேராமல் காத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டும், ஐயுற்றபின் அரசரைத் தெளிவித்தல் எவர்க்கும் முடியாது.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
All whispered words and interchange of smiles repress, In presence of the men who kingly power possess

Meaning: While in the presence of the sovereign, ministers should neither whisper to nor smile at others
pope_couplet: All whispered words and interchange of smiles repress, In presence of the men who kingly power possess
explanation_en: While in the presence of the sovereign, ministers should neither whisper to nor smile at others
explanation_ta: வல்லமை அமைந்த பெரியாரிடத்தில் (மற்றொருவன்) செவியை நெருங்கிச் சொல்லுதல் உடன் சேர்ந்து நகைத்தலும் செய்யாமல் ஒழுகவேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Seek not, ask not, the secret of the king to hear; But if he lets the matter forth, give ear

Meaning: (When the king is engaged) in secret counsel (with others), ministers should neither over-hear anything whatever nor pry into it with inquisitive questions, but (wait to) listen when it is divulged (by
pope_couplet: Seek not, ask not, the secret of the king to hear; But if he lets the matter forth, give ear
explanation_en: (When the king is engaged) in secret counsel (with others), ministers should neither over-hear anything whatever nor pry into it with inquisitive questions, but (wait to) listen when it is divulged (by
explanation_ta: (அரசர் மறைபொருள் பேசும் போது) எப்பொருளையும் உற்றுக் கேட்காமல் தொடர்ந்து வினவாமல் அப்பொருளை அவரே விட்டுச் சொன்னபோது கேட்டறிய வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Knowing the signs, waiting for fitting time, with courteous care, Things not displeasing, needful things, declare

Meaning: Knowing the (king's disposition and seeking the right time, (the minister) should in a pleasing manner suggest things such as are desirable and not disagreeable
pope_couplet: Knowing the signs, waiting for fitting time, with courteous care, Things not displeasing, needful things, declare
explanation_en: Knowing the (king's disposition and seeking the right time, (the minister) should in a pleasing manner suggest things such as are desirable and not disagreeable
explanation_ta: அரசருடையக் குறிப்பை அறிந்து தக்கக் காலத்தை எதிர்நோக்கி, வெறுப்பில்லாதவற்றையும் விருப்பமானவற்றையும் அவர் விரும்புமாறுச் சொல்ல வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Speak pleasant things, but never utter idle word; Not though by monarch's ears with pleasure heard

Meaning: Ministers should (always) give agreeable advice but on no occasion recommend useless actions, though requested (to do so)
pope_couplet: Speak pleasant things, but never utter idle word; Not though by monarch's ears with pleasure heard
explanation_en: Ministers should (always) give agreeable advice but on no occasion recommend useless actions, though requested (to do so)
explanation_ta: அரசர் விரும்புகின்றவற்றை மட்டும் சொல்லிப் பயனில்லாதவற்றை அவரே கேட்ட போதிலும் சொல்லாமல் விட வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Say not, 'He's young, my kinsman,' despising thus your king; But reverence the glory kingly state doth bring

Meaning: Ministers should behave in accordance with the (Divine) light in the person of kings and not despise them saying, "He is our junior (in age) and connected with our family!"
pope_couplet: Say not, 'He's young, my kinsman,' despising thus your king; But reverence the glory kingly state doth bring
explanation_en: Ministers should behave in accordance with the (Divine) light in the person of kings and not despise them saying, "He is our junior (in age) and connected with our family!"
explanation_ta: (அரசரை) எமக்கு இளையவர், எமக்கு இன்ன முறை உடையவர் என்று இகழாமல் அவருடைய நிலைக்கு ஏற்றவாறு அமைந்த புகழுடன் பொருந்த நடக்க வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
'We've gained his grace, boots nought what graceless acts we do', So deem not sages who the changeless vision view

Meaning: Those whose judgement is firm will not do what is disagreeable (to the sovereign) saying (within
pope_couplet: 'We've gained his grace, boots nought what graceless acts we do', So deem not sages who the changeless vision view
explanation_en: Those whose judgement is firm will not do what is disagreeable (to the sovereign) saying (within
explanation_ta: அசைவற்ற தெளிந்த அறிவினை உடையவர் யாம் அரசரால் விரும்பப்பட்டோம் என்று எண்ணி அவர் விரும்பாதவற்றைச் செய்யமாட்டார்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Who think 'We're ancient friends' and do unseemly things; To these familiarity sure ruin brings

Meaning: The (foolish) claim with which a minister does unbecoming acts because of his (long) familiarity (with the king) will ensure his ruin
pope_couplet: Who think 'We're ancient friends' and do unseemly things; To these familiarity sure ruin brings
explanation_en: The (foolish) claim with which a minister does unbecoming acts because of his (long) familiarity (with the king) will ensure his ruin
explanation_ta: யாம் அரசர்க்கு பழைமையானவராய் உள்ளோம் எனக்கருதித் தகுதி அல்லாதவற்றைச் செய்யும் உரிமை கேட்டைத்தரும்.
adhigaram_name_en: Conduct in the Presence of the King

translation:
Who knows the sign, and reads unuttered thought, the gem is he, Of earth round traversed by the changeless sea

Meaning: The minister who by looking (at the king) understands his mind without being told (of it), will be a perpetual ornament to the world which is surrounded by a never-drying sea
pope_couplet: Who knows the sign, and reads unuttered thought, the gem is he, Of earth round traversed by the changeless sea
explanation_en: The minister who by looking (at the king) understands his mind without being told (of it), will be a perpetual ornament to the world which is surrounded by a never-drying sea
explanation_ta: ஓருவர் சொல்லாமலே அவறுடைய முகத்தை நோக்கி அவர் கருதிய குறிப்பை அறிகின்றவன் எப்போதும் உலகத்திற்க்கு ஓர் அணிகலன் ஆவான்.

translation:
Undoubting, who the minds of men can scan, As deity regard that gifted man

Meaning: He is to be esteemed a god who is able to ascertain without a doubt what is within (one's mind)
pope_couplet: Undoubting, who the minds of men can scan, As deity regard that gifted man
explanation_en: He is to be esteemed a god who is able to ascertain without a doubt what is within (one's mind)
explanation_ta: ஐயப்படாமல் மனத்தில் உள்ளதை உணரவல்லவனை (அவன் மனிதனே ஆனாலும்) தெய்வத் தோடு ஒப்பாக கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who by the sign the signs interprets plain, Give any member up his aid to gain

Meaning: The king should ever give whatever (is asked) of his belongings and secure him who, by the indications (of his own mind) is able to read those of another
pope_couplet: Who by the sign the signs interprets plain, Give any member up his aid to gain
explanation_en: The king should ever give whatever (is asked) of his belongings and secure him who, by the indications (of his own mind) is able to read those of another
explanation_ta: (முகம் கண் இவற்றின்) குறிப்புக்களால் உள்ள குறிப்பை உணர வல்லவரை நாட்டின் உறுப்புக்களுள் எதைக் கொடுத்தாவது துணையாக பெற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who reads what's shown by signs, though words unspoken be, In form may seem as other men, in function nobler far is he

Meaning: Those who understand one's thoughts without being informed (thereof) and those who do not, may (indeed) resemble one another bodily; still are they different (mentally)
pope_couplet: Who reads what's shown by signs, though words unspoken be, In form may seem as other men, in function nobler far is he
explanation_en: Those who understand one's thoughts without being informed (thereof) and those who do not, may (indeed) resemble one another bodily; still are they different (mentally)
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் மனதில் கருதியதை அவன் கூறாமலே அறிந்து கொள்ள வல்லவரோடு மற்றவர் உறுப்பால் ஒத்தவராக இருந்தாலும் அறிவால் வேறுபட்டவர் ஆவார்.

translation:
By sign who knows not sings to comprehend, what gain,'Mid all his members, from his eyes does he obtain

Meaning: Of what use are the eyes amongst one's members, if they cannot by their own indications dive those of another ?
pope_couplet: By sign who knows not sings to comprehend, what gain,'Mid all his members, from his eyes does he obtain
explanation_en: Of what use are the eyes amongst one's members, if they cannot by their own indications dive those of another ?
explanation_ta: (முகம் கண் இவற்றின்) குறிப்புக்களால் உள்ளக்குறிப்பை உணராவிட்டால், ஒருவனுடைய உறுப்புகளுள் கண்கள் என்னப் பயன்படும்.

translation:
As forms around in crystal mirrored clear we find, The face will show what's throbbing in the mind

Meaning: As the mirror reflects what is near so does the face show what is uppermost in the mind
pope_couplet: As forms around in crystal mirrored clear we find, The face will show what's throbbing in the mind
explanation_en: As the mirror reflects what is near so does the face show what is uppermost in the mind
explanation_ta: தன்னை அடுத்தப் பொருளைத் தன்னிடம் காட்டும் பளிங்கு போல், ஒருவனுடைய நெஞ்சில் மிகுந்துள்ளதை அவனுடைய முகம் காட்டும்.

translation:
Than speaking countenance hath aught more prescient skill?Rejoice or burn with rage, 'tis the first herald still

Meaning: Is there anything so full of knowledge as the face ? (No) it precedes the mind, whether (the latter is) pleased or vexed
pope_couplet: Than speaking countenance hath aught more prescient skill?Rejoice or burn with rage, 'tis the first herald still
explanation_en: Is there anything so full of knowledge as the face ? (No) it precedes the mind, whether (the latter is) pleased or vexed
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் விருப்பம் கொண்டாலும், வெறுப்புக் கொண்டாலும் அவனுடைய முகம் முற்ப்பட்டு அதைத் தெரிவிக்கும், அம் முகத்தைவிட அறிவு மிக்கது உண்டோ.

translation:
To see the face is quite enough, in presence brought, When men can look within and know the lurking thought

Meaning: If the king gets those who by looking into his mind can understand (and remove) what has occurred (to him) it is enough that he stand looking at their face
pope_couplet: To see the face is quite enough, in presence brought, When men can look within and know the lurking thought
explanation_en: If the king gets those who by looking into his mind can understand (and remove) what has occurred (to him) it is enough that he stand looking at their face
explanation_ta: உள்ளக் குறிப்பை நோக்கி உற்றதை உணரவல்லவரைப் பெற்றால், (அவரிடம் எதையும் கூறாமல்) அவறுடைய முகத்தை நோக்கி நின்றால் போதும்.

translation:
The eye speaks out the hate or friendly soul of man; To those who know the eye's swift varying moods to scan

Meaning: If a king gets ministers who can read the movements of the eye, the eyes (of foreign kings) will (themselves) reveal (to him) their hatred or friendship
pope_couplet: The eye speaks out the hate or friendly soul of man; To those who know the eye's swift varying moods to scan
explanation_en: If a king gets ministers who can read the movements of the eye, the eyes (of foreign kings) will (themselves) reveal (to him) their hatred or friendship
explanation_ta: கண்பார்வையின் வேறுபாடுகளை உணரவல்லவரைப் பெற்றால்( ஒருவனுடைய மனதில் உள்ள) கையையும் நட்பையும் அவனுடைய கண்களே சொல்லி விடும்.

translation:
The men of keen discerning soul no other test apply(When you their secret ask) than man's revealing eye

Meaning: The measuring-rod of those (ministers) who say "we are acute" will on inquiry be found to be their (own) eyes and nothing else
pope_couplet: The men of keen discerning soul no other test apply(When you their secret ask) than man's revealing eye
explanation_en: The measuring-rod of those (ministers) who say "we are acute" will on inquiry be found to be their (own) eyes and nothing else
explanation_ta: யாம் நுட்பமான அறிவுடையேம் என்று பிறர் கருத்தை அறிபவரின் அளக்குங்கோல், ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால் அவனுடையக் கண்களே அல்லாமல் வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Men pure in heart, who know of words the varied force, Should to their audience known adapt their well-arranged discourse

Meaning: Let the pure who know the arrangement of words speak with deliberation after ascertaining (the nature of) the court (then assembled)
pope_couplet: Men pure in heart, who know of words the varied force, Should to their audience known adapt their well-arranged discourse
explanation_en: Let the pure who know the arrangement of words speak with deliberation after ascertaining (the nature of) the court (then assembled)
explanation_ta: சொற்களின் தொகுதி அறிந்த தூய்மை உடையவர், அவைக்களத்தின் தன்மை அறிந்து ஏற்றச் சொற்களை ஆராய்ந்து சொல்ல வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
Good men to whom the arts of eloquence are known, Should seek occasion meet, and say what well they've made their own

Meaning: Let the good who know the uses of words speak with a clear knowledge after ascertaining the time (suited to the court)
pope_couplet: Good men to whom the arts of eloquence are known, Should seek occasion meet, and say what well they've made their own
explanation_en: Let the good who know the uses of words speak with a clear knowledge after ascertaining the time (suited to the court)
explanation_ta: சொற்களின் தன்மையை ஆராய்ந்த நன்மை உடையவர், அவையின் செவ்வியை ஆராய்ந்து நன்றாக உணர்ந்து சொல்ல வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
Unversed in councils, who essays to speakKnows not the way of suasive words,- and all is weak

Meaning: Those who undertake to speak without knowing the (nature of the) court are ignorant of the quality of words as well as devoid of the power (of learning)
pope_couplet: Unversed in councils, who essays to speakKnows not the way of suasive words,- and all is weak
explanation_en: Those who undertake to speak without knowing the (nature of the) court are ignorant of the quality of words as well as devoid of the power (of learning)
explanation_ta: அவையின் தன்மை அறியாமல் சொல்லுதலை மேற்கொள்கின்றவர், சொற்களின் வகை அறியாதவரே, அவர் சொல்லவல்லதும் இல்லை.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
Before the bright ones shine as doth the lightBefore the dull ones be as purest stucco white

Meaning: Ministers should be lights in the assembly of the enlightned, but assume the pure whiteness of mortar (ignorance) in that of fools
pope_couplet: Before the bright ones shine as doth the lightBefore the dull ones be as purest stucco white
explanation_en: Ministers should be lights in the assembly of the enlightned, but assume the pure whiteness of mortar (ignorance) in that of fools
explanation_ta: அறிவிற் சிறந்தவரின் முன் தானும் அறிவிற் சிறந்தவராக நடந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும், அறிவில்லாதவர் முன் தாமும் வெண் கண்ணம் போல் அறிவில்லாதவராய் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
Midst all good things the best is modest grace, That speaks not first before the elders' face

Meaning: The modesty by which one does not rush forward and speak in (an assembly of) superiors is the best among all (one's) good qualities
pope_couplet: Midst all good things the best is modest grace, That speaks not first before the elders' face
explanation_en: The modesty by which one does not rush forward and speak in (an assembly of) superiors is the best among all (one's) good qualities
explanation_ta: அறிவு மிகுந்தவரிடையே முந்திச் சென்று பேசாத அடக்கம் ஒருவனுக்கு நன்மை என்று சொல்லப்பட்டவை எல்லாவற்றிலும நல்லது.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
As in the way one tottering falls, is slip beforeThe men whose minds are filled with varied lore

Meaning: (For a minister) to blunder in the presence of those who have acquired a vast store of learning and know (the value thereof) is like a good man stumbling (and falling away) from the path (of virtue)
pope_couplet: As in the way one tottering falls, is slip beforeThe men whose minds are filled with varied lore
explanation_en: (For a minister) to blunder in the presence of those who have acquired a vast store of learning and know (the value thereof) is like a good man stumbling (and falling away) from the path (of virtue)
explanation_ta: விரிவான அறிவுத்துறைகளை அறிந்து உணர்கின்றவரின் முன்னே குற்றப்படுதல், ஒழுக்கநெறியிலிருந்து நிலைத் தளர்ந்து கெடுவதைப் போன்றதாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
The learning of the learned sage shines brightTo those whose faultless skill can value it aright

Meaning: The learning of those who have read and understood (much) will shine in the assembly of those who faultlessly examine (the nature of) words
pope_couplet: The learning of the learned sage shines brightTo those whose faultless skill can value it aright
explanation_en: The learning of those who have read and understood (much) will shine in the assembly of those who faultlessly examine (the nature of) words
explanation_ta: குற்றமறச்சொற்களை ஆராயவதில் வ ல்ல அறிஞர்களிடத்தில் பல நூல்களைக் கற்றறிந்தவரின் கல்வியானது நன்றாக விளங்கித் தொன்றும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
To speak where understanding hearers you obtain, Is sprinkling water on the fields of growing grain

Meaning: Lecturing to those who have the ability to understand (for themselves) is like watering a bed of plants that are growing (of themselves)
pope_couplet: To speak where understanding hearers you obtain, Is sprinkling water on the fields of growing grain
explanation_en: Lecturing to those who have the ability to understand (for themselves) is like watering a bed of plants that are growing (of themselves)
explanation_ta: தாமே உணர்கின்ற தன்மை உடையவரின் முன் கற்றவர் பேசுதல், தானே வளரும் பயிருள்ள பாத்தியில் நீரைச் சொரிந்தாற் போன்றது.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
In councils of the good, who speak good things with penetrating power, In councils of the mean, let them say nought, e'en in oblivious hour

Meaning: Those who are able to speak good things impressively in an assembly of the good should not even forgetfully speak them in that of the low
pope_couplet: In councils of the good, who speak good things with penetrating power, In councils of the mean, let them say nought, e'en in oblivious hour
explanation_en: Those who are able to speak good things impressively in an assembly of the good should not even forgetfully speak them in that of the low
explanation_ta: நல்ல அறிஞரின் அவையில் நல்ல பொருளைப் மனதில் பதியுமாறு சொல்லவல்லவர், அறிவில்லாதவரின் கூட்டத்தில் மறந்தும் பேசக் கூடாது.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
Ambrosia in the sewer spilt, is wordSpoken in presence of the alien herd

Meaning: To utter (a good word) in the assembly of those who are of inferior rank is like dropping nectar on the ground
pope_couplet: Ambrosia in the sewer spilt, is wordSpoken in presence of the alien herd
explanation_en: To utter (a good word) in the assembly of those who are of inferior rank is like dropping nectar on the ground
explanation_ta: தன் இனத்தார் அல்லாதவரின் கூட்டத்தில் முன் ஒரு பொருளைப்பற்றி பேசுதல், தூய்மையில்லாத முற்றத்தில் சிந்திய அமிழ்தம் போன்றது.
adhigaram_name_en: The Knowledge of the Council Chamber

translation:
Men, pure in heart, who know of words the varied force, The mighty council's moods discern, nor fail in their discourse

Meaning: The pure who know the classification of words having first ascertained the nature (of the court) will not (through fear) falter in their speech before the powerful body
pope_couplet: Men, pure in heart, who know of words the varied force, The mighty council's moods discern, nor fail in their discourse
explanation_en: The pure who know the classification of words having first ascertained the nature (of the court) will not (through fear) falter in their speech before the powerful body
explanation_ta: சொற்களின் தூய்மை தொகுதி அறிந்த தூய்மை உடையவர், அவைக்களத்தின் வகையினை அறிந்து, வல்லவறின் அவையில் வாய்ச் சோர்ந்து பிழை சொல்லமாட்டார்.

translation:
Who what they've learned, in penetrating words heve learned to say, Before the learn'd among the learn'd most learn'd are they

Meaning: Those who can agreeably set forth their acquirements before the learned will be regarded as the most learned among the learned
pope_couplet: Who what they've learned, in penetrating words heve learned to say, Before the learn'd among the learn'd most learn'd are they
explanation_en: Those who can agreeably set forth their acquirements before the learned will be regarded as the most learned among the learned
explanation_ta: கற்றவரின் முன் தாம் கற்றவைகளைச் அவருடைய மனதில் பதியுமாறுச் சொல்லவல்லவர், கற்றவர் எல்லாரிலும் கற்றவராக மதித்துச் சொல்லப்படுவார்.

translation:
Many encountering death in face of foe will hold their ground; Who speak undaunted in the council hall are rarely found

Meaning: Many indeed may (fearlessly) die in the presence of (their) foes; (but) few are those who are fearless in the assembly (of the learned)
pope_couplet: Many encountering death in face of foe will hold their ground; Who speak undaunted in the council hall are rarely found
explanation_en: Many indeed may (fearlessly) die in the presence of (their) foes; (but) few are those who are fearless in the assembly (of the learned)
explanation_ta: பகைவர் உள்ள போர்க்களத்தில் (அஞ்சாமல் சென்று) சாகத் துணிந்தவர் உலகத்தில் பலர், கற்றவரின் அவைக்களத்தில் பேச வல்லவர் சிலரே.

translation:
What you have learned, in penetrating words speak out beforeThe learn'd; but learn what men more learn'd can teach you more

Meaning: (Ministers) should agreeably set forth their acquirements before the learned and acquire more (knowledge) from their superiors (in learning)
pope_couplet: What you have learned, in penetrating words speak out beforeThe learn'd; but learn what men more learn'd can teach you more
explanation_en: (Ministers) should agreeably set forth their acquirements before the learned and acquire more (knowledge) from their superiors (in learning)
explanation_ta: கற்றவரின் முன் தான் கற்றவைகளை அவருடைய மனதில் பதியுமாறு சொல்லி, மிகுதியாகக் கற்றவரிடம் அம்மிகுதியான கல்வியைக் அறிந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
By rule, to dialectic art your mind apply, That in the council fearless you may make an apt reply

Meaning: In order to reply fearlessly before a foreign court, (ministers) should learn logic according to the rules (of grammar)
pope_couplet: By rule, to dialectic art your mind apply, That in the council fearless you may make an apt reply
explanation_en: In order to reply fearlessly before a foreign court, (ministers) should learn logic according to the rules (of grammar)
explanation_ta: அவையில் (ஒன்றைக் கேட்டவர்க்கு) அஞ்சாது விடைகூறும் பொருட்டாக நூல்களைக் கற்க்கும் நெறியில் அளவை நூல் அறிந்து கற்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
To those who lack the hero's eye what can the sword availOr science what, to those before the council keen who quail

Meaning: What have they to do with a sword who are not valiant, or they with learning who are afraid of an intelligent assembly ?
pope_couplet: To those who lack the hero's eye what can the sword availOr science what, to those before the council keen who quail
explanation_en: What have they to do with a sword who are not valiant, or they with learning who are afraid of an intelligent assembly ?
explanation_ta: அஞ்சாத வீரர் அல்லாத மற்றவர்க்கு வாளோடு என்ன தொடர்பு உண்டு, நுண்ணறிவுடையவரின் அவைக்கு அஞ்சுகின்றவர்க்கு நூலோடு என்ன தொடர்பு உண்டு.

translation:
As shining sword before the foe which 'sexless being' bears, Is science learned by him the council's face who fears

Meaning: The learning of him who is diffident before an assembly is like the shining sword of an hermaphrodite in the presence of his foes
pope_couplet: As shining sword before the foe which 'sexless being' bears, Is science learned by him the council's face who fears
explanation_en: The learning of him who is diffident before an assembly is like the shining sword of an hermaphrodite in the presence of his foes
explanation_ta: அவையினிடத்தில் அஞ்சுகின்றவன் கற்ற நூல், பகைவரின் போர்க்களத்தில் அஞ்சுகின்ற பேடியின் கையில் உள்ள கூர்மையான வாள் போன்றது.

translation:
Though many things they've learned, yet useless are they all, To man who cannot well and strongly speak in council hall

Meaning: Those who cannot agreeably speak good things before a good assembly are indeed unprofitable persons inspite of all their various acquirements
pope_couplet: Though many things they've learned, yet useless are they all, To man who cannot well and strongly speak in council hall
explanation_en: Those who cannot agreeably speak good things before a good assembly are indeed unprofitable persons inspite of all their various acquirements
explanation_ta: நல்ல அறிஞரின் அவையில் நல்லப் பொருளைக் கேட்பவர் மனதில் பதியுமாறு சொல்ல முடியாதவர், பல நூல்களைக் கற்றாலும் பயன் இல்லாதவரே.

translation:
Who, though they've learned, before the council of the good men quake, Than men unlearn'd a lower place must take

Meaning: They who, though they have learned and understood, are yet afraid of the assembly of the good, are said to be inferior (even) to the illiterate
pope_couplet: Who, though they've learned, before the council of the good men quake, Than men unlearn'd a lower place must take
explanation_en: They who, though they have learned and understood, are yet afraid of the assembly of the good, are said to be inferior (even) to the illiterate
explanation_ta: நூல்களைக் கற்றிந்த போதிலும் நல்ல அறிஞரின் அவைக்கு அஞ்சுகின்றவர், கல்லாதவரை விடக் கடைப்பட்டவர் என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Who what they've learned, in penetrating words know not to say, The council fearing, though they live, as dead are they

Meaning: Those who through fear of the assembly are unable to set forth their learning in an interesting manner, though alive, are yet like the dead
pope_couplet: Who what they've learned, in penetrating words know not to say, The council fearing, though they live, as dead are they
explanation_en: Those who through fear of the assembly are unable to set forth their learning in an interesting manner, though alive, are yet like the dead
explanation_ta: அவைக்களத்திற்கு அஞ்சித் தாம் கற்றவைகளைக் (கேட்பவர் மனத்தில்) பதியுமாறு சொல்ல முடியாதவர், உயிரோடு வாழ்ந்தலும் இறந்தவர்க்கு ஒப்பாவர்.

translation:
Where spreads fertility unfailing, where resides a band, Of virtuous men, and those of ample wealth, call that a 'land'

Meaning: A kingdom is that in which (those who carry on) a complete cultivation, virtuous persons, and
pope_couplet: Where spreads fertility unfailing, where resides a band, Of virtuous men, and those of ample wealth, call that a 'land'
explanation_en: A kingdom is that in which (those who carry on) a complete cultivation, virtuous persons, and
explanation_ta: குறையாத விளைபொருளும் தக்க அறிஞரும் கேடில்லாத செல்வம் உடையவரும் கூடிப் பொருந்தியுள்ள நாடே நாடாகும்.

translation:
That is a 'land' which men desire for wealth's abundant share, Yielding rich increase, where calamities are rare

Meaning: A kingdom is that which is desire for its immense wealth, and which grows greatly in prosperity, being free from destructive causes
pope_couplet: That is a 'land' which men desire for wealth's abundant share, Yielding rich increase, where calamities are rare
explanation_en: A kingdom is that which is desire for its immense wealth, and which grows greatly in prosperity, being free from destructive causes
explanation_ta: மிக்க பொருள் வளம் உடையதாய், எல்லோரும் விரும்பத்தக்கதாய் கேடு இல்லாததாய், மிகுதியாக விளைபொருள் தருவதே நாடாகும்.

translation:
When burthens press, it bears; Yet, With unfailing handTo king due tribute pays: that is the 'land'

Meaning: A kingdom is that which can bear any burden that may be pressed on it (from adjoining kingdoms) and (yet) pay the full tribute to its sovereign
pope_couplet: When burthens press, it bears; Yet, With unfailing handTo king due tribute pays: that is the 'land'
explanation_en: A kingdom is that which can bear any burden that may be pressed on it (from adjoining kingdoms) and (yet) pay the full tribute to its sovereign
explanation_ta: (மற்ற நாட்டு மக்கள் குடியேறுவதால்) சுமை ஒரு சேரத் தன் மேல் வரும் போது தாங்கி, அரசனுக்கு இறைபொருள் முழுதும் தர வல்லது நாடாகும்.

translation:
That is a 'land' whose peaceful annals know, Nor famine fierce, nor wasting plague, nor ravage of the foe

Meaning: A kingdom is that which continues to be free from excessive starvation, irremediable epidemics, and destructive foes
pope_couplet: That is a 'land' whose peaceful annals know, Nor famine fierce, nor wasting plague, nor ravage of the foe
explanation_en: A kingdom is that which continues to be free from excessive starvation, irremediable epidemics, and destructive foes
explanation_ta: மிக்க பசியும், ஓயாத நோயும் (வெளியே வந்து தாக்கி) அழிவு செய்யும் பகையும் தன்னிடம் சேராமல் நல்ல வகையில் நடைபெறுவதே நாடாகும்.

translation:
From factions free, and desolating civil strife, and bandOf lurking murderers that king afflict, that is the 'land'

Meaning: A kingdom is that which is without various (irregular) associations, destructive internal enemies, and murderous savages who (sometimes) harass the sovereign
pope_couplet: From factions free, and desolating civil strife, and bandOf lurking murderers that king afflict, that is the 'land'
explanation_en: A kingdom is that which is without various (irregular) associations, destructive internal enemies, and murderous savages who (sometimes) harass the sovereign
explanation_ta: பல வகை மாறுபடும் கூட்டங்களும், உடனிருந்தே அழிவு செய்யும் பகையும், அரசனை வருத்துகின்ற கொலைத் தொழில் பொருந்திய குறுநில மன்னரும் இல்லாதது நாடு.

translation:
Chief of all lands is that, where nought disturbs its peace; Or, if invaders come, still yields its rich increase

Meaning: The learned say that the best kingdom is that which knows no evil (from its foes), and, if injured (at all), suffers no diminution in its fruitfulness
pope_couplet: Chief of all lands is that, where nought disturbs its peace; Or, if invaders come, still yields its rich increase
explanation_en: The learned say that the best kingdom is that which knows no evil (from its foes), and, if injured (at all), suffers no diminution in its fruitfulness
explanation_ta: பகைவரால் கெடுக்கப் படாததாய், கெட்டுவிட்ட காலத்திலும் வளம் குன்றாததாய் உள்ள நாடே நாடுகள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் தலைமையானது என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Waters from rains and springs, a mountain near, and waters thence; These make a land, with fortress' sure defence

Meaning: The constituents of a kingdom are the two waters (from above and below), well situated hills and an undestructible fort
pope_couplet: Waters from rains and springs, a mountain near, and waters thence; These make a land, with fortress' sure defence
explanation_en: The constituents of a kingdom are the two waters (from above and below), well situated hills and an undestructible fort
explanation_ta: ஊற்றும் மழையும் மாகிய இருவகை நீர்வளமும், தக்கவாறு அமைந்த மலையும் அந்த மலையிலிருந்து ஆறாக வரும் நீர் வளமும் வலிய அரணும் நாட்டிற்கு உறுப்புகளாகும்.

translation:
A country's jewels are these five: unfailing health, Fertility, and joy, a sure defence, and wealth

Meaning: Freedom from epidemics, wealth, produce, happiness and protection (to subjects); these five, the learned, say, are the ornaments of a kingdom
pope_couplet: A country's jewels are these five: unfailing health, Fertility, and joy, a sure defence, and wealth
explanation_en: Freedom from epidemics, wealth, produce, happiness and protection (to subjects); these five, the learned, say, are the ornaments of a kingdom
explanation_ta: நோயில்லாதிருத்தல், செல்வம், விளை பொருள், வளம், இன்பவாழ்வு, நல்ல காவல் இந்த ஐந்தும் நாட்டிற்கு அழகு என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
That is a land that yields increase unsought, That is no land whose gifts with toil are bought

Meaning: The learned say that those are kingdom whose wealth is not laboured for, and those not, whose wealth is only obtained through labour
pope_couplet: That is a land that yields increase unsought, That is no land whose gifts with toil are bought
explanation_en: The learned say that those are kingdom whose wealth is not laboured for, and those not, whose wealth is only obtained through labour
explanation_ta: முயற்சி செய்து தேடாமலேயே தரும் வளத்தை உடைய நாடுகளைச் சிறந்த நாடுகள் என்று கூறுவர், தேடிமுயன்றால் வளம் தரும் நாடுகள் சிறந்த நாடுகள் அல்ல.

translation:
Though blest with all these varied gifts' increase, A land gains nought that is not with its king at peace

Meaning: Although in possession of all the above mentioned excellences, these are indeed of no use to a country, in the absence of harmony between the sovereign and the sujects
pope_couplet: Though blest with all these varied gifts' increase, A land gains nought that is not with its king at peace
explanation_en: Although in possession of all the above mentioned excellences, these are indeed of no use to a country, in the absence of harmony between the sovereign and the sujects
explanation_ta: நல்ல அரசன் பொருந்தாத நாடு, மேற்சொன்ன நன்மைகள் எல்லாம் அமைதிருந்த போதிலும் அவற்றால் பயன் இல்லாமல் போகும்.

translation:
A fort is wealth to those who act against their foes; Is wealth to them who, fearing, guard themselves from woes

Meaning: A fort is an object of importance to those who march (against their foes) as well as to those who through fear (of pursuers) would seek it for shelter
pope_couplet: A fort is wealth to those who act against their foes; Is wealth to them who, fearing, guard themselves from woes
explanation_en: A fort is an object of importance to those who march (against their foes) as well as to those who through fear (of pursuers) would seek it for shelter
explanation_ta: (படையெடுத்தும்) போர் செய்யச் செல்பவர்க்கும் அரண் சிறந்ததாகும், (படையெடுத்தவர்க்கு) அஞ்சித் தன்னை புகழிடமாக அடைந்தவர்க்கும் அது சிறந்ததாகும்.

translation:
A fort is that which owns fount of waters crystal clear, An open space, a hill, and shade of beauteous forest near

Meaning: A fort is that which has everlasting water, plains, mountains and cool shady forests
pope_couplet: A fort is that which owns fount of waters crystal clear, An open space, a hill, and shade of beauteous forest near
explanation_en: A fort is that which has everlasting water, plains, mountains and cool shady forests
explanation_ta: மணிபோல் தெளிந்த நீரும், வெட்ட வெளியான நிலமும், மலையும், அழகிய நிழல் உடைய காடும் ஆகிய இவை நான்கும் உள்ளதே அரண் ஆகும்.

translation:
Height, breadth, strength, difficult access:Science declares a fort must these possess

Meaning: The learned say that a fortress is an enclosure having these four (qualities) viz, height, breadth, strength and inaccessibility
pope_couplet: Height, breadth, strength, difficult access:Science declares a fort must these possess
explanation_en: The learned say that a fortress is an enclosure having these four (qualities) viz, height, breadth, strength and inaccessibility
explanation_ta: உயரம், அகலம், உறுதி, பகைவரால் அழிக்க முடியாத அருமை ஆகிய இந்த நான்கும் அமைந்திப்பதே அரண் என்று நூலோர் கூறுவர்.

translation:
A fort must need but slight defence, yet ample be, Defying all the foeman's energy

Meaning: A fort is that which has an extensive space within, but only small places to be guarded, and such as can destroy the courage of besieging foes
pope_couplet: A fort must need but slight defence, yet ample be, Defying all the foeman's energy
explanation_en: A fort is that which has an extensive space within, but only small places to be guarded, and such as can destroy the courage of besieging foes
explanation_ta: காக்க வேண்டிய இடம் சிறியதாய், மற்ற இடம் பெரிய பரப்புள்ளதாய், தன்னை எதிர்த்துவந்த பகைவரிருடைய ஊக்கத்தை அழிக்க வல்லது அரண் ஆகும்.

translation:
Impregnable, containing ample stores of food, A fort for those within, must be a warlike station good

Meaning: A fort is that which cannot be captured, which abounds in suitable provisions, and affords a position of easy defence to its inmates
pope_couplet: Impregnable, containing ample stores of food, A fort for those within, must be a warlike station good
explanation_en: A fort is that which cannot be captured, which abounds in suitable provisions, and affords a position of easy defence to its inmates
explanation_ta: பகைவரால் கைப்பற்ற முடியாததாய், தன்னிடம் உணவுபொருள் கொண்டதாய், உள்ளிருப்போர் நிலைத்திருப்பதர்க்கு எளிதாகிய தன்மை உடையது அரண்.

translation:
A fort, with all munitions amply stored, In time of need should good reserves afford

Meaning: A fort is that which has all (needful) things, and excellent heroes that can help it against destruction (by foes)
pope_couplet: A fort, with all munitions amply stored, In time of need should good reserves afford
explanation_en: A fort is that which has all (needful) things, and excellent heroes that can help it against destruction (by foes)
explanation_ta: தன்னிடம் (உள்ளவர்க்கு) எல்லாப் பொருளும் உடையதாய், போர் நெருக்கடியானவிடத்தில் உதவ வல்ல நல்ல விரர்களை உடையது அரண் ஆகும்.

translation:
A fort should be impregnable to foes who gird it round, Or aim there darts from far, or mine beneath the ground

Meaning: A fort is that which cannot be captured by blockading, assaulting, or undermining it
pope_couplet: A fort should be impregnable to foes who gird it round, Or aim there darts from far, or mine beneath the ground
explanation_en: A fort is that which cannot be captured by blockading, assaulting, or undermining it
explanation_ta: முற்றுகையிட்டும் முற்றுகையிடாமல் போர் செய்தும், வஞ்சனை செய்தும் எப்படியும் பகைவரால் கைப்பற்ற முடியாத அருமை உடையது அரண் ஆகும்.

translation:
Howe'er the circling foe may strive access to win, A fort should give the victory to those who guard within

Meaning: That is a fort whose inmates are able to overcome without losing their ground, even abler men who have besieged it
pope_couplet: Howe'er the circling foe may strive access to win, A fort should give the victory to those who guard within
explanation_en: That is a fort whose inmates are able to overcome without losing their ground, even abler men who have besieged it
explanation_ta: முற்றுகையிடுவதில் வல்லமை கொண்டு முற்றுகை இட்டவரையும், (உள்ளிருந்தவர் பற்றிய) பற்றை விடாமலிருந்து வெல்வதற்கு உரியது அரண் ஆகும்.

translation:
At outset of the strife a fort should foes dismay; And greatness gain by deeds in every glorious day

Meaning: A fort is that which derives excellence from the stratagems made (by its inmates) to defeat their enemies in the battlefield
pope_couplet: At outset of the strife a fort should foes dismay; And greatness gain by deeds in every glorious day
explanation_en: A fort is that which derives excellence from the stratagems made (by its inmates) to defeat their enemies in the battlefield
explanation_ta: போர் முனையில் பகைவர் அழியும் படியாக (உள்ளிருந்தவர்செய்யும்) போர்ச் செயல்வகையால் பெருமைப் பெற்றுச் சிறப்புடையதாய் விளங்குவது அரண் ஆகும்.

translation:
Howe'er majestic castled walls may rise, To craven souls no fortress strength supplies

Meaning: Although a fort may possess all (the above-said) excellence, it is, as it were without these, if its inmates possess not the excellence of action
pope_couplet: Howe'er majestic castled walls may rise, To craven souls no fortress strength supplies
explanation_en: Although a fort may possess all (the above-said) excellence, it is, as it were without these, if its inmates possess not the excellence of action
explanation_ta: எத்தகைய பெருமையை உடையதாக இருந்த போதிலும், செயல்வகையால் சிறப்பு இல்லாதவரரிடத்தில் அரண் பயனில்லாததாகும். பொருள் செயல்வகை

translation:
Nothing exists save wealth, that canChange man of nought to worthy man

Meaning: Besides wealth there is nothing that can change people of no importance into those of (some) importance
pope_couplet: Nothing exists save wealth, that canChange man of nought to worthy man
explanation_en: Besides wealth there is nothing that can change people of no importance into those of (some) importance
explanation_ta: ஒரு பொருளாக மதிக்கத் தகாதவரையும், மதிப்புடையவராகச் செய்வதாகிய பொருள் அல்லாமல் சிறப்புடைய பொருள் வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Those who have nought all will despise; All raise the wealthy to the skies

Meaning: All despise the poor; (but) all praise the rich
pope_couplet: Those who have nought all will despise; All raise the wealthy to the skies
explanation_en: All despise the poor; (but) all praise the rich
explanation_ta: பொருள் இல்லாதவரை (வேறு நன்மை உடையவராக இருந்தாலும்) எல்லாரும் இகழ்வார், செல்வரை (வேறு நன்மை இல்லாவிட்டாலும்) எல்லாரும் சிறப்பு செய்வர்.

translation:
Wealth, the lamp unfailing, speeds to every land, Dispersing darkness at its lord's command

Meaning: The imperishable light of wealth goes into regions desired (by its owner) and destroys the darkness (of enmity therein)
pope_couplet: Wealth, the lamp unfailing, speeds to every land, Dispersing darkness at its lord's command
explanation_en: The imperishable light of wealth goes into regions desired (by its owner) and destroys the darkness (of enmity therein)
explanation_ta: பொருள் என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற நந்தா விளக்கு, நினைத்த இடத்திற்குச் சென்று உள்ள இடையூற்றைக் கெடுக்கும்

translation:
Their wealth, who blameless means can use aright, Is source of virtue and of choice delight

Meaning: The wealth acquired with a knowledge of the proper means and without foul practices will yield virtue and happiness
pope_couplet: Their wealth, who blameless means can use aright, Is source of virtue and of choice delight
explanation_en: The wealth acquired with a knowledge of the proper means and without foul practices will yield virtue and happiness
explanation_ta: சேர்க்கும் திறம் அறிந்து தீமை ஒன்றும் இல்லாமல், சேர்க்கப் பட்டுவந்த பொருள் ஒருவனுக்கு அறத்தையும் கொடுக்கும் இன்பத்தையும் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Wealth gained by loss of love and grace, Let man cast off from his embrace
