Meaning: (Kings) should rather avoid than seek the accumulation of wealth which does not flow in with mercy and love
pope_couplet: Wealth gained by loss of love and grace, Let man cast off from his embrace
explanation_en: (Kings) should rather avoid than seek the accumulation of wealth which does not flow in with mercy and love
explanation_ta: அருளோடும், அன்போடும் பொருந்தாத வழிகளில் வந்த செல்வத்தின் ஆக்கத்தைப் பெற்று மகிழாமல் அதைத் தீமையானது என்று நீக்கிவிட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Wealth that falls to him as heir, wealth from the kingdom's dues,

Meaning: The spoils of slaughtered foes; these are the royal revenues
pope_couplet: Wealth that falls to him as heir, wealth from the kingdom's dues,
explanation_en: The spoils of slaughtered foes; these are the royal revenues
explanation_ta: இறையாக வந்து சேரும் பொருளும், சுங்கமாகக் கொள்ளும் பொருளும், தன் பகைவரை வென்று திறமையாகக் கொள்ளும் பொருளும் அரசனுடைய பொருள்களாகும்.

translation:
'Tis love that kindliness as offspring bears:And wealth as bounteous nurse the infant rears

Meaning: The child mercy which is borne by love grows under the care of the rich nurse of wealth
pope_couplet: 'Tis love that kindliness as offspring bears:And wealth as bounteous nurse the infant rears
explanation_en: The child mercy which is borne by love grows under the care of the rich nurse of wealth
explanation_ta: அன்பினால் பெறப்பட்ட அருள் என்றுக் கூறப்படும் குழந்தை, பொருள் என்றுக் கூறப்படும் செல்வமுள்ள செவிலித் தாயால் வளர்வதாகும்.

translation:
As one to view the strife of elephants who takes his stand, On hill he's climbed, is he who works with money in his hand

Meaning: An undertaking of one who has wealth in one's hands is like viewing an elephant-fight from a hill-top
pope_couplet: As one to view the strife of elephants who takes his stand, On hill he's climbed, is he who works with money in his hand
explanation_en: An undertaking of one who has wealth in one's hands is like viewing an elephant-fight from a hill-top
explanation_ta: தன் கைப்பொருள் ஒன்று தன்னிடம் இருக்க அதைக் கொண்டு ஒருவன் செயல் செய்தால், மலையின் மேல் ஏறி யானைப் போரைக் கண்டாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Make money! Foeman's insolence o'ergrownTo lop away no keener steel is known

Meaning: Accumulate wealth; it will destroy the arrogance of (your) foes; there is no weapon sharper than it
pope_couplet: Make money! Foeman's insolence o'ergrownTo lop away no keener steel is known
explanation_en: Accumulate wealth; it will destroy the arrogance of (your) foes; there is no weapon sharper than it
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் பொருளை ஈட்டவேண்டும், அவனுடைய பகைவரின் செருக்கைக் கெடுக்க வல்ல வாள் அதைவிடக் கூர்மையானது வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Who plenteous store of glorious wealth have gained, By them the other two are easily obtained

Meaning: To those who have honestly acquired an abundance of riches, the other two, (virtue and pleasure) are things easy (of acquisition)
pope_couplet: Who plenteous store of glorious wealth have gained, By them the other two are easily obtained
explanation_en: To those who have honestly acquired an abundance of riches, the other two, (virtue and pleasure) are things easy (of acquisition)
explanation_ta: சிறந்ததாகிய பொருளை மிகுதியாக ஈட்டியவர்க்கு, மற்ற அறமும் இன்பமுமாகிய இரண்டும் ஒரு சேரக்கைகூடும் எளிய பொருளாகும்.

translation:
A conquering host, complete in all its limbs, that fears no wound, Mid treasures of the king is chiefest found

Meaning: The army which is complete in (its) parts and conquers without fear of wounds is the chief wealth of the king
pope_couplet: A conquering host, complete in all its limbs, that fears no wound, Mid treasures of the king is chiefest found
explanation_en: The army which is complete in (its) parts and conquers without fear of wounds is the chief wealth of the king
explanation_ta: எல்லா உறுப்புக்களும் நிறைந்ததாய் இடையூறுகளுக்கு அஞ்சாததாய் உள்ள வெற்றி தரும் படை, அரசனுடைய செல்வங்கள் எல்லாவற்றிலும் சிறந்ததாகும்.

translation:
In adverse hour, to face undaunted might of conquering foe, Is bravery that only veteran host can show

Meaning: Ancient army can alone have the valour which makes it stand by its king at the time of defeat, fearless of wounds and unmindful of its reduced strength
pope_couplet: In adverse hour, to face undaunted might of conquering foe, Is bravery that only veteran host can show
explanation_en: Ancient army can alone have the valour which makes it stand by its king at the time of defeat, fearless of wounds and unmindful of its reduced strength
explanation_ta: போரில் அழிவு வந்தவிடத்தில் வலிமைக் குன்றினாலும், இடையூறுகளுக்கு அஞ்சாத அஞ்சாமை தொன்றுதொட்டுப் பெருமை உடையபடைக்கு அல்லாமல் முடியாது.

translation:
Though, like the sea, the angry mice send forth their battle cry; What then? The dragon breathes upon them, and they die

Meaning: What if (a host of) hostile rats roar like the sea ? They will perish at the mere breath of the cobra
pope_couplet: Though, like the sea, the angry mice send forth their battle cry; What then? The dragon breathes upon them, and they die
explanation_en: What if (a host of) hostile rats roar like the sea ? They will perish at the mere breath of the cobra
explanation_ta: எலியாகிய பகைக்கூடி கடல் போல் ஒலித்தாலும் என்ன தீங்கு ஏற்ப்படும், பாம்பு மூச்சு விட்ட அளவில் அவைக் கெட்டழியும்.

translation:
That is a host, by no defeats, by no desertions shamed, For old hereditary courage famed

Meaning: That indeed is an army which has stood firm of old without suffering destruction or deserting (to the enemy)
pope_couplet: That is a host, by no defeats, by no desertions shamed, For old hereditary courage famed
explanation_en: That indeed is an army which has stood firm of old without suffering destruction or deserting (to the enemy)
explanation_ta: (போர் முனையில்) அழிவு இல்லாததாய்(பகைவருடைய) வஞ்சனைக்கு இரையாகாததாய், தொன்று தொட்டுவந்த அஞ்சாமை உடையதே படையாகும்.

translation:
That is a 'host' that joins its ranks, and mightily withstands, Though death with sudden wrath should fall upon its bands

Meaning: That indeed is an army which is capable of offering a united resistance, even if Yama advances against it with fury
pope_couplet: That is a 'host' that joins its ranks, and mightily withstands, Though death with sudden wrath should fall upon its bands
explanation_en: That indeed is an army which is capable of offering a united resistance, even if Yama advances against it with fury
explanation_ta: எமனே சினங்கொண்டு தன் மேல் எதிர்த்து வந்தாலும் ஒன்றாகத் திரண்டு எதிர்த்து நிற்க்கும் ஆற்றல் உடையதே படையாகும்.

translation:
Valour with honour, sure advance in glory's path, with confidence; To warlike host these four are sure defence

Meaning: Valour, honour, following in the excellent-footsteps (of its predecessors) and trust-worthiness; these four alone constitute the safeguard of an army
pope_couplet: Valour with honour, sure advance in glory's path, with confidence; To warlike host these four are sure defence
explanation_en: Valour, honour, following in the excellent-footsteps (of its predecessors) and trust-worthiness; these four alone constitute the safeguard of an army
explanation_ta: வீரம், மானம், சிறந்த வழியில் நடக்கும் நடக்கை, தலைவரால் நம்பித் தெளியப்படுதல் ஆகிய இந்த நான்கு பண்புகளும் படைக்கு சிறந்தவையாகும்.

translation:
A valiant army bears the onslaught, onward goes, Well taught with marshalled ranks to meet their coming foes

Meaning: That is an army which knowing the art of warding off an impending struggle, can bear against the dust-van (of a hostile force)
pope_couplet: A valiant army bears the onslaught, onward goes, Well taught with marshalled ranks to meet their coming foes
explanation_en: That is an army which knowing the art of warding off an impending struggle, can bear against the dust-van (of a hostile force)
explanation_ta: தன் மேல் எதிர்த்து வந்த பகைவரின் போரைத்தாங்கி, வெல்லும் தன்மை அறிந்து அவனுடைய தூசிப்படையை எதிர்த்துச் செல்லவல்லதே படையாகும்.

translation:
Though not in war offensive or defensive skilled; An army gains applause when well equipped and drilled

Meaning: Though destitute of courage to fight and strength (to endure), an army may yet gain renown by the splendour of its appearance
pope_couplet: Though not in war offensive or defensive skilled; An army gains applause when well equipped and drilled
explanation_en: Though destitute of courage to fight and strength (to endure), an army may yet gain renown by the splendour of its appearance
explanation_ta: போர் செய்யும் வீரமும்( எதிர்ப்பைத் தாங்கும்) ஆற்றலுமும் இல்லையானால் படைத்தன்னுடைய அணிவகுப்பால் பெருமை பெறும்.

translation:
Where weakness, clinging fear and povertyAre not, the host will gain the victory

Meaning: An army can triumph (over its foes) if it is free from diminution; irremediable aversion and poverty
pope_couplet: Where weakness, clinging fear and povertyAre not, the host will gain the victory
explanation_en: An army can triumph (over its foes) if it is free from diminution; irremediable aversion and poverty
explanation_ta: தன் அளவு சிறிதாகத் தேய்தலும், தலைவரிடம் நீங்காத வெறுப்பும் வறுமையும் இல்லாதிருக்குமானால் அத்தகைய படை வெற்றி பெறும்.

translation:
Though men abound, all ready for the war, No army is where no fit leaders are

Meaning: Though an army may contain a large number of permanent soldiers, it cannot last if it has no generals
pope_couplet: Though men abound, all ready for the war, No army is where no fit leaders are
explanation_en: Though an army may contain a large number of permanent soldiers, it cannot last if it has no generals
explanation_ta: நெடுங்காலமாக நிலைத்திருக்கும் வீரர் பலரை உடையதே ஆனாலும், தலைமைதாங்கும் தலைவர் இல்லாத போது படைக்குப் பெருமை இல்லையாகும்.

translation:
Ye foes stand not before my lord for many a oneWho did my lord withstand, now stands in stone

Meaning: O my foes, stand not before my leader; (for) many are those who did so but afterwards stood (in the shape of) statues
pope_couplet: Ye foes stand not before my lord for many a oneWho did my lord withstand, now stands in stone
explanation_en: O my foes, stand not before my leader; (for) many are those who did so but afterwards stood (in the shape of) statues
explanation_ta: பகைவரே! என்னுடைய தலைவர் முன் எதிர்த்து நிற்காதீர்கள், என்னுடைய தலைவர் முன் எதிர்த்து நின்று கல்வடிவாய் நின்றவர் பலர்.

translation:
Who aims at elephant, though dart should fail, has greater praiseThan he who woodland hare with winged arrow slays

Meaning: It is more pleasant to hold the dart that has missed an elephant than that which has hit hare in the forest
pope_couplet: Who aims at elephant, though dart should fail, has greater praiseThan he who woodland hare with winged arrow slays
explanation_en: It is more pleasant to hold the dart that has missed an elephant than that which has hit hare in the forest
explanation_ta: காட்டில் ஓடுகின்ற முயலை நோக்கி குறிதவறாமல் எய்த அம்பை ஏந்துதலைவிட, வெட்ட வெளியில் நின்ற யானை மேல் எறிந்து தவறிய வேலை ஏந்துதல் சிறந்தது.

translation:
Fierceness in hour of strife heroic greatness shows; Its edge is kindness to our suffering foes

Meaning: The learned say that fierceness (incontest with a foe) is indeed great valour; but to become a benefactor in case of accident (to a foe) is the extreme (limit) of that valour
pope_couplet: Fierceness in hour of strife heroic greatness shows; Its edge is kindness to our suffering foes
explanation_en: The learned say that fierceness (incontest with a foe) is indeed great valour; but to become a benefactor in case of accident (to a foe) is the extreme (limit) of that valour
explanation_ta: பகைவரை எதிர்த்து நிற்க்கும் வீரத்தை மிக்க ஆண்மை என்று கூறுவர், ஒரு துன்பம் வந்த போது பகைவர்க்கும் உதவிச் செய்தலை அந்த ஆண்மையின் கூர்மை என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
At elephant he hurls the dart in hand; for weapon pressed, He laughs and plucks the javelin from his wounded breast

Meaning: The hero who after casting the lance in his hand on an elephant, comes (in search of another) will pluck the one (that sticks) in his body and laugh (exultingly)
pope_couplet: At elephant he hurls the dart in hand; for weapon pressed, He laughs and plucks the javelin from his wounded breast
explanation_en: The hero who after casting the lance in his hand on an elephant, comes (in search of another) will pluck the one (that sticks) in his body and laugh (exultingly)
explanation_ta: கையில் ஏந்திய வேலை ஒரு யானையின் மேல் எறிந்து துரத்திவிட்டு, வேறு வேல் தேடி வருகின்றவன் தன் மார்பில் பட்டிருந்த வேலைக் கண்டு பறித்து மகிழ்கின்றான்.

translation:
To hero fearless must it not defeat appear, If he but wink his eye when foemen hurls his spear

Meaning: Is it not a defeat to the valiant to wink and destroy their ferocious look when a lance in cast at them (by their foe) ?
pope_couplet: To hero fearless must it not defeat appear, If he but wink his eye when foemen hurls his spear
explanation_en: Is it not a defeat to the valiant to wink and destroy their ferocious look when a lance in cast at them (by their foe) ?
explanation_ta: பகைவரை சினந்து நோக்கியக் கண், அவர் வேலைக் கொண்டு எறிந்த போது மூடி இமைக்குமானால், அது வீரமுடையவர்க்குத் தோல்வி அன்றோ.

translation:
The heroes, counting up their days, set down as vainEach day when they no glorious wound sustain

Meaning: The hero will reckon among wasted days all those on which he had not received severe wounds
pope_couplet: The heroes, counting up their days, set down as vainEach day when they no glorious wound sustain
explanation_en: The hero will reckon among wasted days all those on which he had not received severe wounds
explanation_ta: வீரன் தன் கழிந்த நாட்களைக் கணக்கிட்டு, விழுப்புண் படாத நாட்களை எல்லாம் பயன் படாமல் தவறிய நாட்களுள் சேர்ப்பான்.

translation:
Who seek for world-wide fame, regardless of their life, The glorious clasp adorns, sign of heroic strife

Meaning: The fastening of ankle-ring by those who disire a world-wide renown and not (the safety of) their lives is like adorning (themselves)
pope_couplet: Who seek for world-wide fame, regardless of their life, The glorious clasp adorns, sign of heroic strife
explanation_en: The fastening of ankle-ring by those who disire a world-wide renown and not (the safety of) their lives is like adorning (themselves)
explanation_ta: பரந்து நிற்க்கும் புகழை விரும்பி, உயிர்வாழ்வையும் விரும்பாத வீரர், வீரக் கழலை காலில் கட்டிக்கொள்ளுதல் அழகு செய்யும் தன்மையுடையதாகும்.

translation:
Fearless they rush where'er 'the tide of battle rolls'; The king's reproof damps not the ardour of their eager souls

Meaning: The heroes who are not afraid of losing their life in a contest will not cool their ardour, even if the king prohibits (their fighting)
pope_couplet: Fearless they rush where'er 'the tide of battle rolls'; The king's reproof damps not the ardour of their eager souls
explanation_en: The heroes who are not afraid of losing their life in a contest will not cool their ardour, even if the king prohibits (their fighting)
explanation_ta: போர்வந்தால் உயிரின் பொருட்டு அஞ்சாமல் போர் செய்யத் துணியும் வீரர், அரசன் சினந்தாலும் தம்முடைய சிறப்புக் குன்றாதவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
Who says they err, and visits them scorn, Who die and faithful guard the vow they've sworn

Meaning: Who would reproach with failure those who seal their oath with their death ?
pope_couplet: Who says they err, and visits them scorn, Who die and faithful guard the vow they've sworn
explanation_en: Who would reproach with failure those who seal their oath with their death ?
explanation_ta: தாம் உரைத்த சூள் தவராத படி போர் செய்து சாக வல்லவரை, அவர் செய்தப் பிழைக்காக தண்டிக்க வல்லவர் யார்.

translation:
If monarch's eyes o'erflow with tears for hero slain, Who would not beg such boon of glorious death to gain

Meaning: If (heroes) can so die as to fill with tears the eyes of their rulers, such a death deserves to be obtained even by begging
pope_couplet: If monarch's eyes o'erflow with tears for hero slain, Who would not beg such boon of glorious death to gain
explanation_en: If (heroes) can so die as to fill with tears the eyes of their rulers, such a death deserves to be obtained even by begging
explanation_ta: தம்மைக் காத்த தலைவருடைய கண்கள் நீர் பெருக்குமாறு சாகப் பெற்றால், சாவு இரந்தாவது பெற்றுக் கொள்ளத் தக்க பெருமை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
What so hard for men to gain as friendship trueWhat so sure defence 'gainst all that foe can do

Meaning: What so sure defence 'gainst all that foe can do?
pope_couplet: What so hard for men to gain as friendship trueWhat so sure defence 'gainst all that foe can do
explanation_en: What so sure defence 'gainst all that foe can do?
explanation_ta: நட்பைப்போல் செய்து கொள்வதற்கு அருமையானவை எவை உள்ளன, அதுபோல் தொழிலுக்கு அரிய காவலாக இருப்பவை எவை உள்ளன.

translation:
Friendship with men fulfilled of good Waxes like the crescent moon; Friendship with men of foolish mood, Like the full orb, waneth soon

Meaning: The friendship of the wise waxes like the new moon; (but) that of fools wanes like the full moon
pope_couplet: Friendship with men fulfilled of good Waxes like the crescent moon; Friendship with men of foolish mood, Like the full orb, waneth soon
explanation_en: The friendship of the wise waxes like the new moon; (but) that of fools wanes like the full moon
explanation_ta: அறிவுடையவரின் நட்பு பிறை நிறைந்து வருதல் போன்ற தன்மையுடையது, அறிவில்லாதவரின் நட்பு முழுமதி தேய்ந்து பின் செல்லுதல் போன்ற தன்மையுடையன.

translation:
Learned scroll the more you ponder, Sweeter grows the mental food; So the heart by use grows fonder, Bound in friendship with the good

Meaning: Like learning, the friendship of the noble, the more it is cultivated, the more delightful does it become
pope_couplet: Learned scroll the more you ponder, Sweeter grows the mental food; So the heart by use grows fonder, Bound in friendship with the good
explanation_en: Like learning, the friendship of the noble, the more it is cultivated, the more delightful does it become
explanation_ta: பழகப் பழக நற்பண்பு உடையவரின் நட்பு இன்பம் தருதல், நூலின் நற்பொருள் கற்கக் கற்க மேன்மேலும் இன்பம் தருதலைப் போன்றதாகும்.

translation:
Nor for laughter only friendship all the pleasant day, But for strokes of sharp reproving, when from right you stray

Meaning: Friendship is to be practised not for the purpose of laughing but for that of being beforehand in giving one another sharp rebukes in case of transgression
pope_couplet: Nor for laughter only friendship all the pleasant day, But for strokes of sharp reproving, when from right you stray
explanation_en: Friendship is to be practised not for the purpose of laughing but for that of being beforehand in giving one another sharp rebukes in case of transgression
explanation_ta: நட்புச் செய்தல் ஒருவரோடு ஒருவர் சிரித்து மகிழும் பொருட்டு அன்று, நண்பர் நெறிக்கடந்து செல்லும் போது முற்ப்பட்டுச் சென்று இடித்துரைப்பதற்காகும்.

translation:
Not association constant, not affection's token bind;'Tis the unison of feeling friends unites of kindred mind

Meaning: Living together and holding frequent intercourse are not necessary (for friendship); (mutual) understanding can alone create a claim for it
pope_couplet: Not association constant, not affection's token bind;'Tis the unison of feeling friends unites of kindred mind
explanation_en: Living together and holding frequent intercourse are not necessary (for friendship); (mutual) understanding can alone create a claim for it
explanation_ta: நட்புச் செய்வதற்குத் தொடர்பும் பழக்கமும் வேண்டியதில்லை, ஒத்த உணர்ச்சியே நட்பு ஏற்படுத்துவதற்கு வேண்டிய உரிமையைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Not the face's smile of welcome shows the friend sincere, But the heart's rejoicing gladness when the friend is near

Meaning: The love that dwells (merely in the smiles of the face is not friendship; (but) that which dwells deep in the smiles of the heart is true friendship
pope_couplet: Not the face's smile of welcome shows the friend sincere, But the heart's rejoicing gladness when the friend is near
explanation_en: The love that dwells (merely in the smiles of the face is not friendship; (but) that which dwells deep in the smiles of the heart is true friendship
explanation_ta: முகம் மட்டும் மலரும் படியா நட்பு செய்வது நட்பு அன்று, நெஞ்சமும் மலரும் படியாக உள்ளன்பு கொண்டு நட்பு செய்வதே நட்பு ஆகும்.

translation:
Friendship from ruin saves, in way of virtue keeps; In troublous time, it weeps with him who weeps

Meaning: (True) friendship turns aside from evil (ways) makes (him) walk in the (good) way, and, in case of loss if shares his sorrow (with him)
pope_couplet: Friendship from ruin saves, in way of virtue keeps; In troublous time, it weeps with him who weeps
explanation_en: (True) friendship turns aside from evil (ways) makes (him) walk in the (good) way, and, in case of loss if shares his sorrow (with him)
explanation_ta: அழிவைத் தரும் தீமைகளிலிருந்து நீக்கி, நல்ல வழியில் நடக்கச் செய்து, அழிவுவந்த காலத்தில் உடனிருந்து துன்பப்படுவதே நட்பாகும்.

translation:
As hand of him whose vesture slips away, Friendship at once the coming grief will stay

Meaning: (True) friendship hastens to the rescue of the afflicted (as readily) as the hand of one whose garment is loosened (before an assembly)
pope_couplet: As hand of him whose vesture slips away, Friendship at once the coming grief will stay
explanation_en: (True) friendship hastens to the rescue of the afflicted (as readily) as the hand of one whose garment is loosened (before an assembly)
explanation_ta: உடைநெகிழ்ந்தவனுடைய கை, உடனே உதவிக்காப்பது போல் (நண்பனுக்குத் துன்பம் வந்தால்) அப்போதே சென்று துன்பத்தைக் களைவது நட்பு.

translation:
And where is friendship's royal seat? In stable mind, Where friend in every time of need support may find

Meaning: Friendship may be said to be on its throne when it possesses the power of supporting one at all times and under all circumstances, (in the practice or virtue and wealth)
pope_couplet: And where is friendship's royal seat? In stable mind, Where friend in every time of need support may find
explanation_en: Friendship may be said to be on its throne when it possesses the power of supporting one at all times and under all circumstances, (in the practice or virtue and wealth)
explanation_ta: நட்புக்கு சிறந்த நிலை எது என்றால், எப்போதும் வேறுபடுதல் இல்லாமல், முடியும் போதெல்லாம் உதவி செய்து தாங்கும் நிலையாகும்.

translation:
Mean is the friendship that men blazon forth,'He's thus to me' and 'such to him my worth'

Meaning: Though friends may praise one another saying, "He is so intimate with us, and we so much (with him)"; (still) such friendship will appear mean
pope_couplet: Mean is the friendship that men blazon forth,'He's thus to me' and 'such to him my worth'
explanation_en: Though friends may praise one another saying, "He is so intimate with us, and we so much (with him)"; (still) such friendship will appear mean
explanation_ta: இவர் எமக்கு இத்தன்மையானவர், யாம் இவர்க்கு இத் தன்மையுடையேம் என்று புனைந்துரைத்தாலும் நட்பு சிறப்பிழந்து விடும்.

translation:
To make an untried man your friend is ruin sure; For friendship formed unbroken must endure

Meaning: As those who are of a friendly nature will not forsake (a friend) after once loving (him), there is no evil so great as contracting a friendship without due inquiry
pope_couplet: To make an untried man your friend is ruin sure; For friendship formed unbroken must endure
explanation_en: As those who are of a friendly nature will not forsake (a friend) after once loving (him), there is no evil so great as contracting a friendship without due inquiry
explanation_ta: நட்புச் செய்தபிறகு நட்பை உடையவர்க்கு அதிலிருந்து விடுதலை இல்லை, ஆகையால் ஆராயாமல் நட்புச் செய்வது போல் கெடுதியானது வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Alliance with the man you have not proved and proved again, In length of days will give you mortal pain

Meaning: The friendship contracted by him who has not made repeated inquiry will in the end grieve (him) to death
pope_couplet: Alliance with the man you have not proved and proved again, In length of days will give you mortal pain
explanation_en: The friendship contracted by him who has not made repeated inquiry will in the end grieve (him) to death
explanation_ta: ஆராய்ந்து ஆராய்ந்து நட்புக் கொள்ளாதவனுடைய நட்பு, இறுதியில் தான் சாவதற்க்குக் காரணமானத் துயரத்தை உண்டாக்கிவிடும்.

translation:
Temper, descent, defects, associations freeFrom blame: know these, then let the man be friend to thee

Meaning: Make friendship (with one) after ascertaining (his) character, birth, defects and the whole of one's relations
pope_couplet: Temper, descent, defects, associations freeFrom blame: know these, then let the man be friend to thee
explanation_en: Make friendship (with one) after ascertaining (his) character, birth, defects and the whole of one's relations
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய குணத்தையும், குடிப்பிறப்பையும் குற்றத்தையும் குறையாத இனத்தாரின் இயல்பையும் அறிந்து அவனேடு நட்புக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who, born of noble race, from guilt would shrink with shame, Pay any price so you as friend that man may claim

Meaning: The friendship of one who belongs to a (good) family and is afraid of (being charged with) guilt, is worth even purchasing
pope_couplet: Who, born of noble race, from guilt would shrink with shame, Pay any price so you as friend that man may claim
explanation_en: The friendship of one who belongs to a (good) family and is afraid of (being charged with) guilt, is worth even purchasing
explanation_ta: உயர்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்து, தன்னிடத்தில் வருகின்றப் பழிக்கு நாணுகின்றவனைப் பொருள் கொடுத்தாவது நட்பு கொள்ளவேண்டும்.

translation:
Make them your chosen friend whose words repentance move, With power prescription's path to show, while evil they reprove

Meaning: You should examine and secure the friendship of those who can speak so as to make you weep over a crime (before its commission) or rebuke you severely (after you have done it) and are able to teach
pope_couplet: Make them your chosen friend whose words repentance move, With power prescription's path to show, while evil they reprove
explanation_en: You should examine and secure the friendship of those who can speak so as to make you weep over a crime (before its commission) or rebuke you severely (after you have done it) and are able to teach
explanation_ta: நன்மை இல்லாதச் சொற்களைக் கண்டபோது வருந்தும்படியாக இடிந்துச் சொல்லி, உலகநடையை அறிய வல்லவரின் நட்பை ஆராய்ப்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
Ruin itself one blessing lends:'Tis staff that measures out one's friends

Meaning: Even in ruin there is some good; (for) it is a rod by which one may measure fully (the affection of one's) relations
pope_couplet: Ruin itself one blessing lends:'Tis staff that measures out one's friends
explanation_en: Even in ruin there is some good; (for) it is a rod by which one may measure fully (the affection of one's) relations
explanation_ta: கேடு வந்த போதும் ஒருவகை நன்மை உண்டு, அக் கேடு ஒருவனுடைய நண்பரின் இயல்புகளை நீட்டிஅளந்து பார்ப்பதொரு கோலாகும்.

translation:
'Tis gain to any man, the sages say, Friendship of fools to put away

Meaning: It is indead a gain for one to renounce the friendship of fools
pope_couplet: 'Tis gain to any man, the sages say, Friendship of fools to put away
explanation_en: It is indead a gain for one to renounce the friendship of fools
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு ஊதியம் என்று சொல்லப்படுவது, அறிவில்லாதவறுடன் செய்து கொண்ட நட்பிலிருந்து நீங்கி அவரைக் கைவிடுதலாகும்.

translation:
Think not the thoughts that dwarf the soul; nor takeFor friends the men who friends in time of grief forsake

Meaning: Do not think of things that discourage your mind, nor contract friendship with those who would forsake you in adversity
pope_couplet: Think not the thoughts that dwarf the soul; nor takeFor friends the men who friends in time of grief forsake
explanation_en: Do not think of things that discourage your mind, nor contract friendship with those who would forsake you in adversity
explanation_ta: ஊக்கம் குறைவதற்குக் காரணமான செயல்களை எண்ணாமலிருக்க வேண்டும், அதுபோல் துன்பம் வந்த போது கைவிடுகின்றவரின் நட்பைக் கொள்ளாதிருக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
Of friends deserting us on ruin's brink,'Tis torture e'en in life's last hour to think

Meaning: The very thought of the friendship of those who have deserted one at the approach of adversity will burn one's mind at the time of death
pope_couplet: Of friends deserting us on ruin's brink,'Tis torture e'en in life's last hour to think
explanation_en: The very thought of the friendship of those who have deserted one at the approach of adversity will burn one's mind at the time of death
explanation_ta: கேடு வரும் காலத்தில் கைவிட்டு ஒதுங்குகின்றவரின் நட்பு, எமன் கொல்லும் காலத்தில் நினைத்தாலும் நினைத்த உள்ளத்தை வருத்தும்.

translation:
Cling to the friendship of the spotless one's; whate'er you payRenounce alliance with the men of evil way

Meaning: Continue to enjoy the friendship of the pure; (but) renounce even with a gift, the friendship of those who do not agree (with the world)
pope_couplet: Cling to the friendship of the spotless one's; whate'er you payRenounce alliance with the men of evil way
explanation_en: Continue to enjoy the friendship of the pure; (but) renounce even with a gift, the friendship of those who do not agree (with the world)
explanation_ta: குற்றமற்றவருடைய நட்பைக் கொள்ள வேண்டும், ஒத்தபண்பை இல்லாதவறுடைய நட்பை ஒன்றைக் கொடுத்தாவது கைவிட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Familiarity is friendship's silent pact, That puts restraint on no familiar act

Meaning: Imtimate friendship is that which cannot in the least be injured by (things done through the) right (of longstanding intimacy)
pope_couplet: Familiarity is friendship's silent pact, That puts restraint on no familiar act
explanation_en: Imtimate friendship is that which cannot in the least be injured by (things done through the) right (of longstanding intimacy)
explanation_ta: பழைமை என்று சொல்லப்படுவது எது என்று வினாவினால் அது பழகியவர் உரிமைப் பற்றிச் செய்யும் செயலைக் கீழ்ப்படுத்தாமல் ஏற்கும் நட்பாகும்.

translation:
Familiar freedom friendship's very frame supplies; To be its savour sweet is duty of the wise

Meaning: The constituents of friendship are (things done through) the right of intimacy; to be pleased with such a right is the duty of the wise
pope_couplet: Familiar freedom friendship's very frame supplies; To be its savour sweet is duty of the wise
explanation_en: The constituents of friendship are (things done through) the right of intimacy; to be pleased with such a right is the duty of the wise
explanation_ta: நட்பிற்க்கு உறுப்பாவது நண்பனுடைய உரிமைச் செயலாகும், அந்த உரிமைச் செயலுக்கு உடன்பட்டவராதல் சான்றோரின் கடமையாகும்.

translation:
When to familiar acts men kind response refuse, What fruit from ancient friendship's use

Meaning: Of what avail is long-standing friendship, if friends do not admit as their own actions done through the right of intimacy ?
pope_couplet: When to familiar acts men kind response refuse, What fruit from ancient friendship's use
explanation_en: Of what avail is long-standing friendship, if friends do not admit as their own actions done through the right of intimacy ?
explanation_ta: பழகியவர் உரிமைப்பற்றிச் செய்யும் செயலைத் தாம் செய்தது போலவேக் கருதி உடன்படாவிட்டால் அவரோடு தாம் பழகிய நட்பு என்ன பயன் தரும்.

translation:
When friends unbidden do familiar acts with loving heart, Friends take the kindly deed in friendly part

Meaning: If friends, through the right of friendship, do (anything) without being asked, the wise will be pleased with them on account of its desirability
pope_couplet: When friends unbidden do familiar acts with loving heart, Friends take the kindly deed in friendly part
explanation_en: If friends, through the right of friendship, do (anything) without being asked, the wise will be pleased with them on account of its desirability
explanation_ta: உரிமையால் கேளாமலே நண்பர் ஒன்றைச் செய்தால், அந்த உரிமையைப் போற்றி விரும்பும் தன்மையோடு அச் செயலையும் விரும்பி உடன்பட்டிருப்பர் அறிஞர்.

translation:
Not folly merely, but familiar carelessness, Esteem it, when your friends cause you distress

Meaning: If friends should perform what is painful, understand that it is owing not only to ignorance, but also to the strong claims of intimacy
pope_couplet: Not folly merely, but familiar carelessness, Esteem it, when your friends cause you distress
explanation_en: If friends should perform what is painful, understand that it is owing not only to ignorance, but also to the strong claims of intimacy
explanation_ta: வருந்ததக்க செயல்களை நண்பர் செய்தால் அதற்குக் காரணம் அறியாமை என்றாவது மிகுந்த உரிமை என்றாவது உணரவேண்டும்.

translation:
Who stand within the bounds quit not, though loss impends, Association with the old familiar friends

Meaning: Those who stand within the limits (of true friendship) will not even in adversity give up the intimacy of long-standing friends
pope_couplet: Who stand within the bounds quit not, though loss impends, Association with the old familiar friends
explanation_en: Those who stand within the limits (of true friendship) will not even in adversity give up the intimacy of long-standing friends
explanation_ta: உரிமை வாழ்வின் எல்லையில் நின்றவர், தமக்கு அழிவுநேர்ந்தவிடத்திலும் பழைமையாய் உறவு கொண்டு நின்றவரின் தொடர்பைக் கைவிட மாட்டார்.

translation:
True friends, well versed in loving ways, Cease not to love, when friend their love betrays

Meaning: Those who have (long) stood in the path of affection will not give it up even if their friends cause (them) their ruin
pope_couplet: True friends, well versed in loving ways, Cease not to love, when friend their love betrays
explanation_en: Those who have (long) stood in the path of affection will not give it up even if their friends cause (them) their ruin
explanation_ta: அன்புடன் தொன்றுதொட்டு வந்த உறவை உடையவர், அழிவுதரும் செயல்களை பழகியவர் செய்த போதிலும் தம் அன்பு நீங்காமலிருப்பர்.

translation:
In strength of friendship rare of friend's disgrace who will not hear, The day his friend offends will day of grace to him appear

Meaning: To those who understand that by which they should not listen to (tales about) the faults of their friends, that is a (profitable) day on which the latter may commit a fault
pope_couplet: In strength of friendship rare of friend's disgrace who will not hear, The day his friend offends will day of grace to him appear
explanation_en: To those who understand that by which they should not listen to (tales about) the faults of their friends, that is a (profitable) day on which the latter may commit a fault
explanation_ta: பழகிய நண்பர் செய்த தவறு பற்றிப் பிறர் சொன்னாலும், கேளாமலிருக்கும் உரிமை வல்லவர்க்கு, அந்த நண்பர் தவறுசெய்வாரானால் அது பயனுள்ள நாளாகும்.

translation:
Friendship of old and faithful friends, Who ne'er forsake, the world commends

Meaning: They will be loved by the world, who have not forsaken the friendship of those with whom they have kept up an unbroken long-standing intimacy
pope_couplet: Friendship of old and faithful friends, Who ne'er forsake, the world commends
explanation_en: They will be loved by the world, who have not forsaken the friendship of those with whom they have kept up an unbroken long-standing intimacy
explanation_ta: உரிமை கெடாமல் தொன்று தொட்டு வந்த உறவு உடையவரின் தொடர்பைக் கைவிடாதவரை உலகம் விரும்பிப் போற்றும்.

translation:
Ill-wishers even wish them well, who guardFor ancient friends, their wonted kind regard

Meaning: Even enemies will love those who have never changed in their affection to their long-standingfriends
pope_couplet: Ill-wishers even wish them well, who guardFor ancient friends, their wonted kind regard
explanation_en: Even enemies will love those who have never changed in their affection to their long-standingfriends
explanation_ta: (தவறு செய்த போதிலும்)பழகிய நண்பரிடத்தில் தம் உரிமை பண்பிலிருந்து மாறாதவர், தம் பகைவராலும் விரும்பப்படுதற்குறிய சிறப்பை அடைவர்

translation:
Though evil men should all-absorbing friendship show, Their love had better die away than grow

Meaning: The decrease of friendship with those who look as if they would eat you up (through excess of love) while they are really destitute of goodness is far better than its increase
pope_couplet: Though evil men should all-absorbing friendship show, Their love had better die away than grow
explanation_en: The decrease of friendship with those who look as if they would eat you up (through excess of love) while they are really destitute of goodness is far better than its increase
explanation_ta: அன்பு மிகுதியால் பருகுவார் போல் தோன்றினாலும் நற்பண்பு இல்லாதவரின் நட்பு, வளர்ந்து பெருகுவதை விடத் தேய்ந்து குறைவது நல்லது.

translation:
What though you gain or lose friendship of men of alien heart, Who when you thrive are friends, and when you fail depart

Meaning: Of what avail is it to get or lose the friendship of those who love when there is gain and leave when there is none ?
pope_couplet: What though you gain or lose friendship of men of alien heart, Who when you thrive are friends, and when you fail depart
explanation_en: Of what avail is it to get or lose the friendship of those who love when there is gain and leave when there is none ?
explanation_ta: தமக்கு பயன் உள்ள போது நட்பு செய்து பயன் இல்லாத போது நீங்கிவிடும் தகுதியில்லாதவரின் நட்பைப் பெற்றாலும் என்ன பயன், இழந்தாலும் என்ன பயன்.

translation:
These are alike: the friends who ponder friendship's gainThose who accept whate'er you give, and all the plundering train

Meaning: Friendship who calculate the profits (of their friendship), prostitutes who are bent on obtaining their gains, and thieves are (all) of the same character
pope_couplet: These are alike: the friends who ponder friendship's gainThose who accept whate'er you give, and all the plundering train
explanation_en: Friendship who calculate the profits (of their friendship), prostitutes who are bent on obtaining their gains, and thieves are (all) of the same character
explanation_ta: கிடைக்கும் பயனை அளந்து பார்க்கும் நண்பரும், அன்பைக் கொள்ளாமல் பெறுகின்ற பொருளைக் கொள்ளும் விலை மகளிரும், கள்வரும் ஒரு நிகரானவர்.

translation:
A steed untrained will leave you in the tug of war; Than friends like that to dwell alone is better far

Meaning: Solitude is more to be desired than the society of those who resemble the untrained horses which throw down (their riders) in the fields of battle
pope_couplet: A steed untrained will leave you in the tug of war; Than friends like that to dwell alone is better far
explanation_en: Solitude is more to be desired than the society of those who resemble the untrained horses which throw down (their riders) in the fields of battle
explanation_ta: போர் வந்த போது களத்தில் தள்ளிவிட்டு ஓடும் அறிவில்லாத குதிரை போன்றவரின் உறவை விட, ஒரு நட்பும் இல்லாமல் தனித்திருத்தலே சிறந்தது.

translation:
'Tis better not to gain than gain the friendship profitlessOf men of little minds, who succour fails when dangers press

Meaning: It is far better to avoid that to contract the evil friendship of the base who cannot protect (their friends) even when appointed to do so
pope_couplet: 'Tis better not to gain than gain the friendship profitlessOf men of little minds, who succour fails when dangers press
explanation_en: It is far better to avoid that to contract the evil friendship of the base who cannot protect (their friends) even when appointed to do so
explanation_ta: காவல் செய்து வைத்தாலும் காவல் ஆகாத கீழ்மக்களின் தீய நட்பு, ஒருவனுக்கு ஏற்படுவதை விட ஏற்படாமலிருப்பதே நன்மையாகும்.

translation:
Better ten million times incur the wise man's hate, Than form with foolish men a friendship intimate

Meaning: The hatred of the wise is ten-million times more profitable than the excessive intimacy of the fool
pope_couplet: Better ten million times incur the wise man's hate, Than form with foolish men a friendship intimate
explanation_en: The hatred of the wise is ten-million times more profitable than the excessive intimacy of the fool
explanation_ta: அறிவில்லாதவனுடைய மிகப் பொருந்திய நட்பை விட அறிவுடையவரின் நட்பில்லாத தன்மை கோடி மடங்கு நன்மை தருவதாகும்.

translation:
From foes ten million fold a greater good you gain, Than friendship yields that's formed with laughers vain

Meaning: What comes from enemies is a hundred million times more profitable than what comes from the friendship of those who cause only laughter
pope_couplet: From foes ten million fold a greater good you gain, Than friendship yields that's formed with laughers vain
explanation_en: What comes from enemies is a hundred million times more profitable than what comes from the friendship of those who cause only laughter
explanation_ta: (அகத்தில் அன்பு இல்லாமல் புறத்தில்) நகைக்கும் தன்மை உடையவரின் நட்பை விட, பகைவரால் வருவன பத்துகோடி மடங்கு நன்மையாகும்.

translation:
Those men who make a grievous toil of what they doOn your behalf, their friendship silently eschew

Meaning: Gradually abandon without revealing (beforehand) the friendship of those who pretend inability to carry out what they (really) could do
pope_couplet: Those men who make a grievous toil of what they doOn your behalf, their friendship silently eschew
explanation_en: Gradually abandon without revealing (beforehand) the friendship of those who pretend inability to carry out what they (really) could do
explanation_ta: முடியும் செயலையும் முடியாத படி செய்து கெடுப்பவரின் உறவை, அவர் அறியுமாறு ஒன்றும் செய்யாமலே தளரச் செய்து கைவிட வேண்டும்.

translation:
E'en in a dream the intercourse is bitternessWith men whose deeds are other than their words profess

Meaning: The friendship of those whose actions do not agree with their words will distress (one) even in (one's) dreams
pope_couplet: E'en in a dream the intercourse is bitternessWith men whose deeds are other than their words profess
explanation_en: The friendship of those whose actions do not agree with their words will distress (one) even in (one's) dreams
explanation_ta: செய்யும் செயல் வேறாகவும் சொல்லும் சொல் வேறாகவும் உள்ளவரின் நட்பு, ஒருவனுக்கு கனவிலும் துன்பம் தருவதாகும்.

translation:
In anywise maintain not intercourse with those, Who in the house are friends, in hall are slandering foes

Meaning: Avoid even the least approach to a contraction of friendship with those who would love you in private but ridicule you in public
pope_couplet: In anywise maintain not intercourse with those, Who in the house are friends, in hall are slandering foes
explanation_en: Avoid even the least approach to a contraction of friendship with those who would love you in private but ridicule you in public
explanation_ta: தனியே வீட்டில் உள்ளபோது பொருந்தியிருந்து, பலர் கூடிய மன்றத்தில் பழித்து பேசுவோரின் நட்பை எவ்வளவு சிறிய அளவிலும் அணுகாமல் விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Anvil where thou shalt smitten be, when men occasion find, Is friendship's form without consenting mind

Meaning: The friendship of those who behave like friends without inward affection is a weapon that may be thrown when a favourable opportunity presents itself
pope_couplet: Anvil where thou shalt smitten be, when men occasion find, Is friendship's form without consenting mind
explanation_en: The friendship of those who behave like friends without inward affection is a weapon that may be thrown when a favourable opportunity presents itself
explanation_ta: அகத்தே பொருந்தாமல் புறத்தே பொருந்தி நடப்பவரின் நட்பு, தக்க இடம் கண்டபோது எறிவதற்கு உரிய பட்டையாகும்.

translation:
Friendship of those who seem our kin, but are not really kindWill change from hour to hour like woman's mind

Meaning: The friendship of those who seem to be friends while they are not, will change like the love of women
pope_couplet: Friendship of those who seem our kin, but are not really kindWill change from hour to hour like woman's mind
explanation_en: The friendship of those who seem to be friends while they are not, will change like the love of women
explanation_ta: இனம் போலவே இருந்து உண்மையில் இனம் அல்லாதவரின் நட்பு, பொதுமகளிரின் மனம் போல உள்ளொன்று புறமொன்றாக வேறுபட்டு நிற்கும்.

translation:
To heartfelt goodness men ignoble hardly may attain, Although abundant stores of goodly lore they gain

Meaning: Though (one's) enemies may have mastered many good books, it will be impossible for them to become truly loving at heart
pope_couplet: To heartfelt goodness men ignoble hardly may attain, Although abundant stores of goodly lore they gain
explanation_en: Though (one's) enemies may have mastered many good books, it will be impossible for them to become truly loving at heart
explanation_ta: பல நல்ல நூல்களைக் கற்றுத் தேர்ந்த போதிலும், அவற்றின் பயனாக நல்ல மனம் உடையவராகப் பழகுதல், (உள்ளன்பினால்) மாட்சியடையாதவர்க்கு இல்லை.

translation:
'Tis fitting you should dread dissemblers' guile, Whose hearts are bitter while their faces smile

Meaning: One should fear the deceitful who smile sweetly with their face but never love with their heart
pope_couplet: 'Tis fitting you should dread dissemblers' guile, Whose hearts are bitter while their faces smile
explanation_en: One should fear the deceitful who smile sweetly with their face but never love with their heart
explanation_ta: முகத்தால் இனிமையாகச் சிரித்துப் பழகி அகத்தில் தீமை கொண்டுள்ள வஞ்சகருடன் நட்பு கொள்வதற்கு அஞ்ச வேண்டும்.

translation:
When minds are not in unison, 'its never; just, In any words men speak to put your trust

Meaning: In nothing whatever is it proper to rely on the words of those who do not love with their heart
pope_couplet: When minds are not in unison, 'its never; just, In any words men speak to put your trust
explanation_en: In nothing whatever is it proper to rely on the words of those who do not love with their heart
explanation_ta: மனத்தால் தம்மொடு பொருந்தாமல் பழகுகின்றவரை அவர் கூறுகின்ற சொல்லைக் கொண்டு எத்தகைய ஒரு செயலிலும் நம்பித் தெளியக்கூடாது.

translation:
Though many goodly words they speak in friendly tone, The words of foes will speedily be known

Meaning: Though (one's) foes may utter good things as though they were friends, once will at once understand (their evil, import)
pope_couplet: Though many goodly words they speak in friendly tone, The words of foes will speedily be known
explanation_en: Though (one's) foes may utter good things as though they were friends, once will at once understand (their evil, import)
explanation_ta: நண்பர்போல் நன்மையானவற்றைச் சொன்னபோதிலும் பகைமை கொண்டவர் சொல்லும் சொற்களின் உண்மைத் தன்மை விரைவில் உணரப்படும்.

translation:
To pliant speech from hostile lips give thou no ear;'Tis pliant bow that show the deadly peril near

Meaning: Since the bending of the bow bespeaks evil, one should not accept (as good) the humiliating speeches of one's foes
pope_couplet: To pliant speech from hostile lips give thou no ear;'Tis pliant bow that show the deadly peril near
explanation_en: Since the bending of the bow bespeaks evil, one should not accept (as good) the humiliating speeches of one's foes
explanation_ta: வில்லின் வணக்கம் வணக்கமாக இருந்தாலும் தீங்கு செய்தலைக்குறித்தமையால், பகைவரிடத்திலும் அவருடைய சொல்லின் வணக்கத்தை நன்மையாகக் கொள்ளக் கூடாது.

translation:
In hands that worship weapon ten hidden lies; Such are the tears that fall from foeman's eyes

Meaning: A weapon may be hid in the very hands with which (one's) foes adore (him) (and) the tears they shed are of the same nature
pope_couplet: In hands that worship weapon ten hidden lies; Such are the tears that fall from foeman's eyes
explanation_en: A weapon may be hid in the very hands with which (one's) foes adore (him) (and) the tears they shed are of the same nature
explanation_ta: பகைவர் வணங்கித் தொழுத கையினுள்ளும் கொலைக்கருவி மறைந்திருக்கும், பகைவர் அழுதுசொரிந்த கண்ணீரும் அத்தன்மையானதே.

translation:
'Tis just, when men make much of you, and then despise, To make them smile, and slap in friendship's guise

Meaning: It is the duty of kings to affect great love but make it die (inwardly); as regard those foes who shew them great friendship but despise them (in their heart)
pope_couplet: 'Tis just, when men make much of you, and then despise, To make them smile, and slap in friendship's guise
explanation_en: It is the duty of kings to affect great love but make it die (inwardly); as regard those foes who shew them great friendship but despise them (in their heart)
explanation_ta: புறத்தே மிகுதியாக நட்புத் தோன்றச் செய்து அகத்தில் இகழ்கின்றவரைத் தாமும் அந் நட்பில் நகைத்து மகிழுமாறு செய்து அத் தொடர்பு சாகுமாறு நடக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
When time shall come that foes as friends appear, Then thou, to hide a hostile heart, a smiling face may'st wear

Meaning: When one's foes begin to affect friendship, one should love them with one's looks, and, cherishing no love in the heart, give up (even the former)
pope_couplet: When time shall come that foes as friends appear, Then thou, to hide a hostile heart, a smiling face may'st wear
explanation_en: When one's foes begin to affect friendship, one should love them with one's looks, and, cherishing no love in the heart, give up (even the former)
explanation_ta: பகைவர் நண்பராகும் காலம் வரும் போது முகத்தளவில் நட்பு கொண்டு அகத்தில் நட்பு நீங்கி வாய்ப்புக் கிடைத்த போது அதையும் விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
What one thing merits folly's special name.Letting gain go, loss for one's own to claim

Meaning: Folly is one (of the chief defects); it is that which (makes one) incur loss and forego gain
pope_couplet: What one thing merits folly's special name.Letting gain go, loss for one's own to claim
explanation_en: Folly is one (of the chief defects); it is that which (makes one) incur loss and forego gain
explanation_ta: பேதைமை என்று சொல்லப்படுவது யாது என்றால், தனக்கு கெடுதியானதைக் கைக் கொண்டு ஊதியமானதை கைவிடுதலாகும்.

translation:
'Mid follies chiefest folly is to fix your loveOn deeds which to your station unbefitting prove

Meaning: The greatest folly is that which leads one to take delight in doing what is forbidden
pope_couplet: 'Mid follies chiefest folly is to fix your loveOn deeds which to your station unbefitting prove
explanation_en: The greatest folly is that which leads one to take delight in doing what is forbidden
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு பேதைமை எல்லாவற்றிலும் மிக்க பேதைமை, தன் ஒழுக்கத்திற்குப் பொருந்தாததில் தன் விருப்பத்தை செலுத்துதல் ஆகும்.

translation:
Ashamed of nothing, searching nothing out, of loveless heart, Nought cherishing, 'tis thus the fool will play his part

Meaning: Shamelessness indifference (to what must be sought after), harshness, and aversion for everything (that ought to be desired) are the qualities of the fool
pope_couplet: Ashamed of nothing, searching nothing out, of loveless heart, Nought cherishing, 'tis thus the fool will play his part
explanation_en: Shamelessness indifference (to what must be sought after), harshness, and aversion for everything (that ought to be desired) are the qualities of the fool
explanation_ta: தகாதவற்றிற்கு நாணாமலிருத்தல், தக்கவற்றை நாடாமலிருத்தல், அன்பு இல்லாமை, நன்மை ஒன்றையும் விரும்பாமை ஆகியவை பேதையின் தொழில்கள்.

translation:
The sacred law he reads and learns, to other men expounds,-Himself obeys not; where can greater fool be found

Meaning: There are no greater fools than he who, though he has read and understood (a great deal) and even taught it to others, does not walk according to his own teaching
pope_couplet: The sacred law he reads and learns, to other men expounds,-Himself obeys not; where can greater fool be found
explanation_en: There are no greater fools than he who, though he has read and understood (a great deal) and even taught it to others, does not walk according to his own teaching
explanation_ta: நூல்களை ஓதியும், அவற்றின் பொருளை உணர்ந்தும், பிறர்க்கு எடுத்துச் சொல்லியும் தான் அவற்றின் நெறியில் அடங்கி ஒழுகாதப் பேதைப் போல் வேறு பேதையர் இல்லை.

translation:
The fool will merit hell in one brief life on earth, In which he entering sinks through sevenfold round of birth

Meaning: A fool can procure in a single birth a hell into which he may enter and suffer through all the seven births
pope_couplet: The fool will merit hell in one brief life on earth, In which he entering sinks through sevenfold round of birth
explanation_en: A fool can procure in a single birth a hell into which he may enter and suffer through all the seven births
explanation_ta: எழுப்பிறப்பிலும் தான் புகுந்து அழுந்துவதற்கு உரிய நரகத் துன்பத்தைப் பேதைத் தன் ஒருபிறவியில் செய்து கொள்ள வல்லவனாவான்.

translation:
When fool some task attempts with uninstructed pains, It fails; nor that alone, himself he binds with chains

Meaning: If the fool, who knows not how to act undertakes a work, he will (certainly) fail (But) is it all ? He will even adorn himself with fetters
pope_couplet: When fool some task attempts with uninstructed pains, It fails; nor that alone, himself he binds with chains
explanation_en: If the fool, who knows not how to act undertakes a work, he will (certainly) fail (But) is it all ? He will even adorn himself with fetters
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்க நெறி அறியத பேதை ஒருச் செயலை மேற்கொண்டால் (அந்த செயல் முடிவுபெறாமல்) பொய்படும், அன்றியும் அவன் குற்றவாளியாகித் தளை பூணுவான்.

translation:
When fools are blessed with fortune's bounteous store, Their foes feed full, their friends are prey to hunger sore

Meaning: If a fool happens to get an immense fortune, his neighbours will enjoy it while his relations starve
pope_couplet: When fools are blessed with fortune's bounteous store, Their foes feed full, their friends are prey to hunger sore
explanation_en: If a fool happens to get an immense fortune, his neighbours will enjoy it while his relations starve
explanation_ta: பேதை பெருஞ் செல்வம் அடைந்த போது ( அவனோடு தொடர்பில்லாத) அயலார் நிறைய நன்மை பெற, அவனுடைய சுற்றத்தார் வருந்துவர்.

translation:
When folly's hand grasps wealth's increase, 'twill beAs when a mad man raves in drunken glee

Meaning: A fool happening to possess something is like the intoxication of one who is (already) giddy
pope_couplet: When folly's hand grasps wealth's increase, 'twill beAs when a mad man raves in drunken glee
explanation_en: A fool happening to possess something is like the intoxication of one who is (already) giddy
explanation_ta: பேதை தன் கையில் ஒரு பொருள் பெற்றால் (அவன் நிலைமை) பித்து பிடித்த ஒருவன் கள்குடித்து மயங்கினார் போன்றதாகும்.

translation:
Friendship of fools is very pleasant thing, Parting with them will leave behind no sting

Meaning: The friendship between fools is exceedingly delightful (to each other): for at parting there will be
pope_couplet: Friendship of fools is very pleasant thing, Parting with them will leave behind no sting
explanation_en: The friendship between fools is exceedingly delightful (to each other): for at parting there will be
explanation_ta: பேதையிரிடமிருந்து பிரிவு நேர்ந்த போது, அப்பிரிவு துன்பம் ஒன்றும் தருவதில்லை, ஆகையால் பேதையரிடம் கொள்ளும் நட்பு மிக இனியதாகும்.

translation:
Like him who seeks his couch with unwashed feet, Is fool whose foot intrudes where wise men meet

Meaning: The appearance of a fool in an assembly of the learned is like placing (one's) unwashed feet on a bed
pope_couplet: Like him who seeks his couch with unwashed feet, Is fool whose foot intrudes where wise men meet
explanation_en: The appearance of a fool in an assembly of the learned is like placing (one's) unwashed feet on a bed
explanation_ta: சான்றோரின் கூட்டத்தில் பேதை புகுதல், ஒருவன் தூய்மையில்லாதவற்றை மிதித்துக் கழுவாதக் காலைப் படுக்கையில் வைத்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Want of knowledge, 'mid all wants the sorest want we deem; Want of other things the world will not as want esteem

Meaning: The want of wisdom is the greatest of all wants; but that of wealth the world will not regard as such
pope_couplet: Want of knowledge, 'mid all wants the sorest want we deem; Want of other things the world will not as want esteem
explanation_en: The want of wisdom is the greatest of all wants; but that of wealth the world will not regard as such
explanation_ta: அறியாமையே இல்லாமைப் பலவற்றுளளும் கொடிய இல்லாமையாகும், மற்ற இல்லாமைகளை உலகம் அத்தகைய இல்லாமையாகக் கருதாது.

translation:
The gift of foolish man, with willing heart bestowed, is nought, But blessing by receiver's penance bought

Meaning: (The cause of) a fool cheerfully giving (something) is nothing else but the receiver's merit (in a former birth)
pope_couplet: The gift of foolish man, with willing heart bestowed, is nought, But blessing by receiver's penance bought
explanation_en: (The cause of) a fool cheerfully giving (something) is nothing else but the receiver's merit (in a former birth)
explanation_ta: அறிவில்லாதவவன் மனம் மகிழ்ந்து ஒரு பொருளைக் கொடுத்தலுக்கு காரணம், வேறொன்றும் இல்லை, அப் பொருளைப் பெறுகின்றவனுடைய நல்வினையே ஆகும்.

translation:
With keener anguish foolish men their own hearts wring, Than aught that even malice of their foes can bring

Meaning: The suffering that fools inflict upon themselves is hardly possible even to foes
pope_couplet: With keener anguish foolish men their own hearts wring, Than aught that even malice of their foes can bring
explanation_en: The suffering that fools inflict upon themselves is hardly possible even to foes
explanation_ta: அறிவில்லாதவர் தம்மைத்தாமே துன்புறுத்தும் துன்பம் அவருடைய பகைவர்க்கும் செய்யமுடியாத அளவினதாகும்.

translation:
What is stupidity? The arrogance that cries,'Behold, we claim the glory of the wise.'

Meaning: What is called want of wisdom is the vanity which says, "We are wise"
pope_couplet: What is stupidity? The arrogance that cries,'Behold, we claim the glory of the wise.'
explanation_en: What is called want of wisdom is the vanity which says, "We are wise"
explanation_ta: புல்லறிவு என்று சொல்லப்படுவது யாது என்றால் யாம் அறிவுடையேம் என்று ஒருவன் தன்னைத்தான் மதித்துகொள்ளும் செருக்காகும்.

translation:
If men what they have never learned assume to know, Upon their real learning's power a doubt 'twill throw

Meaning: Fools pretending to know what has not been read (by them) will rouse suspicion even as to what they have thoroughly mastered
pope_couplet: If men what they have never learned assume to know, Upon their real learning's power a doubt 'twill throw
explanation_en: Fools pretending to know what has not been read (by them) will rouse suspicion even as to what they have thoroughly mastered
explanation_ta: அறிவில்லாதவர் தாம் கற்காத நூல்களை கற்றவர் போல் மேற்கொண்டு நடத்தல், அவர் குற்றமறக் கற்றுவல்ல பொருளைப் பற்றியும் மற்றவர்க்கு ஐயம் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
Fools are they who their nakedness conceal, And yet their faults unveiled reveal

Meaning: Even to cover one's nakedness would be folly, if (one's) faults were not covered (by forsaking them)
pope_couplet: Fools are they who their nakedness conceal, And yet their faults unveiled reveal
explanation_en: Even to cover one's nakedness would be folly, if (one's) faults were not covered (by forsaking them)
explanation_ta: தம்மிடத்தில் உள்ளக் குற்றத்தை அறிந்து நீக்காத போது , உடம்பில் மறைப்பதற்குரிய பகுதியை மட்டும், ஆடையால் மறைத்தல் புல்லறிவாகும்.

translation:
From out his soul who lets the mystic teachings die, Entails upon himself abiding misery

Meaning: The fool who neglects precious counsel does, of his own accord, a great injury to himself
pope_couplet: From out his soul who lets the mystic teachings die, Entails upon himself abiding misery
explanation_en: The fool who neglects precious counsel does, of his own accord, a great injury to himself
explanation_ta: அரிய மறைபொருளை மனத்தில் வைத்துக் காக்காமல் சேர்த்தும் வெளிபடுத்தும் அறிவில்லாதவன் தனக்குத் தானே பெருந்தீங்கு செய்து கொள்வான்.

translation:
Advised, he heeds not; of himself knows nothing wise; This man's whole life is all one plague until he dies

Meaning: The fool will not perform (his duties) even when advised nor ascertain them himself; such a soul is a
pope_couplet: Advised, he heeds not; of himself knows nothing wise; This man's whole life is all one plague until he dies
explanation_en: The fool will not perform (his duties) even when advised nor ascertain them himself; such a soul is a
explanation_ta: தனக்கு நன்மையானவற்றை பிறர் ஏவினாலும் செய்யாதவனாய், தானாகவும் உணர்ந்து தெளியாதவனாய் உள்ளவனுடைய உயிர் போகுமளவும் ஒரு நோயாகும்.

translation:
That man is blind to eyes that will not see who knowledge shows;-The blind man still in his blind fashion knows

Meaning: One who would teach a fool will (simply) betray his folly; and the fool would (still) think himself "wise in his own conceit"
pope_couplet: That man is blind to eyes that will not see who knowledge shows;-The blind man still in his blind fashion knows
explanation_en: One who would teach a fool will (simply) betray his folly; and the fool would (still) think himself "wise in his own conceit"
explanation_ta: அறிவு இல்லாதவனுக்கு அறிவிப்பவன் தானே அறிவில்லாதவனாய் நிற்பான், அறிவு இல்லாதவனோ தான் அறிந்த வகையால் அறிவுடையவனாகத் தோன்றுவான்.

translation:
Who what the world affirms as false proclaim, O'er all the earth receive a demon's name

Meaning: He who denies the existence of what the world believes in will be regarded as a demon on earth
pope_couplet: Who what the world affirms as false proclaim, O'er all the earth receive a demon's name
explanation_en: He who denies the existence of what the world believes in will be regarded as a demon on earth
explanation_ta: உலகத்தார் உண்டு என்று சொல்வதை இல்லை என்று கூறுகின்ற ஒருவன், உலகத்தில் காணப்படும் ஒரு பேயாகக் கருதி விலக்கப்படுவான்.

translation:
Hostility disunion's plague will bring, That evil quality, to every living thing

Meaning: The disease which fosters the evil of disunion among all creatures is termed hatred by the wise
pope_couplet: Hostility disunion's plague will bring, That evil quality, to every living thing
explanation_en: The disease which fosters the evil of disunion among all creatures is termed hatred by the wise
explanation_ta: எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் மற்ற உயிர்களோடு பொருந்தாமல் வேறுபடுதலாகிய தீயப் பண்பை வளர்க்கும் நோய் இகழ் (மாறுபாடு) என்று சொல்வர் அறிஞர்.

translation:
Though men disunion plan, and do thee much despite'Tis best no enmity to plan, nor evil deeds requite

Meaning: Though disagreeable things may be done from (a feeling of) disunion, it is far better that nothing painful be done from (that of) hatred
pope_couplet: Though men disunion plan, and do thee much despite'Tis best no enmity to plan, nor evil deeds requite
explanation_en: Though disagreeable things may be done from (a feeling of) disunion, it is far better that nothing painful be done from (that of) hatred
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தன்னோடு பொருந்தாமல் வேறுபடுதலைக் கருதி அன்பில்லாதவற்றைச் செய்தாலும் தான் இகழ் கொண்டு அவர்க்கு துன்பம் செய்யாதிருத்தல் சிறந்ததாகும்.

translation:
If enmity, that grievous plague, you shun, Endless undying praises shall be won

Meaning: To rid one-self of the distressing dtsease of hatred will bestow (on one) a never-decreasing imperishable fame
pope_couplet: If enmity, that grievous plague, you shun, Endless undying praises shall be won
explanation_en: To rid one-self of the distressing dtsease of hatred will bestow (on one) a never-decreasing imperishable fame
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் இகல் என்று சொல்லப்படும் துன்ப நோயை நீக்கி விட்டால் அஃது அவனுக்கு அழிவில்லாத நிலையான புகழைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Joy of joys abundant grows, When malice dies that woe of woes

Meaning: If hatred which is the greatest misery is destroyed, it will yield the greatest delight
pope_couplet: Joy of joys abundant grows, When malice dies that woe of woes
explanation_en: If hatred which is the greatest misery is destroyed, it will yield the greatest delight
explanation_ta: இகல் என்று சொல்லப்படும் துன்பங்களில் கொடிய துன்பம் கெட்டுவிட்டால், அஃது அவனுக்கு இன்பங்களில் சிறந்த இன்பத்தை கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
If men from enmity can keep their spirits free, Who over them shall gain the victory

Meaning: Who indeed would think of conquering those who naturally shrink back from hatred ?
pope_couplet: If men from enmity can keep their spirits free, Who over them shall gain the victory
explanation_en: Who indeed would think of conquering those who naturally shrink back from hatred ?
explanation_ta: இகலை எதிர்த்து நிற்காமல் அதன் எதிரே சாய்ந்து நடக்க வல்லவரை வெல்லக் கருதுகின்ற ஆற்றல் உடையவர் யார்.

translation:
The life of those who cherished enmity hold dear, To grievous fault and utter death is near

Meaning: Failure and ruin are not far from him who says it is sweet to excel in hatred
pope_couplet: The life of those who cherished enmity hold dear, To grievous fault and utter death is near
explanation_en: Failure and ruin are not far from him who says it is sweet to excel in hatred
explanation_ta: இகல் கொள்வதால் வெல்லுதல் இனியது என்று கருதுகின்றவனுடைய வாழ்க்கை தவறிபோதலும் அழிதலும் விரைவவில் உள்ளனவாம்.

translation:
The very truth that greatness gives their eyes can never see, Who only know to work men woe, fulfilled of enmity

Meaning: Who only know to work men woe, fulfilled of enmity
pope_couplet: The very truth that greatness gives their eyes can never see, Who only know to work men woe, fulfilled of enmity
explanation_en: Who only know to work men woe, fulfilled of enmity
explanation_ta: இகலை விரும்புகின்ற தீய அறிவை உடையவர் வெற்றி பொருந்துதலுக்குக் காரணமான உண்மைப் பொருளை அறியமாட்டார்.

translation:
'Tis gain to turn the soul from enmity; Ruin reigns where this hath mastery

Meaning: Shrinking back from hatred will yield wealth; indulging in its increase will hasten ruin
pope_couplet: 'Tis gain to turn the soul from enmity; Ruin reigns where this hath mastery
explanation_en: Shrinking back from hatred will yield wealth; indulging in its increase will hasten ruin
explanation_ta: இகலுக்கு எதிரே சாய்ந்து நடத்தல் ஒருவனுக்கு ஆக்கமாகும், அதனை எதிர்த்து வெல்லக்கருதினால் கேடு அவனிடம் வரக் கருதும்.

translation:
Men think not hostile thought in fortune's favouring hour, They cherish enmity when in misfortune's power

Meaning: At the approach of wealth one will not think of hatred (but) to secure one's ruin, one will look to its increase
pope_couplet: Men think not hostile thought in fortune's favouring hour, They cherish enmity when in misfortune's power
explanation_en: At the approach of wealth one will not think of hatred (but) to secure one's ruin, one will look to its increase
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தனக்கு ஆக்கம் வரும்போது இகலைக் கருதமாட்டான், தனக்கு கேடு தருவிக்கொள்ளும் போது அதனை எதிர்த்து வெல்லக் கருதுவான்.

translation:
From enmity do all afflictive evils flow; But friendliness doth wealth of kindly good bestow

Meaning: All calamities are caused by hatred; but by the delight (of friendship) is caused the great wealth of good virtues
pope_couplet: From enmity do all afflictive evils flow; But friendliness doth wealth of kindly good bestow
explanation_en: All calamities are caused by hatred; but by the delight (of friendship) is caused the great wealth of good virtues
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு இகலால் துன்பமானவை எல்லாம் உண்டாகும்,அதற்கு மாறான நட்பால் நல்ல நீதியாகிய பெருமித நிலை உண்டாகும்.

translation:
With stronger than thyself, turn from the strife away; With weaker shun not, rather court the fray

Meaning: Avoid offering resistance to the strong; (but) never fail to cherish enmity towards the weak
pope_couplet: With stronger than thyself, turn from the strife away; With weaker shun not, rather court the fray
explanation_en: Avoid offering resistance to the strong; (but) never fail to cherish enmity towards the weak
explanation_ta: தம்மை விட வலியவர்க்கு மாறுபட்டு எதிர்த்தலை விட வேண்டும், தம்மை விட மெலியவர் மேல் பகைக் கொள்வதை விடாமல் விரும்பி மேற்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
No kinsman's love, no strength of friends has he; How can he bear his foeman's enmity

Meaning: How can he who is unloving, destitute of powerful aids, and himself without strength overcome the might of his foe ?
pope_couplet: No kinsman's love, no strength of friends has he; How can he bear his foeman's enmity
explanation_en: How can he who is unloving, destitute of powerful aids, and himself without strength overcome the might of his foe ?
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அன்பு இல்லாதவனாய், அமைந்த துணை இல்லாதடனாய், தானும் வலிமை இல்லாதவனாய் இருந்தால், அவன் பகைவனுடைய வலிமையை எவ்வாறு ஒழிக்க முடியும்.

translation:
A craven thing! knows nought, accords with none, gives nought away; To wrath of any foe he falls an easy prey

Meaning: In the estimation of foes miserably weak is he, who is timid, ignorant, unsociable and niggardly
pope_couplet: A craven thing! knows nought, accords with none, gives nought away; To wrath of any foe he falls an easy prey
explanation_en: In the estimation of foes miserably weak is he, who is timid, ignorant, unsociable and niggardly
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் அஞ்சுகின்றவனாய், அறிவு இல்லாதவனாய், பொருந்தும் பண்பு இல்லாதவனாய், பிறர்க்கு ஒன்று ஈயாதவனாய் இருந்தால் , அவன் பகைவர்க்கு மிக எளியவன்.

translation:
His wrath still blazes, every secret told; each dayThis man's in every place to every foe an easy prey

Meaning: He who neither refrains from anger nor keeps his secrets will at all times and in all places be easily conquered by all
pope_couplet: His wrath still blazes, every secret told; each dayThis man's in every place to every foe an easy prey
explanation_en: He who neither refrains from anger nor keeps his secrets will at all times and in all places be easily conquered by all
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் சினம் நீங்காதவனாய், நெஞ்சத்தை நிறுத்தியாளும் தன்மை இல்லாதவனாய் இருந்தால் அவன் எக்காலத்திலும் எவ்விடத்திலும் எவர்க்கும் எளியவன்.

translation:
No way of right he scans, no precepts bind, no crimes affright, No grace of good he owns; such man's his foes' delight

Meaning: (A) pleasing (object) to his foes is he who reads not moral works, does nothing that is enjoined by them cares not for reproach and is not possessed of good qualities
pope_couplet: No way of right he scans, no precepts bind, no crimes affright, No grace of good he owns; such man's his foes' delight
explanation_en: (A) pleasing (object) to his foes is he who reads not moral works, does nothing that is enjoined by them cares not for reproach and is not possessed of good qualities
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் நல்வழியை நோக்காமல் பொருத்தமானவற்றைச் செய்யாமல், பழியையும் பார்க்காமல், நற்பண்பும் இல்லாமல் இருந்தால் அவன் பகைவர்க்கும் எளியனவான்.

translation:
Blind in his rage, his lustful passions rage and swell; If such a man mislikes you, like it well

Meaning: Highly to be desired is the hatred of him whose anger is blind, and whose lust increases beyond measure
pope_couplet: Blind in his rage, his lustful passions rage and swell; If such a man mislikes you, like it well
explanation_en: Highly to be desired is the hatred of him whose anger is blind, and whose lust increases beyond measure
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் உண்மை காணாத சினம் உடையவனாய், மிகப் பெரிய ஆசை உடையவனாய் இருந்தால் அவனுடைய பகை விரும்பி மேற்கொள்ளப்படும்.

translation:
Unseemly are his deeds, yet proffering aid, the man draws nigh:His hate- 'tis cheap at any price- be sure to buy

Meaning: It is indeed necessary to obtain even by purchase the hatred of him who having begun (a work) does what is not conductive (to its accomplishment)
pope_couplet: Unseemly are his deeds, yet proffering aid, the man draws nigh:His hate- 'tis cheap at any price- be sure to buy
explanation_en: It is indeed necessary to obtain even by purchase the hatred of him who having begun (a work) does what is not conductive (to its accomplishment)
explanation_ta: தன்னை அடுத்துத் தன்னோடிருந்தும் பொருந்தாதவற்றைச் செய்பவனுடைய பகையைப் பொருள் கொடுத்தாவது கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
No gracious gifts he owns, faults many cloud his fame; His foes rejoice, for none with kindred claim

Meaning: He will become friendless who is without (any good) qualities and whose faults are many; (such a character) is a help to (his) foes
pope_couplet: No gracious gifts he owns, faults many cloud his fame; His foes rejoice, for none with kindred claim
explanation_en: He will become friendless who is without (any good) qualities and whose faults are many; (such a character) is a help to (his) foes
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் குணம் இல்லாதவனாய், குற்றம் பல உடையவனானால் அவன் துணை இல்லாதவன் ஆவான், அந்நிலைமையே அவனுடைய பகைவர்க்கு நன்மையாகும்.

translation:
The joy of victory is never far removed from thoseWho've luck to meet with ignorant and timid foes

Meaning: There will be no end of lofty delights to the victorious, if their foes are (both) ignorant and timid
pope_couplet: The joy of victory is never far removed from thoseWho've luck to meet with ignorant and timid foes
explanation_en: There will be no end of lofty delights to the victorious, if their foes are (both) ignorant and timid
explanation_ta: அறிவு இல்லாத அஞ்சும் இயல்புடைய பகைவரைப் பெற்றால், அவரை எதிர்த்து பகை கொள்பவர்க்கு இன்பங்கள் தொலைவில் நீங்காமல் இருக்கும்.

translation:
The task of angry war with men unlearned in virtue's loreWho will not meet, glory shall meet him never more

Meaning: The light (of fame) will never be gained by him who gains not the trifling reputation of having fought an unlearned (foe)
pope_couplet: The task of angry war with men unlearned in virtue's loreWho will not meet, glory shall meet him never more
explanation_en: The light (of fame) will never be gained by him who gains not the trifling reputation of having fought an unlearned (foe)
explanation_ta: கல்வி கற்காதவனைப் பகைத்துக்கொள்ளும் எளிய செயலைச் செய்ய இயலாத ஒருவனிடம் எக்காலத்திலும் புகழ் வந்து பொருந்தாது.

translation:
For Hate, that ill-conditioned thing not e'en in jestLet any evil longing rule your breast

Meaning: The evil of hatred is not of a nature to be desired by one even in sport
pope_couplet: For Hate, that ill-conditioned thing not e'en in jestLet any evil longing rule your breast
explanation_en: The evil of hatred is not of a nature to be desired by one even in sport
explanation_ta: பகை என்று சொல்லப்படும் பண்பு இல்லாத தீமையை ஒருவன் சிறிதும் பொழுது போக்கும் விளையாட்டாகவும் விரும்புதலாகாது.

translation:
Although you hate incur of those whose ploughs are bows, Make not the men whose ploughs are words your foes

Meaning: Though you may incur the hatred of warriors whose ploughs are bows, incur not that of ministers whose ploughs are words
pope_couplet: Although you hate incur of those whose ploughs are bows, Make not the men whose ploughs are words your foes
explanation_en: Though you may incur the hatred of warriors whose ploughs are bows, incur not that of ministers whose ploughs are words
explanation_ta: வில்லை ஏராக உடைய உழவராகிய வீரருடன் பகை கொண்ட போதிலும், சொல்லை ஏராக உடைய உழவராகிய அறிஞருடன் பகை கொள்ளக் கூடாது.

translation:
Than men of mind diseased, a wretch more utterly forlorn, Is he who stands alone, object of many foeman's scorn

Meaning: He who being alone, incurs the hatred of many is more infatuated than even mad men
pope_couplet: Than men of mind diseased, a wretch more utterly forlorn, Is he who stands alone, object of many foeman's scorn
explanation_en: He who being alone, incurs the hatred of many is more infatuated than even mad men
explanation_ta: தான் தனியாக இருந்து பலருடைய பகையைத் தேடிக் கொள்பவன், பித்துப் பிடித்தாரை விட அறிவில்லாதவனாகக் கருதப்படுவான்.

translation:
The world secure on his dexterity depends, Whose worthy rule can change his foes to friends

Meaning: Whose worthy rule can change his foes to friends
pope_couplet: The world secure on his dexterity depends, Whose worthy rule can change his foes to friends
explanation_en: Whose worthy rule can change his foes to friends
explanation_ta: பகையையும் நட்பாக செய்து கொண்டு நடக்கும், பண்புடையவனது பெருந்தன்மையில் உலகம் தங்கியிருப்பதாகும்.

translation:
Without ally, who fights with twofold enemy o'ermatched, Must render one of these a friend attached

Meaning: He who is alone and helpless while his foes are two should secure one of them as an agreeable help (to himself)
pope_couplet: Without ally, who fights with twofold enemy o'ermatched, Must render one of these a friend attached
explanation_en: He who is alone and helpless while his foes are two should secure one of them as an agreeable help (to himself)
explanation_ta: தனக்கு உதவியான துணையே இல்லை, பகையே இரண்டு, தானே ஒருவன் இந் நிலையில் அப் பகைகளில் ஒன்றை இனியத் துணையாகக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

translation:
Whether you trust or not, in time of sore distress, Questions of diff'rence or agreement cease to press

Meaning: Though (one's foe is) aware or not of one's misfortune one should act so as neither to join nor separate (from him)
pope_couplet: Whether you trust or not, in time of sore distress, Questions of diff'rence or agreement cease to press
explanation_en: Though (one's foe is) aware or not of one's misfortune one should act so as neither to join nor separate (from him)
explanation_ta: இதற்கு முன் ஒருவனைப் பற்றி ஆராய்ந்து தெளிந்திருந்தாலும், தெளியாவிட்டாலும் அழிவு வந்த காலத்தில் அவனைத் தெளியாமலும் நீங்காமலும் வாளாவிட வேண்டும்.

translation:
To those who know them not, complain not of your woes; Nor to your foeman's eyes infirmities disclose

Meaning: Relate not your suffering even to friends who are ignorant of it, nor refer to your weakness in the presence of your foes
pope_couplet: To those who know them not, complain not of your woes; Nor to your foeman's eyes infirmities disclose
explanation_en: Relate not your suffering even to friends who are ignorant of it, nor refer to your weakness in the presence of your foes
explanation_ta: துன்புற்றதைத் தாமாகவே அறியாத நண்பர்க்குத் துன்பத்தைச் சொல்லக் கூடாது, பகைவரிடத்தில் மென்மை மேற்கொள்ளக் கூடாது.

translation:
Know thou the way, then do thy part, thyself defend; Thus shall the pride of those that hate thee have an end

Meaning: The joy of one's foes will be destroyed if one guards oneself by knowing the way (of acting) and securing assistance
pope_couplet: Know thou the way, then do thy part, thyself defend; Thus shall the pride of those that hate thee have an end
explanation_en: The joy of one's foes will be destroyed if one guards oneself by knowing the way (of acting) and securing assistance
explanation_ta: செய்யும் வகையை அறிந்து தன்னை வலிமைப்படுத்திக் கொண்டு தற்காப்புத் தேடிக் கொண்டால், பகைவரிடத்தில் ஏற்பட்ட செருக்குத் தானாவே அழியும்.

translation:
Destroy the thorn, while tender point can work thee no offence; Matured by time, 'twill pierce the hand that plucks it thence

Meaning: A thorny tree should be felled while young, (for) when it is grown it will destroy the hand of the feller
pope_couplet: Destroy the thorn, while tender point can work thee no offence; Matured by time, 'twill pierce the hand that plucks it thence
explanation_en: A thorny tree should be felled while young, (for) when it is grown it will destroy the hand of the feller
explanation_ta: முள் மரத்தை இளையதாக இருக்கும் போதே வெட்ட வேண்டும், காழ்ப்பு ஏறி முதிர்ந்த போது வெட்டுகின்றவரின் கையை அது வருத்தும்.

translation:
But breathe upon them, and they surely die, Who fail to tame the pride of angry enemy

Meaning: Those who do not destroy the pride of those who hate (them) will certainly not exist even to breathe
pope_couplet: But breathe upon them, and they surely die, Who fail to tame the pride of angry enemy
explanation_en: Those who do not destroy the pride of those who hate (them) will certainly not exist even to breathe
explanation_ta: பகைத்தவருடையத் தலைமையைக் கொடுக்க முடியாதவர் திண்ணமாக மூச்சு விடும் அளவிற்கும் உயிரோடு வாழ்கின்றவர் அல்லர்.

translation:
Water and shade, if they unwholesome prove, will bring you painAnd qualities of friends who treacherous act, will be your bane

Meaning: Shade and water are not pleasant, (if) they cause disease; so are the qualities of (one's) relations not agreeable, (if) they cause pain
pope_couplet: Water and shade, if they unwholesome prove, will bring you painAnd qualities of friends who treacherous act, will be your bane
explanation_en: Shade and water are not pleasant, (if) they cause disease; so are the qualities of (one's) relations not agreeable, (if) they cause pain
explanation_ta: இன்பம் தரும் நிழலும் நீரும் நோய் செய்வனவாக இருந்தால் தீயனவே ஆகும், அதுபோலவே சுற்றத்தாறின் தன்மைகளும் துன்பம் தருவானால் தீயனவே ஆகும்.

translation:
Dread not the foes that as drawn swords appear; Friendship of foes, who seem like kinsmen, fear

Meaning: Fear not foes (who say they would cut) like a sword; (but) fear the friendship of foes (who seemingly
pope_couplet: Dread not the foes that as drawn swords appear; Friendship of foes, who seem like kinsmen, fear
