explanation_en: Fear not foes (who say they would cut) like a sword; (but) fear the friendship of foes (who seemingly
explanation_ta: வாளைப்போல் வெளிப்படையான பகைவர்க்கு அஞ்ச வேண்டியதில்லை, ஆனால் உறவினரைப் போல் இருந்து உட்பகை கொண்டவரின் தொடர்புக்கு அஞ்ச வேண்டும்.

translation:
Of hidden hate beware, and guard thy life; In troublous time 'twill deeper wound than potter's knife

Meaning: Fear internal enmity and guard yourself; (if not) it will destroy (you) in an evil hour, as surely as the tool which cuts the potter's clay
pope_couplet: Of hidden hate beware, and guard thy life; In troublous time 'twill deeper wound than potter's knife
explanation_en: Fear internal enmity and guard yourself; (if not) it will destroy (you) in an evil hour, as surely as the tool which cuts the potter's clay
explanation_ta: உட்பகைக்கு அஞ்சி ஒருவன் தன்னைக் காத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டும், தளர்ச்சி வந்த போது மட்கலத்தை அறுக்கும் கருவி போல் அந்த உட்பகை தவறாமல் அழிவு செய்யும்.

translation:
If secret enmities arise that minds pervert, Then even kin unkind will work thee grievous hurt

Meaning: The secret enmity of a person whose mind in unreformed will lead to many evils causing disaffection among (one's) relations
pope_couplet: If secret enmities arise that minds pervert, Then even kin unkind will work thee grievous hurt
explanation_en: The secret enmity of a person whose mind in unreformed will lead to many evils causing disaffection among (one's) relations
explanation_ta: மனம் திறந்தாத உட்பகை ஒருவனுக்கு உண்டாகுமானால், அது அவனுக்குச் சுற்றம் சிர்படாமைக்கு காரணமான குற்றம் பலவற்றைத் தரும்.

translation:
Amid one's relatives if hidden hath arise,'Twill hurt inflict in deadly wise

Meaning: If there appears internal hatred in a (king's) family; it will lead to many a fatal crime
pope_couplet: Amid one's relatives if hidden hath arise,'Twill hurt inflict in deadly wise
explanation_en: If there appears internal hatred in a (king's) family; it will lead to many a fatal crime
explanation_ta: உறவுமுறையோடு உட்பகை உண்டாகுமானால், அது ஒருவனுக்கு இறக்கும் வகையான துன்பம் பலவற்றையும் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
If discord finds a place midst those who dwelt at one before,'Tis ever hard to keep destruction from the door

Meaning: If hatred arises among (one's) own people, it will be hardly possible (for one) to escape death
pope_couplet: If discord finds a place midst those who dwelt at one before,'Tis ever hard to keep destruction from the door
explanation_en: If hatred arises among (one's) own people, it will be hardly possible (for one) to escape death
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய உற்றாரிடத்தில் பகைமை ஏற்படுமானால், அந்த உட்பகையால் அவன் அழியாமலிருத்தல் எப்போதும் அரிது.

translation:
As casket with its cover, though in one they live alway, No union to the house where hate concealed hath sway

Meaning: Never indeed will a family subject to internal hatred unite (really) though it may present an apparent union like that of a casket and its lid
pope_couplet: As casket with its cover, though in one they live alway, No union to the house where hate concealed hath sway
explanation_en: Never indeed will a family subject to internal hatred unite (really) though it may present an apparent union like that of a casket and its lid
explanation_ta: செப்பின் இணைப்பைப் போல புறத்தே பொருந்தி இருந்தாலும், உட்பகை உண்டான குடியில் உள்ளவர் அகத்தே பொருந்தி இருக்கமாட்டார்.

translation:
As gold with which the file contends is worn away, So strength of house declines where hate concealed hath sway

Meaning: A family subject to internal hatred will wear out and lose its strength like iron that has been filed away
pope_couplet: As gold with which the file contends is worn away, So strength of house declines where hate concealed hath sway
explanation_en: A family subject to internal hatred will wear out and lose its strength like iron that has been filed away
explanation_ta: உட்பகை உண்டான குடி அரத்தினால் தேய்க்கப் பட்ட இரும்பு போல் வலிமை குறைக்கப் பட்டு தேய்ந்து போகும்.

translation:
Though slight as shred of 'seasame' seed it be, Destruction lurks in hidden enmity

Meaning: Although internal hatred be as small as the fragment of the sesamum (seed), still does destruction dwell in it
pope_couplet: Though slight as shred of 'seasame' seed it be, Destruction lurks in hidden enmity
explanation_en: Although internal hatred be as small as the fragment of the sesamum (seed), still does destruction dwell in it
explanation_ta: எள்ளின் பிளவைப் போன்ற சிறிய அளவு உடையதே ஆனாலும், ஒரு குடியை அழிக்கவல்ல கேடு உட்பகையில் உள்ளதாகும்.

translation:
Domestic life with those who don't agree, Is dwelling in a shed with snake for company

Meaning: Living with those who do not agree (with one) is like dwelling with a cobra (in the same) hut
pope_couplet: Domestic life with those who don't agree, Is dwelling in a shed with snake for company
explanation_en: Living with those who do not agree (with one) is like dwelling with a cobra (in the same) hut
explanation_ta: அகத்தில் உடண்பாடு இல்லாதவருடன் குடிவாழும் வாழ்க்கை, ஒரு குடிசையிற் பாம்போடு உடன்வாழ்ந்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
The chiefest care of those who guard themselves from ill, Is not to slight the powers of those who work their mighty will

Meaning: Not to disregard the power of those who can carry out (their wishes) is more important than all the watchfulness of those who guard (themselves against evil)
pope_couplet: The chiefest care of those who guard themselves from ill, Is not to slight the powers of those who work their mighty will
explanation_en: Not to disregard the power of those who can carry out (their wishes) is more important than all the watchfulness of those who guard (themselves against evil)
explanation_ta: மேற்கொண்ட செயலைச் செய்து முடிக்க வல்லவரின் ஆற்றலை இகழாதிருத்தல், காப்பவர் செய்து கொள்ளும் காவல் எல்லாவற்றிலும் சிறந்தது.

translation:
If men will lead their lives reckless of great men's will, Such life, through great men's powers, will bring perpetual ill

Meaning: To behave without respect for the great (rulers) will make them do (us) irremediable evils
pope_couplet: If men will lead their lives reckless of great men's will, Such life, through great men's powers, will bring perpetual ill
explanation_en: To behave without respect for the great (rulers) will make them do (us) irremediable evils
explanation_ta: ஆற்றல் மிகுந்த பெரியாரை விரும்பி மதிக்காமல் நடந்தால், அது அப் பெரியாரால் நீங்காத துன்பத்தைத் தருவதாகும்.

translation:
Who ruin covet let them shut their ears, and do despiteTo those who, where they list to ruin have the might

Meaning: If a person desires ruin, let him not listen to the righteous dictates of law, but commit crimes against those who are able to slay (other sovereigns)
pope_couplet: Who ruin covet let them shut their ears, and do despiteTo those who, where they list to ruin have the might
explanation_en: If a person desires ruin, let him not listen to the righteous dictates of law, but commit crimes against those who are able to slay (other sovereigns)
explanation_ta: அழிக்க வேண்டுமானால் அவ்வாறே செய்து முடிக்க வல்லவரிடத்தில் தவறு செய்தலை, ஒருவன் கெட வேண்டுமானால் கேளாமலேச் செய்யலாம்.

translation:
When powerless man 'gainst men of power will evil deeds essay, Tis beck'ning with the hand for Death to seize them for its prey

Meaning: The weak doing evil to the strong is like beckoning Yama to come (and destroy them)
pope_couplet: When powerless man 'gainst men of power will evil deeds essay, Tis beck'ning with the hand for Death to seize them for its prey
explanation_en: The weak doing evil to the strong is like beckoning Yama to come (and destroy them)
explanation_ta: ஆற்றல் உடையவர்க்கு ஆற்றல் இல்லாதவர் தீமை செய்தல், தானே வந்து அழிக்க வல்ல எமனைக் கைகாட்டி அழைத்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Who dare the fiery wrath of monarchs dread, Where'er they flee, are numbered with the dead

Meaning: Those who have incurred the wrath of a cruel and mighty potentate will not prosper wherever they may go
pope_couplet: Who dare the fiery wrath of monarchs dread, Where'er they flee, are numbered with the dead
explanation_en: Those who have incurred the wrath of a cruel and mighty potentate will not prosper wherever they may go
explanation_ta: மிக்க வலிமை உள்ள அரசனால் வெகுளப்பட்டவர், அவனிடமிருந்து தப்புவதற்க்காக எங்கே சென்றாலும் எங்கும் வாழ முடியாது.

translation:
Though in the conflagration caught, he may escape from thence:He 'scapes not who in life to great ones gives offence

Meaning: Though burnt by a fire (from a forest), one may perhaps live; (but) never will he live who has shown disrespect to the great (devotees)
pope_couplet: Though in the conflagration caught, he may escape from thence:He 'scapes not who in life to great ones gives offence
explanation_en: Though burnt by a fire (from a forest), one may perhaps live; (but) never will he live who has shown disrespect to the great (devotees)
explanation_ta: தீயால் சுடப்பட்டாலும் ஒருகால் உயிர் பிழைத்து வாழ முடியும், ஆற்றல் மிகுந்த பெரியவரிடத்தில் தவறு செய்து நடப்பவர் தப்பி பிழைக்க முடியாது.

translation:
Though every royal gift, and stores of wealth your life should crown, What are they, if the worthy men of mighty virtue frown

Meaning: If a king incurs the wrath of the righteous great, what will become of his government with its splendid auxiliaries and (all) its untold wealth ?
pope_couplet: Though every royal gift, and stores of wealth your life should crown, What are they, if the worthy men of mighty virtue frown
explanation_en: If a king incurs the wrath of the righteous great, what will become of his government with its splendid auxiliaries and (all) its untold wealth ?
explanation_ta: தகுதியால் சிறப்புற்ற பெரியவர் ஒருவனை வெகுண்டால் அவனுக்கு பலவகையால் மாண்புற்ற வாழ்க்கையும் பெரும் பொருளும் இருந்தும் என்ன பயன்.

translation:
If they, whose virtues like a mountain rise, are light esteemed; They die from earth who, with their households, ever-during seemed

Meaning: If (the) hill-like (devotees) resolve on destruction, those who seemed to be everlasting will be destroyed root and branch from the earth
pope_couplet: If they, whose virtues like a mountain rise, are light esteemed; They die from earth who, with their households, ever-during seemed
explanation_en: If (the) hill-like (devotees) resolve on destruction, those who seemed to be everlasting will be destroyed root and branch from the earth
explanation_ta: மலை போன்ற பெரியவர் கெட நினைத்தால். உலகில் அழியாமல் நிலைபெற்றாற் போல் உள்ளவரும் தம் குடியோடு அழிவர்.

translation:
When blazes forth the wrath of men of lofty fame, Kings even fall from high estate and perish in the flame

Meaning: Kings even fall from high estate and perish in the flame
pope_couplet: When blazes forth the wrath of men of lofty fame, Kings even fall from high estate and perish in the flame
explanation_en: Kings even fall from high estate and perish in the flame
explanation_ta: உயர்ந்த கொள்கையுடைய பெரியவர் சீறினால் நாட்டை ஆளும் அரசனும் இடை நடுவே முறிந்து அரசு இழந்து கெடுவான்.

translation:
Though all-surpassing wealth of aid the boast, If men in glorious virtue great are wrath, they're lost

Meaning: Though in possession of numerous auxiliaries, they will perish who are-exposed to the wrath of the noble whose penance is boundless
pope_couplet: Though all-surpassing wealth of aid the boast, If men in glorious virtue great are wrath, they're lost
explanation_en: Though in possession of numerous auxiliaries, they will perish who are-exposed to the wrath of the noble whose penance is boundless
explanation_ta: மிகச் சிறப்பாக அமைந்த பெருமையுடையவர் வெகுண்டால் அளவு கடந்து அமைந்துள்ள சார்புகள் உடையவரானாலும் தப்பி பிழைக்க முடியாது.

translation:
Who give their soul to love of wife acquire not nobler gain; Who give their soul to strenuous deeds such meaner joys disdain

Meaning: Those who lust after their wives will not attain the excellence of virtue; and it is just this that is not desired by those who are bent on acquiring wealth
pope_couplet: Who give their soul to love of wife acquire not nobler gain; Who give their soul to strenuous deeds such meaner joys disdain
explanation_en: Those who lust after their wives will not attain the excellence of virtue; and it is just this that is not desired by those who are bent on acquiring wealth
explanation_ta: மனைவியை விரும்பி அவள் சொன்னபடி நடப்பவர், சிறந்த பயனை அடையமாட்டார், கடமையைச் செய்தலை விரும்புகின்றவர் வேண்டாத பொருளும் அதுவே.

translation:
Who gives himself to love of wife, careless of noble nameHis wealth will clothe him with o'erwhelming shame

Meaning: The wealth of him who, regardless (of his manliness), devotes himself to his wife's feminine nature will cause great shame (to ali men) and to himself;
pope_couplet: Who gives himself to love of wife, careless of noble nameHis wealth will clothe him with o'erwhelming shame
explanation_en: The wealth of him who, regardless (of his manliness), devotes himself to his wife's feminine nature will cause great shame (to ali men) and to himself;
explanation_ta: கடமையை விரும்பாமல் மனைவியின் பெண்மையை விரும்புகின்றவனுடைய ஆக்கம், பெரியதொரு நாணத்தக்கச் செயலாக நாணத்தைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Who to his wife submits, his strange, unmanly moodWill daily bring him shame among the good

Meaning: The frailty that stoops to a wife will always make (her husband) feel ashamed among the good
pope_couplet: Who to his wife submits, his strange, unmanly moodWill daily bring him shame among the good
explanation_en: The frailty that stoops to a wife will always make (her husband) feel ashamed among the good
explanation_ta: மனைவியிடத்தில் தாழ்ந்து நடக்கும் இழிந்த தன்மை ஒருவனுக்கு எப்போதும் நல்லவரிடையே இருக்கும் போது நாணத்தைச் தரும்.

translation:
No glory crowns e'en manly actions wroughtBy him who dreads his wife, nor gives the other world a thought

Meaning: The undertaking of one, who fears his wife and is therefore destitute of (bliss), will never be applauded
pope_couplet: No glory crowns e'en manly actions wroughtBy him who dreads his wife, nor gives the other world a thought
explanation_en: The undertaking of one, who fears his wife and is therefore destitute of (bliss), will never be applauded
explanation_ta: மனைவிக்கு அஞ்சி நடக்கின்ற மறுமைப் பயன் இல்லாத ஒருவன், செயல் ஆற்றுந்தன்மை பெருமை பெற்று விளங்க முடிவதில்லை.

translation:
Who quakes before his wife will ever tremble too, Good deeds to men of good deserts to do

Meaning: He that fears his wife will always be afraid of doing good deeds (even) to the good
pope_couplet: Who quakes before his wife will ever tremble too, Good deeds to men of good deserts to do
explanation_en: He that fears his wife will always be afraid of doing good deeds (even) to the good
explanation_ta: மனைவிக்கு அஞ்சி வாழ்கின்றவன் எப்போதும் நல்லவர்க்கு நன்மையான கடமையைச் செய்வதற்கு அஞ்சி நடப்பான்.

translation:
Though, like the demi-gods, in bliss they dwell secure from harm, Those have no dignity who fear the housewife's slender arm

Meaning: They that fear the bamboo-like shoulders of their wives will be destitute of manliness though they may flourish like the Gods
pope_couplet: Though, like the demi-gods, in bliss they dwell secure from harm, Those have no dignity who fear the housewife's slender arm
explanation_en: They that fear the bamboo-like shoulders of their wives will be destitute of manliness though they may flourish like the Gods
explanation_ta: மனைவியின் தோளுக்கு அஞ்சி வாழ்கின்றவர் தேவரைப் போல் இவ்வுலகில் சிறப்பான நிலையில் வாழ்ந்த போதிலும் பெருமை இல்லாதவரே ஆவர்.

translation:
The dignity of modest womanhood excelsHis manliness, obedient to a woman's law who dwells

Meaning: Even shame faced womanhood is more to be esteemed than the shameless manhood that performs
pope_couplet: The dignity of modest womanhood excelsHis manliness, obedient to a woman's law who dwells
explanation_en: Even shame faced womanhood is more to be esteemed than the shameless manhood that performs
explanation_ta: மனைவியின் ஏவலைச் செய்து நடக்கின்றவனுடைய ஆண்மையைவிட, நாணத்தை தன் இயல்பாக உடையவளின் பெண்மையே பெருமை உடையது.

translation:
Who to the will of her with beauteous brow their lives conform, Aid not their friends in need, nor acts of charity perform

Meaning: Those who yield to the wishes of their wives will neither relieve the wants of (their) friends nor perform virtuous deeds
pope_couplet: Who to the will of her with beauteous brow their lives conform, Aid not their friends in need, nor acts of charity perform
explanation_en: Those who yield to the wishes of their wives will neither relieve the wants of (their) friends nor perform virtuous deeds
explanation_ta: மனைவி விரும்பியபடி செய்து நடப்பவர், தமது நண்பர்க்கு உற்ற குறையையும் செய்து முடிக்க மாட்டார், அறத்தையும் செய்ய மாட்டார்.

translation:
No virtuous deed, no seemly wealth, no pleasure, restsWith them who live obedient to their wives' behests

Meaning: From those who obey the commands of their wives are to be expected neither deeds of virtue, nor those of wealth nor (even) those of pleasure
pope_couplet: No virtuous deed, no seemly wealth, no pleasure, restsWith them who live obedient to their wives' behests
explanation_en: From those who obey the commands of their wives are to be expected neither deeds of virtue, nor those of wealth nor (even) those of pleasure
explanation_ta: அறச் செயலும் அதற்க்கு காரணமாக அமைந்த பொருள் முயற்சியும், மற்றக் கடமைகளும் மனைவியின் ஏவலைச் செய்வோரிடத்தில் இல்லை.

translation:
Where pleasures of the mind, that dwell in realms of thought, abound, Folly, that springs from overweening woman's love, is never found

Meaning: The foolishness that results from devotion to a wife will never be found in those who possess a reflecting mind and a prosperity (flowing) therefrom
pope_couplet: Where pleasures of the mind, that dwell in realms of thought, abound, Folly, that springs from overweening woman's love, is never found
explanation_en: The foolishness that results from devotion to a wife will never be found in those who possess a reflecting mind and a prosperity (flowing) therefrom
explanation_ta: நன்றாக எண்ணுதல், பொருந்திய நெஞ்சத்தோடு தக்க நிலையும் உடையார்க்கு எக்காலத்திலும் மனைவியின் ஏவலுக்கு இணங்கும் அறியாமை இல்லை.

translation:
Those that choice armlets wear who seek not thee with love, But seek thy wealth, their pleasant words will ruin prove

Meaning: The sweet words of elegant braceleted (prostitutes) who desire (a man) not from affection but from avarice, will cause sorrow
pope_couplet: Those that choice armlets wear who seek not thee with love, But seek thy wealth, their pleasant words will ruin prove
explanation_en: The sweet words of elegant braceleted (prostitutes) who desire (a man) not from affection but from avarice, will cause sorrow
explanation_ta: அன் பினால் விரும்பாமல் பொருள் காரணமாக விரும்புகின்ற பொது மகளிர் பேசுகின்ற இனிய சொல், ஒருவனுக்கு துன்பத்தைக் கொடுக்கும்.

translation:
Who weigh the gain, and utter virtuous words with vicious heart, Weighing such women's worth, from their society depart

Meaning: One must ascertain the character of the ill-natured women who after ascertaining the wealth (of a man) speak (as if they were) good natured-ones, and avoid intercourse (with them)
pope_couplet: Who weigh the gain, and utter virtuous words with vicious heart, Weighing such women's worth, from their society depart
explanation_en: One must ascertain the character of the ill-natured women who after ascertaining the wealth (of a man) speak (as if they were) good natured-ones, and avoid intercourse (with them)
explanation_ta: கிடைக்க கூடிய பயனை அளந்து பார்த்து, அதற்கு ஏற்றவாறு இனிய சொல் கூறுகின்ற பண்பற்ற பொது மகளிரின் இன்பத்தை ஆராய்ந்து பொருந்தாமல் விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
As one in darkened room, some stranger corpse inarms, Is he who seeks delight in mercenary women's charms

Meaning: The false embraces of wealth-loving women are like (hired men) embracing a strange corpse in a dark room
pope_couplet: As one in darkened room, some stranger corpse inarms, Is he who seeks delight in mercenary women's charms
explanation_en: The false embraces of wealth-loving women are like (hired men) embracing a strange corpse in a dark room
explanation_ta: பொருளையே விரும்பும் பொது மகளிரின் பொய்யானத் தழுவல், இருட்டறையில் தொடர்பில்லாத ஒரு பிணத்தைத் தழுவினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Their worthless charms, whose only weal is wealth of gain, From touch of these the wise, who seek the wealth of grace, abstain

Meaning: The wise who seek the wealth of grace will not desire the base favours of those who regard wealth (and not pleasure) as (their) riches
pope_couplet: Their worthless charms, whose only weal is wealth of gain, From touch of these the wise, who seek the wealth of grace, abstain
explanation_en: The wise who seek the wealth of grace will not desire the base favours of those who regard wealth (and not pleasure) as (their) riches
explanation_ta: பொருள் ஒன்றையே பொருளாகக் கொண்ட பொது மகளிரின் புன்மையான இன்பத்தை, அருளாகிய சிறந்த பொருளை ஆராயும் அறிவுடையோர் பொருந்த மாட்டார்.

translation:
From contact with their worthless charms, whose charms to all are free, The men with sense of good and lofty wisdom blest will flee;

Meaning: Those whose knowledge is made excellent by their (natural) sense will not covet the trffling delights
pope_couplet: From contact with their worthless charms, whose charms to all are free, The men with sense of good and lofty wisdom blest will flee;
explanation_en: Those whose knowledge is made excellent by their (natural) sense will not covet the trffling delights
explanation_ta: இயற்கை யறிவின் நன்மையால் சிறப்புற்ற அறிவுடையோர், பொருள் தருவார் எல்லார்க்கும் பொதுவாக இன்பம் தரும் மகளிரின் புன்மையான நலத்தைப் பொருந்தார்.

translation:
From touch of those who worthless charms, with wanton arts, display, The men who would their own true good maintain will turn away

Meaning: Those who would spread (the fame of) their own goodness will not desire the shoulders of those, who rejoice in their accomplishments and bestow their despicable favours (on all who pay)
pope_couplet: From touch of those who worthless charms, with wanton arts, display, The men who would their own true good maintain will turn away
explanation_en: Those who would spread (the fame of) their own goodness will not desire the shoulders of those, who rejoice in their accomplishments and bestow their despicable favours (on all who pay)
explanation_ta: அழகு முதலியவற்றால் செருக்கு கொண்டு தம் புன்மையான நலத்தை விற்கும் பொது மகளிரின் தோளை, தம் நல்லோழுக்கத்தைப் போற்றும் சான்றோர் பொருந்தார்.

translation:
Who cherish alien thoughts while folding in their feigned embrace, These none approach save those devoid of virtue's grace

Meaning: Those who are destitute of a perfectly (reformed) mind will covet the shoulders of those who embrace (them) while their hearts covet other things
pope_couplet: Who cherish alien thoughts while folding in their feigned embrace, These none approach save those devoid of virtue's grace
explanation_en: Those who are destitute of a perfectly (reformed) mind will covet the shoulders of those who embrace (them) while their hearts covet other things
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சத்தை நிறுத்தி ஆளும் ஆற்றல் இல்லாதவர், தம் நெஞ்சில் வேறுபொருளை விரும்பிக்கூடும் போது மகளிரின் தோளைப் பொருந்துவர்.

translation:
As demoness who lures to ruin woman's treacherous loveTo men devoid of wisdom's searching power will prove

Meaning: The wise say that to such as are destitute of discerning sense the embraces of faithless women are (as ruinous as those of) the celestail female
pope_couplet: As demoness who lures to ruin woman's treacherous loveTo men devoid of wisdom's searching power will prove
explanation_en: The wise say that to such as are destitute of discerning sense the embraces of faithless women are (as ruinous as those of) the celestail female
explanation_ta: வஞ்சம் நிறைந்த பொதுமகளிரின் சேர்க்கை, ஆராய்ந்தறியும் அறிவு இல்லாதவற்க்கு அணங்கு தாக்கு(மோகினி மயக்கு) என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
The wanton's tender arm, with gleaming jewels decked, Is hell, where sink degraded souls of men abject

Meaning: The delicate shoulders of prostitutes with excellent jewels are a hell into which are plunged the ignorant base
pope_couplet: The wanton's tender arm, with gleaming jewels decked, Is hell, where sink degraded souls of men abject
explanation_en: The delicate shoulders of prostitutes with excellent jewels are a hell into which are plunged the ignorant base
explanation_ta: ஒழுக்க வரையரை இல்லாத பொது மகளிரின் மெல்லிய தோள், உயர்வில்லாத கீழ்மக்கள் ஆழ்ந்து கிடக்கின்ற நரகமாகும்.

translation:
Women of double minds, strong drink, and dice; to these giv'n o'er, Are those on whom the light of Fortune shines no more

Meaning: Treacherous women, liquor, and gambling are the associates of such as have forsaken by Fortune
pope_couplet: Women of double minds, strong drink, and dice; to these giv'n o'er, Are those on whom the light of Fortune shines no more
explanation_en: Treacherous women, liquor, and gambling are the associates of such as have forsaken by Fortune
explanation_ta: இருவகைப்பட்ட மனம் உடைய பொது மகளிரும், கள்ளும் சூதுமாகிய இவ் மூவகையும் திருமகளால் நீக்கப்பட்டவரின் உறவாகும்.

translation:
Who love the palm's intoxicating juice, each day, No rev'rence they command, their glory fades away

Meaning: Those who always thirst after drink will neither inspire fear (in others) nor retain the light (of their fame)
pope_couplet: Who love the palm's intoxicating juice, each day, No rev'rence they command, their glory fades away
explanation_en: Those who always thirst after drink will neither inspire fear (in others) nor retain the light (of their fame)
explanation_ta: கள்ளின் மேல் விருப்பம் கொண்டு நடப்பவர், எக்காலத்திலும் பகைவரால் அஞ்சப்படார், தமக்கு உள்ள புகழையும் இழந்து விடுவார்.

translation:
Drink not inebriating draught Let him count well the costWho drinks, by drinking, all good men's esteem is lost

Meaning: Let no liquor be drunk; if it is desired, let it be drunk by those who care not for esteem of the great
pope_couplet: Drink not inebriating draught Let him count well the costWho drinks, by drinking, all good men's esteem is lost
explanation_en: Let no liquor be drunk; if it is desired, let it be drunk by those who care not for esteem of the great
explanation_ta: கள்ளை உண்ணக் கூடாது, சான்றோரால் நன்கு எண்ணப்படுவதை விரும்பாதவர் கள்ளை உண்ண வேண்டுமானால் உண்ணலாம்.

translation:
The drunkard's joy is sorrow to his mother's eyes; What must it be in presence of the truly wise

Meaning: Intoxication is painful even in the presence of (one's) mother; what will it not then be in that of the wise ?
pope_couplet: The drunkard's joy is sorrow to his mother's eyes; What must it be in presence of the truly wise
explanation_en: Intoxication is painful even in the presence of (one's) mother; what will it not then be in that of the wise ?
explanation_ta: பெற்றதாயின் முகத்திலும் கள்ளுண்டு மயங்குதல் துன்பம் தருவதாகும், அப்படியானால் குற்றம் கடியும் இயல்புடைய சான்றோரின் முகத்தில் அது எண்ணவாகும்.

translation:
Shame, goodly maid, will turn her back for aye on themWho sin the drunkard's grievous sin, that all condemn

Meaning: The fair maid of modesty will turn her back on those who are guilty of the great and abominable crime of drunkenness
pope_couplet: Shame, goodly maid, will turn her back for aye on themWho sin the drunkard's grievous sin, that all condemn
explanation_en: The fair maid of modesty will turn her back on those who are guilty of the great and abominable crime of drunkenness
explanation_ta: நாணம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் நல்லவள், கள் என்று சொல்லப்படும் விரும்பத்தக்காத பெருங்குற்றம் உடையவர்க்கு எதிரே நிற்காமல் செய்வாள்.

translation:
With gift of goods who self-oblivion buys, Is ignorant of all that man should prize

Meaning: To give money and purchase unconsciousness is the result of one's ignorance of (one's own actions)
pope_couplet: With gift of goods who self-oblivion buys, Is ignorant of all that man should prize
explanation_en: To give money and purchase unconsciousness is the result of one's ignorance of (one's own actions)
explanation_ta: விளைப் பொருள் கொடுத்து கள்ளுண்டு தன் உடம்பைத் தான் அறியாத நிலையை மேற்கொள்ளுதல், செய்வது இன்னதென்று அறியாத அறியாமை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
Sleepers are as the dead, no otherwise they seem; Who drink intoxicating draughts, they poison quaff, we deem

Meaning: They that sleep resemble the deed; (likewise) they that drink are no other than poison-eaters
pope_couplet: Sleepers are as the dead, no otherwise they seem; Who drink intoxicating draughts, they poison quaff, we deem
explanation_en: They that sleep resemble the deed; (likewise) they that drink are no other than poison-eaters
explanation_ta: உறங்கினவர் இறந்தவரை விட வேறுபட்டவர் அல்லர், அவ்வாறே கள்ளுண்பவரும் அறிவுமயங்குதலால் நஞ்சு உண்பவரே ஆவர்.

translation:
Who turn aside to drink, and droop their heavy eye, Shall be their townsmen's jest, when they the fault espy

Meaning: Those who always intoxicate themselves by a private (indulgence in) drink; will have their secrets detected and laughed at by their fellow-townsmen
pope_couplet: Who turn aside to drink, and droop their heavy eye, Shall be their townsmen's jest, when they the fault espy
explanation_en: Those who always intoxicate themselves by a private (indulgence in) drink; will have their secrets detected and laughed at by their fellow-townsmen
explanation_ta: கள்ளை மறைந்திருந்து குடித்து அறிவு மயங்குபவர், உள்ளூரில் வாழ்கின்றவரால் உள்ளான செய்திகள் ஆராயப்பட்டு எந்நாளும் சிரிக்கப்படும்.

translation:
No more in secret drink, and then deny thy hidden fraud; What in thy mind lies hid shall soon be known abroad

Meaning: Let (the drunkard) give up saying "I have never drunk"; (for) the moment (he drinks) he will simply betray his former attempt to conceal
pope_couplet: No more in secret drink, and then deny thy hidden fraud; What in thy mind lies hid shall soon be known abroad
explanation_en: Let (the drunkard) give up saying "I have never drunk"; (for) the moment (he drinks) he will simply betray his former attempt to conceal
explanation_ta: கள்ளுண்பவன் யான் ஒருபோதும் கள்ளுண்டறியேன் என்று சொல்வதை விட வேண்டும், நெஞ்சில் ஒளிந்திருந்த குற்றமும் கள்ளுண்டபோதே வெளிப்படும்.

translation:
Like him who, lamp in hand, would seek one sunk beneath the waveIs he who strives to sober drunken man with reasonings grave

Meaning: Reasoning with a drunkard is like going under water with a torch in search of a drowned man
pope_couplet: Like him who, lamp in hand, would seek one sunk beneath the waveIs he who strives to sober drunken man with reasonings grave
explanation_en: Reasoning with a drunkard is like going under water with a torch in search of a drowned man
explanation_ta: கள்ளுண்டு மயங்கினவனைக் காரணம் காட்டி தெளிவித்தல், நீரின் கீழ் மூழ்கின ஒருவனைத் தீவிளக்கு கொண்டு தேடினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
When one, in sober interval, a drunken man espies, Does he not think, 'Such is my folly in my revelries'

Meaning: When (a drunkard) who is sober sees one who is not, it looks as if he remembered not the evil effects of his (own) drink
pope_couplet: When one, in sober interval, a drunken man espies, Does he not think, 'Such is my folly in my revelries'
explanation_en: When (a drunkard) who is sober sees one who is not, it looks as if he remembered not the evil effects of his (own) drink
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் தான் கள் உண்ணாத போது கள்ளுண்டு மயங்கினவளைக் காணுமிடத்தில் உண்டு மயங்குவதால் வரும் சோர்வை நினைக்கமாட்டானோ.

translation:
Seek not the gamester's play; though you should win, Your gain is as the baited hook the fish takes in

Meaning: Though able to win, let not one desire gambling; (for) even what is won is like a fish swallowing the iron in fish-hook
pope_couplet: Seek not the gamester's play; though you should win, Your gain is as the baited hook the fish takes in
explanation_en: Though able to win, let not one desire gambling; (for) even what is won is like a fish swallowing the iron in fish-hook
explanation_ta: வெற்றியே பெறுவதாலும் சூதாட்டத்தை விரும்பக்கூடாது, வென்ற வெற்றியும் தூண்டில் இரும்பை இரை என்று மயங்கி மீன் விழுகினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Is there for gamblers, too, that gaining one a hundred lose, some wayThat they may good obtain, and see a prosperous day

Meaning: That they may good obtain, and see a prosperous day? Is there indeed a means of livelihood that can bestow happiness on gamblers who gain one and lose a hundred?
pope_couplet: Is there for gamblers, too, that gaining one a hundred lose, some wayThat they may good obtain, and see a prosperous day
explanation_en: That they may good obtain, and see a prosperous day? Is there indeed a means of livelihood that can bestow happiness on gamblers who gain one and lose a hundred?
explanation_ta: ஒரு பொருள் பெற்று நூறு மடங்கு பொருளை இழந்து விடும் சூதாடிகளுக்கும், நன்மை பெற்று வாழும் ஒரு வழி உண்டோ.

translation:
If prince unceasing speak of nought but play, Treasure and revenue will pass from him away

Meaning: If the king is incessantly addicted to the rolling dice in the hope of gain, his wealth and the resources thereof will take their departure and fall into other's hands
pope_couplet: If prince unceasing speak of nought but play, Treasure and revenue will pass from him away
explanation_en: If the king is incessantly addicted to the rolling dice in the hope of gain, his wealth and the resources thereof will take their departure and fall into other's hands
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் உருளுகின்ற கருவியால் வரும் ஒரு பொருளை இடைவிடாமல் கூறி சூதாடினால், பொருள் வருவாய் அவனை விட்டு நீங்கிப் பகைவரிடத்தில் சேரும்.

translation:
Gaming brings many woes, and ruins fair renown; Nothing to want brings men so surely down

Meaning: There is nothing else that brings (us) poverty like gambling which causes many a misery and destroys (one's) reputation
pope_couplet: Gaming brings many woes, and ruins fair renown; Nothing to want brings men so surely down
explanation_en: There is nothing else that brings (us) poverty like gambling which causes many a misery and destroys (one's) reputation
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்குத் துன்பம் பலவற்றையும் உண்டாக்கி அவனுடைய புகழைக் கெடுக்கின்ற சூதைபோல் வறுமை தருவது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
The dice, and gaming-hall, and gamester's art, they eager sought, Thirsting for gain- the men in other days who came to nought

Meaning: Penniless are those who by reason of their attachment would never forsake gambling, the gamblingplace and the handling (of dice)
pope_couplet: The dice, and gaming-hall, and gamester's art, they eager sought, Thirsting for gain- the men in other days who came to nought
explanation_en: Penniless are those who by reason of their attachment would never forsake gambling, the gamblingplace and the handling (of dice)
explanation_ta: சூதாடு கருவியும், ஆடும் இடமும், கைத்திறமையும் மதித்துக் கைவிடாதவர், (எல்லாப் பொருள் உடையவராக இருந்தும்) இல்லாதவர் ஆகிவிடுவார்.

translation:
Gambling's Misfortune's other name: o'er whom she casts her veil, They suffer grievous want, and sorrows sore bewail

Meaning: Those who are swallowed by the goddess called "gambling" will never have their hunger satisfied, but suffer the pangs of hell in the next world
pope_couplet: Gambling's Misfortune's other name: o'er whom she casts her veil, They suffer grievous want, and sorrows sore bewail
explanation_en: Those who are swallowed by the goddess called "gambling" will never have their hunger satisfied, but suffer the pangs of hell in the next world
explanation_ta: சூது என்று சொல்லப்படும் மூதேவியால் விழுங்கப்பட்டவர், வயிறு நிறைய உணவும் உண்ணாதவராகிப் பல துன்பப்பட்டு வருந்துவர்.

translation:
Ancestral wealth and noble fame to ruin haste, If men in gambler's halls their precious moments waste

Meaning: To waste time at the place of gambling will destroy inherited wealth and goodness of character
pope_couplet: Ancestral wealth and noble fame to ruin haste, If men in gambler's halls their precious moments waste
explanation_en: To waste time at the place of gambling will destroy inherited wealth and goodness of character
explanation_ta: சூதாடுமிடத்தில் ஒருவனுடைய காலம் கழியுமானால் அது அவனுடைய பழைமையாய் வந்த செல்வத்தையும் இயல்பான நற்பண்பையும் கெடுக்கும்.

translation:
Gambling wastes wealth, to falsehood bends the soul: it drives awayAll grace, and leaves the man to utter misery a prey

Meaning: Gambling destroys property, teaches falsehood, puts an end to benevolence, and brings in misery (here and hereafter)
pope_couplet: Gambling wastes wealth, to falsehood bends the soul: it drives awayAll grace, and leaves the man to utter misery a prey
explanation_en: Gambling destroys property, teaches falsehood, puts an end to benevolence, and brings in misery (here and hereafter)
explanation_ta: சூது உள்ள பொருளை அழித்துப் பொய்யை மேற்கொள்ளச் செய்து அருளையும் கெடுத்துப் பலவகையிலும் துன்பமுற்று வருந்தச் செய்யும்.

translation:
Clothes, wealth, food, praise, and learning, all departFrom him on gambler's gain who sets his heart

Meaning: The habit of gambling prevents the attainment of these five: clothing, wealth, food, fame and learning
pope_couplet: Clothes, wealth, food, praise, and learning, all departFrom him on gambler's gain who sets his heart
explanation_en: The habit of gambling prevents the attainment of these five: clothing, wealth, food, fame and learning
explanation_ta: சூதாடுதலை ஒருவன் மேற்கொண்டால், புகழ், கல்வி, செல்வம், உணவு, உடை ஆகிய ஐந்தும் அவனைச் சேராமல் ஒதுங்கும்.

translation:
Howe'er he lose, the gambler's heart is ever in the play; E'en so the soul, despite its griefs, would live on earth alway

Meaning: As the gambler loves (his vice) the more he loses by it, so does the soul love (the body) the more it suffers through it
pope_couplet: Howe'er he lose, the gambler's heart is ever in the play; E'en so the soul, despite its griefs, would live on earth alway
explanation_en: As the gambler loves (his vice) the more he loses by it, so does the soul love (the body) the more it suffers through it
explanation_ta: பொருள் வைத்து இழக்க இழக்க மேன்மேலும் விருப்பத்தை வளர்க்கும் சூதாட்டம் போல், உடல் துன்பப்பட்டு வருந்ந வருந்த உயிர் மேன்மேலும் காதல் உடையதாகும்.

translation:
The learned books count three, with wind as first; of these, As any one prevail, or fail; 'twill cause disease

Meaning: If (food and work are either) excessive or deficient, the three things enumerated by (medical) writers, flatulence, biliousness, and phlegm, will cause (one) disease
pope_couplet: The learned books count three, with wind as first; of these, As any one prevail, or fail; 'twill cause disease
explanation_en: If (food and work are either) excessive or deficient, the three things enumerated by (medical) writers, flatulence, biliousness, and phlegm, will cause (one) disease
explanation_ta: மருத்துவ நூலோர் வாதம் பித்தம் சிலேத்துமம் என எண்ணிய மூன்று அளவுக்கு மிகுந்தாலும் குறைந்தாலும் நோய் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
No need of medicine to heal your body's pain, If, what you ate before digested well, you eat again

Meaning: No medicine is necessary for him who eats after assuring (himself) that what he has (already) eaten has been digested
pope_couplet: No need of medicine to heal your body's pain, If, what you ate before digested well, you eat again
explanation_en: No medicine is necessary for him who eats after assuring (himself) that what he has (already) eaten has been digested
explanation_ta: முன் உண்ட உணவு செரித்த தன்மை ஆராய்ந்து போற்றியப் பிறகு தக்க அளவு உண்டால், உடம்பிற்கு மருந்து என ஒன்று வேண்டியதில்லை.

translation:
Who has a body gained may long the gift retain, If, food digested well, in measure due he eat again

Meaning: If (one's food has been) digested let one eat with moderation; (for) that is the way to prolong the life of an embodied soul
pope_couplet: Who has a body gained may long the gift retain, If, food digested well, in measure due he eat again
explanation_en: If (one's food has been) digested let one eat with moderation; (for) that is the way to prolong the life of an embodied soul
explanation_ta: முன் உண்ட உணவு செரித்துவிட்டால், பின் வேண்டிய அளவு அறிந்து உண்ணவேண்டும், அதுவே உடம்பு பெற்றவன் அதை நெடுங்காலம் செலுத்தும் வழியாகும்.

translation:
Knowing the food digested well, when hunger prompteth thee, With constant care, the viands choose that well agree

Meaning: (First) assure yourself that your food has been digested and never fail to eat, when very hungry, whatever is not disagreeable (to you)
pope_couplet: Knowing the food digested well, when hunger prompteth thee, With constant care, the viands choose that well agree
explanation_en: (First) assure yourself that your food has been digested and never fail to eat, when very hungry, whatever is not disagreeable (to you)
explanation_ta: முன் உண்ட உணவு செரித்த தன்மையை அறிந்து மாறுபாடில்லாத உணவுகளைக் கடைபிடித்து அவற்றையும் பசித்த பிறகு உண்ண வேண்டும்.

translation:
With self-denial take the well-selected meal; So shall thy frame no sudden sickness feel

Meaning: There will be no disaster to one's life if one eats with moderation, food that is not disagreeable
pope_couplet: With self-denial take the well-selected meal; So shall thy frame no sudden sickness feel
explanation_en: There will be no disaster to one's life if one eats with moderation, food that is not disagreeable
explanation_ta: மாறுபாடில்லாதா உணவை அளவு மீறாமல் மறுத்து அளவோடு உண்டால், உயிர் உடம்பில் வாழ்வதற்கு இடையூறான நோய் இல்லை.

translation:
On modest temperance as pleasures pure, So pain attends the greedy epicure

Meaning: As pleasure dwells with him who eats moderately, so disease (dwells) with the glutton who eats voraciously
pope_couplet: On modest temperance as pleasures pure, So pain attends the greedy epicure
explanation_en: As pleasure dwells with him who eats moderately, so disease (dwells) with the glutton who eats voraciously
explanation_ta: குறைந்த அளவு இன்னதென்று அறிந்து உண்பவனிடத்தில் இன்பம் நிலைநிற்பது போல, மிகப்பெரிதும் உண்பவனிடத்தில் நோய் நிற்க்கும்.

translation:
Who largely feeds, nor measure of the fire within maintains, That thoughtless man shall feel unmeasured pains

Meaning: He will be afflicted with numberless diseases, who eats immoderately, ignorant (of the rules of health)
pope_couplet: Who largely feeds, nor measure of the fire within maintains, That thoughtless man shall feel unmeasured pains
explanation_en: He will be afflicted with numberless diseases, who eats immoderately, ignorant (of the rules of health)
explanation_ta: பசித்தீயின் அளவின் படி அல்லாமல், அதை ஆராயாமல் மிகுதியாக உண்டால் , அதனால் நோய்கள் அளவில்லாமல் ஏற்ப்பட்டு விடும்.

translation:
Disease, its cause, what may abate the ill:Let leech examine these, then use his skill

Meaning: Let the physician enquire into the (nature of the) disease, its cause and its method of cure and treat it faithfully according to (medical rule)
pope_couplet: Disease, its cause, what may abate the ill:Let leech examine these, then use his skill
explanation_en: Let the physician enquire into the (nature of the) disease, its cause and its method of cure and treat it faithfully according to (medical rule)
explanation_ta: நோய் இன்னதென்று ஆராய்ந்து, நோயின் காரணம் ஆராய்ந்து, அதைத் தணிக்கும் வழியையும் ஆராய்ந்து, உடலுக்கு பொருந்தும் படியாகச் செய்யவேண்டும்.

translation:
The habitudes of patient and disease, the crises of the illThese must the learned leech think over well, then use his skill

Meaning: The learned (physician) should ascertain the condition of his patient; the nature of his disease, and the season (of the year) and (then) proceed (with his treatment)
pope_couplet: The habitudes of patient and disease, the crises of the illThese must the learned leech think over well, then use his skill
explanation_en: The learned (physician) should ascertain the condition of his patient; the nature of his disease, and the season (of the year) and (then) proceed (with his treatment)
explanation_ta: மருத்துவ நூலைக் கற்றவன், நோயுற்றவனுடைய வயது முதலியவற்றையும், நோயின் அளவையும், காலத்தையும் ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.

translation:
For patient, leech, and remedies, and him who waits by patient's side, The art of medicine must fourfold code of laws provide

Meaning: Medical science consists of four parts, viz, patient, physician, medicine and compounder; and each of these (again) contains four sub-divisions
pope_couplet: For patient, leech, and remedies, and him who waits by patient's side, The art of medicine must fourfold code of laws provide
explanation_en: Medical science consists of four parts, viz, patient, physician, medicine and compounder; and each of these (again) contains four sub-divisions
explanation_ta: நோயுற்றவன், நோய் தீர்க்கும் மருத்துவன், மருந்து, மருந்தை அங்கிருந்து கொடுப்பவன் என்று மருத்துவ முறை அந்த நான்குவகைப் பாகுபாடு உடையது.

translation:
Save in the scions of a noble house, you never findInstinctive sense of right and virtuous shame combined

Meaning: Consistency (of thought, word and deed) and fear (of sin) are conjointly natural only to the high-born
pope_couplet: Save in the scions of a noble house, you never findInstinctive sense of right and virtuous shame combined
explanation_en: Consistency (of thought, word and deed) and fear (of sin) are conjointly natural only to the high-born
explanation_ta: நடுவு நிமையும் நாணமும் உயர்குடியில் பிறந்தவனிடத்தில் அல்லாமல் மற்றவரிடத்தில் இயல்பாக ஒருசேர அமைவதில்லை.

translation:
In these three things the men of noble birth fail not:In virtuous deed and truthful word, and chastened thought

Meaning: The high-born will never deviate from these three; good manners, truthfulness and modesty
pope_couplet: In these three things the men of noble birth fail not:In virtuous deed and truthful word, and chastened thought
explanation_en: The high-born will never deviate from these three; good manners, truthfulness and modesty
explanation_ta: உயர் குடியில் பிறந்தவர் ஒழுக்கமும் வாய்மையும் நாணமும் ஆகிய இம் மூன்றிலிருந்தும் வழுவாமல் இயல்பாகவே நன்னெறியில் வாழ்வர்.

translation:
The smile, the gift, the pleasant word, unfailing courtesyThese are the signs, they say, of true nobility

Meaning: A cheerful countenance, liberality, pleasant words, and an unreviling disposition, these four are said to be the proper qualities of the truly high-born
pope_couplet: The smile, the gift, the pleasant word, unfailing courtesyThese are the signs, they say, of true nobility
explanation_en: A cheerful countenance, liberality, pleasant words, and an unreviling disposition, these four are said to be the proper qualities of the truly high-born
explanation_ta: உண்மையான உயர்குடியில் பிறந்தவர்க்கு முகமலர்ச்சி, ஈகை, இனிய சொல், பிறரை இகழ்ந்து கூறாமை ஆகிய நான்கும் நல்லப் பண்புகள் என்பர்.

translation:
Millions on millions piled would never winThe men of noble race to soul-degrading sin

Meaning: Though blessed with immense wealth, the noble will never do anything unbecoming
pope_couplet: Millions on millions piled would never winThe men of noble race to soul-degrading sin
explanation_en: Though blessed with immense wealth, the noble will never do anything unbecoming
explanation_ta: பல கோடிப் பொருளைப் பெறுவதாக இருந்தாலும் உயர்குடியில் பிறந்தவர் தம் குடியின் சிறப்புக் குன்றுவதற்கு காரணமான குற்றங்களைச் செய்வதில்லை.

translation:
Though stores for charity should fail within, the ancient raceWill never lose its old ancestral grace

Meaning: Though their means fall off, those born in ancient families, will not lose their character (for liberality)
pope_couplet: Though stores for charity should fail within, the ancient raceWill never lose its old ancestral grace
explanation_en: Though their means fall off, those born in ancient families, will not lose their character (for liberality)
explanation_ta: தாம் பிறர்க்குக் கொடுத்துதவும் வன்மை வறுமையால் சுருங்கிய போதிலும், பழம் பெருமை உடைய குடியில் பிறந்தவர் தம் பண்பிலிருந்து நீங்குவதில்லை.

translation:
Whose minds are set to live as fits their sire's unspotted fame, Stooping to low deceit, commit no deeds that gender shame

Meaning: Those who seek to preserve the irreproachable honour of their families will not viciously do what is detrimental thereto
pope_couplet: Whose minds are set to live as fits their sire's unspotted fame, Stooping to low deceit, commit no deeds that gender shame
explanation_en: Those who seek to preserve the irreproachable honour of their families will not viciously do what is detrimental thereto
explanation_ta: மாசற்ற குடிப் பண்புடன் வாழ்வோம் என்று கருதி வாழ்வோர், வஞ்சனைக் கொண்டு தகுதியில்லாதவற்றைக் செய்யமாட்டார்.

translation:
The faults of men of noble race are seen by every eye, As spots on her bright orb that walks sublime the evening sky

Meaning: As spots on her bright orb that walks sublime the evening sky
pope_couplet: The faults of men of noble race are seen by every eye, As spots on her bright orb that walks sublime the evening sky
explanation_en: As spots on her bright orb that walks sublime the evening sky
explanation_ta: உயர் குடியில் பிறந்தவரிடத்தில் உண்டாகும் குற்றம், ஆகாயத்தில் திங்களிடம் காணப்படும் களங்கம்போல் பலரறியத் தோன்றும்.

translation:
If lack of love appear in those who bear some goodly name,'Twill make men doubt the ancestry they claim

Meaning: If one of a good family betrays want of affection, his descent from it will be called in question
pope_couplet: If lack of love appear in those who bear some goodly name,'Twill make men doubt the ancestry they claim
explanation_en: If one of a good family betrays want of affection, his descent from it will be called in question
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய நல்லப் பண்புகளுக்கிடையில் அன்பற்றத் தன்மைக் காணப்பட்டால், அவனை அவனுடைய குடிப் பிறப்பு பற்றி ஐயப்பட நேரும்.

translation:
Of soil the plants that spring thereout will show the worth:The words they speak declare the men of noble birth

Meaning: As the sprout indicates the nature of the soil, (so) the speech of the noble indicates (that of one's birth)
pope_couplet: Of soil the plants that spring thereout will show the worth:The words they speak declare the men of noble birth
explanation_en: As the sprout indicates the nature of the soil, (so) the speech of the noble indicates (that of one's birth)
explanation_ta: இன்ன நிலத்தில் இருந்து முளைத்தது என்பதை முளை காட்டும், அதுபோல் குடியிற் பிறந்தவரின் வாய்ச் சொல் அவருடைய குடிப்பிறப்பைக் காட்டும்.

translation:
Who seek for good the grace of virtuous shame must know; Who seek for noble name to all must reverence show

Meaning: He who desires a good name must desire modesty; and he who desires (the continuance of) a family greatness must be submissive to all
pope_couplet: Who seek for good the grace of virtuous shame must know; Who seek for noble name to all must reverence show
explanation_en: He who desires a good name must desire modesty; and he who desires (the continuance of) a family greatness must be submissive to all
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு நன்மை வேண்டுமானால் நாணம் உடையவனாக வேண்டும், குடியின் உயர்வு வேண்டுமானால் எல்லோரிடத்தும் பணிவு வேண்டும்.

translation:
Though linked to splendours man no otherwise may gain, Reject each act that may thine honour's clearness stain

Meaning: Actions that would degrade (one's) family should not be done; though they may be so important that not doing them would end in death
pope_couplet: Though linked to splendours man no otherwise may gain, Reject each act that may thine honour's clearness stain
explanation_en: Actions that would degrade (one's) family should not be done; though they may be so important that not doing them would end in death
explanation_ta: இன்றியமையாத சிறப்பை உடைய செயல்களே ஆயினும் குடிப்பெருமை தாழுமாறு வரும் செயல்களை ஒருவன் செய்யாமல் விட வேண்டும்.

translation:
Who seek with glory to combine honour's untarnished fame, Do no inglorious deeds, though men accord them glory's name

Meaning: Those who desire (to maintain their) honour, will surely do nothing dishonourable, even for the sake of fame
pope_couplet: Who seek with glory to combine honour's untarnished fame, Do no inglorious deeds, though men accord them glory's name
explanation_en: Those who desire (to maintain their) honour, will surely do nothing dishonourable, even for the sake of fame
explanation_ta: புகழோடு பெரிய ஆண்மையும் விரும்புகின்றவர், புகழ் தோடும் வழியிலும் குடிப்பெருமைக்கு ஒவ்வாத செயல்களைச் செய்யமாட்டார்.

translation:
Bow down thy soul, with increase blest, in happy hour; Lift up thy heart, when stript of all by fortune's power

Meaning: In great prosperity humility is becoming; dignity, in great adversity
pope_couplet: Bow down thy soul, with increase blest, in happy hour; Lift up thy heart, when stript of all by fortune's power
explanation_en: In great prosperity humility is becoming; dignity, in great adversity
explanation_ta: செல்வம் பெருகியுள்ள காலத்தில் ஒருவனுக்குப் பண்பு வேண்டும், செல்வம் குறைந்து சுருங்கும் வறுமையுள்ள காலத்தில் பணியாத உயர்வு வேண்டும்.

translation:
Like hairs from off the head that fall to earth, When fall'n from high estate are men of noble birth

Meaning: They who have fallen from their (high) position are like the hair which has fallen from the head
pope_couplet: Like hairs from off the head that fall to earth, When fall'n from high estate are men of noble birth
explanation_en: They who have fallen from their (high) position are like the hair which has fallen from the head
explanation_ta: மக்கள் தம் உயர்வுக்கு உரிய நிலையிலிருந்து தாழ்ந்த போது, தலைமையிலிருந்து விழுந்து தாழ்வுற்ற மயிரினைப் போன்றவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
If meanness, slight as 'abrus' grain, by men be wrought, Though like a hill their high estate, they sink to nought

Meaning: Even those who are exalted like a hill will be thought low, if they commit deeds that are debasing
pope_couplet: If meanness, slight as 'abrus' grain, by men be wrought, Though like a hill their high estate, they sink to nought
explanation_en: Even those who are exalted like a hill will be thought low, if they commit deeds that are debasing
explanation_ta: மலை போல் உயர்ந்த நிலையில் உள்ளவரும், தாழ்வுக்கு காரணமானச் செயல்களை ஒரு குன்றிமனி அளவு செய்தாலும் தாழ்ந்து போய் விடுவர்.

translation:
It yields no praise, nor to the land of Gods throws wide the gate:Why follow men who scorn, and at their bidding wait

Meaning: Why follow men who scorn, and at their bidding wait?
pope_couplet: It yields no praise, nor to the land of Gods throws wide the gate:Why follow men who scorn, and at their bidding wait
explanation_en: Why follow men who scorn, and at their bidding wait?
explanation_ta: மதியாமல் இகழ்கின்றவரின் பின் சென்று பணிந்து நிற்க்கும் நிலை, ஒருவனுக்கு புகழும் தராது, தேவருலகிலும் செலுத்தாது, வேறு பயன் என்ன.

translation:
Better 'twere said, 'He's perished!' than to gainThe means to live, following in foeman's train

Meaning: It is better for a man to be said of him that he died in his usual state than that he eked out his life by following those who disgraced him
pope_couplet: Better 'twere said, 'He's perished!' than to gainThe means to live, following in foeman's train
explanation_en: It is better for a man to be said of him that he died in his usual state than that he eked out his life by following those who disgraced him
explanation_ta: மதியாதவரின் பின் சென்று ஒருவன் உயிர்வாழ்வதை விட, அவ்வாறு செய்யாத நிலையில் நின்று அழிந்தான் என்று சொல்லப்படுதல் நல்லது.

translation:
When high estate has lost its pride of honour meet, Is life, that nurses this poor flesh, as nectar sweet

Meaning: For the high-born to keep their body in life when their honour is gone will certainly not prove a remedy against death
pope_couplet: When high estate has lost its pride of honour meet, Is life, that nurses this poor flesh, as nectar sweet
explanation_en: For the high-born to keep their body in life when their honour is gone will certainly not prove a remedy against death
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுடைய பெருந்தகைமை தன் சிறப்புக்கெட நேர்ந்த போது, அவன் உடம்பை மட்டும் காத்து வாழும் வாழ்க்கை சாவாமைக்கு மருந்தோ.

translation:
Like the wild ox that, of its tuft bereft, will pine away, Are those who, of their honour shorn, will quit the light of day

Meaning: Those who give up (their) life when (their) honour is at stake are like the yark which kills itself at the loss of (even one of) its hairs
pope_couplet: Like the wild ox that, of its tuft bereft, will pine away, Are those who, of their honour shorn, will quit the light of day
explanation_en: Those who give up (their) life when (their) honour is at stake are like the yark which kills itself at the loss of (even one of) its hairs
explanation_ta: தன் உடம்பிலிருந்து மயிர் நீங்கினால் உயிர்வாழாத கவரிமானைப் போன்றவர் மானம் அழிய நேர்ந்தால் உயிரை விட்டுவிடுவர்.

translation:
Who, when dishonour comes, refuse to live, their honoured memoryWill live in worship and applause of all the world for aye

Meaning: The world will (always) praise and adore the fame of the honourable who would rather die than suffer indignity
pope_couplet: Who, when dishonour comes, refuse to live, their honoured memoryWill live in worship and applause of all the world for aye
explanation_en: The world will (always) praise and adore the fame of the honourable who would rather die than suffer indignity
explanation_ta: தமக்கு யாதேனும் இழிவு நேர்ந்தால் உயிர் வாழாத மானம் உடையவரின் புகழை உலகத்தார் தொழுது ஏந்தி நிற்பார்கள்.

translation:
The light of life is mental energy; disgrace is hisWho says, 'I 'ill lead a happy life devoid of this.'

Meaning: One's light is the abundance of one's courage; one's darkness is the desire to live destitute of such (a state of mind.)
pope_couplet: The light of life is mental energy; disgrace is hisWho says, 'I 'ill lead a happy life devoid of this.'
explanation_en: One's light is the abundance of one's courage; one's darkness is the desire to live destitute of such (a state of mind.)
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு ஒளி ஊக்கமிகுதியே ஆகும், ஒருவனுக்கு இழிவு அந்த ஊக்கம் இல்லாமலேயே உயிர்வாழலாம் என்று எண்ணுதலாம்.

translation:
All men that live are one in circumstances of birth; Diversities of works give each his special worth

Meaning: All human beings agree as regards their birth but differ as regards their characteristics, because of the different qualities of their actions
pope_couplet: All men that live are one in circumstances of birth; Diversities of works give each his special worth
explanation_en: All human beings agree as regards their birth but differ as regards their characteristics, because of the different qualities of their actions
explanation_ta: எல்லா உயிர்க்கும் பிறப்பு ஒருத் தன்மையானதே, ஆயினும் செய்கின்ற தொழில்களின் உயர்வு தாழ்வு வேறுபாடுகளால் சிறப்பியல்பு ஒத்திருப்பதில்லை.

translation:
The men of lofty line, whose souls are mean, are never greatThe men of lowly birth, when high of soul, are not of low estate

Meaning: Though (raised) above, the base cannot become great; though (brought) low, the great cannot become base
pope_couplet: The men of lofty line, whose souls are mean, are never greatThe men of lowly birth, when high of soul, are not of low estate
explanation_en: Though (raised) above, the base cannot become great; though (brought) low, the great cannot become base
explanation_ta: மேல்நிலையில் இருந்தாலும் மேன்மைப் பண்பு இல்லாதவர் மேலானவர் அல்லர், கீழ் நிலையில் இருந்தாலும் இழிகுணம் இல்லாதவர் கீழ் மக்கள் அல்லர்.

translation:
Like single-hearted women, greatness too, Exists while to itself is true

Meaning: Exists while to itself is true
pope_couplet: Like single-hearted women, greatness too, Exists while to itself is true
explanation_en: Exists while to itself is true
explanation_ta: ஒரு தன்மையான கற்புடைய மகளிரைப்போல் பெருமைப் பண்பும் ஒருவன் தன்னைத் தான் காத்துக் கொண்டு நடந்தால் உளதாகும்.

translation:
The man endowed with greatness true, Rare deeds in perfect wise will do

Meaning: (Though reduced) the great will be able to perform, in the proper way, deeds difficult (for others to do)
pope_couplet: The man endowed with greatness true, Rare deeds in perfect wise will do
explanation_en: (Though reduced) the great will be able to perform, in the proper way, deeds difficult (for others to do)
explanation_ta: பெருமைப் பண்பு உடையவர் செய்வதற்கு அருமையானச் செயலைச் செய்வதற்க்கு உரிய நெறியில் செய்து முடிக்க வல்லவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
'As votaries of the truly great we will ourselves enroll,'Is thought that enters not the mind of men of little soul

Meaning: It is never in the nature of the base to seek the society of the great and partake of their nature
pope_couplet: 'As votaries of the truly great we will ourselves enroll,'Is thought that enters not the mind of men of little soul
explanation_en: It is never in the nature of the base to seek the society of the great and partake of their nature
explanation_ta: பெரியாரை விரும்பிப் போற்றுவோம் எண்ணும் உயர்ந்த நோக்கம், அவருடைய சிறப்பை உணராத சிறியோரின் உணர்ச்சியில் இல்லை.

translation:
Whene'er distinction lights on some unworthy head, Then deeds of haughty insolence are bred

Meaning: Even nobility of birth, wealth and learning, if in (the possession of) the base, will (only) produce everincreasing pride
pope_couplet: Whene'er distinction lights on some unworthy head, Then deeds of haughty insolence are bred
explanation_en: Even nobility of birth, wealth and learning, if in (the possession of) the base, will (only) produce everincreasing pride
explanation_ta: சிறப்பு நிலையும் தனக்கு பொருந்தாத சீரற்ற கீழ் மக்களிடம் ஏற்பட்டால், வரம்பு மீறிய செயலை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
Greatness humbly bends, but littleness alwaysSpreads out its plumes, and loads itself with praise

Meaning: The great will always humble himself; but the mean will exalt himself in self-admiration
pope_couplet: Greatness humbly bends, but littleness alwaysSpreads out its plumes, and loads itself with praise
explanation_en: The great will always humble himself; but the mean will exalt himself in self-admiration
explanation_ta: பெருமைப் பண்பு எக்காலத்திலும் பணிந்து நடக்கும், ஆனால் சிறுமையோ தன்னைத் தானே வியந்துப் பாராட்டிக் கொள்ளும்.

translation:
Greatness is absence of conceit; meanness, we deem, Riding on car of vanity supreme

Meaning: Freedom from conceit is (the nature of true) greatness; (while) obstinacy therein is (that of) meanness
pope_couplet: Greatness is absence of conceit; meanness, we deem, Riding on car of vanity supreme
explanation_en: Freedom from conceit is (the nature of true) greatness; (while) obstinacy therein is (that of) meanness
explanation_ta: பெருமை பண்பு செருக்கு இல்லாமல் வாழ்தல், சிறுமையோ செருக்கே மிகுந்து அதன் எல்லையில் நின்று விடுவதாகும்.

translation:
Greatness will hide a neighbour's shame; Meanness his faults to all the world proclaim

Meaning: The great hide the faults of others; the base only divulge them
pope_couplet: Greatness will hide a neighbour's shame; Meanness his faults to all the world proclaim
explanation_en: The great hide the faults of others; the base only divulge them
explanation_ta: பெருமைப் பண்பு பிறருடைய குறைப்பாட்டை மறைக்கும், சிறுமையோ பிறருடைய குற்றத்தையே எடுத்துச் சொல்லிவிடும்

translation:
All goodly things are duties to the men, they sayWho set themselves to walk in virtue's perfect way

Meaning: It is said that those who are conscious of their duty and behave with a perfect goodness will regard as natural all that is good
pope_couplet: All goodly things are duties to the men, they sayWho set themselves to walk in virtue's perfect way
explanation_en: It is said that those who are conscious of their duty and behave with a perfect goodness will regard as natural all that is good
explanation_ta: கடமை இவை என்று அறிந்து சான்றான்மை மேற்கொண்டு நடப்பவர்க்கு நல்லவை எல்லாம் இயல்பான கடமை என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
The good of inward excellence they claim, The perfect men; all other good is only good in name

Meaning: The only delight of the perfect is that of their goodness; all other (sensual) delights are not to be included among any (true) delights
pope_couplet: The good of inward excellence they claim, The perfect men; all other good is only good in name
explanation_en: The only delight of the perfect is that of their goodness; all other (sensual) delights are not to be included among any (true) delights
explanation_ta: சான்றோரின் நலம் என்று கூறப்படுவது அவறுடைய பண்புகளின் நலமே, மற்ற நலம் வேறு எந்த நலத்திலும் சேர்ந்துள்ளதும் அன்று.

translation:
Love, modesty, beneficence, benignant grace, With truth, are pillars five of perfect virtue's resting-place

Meaning: Affection, fear (of sin), benevolence, favour and truthfulness; these are the five pillars on which perfect goodness rests
pope_couplet: Love, modesty, beneficence, benignant grace, With truth, are pillars five of perfect virtue's resting-place
explanation_en: Affection, fear (of sin), benevolence, favour and truthfulness; these are the five pillars on which perfect goodness rests
explanation_ta: அன்பு, நாணம்,ஒப்புரவு, கண்ணோட்டம், வாய்மை, என்னும் ஐந்து பண்புகளும், சால்பு என்பதைத் தாங்கியுள்ள தூண்களாகும்.

translation:
The type of 'penitence' is virtuous good that nothing slays; To speak no ill of other men is perfect virtue's praise

Meaning: Penance consists in the goodness that kills not , and perfection in the goodness that tells not others' faults
pope_couplet: The type of 'penitence' is virtuous good that nothing slays; To speak no ill of other men is perfect virtue's praise
explanation_en: Penance consists in the goodness that kills not , and perfection in the goodness that tells not others' faults
explanation_ta: தவம் ஓர் உயிரையும் கொல்லாத அறத்தை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டது, சால்பு பிறருடையத் தீமையை எடுத்துச் சொல்லாத நற்பண்பை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டது.

translation:
Submission is the might of men of mighty acts; the sageWith that same weapon stills his foeman's rage

Meaning: Stooping (to inferiors) is the strength of those who can accomplish (an undertaking); and that is the weapon with which the great avert their foes
pope_couplet: Submission is the might of men of mighty acts; the sageWith that same weapon stills his foeman's rage
explanation_en: Stooping (to inferiors) is the strength of those who can accomplish (an undertaking); and that is the weapon with which the great avert their foes
explanation_ta: ஆற்றலுடையவரின் ஆற்றலாவது பணிவுடன் நடத்தலாகும், அது சான்றோர் தம் பகைவரைப் பகைமையிலிருந்து மாற்றுகின்ற கருவியாகும்.

translation:
What is perfection's test? The equal mindTo bear repulse from even meaner men resigned

Meaning: The touch-stone of perfection is to receive a defeat even at the hands of one's inferiors
pope_couplet: What is perfection's test? The equal mindTo bear repulse from even meaner men resigned
explanation_en: The touch-stone of perfection is to receive a defeat even at the hands of one's inferiors
explanation_ta: சால்புக்கு உரைகல் போல் மதிப்பிடும் கருவி எது என்றால் தமக்கு ஒப்பில்லாத தாழ்ந்தோரிடத்திலும்தோல்வியை ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளும் பண்பாகும்.

translation:
What fruit doth your perfection yield you, say!Unless to men who work you ill good repay

Meaning: Of what avail is perfect goodness if it cannot do pleasing things even to those who have pained (it) ?
pope_couplet: What fruit doth your perfection yield you, say!Unless to men who work you ill good repay
explanation_en: Of what avail is perfect goodness if it cannot do pleasing things even to those who have pained (it) ?
explanation_ta: துன்பமானவற்றைச் செய்தவர்க்கும் இனிய உதவிகளைச் செய்யா விட்டால், சான்றோரின் சால்பு என்ன பயன் உடையதாகும்.

translation:
To soul with perfect virtue's strength endued, Brings no disgrace the lack of every earthly good

Meaning: Poverty is no disgrace to one who abounds in good qualities
pope_couplet: To soul with perfect virtue's strength endued, Brings no disgrace the lack of every earthly good
explanation_en: Poverty is no disgrace to one who abounds in good qualities
explanation_ta: சால்பு என்னும் வலிமை உண்டாகப் பெற்றால் ஒருவனுக்குப் பொருள் இல்லாத குறையாகிய வறுமை இழிவானது அன்று.

translation:
Call them of perfect virtue's sea the shore, Who, though the fates should fail, fail not for evermore

Meaning: Those who are said to be the shore of the sea of perfection will never change, though ages may change
pope_couplet: Call them of perfect virtue's sea the shore, Who, though the fates should fail, fail not for evermore
explanation_en: Those who are said to be the shore of the sea of perfection will never change, though ages may change
explanation_ta: சால்பு என்னும் தன்மைக்குக் கடல் என்று புகழப்படுகின்றவர், ஊழிக்காலத்தின் வேறுபாடுகளே நேர்ந்தாலும் தாம் வேறுபடாமல் இருப்பர்.

translation:
The mighty earth its burthen to sustain must cease, If perfect virtue of the perfect men decrease

Meaning: If there is a defect in the character of the perfect, (even) the great world cannot bear (its) burden
pope_couplet: The mighty earth its burthen to sustain must cease, If perfect virtue of the perfect men decrease
explanation_en: If there is a defect in the character of the perfect, (even) the great world cannot bear (its) burden
explanation_ta: சான்றோரின் சால்பு நிறைந்த பண்பு குறைபடுமானால் இந்தப் பெரிய நிலவுலகமும் தன் பாரத்தைத் தாங்க முடியாமற் போய் விடும்.

translation:
Who easy access give to every man, they say, Of kindly courtesy will learn with ease the way

Meaning: If one is easy of access to all, it will be easy for one to obtain the virtue called goodness
pope_couplet: Who easy access give to every man, they say, Of kindly courtesy will learn with ease the way
explanation_en: If one is easy of access to all, it will be easy for one to obtain the virtue called goodness
explanation_ta: பண்பு உடையவராக வாழும் நல்வழியை, யாரிடத்திலும் எளிய செவ்வியுடன் இருப்பதால் அடைவது எளிது என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Benevolence and high born dignity, These two are beaten paths of courtesy

Meaning: Affectionateness and birth in a good family, these two constitute what is called a proper behaviour to all
pope_couplet: Benevolence and high born dignity, These two are beaten paths of courtesy
explanation_en: Affectionateness and birth in a good family, these two constitute what is called a proper behaviour to all
explanation_ta: அன்புடையவராக இருத்தல், உயர்ந்த குடியில் பிறந்த தன்மை அமைந்திருத்தல் ஆகிய இவ் விரண்டும் பண்பு உடையவராக வாழும் நல்வழியாகும்.

translation:
Men are not one because their members seem alike to outward view; Similitude of kindred quality makes likeness true

Meaning: Resemblance of bodies is no resemblance of souls; true resemblance is the resemblance of qualities that attract
pope_couplet: Men are not one because their members seem alike to outward view; Similitude of kindred quality makes likeness true
explanation_en: Resemblance of bodies is no resemblance of souls; true resemblance is the resemblance of qualities that attract
explanation_ta: உடம்பால் ஒத்திருத்தல் மக்களோடு ஒப்புமை அன்று, பொருந்தத்தக்கப் பண்பால் ஒத்திருத்தலே கொள்ளத்தக்க ஒப்புமையாகும்.

translation:
Of men of fruitful life, who kindly benefits dispense, The world unites to praise the 'noble excellence.'

Meaning: The world applauds the character of those whose usefulness results from their equity and charity
pope_couplet: Of men of fruitful life, who kindly benefits dispense, The world unites to praise the 'noble excellence.'
explanation_en: The world applauds the character of those whose usefulness results from their equity and charity
explanation_ta: நீதியையும் நன்மையையும் விரும்பிப் பிறர்க்குப் பயன்பட வாழும் பெரியோரின் நல்லப் பண்பை உலகத்தார் போற்றிக் கொண்டாடுவர்.

translation:
Contempt is evil though in sport They who man's nature know, E'en in their wrath, a courteous mind will show

Meaning: Reproach is painful to one even in sport; those (therefore) who know the nature of others exhibit (pleasing) qualities even when they are hated
pope_couplet: Contempt is evil though in sport They who man's nature know, E'en in their wrath, a courteous mind will show
explanation_en: Reproach is painful to one even in sport; those (therefore) who know the nature of others exhibit (pleasing) qualities even when they are hated
explanation_ta: ஒருவனை இகழ்ந்து பேசுதல் விளையாட்டிலும் துன்பம் தருவதாகும், பிறருடைய இயல்பை அறிந்து நடப்பவரிடத்தில் பகைமையிலும் நல்லப் பண்புகள் உள்ளன.

translation:
The world abides; for 'worthy' men its weight sustainWere it not so, 'twould fall to dust again

Meaning: The (way of the) world subsists by contact with the good; if not, it would bury itself in the earth and perish
pope_couplet: The world abides; for 'worthy' men its weight sustainWere it not so, 'twould fall to dust again
explanation_en: The (way of the) world subsists by contact with the good; if not, it would bury itself in the earth and perish
explanation_ta: பண்பு உடையவரிடத்தில் பொருந்தியிருப்பதால் உலகம் உள்ளதாய் இயங்குகின்றது, அஃது இல்லையானால் மண்ணில் புகுந்து அழிந்து போகும்.

translation:
Though sharp their wit as file, as blocks they must remain, Whose souls are void of 'courtesy humane'

Meaning: He who is destitute of (true) human qualities (only) resembles a tree, though he may possess the sharpness of a file
pope_couplet: Though sharp their wit as file, as blocks they must remain, Whose souls are void of 'courtesy humane'
explanation_en: He who is destitute of (true) human qualities (only) resembles a tree, though he may possess the sharpness of a file
explanation_ta: மக்களுக்கு உரிய பண்பு இல்லாதவர் அரம் போல் கூர்மையான அறிவுடையவரானாலும், ஓரறிவுயிராகிய மரத்தைப் போன்றவரே ஆவர்.

translation:
Though men with all unfriendly acts and wrongs assail,'Tis uttermost disgrace in 'courtesy' to fail

Meaning: It is wrong (for the wise) not to exhibit (good) qualities even towards those who bearing no friendship (for them) do only what is hateful
pope_couplet: Though men with all unfriendly acts and wrongs assail,'Tis uttermost disgrace in 'courtesy' to fail
explanation_en: It is wrong (for the wise) not to exhibit (good) qualities even towards those who bearing no friendship (for them) do only what is hateful
explanation_ta: நட்பு கொள்ள முடியாதவராய்த் தீயவைச் செய்கின்றவரிடத்திலும் பண்பு உடையவராய் நடக்க முடியாமை இழிவானதாகும்.

translation:
To him who knows not how to smile in kindly mirth, Darkness in daytime broods o'er all the vast and mighty earth

Meaning: To those who cannot rejoice, the wide world is buried darkness even in (broad) day light
pope_couplet: To him who knows not how to smile in kindly mirth, Darkness in daytime broods o'er all the vast and mighty earth
explanation_en: To those who cannot rejoice, the wide world is buried darkness even in (broad) day light
explanation_ta: பிறரோடு கலந்து பழகி மகிழ முடியாதவர்க்கு, மிகப் பெரிய இந்த உலகம் ஒளியுள்ள பகற் காலத்திலும் இருளில் கிடப்பதாம்.

translation:
Like sweet milk soured because in filthy vessel poured, Is ample wealth in churlish man's unopened coffers stored

Meaning: The great wealth obtained by one who has no goodness will perish like pure milk spoilt by the
pope_couplet: Like sweet milk soured because in filthy vessel poured, Is ample wealth in churlish man's unopened coffers stored
explanation_en: The great wealth obtained by one who has no goodness will perish like pure milk spoilt by the
explanation_ta: பண்பு இல்லாதவன் பெற்ற பெரிய செல்வம், வைத்த கலத்தின் தீமையால் நல்ல பால் தன் சுவை முதலியன கெட்டாற் போன்றதாகும்.

translation:
Who fills his house with ample store, enjoying none, Is dead Nought with the useless heap is done

Meaning: He who does not enjoy the immense riches he has heaped up in his house, is (to be reckoned as) dead, (for) there is nothing achieved (by him)
pope_couplet: Who fills his house with ample store, enjoying none, Is dead Nought with the useless heap is done
explanation_en: He who does not enjoy the immense riches he has heaped up in his house, is (to be reckoned as) dead, (for) there is nothing achieved (by him)
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் இடமெல்லாம் நிறைந்த பெரும் பொருளைச் சேர்த்து வைத்து அதை உண்டு நூகராமல் இறந்து போனால் அவன் அந்த பொருளால் செய்ய முடிந்தது ஒன்றுமில்லை.

translation:
Who giving nought, opines from wealth all blessing springs, Degraded birth that doting miser's folly brings

Meaning: He who knows that wealth yields every pleasure and yet is so blind as to lead miserly life will be born a demon
pope_couplet: Who giving nought, opines from wealth all blessing springs, Degraded birth that doting miser's folly brings
explanation_en: He who knows that wealth yields every pleasure and yet is so blind as to lead miserly life will be born a demon
explanation_ta: பொருளால் எல்லாம் ஆகும் என்று பிறர்க்கு ஒன்றும் கொடுக்காமல் இறுகப்பற்றிய மயக்கத்தால் சிறப்பில்லாத பிறவி உண்டாம்.

translation:
Who lust to heap up wealth, but glory hold not dear, It burthens earth when on the stage of being they appear

Meaning: A burden to the earth are men bent on the acquisition of riches and not (true) fame
pope_couplet: Who lust to heap up wealth, but glory hold not dear, It burthens earth when on the stage of being they appear
explanation_en: A burden to the earth are men bent on the acquisition of riches and not (true) fame
explanation_ta: சேர்த்து வைப்பதையே விரும்பிப் பற்றுள்ளம் கொண்டு புகழை விரும்பாத மக்கள் பிறந்து வாழ்தல் நிலத்திற்கு பாரமே ஆகும்.

translation:
Whom no one loves, when he shall pass away, What doth he look to leave behind, I pray

Meaning: What will the miser who is not liked (by any one) regard as his own (in the world to come) ?
pope_couplet: Whom no one loves, when he shall pass away, What doth he look to leave behind, I pray
explanation_en: What will the miser who is not liked (by any one) regard as his own (in the world to come) ?
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு உதவியாக வாழாதக் காரணத்தால் ஒருவராலும் விரும்பப்படாதவன் , தான் இறந்த பிறகு எஞ்சி நிற்பது என்று எதனை எண்ணுவானே.

translation:
Amid accumulated millions they are poor, Who nothing give and nought enjoy of all they store

Meaning: Those who neither give (to others) nor enjoy (their property) are (truly) destitute, though possessing immense riches
pope_couplet: Amid accumulated millions they are poor, Who nothing give and nought enjoy of all they store
explanation_en: Those who neither give (to others) nor enjoy (their property) are (truly) destitute, though possessing immense riches
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு கொடுத்து உதவுவதும் தான் நுகர்வதும் இல்லாதவர்க்கு மேன் மேலும் பெருகிய பல கோடிப் பொருள் உண்டானாலும் பயன் இல்லை.

translation:
Their ample wealth is misery to men of churlish heart, Who nought themselves enjoy, and nought to worthy men impart

Meaning: He who enjoys not (his riches) nor relieves the wants of the worthy is a disease to his wealth
pope_couplet: Their ample wealth is misery to men of churlish heart, Who nought themselves enjoy, and nought to worthy men impart
explanation_en: He who enjoys not (his riches) nor relieves the wants of the worthy is a disease to his wealth
explanation_ta: தானும் நுகராமல் தக்கவற்க்கு ஒன்று கொடுத்து உதவும் இயல்பும் இல்லாமல் வாழ்கின்றவன், தன்னிடமுள்ள பெருஞ் செல்வத்திற்கு ஒரு நோய் ஆவான்.

translation:
Like woman fair in lonelihood who aged grows, Is wealth of him on needy men who nought bestows

Meaning: The wealth of him who never bestows anything on the destitute is like a woman of beauty growing old without a husband
pope_couplet: Like woman fair in lonelihood who aged grows, Is wealth of him on needy men who nought bestows
explanation_en: The wealth of him who never bestows anything on the destitute is like a woman of beauty growing old without a husband
explanation_ta: பொருள் இல்லாத வறியவர்க்கு ஒரு பொருள் கொடுத்து உதவாதவனுடையச் செல்வம், மிக்க அழகு பெற்றவள் தனியாக வாழ்ந்து முதுமையுற்றாற் போன்றது.

translation:
When he whom no man loves exults in great prosperity,'Tis as when fruits in midmost of the town some poisonous tree

Meaning: The wealth of him who is disliked (by all) is like the fruit-bearing of the etty tree in the midst of a town
pope_couplet: When he whom no man loves exults in great prosperity,'Tis as when fruits in midmost of the town some poisonous tree
explanation_en: The wealth of him who is disliked (by all) is like the fruit-bearing of the etty tree in the midst of a town
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு உதவாத காரணத்தால் ஒருவராலும் விரும்பப்படாதவனுடைய செல்வம், ஊர் நடுவில் நச்சு மரம் பழுத்தாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Who love abandon, self-afflict, and virtue's way forsakeTo heap up glittering wealth, their hoards shall others take

Meaning: To heap up glittering wealth, their hoards shall others take
