pope_couplet: Who love abandon, self-afflict, and virtue's way forsakeTo heap up glittering wealth, their hoards shall others take
explanation_en: To heap up glittering wealth, their hoards shall others take
explanation_ta: பிறரிடம் செலுத்தும் அன்பையும் விட்டுத் தன்னையும் வருத்தி அறத்தையும் போற்றாமல் சேர்த்து வைத்தப் பெரும் பொருளைப் பெற்று நுகர்பவர் மற்றவரே.

translation:
'Tis as when rain cloud in the heaven grows day, When generous wealthy man endures brief poverty

Meaning: The short-lived poverty of those who are noble and rich is like the clouds becoming poor (for a while)
pope_couplet: 'Tis as when rain cloud in the heaven grows day, When generous wealthy man endures brief poverty
explanation_en: The short-lived poverty of those who are noble and rich is like the clouds becoming poor (for a while)
explanation_ta: புகழ் பொருந்திய செல்வர் உற்ற சிறிய வறுமை உலகத்தைக் காக்க வல்ல மேகம் வறுமை மிகுந்தாற் போன்ற தன்மை உடையது.

translation:
To shrink abashed from evil deed is 'generous shame'; Other is that of bright-browed one of virtuous fame

Meaning: True modesty is the fear of (evil) deeds; all other modesty is (simply) the bashfulness of virtuous maids
pope_couplet: To shrink abashed from evil deed is 'generous shame'; Other is that of bright-browed one of virtuous fame
explanation_en: True modesty is the fear of (evil) deeds; all other modesty is (simply) the bashfulness of virtuous maids
explanation_ta: தகாத செயல் காரணமாக நாணுவதே நாணமாகும், பெண்களுக்கு இயல்பான மற்ற நாணங்கள் வேறு வகையானவை.

translation:
Food, clothing, and other things alike all beings own; By sense of shame the excellence of men is known

Meaning: Food, clothing and the like are common to all men but modesty is peculiar to the good
pope_couplet: Food, clothing, and other things alike all beings own; By sense of shame the excellence of men is known
explanation_en: Food, clothing and the like are common to all men but modesty is peculiar to the good
explanation_ta: உணவும், உடையும் எஞ்சி நிற்கும் மற்றவையும், எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் பொதுவானவை, மக்களின் சிறப்பியல்பாக விளங்குவது நாணுடைமையே ஆகும்.

translation:
All spirits homes of flesh as habitation claim, And perfect virtue ever dwells with shame

Meaning: As the body is the abode of the spirit, so the excellence of modesty is the abode of perfection
pope_couplet: All spirits homes of flesh as habitation claim, And perfect virtue ever dwells with shame
explanation_en: As the body is the abode of the spirit, so the excellence of modesty is the abode of perfection
explanation_ta: எல்லா உயிர்களும் ஊனாலாகிய உடம்பை இருப்பிடமாகக் கொண்டவை, சால்பு என்பது நாணம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் நல்லப் பண்பை இருப்பிடமாகக் கொண்டது.

translation:
And is not shame an ornament to men of dignity?Without it step of stately pride is piteous thing to see

Meaning: Is not the modesty ornament of the noble ? Without it, their haughtiness would be a pain (to others)
pope_couplet: And is not shame an ornament to men of dignity?Without it step of stately pride is piteous thing to see
explanation_en: Is not the modesty ornament of the noble ? Without it, their haughtiness would be a pain (to others)
explanation_ta: சான்றோர்க்கு நாணுடைமை அணிகலம் அன்றோ, அந்த அணிகலம் இல்லையானால் பெருமிதமாக நடக்கும் நடை ஒரு நோய் அன்றோ.

translation:
As home of virtuous shame by all the world the men are known, Who feel ashamed for others, guilt as for their own

Meaning: The world regards as the abode of modesty him who fear his own and other's guilt
pope_couplet: As home of virtuous shame by all the world the men are known, Who feel ashamed for others, guilt as for their own
explanation_en: The world regards as the abode of modesty him who fear his own and other's guilt
explanation_ta: பிறர்க்கு வரும் பழிக்காகவும், தமக்கு வரும் பழிக்காகவும் நாணுகின்றவர் நாணத்திற்கு உறைவிட மானவர் என்று உலகம் சொல்லும்.

translation:
Unless the hedge of shame inviolate remain, For men of lofty soul the earth's vast realms no charms retain

Meaning: The great make modesty their barrier (of defence) and not the wide world
pope_couplet: Unless the hedge of shame inviolate remain, For men of lofty soul the earth's vast realms no charms retain
explanation_en: The great make modesty their barrier (of defence) and not the wide world
explanation_ta: நாணமாகிய வேலியை தமக்கு காவலாகச் செய்து கொள்ளாமல், மேலோர் பரந்த உலகில் வாழும் வாழ்க்கை விரும்பி மேற்கொள்ள மாட்டார்.

translation:
The men of modest soul for shame would life an offering make, But ne'er abandon virtuous shame for life's dear sake

Meaning: The modest would rather lose their life for the sake of modesty than lose modesty for the sake of life
pope_couplet: The men of modest soul for shame would life an offering make, But ne'er abandon virtuous shame for life's dear sake
explanation_en: The modest would rather lose their life for the sake of modesty than lose modesty for the sake of life
explanation_ta: நாணத்தை தமக்கரிய பண்பாகக் கொள்பவர் நாணத்தால் உயிரை விடுவர், உயிரைக் காக்கும் பொருட்டாக நாணத்தை விட மாட்டார்.

translation:
Though know'st no shame, while all around asha med must be:Virtue will shrink away ashamed of thee

Meaning: Virtue is likely to forsake him who shamelessly does what others are ashamed of
pope_couplet: Though know'st no shame, while all around asha med must be:Virtue will shrink away ashamed of thee
explanation_en: Virtue is likely to forsake him who shamelessly does what others are ashamed of
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் மற்றவர் நாணத்தக்க பழிக்குக் காரணமாக இருந்தும் தான் நாணாமலிருப்பானானால், அறம் நாணி அவனைக் கைவிடும் தன்மையுடையதாகும்.

translation:
'Twill race consume if right observance fail;'Twill every good consume if shamelessness prevail

Meaning: Want of manners injures one's family; but want of modesty injures one's character
pope_couplet: 'Twill race consume if right observance fail;'Twill every good consume if shamelessness prevail
explanation_en: Want of manners injures one's family; but want of modesty injures one's character
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் கொள்கை தவறினால் , அத் தவறு அவனுடையக் குடிப் பிறப்பைத் கெடுக்கும், நாணில்லாத தன்மை நிலைப் பெற்றால் நன்மை எல்லாவற்றையும் கெடுக்கும்.

translation:
'Tis as with strings a wooden puppet apes life's functions, whenThose void of shame within hold intercourse with men

Meaning: The actions of those who are without modesty at heart are like those of puppet moved by a string
pope_couplet: 'Tis as with strings a wooden puppet apes life's functions, whenThose void of shame within hold intercourse with men
explanation_en: The actions of those who are without modesty at heart are like those of puppet moved by a string
explanation_ta: மனத்தில் நாணம் இல்லாதவர் உலகத்தில் இயங்குதல், மரத்தால் செய்த பாவையைக் கயிறு கொண்டு ஆட்டி உயிருள்ளதாக மயக்கினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Who says 'I'll do my work, nor slack my hand', His greatness, clothed with dignity supreme, shall stand

Meaning: There is no higher greatness than that of one saying I will not cease in my effort (to raise my family)
pope_couplet: Who says 'I'll do my work, nor slack my hand', His greatness, clothed with dignity supreme, shall stand
explanation_en: There is no higher greatness than that of one saying I will not cease in my effort (to raise my family)
explanation_ta: குடிப் பெருமைக்கு உரிய கடமையைச் செய்வதற்குச் சோர்வடைய மாட்டேன் என்று ஒருவன் முயலும் பெருமையைப் போல மேம்பாடானது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
The manly act and knowledge full, when these combineIn deed prolonged, then lengthens out the race's line

Meaning: One's family is raised by untiring perseverance in both effort and wise contrivances
pope_couplet: The manly act and knowledge full, when these combineIn deed prolonged, then lengthens out the race's line
explanation_en: One's family is raised by untiring perseverance in both effort and wise contrivances
explanation_ta: முயற்சி நிறைந்த அறிவு என்று சொல்லப்படும் இரண்டினையும் உடைய இடைவிடாத செயலால் ஒருவனுடைய குடி உயர்ந்து விளங்கும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
'I'll make my race renowned,' if man shall say, With vest succinct the goddess leads the way

Meaning: The Deity will clothe itself and appear before him who resolves on raising his family
pope_couplet: 'I'll make my race renowned,' if man shall say, With vest succinct the goddess leads the way
explanation_en: The Deity will clothe itself and appear before him who resolves on raising his family
explanation_ta: என் குடியை உயரச் செய்வேன் என்று முயலும் ஒருவனுக்கு ஊழ், ஆடையைக் கட்டிக் கொண்டு தானே முன் வந்து துணை செய்யும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
Who labours for his race with unremitting pain, Without a thought spontaneously, his end will gain

Meaning: Those who are prompt in their efforts (to better their family) need no deliberation, such efforts will of themselves succeed
pope_couplet: Who labours for his race with unremitting pain, Without a thought spontaneously, his end will gain
explanation_en: Those who are prompt in their efforts (to better their family) need no deliberation, such efforts will of themselves succeed
explanation_ta: தம் குடி உயர்வதற்கான செயலை விரைந்து முயன்று செய்வோர்க்கு அவர் ஆராயமலே அச் செயல் தானே நிறைவேறும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
With blameless life who seeks to build his race's fame, The world shall circle him, and kindred claim

Meaning: People will eagerly seek the friendship of the prosperous soul who has raised his family without foul means
pope_couplet: With blameless life who seeks to build his race's fame, The world shall circle him, and kindred claim
explanation_en: People will eagerly seek the friendship of the prosperous soul who has raised his family without foul means
explanation_ta: குற்றம் இல்லாதவனாய்க் குடி உயர்வதற்கான செயல் செய்து வாழ்கின்றவனை உலகத்தார் சுற்றமாக விரும்பிச் சூழ்ந்து கொள்வர்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
Of virtuous manliness the world accords the praiseTo him who gives his powers, the house from which he sprang to raise

Meaning: A man's true manliness consists in making himself the head and benefactor of his family
pope_couplet: Of virtuous manliness the world accords the praiseTo him who gives his powers, the house from which he sprang to raise
explanation_en: A man's true manliness consists in making himself the head and benefactor of his family
explanation_ta: ஒருவனுக்கு நல்ல ஆண்மை என்று சொல்லப்படுவது தான் பிறந்த குடியை ஆளும் சிறப்பைத் தனக்கு உண்டாக்கி கொள்வதாகும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
The fearless hero bears the brunt amid the warrior throng; Amid his kindred so the burthen rests upon the strong

Meaning: Amid his kindred so the burthen rests upon the strong
pope_couplet: The fearless hero bears the brunt amid the warrior throng; Amid his kindred so the burthen rests upon the strong
explanation_en: Amid his kindred so the burthen rests upon the strong
explanation_ta: போர்க்களத்தில் பலரிடையே பொறுப்பை ஏற்றுக் கொள்ளும் அஞ்சாத வீரரைப் போல் குடியில் பிறந்தவரிடையிலும் தாங்க வல்லவர் மேல் தான் பொறுப்பு உள்ளது.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
Wait for no season, when you would your house uprear;'Twill perish, if you wait supine, or hold your honour dear

Meaning: As a family suffers by (one's) indolence and false dignity there is to be so season (good or bad) to those who strive to raise their family
pope_couplet: Wait for no season, when you would your house uprear;'Twill perish, if you wait supine, or hold your honour dear
explanation_en: As a family suffers by (one's) indolence and false dignity there is to be so season (good or bad) to those who strive to raise their family
explanation_ta: குடி உயர்வதற்கான செயல் செய்கின்றவர்க்கு உரிய காலம் என்று ஒன்று இல்லை, சோம்பல் கொண்டு தம் மானத்தைக் கருதுவாரானால் குடிப்பெருமைக் கெடும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
Is not his body vase that various sorrows fill, Who would his household screen from every ill

Meaning: Is it only to suffering that his body is exposed who undertakes to preserve his family from evil ?
pope_couplet: Is not his body vase that various sorrows fill, Who would his household screen from every ill
explanation_en: Is it only to suffering that his body is exposed who undertakes to preserve his family from evil ?
explanation_ta: தன் குடிக்கு வரக்குடிய குற்றத்தை வராமல் நீக்க முயல்கின்ற ஒருவனுடைய உடம்பு துன்பத்திற்கே இருப்பிடமானதோ.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
When trouble the foundation saps the house must fall, If no strong hand be nigh to prop the tottering wall

Meaning: If there are none to prop up and maintain a family (in distress), it will fall at the stroke of the axe of misfortune
pope_couplet: When trouble the foundation saps the house must fall, If no strong hand be nigh to prop the tottering wall
explanation_en: If there are none to prop up and maintain a family (in distress), it will fall at the stroke of the axe of misfortune
explanation_ta: துன்பம் வந்த போது உடனிருந்து தாங்க வல்ல நல்ல ஆள் இல்லாத குடி, துன்பமாகிய கோடாரி அடியில் வெட்டி வீழ்த்த விழுந்துவிடும்.
adhigaram_name_en: The Way of Maintaining the Family

translation:
Howe'er they roam, the world must follow still the plougher's team; Though toilsome, culture of the ground as noblest toil esteem

Meaning: Agriculture, though laborious, is the most excellent (form of labour); for people, though they go about (in search of various employments), have at last to resort to the farmer
pope_couplet: Howe'er they roam, the world must follow still the plougher's team; Though toilsome, culture of the ground as noblest toil esteem
explanation_en: Agriculture, though laborious, is the most excellent (form of labour); for people, though they go about (in search of various employments), have at last to resort to the farmer
explanation_ta: உலகம் பல தொழில் செய்து சுழன்றாலும் ஏர்த் தொழிலின் பின் நிற்கின்றது, அதனால் எவ்வளவு துன்புற்றாலும் உழவுத் தொழிலே சிறந்தது.

translation:
The ploughers are the linch-pin of the world; they bearThem up who other works perform, too weak its toils to share

Meaning: Agriculturists are (as it were) the linch-pin of the world for they support all other workers who cannot till the soil
pope_couplet: The ploughers are the linch-pin of the world; they bearThem up who other works perform, too weak its toils to share
explanation_en: Agriculturists are (as it were) the linch-pin of the world for they support all other workers who cannot till the soil
explanation_ta: உழவு செய்ய முடியாமல் உயிர் வாழ்கின்றவர், எல்லாரையும் தாங்குவதால், உழவு செய்கின்றவர் உலகத்தாற்கு அச்சாணி போன்றவர்.

translation:
Who ploughing eat their food, they truly live:The rest to others bend subservient, eating what they give

Meaning: They alone live who live by agriculture; all others lead a cringing, dependent life
pope_couplet: Who ploughing eat their food, they truly live:The rest to others bend subservient, eating what they give
explanation_en: They alone live who live by agriculture; all others lead a cringing, dependent life
explanation_ta: உழவு செய்து அதனால் கிடைத்ததைக் கொண்டு வாழ்கின்றவரே உரிமையோடு வாழ்கின்றவர், மற்றவர் எல்லோரும் பிறரைத் தொழுது உண்டு பின் செல்கின்றவரே.

translation:
O'er many a land they 'll see their monarch reign, Whose fields are shaded by the waving grain

Meaning: Patriotic farmers desire to bring all other states under the control of their own king
pope_couplet: O'er many a land they 'll see their monarch reign, Whose fields are shaded by the waving grain
explanation_en: Patriotic farmers desire to bring all other states under the control of their own king
explanation_ta: நெல் வளம் உடைய தண்ணளி பொருந்திய உழவர், பல அரசரின் குடை நிழல்களையும் தம் குடையின் கீழ் காணவல்லவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
They nothing ask from others, but to askers give, Who raise with their own hands the food on which they live

Meaning: Those whose nature is to live by manual labour will never beg but give something to those who beg
pope_couplet: They nothing ask from others, but to askers give, Who raise with their own hands the food on which they live
explanation_en: Those whose nature is to live by manual labour will never beg but give something to those who beg
explanation_ta: கையால் தொழில் செய்து உணவு தேடி உண்ணும் இயல்புடைய தொழிலாளர், பிறரிடம் சென்று இரக்கமாட்டார், தம்மிடம் இரந்தவர்க்கு ஒளிக்காமல் ஒரு பொருள் ஈவார்.

translation:
For those who 've left what all men love no place is found, When they with folded hands remain who till the ground

Meaning: If the farmer's hands are slackened, even the ascetic state will fail
pope_couplet: For those who 've left what all men love no place is found, When they with folded hands remain who till the ground
explanation_en: If the farmer's hands are slackened, even the ascetic state will fail
explanation_ta: உழவருடைய கை, தொழில் செய்யாமல் மடங்கியிருக்குமானால், விரும்புகின்ற எந்தப் பற்றையும் விட்டுவிட்டோம் என்று கூறும் துறவிகளுக்கும் வாழ்வு இல்லை.

translation:
Reduce your soil to that dry state, When ounce is quarter-ounce's weight; Without one handful of manure, Abundant crops you thus secure

Meaning: If the land is dried so as to reduce one ounce of earth to a quarter, it will grow plentifully even without a handful of manure
pope_couplet: Reduce your soil to that dry state, When ounce is quarter-ounce's weight; Without one handful of manure, Abundant crops you thus secure
explanation_en: If the land is dried so as to reduce one ounce of earth to a quarter, it will grow plentifully even without a handful of manure
explanation_ta: ஒரு பலம் புழுதி கால்பலம் ஆகும்படி உழுது காயவிட்டால், ஒரு பிடி எருவும் இடவேண்டாமல் அந் நிலத்தில் பயிர் செலுத்தி செழித்து விளையும்.

translation:
To cast manure is better than to plough; Weed well; to guard is more than watering now

Meaning: Manuring is better than ploughing; after weeding, watching is better than watering (it)
pope_couplet: To cast manure is better than to plough; Weed well; to guard is more than watering now
explanation_en: Manuring is better than ploughing; after weeding, watching is better than watering (it)
explanation_ta: ஏர் உழுதலை விட எரு இடுதல் நல்லது, இந்த இரண்டும் சேர்ந்துக் களை நீக்கிய பின், நீர் பாய்ச்சுதலை விடக் காவல்காத்தல் நல்லது.

translation:
When master from the field aloof hath stood; Then land will sulk, like wife in angry mood

Meaning: If the owner does not (personally) attend to his cultivation, his land will behave like an angry wife and yield him no pleasure
pope_couplet: When master from the field aloof hath stood; Then land will sulk, like wife in angry mood
explanation_en: If the owner does not (personally) attend to his cultivation, his land will behave like an angry wife and yield him no pleasure
explanation_ta: நிலத்திற்கு உரியவன் நிலத்தைச் சென்று பார்க்காமல் வாளா இருந்தால் அந் நிலம் அவனுடைய மனைவியைப் போல் வெறுத்து அவனோடு பிணங்கிவிடும்.

translation:
The earth, that kindly dame, will laugh to see, Men seated idle pleading poverty

Meaning: The maiden, Earth, will laugh at the sight of those who plead poverty and lead an idle life
pope_couplet: The earth, that kindly dame, will laugh to see, Men seated idle pleading poverty
explanation_en: The maiden, Earth, will laugh at the sight of those who plead poverty and lead an idle life
explanation_ta: எம்மிடம் ஒரு பொருளும் இல்லை என்று எண்ணி வறுமையால் சோம்பியிருப்பவரைக் கண்டால், நிலமகள் தன்னுள் சிரிப்பாள்.

translation:
You ask what sharper pain than poverty is known; Nothing pains more than poverty, save poverty alone

Meaning: There is nothing that afflicts (one) like poverty
pope_couplet: You ask what sharper pain than poverty is known; Nothing pains more than poverty, save poverty alone
explanation_en: There is nothing that afflicts (one) like poverty
explanation_ta: வறுமையைப் போல் துன்பமானது எது என்று கேட்டால், வறுமையைப் போல் துன்பமானது வறுமை ஒன்றே ஆகும்.

translation:
Malefactor matchless! poverty destroysThis world's and the next world's joys

Meaning: When cruel poverty comes on, it deprives one of both the present and future (bliss)
pope_couplet: Malefactor matchless! poverty destroysThis world's and the next world's joys
explanation_en: When cruel poverty comes on, it deprives one of both the present and future (bliss)
explanation_ta: வறுமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் பாவி ஒருவனை நெருங்கினால், அவனுக்கு மறுமையின்பமும், இன்மையின்பமும் இல்லாமற் போகும் நிலைமை வரும்.

translation:
Importunate desire, which poverty men name, Destroys both old descent and goodly fame

Meaning: Hankering poverty destroys at once the greatness of (one's) ancient descent and (the dignity of one's) speech
pope_couplet: Importunate desire, which poverty men name, Destroys both old descent and goodly fame
explanation_en: Hankering poverty destroys at once the greatness of (one's) ancient descent and (the dignity of one's) speech
explanation_ta: வறுமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஆசைநிலை ஒருவனைப் பற்றினால், அவனுடைய பழைமையானக் குடிப் பண்பையும் புகழையும் ஒரு சேரக் கெடுக்கும்.

translation:
From penury will spring, 'mid even those of noble race, Oblivion that gives birth to words that bring disgrace

Meaning: Even in those of high birth, poverty will produce the fault of uttering mean words
pope_couplet: From penury will spring, 'mid even those of noble race, Oblivion that gives birth to words that bring disgrace
explanation_en: Even in those of high birth, poverty will produce the fault of uttering mean words
explanation_ta: வறுமை என்பது, நல்ல குடியிற் பிறந்தவரிடத்திலும் இழிவு தரும் சொல் பிறப்பதற்குக் காரணமான சோர்வை உண்டாக்கி விடும்.

translation:
From poverty, that grievous woe, Attendant sorrows plenteous grow

Meaning: The misery of poverty brings in its train many (more) miseries
pope_couplet: From poverty, that grievous woe, Attendant sorrows plenteous grow
explanation_en: The misery of poverty brings in its train many (more) miseries
explanation_ta: வறுமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் துன்ப நிலையினுள் பலவகையாக வேறுபட்டுள்ள எல்லாத் துன்பங்களும் சென்று விளைந்திடும்.

translation:
Though deepest sense, well understood, the poor man's words convey, Their sense from memory of mankind will fade away

Meaning: The words of the poor are profitless, though they may be sound in thought and clear in expression
pope_couplet: Though deepest sense, well understood, the poor man's words convey, Their sense from memory of mankind will fade away
explanation_en: The words of the poor are profitless, though they may be sound in thought and clear in expression
explanation_ta: நல்ல நூற் பொருளை நன்றாக உணர்ந்து எடுத்துச் சொன்னப் போதிலும் வறியவர் சொன்ன சொற்பொருள் கேட்பார் இல்லாமல் பயன்படாமல் போகும்.

translation:
From indigence devoid of virtue's grace, The mother e'en that bare, estranged, will turn her face

Meaning: He that is reduced to absolute poverty will be regarded as a stranger even by his own mother
pope_couplet: From indigence devoid of virtue's grace, The mother e'en that bare, estranged, will turn her face
explanation_en: He that is reduced to absolute poverty will be regarded as a stranger even by his own mother
explanation_ta: அறத்தோடு பொருந்தாத வறுமை ஒருவனைச் சேர்ந்தால் பெற்றத் தாயாலும் அவன் அயலானைப் போல் புறக்கணித்துப் பார்க்கப்படுவான்.

translation:
And will it come today as yesterday, The grief of want that eats my soul away

Meaning: Is the poverty that almost killed me yesterday, to meet me today too ?
pope_couplet: And will it come today as yesterday, The grief of want that eats my soul away
explanation_en: Is the poverty that almost killed me yesterday, to meet me today too ?
explanation_ta: நேற்றும் கொலை செய்தது போல் துன்புறுத்திய வறுமை இன்றும் என்னிடம் வருமோ, (என்று வறியவன் நாள்தோறும் கலங்கி வருந்துவான்).

translation:
Amid the flames sleep may men's eyelids close, In poverty the eye knows no repose

Meaning: One may sleep in the midst of fire; but by no means in the midst of poverty
pope_couplet: Amid the flames sleep may men's eyelids close, In poverty the eye knows no repose
explanation_en: One may sleep in the midst of fire; but by no means in the midst of poverty
explanation_ta: ஒருவன் நெருப்பினுள் இருந்து தூங்குதலும் முடியும், ஆனால் வறுமை நிலையில் எவ்வகையாலும் கண்மூடித் தூங்குதல் அரிது.

translation:
Unless the destitute will utterly themselves deny, They cause their neighbour's salt and vinegar to die

Meaning: The destitute poor, who do not renounce their bodies, only consume their neighbour's salt and water
pope_couplet: Unless the destitute will utterly themselves deny, They cause their neighbour's salt and vinegar to die
explanation_en: The destitute poor, who do not renounce their bodies, only consume their neighbour's salt and water
explanation_ta: நுகரும் பொருள் இல்லாத வறியவர் முற்றுந் துறக்க கூடியவராக இருந்தும் துறக்காத காரணம், உப்புக்கும் கஞ்சிக்கும் எமனாக இருப்பதே ஆகும்.

translation:
When those you find from whom 'tis meet to ask,- for aid apply; Theirs is the sin, not yours, if they the gift deny

Meaning: If you meet with those that may be begged of, you may beg; (but) if they withhold (their gift) it is their blame and not yours
pope_couplet: When those you find from whom 'tis meet to ask,- for aid apply; Theirs is the sin, not yours, if they the gift deny
explanation_en: If you meet with those that may be begged of, you may beg; (but) if they withhold (their gift) it is their blame and not yours
explanation_ta: இரந்து கேட்க தக்கவரைக் கண்டால் அவனிடம் இரக்க வேண்டும், அவர் இல்லை என்று ஒளிப்பாரானால் அது அவர்க்கு பழி, தமக்கு பழி அன்று.

translation:
Even to ask an alms may pleasure give, If what you ask without annoyance you receive

Meaning: Even begging may be pleasant, if what is begged for is obtained without grief (to him that begs)
pope_couplet: Even to ask an alms may pleasure give, If what you ask without annoyance you receive
explanation_en: Even begging may be pleasant, if what is begged for is obtained without grief (to him that begs)
explanation_ta: இரந்து கேட்ட பொருள் துன்பமுறாமல் கிடைக்குமானால், அவ்வாறு இரத்தலும் இன்பம் என்று சொல்லத் தக்கதாகும்.

translation:
The men who nought deny, but know what's due, before their faceTo stand as suppliants affords especial grace

Meaning: There is even a beauty in standing before and begging of those who are liberal in their gifts and understand their duty (to beggars)
pope_couplet: The men who nought deny, but know what's due, before their faceTo stand as suppliants affords especial grace
explanation_en: There is even a beauty in standing before and begging of those who are liberal in their gifts and understand their duty (to beggars)
explanation_ta: ஒளிப்பு இல்லாத நெஞ்சும், கடைமையுணர்ச்சியும், உள்ளவரின் முன்னே நின்று இரந்து பொருள் கேட்பதும் ஓர் அழகு உடையதாகும்.

translation:
Like giving alms, may even asking pleasant seem, From men who of denial never even dream

Meaning: To beg of such as never think of withholding (their charity) even in their dreams, is in fact the same as giving (it oneself);
pope_couplet: Like giving alms, may even asking pleasant seem, From men who of denial never even dream
explanation_en: To beg of such as never think of withholding (their charity) even in their dreams, is in fact the same as giving (it oneself);
explanation_ta: உள்ளதை மறைத்துக் கூறும் தன்மையைக் கனவிலும் அறியாதவரிடத்தில் இரந்து கேட்பதும் பிறர்க்கு கொடுப்பதைப் போன்ற சிறப்புடையது.

translation:
Because on earth the men exist, who never say them nay, Men bear to stand before their eyes for help to pray

Meaning: As there are in the world those that give without refusing, there are (also) those that prefer to beg by simply standing before them
pope_couplet: Because on earth the men exist, who never say them nay, Men bear to stand before their eyes for help to pray
explanation_en: As there are in the world those that give without refusing, there are (also) those that prefer to beg by simply standing before them
explanation_ta: ஒருவர் முன் நின்று இரப்பவர் அந்த இரத்தலை மேற்கொள்வது, உள்ளதை இல்லை என்று ஒளித்துக்கூறாத நன்மைகள் உலகத்தில் இருப்பதால் தான்.

translation:
It those you find from evil of 'denial' free, At once all plague of poverty will flee

Meaning: All the evil of begging will be removed at the sight of those who are far from the evil of refusing
pope_couplet: It those you find from evil of 'denial' free, At once all plague of poverty will flee
explanation_en: All the evil of begging will be removed at the sight of those who are far from the evil of refusing
explanation_ta: உள்ளதை ஒளிக்கும் துன்பநிலை இல்லாதவரைக் கண்டால், இரப்பவரின் வறுமைத் துன்பம் எல்லாம் ஒரு சேரக் கெடும்.

translation:
If men are found who give and no harsh words of scorn employ, The minds of askers, through and through, will thrill with joy

Meaning: Beggars rejoice exceedingly when they behold those who bestow (their alms) with kindness and courtesy
pope_couplet: If men are found who give and no harsh words of scorn employ, The minds of askers, through and through, will thrill with joy
explanation_en: Beggars rejoice exceedingly when they behold those who bestow (their alms) with kindness and courtesy
explanation_ta: இகழ்ந்து எள்ளாமல் பொருள் கொடுப்பவரைக் கண்டால், இரப்பவரின் உள்ளம் மகிழ்ந்து உள்ளுக்குள்ளே உவகை அடையும் தன்மையுடையதாகும்.

translation:
If askers cease, the mighty earth, where cooling fountains flow, Will be a stage where wooden puppets come and go

Meaning: If there were no beggars, (the actions done in) the cool wide world would only resemble the movement of a puppet
pope_couplet: If askers cease, the mighty earth, where cooling fountains flow, Will be a stage where wooden puppets come and go
explanation_en: If there were no beggars, (the actions done in) the cool wide world would only resemble the movement of a puppet
explanation_ta: இரப்பவர் இல்லையானால், இப் பெரிய உலகின் இயக்கம் மரத்தால் செய்த பாவை கயிற்றினால் ஆட்டப்பட்டுச் சென்று வந்தாற் போன்றதாகும்.

translation:
What glory will there be to men of generous soul, When none are found to love the askers' role

Meaning: What (praise) would there be to givers (of alms) if there were no beggars to ask for and reveive (them)
pope_couplet: What glory will there be to men of generous soul, When none are found to love the askers' role
explanation_en: What (praise) would there be to givers (of alms) if there were no beggars to ask for and reveive (them)
explanation_ta: பொருள் இல்லை என்று இரந்து அதைப் பெற்றுக் கொள்ள விரும்புவோர் இல்லாதபோது, பொருள் கொடுப்பவனிடத்தில் என்ன புகழ் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
Askers refused from wrath must stand aloof; The plague of poverty itself is ample proof

Meaning: He who begs ought not to be angry (at a refusal); for even the misery of (his own) poverty should be a sufficient reason (for so doing)
pope_couplet: Askers refused from wrath must stand aloof; The plague of poverty itself is ample proof
explanation_en: He who begs ought not to be angry (at a refusal); for even the misery of (his own) poverty should be a sufficient reason (for so doing)
explanation_ta: இரப்பவன் எவரிடத்திலும் சினம் கொள்ளாதிருக்க வேண்டும், அவன் அடைந்துள்ள வறுமைத் துன்பமே அவனுக்கு அறிவு புகட்டும் சான்றாக அமையும்.

translation:
Ten million-fold 'tis greater gain, asking no alms to live, Even from those, like eyes in worth, who nought concealing gladly give

Meaning: Not to beg (at all) even from those excellent persons who cheerfully give without refusing, will do immense good
pope_couplet: Ten million-fold 'tis greater gain, asking no alms to live, Even from those, like eyes in worth, who nought concealing gladly give
explanation_en: Not to beg (at all) even from those excellent persons who cheerfully give without refusing, will do immense good
explanation_ta: உள்ளதை மறைக்காமல் உள்ளம் மகிழ்ந்து கொடுக்கும் கண்போல் சிறந்தவரிடத்திலும் சென்று இரவாமலிருப்பதே கோடி மடங்கு நல்லதாகும்.

translation:
If he that shaped the world desires that men should begging go, Through life's long course, let him a wanderer be and perish so

Meaning: If the Creator of the world has decreed even begging as a means of livelihood, may he too go abegging and perish
pope_couplet: If he that shaped the world desires that men should begging go, Through life's long course, let him a wanderer be and perish so
explanation_en: If the Creator of the world has decreed even begging as a means of livelihood, may he too go abegging and perish
explanation_ta: உலகத்தை படைத்தவன் உலகில் சிலர் இரந்தும் உயிர்வாழுமாறு ஏற்படுத்தியிருந்தால், அவன் இரப்பவரைப் போல் எங்கும் அலைந்து கெடுவானாக.

translation:
Nothing is harder than the hardness that will say,'The plague of penury by asking alms we'll drive away.'

Meaning: There is no greater folly than the boldness with which one seeks to remedy the evils of poverty by begging (rather than by working)
pope_couplet: Nothing is harder than the hardness that will say,'The plague of penury by asking alms we'll drive away.'
explanation_en: There is no greater folly than the boldness with which one seeks to remedy the evils of poverty by begging (rather than by working)
explanation_ta: வறுமைத் துன்பத்தை இரப்பதன் வாயிலாகத் தீர்ப்போம், என்று கருதி முயற்சியைக் கைவிட்ட வன்மையைப் போல் வன்மையானது வேறு இல்லை.

translation:
Who ne'er consent to beg in utmost need, their worthHas excellence of greatness that transcends the earth

Meaning: Even the whole world cannot sufficiently praise the dignity that would not beg even in the midst of destitution
pope_couplet: Who ne'er consent to beg in utmost need, their worthHas excellence of greatness that transcends the earth
explanation_en: Even the whole world cannot sufficiently praise the dignity that would not beg even in the midst of destitution
explanation_ta: வாழ வழி இல்லாத போதும் இரந்து கேட்க உடன்படாத சால்பு, உலகத்தில் இடமெல்லாம் கொள்ளாத அவ்வளவு பொருமையுடையதாகும்.

translation:
Nothing is sweeter than to taste the toil-won cheer, Though mess of pottage as tasteless as the water clear

Meaning: Even thin gruel is ambrosia to him who has obtained it by labour
pope_couplet: Nothing is sweeter than to taste the toil-won cheer, Though mess of pottage as tasteless as the water clear
explanation_en: Even thin gruel is ambrosia to him who has obtained it by labour
explanation_ta: தெளிந்த நீர் போல் சமைத்த கூழே ஆனாலும், முயற்சியால் கிடைத்ததை உண்பதைவிட இனிமையானது வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
E'en if a draught of water for a cow you ask, Nought's so distasteful to the tongue as beggar's task

Meaning: There is nothing more disgraceful to one's tongue than to use it in begging water even for a cow
pope_couplet: E'en if a draught of water for a cow you ask, Nought's so distasteful to the tongue as beggar's task
explanation_en: There is nothing more disgraceful to one's tongue than to use it in begging water even for a cow
explanation_ta: பசுவிற்கு நீர் வேண்டும் என்று அறம் நோக்கி இரந்து கேட்டாலும், இர த்தலை விட நாவிற்கு இழிவானது மற்றொன்று இல்லை.

translation:
One thing I beg of beggars all, 'If beg ye may, Of those who hide their wealth, beg not, I pray.'

Meaning: I beseech all beggars and say, "If you need to beg, never beg of those who give unwillingly."
pope_couplet: One thing I beg of beggars all, 'If beg ye may, Of those who hide their wealth, beg not, I pray.'
explanation_en: I beseech all beggars and say, "If you need to beg, never beg of those who give unwillingly."
explanation_ta: இரந்து கேட்பதனால் உள்ளதை ஒளிப்பவரிடத்தில் சென்று இரக்க வேண்டுடாம் என்று இரப்பவர் எல்லோரையும் இரந்து வேண்டுகின்றேன்.

translation:
The fragile bark of beggaryWrecked on denial's rock will lie

Meaning: The unsafe raft of begging will split when it strikes on the rock of refusal
pope_couplet: The fragile bark of beggaryWrecked on denial's rock will lie
explanation_en: The unsafe raft of begging will split when it strikes on the rock of refusal
explanation_ta: இரத்தல் என்னும் காவல் இல்லாத மரக்கலம் உள்ளதை ஒளித்துவைக்கும் தன்மையாகிய வன்னிலம் தாக்கினால் உடைந்து விடும்.

translation:
The heart will melt away at thought of beggary, With thought of stern repulse 'twill perish utterly

Meaning: To think of (the evil of) begging is enough to melt one's heart; but to think of refusal is enough to break it
pope_couplet: The heart will melt away at thought of beggary, With thought of stern repulse 'twill perish utterly
explanation_en: To think of (the evil of) begging is enough to melt one's heart; but to think of refusal is enough to break it
explanation_ta: இரத்தலின் கொடுமையை நினைத்தால் உள்ளம் கரைந்து உருகும், உள்ளதை ஒழிக்கும் கொடுமையை நினைத்தால் உருகுமளவும் இல்லாமல் அழியும்.

translation:
E'en as he asks, the shamefaced asker dies; Where shall his spirit hide who help denies

Meaning: Saying "No" to a beggar takes away his life. (but as that very word will kill the refuser) where then would the latter's life hide itself ?
pope_couplet: E'en as he asks, the shamefaced asker dies; Where shall his spirit hide who help denies
explanation_en: Saying "No" to a beggar takes away his life. (but as that very word will kill the refuser) where then would the latter's life hide itself ?
explanation_ta: இரப்பவர் இல்லை என்று சொல்கின்ற அளவிலேயே உயிர் போகின்றதே, உள்ளதை இல்லை என்று ஒளிப்பவர்க்கு உயிர் எங்கு ஒளிந்திருக்குமோ.

translation:
The base resemble men in outward form, I ween; But counterpart exact to them I've never seen

Meaning: The base resemble men perfectly (as regards form); and we have not seen such (exact) resemblance (among any other species)
pope_couplet: The base resemble men in outward form, I ween; But counterpart exact to them I've never seen
explanation_en: The base resemble men perfectly (as regards form); and we have not seen such (exact) resemblance (among any other species)
explanation_ta: மக்களே போல் இருப்பார் கயவர், அவர் மக்களை ஒத்திருப்பது போன்ற ஒப்புமை வேறு எந்த இருவகைப் பொருள்களிடத்திலும் யாம் கண்டதில்லை.

translation:
Than those of grateful heart the base must luckier be, Their minds from every anxious thought are free

Meaning: The low enjoy more felicity than those who know what is good; for the former are not troubled with anxiety (as to the good)
pope_couplet: Than those of grateful heart the base must luckier be, Their minds from every anxious thought are free
explanation_en: The low enjoy more felicity than those who know what is good; for the former are not troubled with anxiety (as to the good)
explanation_ta: நன்மை அறிந்தவரை விடக் கயவரே நல்ல பேறு உடையவர், ஏன் என்றால், கயவர் தம் நெஞ்சில் எதைப் பற்றியும் கவலை இல்லாதவர்.

translation:
The base are as the Gods; they tooDo ever what they list to do

Meaning: The base resemble the Gods; for the base act as they like
pope_couplet: The base are as the Gods; they tooDo ever what they list to do
explanation_en: The base resemble the Gods; for the base act as they like
explanation_ta: கயவரும் தேவரைப் போல் தான் விரும்புகின்றவைகளைச் செய்து மனம் போன போக்கில் நடத்தலால், கயவர் தேவரைப் போன்றவர்.

translation:
When base men those behold of conduct vile, They straight surpass them, and exulting smile

Meaning: The base feels proud when he sees persons whose acts meaner than his own
pope_couplet: When base men those behold of conduct vile, They straight surpass them, and exulting smile
explanation_en: The base feels proud when he sees persons whose acts meaner than his own
explanation_ta: கீழ் மக்கள் தமக்கு கீழ் பட்டவராய் நடப்பவரைக் கண்டால், அவரை விடத் தாம் மேம்பாடு உடையவராய் இறுமாப்படைவர்.

translation:
Fear is the base man's virtue; if that fail, Intense desire some little may avail

Meaning: (The principle of) behaviour in the mean is chiefly fear; if not, hope of gain, to some extent
pope_couplet: Fear is the base man's virtue; if that fail, Intense desire some little may avail
explanation_en: (The principle of) behaviour in the mean is chiefly fear; if not, hope of gain, to some extent
explanation_ta: கீழ் மக்களின் ஆசாரத்திற்கு காரணமாக இருப்பது அச்சமே, எஞ்சியவற்றில் அவா உண்டானால் அதனாலும் சிறிதளவு ஆசாரம் உண்டாகும்.

translation:
The base are like the beaten drum; for, when they hearThe sound the secret out in every neighbour's ear

Meaning: The base are like a drum that is beaten, for they unburden to others the secrets they have heard
pope_couplet: The base are like the beaten drum; for, when they hearThe sound the secret out in every neighbour's ear
explanation_en: The base are like a drum that is beaten, for they unburden to others the secrets they have heard
explanation_ta: கயவர், தாம் கேட்டறிந்த மறைப்பொருளைப் பிறர்க்கு வலிய கொண்டுபோய்ச் சொல்லுவதலால், அறையப்படும் பறை போன்றவர்.

translation:
From off their moistened hands no clinging grain they shake, Unless to those with clenched fist their jaws who break

Meaning: The mean will not (even) shake off (what sticks to) their hands (soon after a meal) to any but those who would break their jaws with their clenched fists
pope_couplet: From off their moistened hands no clinging grain they shake, Unless to those with clenched fist their jaws who break
explanation_en: The mean will not (even) shake off (what sticks to) their hands (soon after a meal) to any but those who would break their jaws with their clenched fists
explanation_ta: கயவர் தம் கன்னத்தை இடித்து உடைக்கும் படி வளைந்த கை உடையவரல்லாத மற்றவர்க்கு உண்ட எச்சில் கையையும் உதற மாட்டார்.

translation:
The good to those will profit yield fair words who use; The base, like sugar-cane, will profit those who bruise

Meaning: The great bestow (their alms) as soon as they are informed; (but) the mean, like the sugar-cane, only when they are tortured to death
pope_couplet: The good to those will profit yield fair words who use; The base, like sugar-cane, will profit those who bruise
explanation_en: The great bestow (their alms) as soon as they are informed; (but) the mean, like the sugar-cane, only when they are tortured to death
explanation_ta: அணுகி குறைச் சொல்லுகின்ற அளவிலேயே சான்றோர் பயன்படுவர், கரும்புபோல் அழித்துப் பிழிந்தால் தான் கீழ்மக்கள் பயன்படுவர்.

translation:
If neighbours clothed and fed he see, the baseIs mighty man some hidden fault to trace

Meaning: The base will bring an evil (accusation) against others, as soon as he sees them (enjoying) good food
pope_couplet: If neighbours clothed and fed he see, the baseIs mighty man some hidden fault to trace
explanation_en: The base will bring an evil (accusation) against others, as soon as he sees them (enjoying) good food
explanation_ta: கீழ் மகன் பிறர் உடுப்பதையும், உண்பதையும் கண்டால் அவர் மேல் பொறாமை கொண்டு, வேண்டும் என்றே குற்றம் காண வல்லவனாவான்.

translation:
For what is base man fit, if griefs assail?Himself to offer, there and then, for sale

Meaning: The base will hasten to sell themselves as soon as a calamity has befallen them. For what else are they fitted ?
pope_couplet: For what is base man fit, if griefs assail?Himself to offer, there and then, for sale
explanation_en: The base will hasten to sell themselves as soon as a calamity has befallen them. For what else are they fitted ?
explanation_ta: கயவர், எதற்கு உரியவர், ஒரு துன்பம் வந்தடைந்த காலத்தில் அதற்காக தம்மை பிறர்க்கு விலையாக விற்றுவிடுவதற்கு உரியவர் ஆவர்.

translation:
Goddess? or peafowl rare? She whose ears rich jewels wear, Is she a maid of human kind? All wildered is my mind

Meaning: Is this jewelled female a celestial, a choice peahen, or a human being ? My mind is perplexed
pope_couplet: Goddess? or peafowl rare? She whose ears rich jewels wear, Is she a maid of human kind? All wildered is my mind
explanation_en: Is this jewelled female a celestial, a choice peahen, or a human being ? My mind is perplexed
explanation_ta: தெய்வப் பெண்ணோ! மயிலோ, கனமான குழை அணிந்த மனிதப் பெண்ணோ, என் நெஞ்சம் மயங்குகின்றதே.

translation:
She of the beaming eyes, To my rash look her glance replies, As if the matchless goddess' hand Led forth an armed band

Meaning: This female beauty returning my looks is like a celestial maiden coming with an army to contend against me
pope_couplet: She of the beaming eyes, To my rash look her glance replies, As if the matchless goddess' hand Led forth an armed band
explanation_en: This female beauty returning my looks is like a celestial maiden coming with an army to contend against me
explanation_ta: நோக்கிய அவள் பார்வைக்கு எதிரே நோக்குதல் தானே தாக்கி வருத்தும் அணங்கு, ஒரு சேனையையும் கொண்டு வந்து தாக்கினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Death's form I formerly Knew not; but now 'tis plain to me; He comes in lovely maiden's guise, With soul-subduing eyes

Meaning: I never knew before what is called Yama; I see it now; it is the eyes that carry on a great fight with (the help of) female qualities
pope_couplet: Death's form I formerly Knew not; but now 'tis plain to me; He comes in lovely maiden's guise, With soul-subduing eyes
explanation_en: I never knew before what is called Yama; I see it now; it is the eyes that carry on a great fight with (the help of) female qualities
explanation_ta: எமன் என்று சொல்லப்படுவதை முன்பு அறியேன், இப்பொழுது கண்டறிந்தேன், அது பெண் தனமையுடன் போர் செய்யும் பெரிய கண்களை உடையது

translation:
In sweet simplicity, A woman's gracious form hath she; But yet those eyes, that drink my life, Are with the form at strife

Meaning: These eyes that seem to kill those who look at them are as it were in hostilities with this feminine simplicity
pope_couplet: In sweet simplicity, A woman's gracious form hath she; But yet those eyes, that drink my life, Are with the form at strife
explanation_en: These eyes that seem to kill those who look at them are as it were in hostilities with this feminine simplicity
explanation_ta: பெண்தன்மை உடைய இந்தப் பேதைக்குக் கண்கள் கண்டவரின் உயிரை உண்ணும் தோற்றத்தோடு கூடி ஒன்றோடொன்று மாறுபட்டிருந்தன.

translation:
The light that on me gleams, Is it death's dart? or eye's bright beams?Or fawn's shy glance? All three appear In form of maiden here

Meaning: Is it Yama, (a pair of) eyes or a hind ?- Are not all these three in the looks of this maid ?
pope_couplet: The light that on me gleams, Is it death's dart? or eye's bright beams?Or fawn's shy glance? All three appear In form of maiden here
explanation_en: Is it Yama, (a pair of) eyes or a hind ?- Are not all these three in the looks of this maid ?
explanation_ta: எமனோ. கண்ணோ, பெண்மானோ, இந்த இளம் பெண்ணின் பார்வை இந்த மூன்றன் தன்மையும் உடையதாக இருக்கிறது.

translation:
If cruel eye-brow's bow, Unbent, would veil those glances now; The shafts that wound this trembling heart Her eyes no more would dart

Meaning: Her eyes will cause (me) no trembling sorrow, if they are properly hidden by her cruel arched eyebrows
pope_couplet: If cruel eye-brow's bow, Unbent, would veil those glances now; The shafts that wound this trembling heart Her eyes no more would dart
explanation_en: Her eyes will cause (me) no trembling sorrow, if they are properly hidden by her cruel arched eyebrows
explanation_ta: வளைந்த புருவங்கள் கோணாமல் நேராக இருந்து மறைக்குமானால், இவளுடைய கண்கள் யான் நடுங்கும் படியான துன்பத்தைச் செய்யமாட்டா.

translation:
As veil o'er angry eyes Of raging elephant that lies, The silken cincture's folds invest This maiden's panting breast

Meaning: The cloth that covers the firm bosom of this maiden is (like) that which covers the eyes of a rutting elephant
pope_couplet: As veil o'er angry eyes Of raging elephant that lies, The silken cincture's folds invest This maiden's panting breast
explanation_en: The cloth that covers the firm bosom of this maiden is (like) that which covers the eyes of a rutting elephant
explanation_ta: மாதருடைய சாயாத கொங்கைகளின் மேல் அணிந்த ஆடை, மதம் பிடித்த யானையின் மேல் இட்ட முகப்படாம் போன்றது.

translation:
Ah woe is me my might, That awed my foemen in the fight, By lustre of that beaming brow Borne down, lies broken now

Meaning: On her bright brow alone is destroyed even that power of mine that used to terrify the most fearless
pope_couplet: Ah woe is me my might, That awed my foemen in the fight, By lustre of that beaming brow Borne down, lies broken now
explanation_en: On her bright brow alone is destroyed even that power of mine that used to terrify the most fearless
explanation_ta: போர்க்களத்தில் பகைவரும் அஞ்சுதற்க்கு காரணமான என் வலிமை, இவளுடைய ஒளி பொருந்திய நெற்றிக்குத் தோற்று அழிந்ததே.

translation:
Like tender fawn's her eye; Clothed on is she with modesty; What added beauty can be lent; By alien ornament

Meaning: Of what use are other jewels to her who is adorned with modesty, and the meek looks of a hind ?
pope_couplet: Like tender fawn's her eye; Clothed on is she with modesty; What added beauty can be lent; By alien ornament
explanation_en: Of what use are other jewels to her who is adorned with modesty, and the meek looks of a hind ?
explanation_ta: பெண்மானைப் போன்ற இளமைப் பார்வையும் நாணமும் உடைய இவளுக்கு, ஒரு தொடர்பும் இல்லாத அணிகளைச் செய்து அணிவது ஏனோ.

translation:
The palm-tree's fragrant wine, To those who taste yields joys divine; But love hath rare felicity For those that only see

Meaning: Unlike boiled honey which yields delight only when it is drunk, love gives pleasure even when looked at
pope_couplet: The palm-tree's fragrant wine, To those who taste yields joys divine; But love hath rare felicity For those that only see
explanation_en: Unlike boiled honey which yields delight only when it is drunk, love gives pleasure even when looked at
explanation_ta: கள், தன்னை உண்டவரிடத்தில் அல்லாமல் காமத்தைப் போல் தன்னைக் கண்டவரிடத்தில் மயக்கத்தை உண்டாக்குவதில்லையே.

translation:
A double witchery have glances of her liquid eye; One glance is glance that brings me pain; the other heals again

Meaning: There are two looks in the dyed eyes of this (fair one); one causes pain, and the other is the cure thereof
pope_couplet: A double witchery have glances of her liquid eye; One glance is glance that brings me pain; the other heals again
explanation_en: There are two looks in the dyed eyes of this (fair one); one causes pain, and the other is the cure thereof
explanation_ta: இவளுடைய மை தீட்டிய கண்களில் உள்ளது இருவகைப்பட்ட நோக்கமாகும், அவற்றுள் ஒரு நோக்கம் நோய் செய்யும் நோக்கம், மற்றொன்று அந் நோய்க்கு மருந்தாகும்.

translation:
The furtive glance, that gleams one instant bright, Is more than half of love's supreme delight

Meaning: A single stolen glance of her eyes is more than half the pleasure (of sexual embrace)
pope_couplet: The furtive glance, that gleams one instant bright, Is more than half of love's supreme delight
explanation_en: A single stolen glance of her eyes is more than half the pleasure (of sexual embrace)
explanation_ta: கண்ணால் என்னை நோக்கிக் களவு கொள்கின்ற சுருங்கிய பார்வை காமத்தில் நேர்பாதி அன்று, அதைவிடப் பெரிய பகுதியாகும்.

translation:
She looked, and looking drooped her head:On springing shoot of love 'its water shed

Meaning: She has looked (at men) and stooped (her head); and that (sign) waters as it were (the corn of) our love
pope_couplet: She looked, and looking drooped her head:On springing shoot of love 'its water shed
explanation_en: She has looked (at men) and stooped (her head); and that (sign) waters as it were (the corn of) our love
explanation_ta: என்னை நோக்கினாள், யான் கண்டதும் நோக்கித் தலைகுனிந்தால், அது அவள் வளர்க்கும் அன்பினுள் வார்க்கின்ற நீராகும்.

translation:
I look on her: her eyes are on the ground the while:I look away: she looks on me with timid smile

Meaning: When I look, she looks down; when I do not, she looks and smiles gently
pope_couplet: I look on her: her eyes are on the ground the while:I look away: she looks on me with timid smile
explanation_en: When I look, she looks down; when I do not, she looks and smiles gently
explanation_ta: யான் நோக்கும் போது அவள் நிலத்தை நோக்குவாள், யான் நோக்காத போது அவள் என்னை நோக்கி மெல்லத் தனக்குள் மகிழ்வாள்.

translation:
She seemed to see me not; but yet the maidHer love, by smiling side-long glance, betrayed

Meaning: She not only avoids a direct look at me, but looks as it were with a half-closed eye and smiles
pope_couplet: She seemed to see me not; but yet the maidHer love, by smiling side-long glance, betrayed
explanation_en: She not only avoids a direct look at me, but looks as it were with a half-closed eye and smiles
explanation_ta: என்னை நேராகக் குறித்துப் பார்க்காத அத் தன்மையே அல்லாமல், ஒரு கண்ணைச் சுருக்கினவள் போல் என்னைப் பார்த்து தனக்குள் மகிழ்வாள்.

translation:
Though with their lips affection they disown, Yet, when they hate us not, 'tis quickly known

Meaning: Though they may speak harshly as if they were strangers, the words of the friendly are soon understood
pope_couplet: Though with their lips affection they disown, Yet, when they hate us not, 'tis quickly known
explanation_en: Though they may speak harshly as if they were strangers, the words of the friendly are soon understood
explanation_ta: புறத்தே அயலார் போல் அன்பில்லாத சொற்களைச் சொன்னாலும், அகத்தே பகையில்லாதவரின் சொல் என்பது விரைவில் அறியப்படும்.

translation:
The slighting words that anger feign, while eyes their love revealAre signs of those that love, but would their love conceal

Meaning: Little words that are harsh and looks that are hateful are (but) the expressions of lovers who wish to act like strangers
pope_couplet: The slighting words that anger feign, while eyes their love revealAre signs of those that love, but would their love conceal
explanation_en: Little words that are harsh and looks that are hateful are (but) the expressions of lovers who wish to act like strangers
explanation_ta: பகை கொள்ளாத கடுஞ்சொல்லும், பகைவர் போல் பார்க்கும் பார்வையும் புறத்தே அயலார் போல் இருந்து அகத்தே அன்பு கொண்டவரின் குறிப்பாகும்.

translation:
I gaze, the tender maid relents the while; And, oh the matchless grace of that soft smile

Meaning: When I look, the pitying maid looks in return and smiles gently; and that is a comforting sign for me
pope_couplet: I gaze, the tender maid relents the while; And, oh the matchless grace of that soft smile
explanation_en: When I look, the pitying maid looks in return and smiles gently; and that is a comforting sign for me
explanation_ta: யான் நோக்கும் போது அதற்காக அன்பு கொண்டவனாய் மெல்லச் சிரிப்பாள், அசையும் மெல்லிய இயல்பை உடைய அவளுக்கு அப்போது ஓர் அழகு உள்ளது.

translation:
The look indifferent, that would its love disguise, Is only read aright by lovers' eyes

Meaning: Both the lovers are capable of looking at each other in an ordinary way, as if they were perfect strangers
pope_couplet: The look indifferent, that would its love disguise, Is only read aright by lovers' eyes
explanation_en: Both the lovers are capable of looking at each other in an ordinary way, as if they were perfect strangers
explanation_ta: புறத்தே அயலார்போல் அன்பில்லாத பொது நோக்கம் கொண்டு பார்த்தல், அகத்தே காதல் கொண்டவரிடம் உள்ள இயல்பாகும்.

translation:
When eye to answering eye reveals the tale of love, All words that lips can say must useless prove

Meaning: The words of the mouths are of no use whatever, when there is perfect agreement between the eyes (of lovers)
pope_couplet: When eye to answering eye reveals the tale of love, All words that lips can say must useless prove
explanation_en: The words of the mouths are of no use whatever, when there is perfect agreement between the eyes (of lovers)
explanation_ta: கண்களோடு கண்கள் நோக்காமல் ஒத்திருந்து அன்பு செய்யுமானால் வாய்ச் சொற்கள் என்ன பயனும் இல்லாமற் போகின்றன.

translation:
All joys that senses five- sight, hearing, taste, smell, touch- can give, In this resplendent armlets-bearing damsel live

Meaning: The (simultaneous) enjoyment of the five senses of sight, hearing, taste, smell and touch can only be found with bright braceleted (women)
pope_couplet: All joys that senses five- sight, hearing, taste, smell, touch- can give, In this resplendent armlets-bearing damsel live
explanation_en: The (simultaneous) enjoyment of the five senses of sight, hearing, taste, smell and touch can only be found with bright braceleted (women)
explanation_ta: கண்டும் கேட்டும் உண்டும் முகர்ந்தும் உற்றும் அறிகின்ற ஐந்து புலன்களாகிய இன்பங்களும் ஒளி பொருந்திய வளையல் அணிந்த இவளிடத்தில் உள்ளன.

translation:
Disease and medicine antagonists we surely see; This maid, to pain she gives, herself is remedy

Meaning: The remedy for a disease is always something different (from it); but for the disease caused by this jewelled maid, she is herself the cure
pope_couplet: Disease and medicine antagonists we surely see; This maid, to pain she gives, herself is remedy
explanation_en: The remedy for a disease is always something different (from it); but for the disease caused by this jewelled maid, she is herself the cure
explanation_ta: நோய்களுக்கு மருந்து வேறு பொருள்களாக இருக்கின்றன, ஆனால் அணிகலன் அணிந்த இவளால் வளர்ந்த நோய்க்கு இவளே மருந்தாக இருக்கின்றாள்.

translation:
Than rest in her soft arms to whom the soul is giv'n, Is any sweeter joy in his, the Lotus-eyed-one's heaven

Meaning: Can the lotus-eyed Vishnu's heaven be indeed as sweet to those who delight to sleep in the delicate arms of their beloved ?
pope_couplet: Than rest in her soft arms to whom the soul is giv'n, Is any sweeter joy in his, the Lotus-eyed-one's heaven
explanation_en: Can the lotus-eyed Vishnu's heaven be indeed as sweet to those who delight to sleep in the delicate arms of their beloved ?
explanation_ta: தாமரைக் கண்ணனுடைய உலகம், தாம் விரும்பும் காதலியரின் மெல்லிய தோள்களில் துயிலும் துயில் போல் இனிமை உடையதோ.

translation:
Withdraw, it burns; approach, it soothes the pain; Whence did the maid this wondrous fire obtain

Meaning: From whence has she got this fire that burns when I withdraw and cools when I approach ?
pope_couplet: Withdraw, it burns; approach, it soothes the pain; Whence did the maid this wondrous fire obtain
explanation_en: From whence has she got this fire that burns when I withdraw and cools when I approach ?
explanation_ta: நீங்கினால் சுடுகின்றது, அணுகினால் குளிர்ச்சியாக இருக்கின்றது, இத்தகைய புதுமையானத் தீயை இவள் எவ்விடத்திலிருந்து பெற்றாள்.

translation:
In her embrace, whose locks with flowery wreaths are bound, Each varied form of joy the soul can wish is found

Meaning: Each varied form of joy the soul can wish is found
pope_couplet: In her embrace, whose locks with flowery wreaths are bound, Each varied form of joy the soul can wish is found
explanation_en: Each varied form of joy the soul can wish is found
explanation_ta: மலரணிந்த கூந்தலை உடைய இவளுடைய தோள்கள் விருப்பமான பொருள்களை நினைத்து விரும்பிய பொழுது அவ்வப் பொருள்களைப் போலவே இன்பம் செய்கின்றன.

translation:
Ambrosia are the simple maiden's arms; when I attainTheir touch, my withered life puts forth its buds again

Meaning: The shoulders of this fair one are made of ambrosia, for they revive me with pleasure every time I embrace them
pope_couplet: Ambrosia are the simple maiden's arms; when I attainTheir touch, my withered life puts forth its buds again
explanation_en: The shoulders of this fair one are made of ambrosia, for they revive me with pleasure every time I embrace them
explanation_ta: பொருந்து போதெல்லாம் உயிர் தளிர்க்கும் படியாகத் தீண்டுதலால் இவளுக்கு தோள்கள் அமிழ்தத்தால் செய்யப்பட்டிருக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
As when one eats from household store, with kindly graceSharing his meal: such is this golden maid's embrace

Meaning: The embraces of a gold-complexioned beautiful female are as pleasant as to dwell in one's own house and live by one's own (earnings) after distributing (a portion of it in charity)
pope_couplet: As when one eats from household store, with kindly graceSharing his meal: such is this golden maid's embrace
explanation_en: The embraces of a gold-complexioned beautiful female are as pleasant as to dwell in one's own house and live by one's own (earnings) after distributing (a portion of it in charity)
explanation_ta: அழகிய மா நிறம் உடைய இவளுடைய தழுவுதல், தம்முடைய வீட்டிலிருந்து தாம் ஈட்டிய பொருளைப் பகுந்து கொடுத்து உண்டாற் போன்றது.

translation:
Sweet is the strict embrace of those whom fond affection binds, Where no dissevering breath of discord entrance finds

Meaning: To ardent lovers sweet is the embrace that cannot be penetrated even by a breath of breeze
pope_couplet: Sweet is the strict embrace of those whom fond affection binds, Where no dissevering breath of discord entrance finds
explanation_en: To ardent lovers sweet is the embrace that cannot be penetrated even by a breath of breeze
explanation_ta: காற்று இடையறுத்துச் செல்லாதபடி தழுவும் தழுவுதல், ஒருவரை ஒருவர் விரும்பிய காதலர் இருவருக்கும் இனிமை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
The jealous variance, the healing of the strife, reunion gained:These are the fruits from wedded love obtained

Meaning: Love quarrel, reconciliation and intercourse - these are the advantages reaped by those who marry for lust
pope_couplet: The jealous variance, the healing of the strife, reunion gained:These are the fruits from wedded love obtained
explanation_en: Love quarrel, reconciliation and intercourse - these are the advantages reaped by those who marry for lust
explanation_ta: ஊடுதல், ஊடலை உணர்ந்து விடுதல், அதன்பின் கூடுதல் ஆகிய இவை காதல் வாழ்வு நிறைவேறப் பெற்றவர் பெற்ற பயன்களாகும்.

translation:
The more men learn, the more their lack of learning they detect;'Tis so when I approach the maid with gleaming jewels decked

Meaning: As (one's) ignorance is discovered the more one learns, so does repeated intercourse with a welladorned female (only create a desire for more)
pope_couplet: The more men learn, the more their lack of learning they detect;'Tis so when I approach the maid with gleaming jewels decked
explanation_en: As (one's) ignorance is discovered the more one learns, so does repeated intercourse with a welladorned female (only create a desire for more)
explanation_ta: செந்நிற அணிகலன்களை அணிந்த இவளிடம் பொருந்துந்தோறும் காதல் உணர்தல்,நூற் பொருள்களை அறிய அறிய அறியாதமைக் கண்டாற் போன்றது.

translation:
O flower of the sensitive plant! than theeMore tender's the maiden beloved by me

Meaning: May you flourish, O Anicham! you have a delicate nature But my beloved is more delicate than you
pope_couplet: O flower of the sensitive plant! than theeMore tender's the maiden beloved by me
explanation_en: May you flourish, O Anicham! you have a delicate nature But my beloved is more delicate than you
explanation_ta: அனிச்சப்பூவே நல்ல மென்மை தன்மை பெற்றிறுக்கின்றாய், நீ வாழ்க, யாம் விரும்பும் காதலி உன்னை விட மெல்லியத் தன்மை கொண்டவள்.

translation:
You deemed, as you saw the flowers, her eyes were as flowers, my soul, That many may see; it was surely some folly that over you stole

Meaning: O my soul, fancying that flowers which are seen by many can resemble her eyes, you become confused at the sight of them
pope_couplet: You deemed, as you saw the flowers, her eyes were as flowers, my soul, That many may see; it was surely some folly that over you stole
explanation_en: O my soul, fancying that flowers which are seen by many can resemble her eyes, you become confused at the sight of them
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சமே! இவளுடைய கண்கள் பலரும் காண்கின்ற மலர்களை ஒத்திருக்கின்றன, என்று நினைத்து ஒத்த மலர்களைக் கண்டால் நீ மயங்குகின்றாய்.

translation:
As tender shoot her frame; teeth, pearls; around her odours blend; Darts are the eyes of her whose shoulders like the bambu bend

Meaning: The complexion of this bamboo-shouldered one is that of a shoot; her teeth, are pearls; her breath,
pope_couplet: As tender shoot her frame; teeth, pearls; around her odours blend; Darts are the eyes of her whose shoulders like the bambu bend
explanation_en: The complexion of this bamboo-shouldered one is that of a shoot; her teeth, are pearls; her breath,
explanation_ta: மூங்கில் போன்ற தோளை உடைய இவளுக்குத் தளிரே மேன், முத்தே பல், இயற்கை மணமே மணம், வேலே மை உண்ட கண்.

translation:
The lotus, seeing her, with head demiss, the ground would eye, And say, 'With eyes of her, rich gems who wears, we cannot vie.'

Meaning: If the blue lotus could see, it would stoop and look at the ground saying, "I can never resemble the eyes of this excellent jewelled one."
pope_couplet: The lotus, seeing her, with head demiss, the ground would eye, And say, 'With eyes of her, rich gems who wears, we cannot vie.'
explanation_en: If the blue lotus could see, it would stoop and look at the ground saying, "I can never resemble the eyes of this excellent jewelled one."
explanation_ta: குவளை மலர்கள் காணும் தன்மைப் பெற்றுக் கண்டால், இவளுடைய கண்களுக்கு தாம் ஒப்பாக வில்லையே என்று தலை கவிழ்ந்து நிலத்தை நோக்கும்.

translation:
The flowers of the sensitive plant as a girdle around her she placed; The stems she forgot to nip off; they 'll weigh down the delicate waist

Meaning: No merry drums will be beaten for the (tender) waist of her who has adorned herself with the anicham without having removed its stem
pope_couplet: The flowers of the sensitive plant as a girdle around her she placed; The stems she forgot to nip off; they 'll weigh down the delicate waist
explanation_en: No merry drums will be beaten for the (tender) waist of her who has adorned herself with the anicham without having removed its stem
explanation_ta: அவள் தன் மென்மை அறியாமல் அனிச்ச மலர்களைக் காம்பு களையாமல் சூடினால், அவற்றால் நொந்து வருத்தும் அவளுடைய இடைக்குப் பறைகள் நல்லனவாய் ஒலியா.

translation:
The stars perplexed are rushing wildly from their spheres; For like another moon this maiden's face appears

Meaning: The stars have become confused in their places not being able to distinguish between the moon and the maid's countenance
pope_couplet: The stars perplexed are rushing wildly from their spheres; For like another moon this maiden's face appears
explanation_en: The stars have become confused in their places not being able to distinguish between the moon and the maid's countenance
explanation_ta: விண்மீன்கள் திங்களையும் இவளுடைய முகத்தையும் வேறுபாடு கண்டு அறியமுடியாமல் தம் நிலையில் நிற்காமல் கலங்கித் திரிகின்றன.

translation:
In moon, that waxing waning shines, as sports appear, Are any spots discerned in face of maiden here

Meaning: Could there be spots in the face of this maid like those in the bright full moon ?
pope_couplet: In moon, that waxing waning shines, as sports appear, Are any spots discerned in face of maiden here
explanation_en: Could there be spots in the face of this maid like those in the bright full moon ?
explanation_ta: குறைந்த இடமெல்லாம் படிப்படியாக நிறைந்து விளங்குகின்ற திங்களிடம் உள்ளது போல் இந்த மாதர் முகத்தில் களங்கம் உண்டோ.இல்லையே.

translation:
Farewell, O moon! If that thine orb could shineBright as her face, thou shouldst be love of mine

Meaning: If you can indeed shine like the face of women, flourish, O moon, for then would you be worth loving ?
pope_couplet: Farewell, O moon! If that thine orb could shineBright as her face, thou shouldst be love of mine
explanation_en: If you can indeed shine like the face of women, flourish, O moon, for then would you be worth loving ?
explanation_ta: திங்களே! இம் மாதரின் முகத்தைப் போல உண்ணால் ஒளி வீச முடியுமானால், நீயும் இவள் போல் என் காதலுக்கு உரிமை பெறுவாய்.

translation:
If as her face, whose eyes are flowers, thou wouldst have charms for me, Shine for my eyes alone, O moon, shine not for all to see

Meaning: O moon, if you wish to resemble the face of her whose eyes are like (these) flowers, do not appear so as to be seen by all
pope_couplet: If as her face, whose eyes are flowers, thou wouldst have charms for me, Shine for my eyes alone, O moon, shine not for all to see
explanation_en: O moon, if you wish to resemble the face of her whose eyes are like (these) flowers, do not appear so as to be seen by all
explanation_ta: திங்களே! மலர்போன்ற கண்களை உடைய இவளுடைய முகத்தை ஒத்திருக்க விரும்பினால், நீ பலரும் காணும்படியாகத் தோன்றாதே.

translation:
The flower of the sensitive plant, and the down on the swan's white breast, As the thorn are harsh, by the delicate feet of this maiden pressed

Meaning: The anicham and the feathers of the swan are to the feet of females, like the fruit of the (thorny) Nerunji
pope_couplet: The flower of the sensitive plant, and the down on the swan's white breast, As the thorn are harsh, by the delicate feet of this maiden pressed
explanation_en: The anicham and the feathers of the swan are to the feet of females, like the fruit of the (thorny) Nerunji
explanation_ta: அனிச்ச மலரும், அன்னப்பறவையின் இறகும் ஆகிய இவைகள் மாதரின் மெல்லிய அடிகளுக்கு நெருஞ்சிமுள் போன்றவை.

translation:
The dew on her white teeth, whose voice is soft and low, Is as when milk and honey mingled flow

Meaning: The water which oozes from the white teeth of this soft speeched damsel is like a mixture of milk and honey
pope_couplet: The dew on her white teeth, whose voice is soft and low, Is as when milk and honey mingled flow
explanation_en: The water which oozes from the white teeth of this soft speeched damsel is like a mixture of milk and honey
explanation_ta: மென்மையான மொழிகளைப் பேசு கின்ற இவளுடைய தூய பற்களில் ஊறிய நீர் பாலுடன் தேனைக் கலந்தாற் போன்றதாகும்.

translation:
Between this maid and me the friendship kindIs as the bonds that soul and body bind

Meaning: The love between me and this damsel is like the union of body and soul
pope_couplet: Between this maid and me the friendship kindIs as the bonds that soul and body bind
explanation_en: The love between me and this damsel is like the union of body and soul
explanation_ta: இம் மடந்தையோடு எம்மிடையே உள்ள நட்பு முறைகள், உடம்போடு உயிர்க்கு உள்ள தொடர்புகள், எத்தன்மையானவையோ அத்தன்மையானவை.

translation:
For her with beauteous brow, the maid I love, there place is none; To give her image room, O pupil of mine eye, begone

Meaning: O you image in the pupil (of my eye)! depart; there is no room for (my) fair-browed beloved
pope_couplet: For her with beauteous brow, the maid I love, there place is none; To give her image room, O pupil of mine eye, begone
explanation_en: O you image in the pupil (of my eye)! depart; there is no room for (my) fair-browed beloved
explanation_ta: என் கண்ணின் கருமணியில் உள்ள பாவையே நீ போய் விடு, யாம் விரும்புகின்ற இவளுக்கு என் கண்ணில் இருக்க இடம் இல்லையே.

translation:
Life is she to my very soul when she draws nigh; Dissevered from the maid with jewels rare, I die

Meaning: My fair-jewelled one resembles the living soul (when she is in union with me), the dying soul when she leaves me
pope_couplet: Life is she to my very soul when she draws nigh; Dissevered from the maid with jewels rare, I die
explanation_en: My fair-jewelled one resembles the living soul (when she is in union with me), the dying soul when she leaves me
explanation_ta: ஆராய்ந்து அணிகலன்களை அணிந்த இவள் கூடும் போது உயிர்க்கு வாழ்வு போன்றவள், பிரியும் போது உயிர்க்கு சாவு போன்றவள்.

translation:
I might recall, if I could once forget; but from my heartHer charms fade not, whose eyes gleam like the warrior's dart

Meaning: If I had forgotten her who has bright battling eyes, I would have remembered (thee); but I never forget her (Thus says he to her maid)
pope_couplet: I might recall, if I could once forget; but from my heartHer charms fade not, whose eyes gleam like the warrior's dart
explanation_en: If I had forgotten her who has bright battling eyes, I would have remembered (thee); but I never forget her (Thus says he to her maid)
explanation_ta: போர் செய்யும் பண்புகளை உடைய இவளுடைய பண்புகளை யான் மறந்தால் பிறகு நினைக்க முடியும் ஆனால் ஒரு போதும் மறந்ததில்லையே.

translation:
My loved one's subtle form departs not from my eyes; I wink them not, lest I should pain him where he lies

Meaning: My lover would not depart from mine eyes; even if I wink, he would not suffer (from pain); he is so ethereal
pope_couplet: My loved one's subtle form departs not from my eyes; I wink them not, lest I should pain him where he lies
explanation_en: My lover would not depart from mine eyes; even if I wink, he would not suffer (from pain); he is so ethereal
explanation_ta: எம் காதலர் எம் கண்ணுள்ளிருந்து போக மாட்டார், கண்ணை மூடி இமைத்தாலும் அதனால் வருந்த மாட்டார், அவர் அவ்வளவு நுட்பமானவர்.

translation:
My love doth ever in my eyes reside; I stain them not, fearing his form to hide

Meaning: As my lover abides in my eyes, I will not even paint them, for he would (then) have to conceal himself
pope_couplet: My love doth ever in my eyes reside; I stain them not, fearing his form to hide
explanation_en: As my lover abides in my eyes, I will not even paint them, for he would (then) have to conceal himself
explanation_ta: எம் காதலர் கண்ணினுள் இருக்கின்றார், ஆகையால் மை எழுதினால் அவர் மறைவதை எண்ணிக் கண்ணுக்கு மையும் எழுதமாட்டோம்.

translation:
Within my heart my lover dwells; from food I turnThat smacks of heat, lest he should feel it burn

Meaning: As my lover is in my heart, I am afraid of eating (anything) hot, for I know it would pain him
pope_couplet: Within my heart my lover dwells; from food I turnThat smacks of heat, lest he should feel it burn
explanation_en: As my lover is in my heart, I am afraid of eating (anything) hot, for I know it would pain him
explanation_ta: எம் காதலர் நெஞ்சினுள் இருக்கின்றார், ஆகையால் சூடான பொருளை உண்டால் அவர் வெப்பமுறுதலை எண்ணிச் சூடான பொருளை உண்ண அஞ்சு கின்றோம்.

translation:
I fear his form to hide, nor close my eyes:'Her love estranged is gone!' the village cries

Meaning: I will not wink, knowing that if I did, my lover would hide himself; and for this reason, this town says, he is unloving
pope_couplet: I fear his form to hide, nor close my eyes:'Her love estranged is gone!' the village cries
explanation_en: I will not wink, knowing that if I did, my lover would hide himself; and for this reason, this town says, he is unloving
explanation_ta: கண் இமைத்தால் காதலர் மறைந்து போதலை அறிகின்றேன், அவ்வளவிற்கே இந்த ஊரார் அவரை அன்பில்லாதவர் என்று சொல்லுவர்.

translation:
Rejoicing in my very soul he ever lies;'Her love estranged is gone far off!' the village cries

Meaning: My lover dwells in my heart with perpetual delight; but the town says he is unloving and (therefore) dwells afar
pope_couplet: Rejoicing in my very soul he ever lies;'Her love estranged is gone far off!' the village cries
explanation_en: My lover dwells in my heart with perpetual delight; but the town says he is unloving and (therefore) dwells afar
explanation_ta: காதலர் எப்போதும் என் உள்ளத்தில் மகிழ்ந்து வாழ்கின்றார், ஆனால் அதை அறியாமல் பிரிந்து வாழ்கின்றார், அன்பில்லாதவர் என்று இந்த ஊரார் அவரைப் பழிப்பர்.

translation:
To those who 've proved love's joy, and now afflicted mourn, Except the helpful 'horse of palm', no other strength remains

Meaning: To those who after enjoyment of sexual pleasure suffer (for want of more), there is no help so efficient as the palmyra horse
pope_couplet: To those who 've proved love's joy, and now afflicted mourn, Except the helpful 'horse of palm', no other strength remains
explanation_en: To those who after enjoyment of sexual pleasure suffer (for want of more), there is no help so efficient as the palmyra horse
explanation_ta: காமத்தால் துன்புற்று (காதலின் அன்பு பெறாமல்) வருந்தினவர்க்குக் காவல் மடலூர்தல் அல்லாமல் வலிமையானத் துணை வேறொன்றும் இல்லை.

translation:
My body and my soul, that can no more endure, Will lay reserve aside, and mount the 'horse of palm'

Meaning: Having got rid of shame, the suffering body and soul save themselves on the palmyra horse
pope_couplet: My body and my soul, that can no more endure, Will lay reserve aside, and mount the 'horse of palm'
explanation_en: Having got rid of shame, the suffering body and soul save themselves on the palmyra horse
explanation_ta: (காதலின் பிரிவால் ஆகிய துன்பத்தைப்) பொறுக்காத என் உடம்பும் உயிரும், நாணத்தை நீக்கி நிறுத்தி விட்டு மடலூரத் துணிந்தன.

translation:
I once retained reserve and seemly manliness; To-day I nought possess but lovers' 'horse of palm'

Meaning: Modesty and manliness were once my own; now, my own is the palmyra horse that is ridden by the lustful
pope_couplet: I once retained reserve and seemly manliness; To-day I nought possess but lovers' 'horse of palm'
explanation_en: Modesty and manliness were once my own; now, my own is the palmyra horse that is ridden by the lustful
explanation_ta: நாணமும் நல்ல ஆண்மையும் முன்பு பெற்றிருந்தேன், (காதலியை பிரிந்து வருந்துகின்ற) இப்போது காமம் மிக்கவர் ஏறும் மடலையே உடையேன்.

translation:
Love's rushing tide will sweep away the raftOf seemly manliness and shame combined

Meaning: The raft of modesty and manliness, is, alas, carried-off by the strong current of lust
pope_couplet: Love's rushing tide will sweep away the raftOf seemly manliness and shame combined
explanation_en: The raft of modesty and manliness, is, alas, carried-off by the strong current of lust
explanation_ta: நாணமும் நல்ல ஆண்மையுமாகிய தோணிகளைக் காமம் என்னும் கடுமையான வெள்ளம் அடித்துக் கொண்டு போய் விடுகின்றன.

translation:
The maid that slender armlets wears, like flowers entwined, Has brought me 'horse of palm,' and pangs of eventide

Meaning: She with the small garland-like bracelets has given me the palmyra horse and the sorrow that is endured at night
pope_couplet: The maid that slender armlets wears, like flowers entwined, Has brought me 'horse of palm,' and pangs of eventide
explanation_en: She with the small garland-like bracelets has given me the palmyra horse and the sorrow that is endured at night
explanation_ta: மடலோறுதலோடு மாலைக்காலத்தில் வருந்தும் துயரத்தை மாலைபோல் தொடர்ந்த சிறு வளையல் அணிந்த காதலி எனக்கு தந்தாள்.

translation:
Of climbing 'horse of palm' in midnight hour, I think; My eyes know no repose for that same simple maid

Meaning: Mine eyes will not close in sleep on your mistress's account; even at midnight will I think of mounting the palmyra horse
pope_couplet: Of climbing 'horse of palm' in midnight hour, I think; My eyes know no repose for that same simple maid
explanation_en: Mine eyes will not close in sleep on your mistress's account; even at midnight will I think of mounting the palmyra horse
explanation_ta: மடலூர்தலைப் பற்றி நள்ளிரவிலும் உறுதியாக நினைக்கின்றேன், காதலியின் பிரிவின் காரணமாக என் கண்கள் உறங்காமல் இருக்கின்றன.

translation:
There's nought of greater worth than woman's long-enduring soul, Who, vexed by love like ocean waves, climbs not the 'horse of palm'

Meaning: There is nothing so noble as the womanly nature that would not ride the palmyra horse, though plunged a sea of lust
pope_couplet: There's nought of greater worth than woman's long-enduring soul, Who, vexed by love like ocean waves, climbs not the 'horse of palm'
explanation_en: There is nothing so noble as the womanly nature that would not ride the palmyra horse, though plunged a sea of lust
explanation_ta: கடல் போன்ற காமநோயால் வருந்தியும், மடலேறாமல் துன்பத்தை பொருத்துக் கொண்டிருக்கும் பெண் பிறப்பை போல் பெருமை உடைய பிறவி இல்லை.

translation:
In virtue hard to move, yet very tender, too, are we; Love deems not so, would rend the veil, and court publicity

Meaning: Even the Lust (of women) transgresses its secrecy and appears in public, forgetting that they are too chaste and liberal (to be overcome by it)
pope_couplet: In virtue hard to move, yet very tender, too, are we; Love deems not so, would rend the veil, and court publicity
explanation_en: Even the Lust (of women) transgresses its secrecy and appears in public, forgetting that they are too chaste and liberal (to be overcome by it)
explanation_ta: இவர் நெஞ்சை நிறுத்தும் நிறை இல்லாதவர், மிகவும் இரங்கத்தக்கவர் என்று கருதாமல் காமம் மறைந்திருத்தலைக் கடந்து மன்றத்திலும் வெளிப்படுகின்றதே.

translation:
'There's no one knows my heart,' so says my love, And thus, in public ways, perturbed will rove

Meaning: And thus, in public ways, perturbed will rove
pope_couplet: 'There's no one knows my heart,' so says my love, And thus, in public ways, perturbed will rove
explanation_en: And thus, in public ways, perturbed will rove
explanation_ta: அமைதியாய் இருந்ததால் எல்லோரும் அறியவில்லை என்று கருதி என்னுடைய காமம் தெருவில் பரவி மயங்கிச் சுழல்கின்றது.

translation:
Before my eyes the foolish make a mock of me, Because they ne'er endured the pangs I now must drie

Meaning: Even strangers laugh (at us) so as to be seen by us, for they have not suffered
pope_couplet: Before my eyes the foolish make a mock of me, Because they ne'er endured the pangs I now must drie
explanation_en: Even strangers laugh (at us) so as to be seen by us, for they have not suffered
explanation_ta: யாம் பட்ட துன்பங்களைத் தாம் படாமையால் அறிவில்லாதவர் யாம் கண்ணால் காணுமாறு எம் எதிரில் எம்மைக்கண்டு நகைக்கின்றனர்.

translation:
