By this same rumour's rise, my precious life stands fast; Good fortune grant the many know this not

Meaning: My precious life is saved by the raise of rumour, and this, to my good luck no others are aware of
pope_couplet: By this same rumour's rise, my precious life stands fast; Good fortune grant the many know this not
explanation_en: My precious life is saved by the raise of rumour, and this, to my good luck no others are aware of
explanation_ta: (எம் காதலைப் பற்றி) அலர் எழுவதால் அறிய உயிர் போகாமல் நிற்கின்றது, எம் நல்வினைப் பயனால் பலரும் அறியாமலிருக்கின்றனர்.

translation:
The village hath to us this rumour giv'n, that makes her mine; Unweeting all the rareness of the maid with flower-like eyne

Meaning: Not knowing the value of her whose eyes are like flowers this town has got up a rumour about me
pope_couplet: The village hath to us this rumour giv'n, that makes her mine; Unweeting all the rareness of the maid with flower-like eyne
explanation_en: Not knowing the value of her whose eyes are like flowers this town has got up a rumour about me
explanation_ta: மலர் போன்ற கண்ணை உடைய இவளுடைய அருமை அறியாமல், இந்த ஊரார் எளியவளாகக் கருதி அலர் கூறி எமக்கு உதவி செய்தனர்.

translation:
The rumour spread within the town, is it not gain to me?It is as though that were obtained that may not be

Meaning: Will I not get a rumour that is known to the (whole) town ? For what I have not got is as if I had got it (already)
pope_couplet: The rumour spread within the town, is it not gain to me?It is as though that were obtained that may not be
explanation_en: Will I not get a rumour that is known to the (whole) town ? For what I have not got is as if I had got it (already)
explanation_ta: ஊரார் எல்லோரும் அறிந்துள்ள அலர் நமக்குப் பொருந்தாதோ, (பொருந்தும்) அந்த அலர் பெறமுடியாமலிருந்து பெற்றார் போன்ற நன்மை உடையதாக இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
The rumour rising makes my love to rise; My love would lose its power and languish otherwise

Meaning: Rumour increases the violence of my passion; without it it would grow weak and waste away
pope_couplet: The rumour rising makes my love to rise; My love would lose its power and languish otherwise
explanation_en: Rumour increases the violence of my passion; without it it would grow weak and waste away
explanation_ta: எம் காமம் ஊரார் சொல்லுகின்ற அலரால் வளர்வதாயிற்று, அந்த அலர் இல்லையானால் அது தன் தன்மை இழந்து சுருங்கிப் போய்விடும்.

translation:
The more man drinks, the more he ever drunk would be; The more my love's revealed, the sweeter 'tis to me

Meaning: As drinking liquor is delightful (to one) whenever one is in mirth, so is lust delightful to me whenever it is the subject of rumour
pope_couplet: The more man drinks, the more he ever drunk would be; The more my love's revealed, the sweeter 'tis to me
explanation_en: As drinking liquor is delightful (to one) whenever one is in mirth, so is lust delightful to me whenever it is the subject of rumour
explanation_ta: காமம் அலரால் வெளிப்பட இனியதாதல், கள்ளுண்பவர் கள்ளுண்டு மயங்க மயங்க அக் கள்ளுண்பதையே விரும்பினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
I saw him but one single day: rumour spreads soonAs darkness, when the dragon seizes on the moon

Meaning: It was but a single day that I looked on (my lover); but the rumour thereof has spread like the seizure of the moon by the serpent
pope_couplet: I saw him but one single day: rumour spreads soonAs darkness, when the dragon seizes on the moon
explanation_en: It was but a single day that I looked on (my lover); but the rumour thereof has spread like the seizure of the moon by the serpent
explanation_ta: காதலரைக் கண்டது ஒருநாள் தான், அதனால் உண்டாகிய அலரோ, திங்களைப் பாம்பு கொண்ட செய்தி போல் எங்கும் பரந்து விட்டது.

translation:
My anguish grows apace: the town's reportManures it; my mother's word doth water it

Meaning: This malady (of lust) is manured by the talk of women and watered by the (harsh) words of my mother
pope_couplet: My anguish grows apace: the town's reportManures it; my mother's word doth water it
explanation_en: This malady (of lust) is manured by the talk of women and watered by the (harsh) words of my mother
explanation_ta: இந்தக் காம நோய் ஊராரின் அலர் தூற்றலே எருவாகவும் அன்னை கடிந்து சொல்லும் கடுஞ்சொல்லே நீராகவும் கொண்டு செழித்து வளர்கின்றது.

translation:
With butter-oil extinguish fire! 'Twill proveHarder by scandal to extinguish love

Meaning: To say that one could extinguish passion by rumour is like extinguishing fire with ghee
pope_couplet: With butter-oil extinguish fire! 'Twill proveHarder by scandal to extinguish love
explanation_en: To say that one could extinguish passion by rumour is like extinguishing fire with ghee
explanation_ta: அலர் கூறுவதால் காமத்தை அடக்குவோம் என்று முயலுதல், நெய்யால் நெருப்பை அவிப்போம் என்று முயல்வதைப் போன்றது.

translation:
When he who said 'Fear not!' hath left me blamed, While many shrink, can I from rumour hide ashamed

Meaning: When the departure of him who said "fear not" has put me to shame before others, why need I be ashamed of scandal
pope_couplet: When he who said 'Fear not!' hath left me blamed, While many shrink, can I from rumour hide ashamed
explanation_en: When the departure of him who said "fear not" has put me to shame before others, why need I be ashamed of scandal
explanation_ta: அஞ்ச வேண்டா என்று அன்று உறுதிகூறியவர், இன்று பலரும் நாணும்படியாக நம்மை விட்டுப் பிரிந்தால் அதனால் அலருக்கு நாணியிருக்க முடியுமோ.

translation:
If we desire, who loves will grant what we require; This town sends forth the rumour we desire

Meaning: The rumour I desire is raised by the town (itself); and my lover would if desired consent (to my following him)
pope_couplet: If we desire, who loves will grant what we require; This town sends forth the rumour we desire
explanation_en: The rumour I desire is raised by the town (itself); and my lover would if desired consent (to my following him)
explanation_ta: யாம் விரும்புகின்ற அலரை இவ்வூரார் எடுத்துக்கூறுகின்றனர், அதனால் இனிமேல் காதலர் விரும்பினால் விரும்பியவாறு அதனை உதவுவார்.

translation:
If you will say, 'I leave thee not,' then tell me so; Of quick return tell those that can survive this woe

Meaning: If it is not departure, tell me; but if it is your speedy return, tell it to those who would be alive then
pope_couplet: If you will say, 'I leave thee not,' then tell me so; Of quick return tell those that can survive this woe
explanation_en: If it is not departure, tell me; but if it is your speedy return, tell it to those who would be alive then
explanation_ta: பிரிந்து செல்லாத நிலைமை இருந்தால் எனக்குச் சொல், பிரிந்து சென்று விரைந்து வருதலைப் பற்றியானால் அதுவரையில் உயிர்வாழ வல்லவர்க்குச் சொல்.

translation:
It once was perfect joy to look upon his face; But now the fear of parting saddens each embrace

Meaning: His very look was once pleasing; but (now) even intercourse is painful through fear of separation
pope_couplet: It once was perfect joy to look upon his face; But now the fear of parting saddens each embrace
explanation_en: His very look was once pleasing; but (now) even intercourse is painful through fear of separation
explanation_ta: அவருடைய பார்வை முன்பு இன்பம் உடையதாக இருந்தது, இப்போது அவருடைய கூட்டம் பிரிவுக்கு அஞ்சுகின்ற துன்பம் உடையதாக இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
To trust henceforth is hard, if ever he depart, E'en he, who knows his promise and my breaking heart

Meaning: As even the lover who understands (everything) may at times depart, confidence is hardly possible
pope_couplet: To trust henceforth is hard, if ever he depart, E'en he, who knows his promise and my breaking heart
explanation_en: As even the lover who understands (everything) may at times depart, confidence is hardly possible
explanation_ta: அறிவுடைய காதலரிடத்தும் பிரிவு ஒரு காலத்தில் உள்ள படியால் அவர் பிரியேன் என்று சொல்லும் உறுதி மொழியை நம்பித் தெளிவது அரிது.

translation:
If he depart, who fondly said, 'Fear not,' what blame's incurredBy those who trusted to his reassuring word

Meaning: If he who bestowed his love and said "fear not" should depart, will it be the fault of those who believed in (his) assuring words ?
pope_couplet: If he depart, who fondly said, 'Fear not,' what blame's incurredBy those who trusted to his reassuring word
explanation_en: If he who bestowed his love and said "fear not" should depart, will it be the fault of those who believed in (his) assuring words ?
explanation_ta: அருள் மிகுந்தவராய் அஞ்ச வேண்டா என்று முன் தேற்றியவர் பிரிந்து செல்வாரானால் அவர் கூறிய உறுதிமொழியை நம்பித் தெளிந்தவர்க்கு குற்றம் உண்டோ.

translation:
If you would guard my life, from going him restrainWho fills my life! If he depart, hardly we meet again

Meaning: If you would save (my life), delay the departure of my destined (husband); for if he departs, intercourse will become impossible
pope_couplet: If you would guard my life, from going him restrainWho fills my life! If he depart, hardly we meet again
explanation_en: If you would save (my life), delay the departure of my destined (husband); for if he departs, intercourse will become impossible
explanation_ta: காத்துக் கொள்வதானால் காதலராக அமைந்தவரின் பிரிவு நேராமல் காக்க வேண்டும், அவர் பிரிந்து நீங்கினால் மீண்டும் கூடுதல் அரிது.

translation:
To cherish longing hope that he should ever gracious be, Is hard, when he could stand, and of departure speak to me

Meaning: Is hard, when he could stand, and of departure speak to me
pope_couplet: To cherish longing hope that he should ever gracious be, Is hard, when he could stand, and of departure speak to me
explanation_en: Is hard, when he could stand, and of departure speak to me
explanation_ta: பிரிவைப்பற்றி தெரிவிக்கும் அளவிற்குக் கல் நெஞ்சம் உடையவரானால் , அத்தகையவர் திரும்பிவந்து அன்பு செய்வார் என்னும் ஆசை பயனற்றது.

translation:
The bracelet slipping from my wrist announced beforeDeparture of the Prince that rules the ocean shore

Meaning: Do not the rings that begin to slide down my fingers forebode the separation of my lord ?
pope_couplet: The bracelet slipping from my wrist announced beforeDeparture of the Prince that rules the ocean shore
explanation_en: Do not the rings that begin to slide down my fingers forebode the separation of my lord ?
explanation_ta: என் மெலிவால் முன் கையில் இறை கடந்து கழலும் வளையல்கள், தலைவன் விட்டுப் பிரிந்த செய்தியைப் பலரறியத் தெரிவித்துத் தூற்றாமலிருக்குமோ.

translation:
'Tis sad to sojourn in the town where no kind kinsmen dwell;'Tis sadder still to bid a friend beloved farewell

Meaning: Painful is it to live in a friendless town; but far more painful is it to part from one's lover
pope_couplet: 'Tis sad to sojourn in the town where no kind kinsmen dwell;'Tis sadder still to bid a friend beloved farewell
explanation_en: Painful is it to live in a friendless town; but far more painful is it to part from one's lover
explanation_ta: இனத்தவராக நம்மேல் அன்புடையார் இல்லாத ஊரில் வாழ்தல் துன்பமானது, இனியக் காதலரின் பிரிவு அதை விடத் துன்பமானது.

translation:
Fire burns the hands that touch; but smart of loveWill burn in hearts that far away remove

Meaning: Fire burns when touched; but, like the sickness of love, can it also burn when removed ?
pope_couplet: Fire burns the hands that touch; but smart of loveWill burn in hearts that far away remove
explanation_en: Fire burns when touched; but, like the sickness of love, can it also burn when removed ?
explanation_ta: நெருப்பு, தன்னைத் தொட்டால் சுடுமே அல்லாமல் காமநோய் போல் தன்னை விட்டு நீங்கிய பொழுது சுடவல்லதாகுமோ.

translation:
Sorrow's sadness meek sustaining, Driving sore distress away, Separation uncomplaining Many bear the livelong day

Meaning: As if there were many indeed that can consent to the impossible, kill their pain, endure separation and yet continue to live afterwards
pope_couplet: Sorrow's sadness meek sustaining, Driving sore distress away, Separation uncomplaining Many bear the livelong day
explanation_en: As if there were many indeed that can consent to the impossible, kill their pain, endure separation and yet continue to live afterwards
explanation_ta: பிரிய முடியாத பிரிவிற்கு உடன்பட்டு,( பிரியும் போது) துன்பத்தால் கலங்குவதையும், விட்டு பிரிந்த பின் பொருத்திருந்து பின்னும் உயிரோடிருந்து வாழ்வோர் உலகில் பலர்.

translation:
I would my pain conceal, but see! it surging swells, As streams to those that draw from ever-springing wells

Meaning: I would hide this pain from others; but it (only) swells like a spring to those who drain it
pope_couplet: I would my pain conceal, but see! it surging swells, As streams to those that draw from ever-springing wells
explanation_en: I would hide this pain from others; but it (only) swells like a spring to those who drain it
explanation_ta: இக் காமநோயைப் பிறர் அறியாமல் யான் மறைப்பேன், ஆனால் இது இறைப்பவர்க்கு ஊற்று நீர் மிகுவது போல் மிகுகின்றது.

translation:
I cannot hide this pain of mine, yet shame restrainsWhen I would tell it out to him who caused my pains

Meaning: I cannot conceal this pain, nor can I relate it without shame to him who has caused it
pope_couplet: I cannot hide this pain of mine, yet shame restrainsWhen I would tell it out to him who caused my pains
explanation_en: I cannot conceal this pain, nor can I relate it without shame to him who has caused it
explanation_ta: இக் காமநோயைப் பிறர் அறியாமல் முற்றிலும் மறைக்கவும் முடியவில்லை, நோய் செய்த காதலர்க்குச் சொல்வதும் நாணம் தருகின்றது.

translation:
My soul, like porter's pole, within my wearied frame, Sustains a two-fold burthen poised, of love and shame

Meaning: (Both) lust and shame, with my soul for their shoulder pole balance themselves on a body that cannot bear them
pope_couplet: My soul, like porter's pole, within my wearied frame, Sustains a two-fold burthen poised, of love and shame
explanation_en: (Both) lust and shame, with my soul for their shoulder pole balance themselves on a body that cannot bear them
explanation_ta: துன்பத்தைப் பொருக்காமல் வருந்துகின்ற என் உடம்பினிடத்தில் உயிரே காவடித்தண்டாகக் கொண்டு காமநோயும் நாணமும் இருப்பக்கமாக தொங்குகின்றன.

translation:
A sea of love, 'tis true, I see stretched out before, But not the trusty bark that wafts to yonder shore

Meaning: There is indeed a flood of lust; but there is no raft of safety to cross it with
pope_couplet: A sea of love, 'tis true, I see stretched out before, But not the trusty bark that wafts to yonder shore
explanation_en: There is indeed a flood of lust; but there is no raft of safety to cross it with
explanation_ta: காமநோயாகிய கடல் இருக்கின்றது. ஆனால் அதை நீந்திக்கடந்து செல்வதற்கு வேண்டிய காவலான ‌தோணியோ இல்லை.

translation:
Who work us woe in friendship's trustful hour, What will they prove when angry tempests lower

Meaning: What will they prove when angry tempests lower?
pope_couplet: Who work us woe in friendship's trustful hour, What will they prove when angry tempests lower
explanation_en: What will they prove when angry tempests lower?
explanation_ta: ( இன்பமான) நட்பிலேயே துயரத்தை வரச் செய்வதில் வல்லவர். ( துன்பம் தரும் பகையை வெல்லும்) வலிமை வேண்டும்போது என்ன ஆவாரோ?

translation:
A happy love 's sea of joy; but mightier sorrows rollFrom unpropitious love athwart the troubled soul

Meaning: The pleasure of lust is (as great as) the sea; but the pain of lust is far greater
pope_couplet: A happy love 's sea of joy; but mightier sorrows rollFrom unpropitious love athwart the troubled soul
explanation_en: The pleasure of lust is (as great as) the sea; but the pain of lust is far greater
explanation_ta: காமம் மகிழ்விக்கும்போது அதன் இன்பம் கடல் போன்றது; அது வருத்தும்போது அதன் துன்பமோ கடலைவிடப் பெரியது.

translation:
I swim the cruel tide of love, and can no shore descry, In watches of the night, too, 'mid the waters, only I

Meaning: I have swam across the terrible flood of lust, but have not seen its shore; even at midnight I am alone; still I live
pope_couplet: I swim the cruel tide of love, and can no shore descry, In watches of the night, too, 'mid the waters, only I
explanation_en: I have swam across the terrible flood of lust, but have not seen its shore; even at midnight I am alone; still I live
explanation_ta: காமம் என்னும்‌ வெள்ளத்தை நீந்தியும் அதன் கரையை யான் காணவில்லை; நள்ளிரவிலும் யான் தனியே இருக்கின்றேன்.

translation:
All living souls in slumber soft she steeps; But me alone kind night for her companing keeps

Meaning: The night which graciously lulls to sleep all living creatures, has me alone for her companion
pope_couplet: All living souls in slumber soft she steeps; But me alone kind night for her companing keeps
explanation_en: The night which graciously lulls to sleep all living creatures, has me alone for her companion
explanation_ta: இந்த இராக்காலம் இரங்கத்தக்கது; எல்லா உயிரையும் தூங்கச் செய்துவிட்டு என்னை அல்லாமல் வேறு துணை இல்லாமல் இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
More cruel than the cruelty of him, the cruel one, In these sad times are lengthening hours of night I watch alone

Meaning: The long nights of these days are far more cruel than the heartless one who is torturing me
pope_couplet: More cruel than the cruelty of him, the cruel one, In these sad times are lengthening hours of night I watch alone
explanation_en: The long nights of these days are far more cruel than the heartless one who is torturing me
explanation_ta: ( பிரிந்து துன்புறுகின்ற) இந்நாட்களில் நெடுநேரம் உடையனவாய்க் கழிகின்ற இராக்காலங்கள், பிரிந்த கொடியவரின் கொடுமையை விடத் தாம் கொடியவை.

translation:
When eye of mine would as my soul go forth to him, It knows not how through floods of its own tears to swim

Meaning: Could mine eyes travel like my thoughts to the abode (of my absent lord), they would not swim in this flood of tears
pope_couplet: When eye of mine would as my soul go forth to him, It knows not how through floods of its own tears to swim
explanation_en: Could mine eyes travel like my thoughts to the abode (of my absent lord), they would not swim in this flood of tears
explanation_ta: காதலர் உள்ள இடத்திற்கு என் மனத்தைப்போல் செல்ல முடியுமானால், என்‌ கண்கள் இவ்வாறு வெள்ளமாகிய கண்ணீரில் நீந்த வேண்டியதில்லை.

translation:
They showed me him, and then my endless painI saw: why then should weeping eyes complain

Meaning: As this incurable malady has been caused by my eyes which showed (him) to me, why should they now weep for (him)
pope_couplet: They showed me him, and then my endless painI saw: why then should weeping eyes complain
explanation_en: As this incurable malady has been caused by my eyes which showed (him) to me, why should they now weep for (him)
explanation_ta: தீராத இக்காமநோய், கண்கள் காட்ட யாம் கண்டதால் விளைந்தது; அவ்வாறிருக்க, காட்டிய கண்கள், இன்று அன்பு கொண்டு உணராமல் துன்பத்தால் வருந்துவது ஏன்?

translation:
How glancing eyes, that rash unweeting looked that day, With sorrow measureless are wasting now away

Meaning: The dyed eyes that (then) looked without foresight, why should they now endure sorrow, without feeling sharply (their own fault)
pope_couplet: How glancing eyes, that rash unweeting looked that day, With sorrow measureless are wasting now away
explanation_en: The dyed eyes that (then) looked without foresight, why should they now endure sorrow, without feeling sharply (their own fault)
explanation_ta: ஆராய்ந்து உணராமல் அன்று நோக்கிக் காதல் கொண்ட கண்கள், இன்று அன்பு கொண்டு உணராமல் துன்பத்தால் வருந்துவது ஏன்?

translation:
The eyes that threw such eager glances round erewhileAre weeping now. Such folly surely claims a smile

Meaning: They themselves looked eagerly (on him) and now they weep. Is not this to be laughed at ?
pope_couplet: The eyes that threw such eager glances round erewhileAre weeping now. Such folly surely claims a smile
explanation_en: They themselves looked eagerly (on him) and now they weep. Is not this to be laughed at ?
explanation_ta: அன்று காதலரைக் கண்கள் தாமே விரைந்து நோக்கி இன்று தாமே அழுகின்றன; இது நகைக்கத்தக்க தன்மை உடையது.

translation:
Those eyes have wept till all the fount of tears is dry, That brought upon me pain that knows no remedy

Meaning: These painted eyes have caused me a lasting mortal disease; and now they can weep no more, the tears having dried up
pope_couplet: Those eyes have wept till all the fount of tears is dry, That brought upon me pain that knows no remedy
explanation_en: These painted eyes have caused me a lasting mortal disease; and now they can weep no more, the tears having dried up
explanation_ta: என் கண்கள், தப்பிப் பிழைக்க முடியாத தீராத காமநோயை என்னிடத்தில் உண்டாக்கி நிறுத்திவிட்டு, தாமும் அழமுடியாமல் நீர் வறண்டு விட்டன.

translation:
The eye that wrought me more than sea could hold of woes, Is suffering pangs that banish all repose

Meaning: Mine eyes have caused me a lust that is greater than the sea and (they themselves) endure the torture of sleeplessness
pope_couplet: The eye that wrought me more than sea could hold of woes, Is suffering pangs that banish all repose
explanation_en: Mine eyes have caused me a lust that is greater than the sea and (they themselves) endure the torture of sleeplessness
explanation_ta: அன்று கடலும் தாங்கமுடியாத காமநோயை உண்டாக்கிய என் கண்கள், இன்று உறங்க முடியாமல் துன்பத்தால் வருந்துகின்றன.

translation:
Oho! how sweet a thing to see! the eyeThat wrought this pain, in the same gulf doth lie

Meaning: The eyes that have given me this disease have themselves been seized with this (suffering) Oh! I am much delighted
pope_couplet: Oho! how sweet a thing to see! the eyeThat wrought this pain, in the same gulf doth lie
explanation_en: The eyes that have given me this disease have themselves been seized with this (suffering) Oh! I am much delighted
explanation_ta: எமக்கு இந்தக் காமநோயைஉண்டாக்கிய கண்கள், தாமும் இத்தகைய துன்பத்தைப்பட்டு வருந்துவது மிகவும் நல்லதே!

translation:
Aching, aching, let those exhaust their stream, That melting, melting, that day gazed on him

Meaning: The eyes that became tender and gazed intently on him, may they suffer so much as to dry up the fountain of their tears
pope_couplet: Aching, aching, let those exhaust their stream, That melting, melting, that day gazed on him
explanation_en: The eyes that became tender and gazed intently on him, may they suffer so much as to dry up the fountain of their tears
explanation_ta: அன்று விரும்பி நெகிழ்ந்து காதலரைக் கண்ட கண்கள் இன்று உறக்கமில்லாத துன்பத்தால் வருந்தி வருந்திக் கண்ணீரும் அற்றுப் போகட்டும்.

translation:
Who loved me once, onloving now doth here remain; Not seeing him, my eye no rest can gain

Meaning: He is indeed here who loved me with his lips but not with his heart but mine eyes suffer from not seeing him
pope_couplet: Who loved me once, onloving now doth here remain; Not seeing him, my eye no rest can gain
explanation_en: He is indeed here who loved me with his lips but not with his heart but mine eyes suffer from not seeing him
explanation_ta: உள்ளத்தால் விரும்பாமலே சொல்லளவில் விரும்பிப் பழகியவர் ஒருவர் இருக்கின்றார்; அவரைக் காணாமல் கண்கள் அமைதியுறவில்லை.

translation:
When he comes not, all slumber flies; no sleep when he is there; Thus every way my eyes have troubles hard to bear

Meaning: When he is away they do not sleep; when he is present they do not sleep; in either case, mine eyes endure unbearable agony
pope_couplet: When he comes not, all slumber flies; no sleep when he is there; Thus every way my eyes have troubles hard to bear
explanation_en: When he is away they do not sleep; when he is present they do not sleep; in either case, mine eyes endure unbearable agony
explanation_ta: காதலர் வாராவிட்டால் தூங்குவதில்லை; வந்தாலும் தூங்குவதில்லை; இவற்றுக்கி‌டையே என் கண்கள் மிக்க துன்பத்தை அடைந்தன.

translation:
It is not hard for all the town the knowledge to obtain, When eyes, as mine, like beaten tambours, make the mystery plain

Meaning: It is not difficult for the people of this place to understand the secret of those whose eyes, like mine, are as it were beaten drums
pope_couplet: It is not hard for all the town the knowledge to obtain, When eyes, as mine, like beaten tambours, make the mystery plain
explanation_en: It is not difficult for the people of this place to understand the secret of those whose eyes, like mine, are as it were beaten drums
explanation_ta: அறையப்படும் பறைபோல் துன்பத்தை வெளிப்படுத்தும் கண்களை உடைய எம்மைப் போன்றவரிடத்தில் மறைபொருளான செய்தியை அறிதல் ஊரார்க்கு அரிது அன்று.

translation:
I willed my lover absent should remain; Of pining's sickly hue to whom shall I complain

Meaning: I who (then) consented to the absence of my loving lord, to whom can I (now) relate the fact of my having turned sallow
pope_couplet: I willed my lover absent should remain; Of pining's sickly hue to whom shall I complain
explanation_en: I who (then) consented to the absence of my loving lord, to whom can I (now) relate the fact of my having turned sallow
explanation_ta: விரும்பிய காதலர்க்கு அன்று பிரிவை உடன்பட்டேன்; பிரிந்தபின் பசலை உற்ற என் தன்மையை வேறு யார்க்குச் சென்று சொல்வேன்?

translation:
'He gave': this sickly hue thus proudly speaks, Then climbs, and all my frame its chariot makes

Meaning: Sallowness, as if proud of having been caused by him, would now ride on my person
pope_couplet: 'He gave': this sickly hue thus proudly speaks, Then climbs, and all my frame its chariot makes
explanation_en: Sallowness, as if proud of having been caused by him, would now ride on my person
explanation_ta: அந்தக் காதலர் உண்டாக்கினார் என்னும் பெருமிதத்தோடு இந்தப் பசலை நிறம் என்னுடைய மேனிமேல் ஏறி ஊர்ந்து பரவி வருகிறது.

translation:
Of comeliness and shame he me bereft, While pain and sickly hue, in recompense, he left

Meaning: He has taken (away) my beauty and modesty, and given me instead disease and sallowness
pope_couplet: Of comeliness and shame he me bereft, While pain and sickly hue, in recompense, he left
explanation_en: He has taken (away) my beauty and modesty, and given me instead disease and sallowness
explanation_ta: காம நோயையும் பசலை நிறத்தையும் எனக்குக் கைம்மாறாக ‌‌கொடுத்து விட்டு, என் சாயலையும் நாணத்தையும் அவர் என்னிடமிருந்து பெற்றுக் கொண்டார்.

translation:
I meditate his words, his worth is theme of all I say, This sickly hue is false that would my trust betray

Meaning: I think (of him); and what I speak about is but his excellence; still is there sallowness; and this is deceitful
pope_couplet: I meditate his words, his worth is theme of all I say, This sickly hue is false that would my trust betray
explanation_en: I think (of him); and what I speak about is but his excellence; still is there sallowness; and this is deceitful
explanation_ta: யான் அவருடைய நல்லியல்புகளை நினைக்கின்றேன்; யான் உரைப்பதும் அவற்றையே; அவ்வாறிருந்தும் பசலை வந்தது வஞ்சனையோ? வேறு வகையோ?

translation:
My lover there went forth to roam; This pallor of my frame usurps his place at home

Meaning: Just as my lover departed then, did not sallowness spread here on my person ?
pope_couplet: My lover there went forth to roam; This pallor of my frame usurps his place at home
explanation_en: Just as my lover departed then, did not sallowness spread here on my person ?
explanation_ta: அதோ பார்! எம்முடைய காதலர் பிரிந்து செல்கின்றார்; இதோ பார்! என்னுடைய மேனியில் பசலை நிறம் வந்து படர்கிறது.

translation:
As darkness waits till lamp expires, to fill the place, This pallor waits till I enjoy no more my lord's embrace

Meaning: Just as darkness waits for the failing light; so does sallowness wait for the laxity of my husband's intercourse
pope_couplet: As darkness waits till lamp expires, to fill the place, This pallor waits till I enjoy no more my lord's embrace
explanation_en: Just as darkness waits for the failing light; so does sallowness wait for the laxity of my husband's intercourse
explanation_ta: விளக்கினுடைய மறைவைப் பார்த்துக் காத்திருக்கின்ற இருளைப் போலவே, தலைவனுடைய தழுவுதலின் ‌சோர்வைப் பார்த்துக் காத்திருக்கினறது.

translation:
I lay in his embrace, I turned unwittingly; Forthwith this hue, as you might grasp it, came on me

Meaning: I who was in close embrace just turned aside and the moment I did so, sallowness came on me like something to be seized on
pope_couplet: I lay in his embrace, I turned unwittingly; Forthwith this hue, as you might grasp it, came on me
explanation_en: I who was in close embrace just turned aside and the moment I did so, sallowness came on me like something to be seized on
explanation_ta: தலைவனைத் தழுவிக் கிடந்தேன்; பக்கத்தே சிறிது அகன்றேன்; அவ்வளவிலேயே பசலை நிறம் அள்ளிக் கொள்வதுபோல் வந்து பரவி விட்டதே!

translation:
On me, because I pine, they cast a slur; But no one says, 'He first deserted her.'

Meaning: Besides those who say "she has turned sallow" there are none who say "he has forsaken her"
pope_couplet: On me, because I pine, they cast a slur; But no one says, 'He first deserted her.'
explanation_en: Besides those who say "she has turned sallow" there are none who say "he has forsaken her"
explanation_ta: இவள் பிரிவால் வருத்திப் பசலை நிறம் அடைந்தாள் என்ற பழி சொல்வதே அல்லாமல், இவளைக் காதலர் விட்டுப் பிரிந்தார் என்று சொல்பவர் இல்லையே!

translation:
Well let my frame, as now, be sicklied o'er with pain, If he who won my heart's consent, in good estate remain

Meaning: If he is clear of guilt who has conciliated me (to his departure) let my body suffer its due and turn sallow
pope_couplet: Well let my frame, as now, be sicklied o'er with pain, If he who won my heart's consent, in good estate remain
explanation_en: If he is clear of guilt who has conciliated me (to his departure) let my body suffer its due and turn sallow
explanation_ta: பிரிவுக்கு உடன்படச் செய்த காதலர் நல்ல நிலையுடையவர் ஆவார் என்றால், என்னுடைய மேனி உள்ளபடி பசலை நிறம் அடைவதாக.

translation:
'Tis well, though men deride me for my sickly hue of pain; If they from calling him unkind, who won my love, refrain

Meaning: It would be good to be said of me that I have turned sallow, if friends do not reproach with unkindness him who pleased me (then)
pope_couplet: 'Tis well, though men deride me for my sickly hue of pain; If they from calling him unkind, who won my love, refrain
explanation_en: It would be good to be said of me that I have turned sallow, if friends do not reproach with unkindness him who pleased me (then)
explanation_ta: பிரிவுக்கு உடன்படச் செய்த காதலர் பிரிந்து வருத்துதலைப் பிறர் தூற்றாமல் இருப்பாரானால், யான் பசலை உற்றதாக பெயர் எடுத்தல் நல்லதே.

translation:
The bliss to be beloved by those they love who gains, Of love the stoneless, luscious fruit obtains

Meaning: The women who are beloved by those whom they love, have they have not got the stone-less fruit of sexual delight ?
pope_couplet: The bliss to be beloved by those they love who gains, Of love the stoneless, luscious fruit obtains
explanation_en: The women who are beloved by those whom they love, have they have not got the stone-less fruit of sexual delight ?
explanation_ta: தாம் விரும்பும் காதலர் தம்மை விரும்புகின்ற பேறு பெற்றவர், காதல் வாழ்க்கையின் பயனாகிய விதை இல்லாத பழத்தைப் பெற்றவரே ஆவார்.

translation:
As heaven on living men showers blessings from above, Is tender grace by lovers shown to those they love

Meaning: The bestowal of love by the beloved on those who love them is like the rain raining (at the proper season) on those who live by it
pope_couplet: As heaven on living men showers blessings from above, Is tender grace by lovers shown to those they love
explanation_en: The bestowal of love by the beloved on those who love them is like the rain raining (at the proper season) on those who live by it
explanation_ta: தம்மை விரும்புகின்றவர்க்குக் காதலர் அளிக்கும் அன்பு, உயிர் வாழ்கினறவர்க்கு மேகம் மழை பெய்து காப்பாற்றுதலைப் போன்றது.

translation:
Who love and are beloved to them aloneBelongs the boast, 'We've made life's very joys our own.'

Meaning: The pride that says "we shall live" suits only those who are loved by their beloved (husbands)
pope_couplet: Who love and are beloved to them aloneBelongs the boast, 'We've made life's very joys our own.'
explanation_en: The pride that says "we shall live" suits only those who are loved by their beloved (husbands)
explanation_ta: காதலரால் விரும்பப்படுகின்றவர்க்கும் ( பிரிவுத் துன்பம் இருந்தாலும்) மீண்டும் வந்தபின் வாழ்வோம் என்று இருக்கும் செருக்குத் தகும்.

translation:
Those well-beloved will luckless prove, Unless beloved by those they love

Meaning: Even those who are esteemed (by other women) are devoid of excellence, if they are not loved by their beloved
pope_couplet: Those well-beloved will luckless prove, Unless beloved by those they love
explanation_en: Even those who are esteemed (by other women) are devoid of excellence, if they are not loved by their beloved
explanation_ta: தாம் விரும்பும் காதலரால் விரும்பப்படாவிட்டால் உலகத்தாரால் விரும்பப்படும் நிலையில் உள்ளவரும் நல்வினை பொருந்தியவர் அல்லர்.

translation:
From him I love to me what gain can be, Unless, as I love him, he loveth me

Meaning: He who is beloved by me, what will he do to me, if I am not beloved by him ?
pope_couplet: From him I love to me what gain can be, Unless, as I love him, he loveth me
explanation_en: He who is beloved by me, what will he do to me, if I am not beloved by him ?
explanation_ta: நாம் காதல் கொண்ட காதலர் தாமும் அவ்வாறே நம்மிடம் காதல் கொள்ளாதபோது, நமக்கு அவர் என்ன நன்மை செய்வார்?

translation:
Love on one side is bad; like balanced loadBy porter borne, love on both sides is good

Meaning: Lust, like the weight of the KAVADI, pains if it lies in one end only but pleases if it is in both
pope_couplet: Love on one side is bad; like balanced loadBy porter borne, love on both sides is good
explanation_en: Lust, like the weight of the KAVADI, pains if it lies in one end only but pleases if it is in both
explanation_ta: காதல் ஒரு பக்கமாக இருத்தல் துன்பமானது; காவடியின் பாரம் போல் இருபக்கமாகவும் ஒத்திருப்பது இன்பமானதாகும்.

translation:
While Kaman rushes straight at me alone, Is all my pain and wasting grief unknown

Meaning: Would not cupid who abides and contends in one party (only) witness the pain and sorrow (in that party)?
pope_couplet: While Kaman rushes straight at me alone, Is all my pain and wasting grief unknown
explanation_en: Would not cupid who abides and contends in one party (only) witness the pain and sorrow (in that party)?
explanation_ta: ( காதலர் இருவரிடத்திலும் ஒத்திருக்காமல்) ஒருவரிடத்தில் மட்டும் காமன் நின்று இயங்குவதால், என்னுடைய துன்பத்தையும் வருத்தத்தையும் அறியானோ?

translation:
Who hear from lover's lips no pleasant word from day to day, Yet in the world live out their life,- no braver souls than they

Meaning: There is no one in the world so hard-hearted as those who can live without receiving (even) a kind word from their beloved
pope_couplet: Who hear from lover's lips no pleasant word from day to day, Yet in the world live out their life,- no braver souls than they
explanation_en: There is no one in the world so hard-hearted as those who can live without receiving (even) a kind word from their beloved
explanation_ta: தான் விரும்பும் காதலரின் இனிய சொல்லைப் பெறாமல் உலகத்தில் ( பிரிவுத் துன்பத்தைப் பொறுத்து) வாழ்கின்றவரைப் போல் வன்கண்மை உடையவர் இல்லை.

translation:
Though he my heart desires no grace accords to me, Yet every accent of his voice is melody

Meaning: Though my beloved bestows no love on one, still are his words sweet to my ears
pope_couplet: Though he my heart desires no grace accords to me, Yet every accent of his voice is melody
explanation_en: Though my beloved bestows no love on one, still are his words sweet to my ears
explanation_ta: யான் விரும்பிய காதலர் மீண்டு வந்து அன்பு செய்யமாட்டார் என்றாலும், அவரைப் பற்றிய புகழைக் ‌கேட்பதும் என் செவிக்கு இன்பமாக இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
Tell him thy pain that loves not thee?Farewell, my soul, fill up the sea

Meaning: Live, O my soul, would you who relate your great sorrow to strangers, try rather to fill up your own sea (of sorrow)
pope_couplet: Tell him thy pain that loves not thee?Farewell, my soul, fill up the sea
explanation_en: Live, O my soul, would you who relate your great sorrow to strangers, try rather to fill up your own sea (of sorrow)
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சமே! நீ வாழி! அன்பு இல்லாதவரிடம் உன் மிகுந்த துன்பத்தைச் சொல்கின்றாய்! அதை விட எளிதாகக் கடலைத் தூர்ப்பாயாக.

translation:
From thought of her unfailing gladness springs, Sweeter than palm-rice wine the joy love brings

Meaning: Sexuality is sweeter than liquor, because when remembered, it creates a most rapturous delight
pope_couplet: From thought of her unfailing gladness springs, Sweeter than palm-rice wine the joy love brings
explanation_en: Sexuality is sweeter than liquor, because when remembered, it creates a most rapturous delight
explanation_ta: நினைத்தாலும் தீராத பெரிய மகிழ்ச்சியைச் செய்தலால் ( உண்டபோது மட்டும் மகிழ்ச்சி தரும் ) கள்ளை விட காமம் இன்பமானதாகும்.

translation:
How great is love! Behold its sweetness past belief!Think on the lover, and the spirit knows no grief

Meaning: Even to think of one's beloved gives one no pain Sexuality, in any degree, is always delightful
pope_couplet: How great is love! Behold its sweetness past belief!Think on the lover, and the spirit knows no grief
explanation_en: Even to think of one's beloved gives one no pain Sexuality, in any degree, is always delightful
explanation_ta: தாம் விரும்புகின்ற காதலர் தம்மை நினைத்தலும் பிரிவால் வரக்கூடிய துன்பம் இல்லாமல் போகின்றது. அதனால் காமம் எவ்வளவாயினும் இன்பம் தருவதே ஆகும்.

translation:
A fit of sneezing threatened, but it passed away; He seemed to think of me, but do his fancies stray

Meaning: I feel as if I am going to sneeze but do not, and (therefore) my beloved is about to think (of me) but does not
pope_couplet: A fit of sneezing threatened, but it passed away; He seemed to think of me, but do his fancies stray
explanation_en: I feel as if I am going to sneeze but do not, and (therefore) my beloved is about to think (of me) but does not
explanation_ta: தும்மல் வருவது போலிருந்து வாராமல் அடங்குகின்றதே! என் காதலர் என்னை நினைப்பவர் போலிருந்து நினையாமல் விடுகின்றாரோ?

translation:
Have I a place within his heart!From mine, alas! he never doth depart

Meaning: He continues to abide in my soul, do I likewise abide in his ?
pope_couplet: Have I a place within his heart!From mine, alas! he never doth depart
explanation_en: He continues to abide in my soul, do I likewise abide in his ?
explanation_ta: எம்முடைய நெஞ்சில் காதலராகிய அவர் இருக்கின்றாரே! ( அது போலவே) யாமும் அவருடைய நெஞ்சத்தில் நீங்காமல் இருக்கின்றோ‌மோ?

translation:
Me from his heart he jealously excludes:Hath he no shame who ceaseless on my heart intrudes

Meaning: He who has imprisoned me in his soul, is he ashamed to enter incessantly into mine
pope_couplet: Me from his heart he jealously excludes:Hath he no shame who ceaseless on my heart intrudes
explanation_en: He who has imprisoned me in his soul, is he ashamed to enter incessantly into mine
explanation_ta: தம்முடைய நெஞ்சில் எம்மை வரவிடாது காவல் கொண்ட காதலர், எம்முடைய நெஞ்சில் தாம் ஓயாமல் வரவதைப் பற்றி நாணமாட்டாரோ?

translation:
How live I yet? I live to ponder o'erThe days of bliss with him that are no more

Meaning: I live by remembering my (former) intercourse with him; if it were not so, how could I live ?
pope_couplet: How live I yet? I live to ponder o'erThe days of bliss with him that are no more
explanation_en: I live by remembering my (former) intercourse with him; if it were not so, how could I live ?
explanation_ta: காதலராகிய அவரோடு யான் பொருந்தியிருந்த நாட்களை நினைத்துக் கொள்வதால்தான் உயிரோடு இருக்கின்றேன்; வேறு எதனால் உயிர் வாழ்கின்றேன்?

translation:
If I remembered not what were I then? And yet, The fiery smart of what my spirit knows not to forget

Meaning: I have never forgotten (the pleasure); even to think of it burns my soul; could I live, if I should ever forget it ?
pope_couplet: If I remembered not what were I then? And yet, The fiery smart of what my spirit knows not to forget
explanation_en: I have never forgotten (the pleasure); even to think of it burns my soul; could I live, if I should ever forget it ?
explanation_ta: ( காதலரை ) மறந்தறியாமல் நினைத்தாலும் உள்ளத்தைப் பிரிவுத் துன்பம் சுடுகின்றதே! நினைக்காமல் மறந்து விட்டால் என்ன ஆவேனோ?

translation:
My frequent thought no wrath excites It is not so?This honour doth my love on me bestow

Meaning: He will not be angry however much I may think of him; is it not so much the delight my beloved
pope_couplet: My frequent thought no wrath excites It is not so?This honour doth my love on me bestow
explanation_en: He will not be angry however much I may think of him; is it not so much the delight my beloved
explanation_ta: காதலரை எவ்வளவு மிகுதியாக நினைத்தாலும் அவர் என்மேல் சினங்கொள்ளார்; காதலர் செய்யும் சிறந்த உதவி அத்தன்மையானது அன்றோ!

translation:
Dear life departs, when his ungracious deeds I ponder o'er, Who said erewhile, 'We're one for evermore'

Meaning: My precious life is wasting away by thinking too much on the cruelty of him who said we were not different
pope_couplet: Dear life departs, when his ungracious deeds I ponder o'er, Who said erewhile, 'We're one for evermore'
explanation_en: My precious life is wasting away by thinking too much on the cruelty of him who said we were not different
explanation_ta: நாம் இருவரும் வேறு அல்லேம் என்று அடிக்கடி சொல்லும் அவர் இப்போது அன்பு இல்லாதிருத்தலை மிக நினைத்து என் இனிய உயிர் அழிகின்றது.

translation:
Set not; so may'st thou prosper, moon! that eyes may seeMy love who went away, but ever bides with me

Meaning: May you live, O Moon! Do not set, that I mine see him who has departed without quitting my soul
pope_couplet: Set not; so may'st thou prosper, moon! that eyes may seeMy love who went away, but ever bides with me
explanation_en: May you live, O Moon! Do not set, that I mine see him who has departed without quitting my soul
explanation_ta: தி்ங்களே! பிரியாமல் இருந்து இறுதியில் பிரிந்து சென்ற காதலரை என் கண்ணால் தேடிக் காணும்படியாக நீ மறைந்து விடாமல் இருப்பாயாக!

translation:
It came and brought to me, that nightly vision rare, A message from my love,- what feast shall I prepare

Meaning: Where with shall I feast the dream which has brought me my dear one's messenger ?
pope_couplet: It came and brought to me, that nightly vision rare, A message from my love,- what feast shall I prepare
explanation_en: Where with shall I feast the dream which has brought me my dear one's messenger ?
explanation_ta: ( யான் பிரிவால் வருந்தி உறங்கியபோது) காதலர் அனுப்பிய தூதோடு வந்த கனவுக்கு உரிய விருந்தாக என்ன செய்து உதவுவேன்?

translation:
If my dark, carp-like eye will close in sleep, as I implore, The tale of my long-suffering life I'll tell my loved one o'er

Meaning: If my fish-like painted eyes should, at my begging, close in sleep, I could fully relate my sufferings to my lord
pope_couplet: If my dark, carp-like eye will close in sleep, as I implore, The tale of my long-suffering life I'll tell my loved one o'er
explanation_en: If my fish-like painted eyes should, at my begging, close in sleep, I could fully relate my sufferings to my lord
explanation_ta: கண்கள் யான் வேண்டுவதுபோல் தூங்குமானால், ( அப்போது வரும் கனவில் காணும்) காதலர்க்கு யான் தப்பிப் பிழைத்திருக்கும்‌ தன்மையைச் சொல்வேன்.

translation:
Him, who in waking hour no kindness shows, In dreams I see; and so my lifetime goes

Meaning: My life lasts because in my dream I behold him who does not favour me in my waking hours
pope_couplet: Him, who in waking hour no kindness shows, In dreams I see; and so my lifetime goes
explanation_en: My life lasts because in my dream I behold him who does not favour me in my waking hours
explanation_ta: நனவில் வந்து அன்பு செய்யாத காதலரைக் கனவில் காண்பதால்தான் என்னுடைய உயிர் இன்னும் நீங்காமல் உள்ளதாகின்றது.

translation:
Some pleasure I enjoy when him who loves not meIn waking hours, the vision searches out and makes me see

Meaning: There is pleasure in my dream, because in it I seek and obtain him who does not visit me in my wakefulness
pope_couplet: Some pleasure I enjoy when him who loves not meIn waking hours, the vision searches out and makes me see
explanation_en: There is pleasure in my dream, because in it I seek and obtain him who does not visit me in my wakefulness
explanation_ta: நனவில் வந்து அன்பு செய்யாத காதலரைத் தேடி அழைத்துக் கொண்டு வருவதற்காகக் கனவில் அவரைப் பற்றிய காதல் நிகழ்ச்சிகள் உண்டாகின்றன.

translation:
As what I then beheld in waking hour was sweet, So pleasant dreams in hour of sleep my spirit greet

Meaning: I saw him in my waking hours, and then it was pleasant; I see him just now in my dream, and it is (equally) pleasant
pope_couplet: As what I then beheld in waking hour was sweet, So pleasant dreams in hour of sleep my spirit greet
explanation_en: I saw him in my waking hours, and then it was pleasant; I see him just now in my dream, and it is (equally) pleasant
explanation_ta: முன்பு நனவில் கண்ட இன்பமும் அப்பொழுது மட்டும் இனிதாயிற்று; இப்‌பொழுது காணும் கனவும் கண்ட பொழுது மட்டுமே இன்பமாக உள்ளது.

translation:
And if there were no waking hour, my loveIn dreams would never from my side remove

Meaning: Were there no such thing as wakefulness, my beloved (who visited me) in my dream would not depart from me
pope_couplet: And if there were no waking hour, my loveIn dreams would never from my side remove
explanation_en: Were there no such thing as wakefulness, my beloved (who visited me) in my dream would not depart from me
explanation_ta: நனவு என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற ஒன்று இல்லாதிருக்குமானால், கனவில் வந்த காதலர் என்னை விட்டுப் பிரியாமலே இருப்பர்.

translation:
The cruel one, in waking hour, who all ungracious seems, Why should he thus torment my soul in nightly dreams

Meaning: The cruel one who would not favour me in my wakefulness, what right has he to torture me in my dreams?
pope_couplet: The cruel one, in waking hour, who all ungracious seems, Why should he thus torment my soul in nightly dreams
explanation_en: The cruel one who would not favour me in my wakefulness, what right has he to torture me in my dreams?
explanation_ta: நனவில் வந்து எமக்கு அன்பு செய்யாத கொடுமை உடைய அவர், கனவில் வந்து எம்மை வருத்துவது என்ன காரணத்தால்?

translation:
And when I sleep he holds my form embraced; And when I wake to fill my heart makes haste

Meaning: When I am asleep he rests on my shoulders, (but) when I awake he hastens into my soul
pope_couplet: And when I sleep he holds my form embraced; And when I wake to fill my heart makes haste
explanation_en: When I am asleep he rests on my shoulders, (but) when I awake he hastens into my soul
explanation_ta: தூங்கும்போது கனவில் வந்து என் தோள்மேல் உள்ளவராகி, விழி்த்தெழும்போது விரைந்து என் நெஞ்சில் உள்ளவராகிறார்‌.

translation:
In dreams who ne'er their lover's form perceive, For those in waking hours who show no love will grieve

Meaning: They who have no dear ones to behold in their dreams blame him who visits me not in my waking hours
pope_couplet: In dreams who ne'er their lover's form perceive, For those in waking hours who show no love will grieve
explanation_en: They who have no dear ones to behold in their dreams blame him who visits me not in my waking hours
explanation_ta: கனவில் காதலர் வரக் காணாத மகளிர், நனவில் வந்து அன்பு செய்யாத கா‌தலரை ( அவர் வராத காரணம் பற்றி ) நொந்து கொள்வர்.

translation:
They say, that he in waking hours has left me lone; In dreams they surely see him not,- these people of the town;

Meaning: The women of this place say he has forsaken me in my wakefulness I think they have not seen him visit me in my dreams
pope_couplet: They say, that he in waking hours has left me lone; In dreams they surely see him not,- these people of the town;
explanation_en: The women of this place say he has forsaken me in my wakefulness I think they have not seen him visit me in my dreams
explanation_ta: நனவில் நம்‌மை விட்டு நீங்கினார் என்று காதலரைப் பழித்து பேசுகின்றனரே! இந்த ஊரார் கனவில் அவரைக் காண்பதில்லையோ?

translation:
Thou art not evening, but a spear that doth devourThe souls of brides; farewell, thou evening hour

Meaning: Live, O you evening are you (the former) evening? No, you are the season that slays (married) women
pope_couplet: Thou art not evening, but a spear that doth devourThe souls of brides; farewell, thou evening hour
explanation_en: Live, O you evening are you (the former) evening? No, you are the season that slays (married) women
explanation_ta: பொழுதே! நீ மாலைக்காலம் அல்ல; (காதலரோடு கூடியிருந்து பிறகு பிரிந்து வாழும்) மகளிரின் உயிரை உண்ணும் முடிவுக் காலமாக இருக்கினறாய்!

translation:
Thine eye is sad; Hail, doubtful hour of eventide!Of cruel eye, as is my spouse, is too thy bride

Meaning: A long life to you, O dark evening! You are sightless Is your help-mate (also) as hard-hearted as mine
pope_couplet: Thine eye is sad; Hail, doubtful hour of eventide!Of cruel eye, as is my spouse, is too thy bride
explanation_en: A long life to you, O dark evening! You are sightless Is your help-mate (also) as hard-hearted as mine
explanation_ta: மயங்கிய மாலைப்‌பொழுதே! நீயும் எம்மைப்போல் துன்பப்படுகின்‌றாயே! உன் துணையும் எம் காதலர் போல் இரக்கம் அற்றதோ?

translation:
With buds of chilly dew wan evening's shade enclose; My anguish buds space and all my sorrow grows

Meaning: The evening that (once) came in with trembling and dimness (now) brings me an aversion for life and increasing sorrow
pope_couplet: With buds of chilly dew wan evening's shade enclose; My anguish buds space and all my sorrow grows
explanation_en: The evening that (once) came in with trembling and dimness (now) brings me an aversion for life and increasing sorrow
explanation_ta: பனி தோன்றிப் பசந்த நிறம் கொண்ட மாலைப் பொழுது எனக்கு வருத்தம் ஏற்பட்டுத் துன்பம் மேன்மேலும் வளரும்படியாக வருகின்றது.

translation:
When absent is my love, the evening hour descends, As when an alien host to field of battle wends

Meaning: In the absence of my lover, evening comes in like slayers on the field of slaughter
pope_couplet: When absent is my love, the evening hour descends, As when an alien host to field of battle wends
explanation_en: In the absence of my lover, evening comes in like slayers on the field of slaughter
explanation_ta: காதலர் இல்லாத இப்போது, கொலை செய்யும் இடத்தில் பகைவர் வருவது போல் மாலைப்பொழுது ( என் உயிரைக் கொள்ள) வருகின்றது.

translation:
O morn, how have I won thy grace? thou bring'st reliefO eve, why art thou foe! thou dost renew my grief

Meaning: O eve, why art thou foe! thou dost renew my grief
pope_couplet: O morn, how have I won thy grace? thou bring'st reliefO eve, why art thou foe! thou dost renew my grief
explanation_en: O eve, why art thou foe! thou dost renew my grief
explanation_ta: யான் காலைப்பொழுதிற்குச் செய்த நன்மை என்ன? (என்னைத் துன்புறுத்துகின்ற) மாலைப் பொழுதிற்குச் செய்த பகையான தீமை என்ன?

translation:
The pangs that evening brings I never knew, Till he, my wedded spouse, from me withdrew

Meaning: Previous to my husband's departure, I know not the painful nature of evening
pope_couplet: The pangs that evening brings I never knew, Till he, my wedded spouse, from me withdrew
explanation_en: Previous to my husband's departure, I know not the painful nature of evening
explanation_ta: மாலைப் பொழுது இவ்வாறு துன்பம் செய்ய வல்லது என்பதைக் காதலர் என்னை விட்டு அகலாமல் உடனிருந்த காலத்தில் யான் அறியவில்லை.

translation:
My grief at morn a bud, all day an opening flower, Full-blown expands in evening hour

Meaning: This malady buds forth in the morning, expands all day long and blossoms in the evening
pope_couplet: My grief at morn a bud, all day an opening flower, Full-blown expands in evening hour
explanation_en: This malady buds forth in the morning, expands all day long and blossoms in the evening
explanation_ta: இந்த காமநோய், காலைப்பொழுதில் அரும்பாய்த் தோன்றி, பகற்பொழுதெல்லாம் பேரரும்பாய் வளர்ந்து மாலைப்பொழுதில் மலராகின்றது.

translation:
The shepherd's pipe is like a murderous weapon, to my ear, For it proclaims the hour of ev'ning's fiery anguish near

Meaning: The shepherd's flute now sounds as a fiery forerunner of night, and is become a weapon that slays (me)
pope_couplet: The shepherd's pipe is like a murderous weapon, to my ear, For it proclaims the hour of ev'ning's fiery anguish near
explanation_en: The shepherd's flute now sounds as a fiery forerunner of night, and is become a weapon that slays (me)
explanation_ta: ஆயனுடைய புல்லாங்குழல், நெருப்புப்போல் வருத்தும்‌ மாலைப்பொழுதிற்குத் தூதாகி என்னைக் கொல்லும்‌‌ படையாகவும் வருகின்றது.

translation:
If evening's shades, that darken all my soul, extend; From this afflicted town will would of grief ascend

Meaning: When night comes on confusing (everyone's) mind, the (whole) town will lose its sense and be plunged in sorrow
pope_couplet: If evening's shades, that darken all my soul, extend; From this afflicted town will would of grief ascend
explanation_en: When night comes on confusing (everyone's) mind, the (whole) town will lose its sense and be plunged in sorrow
explanation_ta: அறிவு மயங்கும்படியாக மாலைப்பொழுது வந்து படரும்போது, இந்த ஊரும் மயங்கி என்னைப் போல் துன்பத்தால் வருந்தும்.

translation:
This darkening eve, my darkling soul must perish utterly; Remembering him who seeks for wealth, but seeks not me

Meaning: My (hitherto) unextinguished life is now lost in this bewildering night at the thought of him who has the nature of wealth
pope_couplet: This darkening eve, my darkling soul must perish utterly; Remembering him who seeks for wealth, but seeks not me
explanation_en: My (hitherto) unextinguished life is now lost in this bewildering night at the thought of him who has the nature of wealth
explanation_ta: ( பிரிவுத் துன்பத்தால்) மாயமாய் நின்ற என் உயிர், பொருள் காரணமாகப் பிரிந்து சென்ற காதலரை நினைந்து மயங்குகின்ற இம் மாலைப்பொழுதில் மாய்கின்றது.

translation:
Thine eyes grown dim are now ashamed the fragrant flow'rs to see, Thinking on him, who wand'ring far, leaves us in misery

Meaning: While we endure the unbearable sorrow, your eyes weep for him who is gone afar, and shun (the sight of) fragrant flowers
pope_couplet: Thine eyes grown dim are now ashamed the fragrant flow'rs to see, Thinking on him, who wand'ring far, leaves us in misery
explanation_en: While we endure the unbearable sorrow, your eyes weep for him who is gone afar, and shun (the sight of) fragrant flowers
explanation_ta: இத்துன்பத்தை நமக்கு விட்டு விட்டுத் தொலைவில் உள்ள நாட்டுக்குச் சென்ற காதலரை நினைந்து அழுதமையால் கண்கள் அழகு இழந்து நறுமலர்களுக்கு நாணி விட்டன.

translation:
The eye, with sorrow wan, all wet with dew of tears, As witness of the lover's lack of love appears

Meaning: The discoloured eyes that shed tears profusely seem to betray the unkindness of our beloved
pope_couplet: The eye, with sorrow wan, all wet with dew of tears, As witness of the lover's lack of love appears
explanation_en: The discoloured eyes that shed tears profusely seem to betray the unkindness of our beloved
explanation_ta: பசலை நிறம் அடைந்து நீர் சொரியும் கண்கள், நாம் விரும்பிய காதலர் நமக்கு அன்பு செய்யாத தன்மையைப் ( பிறர்க்குச்) சொல்வன போல் உள்ளன.

translation:
These withered arms, desertion's pangs abundantly display, That swelled with joy on that glad nuptial day

Meaning: The shoulders that swelled on the day of our union (now) seem to announce our separation clearly (to the public)
pope_couplet: These withered arms, desertion's pangs abundantly display, That swelled with joy on that glad nuptial day
explanation_en: The shoulders that swelled on the day of our union (now) seem to announce our separation clearly (to the public)
explanation_ta: கூடியிருந்த காலத்தில் மகிழ்ந்து பூரித்திருந்த தோள்கள், ( இப்போது மெலிந்தும்) காதலருடைய பிரிவை நன்றாக அறிவிப்பவை போல் உள்ளன.

translation:
When lover went, then faded all their wonted charms, And armlets' golden round slips off from these poor wasted arms

Meaning: In the absence of your consort, your shoulders having lost their former beauty and fulness, your bracelets of pure gold have become loose
pope_couplet: When lover went, then faded all their wonted charms, And armlets' golden round slips off from these poor wasted arms
explanation_en: In the absence of your consort, your shoulders having lost their former beauty and fulness, your bracelets of pure gold have become loose
explanation_ta: துணைவர் விட்டு நீங்கியதால் பழைய அழகு கெட்டு வாடிய தோள்கள், பருத்த தன்மை கெட்டு மெலிந்து வளையல்களும் கழலச் செய்கின்றன.

translation:
These wasted arms, the bracelet with their wonted beauty gone, The cruelty declare of that most cruel one

Meaning: The (loosened) bracelets, and the shoulders from which the old beauty has faded, relate the cruelty of the pitiless one
pope_couplet: These wasted arms, the bracelet with their wonted beauty gone, The cruelty declare of that most cruel one
explanation_en: The (loosened) bracelets, and the shoulders from which the old beauty has faded, relate the cruelty of the pitiless one
explanation_ta: வளையல்களும் கழன்று பழைய அழகும் கெட்டு, வாடிய தோள்கள் (என் துன்பம் உணராத) கொடியவரி்ன கொடுமையைப் பிறர் அறியச் சொல்கின்றன.

translation:
I grieve, 'tis pain to me to hear him cruel chid, Because the armlet from my wasted arm has slid

Meaning: I am greatly pained to hear you call him a cruel man, just because your shoulders are reduced and your bracelets loosened
pope_couplet: I grieve, 'tis pain to me to hear him cruel chid, Because the armlet from my wasted arm has slid
explanation_en: I am greatly pained to hear you call him a cruel man, just because your shoulders are reduced and your bracelets loosened
explanation_ta: வளையல்கள் கழன்று தோள்களும் மெலிவடைவதால் (அவற்றைக் காண்போர்) காதலரைக் கொடியவர் என்று கூறுவதைக் கேட்டு வருந்துகின்றேன்.

translation:
My heart! say ought of glory wilt thou gain, If to that cruel one thou of thy wasted arms complain

Meaning: Can you O my soul! gain glory by relating to the (so-called) cruel one the clamour of my fading shoulders?
pope_couplet: My heart! say ought of glory wilt thou gain, If to that cruel one thou of thy wasted arms complain
explanation_en: Can you O my soul! gain glory by relating to the (so-called) cruel one the clamour of my fading shoulders?
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே! கொடியவர் என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற காதலர்க்கு என் மெலிந்த தோள்களின் ஆரவாரத்தை உரைத்து, அந்த உதவியால் பெருமை அடைவாயோ?

translation:
One day the fervent pressure of embracing arms I checked, Grew wan the forehead of the maid with golden armlet decked

Meaning: When I once loosened the arms that were in embrace, the forehead of the gold-braceleted women turned sallow
pope_couplet: One day the fervent pressure of embracing arms I checked, Grew wan the forehead of the maid with golden armlet decked
explanation_en: When I once loosened the arms that were in embrace, the forehead of the gold-braceleted women turned sallow
explanation_ta: தழுவிய கை‌களைத் தளர்த்தியவுடனே, பைந்தொடி அணிந்த காதலியின் நெற்றி, ( அவ்வளவு சிறியதாகிய பிரிவையும் பொறுக்காமல்) பசலை நிறம் அடைந்தது.

translation:
As we embraced a breath of wind found entrance there; The maid's large liquid eyes were dimmed with care

Meaning: When but a breath of breeze penetrated our embrace, her large cool eyes became sallow
pope_couplet: As we embraced a breath of wind found entrance there; The maid's large liquid eyes were dimmed with care
explanation_en: When but a breath of breeze penetrated our embrace, her large cool eyes became sallow
explanation_ta: தழுவுதலுக்கு இடையே குளி்ந்த காற்று நுழைய, காதலியின் பெரிய மழை போன்ற கண்கள் பசலை நிறம் அடைந்தன.

translation:
The dimness of her eye felt sorrow now, Beholding what was done by that bright brow

Meaning: Was it at the sight of what the bright forehead had done that the sallowness of her eyes became sad?
pope_couplet: The dimness of her eye felt sorrow now, Beholding what was done by that bright brow
explanation_en: Was it at the sight of what the bright forehead had done that the sallowness of her eyes became sad?
explanation_ta: காதலியின் ஒளி பொருந்திய நெற்றி, பசலை நிறம் உற்றதைக் கண்டு, அவளுடைய க்ண்களில் பசலையும் துன்பம் அடைந்து விட்டது.

translation:
My heart, canst thou not thinking of some med'cine tell, Not any one, to drive away this grief incurable

Meaning: O my soul, will you not think and tell me some medicine be it what it may, that can cure this incurable malady?
pope_couplet: My heart, canst thou not thinking of some med'cine tell, Not any one, to drive away this grief incurable
explanation_en: O my soul, will you not think and tell me some medicine be it what it may, that can cure this incurable malady?
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே! ( காதலால் வளர்ந்த) இத் துன்ப நோயைத் தீர்க்கும் மருந்து ஏதாவது ஒன்றை நீ நினைத்துப் பார்த்து எனக்குச் சொல்ல மாட்டாயோ?

translation:
Since he loves not, thy smartIs folly, fare thee well my heart

Meaning: Is folly, fare thee well my heart!
pope_couplet: Since he loves not, thy smartIs folly, fare thee well my heart
explanation_en: Is folly, fare thee well my heart!
explanation_ta: என் நெஞ்சே! வாழ்க! அவர் நம்மிடம் காதல் இல்லாதவராக இருக்க, நீ மட்டும் அவரை நினைந்து வருந்துவது உன் அறியாமையே!

translation:
What comes of sitting here in pining thought, O heart? He knowsNo pitying thought, the cause of all these wasting woes

Meaning: O my soul! why remain (here) and suffer thinking (of him)? There are no lewd thoughts (of you) in him who has caused you this disease of sorrow
pope_couplet: What comes of sitting here in pining thought, O heart? He knowsNo pitying thought, the cause of all these wasting woes
explanation_en: O my soul! why remain (here) and suffer thinking (of him)? There are no lewd thoughts (of you) in him who has caused you this disease of sorrow
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே (என்னுடன்) இருந்து அவரை நினைந்து வருந்துவது ஏன்? இந்தத் துன்பநோயை உண்டாக்கியவரிடம் இவ்வாறு அன்பு கொண்டு நினைக்கும் தன்மை இல்லையே!

translation:
O rid me of these eyes, my heart; for they, Longing to see him, wear my life away

Meaning: O my soul! take my eyes also with you, (if not), these would eat me up (in their desire) to see him
pope_couplet: O rid me of these eyes, my heart; for they, Longing to see him, wear my life away
explanation_en: O my soul! take my eyes also with you, (if not), these would eat me up (in their desire) to see him
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே! நீ அவரிடம் செல்லும்போது என் கண்களையும் உடன் கொண்டு செல்வாயாக; அவரைக் காணவேண்டும் என்று இவை என்னைப் பிடுங்கித் தின்கின்றன.

translation:
O heart, as a foe, can I abandon utterlyHim who, though I long for him, longs not for me

Meaning: O my soul! can he who loves not though he is beloved, be forsaken saying he hates me (now)?
pope_couplet: O heart, as a foe, can I abandon utterlyHim who, though I long for him, longs not for me
explanation_en: O my soul! can he who loves not though he is beloved, be forsaken saying he hates me (now)?
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே! யாம் விரும்பி நாடினாலும் எம்மை நாடாத அவர் நம்மை வெறுத்து விட்டார் என்று எண்ணிக் கைவிட முடியும‌ோ?

translation:
My heart, false is the fire that burns; thou canst not wrath maintain, If thou thy love behold, embracing, soothing all thy pain

Meaning: O my soul! when you see the dear one who remove dislike by intercourse, you are displeased and continue to be so Nay, your displeasure is (simply) false
pope_couplet: My heart, false is the fire that burns; thou canst not wrath maintain, If thou thy love behold, embracing, soothing all thy pain
explanation_en: O my soul! when you see the dear one who remove dislike by intercourse, you are displeased and continue to be so Nay, your displeasure is (simply) false
explanation_ta: என் நெஞ்சே! ஊடியபோது கூடி ஊடல் உணர்த்த வல்ல காதலரைக் கண்டபோது நீ பிணங்கி உணர மாட்டாய்; பொய்யான சினங்கொண்டு காய்கினறாய்.

translation:
Or bid thy love, or bid thy shame depart; For me, I cannot bear them both, my worthy heart

Meaning: O my good soul, give up either lust or honour, as for me I can endure neither
pope_couplet: Or bid thy love, or bid thy shame depart; For me, I cannot bear them both, my worthy heart
explanation_en: O my good soul, give up either lust or honour, as for me I can endure neither
explanation_ta: நல்ல நெஞ்சே! ஒன்று காமத்தை விட்டு விடு; அல்லது நாணத்தை விட்டு விடு; இந்த இரண்டையும் பொறுத்துக் கொண்டிருக்க என்னால் முடியாது.

translation:
Thou art befooled, my heart, thou followest him who flees from thee; And still thou yearning criest: 'He will nor pity show nor love to me.'

Meaning: You are a fool, O my soul! to go after my departed one, while you mourn that he is not kind enough to favour you
pope_couplet: Thou art befooled, my heart, thou followest him who flees from thee; And still thou yearning criest: 'He will nor pity show nor love to me.'
explanation_en: You are a fool, O my soul! to go after my departed one, while you mourn that he is not kind enough to favour you
explanation_ta: என் நெஞ்சே! பிரிவுத் துன்பத்தால் வருந்தி அவர் வந்து அன்பு செய்ய வில்லையே என்று ஏங்கி பிரிந்தவரின் பின் செல்கின்றாய் பேதை.

translation:
My heart! my lover lives within my mind; Roaming, whom dost thou think to find

Meaning: O my soul! to whom would you repair, while the dear one is within yourself?
pope_couplet: My heart! my lover lives within my mind; Roaming, whom dost thou think to find
explanation_en: O my soul! to whom would you repair, while the dear one is within yourself?
explanation_ta: என் நெஞ்சே! காதலர் உன் உள்ளத்தில் உள்ளவராக இருக்கும்போது நீ அவரை நினைத்து யாரிடம் தேடிச் செல்கின்றாய்?

translation:
If I should keep in mind the man who utterly renounces me, My soul must suffer further loss of dignity

Meaning: If I retain in my heart him who has left me without befriending me, I shall lose even the (inward) beauty that remains
pope_couplet: If I should keep in mind the man who utterly renounces me, My soul must suffer further loss of dignity
explanation_en: If I retain in my heart him who has left me without befriending me, I shall lose even the (inward) beauty that remains
explanation_ta: நம்மோடு பொருந்தி இருக்காமல் கைவிட்டுச சென்ற காதலரை நெஞ்சில் வைத்திருக்கும்போது இன்னும் மெலிந்து அழகை இழந்து வருகின்றோம்.

translation:
Of womanly reserve love's axe breaks through the door, Barred by the bolt of shame before

Meaning: The axe of lust can break the door of chastity which is bolted with the bolt of modesty
pope_couplet: Of womanly reserve love's axe breaks through the door, Barred by the bolt of shame before
explanation_en: The axe of lust can break the door of chastity which is bolted with the bolt of modesty
explanation_ta: நாணம் என்னும் தாழ்ப்பாள் பொருந்திய நிறை என்று சொல்லப்படும் கதவை காமம் ஆகிய கோடாலி உடைத்து விடுகிறதே.

translation:
What men call love is the one thing of merciless power; It gives my soul no rest, e'en in the midnight hour

Meaning: Even at midnight is my mind worried by lust, and this one thing, alas! is without mercy
pope_couplet: What men call love is the one thing of merciless power; It gives my soul no rest, e'en in the midnight hour
explanation_en: Even at midnight is my mind worried by lust, and this one thing, alas! is without mercy
explanation_ta: காமம் என்று சொல்லப்படுகின்ற ஒன்று கண்ணோட்டம் இல்லாதது. அது என் நெஞ்சத்தை நள்ளிரவில் ஏவல் கொண்டு ஆள்கிறது.

translation:
I would my love conceal, but like a sneezeIt shows itself, and gives no warning sign

Meaning: I would conceal my lust, but alas, it yields not to my will but breaks out like a sneeze
pope_couplet: I would my love conceal, but like a sneezeIt shows itself, and gives no warning sign
explanation_en: I would conceal my lust, but alas, it yields not to my will but breaks out like a sneeze
explanation_ta: யான் காமத்தை என்னுள்‌ளே மறைக்க முயல்வேன்; ஆனால் அதுவே என் குறிப்பின்படி நிற்காமல் தும்மல் போல் தானே வெளிப்பட்டு விடுகிறது.

translation:
In womanly reserve I deemed myself beyond assail; But love will come abroad, and casts away the veil

Meaning: I say I would be firm, but alas, my malady breaks out from its concealment and appears in public
pope_couplet: In womanly reserve I deemed myself beyond assail; But love will come abroad, and casts away the veil
explanation_en: I say I would be firm, but alas, my malady breaks out from its concealment and appears in public
explanation_ta: யான் இதுவரையில் நிறையோடிருப்பதாக எண்ணிக கொண்டிருந்தேன். ஆனால் என் காமம் என்னுள் மறைந்திருத்தலைக் கடந்து மன்றத்தில் வெளிப்படுகின்றது.

translation:
The dignity that seeks not him who acts as foe, Is the one thing that loving heart can never know

Meaning: The dignity that would not go after an absent lover is not known to those who are sticken by love
pope_couplet: The dignity that seeks not him who acts as foe, Is the one thing that loving heart can never know
explanation_en: The dignity that would not go after an absent lover is not known to those who are sticken by love
explanation_ta: தம்மை வெறுத்து நீங்கியவரின் பின் செல்லாமல் மானத்தோடு நிற்கும் பெருந்தகைமை, காமநோய் உற்றவர் அறியும் தன்மையது அனறு.

translation:
My grief how full of grace, I pray you see!It seeks to follow him that hateth me

Meaning: The sorrow I have endured by desiring to go after my absent lover, in what way is it excellent?
pope_couplet: My grief how full of grace, I pray you see!It seeks to follow him that hateth me
explanation_en: The sorrow I have endured by desiring to go after my absent lover, in what way is it excellent?
explanation_ta: வெறுத்து நீங்கிய காதலரின் பின் செல்ல விரும்பிய நிலையில் இருப்பதால் என்னை அடைந்த இந்த காமநோய் எத்தன்மையானது? அந்‌தோ!

translation:
No sense of shame my gladdened mind shall prove, When he returns my longing heart to bless with love

Meaning: I know nothing like shame when my beloved does from love (just) what is desired (by me)
pope_couplet: No sense of shame my gladdened mind shall prove, When he returns my longing heart to bless with love
explanation_en: I know nothing like shame when my beloved does from love (just) what is desired (by me)
explanation_ta: நாம் விரும்பிய காதலர் காமத்தால் நமக்கு விருப்பமானவற்றைச் செய்வாரானால். நாணம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் ஒரு பண்பையும் அறியாமல் இருப்போம்.

translation:
The words of that deceiver, versed in every wily art, Are instruments that break through every guard of woman's heart

Meaning: Are not the enticing words of my trick-abounding roguish lover the weapon that breaks away my feminine firmness?
pope_couplet: The words of that deceiver, versed in every wily art, Are instruments that break through every guard of woman's heart
explanation_en: Are not the enticing words of my trick-abounding roguish lover the weapon that breaks away my feminine firmness?
explanation_ta: நம்முடைய பெண்மையாகிய அரணை அழிக்கும் படையாக இருப்பது, பல மாயங்களில் வல்ல, கள்வனான காதலரடைய பணிவுடைய மொழி அன்றோ?

translation:
'I 'll shun his greeting'; saying thus with pride away I went:I held him in my arms, for straight I felt my heart relent

Meaning: I said I would feign dislike and so went (away); (but) I embraced him the moment I say my mind began to unite with him!
pope_couplet: 'I 'll shun his greeting'; saying thus with pride away I went:I held him in my arms, for straight I felt my heart relent
explanation_en: I said I would feign dislike and so went (away); (but) I embraced him the moment I say my mind began to unite with him!
explanation_ta: ஊடுவேன் என்று எண்ணிக் கொண்டு சென்றேன்; ஆனால் என் நெஞ்சம் என்னை விட்டு அவரோடு கூடுவதை கண்டு தழுவினேன்.

translation:
'We 'll stand aloof and then embrace': is this for them to say, Whose hearts are as the fat that in the blaze dissolves away

Meaning: Is it possible for those whose hearts melt like fat in the fire to say they can feign a strong dislike and remain so?
pope_couplet: 'We 'll stand aloof and then embrace': is this for them to say, Whose hearts are as the fat that in the blaze dissolves away
explanation_en: Is it possible for those whose hearts melt like fat in the fire to say they can feign a strong dislike and remain so?
explanation_ta: கொழுப்பைத் தீயில் இட்டால் போன்ற உருகும் நெஞ்சுடைய என்னைப் போன்றவர்க்கு, இசைந்து ஊடி நிற்போம் என்று ஊடும் தன்மை உண்டோ?

translation:
My eyes have lost their brightness, sight is dimmed; my fingers worn, With nothing on the wall the days since I was left forlorn

Meaning: My finger has worn away by marking (on the wall) the days he has been absent while my eyes have lost their lustre and begin to fail
pope_couplet: My eyes have lost their brightness, sight is dimmed; my fingers worn, With nothing on the wall the days since I was left forlorn
explanation_en: My finger has worn away by marking (on the wall) the days he has been absent while my eyes have lost their lustre and begin to fail
explanation_ta: என் கண்களும் அவர் வரும் வழியைப் பார்த்துப் பார்த்து ஒளி இழந்து அழகு கெட்டன; விரல்களும் அவர் சென்ற நாட்களைக் குறித்துத் தொட்டுத் தொட்டுத் தேய்ந்தன.

translation:
O thou with gleaming jewels decked, could I forget for this one day, Henceforth these bracelets from my arms will slip, my beauty worn away

Meaning: O you bright-jewelled maid, if I forget (him) today, my shoulders will lose their beauty even in the other life and make my bracelets loose
pope_couplet: O thou with gleaming jewels decked, could I forget for this one day, Henceforth these bracelets from my arms will slip, my beauty worn away
explanation_en: O you bright-jewelled maid, if I forget (him) today, my shoulders will lose their beauty even in the other life and make my bracelets loose
explanation_ta: தோழி! காதலரின் பிரிவால்துன்புற்று வருந்துகின்ற இன்றும் அவரை மறந்து விட்டால், அழகு கெட்டு என் தோள் மேல் அணிந்துள்ள அணிகள் கழலுமாறு நேரும்.

translation:
On victory intent, His mind sole company he went; And I yet life sustain And long to see his face again

Meaning: I still live by longing for the arrival of him who has gone out of love for victory and with valour as his guide
pope_couplet: On victory intent, His mind sole company he went; And I yet life sustain And long to see his face again
explanation_en: I still live by longing for the arrival of him who has gone out of love for victory and with valour as his guide
explanation_ta: வெற்றியை விரும்பி ஊக்கமே துணையாகக் கொண்டு வெளிநாட்டுக்குச் சென்ற காதலர், திரும்பி வருதலைக் காண விரும்பியே இன்னும் யான் உயிரோடு இருக்கின்றேன்.

translation:
'He comes again, who left my side, and I shall taste love's joy,'-My heart with rapture swells, when thoughts like these my mind employ

Meaning: My heart is rid of its sorrow and swells with rapture to think of my absent lover returning with his love
pope_couplet: 'He comes again, who left my side, and I shall taste love's joy,'-My heart with rapture swells, when thoughts like these my mind employ
explanation_en: My heart is rid of its sorrow and swells with rapture to think of my absent lover returning with his love
explanation_ta: முன்பு கூடியிருந்த காதலைக் கைவிட்டுப் பிரிந்த அவருடைய வருகை‌யைநினைத்து என் நெஞ்சம் மரத்தின் கிளைகளின் மேலும் ஏறிப் பார்க்கின்றது.

translation:
O let me see my spouse again and sate these longing eyes!That instant from my wasted frame all pallor flies

Meaning: May I look on my lover till I am satisfied and thereafter will vanish the sallowness of my slender shoulders
pope_couplet: O let me see my spouse again and sate these longing eyes!That instant from my wasted frame all pallor flies
explanation_en: May I look on my lover till I am satisfied and thereafter will vanish the sallowness of my slender shoulders
explanation_ta: என் காதலரைக் கண்ணாரக் காண்பேனாக; கண்ட பிறகு என்னுடைய மெல்லிய தோளில் உண்டாகிய பசலை நிறம் தானே நீங்கி விடும்.

translation:
O let my spouse but come again to me one day!I'll drink that nectar: wasting grief shall flee away

Meaning: May my husband return some day; and then will I enjoy (him) so as to destroy all this agonizing sorrow
pope_couplet: O let my spouse but come again to me one day!I'll drink that nectar: wasting grief shall flee away
explanation_en: May my husband return some day; and then will I enjoy (him) so as to destroy all this agonizing sorrow
explanation_ta: என் காதலன் ஒருநாள் என்னிடம் வருவானாக; வந்த பிறகு, என்னுடைய துன்பநோய் எல்லொம் தீருமாறு நான் நன்றாக நுகர்வேன்.

translation:
Shall I draw back, or yield myself, or shall both mingled be, When he returns, my spouse, dear as these eyes to me

Meaning: On the return of him who is as dear as my eyes, am I displeased or am I to embrace (him); or am I to do both?
pope_couplet: Shall I draw back, or yield myself, or shall both mingled be, When he returns, my spouse, dear as these eyes to me
explanation_en: On the return of him who is as dear as my eyes, am I displeased or am I to embrace (him); or am I to do both?
explanation_ta: என்னுடைய கண்போன்ற காதலர் வருவாரானால், யான் அவரோடு ஊடுவேனோ? அல்லது அவரைத் தழுவுவேனோ? அவரோடு கூடுவேனோ?

translation:
O would my king would fight, o'ercome, devide the spoil; At home, to-night, the banquet spread should crown the toil

Meaning: Let the king fight and gain (victories); (but) let me be united to my wife and feast the evening
pope_couplet: O would my king would fight, o'ercome, devide the spoil; At home, to-night, the banquet spread should crown the toil
explanation_en: Let the king fight and gain (victories); (but) let me be united to my wife and feast the evening
explanation_ta: அரசன் இச் செயலில் முனைந்து நின்று வெற்றி பெறுவானாக; அதன்பின் யாம் மனைவியோடு கூடியிருந்து அனறு வரும் மாலைப் பொழுதிற்கு விருந்து செய்வோம்.

translation:
One day will seem like seven to those who watch and yearnFor that glad day when wanderers from afar return

Meaning: To those who suffer waiting for the day of return of their distant lovers one day is as long as seven days
pope_couplet: One day will seem like seven to those who watch and yearnFor that glad day when wanderers from afar return
explanation_en: To those who suffer waiting for the day of return of their distant lovers one day is as long as seven days
explanation_ta: தொலைவில் உள்ள வெளிநாட்டிற்குச் சென்ற காதலர் திரும்பி வரும் நாளை நினைத்து ஏங்கும் மகளிர்க்கு ஒருநாள் ஏழுநாள் போல ( நெடிதாக) கழியும்.

translation:
What's my return, the meeting hour, the wished-for greeting worth, If she heart-broken lie, with all her life poured forth

Meaning: After (my wife) has died of a broken heart, what good will there be if she is to receive me, has received me, or has even embraced me?
pope_couplet: What's my return, the meeting hour, the wished-for greeting worth, If she heart-broken lie, with all her life poured forth
explanation_en: After (my wife) has died of a broken heart, what good will there be if she is to receive me, has received me, or has even embraced me?
explanation_ta: துன்பத்தைத் தாங்காமல் மனம் உடைந்து அழிந்து விட்டால், நம்மைத் திரும்பப்‌ பெறுவதனால் என்ன? பெற்றக்கால் என்ன? பெற்றுப் பொருந்தினாலும் என்ன?

translation:
Thou hid'st it, yet thine eye, disdaining all restraint, Something, I know not, what, would utter of complaint

Meaning: Though you would conceal (your feelings), your painted eyes would not, for, transgressing (their bounds), they tell (me) something
pope_couplet: Thou hid'st it, yet thine eye, disdaining all restraint, Something, I know not, what, would utter of complaint
explanation_en: Though you would conceal (your feelings), your painted eyes would not, for, transgressing (their bounds), they tell (me) something
explanation_ta: நீ சொல்லாமல் மறைத்தாலும் நிற்காமல் உன்னைக் கடந்து உன்னுடைய கண்கள் எனக்குச் சொல்லக் கூடிய செய்தி ஒன்று இருக்கிறது.

translation:
The simple one whose beauty fills mine eye, whose shoulders curveLike bambu stem, hath all a woman's modest sweet reserve

Meaning: Unusually great is the female simplicity of your maid whose beauty fills my eyes and whose shoulders resemble the bamboo
pope_couplet: The simple one whose beauty fills mine eye, whose shoulders curveLike bambu stem, hath all a woman's modest sweet reserve
explanation_en: Unusually great is the female simplicity of your maid whose beauty fills my eyes and whose shoulders resemble the bamboo
explanation_ta: கண் நிறைந்த அழகும் மூங்கில் போன்ற தோளும் உடைய என் காதலிக்குப் பெண்மைத்தன்மை நிறைந்து விளங்கும் இயல்பு மிகுதியாக உள்ளது.

translation:
As through the crystal beads is seen the thread on which they 're strungSo in her beauty gleams some thought cannot find a tongue

Meaning: There is something that is implied in the beauty of this woman, like the thread that is visible in a garland of gems
pope_couplet: As through the crystal beads is seen the thread on which they 're strungSo in her beauty gleams some thought cannot find a tongue
explanation_en: There is something that is implied in the beauty of this woman, like the thread that is visible in a garland of gems
