explanation_ta: ( கோத்த) மணியினுள் விளங்கும் நூலைப் போல் என் காதலியின் அழகினுள் விளங்குவதான குறிப்பு ஒன்று இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
As fragrance in the opening bud, some secret liesConcealed in budding smile of this dear damsel's eyes

Meaning: There is something in the unmatured smile of this maid like the fragrance that is contained in an unblossomed bud
pope_couplet: As fragrance in the opening bud, some secret liesConcealed in budding smile of this dear damsel's eyes
explanation_en: There is something in the unmatured smile of this maid like the fragrance that is contained in an unblossomed bud
explanation_ta: அரும்பு தோன்றும்போது அடங்கியிருக்கும் மணத்தைப் போல், காதலியின் புன்முறுவலின் தோற்றத்தில் அடங்கி இருக்கும் குறிப்பு ஒன்று உள்ளது.

translation:
The secret wiles of her with thronging armlets decked, Are medicines by which my raising grief is checked

Meaning: The well-meant departure of her whose bangles are tight-fitting contains a remedy that can cure my great sorrow
pope_couplet: The secret wiles of her with thronging armlets decked, Are medicines by which my raising grief is checked
explanation_en: The well-meant departure of her whose bangles are tight-fitting contains a remedy that can cure my great sorrow
explanation_ta: காதலி என்னை நோக்கி செய்து விட்டுச் சென்ற கள்ளமான குறிப்பு, என் மிக்க துயரத்தைத் தீர்க்கும் மருந்து ஒன்று உடையதாக இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
While lovingly embracing me, his heart is only grieved:It makes me think that I again shall live of love bereaved

Meaning: The embrace that fills me with comfort and gladness is capable of enduring (my former) sorrow and meditating on his want of love
pope_couplet: While lovingly embracing me, his heart is only grieved:It makes me think that I again shall live of love bereaved
explanation_en: The embrace that fills me with comfort and gladness is capable of enduring (my former) sorrow and meditating on his want of love
explanation_ta: பெரிதும் அன்பு செய்து விரும்புமாறு கூடுதல், அரிதாகிய பிரிவைச் செய்து பிறகு அன்பில்லாமல்கைவிட எண்ணுகின்ற குறிப்பை உடையதாகும்.

translation:
My severance from the lord of this cool shore, My very armlets told me long before

Meaning: My bracelets have understood before me the (mental) separation of him who rules the cool seashore
pope_couplet: My severance from the lord of this cool shore, My very armlets told me long before
explanation_en: My bracelets have understood before me the (mental) separation of him who rules the cool seashore
explanation_ta: குளிர்ந்த துறையை உடைய காதலன் பிரிந்த பிரிவை நம்மை விட முன்னம‌ே நம்முடைய வளையல்கள் உணர்ந்து கழன்று விட்டனவே!

translation:
My loved one left me, was it yesterday?Days seven my pallid body wastes away

Meaning: It was but yesterday my lover departed (from me); and it is seven days since my complexion turned sallow
pope_couplet: My loved one left me, was it yesterday?Days seven my pallid body wastes away
explanation_en: It was but yesterday my lover departed (from me); and it is seven days since my complexion turned sallow
explanation_ta: எம்முடைய காதலர் நேற்றுதான் பிரிந்து சென்றார்; யாமும் மேனி பசலை நிறம் அடைந்து ஏழு நாட்கள் ஆய்விட்ட நிலையில் இருக்கின்றோம்.

translation:
She viewed her tender arms, she viewed the armlets from them slid; She viewed her feet: all this the lady did

Meaning: She looked at her bracelets, her tender shoulders, and her feet; this was what she did there (significantly)
pope_couplet: She viewed her tender arms, she viewed the armlets from them slid; She viewed her feet: all this the lady did
explanation_en: She looked at her bracelets, her tender shoulders, and her feet; this was what she did there (significantly)
explanation_ta: தன்னுடைய வளையல்களை நோக்கி, மெல்லிய தோள்களையும் நோக்கித் தன்னுடைய அடிகளையும் நோக்கி அவள் செய்த குறிப்பு உடன்போக்காகிய அதுவேயாகும்.

translation:
To show by eye the pain of love, and for relief to pray, Is womanhood's most womanly device, men say

Meaning: To express their love-sickness by their eyes and resort to begging bespeaks more than ordinary female excellence
pope_couplet: To show by eye the pain of love, and for relief to pray, Is womanhood's most womanly device, men say
explanation_en: To express their love-sickness by their eyes and resort to begging bespeaks more than ordinary female excellence
explanation_ta: கண்ணினால் காமநோயைத் தெரிவித்துப் பிரியாமல் இருக்குமாறு இரத்தல், பெண் தன்மைக்கு மேலும் பெண் தன்மை உடையது என்று கூறுவர்.

translation:
Gladness at the thought, rejoicing at the sight, Not palm-tree wine, but love, yields such delight

Meaning: To please by thought and cheer by sight is peculiar, not to liquor but lust
pope_couplet: Gladness at the thought, rejoicing at the sight, Not palm-tree wine, but love, yields such delight
explanation_en: To please by thought and cheer by sight is peculiar, not to liquor but lust
explanation_ta: நினைத்த அளவிலே களிப்படைதலும் கண்ட அளவிலே மகிழ்ச்சி அடைதலும் ஆகிய இந்த இருவகை தன்மையும் கள்ளுக்கு இல்‌லை; காமத்திற்கு உண்டு

translation:
When as palmyra tall, fulness of perfect love we gain, Distrust can find no place small as the millet grain

Meaning: If women have a lust that exceeds even the measure of the palmyra fruit, they will not desire (to feign) dislike even as much as the millet
pope_couplet: When as palmyra tall, fulness of perfect love we gain, Distrust can find no place small as the millet grain
explanation_en: If women have a lust that exceeds even the measure of the palmyra fruit, they will not desire (to feign) dislike even as much as the millet
explanation_ta: காமம் பனையளவாக நிறைய வரும்போது காதலரோடு தினையளவாகச் சிறிதேனும் ஊடல் கொள்ளாமல் இருக்க வேண்டும்.

translation:
Although his will his only law, he lightly value me, My heart knows no repose unless my lord I see

Meaning: Though my eyes disregard me and do what is pleasing to my husband, still will they not be satisfied unless they see him
pope_couplet: Although his will his only law, he lightly value me, My heart knows no repose unless my lord I see
explanation_en: Though my eyes disregard me and do what is pleasing to my husband, still will they not be satisfied unless they see him
explanation_ta: என்னை விரும்பாமல் புறக்கணித்துத் தனக்கு விருப்பமானவற்றையே செய்து ஒழுகினாலும், என்னுடைய கண்கள் காதலனைக் காணாமல் பொருந்தவில்லை.

translation:
My friend, I went prepared to show a cool disdain; My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain

Meaning: My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain
pope_couplet: My friend, I went prepared to show a cool disdain; My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain
explanation_en: My heart, forgetting all, could not its love restrain
explanation_ta: தோழி! யான் அவரோடு ஊடுவதற்காகச் சென்றேன்; ஆனால், என்னுடைய நெஞ்சம் அந்த நோக்கத்தை மறந்து அவரோடு கூடுவதற்காகச் சென்றது.

translation:
The eye sees not the rod that paints it; nor can ISee any fault, when I behold my husband nigh

Meaning: Like the eyes which see not the pencil that paints it, I cannot see my husband's fault (just) when I meet him
pope_couplet: The eye sees not the rod that paints it; nor can ISee any fault, when I behold my husband nigh
explanation_en: Like the eyes which see not the pencil that paints it, I cannot see my husband's fault (just) when I meet him
explanation_ta: மை தீட்டும் நேரத்தில் தீட்டு் கோலைக் காணாத கண்களைப் போல், காதலனைக் கண்டபோது மட்டும் அவனுடைய குற்றத்தை நினைக்காமல் மறந்து விடுகின்றேன்.

translation:
When him I see, to all his faults I 'm blind; But when I see him not, nothing but faults I find

Meaning: When I see my husband, I do not see any faults; but when I do not see him, I do not see anything but faults
pope_couplet: When him I see, to all his faults I 'm blind; But when I see him not, nothing but faults I find
explanation_en: When I see my husband, I do not see any faults; but when I do not see him, I do not see anything but faults
explanation_ta: காதலரைக் யான் காணும்போது ( அவருடைய செயல்களில்) தவறானவற்றைக் காண்பதில்லை; அவரைக் காணாதபோது தவறு அல்லாத நன்மைகளைக் காண்பதில்லை.

translation:
As those of rescue sure, who plunge into the stream, So did I anger feign, though it must falsehood seem

Meaning: Like those who leap into a stream which they know will carry them off, why should a wife feign dislike which she knows cannot hold out long?
pope_couplet: As those of rescue sure, who plunge into the stream, So did I anger feign, though it must falsehood seem
explanation_en: Like those who leap into a stream which they know will carry them off, why should a wife feign dislike which she knows cannot hold out long?
explanation_ta: வெள்ளம் இழுத்துச் செல்வதை அறிந்திருந்தும் ஓட் நீரில் பாய்கின்றவரைப் போல், பயன்படாமை அறிந்திருந்திருந்தும் ஊடல் கொள்வதால் பயன் ன்னெ?

translation:
Though shameful ill it works, dear is the palm-tree wineTo drunkards; traitor, so to me that breast of thine

Meaning: O you rogue! your breast is to me what liquor is to those who rejoice in it, though it only gives them an unpleasant disgrace
pope_couplet: Though shameful ill it works, dear is the palm-tree wineTo drunkards; traitor, so to me that breast of thine
explanation_en: O you rogue! your breast is to me what liquor is to those who rejoice in it, though it only gives them an unpleasant disgrace
explanation_ta: கள்வ! இழிவு வரத்தக்க துன்பங்களைச் செய்தாலும் கள்ளுண்டு களித்தவர்க்கு மேன்‌மேலும் விருப்பம் தரும் கள்ளைப் போன்றது உன் மார்பு.

translation:
Love is tender as an opening flower In season dueTo gain its perfect bliss is rapture known to few

Meaning: Sexual delight is more delicate than a flower, and few are those who understand its real nature
pope_couplet: Love is tender as an opening flower In season dueTo gain its perfect bliss is rapture known to few
explanation_en: Sexual delight is more delicate than a flower, and few are those who understand its real nature
explanation_ta: காமம் மலரை விட மென்மை உடையதாகும்; அந்த உண்மை அறிந்து அதன் நல்ல பயனைப் பெறக்கூடியவர் சிலரே.

translation:
Her eye, as I drew nigh one day, with anger shone:By love o'erpowered, her tenderness surpassed my own

Meaning: She once feigned dislike in her eyes, but the warmth of her embrace exceeded my own
pope_couplet: Her eye, as I drew nigh one day, with anger shone:By love o'erpowered, her tenderness surpassed my own
explanation_en: She once feigned dislike in her eyes, but the warmth of her embrace exceeded my own
explanation_ta: கண் பார்வையின் அளவில் பிணங்கி, என்னை விடத் தான் விரைந்து தழுவுதலை விரும்பி, ( பிணங்கிய நிலையையும் மறந்து) கலந்து விட்டாள்.

translation:
You see his heart is his aloneO heart, why not be all my own

Meaning: O my soul! although you have seen how his soul stands by him, how is it you do not stand by me?
pope_couplet: You see his heart is his aloneO heart, why not be all my own
explanation_en: O my soul! although you have seen how his soul stands by him, how is it you do not stand by me?
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே! அவருடைய நெஞ்சம் ( நம்மை நினையாமல் நம்மிடம் வராமல்) அவர்க்குத் துணையாதலைக் கண்டும் நீ எமக்குத் துணையாகாதது ஏன்?

translation:
'Tis plain, my heart, that he 's estranged from thee; Why go to him as though he were not enemy

Meaning: O my soul! although you have known him who does not love me, still do you go to him, saying "he will not be displeased."
pope_couplet: 'Tis plain, my heart, that he 's estranged from thee; Why go to him as though he were not enemy
explanation_en: O my soul! although you have known him who does not love me, still do you go to him, saying "he will not be displeased."
explanation_ta: என் நெஞசே! நம்மேல் அன்பு கொள்ளாத காதலரைக் கண்டபோதும், அவர் வெறுக்கமாட்டார் என்று எண்ணி அவரிடம் செல்கின்றாயே!

translation:
'The ruined have no friends, 'they say; and so, my heart, To follow him, at thy desire, from me thou dost depart

Meaning: O my soul! do you follow him at pleasure under the belief that the ruined have no friends?
pope_couplet: 'The ruined have no friends, 'they say; and so, my heart, To follow him, at thy desire, from me thou dost depart
explanation_en: O my soul! do you follow him at pleasure under the belief that the ruined have no friends?
explanation_ta: நெஞ்சே! நீ உன் விருப்பத்தின்படியே அவர் பின் செல்வதற்குக் காரணம், துன்பத்தால் அழிந்தவர்‌க்கு நண்பர் இல்லை என்னும் எண்ண‌மோ?

translation:
'See, thou first show offended pride, and then submit,' I bade; Henceforth such council who will share with thee my heart

Meaning: O my soul! you would not first seem sulky and then enjoy (him); who then would in future consult you about such things?
pope_couplet: 'See, thou first show offended pride, and then submit,' I bade; Henceforth such council who will share with thee my heart
explanation_en: O my soul! you would not first seem sulky and then enjoy (him); who then would in future consult you about such things?
explanation_ta: நெஞ்‌சே! நீ ஊடலைச் செய்து அதன் பயனை நுகர மாட்டாய்; இனிமேல் அத்தகையவற்றைப் பற்றி உன்னோடு கலந்து எண்ணப் போகின்றவர் யார்?

translation:
I fear I shall not gain, I fear to lose him when I gain; And thus my heart endures unceasing pain

Meaning: My soul fears when it is without him; it also fears when it is with him; it is subject to incessant sorrow
pope_couplet: I fear I shall not gain, I fear to lose him when I gain; And thus my heart endures unceasing pain
explanation_en: My soul fears when it is without him; it also fears when it is with him; it is subject to incessant sorrow
explanation_ta: ( காதலரைப் பெறாதபோது) பெறாமைக்கு அஞ்சும்; பெற்றால் பிரிவை நினைத்து அஞ்சும்; ( இவ்வாறாக) என் நெஞ்சம் தீராத துன்பம் உடையதாகின்றது.

translation:
My heart consumes me when I ponder lone, And all my lover's cruelty bemoan

Meaning: My mind has been (here) in order to eat me up (as it were) whenever I think of him in my solitude
pope_couplet: My heart consumes me when I ponder lone, And all my lover's cruelty bemoan
explanation_en: My mind has been (here) in order to eat me up (as it were) whenever I think of him in my solitude
explanation_ta: காதலரைப் பிரிந்து தனியே இருந்து அவருடைய தவறுகளை நினைத்தபோது என் நெஞ்சம் என்னைத் தின்பது போல் துன்பம் செய்வதாக இருந்தது.

translation:
Fall'n 'neath the sway of this ignoble foolish heart, Which will not him forget, I have forgotten shame

Meaning: I have even forgotten my modesty, having been caught in my foolish mind which is not dignified enough to forget him
pope_couplet: Fall'n 'neath the sway of this ignoble foolish heart, Which will not him forget, I have forgotten shame
explanation_en: I have even forgotten my modesty, having been caught in my foolish mind which is not dignified enough to forget him
explanation_ta: காதலனை மறக்க முடியாத என்னுடைய சிறப்பில்லாத மட நெஞ்சினோடு சேர்ந்து, மறக்கத் தகாததாகிய நாணத்தையும் மறந்து விடடேன்.

translation:
If I contemn him, then disgrace awaits me evermore; My soul that seeks to live his virtues numbers o'er

Meaning: My soul which clings to life thinks only of his (own) gain in the belief that it would be disgraceful for it to despise him
pope_couplet: If I contemn him, then disgrace awaits me evermore; My soul that seeks to live his virtues numbers o'er
explanation_en: My soul which clings to life thinks only of his (own) gain in the belief that it would be disgraceful for it to despise him
explanation_ta: உயரின் மேல் காதல் கொண்ட என் நெஞ்சம், பிரிந்த காதலரை இகழ்ந்தால் இழிவாகும் என்று எண்ணி அவருடைய உயர்ந்த பண்புகளையே நினைக்கின்றது.

translation:
And who will aid me in my hour of grief, If my own heart comes not to my relief

Meaning: Who would help me out of one's distress, when one's own soul refuses help to one?
pope_couplet: And who will aid me in my hour of grief, If my own heart comes not to my relief
explanation_en: Who would help me out of one's distress, when one's own soul refuses help to one?
explanation_ta: ஒருவர்க்குத் துன்பம் வந்தபோது, தாம் உரிமையாகப் பெற்றுள்ள நெஞ்சமே துணையாகா விட்டால், வேறு யார் துணையாவார்?

translation:
A trifle is unfriendliness by aliens shown, When our own heart itself is not our own

Meaning: It is hardly possible for strangers to behave like relations, when one's own soul acts like a stranger
pope_couplet: A trifle is unfriendliness by aliens shown, When our own heart itself is not our own
explanation_en: It is hardly possible for strangers to behave like relations, when one's own soul acts like a stranger
explanation_ta: ஒருவர்க்கு தாம் உரிமையாகப் பெற்ற நெஞ்சமே உறவாகாதபோது அயலார் உறவில்லாதவராக இருப்பது எளிதேயாகும்.

translation:
Be still reserved, decline his profferred love; A little while his sore distress we 'll prove

Meaning: Let us witness awhile his keen suffering; just feign dislike and embrace him not
pope_couplet: Be still reserved, decline his profferred love; A little while his sore distress we 'll prove
explanation_en: Let us witness awhile his keen suffering; just feign dislike and embrace him not
explanation_ta: ( ஊடும்போது அவர் அடைகின்ற) துன்ப நோயைச் சிறிது காண்போம்; அதற்காக அவரைத் தழுவாமலிருந்து பிணங்குவாயாக.

translation:
A cool reserve is like the salt that seasons well the mess, Too long maintained, 'tis like the salt's excess

Meaning: A little dislike is like salt in proportion; to prolong it a little is like salt a little too much
pope_couplet: A cool reserve is like the salt that seasons well the mess, Too long maintained, 'tis like the salt's excess
explanation_en: A little dislike is like salt in proportion; to prolong it a little is like salt a little too much
explanation_ta: உப்பு, உணவில் அளவோடு அமைந்திருப்பதைப் போன்றது ஊடல்; ஊடலை அளவு கடந்து நீட்டித்தல், அந்த உப்பு சிறிதளவு மிகுதியாக இருப்பதைப் போன்றது.

translation:
'Tis heaping griefs on those whose hearts are grieved; To leave the grieving one without a fond embrace

Meaning: For men not to embrace those who have feigned dislike is like torturing those already in agony
pope_couplet: 'Tis heaping griefs on those whose hearts are grieved; To leave the grieving one without a fond embrace
explanation_en: For men not to embrace those who have feigned dislike is like torturing those already in agony
explanation_ta: தம்மோடு பிணங்கியவரை ஊடலுணர்த்தித் தழுவாமல் விடுதல், துன்பத்தால் வருந்தியவரை மேலும் துன்ப நோய் செய்து வரத்தினாற் போன்றது.

translation:
To use no kind conciliating art when lover grieves, Is cutting out the root of tender winding plant that droops

Meaning: Not to reconcile those who have feigned dislike is like cutting a faded creeper at its root
pope_couplet: To use no kind conciliating art when lover grieves, Is cutting out the root of tender winding plant that droops
explanation_en: Not to reconcile those who have feigned dislike is like cutting a faded creeper at its root
explanation_ta: பிணங்கியவரை ஊடலுணர்த்தி அன்பு செய்யாமல் இருத்தல், முன்னமே வாடியுள்ள கொடியை அதன் அடியிலேயே அறுத்தல் போன்றது.

translation:
Even to men of good and worthy mind, the petulanceOf wives with flowery eyes lacks not a lovely grace

Meaning: An increased shyness in those whose eyes are like flowers is beautiful even to good and virtuous husbands
pope_couplet: Even to men of good and worthy mind, the petulanceOf wives with flowery eyes lacks not a lovely grace
explanation_en: An increased shyness in those whose eyes are like flowers is beautiful even to good and virtuous husbands
explanation_ta: நல்ல பண்புகள் அமைந்த நல்ல ஆடவர்க்கு அழகு, மலர் போன்ற கண்களை உடைய மகளிரின் நெஞ்சம் விளையும் ஊடலின் சிறப்பே ஆகும்.

translation:
Love without hatred is ripened fruit; Without some lesser strife, fruit immature

Meaning: Sexual pleasure, without prolonged and short-lived dislike, is like too ripe, and unripe fruit
pope_couplet: Love without hatred is ripened fruit; Without some lesser strife, fruit immature
explanation_en: Sexual pleasure, without prolonged and short-lived dislike, is like too ripe, and unripe fruit
explanation_ta: பெரும் பிணக்கும் சிறு பிணக்கும் இல்லாவிட்டால், காமம் மிகப் பழுத்த பழமும் முற்றாத இளங்காயும் போல் பயன்படாததாகும்.

translation:
A lovers' quarrel brings its pain, when mind afraidAsks doubtful, 'Will reunion sweet be long delayed?'

Meaning: The doubt as to whether intercourse would take place soon or not, creates a sorrow (even) in feigned dislike
pope_couplet: A lovers' quarrel brings its pain, when mind afraidAsks doubtful, 'Will reunion sweet be long delayed?'
explanation_en: The doubt as to whether intercourse would take place soon or not, creates a sorrow (even) in feigned dislike
explanation_ta: கூடியிருக்கும் இன்பம் இனிமேல் நீட்டிக்காதோ என்று ஏங்கி எண்ணுவதால் ஊடியிருத்தலினும் காதலர்க்கு ஒருவகைத் துன்பம் இருக்கின்றது.

translation:
What good can grieving do, when none who loveAre there to know the grief thy soul endures

Meaning: What avails sorrow when I am without a wife who can understand the cause of my sorrow?
pope_couplet: What good can grieving do, when none who loveAre there to know the grief thy soul endures
explanation_en: What avails sorrow when I am without a wife who can understand the cause of my sorrow?
explanation_ta: நம்மால் இவர் வருந்தினார் என்று அந்த வருத்தத்தை அறிகின்ற காதலர் இல்லாதபோது, வருந்துவதால் பயன் என்ன?

translation:
Water is pleasant in the cooling shade; So coolness for a time with those we love

Meaning: Like water in the shade, dislike is delicious only in those who love
pope_couplet: Water is pleasant in the cooling shade; So coolness for a time with those we love
explanation_en: Like water in the shade, dislike is delicious only in those who love
explanation_ta: நீரும் நிழலை அடுத்திருப்பதே இனிமையானது; அதுபோல், ஊடலும் அன்பு செலுத்துவோரிடத்தில் கொள்வதே இன்பமானது.

translation:
Of her who leaves me thus in variance languishing, To think within my heart with love is fond desire

Meaning: It is nothing but strong desire that makes her mind unite with me who can leave her to her own dislike
pope_couplet: Of her who leaves me thus in variance languishing, To think within my heart with love is fond desire
explanation_en: It is nothing but strong desire that makes her mind unite with me who can leave her to her own dislike
explanation_ta: ஊடல் கொண்ட‌போது உணர்த்தி மகிழ்விக்காமல் வாட விடுகின்றவரோடு என் நெஞ்சம் கூடியிருப்போம் என்று முயல்வதற்குக் காரணம் அதன் ஆசையே.

translation:
From thy regard all womankind Enjoys an equal grace; O thou of wandering fickle mind, I shrink from thine embrace

Meaning: You are given to prostitution; all those who are born as womankind enjoy you with their eyes in an ordinary way I will not embrace you
pope_couplet: From thy regard all womankind Enjoys an equal grace; O thou of wandering fickle mind, I shrink from thine embrace
explanation_en: You are given to prostitution; all those who are born as womankind enjoy you with their eyes in an ordinary way I will not embrace you
explanation_ta: பரத்தமை உடையாய்! பெண் தன்மை உடையவர் எல்லாரும் தம்தம் கண்களால் ‌பொதுப் பொருளாகக் கொண்டு நுகர்கின்றார்கள்; ஆகையால் உன் மார்பைப் பொருந்தேன்.

translation:
One day we silent sulked; he sneezed: The reason well I knew; He thought that I, to speak well pleased, Would say, 'Long life to you!'

Meaning: When I continued to be sulky he sneezed and thought I would (then) wish him a long life
pope_couplet: One day we silent sulked; he sneezed: The reason well I knew; He thought that I, to speak well pleased, Would say, 'Long life to you!'
explanation_en: When I continued to be sulky he sneezed and thought I would (then) wish him a long life
explanation_ta: காதலரோடு ஊடல் கொண்டிருந்தோமாக, யாம் தம்மை நெடுங்காலம் வாழ்க என்று வாய் திறந்து சொல்லுவோம் என நினைத்து அவர் தும்மினார்.

translation:
I wreathed with flowers one day my brow, The angry tempest lowers; She cries, 'Pray, for what woman now Do you put on your flowers?'

Meaning: Even if I were adorned with a garland of branch-flowers, she would say I did so to show it to another woman
pope_couplet: I wreathed with flowers one day my brow, The angry tempest lowers; She cries, 'Pray, for what woman now Do you put on your flowers?'
explanation_en: Even if I were adorned with a garland of branch-flowers, she would say I did so to show it to another woman
explanation_ta: கிளைகளில் மலர்ந்த மலர்களைச் சூடினாலும், நீர் இந்த அழகை யாரோ ஒருத்திக்கு காட்டுவதற்காகச் சூடினீர் என்று சினம் கொள்வாள்.

translation:
'I love you more than all beside,' 'T was thus I gently spoke;'What all, what all?' she instant cried; And all her anger woke

Meaning: When I said I loved her more than any other woman, she said "more than others, yes, more than others," and remained sulky
pope_couplet: 'I love you more than all beside,' 'T was thus I gently spoke;'What all, what all?' she instant cried; And all her anger woke
explanation_en: When I said I loved her more than any other woman, she said "more than others, yes, more than others," and remained sulky
explanation_ta: யாரையும் விட நாம் மிக்க காதல் கொண்டிருக்கிறோம் என்று சொன்னேனாக; ய‌ாரை விட...? யாரை விட..? என்று கேட்டு ஊடல் கொண்டாள்.

translation:
'While here I live, I leave you not,' I said to calm her fearsShe cried, 'There, then, I read your thought'; And straight dissolved in tears

Meaning: When I said I would never part from her in this life her eyes were filled with tears
pope_couplet: 'While here I live, I leave you not,' I said to calm her fearsShe cried, 'There, then, I read your thought'; And straight dissolved in tears
explanation_en: When I said I would never part from her in this life her eyes were filled with tears
explanation_ta: இப்பிறப்பில் யாம் பிரிய மாட்டோம் என்று காதலியிடம் சொன்னேனாக, இனி வரும் பிறப்பில் பிரிவதாக உணர்ந்து கண் நிறையக் கண்ணீர் கொண்டாள்.

translation:
'Each day I called to mind your charms,' 'O, then, you had forgot,'She cried, and then her opened arms, Forthwith embraced me not

Meaning: When I said I had remembered her, she said I had forgotten her and relaxing her embrace, began to feign dislike
pope_couplet: 'Each day I called to mind your charms,' 'O, then, you had forgot,'She cried, and then her opened arms, Forthwith embraced me not
explanation_en: When I said I had remembered her, she said I had forgotten her and relaxing her embrace, began to feign dislike
explanation_ta: நினைத்தேன் என்று கூறி‌னேன்; நினைப்புக்கு முன் மறப்பு உண்டு அன்றோ? ஏன் மறந்தீர் என்று என்னைத் தழுவாமல் ஊடினாள்.

translation:
She hailed me when I sneezed one day; But straight with anger seized, She cried; 'Who was the woman, pray, Thinking of whom you sneezed?'

Meaning: When I sneezed she blessed me, but at once changed (her mind) and wept, asking, "At the thought of whom did you sneeze?"
pope_couplet: She hailed me when I sneezed one day; But straight with anger seized, She cried; 'Who was the woman, pray, Thinking of whom you sneezed?'
explanation_en: When I sneezed she blessed me, but at once changed (her mind) and wept, asking, "At the thought of whom did you sneeze?"
explanation_ta: யான் தும்மினேனாக; அவள் நூறாண்டு என வாழ்த்தினாள்; உடனே அதை விட்டு யார் நினைத்ததால் தும்மினீர்? என்று கேட்டு அழுதாள்?

translation:
And so next time I checked my sneeze; She forthwith wept and cried,(That woman difficult to please), 'Your thoughts from me you hide'

Meaning: When I suppressed my sneezing, she wept saying, "I suppose you (did so) to hide from me your own people's remembrance of you"
pope_couplet: And so next time I checked my sneeze; She forthwith wept and cried,(That woman difficult to please), 'Your thoughts from me you hide'
explanation_en: When I suppressed my sneezing, she wept saying, "I suppose you (did so) to hide from me your own people's remembrance of you"
explanation_ta: அவளுடைய ஊடலுக்கு அஞ்சி யான் தும்மலை அடக்கிக் கொள்ள உம்மவர் உம்மை நினைப்பதை எமக்குத் தெரியாமல் மறைக்கின்றீரோ என்று அழுதாள்.

translation:
I then began to soothe and coax, To calm her jealous mind;'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind

Meaning: 'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind' Even when I try to remove her dislike, she is displeased and says, "This is the way you behave
pope_couplet: I then began to soothe and coax, To calm her jealous mind;'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind
explanation_en: 'I see', quoth she, 'to other folks How you are wondrous kind' Even when I try to remove her dislike, she is displeased and says, "This is the way you behave
explanation_ta: ஊடியிருந்தபோது அவளை ஊடல் உணர்த்தி மகிழ்வித்தாலும், நீர் மற்ற மகளிர்க்கும் இத்தன்மையானவராக ஆவீர் என்று ‌சொல்லிச் சினம் கொள்வாள்.

translation:
I silent sat, but thought the more, And gazed on her Then sheCried out, 'While thus you eye me o'er, Tell me whose form you see'

Meaning: Even when I look on her contemplating (her beauty), she is displeased and says, "With whose thought have you (thus) looked on my person?"
pope_couplet: I silent sat, but thought the more, And gazed on her Then sheCried out, 'While thus you eye me o'er, Tell me whose form you see'
explanation_en: Even when I look on her contemplating (her beauty), she is displeased and says, "With whose thought have you (thus) looked on my person?"
explanation_ta: அவளுடைய அழகை நி‌னைத்து அமைதியாக இருந்து நோக்கினாலும், நீர் யாரை நினைத்து ஒப்புமையாக எல்லாம் பார்க்கின்றீர்? என்று சினம் கொள்வாள்.

translation:
Although there be no fault in him, the sweetness of his loveHath power in me a fretful jealousy to move

Meaning: Although my husband is free from defects, the way in which he embraces me is such as to make me feign dislike
pope_couplet: Although there be no fault in him, the sweetness of his loveHath power in me a fretful jealousy to move
explanation_en: Although my husband is free from defects, the way in which he embraces me is such as to make me feign dislike
explanation_ta: அவரிடம் தவறு ஒன்றும் இல்லையானலும், அவரோடு ஊடுதல், அவர் நம்மேல் மிகுதியாக அன்பு செலுத்துமாறு செய்ய வல்லது.

translation:
My 'anger feigned' gives but a little pain; And when affection droops, it makes it bloom again

Meaning: His love will increase though it may (at first seem to) fade through the short-lived distress caused by (my) dislike
pope_couplet: My 'anger feigned' gives but a little pain; And when affection droops, it makes it bloom again
explanation_en: His love will increase though it may (at first seem to) fade through the short-lived distress caused by (my) dislike
explanation_ta: ஊடுதலால் உண்டாகின்ற சிறிய துன்பம், காதலர் செய்கின்ற நல்ல அன்பு வாடிவிடக் காரணமாக இருந்தாலும் பெருமை பெறும்.

translation:
Is there a bliss in any world more utterly divine, Than 'coyness' gives, when hearts as earth and water join

Meaning: Is there a celestial land that can please like the feigned dislike of those whose union resembles that of earth and water?
pope_couplet: Is there a bliss in any world more utterly divine, Than 'coyness' gives, when hearts as earth and water join
explanation_en: Is there a celestial land that can please like the feigned dislike of those whose union resembles that of earth and water?
explanation_ta: நிலத்தோடு நீர் பொருந்தி கலந்தாற் போன்ற அன்புடைய காதலரிடத்தில் ஊடுவதை விட இன்பம் தருகின்ற தேவருலம் இருக்கின்றதோ.

translation:
'Within the anger feigned' that close love's tie doth bind, A weapon lurks, which quite breaks down my mind

Meaning: In prolonged dislike after an embrace there is a weapon that can break my heart
pope_couplet: 'Within the anger feigned' that close love's tie doth bind, A weapon lurks, which quite breaks down my mind
explanation_en: In prolonged dislike after an embrace there is a weapon that can break my heart
explanation_ta: காதலரைத் தழுவிக்கொண்டு விடாமலிருப்பதற்கு காரணமான ஊடலுள், என்னுடைய உள்ளத்தை உடைக்க வல்ல படை தோன்றுகிறது.

translation:
Though free from fault, from loved one's tender armsTo be estranged a while hath its own special charms

Meaning: Though free from defects, men feel pleased when they cannot embrace the delicate shoulders of those whom they love
pope_couplet: Though free from fault, from loved one's tender armsTo be estranged a while hath its own special charms
explanation_en: Though free from defects, men feel pleased when they cannot embrace the delicate shoulders of those whom they love

translation:
'Tis sweeter to digest your food than 'tis to eat; In love, than union's self is anger feigned more sweet

Meaning: To digest what has been eaten is more delightful than to eat more; likewise love is more delightful in dislike than intercourse

translation:
Let her, whose jewels brightly shine, aversion feignThat I may still plead on, O night, prolong thy reign

Meaning: May the bright-jewelled one feign dislike, and may the night be prolonged for me to implore her!

translation:

Meaning: Dislike adds delight to love; and a hearty embrace (thereafter) will add delight to dislike
